examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢話嗰件事同我哋冇關連，唔好扯埋我哋落水。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 waa6 go2 gin6 si6 tung4 ngo5 dei6 mou5 gwaan1 lin4, m4 hou2 ce2 maai4 ngo5 dei6 lok6 seoi2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他说那件事和我们没有关联，别把我们牵连进去。
examples.english_sentence: He says that matter has no connection to us — don't drag us into it.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢件事可能會關連到好多人，要調查清楚。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 gin6 si6 ho2 nang4 wui5 gwaan1 lin4 dou3 hou2 do1 jan4, jiu3 diu6 caa4 cing1 co2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这件事可能会牵连到很多人，需要调查清楚。
examples.english_sentence: This matter could involve many people; it needs to be investigated thoroughly.

mandarin_meaning: 关键（最重要或决定性的部分）
english_meaning: key; crucial; decisive; the most important or determining factor
explanation_mandarin: 表示事物中最重要的部分或決定成敗的要素，常用來形容關鍵點、關鍵人物或關鍵時刻。
explanation_english: Refers to the most important part of something or the decisive factor that determines success or failure; commonly used to describe a key point, person, or moment.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢個係成功嘅關鍵。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 go3 hai6 sing4 gung1 ge3 gwaan1 gin3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这是成功的关键。
examples.english_sentence: This is the key to success.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢喺團隊入面係個關鍵人物。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hai2 tyun4 deoi2 jap6 min6 hai6 go3 gwaan1 gin3 jan4 mat6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他在团队里是关键人物。
examples.english_sentence: He is a key person in the team.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 問題嘅關鍵係我哋冇足夠資金。
examples.jyutping_sentence: man6 tai4 ge3 gwaan1 gin3 hai6 ngo5 dei6 mou5 zuk1 gau3 zi1 gam1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 问题的关键是我们没有足够的资金。
examples.english_sentence: The crux of the problem is that we don't have enough funds.

mandarin_meaning: 关键词 (guānjiànzì)
english_meaning: keyword
explanation_mandarin: 指用來檢索、分類或描述內容的重要字詞，常用於搜尋引擎、資料檢索或廣告投放（如 SEO 中的關鍵字選擇）。
explanation_english: Refers to important words used to index, search, or describe content; commonly used in search engines, data retrieval, advertising, and SEO keyword selection.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 喺做SEO嘅時候，選擇啱嘅關鍵字好重要。
examples.jyutping_sentence: hai2 zou6 SEO ge3 si4 hau6, syun2 zaak6 aam1 ge3 gwaan1 gin6 zi6 hou2 zung6 jiu3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 在做 SEO 的時候，選擇合適的關鍵字很重要。
examples.english_sentence: When doing SEO, choosing the right keywords is very important.

mandarin_meaning: 关门大吉 (關門大吉)
english_meaning: to close up shop; to shut down; to call it quits; that's the end
explanation_mandarin: 表示結束營業或事情結束、停止活動。可用來形容店舖倒閉、停止營業，或口語上表示『結束了／完蛋了』。
explanation_english: Used to indicate closing up shop or that something has ended/stopped. Can describe a business shutting down or colloquially mean 'it's over' or 'that's it'.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 今晚六點就關門大吉喇，唔好再入嚟買嘢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gam1 maan5 luk6 dim2 zau6 gwaan1 mun4 daai6 gat1 laa3, m4 hou2 zoi3 jap6 lai4 maai5 je5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 今晚六點就關門大吉了，別再進來買東西。
examples.english_sentence: We close at 6 tonight — don't come in to buy anything.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 嗰間舖因為生意差，最後要關門大吉。
examples.jyutping_sentence: go2 gaan1 pou3 jan1 wai6 saang1 ji3 caa1, zeoi3 hau6 jiu3 gwaan1 mun4 daai6 gat1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 那家店因為生意差，最後不得不關門大吉。
examples.english_sentence: That shop had to shut down in the end because business was bad.

mandarin_meaning: 关闭 (guān bì)
english_meaning: to close; to shut; to turn off
explanation_mandarin: 表示把門、開關、系統等關上或使其停止運作。
explanation_english: Indicates closing or shutting something (a door, switch, system) or stopping its operation.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 請關閉電源。
examples.jyutping_sentence: cing2 gwaan1 bai3 din6 jyun4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 请关闭电源。
examples.english_sentence: Please turn off the power.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢間舖因為生意唔好，就關閉咗。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 gaan1 pou3 jan1 wai6 saang1 ji3 m4 hou2, zau6 gwaan1 bai3 zo2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这家店因为生意不好，所以关门了。
examples.english_sentence: This shop closed because business was poor.

mandarin_meaning: 关键时刻；紧要关头
english_meaning: critical moment; crucial point; turning point
explanation_mandarin: 表示形势发展的关键时刻或转折点，需做出重要决策或采取关键行动。
explanation_english: Refers to a decisive or crucial moment/turning point when important decisions must be made or key actions taken.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 依家係關頭，唔可以再拖喇。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ji1 gaa1 hai6 gwaan1 tau4, m4 ho2 ji5 zoi3 to1 laa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 现在是关键时刻，不能再拖了。
examples.english_sentence: This is the critical moment; we can't delay any longer.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 間公司依家到咗關頭，要決定係咪要裁員。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gaan1 gung1 si1 ji1 gaa1 dou3 zo2 gwaan1 tau4, jiu3 kyut3 ding6 hai6 mai6 jiu3 coi4 jyun4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 公司现在到了关键时刻，要决定是否裁员。
examples.english_sentence: The company has reached a critical point and must decide whether to lay off staff.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 喺比賽嘅關頭，佢表現得好冷靜。
examples.jyutping_sentence: hai2 bei2 coi3 ge3 gwaan1 tau4, keoi5 biu2 jin2 dak1 hou2 laang5 zing6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 在比赛的关键时刻，他保持冷静。
examples.english_sentence: At the crucial moment in the game, he remained calm.

mandarin_meaning: 关照；照顾
english_meaning: to look after; to take care of; to show concern for
explanation_mandarin: 表示對某人或某事給予照顧、關照或照料，包含關心和照顧的意思。
explanation_english: To give care or attention to someone or something; to look after, take care of, or show concern for.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 多謝你一直關顧我。
examples.jyutping_sentence: do1 ze6 nei5 jat1 zik6 gwaan1 gu3 ngo5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 谢谢你一直关照我。
examples.english_sentence: Thank you for always looking after me.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 公司會關顧員工嘅需要。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gung1 si1 wui5 gwaan1 gu3 jyun4 gung1 ge3 seoi1 jiu3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 公司會照顧員工的需要。
examples.english_sentence: The company will take care of the employees' needs.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢成日嚟關顧啲老人家。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 sing4 jat6 lai4 gwaan1 gu3 di1 lou5 jan4 gaa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他經常來關照那些老人家。
examples.english_sentence: He often comes to look after those elderly people.

mandarin_meaning: 闡述；說明；解釋（多用於書面語）
english_meaning: to explain; to expound; to elucidate (formal/written usage)
explanation_mandarin: 表示對某事或道理進行說明、闡述，常見於書面或較正式的語境，例如「闡明觀點」「闡述原因」。
explanation_english: To explain or expound on something; used mainly in formal or written contexts (e.g., 'clarify a point', 'expound the reasons').

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我喺會議上闡明咗我哋嘅立場。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 hai2 wui6 ji5 soeng6 caan2 ming4 zo2 ngo5 dei6 ge3 laap6 coeng4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我在會議上闡明了我們的立場。
examples.english_sentence: I clarified our position at the meeting.

mandarin_meaning: 阐明；说明清楚
english_meaning: to clarify; to elucidate; to explain clearly
explanation_mandarin: 表示把某件事、觀點或道理說得清楚，闡述其原因或事實，屬於較正式的用語。
explanation_english: To state or explain something clearly so that its meaning, reasons, or facts are understood; a formal verb used when making something explicit or clear.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 請闡明你嘅立場，咁大家先至可以討論下一步。
examples.jyutping_sentence: cing2 caan2 ming4 nei5 ge3 laap6 coeng4, gam2 daai6 gaa1 sin1 zi3 ho2 ji5 tou2 leon6 haa6 jat1 bou6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 请阐明你的立场，这样大家才能讨论下一步。
examples.english_sentence: Please clarify your position so everyone can discuss the next steps.

mandarin_meaning: 阐述（解释、说明）
english_meaning: to expound; to explain; to elaborate
explanation_mandarin: 用于指对某个观点、事物或理论进行详细说明或阐明其道理。
explanation_english: A verb meaning to explain or expound on an idea, argument, or subject in detail.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 老師闡述咗呢個理論嘅重要性。
examples.jyutping_sentence: lou5 si1 caan2 seot6 zo2 ni1 go3 lei5 leon6 ge3 zung6 jiu3 sing3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 老师阐述了这个理论的重要性。
examples.english_sentence: The teacher expounded on the importance of this theory.

mandarin_meaning: 阐释 (chǎnshì)：解释、说明
english_meaning: to explain; to elucidate; to interpret
explanation_mandarin: 对事物的含义、来龙去脉或内在关系进行说明或解释，使其清楚明白。
explanation_english: To explain or elucidate the meaning, reasons, or relationships of something; to make it clear or comprehensible.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 教授喺課堂上闡釋咗呢段理論嘅來龍去脈。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gaau3 sau6 hai2 fo3 tong4 soeng6 chaan2 sik1 zo2 ni1 dyun6 lei5 leon6 ge3 loi4 lung4 heoi3 mak6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 教授在课堂上阐释了这段理论的来龙去脉。
examples.english_sentence: The professor elucidated the origins and development of this theory in class.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 警方需要闡釋證據，以便陪審團明白案情。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ging2 fong1 seoi1 jiu3 chaan2 sik1 zing3 geoi3, ji5 bin6 pui4 sam2 tyun4 ming4 baak6 on3 cing4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 警方需要阐释证据，以便陪审团明白案情。
examples.english_sentence: The police need to interpret the evidence so the jury can understand the case.

mandarin_meaning: 開闢；開創；闢謠（澄清謠言）
english_meaning: to open up / to found or establish; to dispel or refute (a rumor)
explanation_mandarin: 通常作動詞，表示開闢、開創（如開闢道路、開闢土地），也可指澄清或駁斥謠言（如闢謠）。多見於書面語或正式語境。
explanation_english: A verb meaning to open up or establish (e.g. open a road or found a park) and also to dispel or refute rumors (as in 'to debunk/deny a rumor'). Commonly used in formal or written contexts.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 政府話會開闢一個新公園畀市民。
examples.jyutping_sentence: zing3 fu2 waa6 wui5 hoi1 pik1 jat1 go3 san1 gung1 jyun4 bei2 si5 man4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 政府說會開闢一個新公園給市民。
examples.english_sentence: The government said it will open up a new park for the public.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 公司發聲明闢謠，話董事長冇辭職。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gung1 si1 faat3 seng1 ming4 pik1 jiu4, waa6 dung2 si6 zoeng2 mou5 ci4 zik1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 公司發聲明闢謠，說董事長沒有辭職。
examples.english_sentence: The company issued a statement to dispel the rumor, saying the chairman did not resign.

mandarin_meaning: 辟謠；澄清謠言或否認不實訊息
english_meaning: to dispel or refute rumors; to debunk false information
explanation_mandarin: 公開說明或否認流傳的不實訊息，以消除誤解或制止謠言的傳播。
explanation_english: To publicly clarify, deny, or correct false information or rumors in order to stop their spread or remove misunderstanding.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 政府出咗份聲明闢謠，話嗰個消息唔係事實。
examples.jyutping_sentence: zing3 fu2 ceot1 zo2 fan6 sing1 ming4 pik1 jiu4, waa6 go2 go3 siu1 sik1 m4 hai6 si6 sat6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 政府發表聲明辟謠，稱那個消息並非事實。
examples.english_sentence: The government issued a statement to dispel the rumor, saying that the information is not true.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 藝人喺社交媒體上闢謠，話自己冇做過嗰啲事。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngai6 jan4 hai2 se5 gaau1 mui4 tai2 soeng6 pik1 jiu4, waa6 zi6 gei2 mou5 zou6 gwo3 go2 di1 si6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 藝人在社交媒體上辟謠，表示自己沒有做過那些事。
examples.english_sentence: The celebrity debunked the rumors on social media, saying they never did those things.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 公司出咗公告闢謠，希望平息流言對員工嘅影響。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gung1 si1 ceot1 zo2 gung1 gou3 pik1 jiu4, hei1 mong6 ping4 sik1 lau4 jin4 deoi3 jyun4 gung1 ge3 jing2 hoeng2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 公司發布公告辟謠，希望平息謠言對員工的影響。
examples.english_sentence: The company released a notice to refute the rumors, hoping to calm the impact on employees.

mandarin_meaning: 门、门户；门第、门阀（古字，常见于“门闥”），亦有开启之意。
english_meaning: gate; door; household or family status (archaic/literary); often seen in '門闥' to denote a prestigious family or clan.
explanation_mandarin: ‘闥’為古字，本義指門扇或門戶，後引申為門第、門閥等。現多見於合成詞如“門闥”，用以指顯赫的門第或家族勢力，屬文言或書面用字，口語中較少單獨使用。
explanation_english: An archaic/literary character originally meaning 'door' or 'gate', later extended to mean 'household' or 'family status'. It commonly appears in compounds such as '門闥' to refer to a prominent family or clan. Rarely used alone in everyday speech.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢出身於有門闥嘅世家，做乜都有人撐腰。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 ceot1 san1 jyu1 jau5 mun4 taap3 ge3 sai3 gaa1, zou6 mat1 dou1 jau5 jan4 caang1 jiu1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他出身於有門閥的世家，做什麼都有靠山。
examples.english_sentence: He comes from a prominent family with strong connections; whatever he does, he has backing.

mandarin_meaning: 问 / 問（提问）
english_meaning: to ask; to inquire
explanation_mandarin: 表示向他人提出疑問或請求資訊，用作動詞，常見於日常對話及書面語中（繁體字為「問」或「問」）。
explanation_english: Used to pose a question or request information from someone. Common verb in everyday speech and writing.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我想問你一個問題。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 soeng2 man6 nei5 jat1 go3 man6 tai4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我想問你一個問題。
examples.english_sentence: I want to ask you a question.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢唔識答案，就去問老師。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 m4 sik1 daap3 ngaan6, zau6 heoi3 man6 lou5 si1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他不懂答案，就去問老師。
examples.english_sentence: He didn't know the answer, so he went to ask the teacher.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 可以問下呢度幾時開門嗎？
examples.jyutping_sentence: ho2 ji5 man6 haa5 ni1 dou6 gei2 si4 hoi1 mun4 maa3?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 可以問一下這裡什麼時候開門嗎？
examples.english_sentence: May I ask when this place opens?

mandarin_meaning: 间 / 間 (jiān)：房间、之间，亦作量词用于房屋或房间等
english_meaning: room; between; (classifier) measure word for rooms/buildings; interval
explanation_mandarin: “间”常用作名词，表示房间或空间；也可表示“之间”的意思；在作量词时用于计数房屋、房间、商铺等。
explanation_english: “間” (gaan1) is used to mean a room or space, or 'between/among'. It is also a classifier (measure word) used for counting rooms, buildings, shops, etc.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢间房几靓。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 gaan1 fong4 gei2 leng3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这间房子很漂亮。
examples.english_sentence: This room is very pretty.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋之間有問題，要傾下。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 zi1 gaan1 jau5 man6 tai4, jiu3 king1 haa5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们之间有问题，需要谈一谈。
examples.english_sentence: There are problems between them; they need to talk.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我喺兩堂課之間食咗嘢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 hai2 loeng5 tong4 fo3 zi1 gaan1 sik6 zo2 je5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我在两节课之间吃了东西。
examples.english_sentence: I ate something between two classes.

mandarin_meaning: 闹（吵闹、闹事、吵架、责骂）
english_meaning: to make noise; to make a fuss; to cause trouble; to quarrel; to scold
explanation_mandarin: 表示發出噪音、製造喧鬧、引起事端或與人爭吵，有時亦指責罵或戲弄別人。
explanation_english: Indicates making noise or causing a disturbance, creating a fuss or trouble, arguing/quarrelling, or sometimes scolding/teasing someone.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢個街市真係好闹，成日都好多人。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 go3 gaai1 si5 zan1 hai6 hou2 naau6, sing4 jat6 dou1 hou2 do1 jan4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 這個街市真的很熱鬧，總是有很多人。
examples.english_sentence: This street market is really noisy; there are always lots of people.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好闹我啦，我真係唔識做。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 naau6 ngo5 laa1, ngo5 zan1 hai6 m4 sik1 zou6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 別責罵我了，我真的不會做。
examples.english_sentence: Don't scold me, I really don't know how to do it.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋成日喺度闹交，好煩。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 sing4 jat6 hai2 dou6 naau6 gaau1, hou2 faan4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他們經常在那裡吵架，真煩人。
examples.english_sentence: They're always arguing there; it's so annoying.

mandarin_meaning: 阁（gé）：楼阁、阁楼；用于合成词如内阁（政府的决策机构）、阁下（对尊称）
english_meaning: gé / gok3: pavilion, attic, cabinet; used in compounds such as 'cabinet' (government) and the honorific 'Your Excellency'
explanation_mandarin: 表示建筑物中的楼阁或合成词中的部分（如内阁、阁下），在粤语中读作 gok3。
explanation_english: Refers to a pavilion or upper chamber and appears in compounds (e.g., '內閣' for the government cabinet, '閣下' as an honorific). Pronounced gok3 in Cantonese.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 內閣今朝開會討論新政策。
examples.jyutping_sentence: noi6 gok3 gam1 ziu1 hoi1 wui6 tou2 leon6 san1 zing3 caak3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 内阁今天开会讨论新政策。
examples.english_sentence: The cabinet met this morning to discuss the new policy.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 閣下，請留步。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gok3 haa6, ceng2 lau4 bou6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 阁下，请留步。
examples.english_sentence: Your Excellency, please wait/hold on.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 山上有古老嘅樓閣。
examples.jyutping_sentence: saan1 soeng5 jau5 gu2 lou5 ge3 lau4 gok3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 山上有古老的楼阁。
examples.english_sentence: There is an ancient pavilion on the mountain.

mandarin_meaning: 阜 (fù) — 小山丘、土堆；引申为富饶，常见于地名（如阜阳）
english_meaning: mound; hill; abundance; often appears in place names
explanation_mandarin: 字本義為土堆、小山丘，也常用作地名或表示豐裕、富饒的概念，現代多見於專有名詞中。
explanation_english: Originally denotes a mound or small hill; also used in place names and historically can imply abundance. In modern usage it is often seen in proper nouns.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋下個禮拜會去阜陽旅行。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 haa6 go3 lai5 baai3 wui5 heoi3 fau3 joeng4 leoi5 hang4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们下个礼拜会去阜阳旅行。
examples.english_sentence: We will travel to Fuyang next week.

jyutping: jap6 / fu6 (無獨立讀音，作右邊部首相當於「邑」jap6；作左邊部首相當於「阜」fu6)
mandarin_meaning: 部首/偏旁（阜或邑的簡化形式），本身不作獨立字讀音；作左邊時對應「阜」（fù），作右邊時對應「邑」（yì）。
english_meaning: A Chinese character component/radical (no independent pronunciation). It is a simplified form used for two different radicals: 阜 when appearing on the left, and 邑 when appearing on the right.
explanation_mandarin: 「阝」不是一個常作獨立讀音的字，而是漢字的部首或偏旁的形體。它在字的左邊時來源於「阜」，多與丘陵、地勢或與土地有關；在字的右邊時來源於「邑」，多與城鎮、地方、行政區劃有關。讀音與意義以所屬的整字為準。
explanation_english: “阝” is not normally pronounced as a standalone character; it is a graphic component used as a radical. On the left it is the simplified form of 阜 and often relates to mounds, hills, or land; on the right it is the simplified form of 邑 and often relates to towns, cities, or administrative places. Pronunciation and meaning depend on the whole character in which it appears.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 教中文嗰陣，老師話呢個字有個阝部，係部首。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gaau3 zung1 man4 go2 zan6, lou5 si1 waa6 ni1 go3 zi6 jau5 go3 jap6/fu6 bou6, hai6 bou6 sau2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 教中文的时候，老师说这个字有个阝部，是部首。
examples.english_sentence: When teaching Chinese, the teacher said this character has the 阝 radical; it's a radical.

mandarin_meaning: 阡（阡陌）：田間的小路，古文常見用法，常與“陌”連用
english_meaning: qiān (as in 阡陌): a small path between fields; an archaic/literary term for rural paths
explanation_mandarin: “阡”原指田間的田墾間小路，多見於古文或成語“阡陌交通”，現多以複合詞或書面語出現，含田間小徑或道路縱橫之意。
explanation_english: “阡” originally refers to small paths between fields, often seen in literary or classical Chinese (e.g. 阡陌). It denotes field paths or, more generally, interlacing rural roads.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 鄉下田間有好多阡陌小路，村民成日行過去做工。
examples.jyutping_sentence: hoeng1 haa6 tin4 gaan1 jau5 hou2 do1 cin1 mok6 siu2 lou6, cyun1 man4 sing4 jat6 hang4 gwo3 heoi3 zou6 gung1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 乡下田间有很多阡陌小路，村民经常走过去干活。
examples.english_sentence: In the countryside there are many paths between fields; villagers often walk along them to work.

mandarin_meaning: 田间小路；乡间道路；田野纵横的景象（书面用语）
english_meaning: paths between fields; the crisscrossing lanes in the countryside; a literary term for rural lanes/fields
explanation_mandarin: “阡陌”原指田间的纵横小路，后来常用来泛指乡间道路或田野纵横交错的景象，多见于诗词和书面语。
explanation_english: Originally referred to narrow paths between fields; later used to denote the network of lanes and fields in the countryside. It is a literary term often found in poetry and formal writing.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 阡陌縱橫，農田間條條小路交錯，風景好寧靜。
examples.jyutping_sentence: cin1 mok6 zung3 waang4, nung4 tin4 gaan1 tiu4 tiu4 siu2 lou6 gaau1 co3, fung1 ging2 hou2 ning4 zing6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 阡陌纵横，农田间条条小路交错，风景很宁静。
examples.english_sentence: The fields are crisscrossed by paths; the little lanes between the farms intersect, and the scenery is very peaceful.

mandarin_meaning: 坡、斜坡（常用於地形或地名，如「大阪」）
english_meaning: slope, incline, hill (also used in place names such as Osaka)
explanation_mandarin: 「阪」指地形上的坡或斜坡，可單獨表示坡地，也常見於地名（例如大阪）。
explanation_english: Refers to a slope or incline. Can denote a hillside or slope in terrain and often appears in place names (e.g., Osaka).

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢條阪好陡，行落去好辛苦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 tiu4 baan2 hou2 dau2, hang4 lok6 heoi3 hou2 san1 fu2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这条坡很陡，走下去很辛苦。
examples.english_sentence: This slope is very steep; walking down is exhausting.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我而家要飛去大阪旅行。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 ji4 gaa1 jiu3 fei1 heoi3 daai6 baan2 leoi5 hang4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我现在要飞去大阪旅行。
examples.english_sentence: I'm flying to Osaka for a trip now.

mandarin_meaning: 阮（ruǎn）——姓氏；阮琴（弹拨弦乐器）；在闽南语中作代词“我 / 我们”
english_meaning: Ruan (surname); the ruan (a plucked Chinese lute); in Minnan (Hokkien) dialect used as a pronoun meaning 'I' or 'we'.
partOfSpeech_mandarin: 名词（可作姓氏或乐器名称；在闽南语中作代词）
explanation_mandarin: 「阮」在粤语里主要作为姓氏或指代传统拨弦乐器阮（阮琴）。此外，在閩南語/台語中「阮」是常见的代词，表示「我」或「我们」，但此用法屬於閩南話，不是標準粵語口語。也有文言或方言的特殊讀法或用法。
explanation_english: In Cantonese, 阮 is primarily seen as a surname or the name of the traditional plucked lute (ruan). Separately, in Minnan (Hokkien/Taiwanese), 阮 is a common pronoun meaning 'I' or 'we' — this usage is not standard Cantonese but occurs in southern Sinitic dialect contexts. It can therefore refer to a family name, a musical instrument, or (in other dialects) a pronoun.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 阮先生今日唔喺。
examples.jyutping_sentence: jyun5 sin1 saang1 gam1 jat6 m4 hai2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 阮先生今天不在。
examples.english_sentence: Mr. Ruan is not here today.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢喺度彈阮（阮琴）。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hai2 dou6 taan4 jyun5 (jyun5 kam4).
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他在弹阮（阮琴）。
examples.english_sentence: He is playing the ruan (a plucked lute).

examples.cantonese_sentence: 喺閩南話，阮代表我哋。
examples.jyutping_sentence: hai2 man5 naam4 waa2, jyun5 doi6 biu2 ngo5 dei6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 在闽南话里，阮表示我们／我。
examples.english_sentence: In Minnan (Hokkien), '阮' represents 'we' (or 'I').

mandarin_meaning: 阱（陷阱）
english_meaning: trap; pitfall; snare
explanation_mandarin: 指用來困住或誘騙人的陷阱、圈套，也可引申為比喻性的陷阱或局套。
explanation_english: Refers to a trap, pitfall, or snare used to catch or deceive; can also be used metaphorically for a scheme or pitfall.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢單生意好似有阱，唔好咁快簽約。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 daan1 sang1 ji3 hou2 ci5 jau5 zing6, m4 hou2 gam2 faai3 cim1 joek3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这笔生意好像有陷阱，不要这么快签约。
examples.english_sentence: This deal seems to have a trap; don't sign the contract so quickly.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 小心，路邊有個阱，唔好跌落去。
examples.jyutping_sentence: siu2 sam1, lou6 bin1 jau5 go3 zing6, m4 hou2 dit3 lok6 heoi3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 小心，路边有一个陷阱，不要掉下去。
examples.english_sentence: Watch out, there's a pit by the roadside — don't fall in.

mandarin_meaning: 防；防止；防范 (fáng)，表示预防或防备
english_meaning: to guard against; to prevent; defense; precaution
explanation_mandarin: 表示采取措施以防备或阻止不良情形发生，例如預防疾病、抵御危险或防止损失。
explanation_english: Indicates taking measures to guard against or prevent undesirable situations, such as preventing disease, guarding against danger, or avoiding loss.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋要防疫，記得戴口罩。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 jiu3 fong4 jik6, gei3 dak1 daai3 hau2 zaau3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们要防疫，记得戴口罩。
examples.english_sentence: We need to prevent the epidemic; remember to wear masks.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢買咗防盜鎖，為咗防小偷。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 maai5 zo2 fong4 dou6 so2, wai6 zo2 fong4 siu2 tau1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他买了防盗锁，为了防止小偷。
examples.english_sentence: He bought an anti-theft lock to prevent thieves.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢啲措施可以防止水浸。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 di1 cou3 sik1 ho2 ji5 fong4 zi2 seoi2 zam1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这些措施可以防止水灾。
examples.english_sentence: These measures can prevent flooding.

mandarin_meaning: 防不勝防（難以防範、無法一一預防）
english_meaning: Impossible to guard against; too many (or too tricky) to defend against or prevent
partOfSpeech_mandarin: 成語（可作形容詞或動詞性短語）
explanation_mandarin: 表示威脅、麻煩或騙局等太多或太難預防，使人無法逐一防範或應付。
explanation_english: Indicates that threats, problems, or scams are so numerous or hard to anticipate that one cannot guard against them all.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 而家網絡詐騙咁多，真係防不勝防。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ji4 gaa1 mong5 lok6 zaa3 pin3 gam2 do1, zan1 hai6 fong4 bat1 sing3 fong4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 現在網絡詐騙這麼多，真是防不勝防。
examples.english_sentence: There are so many online scams now that it's impossible to guard against them all.

jyutping: fong4 jan4 zi1 sam1 bat1 ho2 mou4
mandarin_meaning: 防人之心不可无（对别人要有所防备，不能没有戒心）
english_meaning: One should always be on guard against others; don't trust people blindly.
explanation_mandarin: 表示对他人要保持一定的警惕和防备心理，避免轻易相信别人或被利用。
explanation_english: Conveys that one should keep a degree of caution or suspicion toward others to avoid being taken advantage of or trusting too readily.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 做生意要小心，防人之心不可無。
examples.jyutping_sentence: zou6 saang1 ji3 jiu3 siu2 sam1, fong4 jan4 zi1 sam1 bat1 ho2 mou4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 做生意要小心，防人之心不可无。
examples.english_sentence: Be careful in business; you should always be wary of others.

mandarin_meaning: 防伪（防止偽造、仿冒）
english_meaning: anti-counterfeit; anti-forgery (measures or features to prevent counterfeiting)
explanation_mandarin: 指採取或具備用以防止商品、文件等被偽造或仿冒的措施、技術或標識。
explanation_english: Refers to measures, techniques, or features designed to prevent products, documents, etc. from being forged or counterfeited.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 件手錶嗰度有防偽標籤，你可以掃碼驗證係咪真貨。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gin6 sau2 biu1 go2 dou6 jau5 fong4 ngai6 biu1 cim1, nei5 ho2 ji5 sou3 maa5 jim6 zing3 hai6 mai6 zan1 fo3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 那隻手錶有防偽標籤，你可以掃碼驗證是不是正品。
examples.english_sentence: The watch has an anti-counterfeit label; you can scan the code to verify whether it's genuine.

mandarin_meaning: 防备 (fángbèi)
english_meaning: to guard against; to take precautions; to be on one's guard
explanation_mandarin: 表示对可能的危险或问题采取预防、警惕的态度和措施，以减少或避免损害。
explanation_english: To take precautions or remain alert against possible danger or problems; to adopt defensive measures to reduce or avoid harm.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 出門要有防備，記得帶埋雨傘同口罩。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ceot1 mun4 jiu3 jau5 fong4 bei6, gei3 dak1 daai3 maai4 jyu5 saan3 tung4 hau2 zaau3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 出门要有防备，记得带上雨伞和口罩。
examples.english_sentence: Be prepared when you go out — remember to bring an umbrella and a face mask.

mandarin_meaning: 防伪；防止假冒、驗證真偽
english_meaning: anti-counterfeit; anti-forgery; to prevent counterfeiting or verify authenticity
explanation_mandarin: 指用來防止商品或文件被偽造、用以辨別真偽的措施或技術，例如防偽標籤、防偽碼、防偽印記等。
explanation_english: Refers to measures or technologies used to prevent items or documents from being counterfeited and to verify authenticity — for example, anti-counterfeit labels, codes, or marks.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 公司喺包裝上印咗防僞碼，消費者可以用手機掃描驗證真偽。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gung1 si1 hai2 baau1 zong1 soeng6 jan3 zo2 fong4 ngai6 maa5, siu1 fai3 ze2 ho2 ji5 jung6 sau2 gei1 sou3 miu4 jim6 zing3 zan1 ngai6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 公司在包裝上印了防偽碼，消費者可以用手機掃描驗證真偽。
examples.english_sentence: The company printed anti-counterfeit codes on the packaging; consumers can scan them with their phones to verify authenticity.

mandarin_meaning: 防具（指用來保護身體的器具，如盔甲、頭盔、護膝等）
english_meaning: protective gear; armor
explanation_mandarin: 指用於保護身體的器具或裝備，包含盔甲、頭盔、護具等，常見於運動、騎行、軍事或遊戲裝備情境。
explanation_english: Refers to equipment worn to protect the body (e.g., armor, helmets, pads). Commonly used in contexts like sports, cycling, military, or gaming.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 出門踩單車要記得戴齊防具，特別係頭盔同護膝。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ceot1 mun4 caai2 daan1 ce1 jiu3 gei3 dak1 daai3 cai4 fong4 geoi6, dak6 bit6 hai6 tau4 kwai1 tung4 wu6 sat1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 出门骑自行车要记得戴好防护用具，特别是头盔和护膝。
examples.english_sentence: When you go out cycling, remember to wear your protective gear, especially a helmet and knee pads.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢隻遊戲裡面可以裝備唔同嘅防具，提升角色嘅防禦力。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 zek3 jau4 hei3 leoi5 min6 ho2 ji5 zong1 bei6 m4 tung4 ge3 fong4 geoi6, tai1 sing1 gok3 sik1 ge3 fong4 jyu6 lik6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这个游戏里可以装备不同的防具，提升角色的防御力。
examples.english_sentence: In this game you can equip different protective gear to increase the character's defense.

mandarin_meaning: 防务（指与国防、保卫国家安全相关的事务）
english_meaning: defense affairs; matters related to national defense or protection
explanation_mandarin: 指與國防或保衛國家安全相關的事務、職責和工作，例如軍事部署、國防政策等。
explanation_english: Refers to affairs, duties, and work related to national defense or safeguarding a country's security, such as military deployments and defense policy.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 政府要加強國家防務，確保市民安全。
examples.jyutping_sentence: zing3 fu2 jiu3 gaa1 koeng4 gwok3 gaa1 fong4 mou6, kok3 bou2 si5 man4 on1 cyun4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 政府要加强国家防务，确保市民安全。
examples.english_sentence: The government must strengthen national defense to ensure the safety of citizens.

mandarin_meaning: 防守 (fángshǒu) — 防禦、守衛，阻止對方進攻，亦指體育比賽中的防守動作或策略。
english_meaning: defend; defense; to guard or prevent an opponent's attack; defensive play/behavior (in sports or conflict).
explanation_mandarin: 指採取措施保護或阻止對手進攻，可用作動詞（進行防守）或名詞（防守策略、球隊的防守）。常見於體育、軍事或一般保護語境。
explanation_english: Refers to taking measures to protect or stop an opponent's attack. Can be used as a verb (to defend) or a noun (defense/defensive strategy). Common in sports, military, or general protection contexts.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋要加強防守，唔好畀對方入波。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 jiu3 gaa1 koeng4 fong4 sau2, m4 hou2 bei2 deoi3 fong1 jap6 bo1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我們要加強防守，不要讓對方進球。
examples.english_sentence: We need to strengthen our defense; don't let the opponent score.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢喺投資上好防守，唔鍾意承擔風險。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hai6 tau4 zi1 soeng6 hou2 fong4 sau2, m4 zung1 ji3 sing4 daam1 fung1 him2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他在投資上很保守，不喜歡承擔風險。
examples.english_sentence: He's conservative in investing and doesn't like taking risks.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 球隊今場防守做得好，守住勝利。
examples.jyutping_sentence: kau4 deoi6 gam1 coeng4 fong4 sau2 zou6 dak1 hou2, sau2 zyu6 sing3 lei6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 球隊這場防守做得很好，守住了勝利。
examples.english_sentence: The team's defense performed well this match and held on to the victory.

mandarin_meaning: 防弹（能够抵挡子弹或弹片的）
english_meaning: bulletproof; able to resist bullets or shrapnel; figuratively, invulnerable or immune to criticism
explanation_mandarin: 指能抵挡子弹或弹片的性能，常用来形容背心、玻璃、車輛等具備防護作用。也可引申為比喻用法，表示“刀槍不入”或不易被反駁、攻破。
explanation_english: Refers to the ability to stop bullets or shrapnel, commonly used for vests, glass, vehicles, etc. Can also be used figuratively to mean impervious or hard to refute.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 警察着住防彈背心出勤。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ging2 caat3 zoek3 zyu6 fong4 daan6 bui3 sam1 ceot1 kan4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 警察穿着防弹背心值勤。
examples.english_sentence: The police are on duty wearing bulletproof vests.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢啲辯詞好有力，好似防彈咁，冇人可以反駁。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 di1 bin6 ci4 hou2 jau5 lik6, hou2 ci5 fong4 daan6 gam2, mou5 jan4 ho2 ji5 faan2 guk6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他的辩词很有力，像防弹一样，没人能反驳。
examples.english_sentence: His arguments were so strong they were bulletproof — nobody could refute them.

mandarin_meaning: 防微杜渐
english_meaning: to nip something in the bud; to prevent minor issues from becoming serious
explanation_mandarin: 比喻在事情剛開始、尚未嚴重時就採取防範措施，以免惡化或引發更大的後果。
explanation_english: An idiom meaning to take preventive measures against small problems early, so they do not develop into serious ones.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 公司要防微杜漸，早啲解決細問題，先至唔會變成大麻煩。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gung1si1 jiu3 fong4-mei4-dou6-zim6, zou2 di1 gaai2 kyut3 sai3 man6 tai4, sin1 zi3 m4 wui5 bin3 sing4 daai6 maa4faan4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 公司要防微杜漸，早点解决小问题，才不会变成大麻烦。
examples.english_sentence: The company should nip problems in the bud: solve small issues early so they don't turn into big troubles.

mandarin_meaning: 防患于未然（成语），事先采取措施以防止灾祸或问题发生
english_meaning: An idiom meaning to take precautions to prevent problems or disasters before they occur; nip problems in the bud.
explanation_mandarin: 用来表示在危险或问题尚未发生时就采取预防措施，以避免或减少损失。
explanation_english: Used to express taking preventive measures before danger or problems arise, in order to avoid or reduce loss.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 公司早就制定咗應急預案，係為咗防患於未然。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gung1 si1 zou2 zau6 zai3 ding6 zo2 jing3 gap1 jyu6 on3, hai6 wai6 zo2 fong4 waan6 jyu1 mei6 jin4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 公司早已制定了应急预案，目的是为了防患于未然。
examples.english_sentence: The company had already drawn up an emergency plan to prevent problems before they occur.

mandarin_meaning: 防患于未然（事先采取预防措施以避免灾祸或问题发生）
english_meaning: To prevent problems before they occur; take precautions in advance.
explanation_mandarin: 表示事先采取预防措施，以防止灾害或问题发生。
explanation_english: Indicates taking preventive measures beforehand to avoid disasters or problems.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 為咗防患未然，公司應該早啲做好防範措施。
examples.jyutping_sentence: wai6 zo2 fong4 waan6 mei6 jin4 , gung1 si1 jing1 goi1 zou2 di1 zou6 hou2 fong4 faan6 cou3 si1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 为了防患于未然，公司应该早点做好防范措施。
examples.english_sentence: To prevent problems before they happen, the company should take preventive measures early.

mandarin_meaning: 防撞杆（用於車輛或建築物上，用來減少碰撞和保護結構的桿件）
english_meaning: bumper; crash bar; guard bar (a bar used on vehicles or buildings to reduce impact and protect structures)
explanation_mandarin: 指安裝在汽車、牆角或柱子等處的金屬或塑料桿，用以吸收或緩和碰撞，保護本體免受損壞。
explanation_english: Refers to a metal or plastic bar installed on cars, walls, or columns to absorb or cushion impacts and protect the structure from damage.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 條防撞桿畀貨車撞凹咗，宜家要去維修。
examples.jyutping_sentence: tiu4 fong4 zong6 gon1 bei2 fo3 ce1 zong6 aau1 zo2, ji4 gaa1 jiu3 heoi3 wai4 sau1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 防撞杆被貨車撞凹了，現在要去維修。
examples.english_sentence: The bumper was dented by a truck; now it needs repair.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 為咗保護牆角，商場裝咗防撞桿。
examples.jyutping_sentence: wai6 zo2 bou2 wu6 coeng4 gok3, soeng1 coeng4 zong1 zo2 fong4 zong6 gon1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 為了保護牆角，商場裝了防撞杆。
examples.english_sentence: To protect the wall corners, the mall installed crash bars.

mandarin_meaning: 防撞栏；用以防止碰撞、保護行人或車輛的欄杆
english_meaning: guardrail; crash barrier — a railing or barrier installed to prevent collisions and protect pedestrians or vehicles
explanation_mandarin: 指設置在道路、橋梁或建築邊緣，用來防止車輛或行人發生碰撞或跌落的欄杆或障礙物。
explanation_english: A barrier or railing placed along roadsides, bridges, or edges of structures to prevent collisions, protect pedestrians and vehicles, and reduce accident severity.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 高速公路兩邊裝咗防撞欄，可以減低意外嘅嚴重性。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gou1 cuk1 gung1 lou6 loeng5 bin1 zong1 zo2 fong4 zong6 laan4, ho2 ji5 gaam2 dai1 ji3 ngoi6 ge3 jim4 zung6 sing3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 高速公路兩邊裝了防撞欄，可以降低意外的嚴重性。
examples.english_sentence: Crash barriers have been installed along both sides of the highway to reduce the severity of accidents.

mandarin_meaning: 防止暴亂／防暴（如防暴警、 防暴措施）
english_meaning: anti‑riot; riot control (preventing or responding to riots/violent unrest)
partOfSpeech_mandarin: 動詞 / 形容詞（可作為描述防止暴亂的用語或與警力、措施連用）
partOfSpeech_english: verb / adjective (used attributively as 'anti‑riot' or as verb 'to prevent/contain riots')
explanation_mandarin: 指防範或應對暴力、騷亂的行動、措施或相關部隊與裝備，例如「防暴警察」、「防暴措施」。
explanation_english: Refers to actions, measures, units, or equipment for preventing or responding to riots and violent unrest (e.g., riot police, anti‑riot measures).

examples.cantonese_sentence: 政府派咗防暴警察嚟維持秩序。
examples.jyutping_sentence: zing3 fu2 paai3 zo2 fong4 bou6 ging2 caat3 lai4 wai4 ci4 zat6 zeoi6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 政府派了防暴警察來維持秩序。
examples.english_sentence: The government sent riot police to maintain order.

mandarin_meaning: 防暴队（负责应对骚乱、示威时维持秩序的警察单位）
english_meaning: riot police; anti-riot unit (police unit responsible for handling riots and maintaining order during protests)
explanation_mandarin: 指专门应对骚乱、群体性事件或示威期间维持治安与秩序的警察编制或队伍，通常配备防暴装备。
explanation_english: Refers to a police unit specifically tasked with responding to riots, mass disturbances, or protests to maintain public order; typically equipped with crowd-control gear.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 今日示威期間，防暴隊已經到場戒備。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gam1 jat6 si6 wai1 kei4 gaan1, fong4 bou6 deoi6 ji5 ging1 dou3 coeng4 gaai3 bei6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 今天示威期间，防暴队已经到场戒备。
examples.english_sentence: During today's protest, the riot police have already arrived to stand guard.

mandarin_meaning: 防晒（防止陽光/紫外線傷害）
english_meaning: sun protection; sunscreen; to protect against sun (UV) rays
explanation_mandarin: 指為了防止陽光（尤其是紫外線）對皮膚造成傷害而採取的措施或使用的用品，例如塗防晒霜、戴遮陽帽或穿防曬衣等。
explanation_english: Refers to measures or products used to prevent sunlight (especially UV rays) from damaging the skin, such as applying sunscreen, wearing a hat, or using sun-protective clothing.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 出街記得搽防曬。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ceot1 gaai1 gei3 dak1 caat3 fong4 saai3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 出門記得塗防晒。
examples.english_sentence: Remember to put on sunscreen when you go out.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 夏天去海邊一定要做足防曬，唔係會曬傷。
examples.jyutping_sentence: haa6 tin1 heoi3 hoi2 bin1 jat1 ding6 jiu3 zou6 zuk1 fong4 saai3, m4 hai6 wui5 saai3 soeng1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 夏天去海边一定要做好防晒，否則會曬傷。
examples.english_sentence: When you go to the beach in summer you must fully protect yourself from the sun, otherwise you'll get sunburned.

mandarin_meaning: 防止（阻止、避免某事發生）
english_meaning: to prevent; to stop or guard against something from happening
explanation_mandarin: 表示採取措施以阻止某事發生或避免某種情況出現。
explanation_english: To take measures to stop something from happening or to guard against a particular situation.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋要防止疫情擴散。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 jiu3 fong4 zi2 jik6 cing4 kwaak3 saan3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们要防止疫情扩散。
examples.english_sentence: We must prevent the spread of the epidemic.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 公司有措施防止資料外洩。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gung1 si1 jau5 co3 si1 fong4 zi2 zi1 liu6 ngoi6 sit3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 公司有措施防止资料外泄。
examples.english_sentence: The company has measures to prevent data leaks.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 為咗防止跌倒，樓梯裝咗手扶欄。
examples.jyutping_sentence: wai6 zo2 fong4 zi2 dit3 dou2, lau4 tai1 zong1 zo2 sau2 fau4 laan4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 为了防止跌倒，楼梯装了扶手栏。
examples.english_sentence: To prevent falls, handrails were installed on the stairs.

mandarin_meaning: 防止中毒；防病毒（尤指電腦）
english_meaning: to prevent poisoning; antivirus (esp. for computers)
explanation_mandarin: 可指採取措施避免人體或食物中毒，也常用於指防止、偵測和清除電腦病毒的軟件或行為（例如防毒軟件）。
explanation_english: Can mean actions to prevent poisoning (to people or food), and is commonly used for software or measures that prevent, detect, and remove computer viruses (antivirus).

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我啱啱幫部電腦裝咗防毒軟件。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 ngaam1 ngaam1 bong1 bou6 din6 nou5 zong1 zo2 fong4 duk6 jyun5 gin6。
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我剛剛幫電腦裝了防毒軟件。
examples.english_sentence: I just installed antivirus software on the computer.

mandarin_meaning: 防毒軟件（防病毒软件）
english_meaning: antivirus software
explanation_mandarin: 用來偵測、攔截和移除電腦病毒、惡意軟體等的程式軟體，保護系統和資料安全。
explanation_english: Software designed to detect, block, and remove computer viruses and other malicious programs, protecting the system and data.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我啱啱裝咗個新防毒軟件，電腦快好多。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 aam1 aam1 zong1 zo2 go3 san1 fong4 duk6 jyun5 gin6, din6 nou5 faai3 hou2 do1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我剛剛安裝了新的防毒軟件，電腦快了很多。
examples.english_sentence: I just installed new antivirus software; the computer is much faster.

mandarin_meaning: 防毒面具 (fáng dú miàn jù)
english_meaning: gas mask; respirator used to protect the wearer from poisonous gases, toxic fumes, and hazardous particles
explanation_mandarin: 用來覆蓋面部並過濾有毒氣體、煙霧或有害顆粒的防護器具，常見於軍事、消防和緊急救援場景。
explanation_english: A protective device that covers the face and filters poisonous gases, toxic fumes, or harmful particles; commonly used in military, firefighting, and emergency response situations.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 今次化學洩漏，所有人都要戴防毒面具。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gam1 ci3 faa3 hok6 sit3 lau6, so2 jau5 jan4 dou1 jiu3 daai3 fong4 duk6 min6 geoi6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这次化学泄漏，所有人都要戴防毒面具。
examples.english_sentence: Because of the chemical leak, everyone must wear gas masks.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 救火隊員戴住防毒面具衝入有毒煙霧嘅房間。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gau3 fo2 deoi6 jyun4 daai3 zyu6 fong4 duk6 min6 geoi6 cung1 jap6 jau5 duk6 jin1 mou6 ge3 fong4 gaan1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 救火队员戴着防毒面具冲进有毒烟雾的房间。
examples.english_sentence: The firefighters wore gas masks to enter the room filled with toxic smoke.

mandarin_meaning: 防水 (fángshuǐ)
english_meaning: waterproof; water-resistant
explanation_mandarin: 表示物品能夠防止水滲入或被水弄濕，常用於衣物、電子產品、建材等的特性描述。
explanation_english: Describes an object's ability to prevent water from entering or causing wetness; commonly used for clothing, electronics, construction materials, etc.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢個電話殼係防水嘅。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 go3 din6 waa2 hok3 hai6 fong4 seoi2 ge3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这个手机壳是防水的。
examples.english_sentence: This phone case is waterproof.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢件雨衣好防水，落大雨都唔怕濕。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 gin6 jyu5 ji1 hou2 fong4 seoi2, lok6 daai6 jyu5 dou1 m4 pa3 sap1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这件雨衣很防水，下大雨也不怕湿。
examples.english_sentence: This raincoat is very waterproof; it won't get wet even in heavy rain.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢隻手錶有防水功能，可以戴住游水。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 zek3 sau2 biu1 jau5 fong4 seoi2 gung1 nang4, ho2 ji5 daai3 zyu6 jau4 seoi2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这只手表有防水功能，可以戴着游泳。
examples.english_sentence: This watch has waterproof capability and can be worn while swimming.

mandarin_meaning: 防水布（fángshuǐ bù）
english_meaning: waterproof cloth; tarpaulin; waterproof fabric
explanation_mandarin: 用來防水的布料，通常經過處理或使用防水材質，常用於遮蓋物品、製作雨具或戶外防護。
explanation_english: A fabric made or treated to resist water. Commonly used to cover items, make tarps or rain gear, and provide outdoor protection.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 落雨嘅時候，我哋用防水布遮住啲傢俬。
examples.jyutping_sentence: lok6 jyu5 ge3 si4 hau6, ngo5 dei6 jung6 fong4 seoi2 bou3 ze1 zyu6 di1 gaa1 si1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 下雨的時候，我們用防水布蓋住家具。
examples.english_sentence: When it rains, we cover the furniture with a tarpaulin.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢塊防水布好耐用，可以防風防雨。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 faai3 fong4 seoi2 bou3 hou2 noi6 jung6, ho2 ji5 fong4 fung1 fong4 jyu5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 這塊防水布很耐用，可以防風防雨。
examples.english_sentence: This piece of waterproof cloth is very durable; it can block wind and rain.

mandarin_meaning: 预防和治理（或治疗）
english_meaning: prevention and control; prevention and treatment (of diseases or problems)
explanation_mandarin: 指对疾病、污染或其他问题进行预防，并采取措施进行治理或治疗。
explanation_english: Refers to preventing and taking measures to control or treat diseases, pollution, or other problems.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 政府要加強對疾病嘅防治措施。
examples.jyutping_sentence: zing3 fu2 jiu3 gaa1 koeng4 deoi3 zat6 beng6 ge3 fong4 zi6 cou3 sik1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 政府要加强对疾病的防治措施。
examples.english_sentence: The government needs to strengthen measures for the prevention and control of diseases.

mandarin_meaning: 防波堤（fángbōdī），防浪堤壩
english_meaning: breakwater; seawall
explanation_mandarin: 指為阻擋或消減海浪而建造的人工構築物，用來保護海港、碼頭或岸邊，避免被浪沖蝕或淹沒。
explanation_english: A man-made structure built to block or reduce wave action, protecting harbors, piers, or shorelines from erosion and wave damage.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋今朝去防波堤釣魚，釣到好多條魚。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 gam1 ziu1 heoi3 fong4 bo1 tai4 diu3 jyu4, diu3 dou2 hou2 do1 tiu4 jyu4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我們今天早上去防波堤釣魚，釣到很多條魚。
examples.english_sentence: This morning we went fishing on the breakwater and caught a lot of fish.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 颱風期間，港務處會封閉防波堤，唔准市民上去。
examples.jyutping_sentence: toi4 fung1 kei4 gaan1, gong2 mou6 cyu3 wui5 fung1 bai3 fong4 bo1 tai4, m4 zeon2 si5 man4 soeng5 heoi3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 颱風期間，港務處會封閉防波堤，不允許市民上去。
examples.english_sentence: During a typhoon the port authority will close the breakwater and forbid the public from going onto it.

mandarin_meaning: 防潮柜（fángcháo guì）
english_meaning: dehumidifying cabinet / dry cabinet / moisture-proof cabinet
explanation_mandarin: 用來保存易受潮物品的櫃子，能控制或降低櫃內濕度，常用來放相機、鏡頭、電子元件、文件、郵票等以防潮損壞。
explanation_english: A cabinet designed to prevent moisture — it controls or reduces humidity inside to store moisture-sensitive items. Commonly used for cameras, lenses, electronic components, documents, stamps, etc.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我買咗部防潮櫃放我嘅相機同鏡頭。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 maai5 zo2 bou6 fong4 ciu4 gwai6 fong3 ngo5 ge3 soeng2 gei1 tung4 ging2 tau4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我買了一個防潮柜放我的相機和鏡頭。
examples.english_sentence: I bought a dry cabinet to store my camera and lenses.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 防潮櫃可以調校濕度，保護電子產品唔怕潮氣。
examples.jyutping_sentence: fong4 ciu4 gwai6 ho2 ji5 tiu4 haau6 sap1 dou6, bou2 wu6 din6 zi2 caan2 ban2 m4 paa3 ciu4 hei3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 防潮柜可以調節濕度，保護電子產品不怕潮氣。
examples.english_sentence: A dry cabinet can adjust humidity to protect electronic products from moisture.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢啲郵票好易受潮，要放入防潮櫃保存。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 di1 jau4 piu3 hou2 ji6 sau6 ciu4, jiu3 fong3 jap6 fong4 ciu4 gwai6 bou2 cyun4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 這些郵票很容易受潮，要放進防潮柜保存。
examples.english_sentence: These stamps are prone to dampness; they should be stored in a dry cabinet.

mandarin_meaning: 防潮珠 / 吸濕珠（乾燥劑的一種，用於吸收濕氣，防止受潮）
english_meaning: desiccant beads; silica gel/moisture-absorbing beads used to prevent dampness
explanation_mandarin: 指放在包裝、櫃子或容器內用來吸收濕氣的小珠狀乾燥劑，常見於鞋盒、電子產品包裝和衣物儲存等，能防止發霉或生鏽。
explanation_english: Refers to small bead-like desiccants placed inside packaging, containers, or storage to absorb moisture. Commonly found in shoe boxes, electronics packaging, and garment storage to prevent mold, rust, or damp damage.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 新買嘅皮鞋我喺鞋盒入面放咗幾包防潮珠。
examples.jyutping_sentence: san1 maai5 ge3 pei4 haai4 ngo5 hai2 haai4 hap6 jap6 min6 fong3 zo2 gei2 baau1 fong4 ciu4 zyu1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 新买的皮鞋我在鞋盒里面放了几包防潮珠。
examples.english_sentence: I put a few packets of desiccant beads in the shoebox for the new leather shoes.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 電子產品嘅包裝入面通常有防潮珠，用嚟保護機件唔受潮。
examples.jyutping_sentence: din6 zi2 caan2 ban2 ge3 baau1 zong1 jap6 min6 tung1 soeng4 jau5 fong4 ciu4 zyu1, jung6 lai4 bou2 wu6 gei1 gin6 m4 sau6 ciu4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 电子产品的包装里面通常有防潮珠，用来保护机件不受潮。
examples.english_sentence: Electronics packaging usually contains desiccant beads to keep the components from getting damp.

mandarin_meaning: 防潮箱 / 干燥箱（用于存放相机、电子产品等以防潮湿）
english_meaning: dry cabinet; dehumidifying cabinet (a moisture-proof storage box for cameras, electronics, etc.)
explanation_mandarin: 一种可以控制内部湿度的储物箱，用于存放相机、镜头、电子元件、药材等以防潮湿损坏。通常内置吸湿装置或电子除湿器。
explanation_english: A storage cabinet that controls internal humidity to protect items such as cameras, lenses, electronics, or herbs from moisture damage. Often uses desiccants or electronic dehumidifiers.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我啲相機同鏡頭要放入防潮箱，咁先唔會受潮。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 di1 soeng1 gei1 tung4 geng3 tau4 jiu3 fong3 jap6 fong4 ciu4 soeng1, gam2 sin1 m4 wui5 sau6 ciu4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我的相机和镜头要放进防潮箱，这样才不会受潮。
examples.english_sentence: I need to put my cameras and lenses into the dry cabinet so they won't get damp.

mandarin_meaning: 防火 / 防止火灾；耐火
english_meaning: fire prevention; fireproof / fire-resistant; to prevent fires
explanation_mandarin: 表示預防火災或具有防止火勢蔓延的性質（如防火門、防火牆），也可作動詞表示採取措施預防火災。
explanation_english: Refers to preventing fires or being resistant to fire (e.g., fireproof materials, fire doors); can also be used as a verb meaning to take measures to prevent fires.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 屋企裝咗防火設備，安心啲。
examples.jyutping_sentence: uk1 kei5 zong1 zo2 fong4 fo2 cit3 bei6, on1 sam1 di1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 家里安装了防火设备，會安心一些。
examples.english_sentence: We installed fire-prevention equipment at home, so it's a bit more reassuring.

mandarin_meaning: 防火墙 (fánghuǒqiáng)
english_meaning: firewall (network security device or software that blocks/controls access)
explanation_mandarin: 用於保護電腦或網絡安全的設備或軟體，能阻擋未授權的訪問或不良流量。
explanation_english: A device or software that protects a computer or network by blocking or controlling unauthorized access and malicious traffic.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 公司部門嘅伺服器有防火牆，阻止未授權嘅訪問。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gung1 si1 bou6 mun4 ge3 ci5 fuk6 hei3 jau5 fong4 fo2 coeng4, zo2 zi2 mei6 sau6 kyun4 ge3 fong2 man6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 公司部門的伺服器有防火牆，阻止未授權的訪問。
examples.english_sentence: The department's server has a firewall that blocks unauthorized access.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋喺電腦上安裝咗防火牆，防止病毒入侵。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 hai2 din6 nou5 soeng6 on1 zong1 zo2 fong4 fo2 coeng4, fong4 zi2 beng6 duk6 jap6 cam1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他們在電腦上安裝了防火牆，防止病毒入侵。
examples.english_sentence: They installed a firewall on the computer to prevent virus intrusions.

mandarin_meaning: 防灾（拼音：fángzāi），指防止或減少災害發生及其影響的措施與準備。
english_meaning: Disaster prevention — measures and preparedness to prevent or mitigate natural or human-made disasters.
explanation_mandarin: 指為了預防或減輕地震、颱風、水災、火災等災害所做的各種準備、措施與演練。
explanation_english: Refers to preparations, measures, and drills carried out to prevent or lessen the impact of disasters such as earthquakes, typhoons, floods, and fires.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 颱風嚟之前，屋企要做好防災準備。
examples.jyutping_sentence: toi4 fung1 lei4 zi1 cin4, uk1 kei5 jiu3 zou6 hou2 fong4 zoi1 zeon2 bei6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 颱風來之前，家裡要做好防災準備。
examples.english_sentence: Before a typhoon arrives, the household needs to make disaster-prevention preparations.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 學校會定期做防災演習，教學生點樣應對地震同火災。
examples.jyutping_sentence: hok6 haau6 wui5 ding6 kei4 zou6 fong4 zoi1 jin2 jyu6, gaau3 hok6 saang1 dim2 joeng6 jing3 deoi3 dei6 zan3 tung4 fo2 zoi1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 學校會定期做防災演習，教學生如何應對地震和火災。
examples.english_sentence: The school conducts regular disaster drills to teach students how to respond to earthquakes and fires.

mandarin_meaning: 防烟门（建筑内用于阻止烟雾扩散的门）
english_meaning: smoke door; smoke-proof door (a door designed to prevent the spread of smoke)
explanation_mandarin: 指安裝在樓宇內用以阻止煙霧擴散的門，常見於樓梯間、走廊或防火分區，通常會設計為能自動關閉或與防煙系統配合以達到防煙或分隔煙道的目的。
explanation_english: A door installed in a building to prevent the spread of smoke; commonly found in stairwells, corridors or fire compartments. Often designed to close automatically or work with smoke-control systems to contain smoke.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 樓梯間嗰啲防煙門要定期檢查，確保正常運作。
examples.jyutping_sentence: lou4 tai1 gaan1 go2 di1 fong4 jin1 mun4 jiu3 ding6 kei4 gim2 caa4, kok3 bou2 zing3 soeng4 wan6 zok3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 楼梯间的防烟门要定期检查，确保正常运作。
examples.english_sentence: The smoke doors in the stairwell must be inspected regularly to ensure they function properly.

mandarin_meaning: 防疫（防止傳染病或疫情的措施或行為）
english_meaning: epidemic prevention; disease prevention; anti-epidemic measures; infection control
explanation_mandarin: 指為防止傳染病或疫情擴散而採取的各種措施或行動，例如戴口罩、消毒、隔離等。
explanation_english: Refers to measures or actions taken to prevent the spread of infectious diseases or epidemics, such as wearing masks, disinfecting, and quarantining.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 依家要做好防疫，出街記住戴口罩。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ji1 gaa1 jiu3 zou6 hou2 fong4 jik6, ceot1 gaai1 gei3 zyu6 daai3 hau2 zaau3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 現在要做好防疫，出門記得戴口罩。
examples.english_sentence: We need to take good epidemic prevention measures now; remember to wear a mask when going out.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 政府公佈咗一啲新嘅防疫措施。
examples.jyutping_sentence: zing3 fu2 gung1 bou3 zo2 jat1 di1 san1 ge3 fong4 jik6 cou3 sik1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 政府公布了一些新的防疫措施。
examples.english_sentence: The government announced some new anti-epidemic measures.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 公司要求員工遵守防疫規定，返工要量體溫。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gung1 si1 jiu1 kau4 jyun4 gung1 zeon1 sau2 fong4 jik6 kwai1 ding6, faan1 gung1 jiu3 loeng4 tai2 wan1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 公司要求員工遵守防疫規定，上班要量體溫。
examples.english_sentence: The company requires staff to follow epidemic prevention rules; employees must have their temperature checked when coming to work.

mandarin_meaning: 防盗
english_meaning: anti-theft; theft prevention; burglar-proof
explanation_mandarin: 表示用來防止偷竊的措施或設備。可作動詞（防止偷竊）或形容詞（具有防盜功能）。
explanation_english: Refers to measures or devices designed to prevent theft. Can be used as a verb (to prevent theft) or an adjective (having anti-theft features).

examples.cantonese_sentence: 屋企裝咗防盜系統，出門都放心啲。
examples.jyutping_sentence: uk1 kei5 zong1 zo2 fong4 dou6 hai6 tung2, ceot1 mun4 dou1 fong3 sam1 di1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 家裡安裝了防盜系統，出門也比較放心。
examples.english_sentence: We installed an anti-theft system at home, so we're more at ease when going out.

mandarin_meaning: 门镜 / 猫眼（门上的窥视孔，用于在不开门的情况下看到门外的人）
english_meaning: peephole; door viewer (a small lens in a door to see who is outside without opening it)
explanation_mandarin: 防盗眼（也叫猫眼或门镜）是一种安装在门上的窥视装置，便于在不开门的情况下看清门外的人，从而提高居家安全。
explanation_english: A peephole (door viewer) is a small viewing device installed in a door that allows occupants to see who is outside without opening the door, enhancing home security.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我裝咗個防盜眼，可以先睇清楚先開門。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 zong1 zo2 go3 fong4 dou6 ngaan5, ho2 ji5 sin1 tai2 cing1 co2 sin1 hoi1 mun4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我装了个防盗眼，可以先看清楚再开门。
examples.english_sentence: I installed a peephole, so I can see clearly before opening the door.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 舊樓個防盜眼好細，望唔清楚。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gau6 lau4 go3 fong4 dou6 ngaan5 hou2 sai3, mong6 m4 cing1 co2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 旧楼的防盗眼很小，看不清楚。
examples.english_sentence: The peephole in the old building is very small; you can't see clearly.

mandarin_meaning: 防禦（fángyù）——防守、抵禦敵人或有害事物的行為或措施
english_meaning: defense; to defend — measures or actions to guard against attack or harm
explanation_mandarin: 指為了抵擋攻擊或減少損害而採取的防守、保護行為或能力，可指具體的防護措施或防守的動作。
explanation_english: Refers to actions, measures, or the capability to guard against attacks, intrusion, or harm; can denote concrete protective measures (noun) or the act of defending (verb).

examples.cantonese_sentence: 士兵試圖加強城牆嘅防禦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: si6 bing1 si3 tou4 gaa1 koeng4 sing4 coeng4 ge3 fong4 jyu6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 士兵試圖加強城牆的防禦。
examples.english_sentence: The soldiers tried to strengthen the defenses of the city walls.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢個系統可以有效防禦外來攻擊。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 go3 hai6 tung2 ho2 ji5 jau5 haau6 fong4 jyu6 ngoi6 loi4 gung1 gik1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 這個系統可以有效防禦外來攻擊。
examples.english_sentence: This system can effectively defend against external attacks.

mandarin_meaning: 防禦工事（防御工事）
english_meaning: fortifications; defensive works
explanation_mandarin: 指用於防守或保護的建築或設施，如城牆、壕溝、碉堡等軍事防護工程。
explanation_english: Refers to structures or installations built for defense or protection, such as walls, trenches, bunkers — military defensive works.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 古戰場上遺留咗好多防禦工事。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gu2 zin3 coeng4 soeng6 wai4 lau4 zo2 hou2 do1 fong4 jyu6 gung1 si6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 古戰場上遺留了很多防禦工事。
examples.english_sentence: Many defensive works remain on the ancient battlefield.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 工程師話要加固舊有嘅防禦工事，防止海水侵蝕。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gung1 cing4 si1 waa6 jiu3 gaa1 gu3 gau6 jau5 ge3 fong4 jyu6 gung1 si6, fong4 zi2 hoi2 seoi2 cam1 sik6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 工程師說要加固舊有的防禦工事，以防海水侵蝕。
examples.english_sentence: The engineers said they need to reinforce the old defensive works to prevent seawater erosion.

mandarin_meaning: 防空洞 / 空襲避難所（fángkōngdòng）
english_meaning: air-raid shelter; bomb shelter
explanation_mandarin: 供人在空襲或戰時避難的地下或加固建築或設施，有時亦可指改作其他用途的舊避難設施。
explanation_english: A structure or facility (often underground or reinforced) used for sheltering people during air raids or wartime; can also refer to older shelters repurposed for other uses.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 二戰期間，居民會入防空洞避難。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ji6 zin3 kei4 gaan1, geoi1 man4 wui5 jap6 fong4 hung1 dung6 bei6 naan6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 二战期间，居民会进入防空洞避难。
examples.english_sentence: During World War II, residents would go into air-raid shelters to take refuge.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 而家好多舊防空洞都改建做展覽或者倉庫。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ji4 gaa1 hou2 do1 gau6 fong4 hung1 dung6 dou1 goi2 gin3 zou6 zin2 laam5 waak6 ze2 cong1 fu3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 现在许多旧防空洞都改建成展览空间或仓库。
examples.english_sentence: Nowadays many old air-raid shelters have been converted into exhibition spaces or storage.

mandarin_meaning: 防范 / 防範（fángfàn）—— 採取措施以防止危害或不良事件發生
english_meaning: to guard against; to take precautions; to prevent
explanation_mandarin: 表示採取預防或防備的措施，以避免發生損害、威脅或不良事件。
explanation_english: Indicates taking precautions or protective measures to avoid harm, threats, or undesirable events.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 為咗防範入屋盜竊，你應該鎖好門窗。
examples.jyutping_sentence: wai6 zo2 fong4 faan6 jap6 nguk1 dou6 cit3, nei5 jing1 goi1 so2 hou2 mun4 coeng1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 為了防範入室盜竊，你應該把門窗鎖好。
examples.english_sentence: To guard against house burglaries, you should lock your doors and windows.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 學校加強安全措施，防範校園暴力。
examples.jyutping_sentence: hok6 haau6 gaa1 koeng4 on1 cyun4 cou3 sik1, fong4 faan6 haau6 jyun4 bou6 lik6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 學校加強安全措施，防範校園暴力。
examples.english_sentence: The school has strengthened safety measures to prevent campus violence.

mandarin_meaning: 防範於未然（在問題發生之前採取預防措施）
english_meaning: to take precautions before something happens; prevent problems before they occur
explanation_mandarin: 表示事先採取預防或防範措施，以避免災禍或問題發生。
explanation_english: Expresses taking preventive measures in advance to avoid disasters or problems from occurring.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 公司應該防範於未然，早啲做好資料備份同安全措施。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gung1 si1 jing1 goi1 fong4 faan6 jyu1 mei6 jin4, zou2 di1 zou6 hou2 zi1 liu2 bei6 fan6 tung4 ngon1 cyun4 cou3 si1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 公司應該防範於未然，早點做好資料備份和安全措施。
examples.english_sentence: The company should take precautions before problems arise, and make data backups and security measures early.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 為咗防範於未然，我哋每年都會做消防演習。
examples.jyutping_sentence: wai6 zo2 fong4 faan6 jyu1 mei6 jin4, ngo5 dei6 mui5 nin4 dou1 wui5 zou6 siu1 fong4 jin2 zaap6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 為了防範於未然，我們每年都會進行消防演習。
examples.english_sentence: In order to prevent problems beforehand, we hold fire drills every year.

mandarin_meaning: 防范未然（採取預防措施以避免事故或危害發生）
english_meaning: To take precautions to prevent problems or dangers before they occur; to forestall mishaps.
explanation_mandarin: 指事先採取防備或預防措施，以免發生意外或不良後果。
explanation_english: An idiom meaning to take preventive measures beforehand to avoid accidents, problems, or dangers from happening.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 公司應該防範未然，加強安全檢查。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gung1 si1 jing1 goi1 fong4 faan6 mei6 jin4, gaa1 koeng4 on1 cyun4 gim2 caa4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 公司應該防範未然，加強安全檢查。
examples.english_sentence: The company should take precautions to prevent incidents and strengthen safety inspections.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 為咗防範未然，我哋決定多裝幾個監控鏡頭。
examples.jyutping_sentence: wai6 zo2 fong4 faan6 mei6 jin4, ngo5 dei6 kyut3 ding6 do1 zong1 gei2 go3 gaam1 hung3 geng3 tau4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 為了防範未然，我們決定多裝幾個監控攝像頭。
examples.english_sentence: To guard against potential problems, we decided to install several more security cameras.

mandarin_meaning: 防线（用于阻挡敌人或阻止问题扩散的防御线）
english_meaning: line of defense; defensive line; barrier (literal or figurative)
explanation_mandarin: 指用來阻止敵人、問題或危害蔓延的防衛線，可以是軍事上的陣線，也可引申為阻止不良情況的最後防線或防護措施。
explanation_english: Refers to a line or barrier set up to stop an enemy, problem, or harm from spreading. It can mean a military defensive line or figuratively any last or primary protective measure.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋嘅防線畀敵人突破咗。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 ge3 fong4 sin3 bei2 dik6 jan4 dat6 po3 zo2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们的防线被敌人突破了。
examples.english_sentence: Our line of defense was breached by the enemy.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 醫療系統嘅防線已經好脆弱，要趕快加強。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ji1 liu4 hai6 tung2 ge3 fong4 sin3 ji5 ging1 hou2 ceoi3 joek6, jiu3 gon2 faai3 gaa1 koeng4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 医疗系统的防线已经很脆弱，要赶快加强。
examples.english_sentence: The healthcare system's defenses are already fragile and need to be strengthened quickly.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 如果你走咗，我就冇最後一條防線。
examples.jyutping_sentence: jyu4 gwo2 nei5 zau2 zo2, ngo5 zau6 mou5 zeoi3 hau6 jat1 tiu4 fong4 sin3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 如果你走了，我就没有最后一道防线。
examples.english_sentence: If you leave, I'll have no last line of defense.

mandarin_meaning: 防腐剂
english_meaning: preservative
explanation_mandarin: 用于防止食品、化妆品或其他物品变质、延长保存期限的化学物质或添加剂。
explanation_english: A chemical substance or additive used to prevent spoilage and extend the shelf life of foods, cosmetics, or other products.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢款餅乾入面有好多防腐劑，食多咗對身體唔好。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 fun2 beng2 gon1 jap6 min6 jau5 hou2 do1 fong4 fu2 zai3, sik6 do1 zo2 deoi3 san1 tai2 m4 hou2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 這種餅乾裡面有很多防腐劑，吃多了對身體不好。
examples.english_sentence: This biscuit contains a lot of preservatives; eating too many is bad for your health.

mandarin_meaning: 防卫 (fángwèi)
english_meaning: defend; defence; to guard against threats or intrusions
explanation_mandarin: 表示保護、抵禦外來威脅或侵害的行為或狀態，可作動詞或名詞使用，語氣較正式。
explanation_english: Refers to protecting or guarding against external threats or intrusions; can be used as a verb or noun and is relatively formal.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 為咗防衛個人私隱，我哋要好好保護自己嘅資料。
examples.jyutping_sentence: wai6 zo2 fong4 wai6 go3 jan4 si1 jan4, ngo5 dei6 jiu3 hou2 hou2 bou2 wu6 zi6 gei2 ge3 zi1 liu2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 為了防衛個人隱私，我們要好好保護自己的資料。
examples.english_sentence: To defend personal privacy, we must properly protect our own data.

mandarin_meaning: 防卫（fang2 wei4）：防守、保卫、采取措施抵御攻击或伤害
english_meaning: to defend; defense; to guard against harm or attack
explanation_mandarin: 指採取措施保護自己或國家，防止攻擊、滲透或損害，可用於軍事、網絡或一般防護情境。
explanation_english: Refers to taking measures to protect oneself or a country, preventing attacks, infiltration, or harm; used in military, cyber-security, or general protection contexts.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 政府要加強國家防衛，保護邊境安全。
examples.jyutping_sentence: zing3 fu2 jiu3 gaa1 koeng4 gwok3 gaa1 fong4 wai6, bou2 wu6 bin1 ging2 on1 cyun4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 政府要加强国家防卫，保护边境安全。
examples.english_sentence: The government needs to strengthen national defense to protect border security.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋要做好網絡防衛，防止資料外洩同黑客入侵。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 jiu3 zou6 hou2 mong5 lok3 fong4 wai6, fong4 zi2 zi1 liu2 ngoi6 sit3 tung4 hak1 haak3 jap6 cam1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们要做好网络防卫，防止资料外泄和黑客入侵。
examples.english_sentence: We must implement strong network defenses to prevent data leaks and hacker intrusions.

mandarin_meaning: 防卫（保護、抵禦）
english_meaning: defend; defense; protection
explanation_mandarin: 表示保護或抵禦外來威脅或攻擊。可作動詞（防衛某物/某地）或名詞（防衛措施、國家防衛）。
explanation_english: Refers to protecting or resisting external threats or attacks. Can be used as a verb (to defend) or as a noun (defense/protection measures).

examples.cantonese_sentence: 政府要加強國家防衞，確保邊境安全。
examples.jyutping_sentence: zing3 fu2 jiu3 gaa1 koeng4 gwok3 gaa1 fong4 wai6, kok3 bou2 bin1 ging2 on1 cyun4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 政府要加强国家防卫，确保边境安全。
examples.english_sentence: The government must strengthen national defense to ensure border security.

mandarin_meaning: 防护（保護、抵禦傷害或損害的措施或行為）
english_meaning: Protection; protective measures or actions to prevent harm or damage
explanation_mandarin: 指為防止傷害、損害或危害而採取的措施、裝備或行為，也可用作動詞表示進行保護或防衛。
explanation_english: Refers to measures, equipment, or actions taken to prevent injury, damage, or harm; can also be used as a verb meaning to protect or guard.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 出門要做好防護，戴口罩同消毒雙手。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ceot1 mun4 jiu3 zou6 hou2 fong4 wu6, daai3 hau2 zaau3 tung4 siu1 duk6 soeng1 sau2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 出门要做好防护，戴口罩并消毒双手。
examples.english_sentence: When going out, take proper protective measures—wear a mask and disinfect your hands.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 工程師檢查咗所有防護設備，確保安全。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gung1 cing4 si1 gim2 caa4 zo2 sou2 jau5 fong4 wu6 cit3 bei6, kok3 bou2 on1 cyun4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 工程师检查了所有防护设备，确保安全。
examples.english_sentence: The engineer inspected all protective equipment to ensure safety.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢啲材料可以防護你嘅皮膚，免受化學品侵害。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 di1 coi4 liu2 ho2 ji5 fong4 wu6 nei5 ge3 pei4 fu1 min5 sau6 faa3 hok6 ban2 cam1 hoi6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这些材料可以保护你的皮肤，免受化学品侵害。
examples.english_sentence: These materials can protect your skin from chemical exposure.

mandarin_meaning: 防長（fángzhǎng）：國防部長、負責國家防務與軍事事務的首長
english_meaning: Minister of Defense; Defense Minister — the head of a country's defense ministry responsible for national defense and military affairs
explanation_mandarin: 指主管國防、軍事或防務事務的政府高級官員或部長職銜，常指國防部長或防衛大臣。
explanation_english: Refers to the senior government official or minister in charge of defense and military affairs, commonly used for the Minister of Defense.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 政府任命咗新嘅防長，會主理國防同軍事。
examples.jyutping_sentence: zing3 fu2 jam6 ming6 zo2 san1 ge3 fong4 zoeng2, wui5 zyu2 lei5 gwok3 fong4 tung4 gwan1 si6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 政府任命了新的防長，會主理國防和軍事。
examples.english_sentence: The government appointed a new Minister of Defense, who will oversee national defense and military affairs.

mandarin_meaning: 防震 / 抗震（fángzhèn）：采取措施预防或减轻地震造成的损害；也可指抗震、抗震性的
english_meaning: earthquake-proof; seismic-resistant; to guard against earthquakes; shockproof
explanation_mandarin: 指為了預防或減輕地震帶來的破壞而採取的措施或具備抗震功能的物品、構造。
explanation_english: Refers to measures taken to prevent or mitigate damage from earthquakes, or to objects/structures that are designed to be seismic-resistant or shockproof.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋屋企要安裝防震設施。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 uk1 kei2 jiu3 on1 zong1 fong4 zan3 cit3 si1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们家要安装防震设施。
examples.english_sentence: We need to install earthquake-proof measures at home.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 部手機有防震保護殼，跌都唔驚咁易爛。
examples.jyutping_sentence: bou6 sau2 gei1 jau5 fong4 zan3 bou2 wu6 hok3, dit3 dou1 m4 ging1 gam2 ji6 laan6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这部手机有防震保护壳，摔了也不怕那么容易坏。
examples.english_sentence: The phone has a shockproof case, so it's not so easily damaged when dropped.

mandarin_meaning: 防鲨网（用于防止鲨鱼袭击的网，也可比喻为防范危害的措施）
english_meaning: shark net (a net to prevent sharks from entering; figuratively, protective measures to guard against predators or harm)
explanation_mandarin: 指安裝在海灘或海域以阻擋鯊魚進入的網狀裝置，用來保護游泳者或海上活動的人；口語中也可引申為防止欺詐、騷擾或其他危害的各類保護性措施或過濾機制。
explanation_english: Refers to a net installed at beaches or in the sea to block sharks from entering, used to protect swimmers and people doing sea activities. Colloquially, it can be used figuratively to mean protective or filtering measures that prevent scams, harassment, or other dangers.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 泳灘已經裝咗防鯊網，市民可以放心游水。
examples.jyutping_sentence: wing6 taan1 ji5 ging1 zong1 zo2 fong4 saa1 mong5, si5 man4 ho2 ji5 fong2 sam1 jau4 seoi2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 沙灘已經裝了防鯊網，市民可以放心游泳。
examples.english_sentence: The beach has been fitted with shark nets, so the public can swim with peace of mind.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋個網站有啲防鯊網功能，可以幫用戶過濾可疑帳戶。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 go3 mong5 zaam6 jau5 di1 fong4 saa1 mong5 gung1 nang4, ho2 ji5 bong1 jung6 wu6 gwo3 leot6 ho2 ji4 zoeng3 wu6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我們的網站有一些防鯊網功能，可以幫助用戶過濾可疑帳戶。
examples.english_sentence: Our website has some 'shark-net' features that help users filter suspicious accounts.

mandarin_meaning: 一段短时间；一会儿；一阵
english_meaning: a short period of time; a while; a spell; moment
explanation_mandarin: 在粵語口語中，『阵』常用來表示一段短暫的時間或某一時刻，可單獨使用或與量詞連用（如『一陣』、『陣間』）。
explanation_english: In Cantonese colloquial use, '阵' (zan6) indicates a short period of time or a moment. It is used alone or in compounds like "jat1 zan6" (a while) or "zan6 gaan1" (in a moment).

examples.cantonese_sentence: 等一陣先。
examples.jyutping_sentence: dang2 jat1 zan6 sin1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 等一下／等一会儿。
examples.english_sentence: Wait a moment.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我做陣陣嘢就返嚟。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 zou6 zan6 zan6 je5 zau6 faan1 lai4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我做一会儿事情就回来。
examples.english_sentence: I'll do something for a bit and then come back.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 陣間見！
examples.jyutping_sentence: zan6 gaan1 gin3!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 待会儿见！
examples.english_sentence: See you in a bit!

examples.cantonese_sentence: 嗰陣天氣真係好熱。
examples.jyutping_sentence: go2 zan6 tin1 hei3 zan1 hai6 hou2 jit6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 那阵子天气真的很热。
examples.english_sentence: The weather was really hot then.

mandarin_meaning: 台阶；阶段；阶级
english_meaning: step; stair; stage; rank; social class
explanation_mandarin: 表示台阶或阶梯，也可指事物的阶段、等级或社会阶层。常见于“階梯”、“階段”、“階級”等词语。
explanation_english: Refers to a step or stair; can also mean a stage/phase or a rank/social class. Commonly appears in compounds like '階梯' (stair), '階段' (stage), and '階級' (class).

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢座樓有十級階梯。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 zo6 lau4 jau5 sap6 kap1 gaai1 tai1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这座楼有十级阶梯。
examples.english_sentence: This building has ten steps.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 個計劃而家仍然處於初期階段。
examples.jyutping_sentence: go3 gai3 waak6 ji4 gaa1 jing4 jin4 cyu3 jyu1 co1 kei4 gaai1 dyun6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这个计划现在仍然处于初期阶段。
examples.english_sentence: The project is still in its initial stage.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋屬於社會上層階級。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 suk6 jyu1 se5 wui6 soeng6 cang4 gaai1 kap1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们属于社会上层阶级。
examples.english_sentence: They belong to the upper social class.

mandarin_meaning: 阻（阻挡、妨碍）
english_meaning: to block; to obstruct; to hinder
explanation_mandarin: 表示阻挡、妨碍或挡住别人或事物，常用于口语，常与“住”连用形成“阻住”表示正在挡住或妨碍。
explanation_english: Means to block, obstruct, or hinder someone or something. Common in colloquial Cantonese and often used with the particle “住” (e.g. “阻住”) to indicate being in the way.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好阻住我做嘢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 zo2 zyu6 ngo5 zou6 je5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 不要阻碍我做事。
examples.english_sentence: Don't block/stop me from doing my work.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢個箱擺喺門口，阻住出入。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 go3 soeng1 baai2 hai2 mun4 hau2, zo2 zyu6 ceot1 jap6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这个箱子放在门口，阻碍出入。
examples.english_sentence: This box is at the doorway, blocking entry and exit.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 對唔住，我唔係想阻你做嘢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: deoi3 m4 zyu6, ngo5 m4 hai6 soeng2 zo2 nei5 zou6 je5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 对不起，我不是想阻碍你做事。
examples.english_sentence: Sorry, I didn't mean to stop you from doing that.

mandarin_meaning: 挑三揀四 / 找碴 / 愛挑剔、干涉
english_meaning: to nitpick; to find fault; to interfere unnecessarily
explanation_mandarin: 粵語俗語，指無端干涉、挑剔或不停找茬，常用來形容在旁邊多嘴、多事或阻礙別人做事。
explanation_english: A Cantonese colloquial expression meaning to nitpick, pick faults, or interfere unnecessarily—often used to describe someone who meddles or constantly objects and obstructs others.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好阻三阻四，等我做完啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 zo2 saam1 zo2 sei3, dang2 ngo5 zou6 jyun4 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 別在旁邊挑三揀四，讓我做完吧。
examples.english_sentence: Stop nitpicking and let me finish.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢成日阻三阻四，搞到大家唔開心。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 sing4 jat6 zo2 saam1 zo2 sei3, gaau2 dou3 daai6 gaa1 m4 hoi1 sam1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他老是挑三揀四，弄得大家不高興。
examples.english_sentence: He is always nitpicking, making everyone unhappy.

mandarin_meaning: 挡住；妨碍
english_meaning: to block; to obstruct; to get in the way
explanation_mandarin: 粤语口语用词，表示挡住、妨碍某人或某事进行，常用于责备或提醒别人不要挡路或打断别人。
explanation_english: A colloquial Cantonese verb meaning to block or obstruct someone or something — to get in the way or hinder an action.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好阻住我做嘢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 zo2 zyu6 ngo5 zou6 je5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 不要妨碍我做事。
examples.english_sentence: Don't get in my way while I'm working.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好阻住個門口，大家走唔到。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 zo2 zyu6 go3 mun4 hau2, daai6 gaa1 zau2 m4 dou3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 别挡着门口，大家进不去/走不过去。
examples.english_sentence: Don't block the doorway; people can't get through.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢成日阻住我同人哋傾計。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 sing4 jat6 zo2 zyu6 ngo5 tung4 jan4 dei6 king1 gai3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他经常打断我和别人说话。
examples.english_sentence: He often interrupts me when I'm talking to others.

jyutping: zo2 zyu6 go3 dei6 kau4 zyun2
mandarin_meaning: 阻碍进展（字面夸张说法：阻挡地球转动）
english_meaning: to obstruct progress; to get in the way (literally: 'stop the Earth from turning', used hyperbolically)
explanation_mandarin: 粤语口语/俚语，字面意思是“阻挡地球转动”，夸张地形容某人或某事妨碍进展、拖累或碍手碍脚，令事情难以进行。
explanation_english: A Cantonese colloquial/slang phrase literally meaning 'to block the Earth's rotation'. Used hyperbolically to describe someone or something that obstructs progress, causes trouble, or gets in the way.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢成日喺度阻住個地球轉，搞到大家做唔到嘢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 seng4 jat6 hai2 dou6 zo2 zyu6 go3 dei6 kau4 zyun2, gaau2 dou3 daai6 gaa1 zou6 m4 dou2 je5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他老是在那儿添阻碍，弄得大家做不了事。
examples.english_sentence: He's always getting in the way and causing everyone to be unable to work.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好阻住個地球轉啦，俾我哋快啲完成先。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 zo2 zyu6 go3 dei6 kau4 zyun2 laa1, bei2 ngo5 dei6 faai3 di1 jyun4 sing4 sin1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 别挡道，让我们先快点完成。
examples.english_sentence: Don't get in the way; let us finish quickly first.

mandarin_meaning: 阻碍进展；妨碍别人/事情顺利进行（夸张说法）
english_meaning: to obstruct or hinder progress; to be a nuisance/get in the way (hyperbolic)
explanation_mandarin: 口語俚語表達，字面為「阻住地球轉」，實際用來誇張地形容某人或某事阻礙、拖累他人或妨礙事情順利進行，帶有不滿或抱怨的語氣。
explanation_english: A colloquial Cantonese expression literally meaning "blocking the Earth's rotation." Used hyperbolically to say someone or something is obstructing progress or causing trouble—i.e., getting in the way or holding things up. Often conveys annoyance.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢成日阻住地球轉，搞到大家做嘢好辛苦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 sing4 jat6 zo2 zyu6 dei6 kau4 zyun2, gaau2 dou3 daai6 gaa1 zou6 je5 hou2 san1 fu2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他老是拖後腿，讓大家工作很辛苦。
examples.english_sentence: He always gets in the way, making everyone's work harder.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好阻住地球轉啦，我而家趕時間。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 zo2 zyu6 dei6 kau4 zyun2 laa1, ngo5 ji4 gaa1 gon2 si4 gaan3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 別擋路了，我現在趕時間。
examples.english_sentence: Don't get in the way—I'm in a hurry.

mandarin_meaning: 阻挡、抵抗的力量或障碍
english_meaning: resistance; force that hinders or an obstacle/impediment
explanation_mandarin: 表示阻擋或抵抗的力量，也可指在推進某事時遇到的障礙或困難。
explanation_english: Refers to a force that hinders or resists movement or progress; can also mean an obstacle or difficulty encountered when advancing something.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 公司推行新政策遇到好大阻力。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gung1 si1 teoi1 hang4 san1 zing3 caak3 jyu6 dou3 hou2 daai6 zo2 lik6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 公司推行新政策遇到很大的阻力。
examples.english_sentence: The company encountered a lot of resistance when implementing the new policy.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 空氣阻力會令飛機減速。
examples.jyutping_sentence: hung1 hei3 zo2 lik6 wui5 ling6 fei1 gei1 gaam2 cuk1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 空气阻力会使飞机减速。
examples.english_sentence: Air resistance causes the airplane to slow down.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 如果你想改變佢，就要搵方法去克服阻力。
examples.jyutping_sentence: jyu4 gwo2 nei5 soeng2 goi2 bin3 keoi5, zau6 jiu3 wan2 fong1 faat3 heoi3 hak1 fuk6 zo2 lik6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 如果你想改变它，就要想办法克服阻力。
examples.english_sentence: If you want to change it, you need to find ways to overcome the resistance.

mandarin_meaning: 恐嚇；威嚇（用言語或行為使人害怕或不敢行動）
english_meaning: to intimidate or threaten someone (colloquial); to block or deter by intimidation
explanation_mandarin: 口語用法，指用言語或行為來恐嚇、威脅或阻止別人，使對方退縮或不敢行動，也可指以阻撓手段嚇阻對方。
explanation_english: Colloquial Cantonese verb meaning to intimidate, threaten, or deter someone—often by words or actions—so that they back down or refrain from acting; can also imply obstructing someone while using intimidation.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢成日嚟阻嚇我，唔俾我講嘢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 sing4 jat6 lei4 zo2 haak3 ngo5, m4 bei2 ngo5 gong2 je5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他成天來恐嚇我，不讓我說話。
examples.english_sentence: He constantly comes to intimidate me and won't let me speak.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 有人喺度阻嚇選民投票，警察要介入。
examples.jyutping_sentence: jau5 jan4 hai2 dou6 zo2 haak3 syun2 man4 tau4 piu3, ging2 caat3 jiu3 gaai3 jap6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 有人在那裡恐嚇選民投票，警察需要介入。
examples.english_sentence: Someone is intimidating voters there; the police need to intervene.

mandarin_meaning: 阻礙、妨礙（口語用法）
english_meaning: to obstruct, to hinder, to hold up (Cantonese colloquial)
explanation_mandarin: 廣東話口語用詞，表示阻擋、妨礙或拖延某事的進行，類似普通話的「阻礙／妨礙」。
explanation_english: A Cantonese colloquial term meaning to block, hinder, or delay something — similar to Mandarin '阻礙' or English 'to obstruct/hold up'.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好阻埞我做嘢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 zo2 dai6 ngo5 zou6 je5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 別阻礙我做事。
examples.english_sentence: Don't obstruct/hold me back from doing my work.

mandarin_meaning: 阻塞（堵塞、阻碍）
english_meaning: to obstruct; blockage; congestion; to clog
explanation_mandarin: 指通道、管道或流程被阻挡或不通畅，常用于交通、血管或網絡等情況，也可指抽象上的阻礙。
explanation_english: Refers to an obstruction or blockage that prevents flow or passage, commonly used for traffic, vessels, networks, or figurative impediments.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 今朝返工嘅時候，幾條要道全部阻塞，我遲到咗。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gam1 ziu1 faan1 gung1 ge3 si4 hau6, gei2 tiu4 jiu3 dou6 cyun4 bou6 zo2 sak1, ngo5 ci4 dou3 zo2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 今天早上上班的时候，几条主要道路全部堵塞，我迟到了。
examples.english_sentence: This morning on the way to work, several main roads were completely blocked and I was late.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 醫生話佢血管有部分阻塞，需要做手術。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ji1 sang1 waa6 keoi5 hyut3 gun2 jau5 bou6 fan6 zo2 sak1, seoi1 jiu3 zou6 sau2 seot6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 医生说他的血管部分阻塞，需要做手术。
examples.english_sentence: The doctor said his blood vessel is partially obstructed and needs surgery.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 而家網絡阻塞，網頁載唔到。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ji4 gaa1 mong5 lok3 zo2 sak1, mong5 jip6 zoi3 m4 dou3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 现在网络拥堵，网页加载不了。
examples.english_sentence: The network is congested right now; web pages won't load.

mandarin_meaning: 把⋯阻住／阻止；確保阻擋住
english_meaning: to block/stop someone or something so that it definitely cannot go/occur
explanation_mandarin: 口語粵語用法，表示把某人或某事物阻住或阻止，確保不讓其發生或離開。
explanation_english: A colloquial Hong Kong Cantonese verb meaning to block or stop someone/something, ensuring it does not happen or leave.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你阻定佢未？
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 zo2 ding6 keoi5 mei6?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你把他挡住了嗎？／你阻止他了嗎？
examples.english_sentence: Did you block/stop him?

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋要阻定佢走，等警察到。
