examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 jiu3 zo2 ding6 keoi5 zau2, dang2 ging2 caat3 dou3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我們要把他挡住，不讓他走，等警察到。
examples.english_sentence: We need to hold him back so he can't leave until the police arrive.

mandarin_meaning: 在工作時間偷懶、打混、不認真工作
english_meaning: to slack off at work; loaf on the job; shirk duties during work hours
explanation_mandarin: 粵語俗語，指在上班或工作時間不認真做事，偷懶、打混或浪費時間，常帶貶義。
explanation_english: A Cantonese slang phrase meaning to be idle or slack off during work hours—loafing on the job, shirking responsibilities. It is colloquial and often has a negative connotation.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢成日喺公司度阻差辦公，公司啲嘢都做唔好。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 seng4 jat6 hai2 gung1 si1 dou6 zo2 caa1 baan6 gung1, gung1 si1 di1 je5 dou1 zou6 m4 hou2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他總是在公司偷懶，公司的事都做不好。
examples.english_sentence: He always slacks off at the company; he can't do his work properly.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好喺老細面前阻差辦公，會畀扣績。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 hai2 lou5 sai3 min6 cin4 zo2 caa1 baan6 gung1, wui5 bei2 kau3 zik1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 不要在老闆面前偷懶，會被扣績。
examples.english_sentence: Don't slack off in front of your boss; you might have your performance points docked.

mandarin_meaning: 拖慢、耽误、妨碍
english_meaning: to slow down; to delay; to hold (someone/something) up
explanation_mandarin: 口語用詞，表示使進度變慢或耽誤某事的進行。
explanation_english: A colloquial Cantonese verb meaning to make something slower or to cause a delay.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好阻慢佢，我哋趕時間。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 zo2 maan6 keoi5, ngo5 dei6 gon2 si4 gaan3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 不要拖慢他，我們趕時間。
examples.english_sentence: Don't slow him down; we're in a hurry.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢條路塞車，阻慢晒我哋。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 tiu4 lou6 sak1 ce1, zo2 maan6 saai3 ngo5 dei6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 這條路塞車，耽誤了我們。
examples.english_sentence: This road is congested; it delayed us.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 電腦死機，阻慢晒我做功課。
examples.jyutping_sentence: din6 nou5 sei2 gei1, zo2 maan6 saai3 ngo5 zou6 gung1 fo3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 電腦當機，耽誤了我做功課。
examples.english_sentence: My computer crashed and slowed me down doing my homework.

mandarin_meaning: 阻截（拦截、阻止、截获）
english_meaning: to block; to intercept; to stop from advancing or reaching
explanation_mandarin: 表示通过阻挡或拦截来阻止某人或某物前进或到达，常用于警方、交通或军事等情境。
explanation_english: Indicates preventing someone or something from advancing or reaching a destination by blocking or intercepting; commonly used in contexts like police operations, traffic, or military actions.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 警方成功阻截咗一艘走私船。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ging2 fong1 sing4 gung1 zo2 zit3 zo2 jat1 sou1 zau2 si1 syun4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 警方成功阻截了一艘走私船。
examples.english_sentence: The police successfully intercepted a smuggling boat.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 大樹倒咗喺路中，阻截咗所有車輛通行。
examples.jyutping_sentence: daai6 syu6 dou2 zo2 hai2 lou6 zung1, zo2 zit3 zo2 so2 jau5 ce1 loeng6 tung1 hang4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 大樹倒在路中，阻截了所有车辆通行。
examples.english_sentence: A large tree fell in the middle of the road, blocking all vehicle traffic.

mandarin_meaning: 妨礙、拖累、使行動不便
english_meaning: to hinder or get in the way; to be a burden that makes actions or progress difficult
explanation_mandarin: 廣東話口語，形容某人或某物妨礙行動或拖累別人，導致事情進展不順利或變慢。
explanation_english: A Cantonese colloquial phrase used to describe someone or something that obstructs movement or progress, causing delays or trouble.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 做嘢嗰陣唔好阻手阻腳，大家分工就快啲做完。
examples.jyutping_sentence: zou6 je5 go2 zan6 m4 hou2 zo2 sau2 zo2 goek3 daai6 gaa1 fan1 gung1 zau6 faai3 di1 zou6 jyun4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 做事的時候不要阻手阻腳，大家分工就能快一點完成。
examples.english_sentence: When working, don't get in the way so everyone can finish faster.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你成日阻手阻腳，佢做唔到嘢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 sing4 jat6 zo2 sau2 zo2 goek3 keoi5 zou6 m4 dou2 je5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你老是阻手阻腳，他做不了事。
examples.english_sentence: You keep getting in the way; he can't get it done.

mandarin_meaning: 阻挠 (zǔnáo)：妨碍、阻止某人或某事的进行
english_meaning: to obstruct; to hinder; to thwart; to interfere with
explanation_mandarin: 表示阻止、干扰或妨碍某人或某事的进行，常用于描述有意或无意的阻碍行为。
explanation_english: Indicates preventing, interfering with, or hindering someone or something from proceeding; commonly used to describe acts of obstruction.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢成日阻撓我做嘢，真係好煩。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 sing4 jat6 zo2 naau4 ngo5 zou6 je5, zan1 hai6 hou2 faan4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他成天阻挠我做事，真是很烦。
examples.english_sentence: He keeps obstructing my work; it's really annoying.

mandarin_meaning: 阻挡 (阻止、挡住)
english_meaning: to block; to obstruct; to prevent
explanation_mandarin: 表示用物體或行為阻止、擋住某人或某事的進行或通行。
explanation_english: To stop, block, or obstruct someone or something from moving or proceeding, either by placing a physical barrier or by taking action.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢企喺門口阻擋我入去。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 kei5 hai2 mun4 hau2 zo2 dong2 ngo5 jap6 heoi3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他站在門口阻擋我進去。
examples.english_sentence: He stood at the doorway blocking me from entering.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 大雨好勁，倒下嘅樹阻擋咗條路。
examples.jyutping_sentence: daai6 jyu5 hou2 ging6, dou3 haa6 ge3 syu6 zo2 dong2 zo2 tiu4 lou6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 大雨很大，倒下的樹擋住了道路。
examples.english_sentence: The rain was heavy; the fallen tree blocked the road.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋要阻擋敵人入侵。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 jiu3 zo2 dong2 dik6 jan4 jap6 cam1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我們要阻擋敵人的入侵。
examples.english_sentence: We must block the enemy's invasion.

mandarin_meaning: 阻拦 (zǔ lán)
english_meaning: to block, obstruct, stop or prevent someone/something
explanation_mandarin: 表示阻挡或拦住某人或某事，使其不能继续进行。
explanation_english: Means to block or stop someone or something from proceeding; to obstruct or prevent.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好阻攔我，畀我試下先。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 zo2 laan4 ngo5, bei2 ngo5 si3 haa5 sin1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 别阻拦我，让我先试一下。
examples.english_sentence: Don't stop me, let me try first.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 警方阻攔咗示威者入內。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ging2 fong1 zo2 laan4 zo2 si6 wai1 ze2 jap6 noi6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 警方阻拦了示威者进入内部。
examples.english_sentence: The police blocked the protesters from entering.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢唔想畀我哋阻攔佢去旅行。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 m4 soeng2 bei2 ngo5 dei6 zo2 laan4 keoi5 heoi3 leoi5 hang4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他不想让我们阻拦他去旅行。
examples.english_sentence: He doesn't want us to stop him from traveling.

mandarin_meaning: 阻止（zǔzhǐ），制止、妨礙某行為發生
english_meaning: to prevent; to stop; to hinder
explanation_mandarin: 表示阻擋、制止某個動作或情況發生或繼續，常用於口語與書面語中。
explanation_english: Indicates preventing or stopping an action or situation from happening or continuing. Commonly used in both spoken and written contexts.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好阻止佢，等佢試下先。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 zo2 zi2 keoi5, dang2 keoi5 si3 haa5 sin1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 不要阻止他，讓他先試一試。
examples.english_sentence: Don't stop him; let him try first.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 警方成功阻止咗暴力行為。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ging2 fong1 sing4 gung1 zo2 zi2 zo2 bou6 lik6 hang4 wai6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 警方成功阻止了暴力行为。
examples.english_sentence: The police successfully stopped the violent behavior.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 如果你阻止佢哋合作，可能會令事情更複雜。
examples.jyutping_sentence: jyu4 gwo2 nei5 zo2 zi2 keoi5 dei6 hap6 zok3, ho2 nang4 wui5 ling6 si6 cing4 gang3 fuk1 zaap6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 如果你阻止他们合作，可能会让事情更复杂。
examples.english_sentence: If you prevent them from cooperating, it may make things more complicated.

mandarin_meaning: 阻滞；阻碍、停滞、不顺畅
english_meaning: obstruction; blockage; stagnation; hindrance; to impede
explanation_mandarin: 指阻碍、停滞或不顺畅的情形，可用作名词表示状态，也可用作动词表示造成阻碍。
explanation_english: Refers to an obstruction, blockage, or stagnation; can be used as a noun to denote the state or as a verb to mean causing an impediment.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢個工程因為材料供應阻滯，所以要延遲。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 go3 gung1 cing4 jan1 wai6 coi4 liu6 gung1 jing3 zo2 zai3, so2 ji5 jiu3 jin4 ci4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 這個工程因為材料供應阻滯，所以要延遲。
examples.english_sentence: This project has to be postponed because the supply of materials is blocked.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 因為系統阻滯，考試成績未能即時更新。
examples.jyutping_sentence: jan1 wai6 hai6 tung2 zo2 zai3, haau2 si3 sing4 zik1 mei6 nang4 zik1 si4 geng1 san1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 因為系統阻滯，考試成績未能即時更新。
examples.english_sentence: Due to a system blockage, exam results couldn't be updated immediately.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 公司嘅決策造成部門之間嘅溝通阻滯，影響工作效率。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gung1 si1 ge3 kyut3 caak3 zou6 sing4 bou6 mun4 zi1 gaan1 ge3 kau1 tung1 zo2 zai3, jing2 hoeng2 gung1 zok3 haau6 leot6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 公司的決策造成部門之間的溝通阻滯，影響工作效率。
examples.english_sentence: The company's decisions caused communication blockages between departments, affecting work efficiency.

mandarin_meaning: 阻礙、擋住（行動或計劃）
english_meaning: to obstruct; to block; to hinder or get in the way
explanation_mandarin: 粵語口語用詞，形容某人或某事物擋路、妨礙、阻撓別人的行動或計劃，帶有干擾或造成不便的意思。
explanation_english: A Cantonese colloquial verb meaning to obstruct or hinder someone's actions or plans; used for people or things that get in the way, cause trouble, or create delays.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢成日嚟阻碇我哋嘅計劃，真係煩。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 sing4 jat6 lai4 zo2 ding6 ngo5 dei6 ge3 gai3 waak6, zan1 hai6 faan4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他總是來阻撓我們的計劃，真煩。
examples.english_sentence: He always comes and obstructs our plans; it's really annoying.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 嗰個工地擺嘢出嚟，成日阻碇行人路。
examples.jyutping_sentence: go2 go3 gung1 dei6 baai2 je5 ceot1 lai4, sing4 jat6 zo2 ding6 hang4 jan4 lou6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 那個工地把東西擺出來，經常阻礙人行道。
examples.english_sentence: That construction site leaves stuff outside and often blocks the sidewalk.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好阻碇，等我講完啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 zo2 ding6, dang2 ngo5 gong2 jyun4 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 不要阻礙，等我說完。
examples.english_sentence: Don't interrupt/get in the way—let me finish speaking.

mandarin_meaning: 阻碍（阻挡、妨碍）
english_meaning: to obstruct; to hinder; obstacle; hindrance
explanation_mandarin: 表示妨碍、阻挡某事的进行，也可指造成妨碍的事物或因素。
explanation_english: Indicates blocking or hindering the progress of something; can also refer to the thing or factor that causes the hindrance.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢啲意見淨係阻礙進步。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 di1 ji3 gin3 zing6 hai6 zo2 ngai6 zeon3 bou6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他的一些意见只会阻碍进步。
examples.english_sentence: His comments only hinder progress.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 維修工程期間，封路會阻礙市民出入。
examples.jyutping_sentence: wai4 sau1 gung1 cing4 kei4 gaan1, fung1 lou6 wui5 zo2 ngai6 si5 man4 ceot1 jap6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 维修工程期间，封路会阻碍市民出入。
examples.english_sentence: Road closures during maintenance will obstruct residents' access.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢個計劃最大嘅阻礙係資金不足。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 go3 gai3 waak6 zeoi3 daai6 ge3 zo2 ngai6 hai6 zi1 gam1 bat1 zuk1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这个计划最大的阻碍是资金不足。
examples.english_sentence: The biggest obstacle to this project is insufficient funding.

mandarin_meaning: 挡路；阻碍通行（多用于香港粤语，指在街上聚集或站着妨碍行人或车辆通行）
english_meaning: to block the street; to obstruct pedestrian or vehicular traffic (colloquial Hong Kong Cantonese)
explanation_mandarin: 『阻街』是香港粤语口语，指在街上挡住他人或车辆通行，或在街道上聚集导致通行不便，有时含有责备或抱怨的语气。
explanation_english: In Hong Kong Cantonese, '阻街' is colloquial and means to block or obstruct the street—standing or gathering in a way that hinders pedestrians or vehicles. It often carries a reproachful or complaining tone.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 喂，你哋唔好阻街，俾啲人過馬路啦！
examples.jyutping_sentence: wai3, nei5 dei6 m4 hou2 zo2 gaai1, bei2 di1 jan4 gwo3 maa5 lou6 laa1!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 喂，你们不要挡路，让别人过马路！
examples.english_sentence: Hey, don't block the street—let people cross!

examples.cantonese_sentence: 啲人喺門口阻街，貨車入唔到，成個生意都受影響。
examples.jyutping_sentence: di1 jan4 hai2 mun4 hau2 zo2 gaai1, fo3 ce1 jap6 m4 dou3, sing4 go3 sang1 ji3 dou1 sau6 jing2 hoeng2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 有人在门口挡路，货车进不去，整个生意都受到影响。
examples.english_sentence: People are blocking the entrance, the delivery truck can't get in, and the whole business is affected.

mandarin_meaning: 耽誤；延誤
english_meaning: to delay; to hold up; to cause lateness
explanation_mandarin: 表示使某事或某人延遲或耽擱，通常指因某人或某事的行為或狀況導致進度或時間安排被推遲。
explanation_english: Indicates causing something or someone to be delayed or held up; commonly used when an action or situation postpones progress or scheduled times.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你咁拖拉會阻遲成個項目嘅進度。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 gam2 to1 laai1 wui5 zo2 ci4 sing4 go3 hong6 muk6 ge3 zeon3 dou6
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你這樣拖拉會耽誤整個項目的進度。
examples.english_sentence: Your procrastination will delay the entire project's progress.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 地鐵故障阻遲咗好多乘客上班。
examples.jyutping_sentence: dei6 tit3 gu3 zong6 zo2 ci4 zo2 hou2 do1 sing4 haak3 soeng5 baan1
examples.mandarin_sentence: 地鐵故障延誤了很多乘客上班。
examples.english_sentence: A subway malfunction delayed many passengers from getting to work.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 對唔住，我唔想阻遲你嘅行程。
examples.jyutping_sentence: deoi3 m4 zyu6, ngo5 m4 soeng2 zo2 ci4 nei5 ge3 hang4 cing4
examples.mandarin_sentence: 對不起，我不想耽誤你的行程。
examples.english_sentence: Sorry, I don't want to delay your schedule.

mandarin_meaning: 阻隔；隔絕；妨礙（交流、通行或聯繫）
english_meaning: to block, to obstruct, to isolate or to cut off (communication, access, contact)
explanation_mandarin: 表示使某種通訊、聯繫、通行或關係被隔斷或阻礙；可用於物理或抽象情況。
explanation_english: Indicates causing communication, contact, access, or relation to be cut off or obstructed; can be used for physical or abstract situations.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 疫情期間，封關同檢疫措施阻隔咗我哋同外國嘅聯繫。
examples.jyutping_sentence: jan4 cing4 kei4 gaan1, fung1 gwaan1 tung4 gim2 jik6 cou3 sik1 zo2 ngo5 dei6 tung4 ngoi6 gwok3 ge3 lyun4 hai6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 疫情期間，封關和檢疫措施使我們與外國的聯繫被阻隔了。
examples.english_sentence: During the pandemic, border closures and quarantine measures have cut off our connections with other countries.

mandarin_meaning: 擺架子；裝腔作勢；擺出一副了不起的樣子
english_meaning: to put on airs; to act pretentiously or pompously
explanation_mandarin: 口語貶義詞，形容一個人擺架子、裝腔作勢或擺出高人一等的態度，令人不舒服或難相處。
explanation_english: A colloquial derogatory expression describing someone who puts on airs or acts pretentiously/pompously, giving an aloof or obstructive attitude that makes others uncomfortable.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢成日阻頭阻勢，大家都唔鍾意同佢一齊做嘢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 sing4 jat6 zo2 tau4 zo2 sai3, daai6 gaa1 dou1 m4 zung1 ji3 tung4 keoi5 jat1 cai4 zou6 je5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他老是擺架子，大家都不喜歡和他一起工作。
examples.english_sentence: He is always putting on airs; no one likes working with him.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你唔好阻頭阻勢，直接講你嘅意思啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 m4 hou2 zo2 tau4 zo2 sai3, zik6 zip3 gong2 nei5 ge3 ji3 si1 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你別擺架子了，直接說你的意思吧。
examples.english_sentence: Don't put on airs — just say what you mean.

mandarin_meaning: 用作稱呼前綴（表示親暱或熟悉）；亦可作語氣詞/感嘆詞
english_meaning: a- (prefix used before names/kinship terms to show familiarity or affection); also an interjection/vocative particle
explanation_mandarin: 「阿」常置於人名或稱謂前以表示親暱、熟悉或非正式的稱呼（如「阿媽」、「阿明」），在口語中亦可作簡短的語氣詞或驚訝、疑問的感嘆詞。
explanation_english: Used before personal names or kinship terms to indicate familiarity or affection (e.g. '阿媽', '阿明'). In colloquial speech it can also function as a short interjection or vocative particle expressing surprise or a prompt.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 阿媽喺廚房度煮緊飯。
examples.jyutping_sentence: aa3 maa1 hai2 cyu4 fong2 dou6 zyu2 gan2 faan6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 妈妈在厨房做饭。
examples.english_sentence: Mom is cooking in the kitchen.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 阿明，你今日食咗未呀？
examples.jyutping_sentence: aa3 ming4, nei5 gam1 jat6 sik6 zo2 mei6 aa3?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 阿明，你今天吃了吗？
examples.english_sentence: Ah Ming, have you eaten yet today?

examples.cantonese_sentence: 阿？你講咩呀？
examples.jyutping_sentence: aa3? nei5 gong2 me1 aa3?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 啊？你说什么？
examples.english_sentence: Huh? What did you say?

synonyms: （稱呼前綴）無直接同義字，但有時與親暱前綴用法相似的有「老」

mandarin_meaning: 指“阿Q精神”——自我安慰、自欺、好勝但其實可笑的心態；亦可指具有這種心態的人。
english_meaning: Refers to the 'Ah Q' mentality — self-deception, petty self-satisfaction or false sense of superiority; also a person who displays such a mentality.
explanation_mandarin: 源自魯迅小說人物“阿Q”，用來形容那種遇挫折時用自我安慰或自我解嘲來維持自尊的心態，常帶貶義。
explanation_english: Originally from Lu Xun's character Ah Q; used to describe a mentality of consoling oneself, self-deception or false pride in the face of setbacks. Often derogatory.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢成日自我安慰，真係好有阿Q精神。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 sing4 jat6 zi6 ngo5 ngon1 wai6, zan1 hai6 hou2 jau5 aa3 kiu4 zing1 san4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他总是自我安慰，真是有阿Q精神。
examples.english_sentence: He is always consoling himself; he really has an 'Ah Q' mentality.

mandarin_meaning: 阿Q精神
english_meaning: the 'Ah Q' mentality; self-deceptive, consolatory/complacent attitude in the face of humiliation or failure
explanation_mandarin: 源自魯迅小說《阿Q正傳》，指以自我安慰或自欺的方式面對挫折、恥辱，表現出自我安慰、沾沾自喜或自我麻痺的心態。
explanation_english: Originating from Lu Xun's character Ah Q, it describes a mentality of self-deception and consoling oneself to preserve dignity when facing humiliation or failure — a complacent, self-comforting attitude.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢明明輸咗，仲話自己贏，真係阿Q精神。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 ming4 ming4 syu1 zo2, zung6 waa6 zi6 gei2 jing4, zan1 hai6 aa3 Q1 zing1 san4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他明明輸了，還說自己贏，真是阿Q精神。
examples.english_sentence: He clearly lost but claims he won — that's classic 'Ah Q' mentality.

mandarin_meaning: 阿哥（大哥、頭目）；可指親兄或在黑社會/地區上有勢力的人
english_meaning: Ah Gor — literally 'older brother'; colloquially a big brother/boss or a local gang/triad boss (a powerful or respected man)
explanation_mandarin: 「阿ger」為「阿哥」的俗寫，口語用來稱呼兄長或尊稱、指代在社區或幫派中有勢力的大哥；語氣可親切亦可帶威嚴或畏懼意味，常見於香港用語。
explanation_english: “阿ger” is an informal spelling of 阿哥 (Ah Gor). It can address an older brother or be used as a title for a respected/powerful man—often a boss or triad figure—in Hong Kong Cantonese. Tone can be affectionate or imply authority/intimidation depending on context.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢個阿ger好威，唔係普通人可以惹嘅。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 go3 aa3 go1 hou2 wai1, m4 hai6 pou2 tung1 jan4 ho2 ji5 je5 ge3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 這個阿哥很威，不是普通人可以惹的。
examples.english_sentence: This Ah Gor is very powerful; he's not someone ordinary people can mess with.

mandarin_meaning: 頭目 / 老闆 / 負責人
english_meaning: boss / leader / person in charge
explanation_mandarin: 由粵語前綴「阿」與英語「head」混合而成的俚語（常寫作「阿頭」），用來指稱組織或團體的領導者、老闆或負責人，語氣口語且具香港本地色彩。
explanation_english: A Cantonese slang term blending the prefix '阿' with the English word 'head' (often written as '阿頭' in Chinese). It refers to a group's leader, boss, or person in charge; informal and colloquial, especially used in Hong Kong.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 阿head講咗要九點開會，唔好遲到。
examples.jyutping_sentence: aa3 tau4 gong2 zo2 jiu3 gau2 dim2 hoi1 wui6, m4 hou2 ci4 dou3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 老闆說要九點開會，別遲到。
examples.english_sentence: The boss said there's a meeting at 9. Don't be late.

mandarin_meaning: （對男性的尊稱）先生/（常指）男教師、男警察等
english_meaning: a respectful form of address for a man (esp. male teacher or police officer); 'sir' or 'Officer' in HK Cantonese
explanation_mandarin: 粵語口語，源自英語 'Sir'，前加 '阿' 表示親切或口語化的尊稱。常用於稱呼男教師、男警察或其他男性專業人士，也可泛指男性長者或表示禮貌的稱呼。
explanation_english: A Cantonese colloquial term formed from English 'Sir' with the prefix 'Ah' to make a familiar/respectful form of address. Commonly used for male teachers, police officers, or other male professionals; can also be a polite way to address an older man.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 阿Sir，可唔可以幫我解釋呢題？
examples.jyutping_sentence: aa3 si1, ho2 m4 ho2 ji5 bong1 ngo5 gaai2 sik1 ni1 tai4?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 老師/先生，可以幫我解釋這題嗎？
examples.english_sentence: Sir, can you help me explain this question?

examples.cantonese_sentence: 阿Sir，發生咩事呀？
examples.jyutping_sentence: aa3 si1, faat3 saang1 me1 si6 aa3?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 警察先生，發生了什麼事？
examples.english_sentence: Officer, what happened?

mandarin_meaning: （对人的）称呼或绰号，常用于名字或昵称中，表示“阿＋一”的称呼（例如名字里有「一」或排行第一等）
english_meaning: A familiar form of address 'Ah Yat' (literally 'Ah One') — a nickname or personal name using the prefix 'Ah' plus 'Yat' (one)
explanation_mandarin: 「阿一」由前缀「阿」加上「一」构成，常见於粤语圈作为对某人的亲昵称呼或绰号。『一』可能来自本名中的音節、排行或其他来源。属于非正式口语用法，多用于朋友或家人之间。
explanation_english: Formed by the Cantonese familiar prefix 'Ah' (阿) plus 'Yat' (一). Used as a casual personal name or nickname in Cantonese-speaking communities; 'Yat' may derive from a given name syllable, birth order, or other origin. Informal and used among friends or family.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 阿一，食晏未？
examples.jyutping_sentence: aa3 jat1, sik6 ngaan3 mei6?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 阿一，你吃午饭了吗？
examples.english_sentence: Ah Yat, have you had lunch?

examples.cantonese_sentence: 聽日阿一會嚟幫手搬屋。
examples.jyutping_sentence: teng1 jat6 aa3 jat1 wui5 lai4 bong1 sau2 bun1 uk1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 阿一明天会来帮忙搬家。
examples.english_sentence: Ah Yat will come tomorrow to help move house.

mandarin_meaning: （对名为丁的人）昵称、称呼
english_meaning: Ah Ding — a familiar form of address or nickname for someone called Ding
explanation_mandarin: 「阿丁」通常用作對姓或名為「丁」的人的親暱或口語稱呼，可用於朋友、家人或同事之間，語氣較隨意。
explanation_english: "Ah Ding" is a familiar or colloquial form of address for someone with the surname or name Ding. It is used affectionately or casually among friends, family, or colleagues.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 阿丁，你今日做咩呀？
examples.jyutping_sentence: aa3 ding1, nei5 gam1 jat6 zou6 me1 aa3?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 阿丁，你今天做什麼？
examples.english_sentence: Ah Ding, what are you doing today?

examples.cantonese_sentence: 老細叫阿丁去交報告。
examples.jyutping_sentence: lou5 sai3 giu3 aa3 ding1 heoi3 gaau1 bou3 gou3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 老闆叫阿丁去交報告。
examples.english_sentence: The boss told Ah Ding to submit the report.

mandarin_meaning: （對印度人或南亞人的）貶稱
english_meaning: Derogatory slang for Indians / South Asians
explanation_mandarin: 香港口語中的俗稱，原指印度人或泛指南亞裔人士。此詞帶有貶義與種族歧視色彩，來源說法不一（可能與英殖時期香港對印度裔人士的稱呼有關）。屬於冒犯性用語，建議避免使用。
explanation_english: A Hong Kong slang term historically used to refer to Indians or South Asian people. It carries derogatory and racist connotations. The exact origin is uncertain (possibly related to colonial-era references to Indian people). Considered offensive and should be avoided.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 喂，你唔好咁講，『阿三』呢個稱呼好冒犯。
examples.jyutping_sentence: wai3, nei5 m4 hou2 gam2 gong2, 'aa3 saam1' ni1 go3 cing1fu1 hou2 mou6faan6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 喂，你不要这样说，『阿三』这个称呼很冒犯。
examples.english_sentence: Hey, don't say that — calling someone '阿三' is very offensive.

mandarin_meaning: 你以為你是什麼人？/你算是哪門子人物？
english_meaning: Who do you think you are? (confrontational/questioning someone's identity or status)
explanation_mandarin: 口語廣東話用法，帶有反問或不滿語氣，用來質疑對方的身份、地位或行為，類似「你以為你是誰？」
explanation_english: Colloquial Cantonese expression, often confrontational or dismissive, used to question someone's identity, status, or behaviour — similar to "Who do you think you are?"

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你以為你係阿乜人呀？唔好咁自來熟。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 ji5 wai4 nei5 hai6 aa3 mat1 jan4 aa3? m4 hou2 gam2 zi6 loi4 suk6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你以為你是什麼人啊？不要這麼自作主張/自來熟。
examples.english_sentence: Who do you think you are? Don't be so presumptuous.

mandarin_meaning: 笨蛋；傻瓜（俚語）；也可作綽號（如阿＋數字）
english_meaning: a fool; silly/stupid person (slang); can also be a nickname formed with 'Ah' + number
explanation_mandarin: 「阿二」在廣東話常用作俚語，意指愚蠢或傻氣的人，語氣可親切或帶貶義，視語境而定。另「阿＋數字」亦可作綽號，例如家中排行第二可叫「阿二」。
explanation_english: In Cantonese, "阿二" is a slang term meaning a fool or someone acting silly/stupid; tone can be playful or insulting depending on context. It can also appear as a nickname of the form "Ah + number" (e.g., the second sibling).

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你唔好做阿二啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 m4 hou2 zou6 aa3 ji6 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 別做傻事／別裝傻。
examples.english_sentence: Don't be stupid.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢成日好阿二，成日做啲奇怪嘢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 sing4 jat6 hou2 aa3 ji6, sing4 jat6 zou6 di1 kei4 gwaai3 je5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他總是很傻，總是做一些奇怪的事。
examples.english_sentence: He's always being silly and doing weird things.

mandarin_meaning: 儿子；（口）小男孩
english_meaning: son; (colloquial) boy/kid
explanation_mandarin: 粵語口語，通常指男孩或兒子，帶有親暱或口語色彩。在香港廣泛使用，也可泛指小男孩或年輕男子。
explanation_english: A Cantonese colloquial term typically meaning 'son' or 'boy'. It carries an affectionate or informal tone and is widely used in Hong Kong; can refer to a young male or child.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我個阿仔今日去學校表演。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 go3 aa3zai2 gam1jat6 heoi3 hok6haau6 biu2yin2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我的兒子今天去學校表演。
examples.english_sentence: My son is performing at school today.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你唔好睇低阿仔，佢都好努力。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 m4hou2 tai2dai1 aa3zai2, keoi5 dou1 hou2 nou5lik6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你不要小看小孩，他也很努力。
examples.english_sentence: Don't look down on the kid; he's trying hard.

mandarin_meaning: 伯父 / 伯伯 / 老伯（對年長男性的稱呼）
english_meaning: uncle (father's elder brother); an older man; a respectful way to address an elderly man
explanation_mandarin: 用於稱呼年長男性，既可指父親的伯父（長輩），亦常作對陌生或熟識年長男性的禮貌稱呼。
explanation_english: Used to address an older man. It can refer specifically to a father's elder brother (paternal uncle) or be a polite form of address for an elderly man in general.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 嗰位阿伯好好心，幫我拎袋。
examples.jyutping_sentence: go2 wai2 aa3 baak3 hou2 hou2 sam1, bong1 ngo5 ling1 doi2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 那位伯伯很善良，幫我拿袋子。
examples.english_sentence: That uncle was very kind and helped me carry the bag.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 阿伯，你今朝食咗早餐未？
examples.jyutping_sentence: aa3 baak3 nei5 gam1 ziu1 sik6 zo2 zou2 caan1 mei6?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 伯伯，您今天早上吃早餐了嗎？
examples.english_sentence: Uncle, did you eat breakfast this morning?

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔該阿伯，借過下。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 goi1 aa3 baak3 ze3 gwo3 haa5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 不好意思，伯伯，讓一下。
examples.english_sentence: Excuse me, sir, please let me pass.

mandarin_meaning: 笨蛋；傻瓜（口語、帶貶義或戲謔）
english_meaning: idiots; fools (colloquial, often derogatory or teasing)
explanation_mandarin: 「阿保阿勝」是粵語口語用法，用來形容人愚蠢、做事沒腦或行為荒謬，常帶貶義或戲謔的語氣，可以指單一或兩個人。
explanation_english: A Cantonese colloquial/slang term used to describe someone as foolish or acting stupidly. It often carries a derogatory or teasing tone and can refer to one or more people.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋兩個係阿保阿勝，成日做啲傻事。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 loeng5 go3 hai6 aa3 bou2 aa3 sing3, sing4 jat6 zou6 di1 so4 si6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他們兩個是笨蛋，總是做一些傻事。
examples.english_sentence: Those two are idiots, always doing stupid things.

mandarin_meaning: 阿们（祈祷结束语，表示“愿如此”或表示同意）
english_meaning: Amen (used at the end of a prayer to mean 'so be it' or to express agreement)
explanation_mandarin: 「阿們」是「Amen」的音譯，常在祈禱或宗教儀式結束時使用，表示「願如此/如是」；在口語中亦可作為表示強烈贊同或附和的詞。
explanation_english: A Cantonese transliteration of 'Amen'. Commonly used at the end of prayers or religious rites to mean 'so be it' or to express agreement. It can also be used colloquially to strongly agree or affirm something.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋一齊祈禱，最後講一聲阿們。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 jat1 cai4 kei4 tou2, zeoi3 hau6 gong2 jat1 seng1 aa3 mun4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们一起祈祷，最后说一声阿们。
examples.english_sentence: We pray together and say 'Amen' at the end.

mandarin_meaning: （口語）傻瓜／笨蛋（可作暱稱或帶輕微責備）
english_meaning: a silly person; fool (informal, often used affectionately or teasingly)
explanation_mandarin: 「阿傻」是廣東話口語用法，通常用來稱呼對方為「傻瓜」。根據語境可以是親暱的暱稱，也可以是帶有責備或輕視的罵法。
explanation_english: “阿傻” is a Cantonese colloquial term used to call someone a silly person or fool. Depending on context it can be an affectionate nickname or a teasing/critical remark.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 阿傻，你又唔記得帶鎖匙啦？
examples.jyutping_sentence: aa3 so4, nei5 jau6 m4 gei3 dak1 daai3 so2 si4 laa1?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 阿傻，你又忘記帶鑰匙了？
examples.english_sentence: You silly, you forgot to bring your keys again?

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好鬧佢啦，佢只係阿傻啫。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 naau6 keoi5 laa1, keoi5 zi2 hai6 aa3 so4 ze1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 別罵他了，他只是個傻瓜而已。
examples.english_sentence: Don't scold him, he's just a fool.

mandarin_meaning: 祖父；（口語）爺爺
english_meaning: grandfather; grandpa
explanation_mandarin: 廣東話中常用的稱呼，指父親一方的父親或泛指年長的男性長輩。不同地區用法有差異（例如臺灣口語中也用「阿公」指外公）。
explanation_english: A Cantonese colloquial term for grandfather (often the father's father) or an elderly male elder. Usage can vary by region (e.g., in Taiwan 阿公 commonly refers to the maternal grandfather).

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我星期日去探阿公。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 sing1 kei4 jat6 heoi3 taam3 aa3 gung1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我星期天去看望爷爷。
examples.english_sentence: I'm going to visit my grandpa on Sunday.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 細個時阿公成日帶我去公園。
examples.jyutping_sentence: sai3 go3 si4 aa3 gung1 sing4 jat6 daai3 ngo5 heoi3 gung1 jyun4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 小时候爷爷经常带我去公园。
examples.english_sentence: When I was little, grandpa often took me to the park.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 阿公話佢仲記得細個嗰陣嘅事。
examples.jyutping_sentence: aa3 gung1 waa6 keoi5 zung6 gei3 dak1 sai3 go3 go2 zan6 ge3 si6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 爷爷说他还记得小时候的事。
examples.english_sentence: Grandpa said he still remembers things from his childhood.

mandarin_meaning: 阿拉伯（指阿拉伯人、阿拉伯國家或與阿拉伯有關之事物或語言）
english_meaning: Arab; Arabic (referring to Arab people, Arab countries, or things related to Arabic language/culture)
explanation_mandarin: 「阿剌伯」為「阿拉伯」的變體寫法，用來指阿拉伯人、阿拉伯國家或與阿拉伯有關的事物或語言。
explanation_english: A variant written form of '阿拉伯' (Arab). Used to refer to Arabs, Arab countries, or matters related to the Arabic language and culture.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢係阿剌伯人，識講阿拉伯文。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hai6 aa3 laai1 baak3 jan4, sik1 gong2 aa3 laai1 baak3 man4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他是阿拉伯人，會說阿拉伯語。
examples.english_sentence: He is Arab and can speak Arabic.

mandarin_meaning: 黏人的人；比喻像強力膠一樣黏著別人的人（俚語）
english_meaning: a clingy person; (slang) someone who sticks to others like superglue
explanation_mandarin: 「阿加力膠」是香港粵語俚語，帶有貶義／戲謔意味，用來形容對別人過分黏著、常常跟從或纏人的人。字面上借用「膠」的黏性作比喻。
explanation_english: A Hong Kong Cantonese slang term (pejorative/ jocular) used to describe someone who is overly clingy or constantly attached to another person. Literally likening the person to an adhesive.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢成日跟住女朋友，真係阿加力膠。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 sing4 jat6 gan1 zyu6 neoi5 pang4 jau5, zan1 hai6 aa3 gaa1 lik6 gaau1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他老是跟著女朋友，真是個黏人的人。
examples.english_sentence: He always follows his girlfriend around — he's really clingy.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好做阿加力膠，畀佢少少空間啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 zou6 aa3 gaa1 lik6 gaau1, bei2 keoi5 siu2 siu2 hung1 gaan1 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 不要做黏人的人，給他一點空間吧。
examples.english_sentence: Don't be clingy; give them a bit of space.

mandarin_meaning: 對印度裔或南亞裔人士的貶稱（香港粵語俗稱，帶有歧視意味）
english_meaning: A derogatory Cantonese slang term used in Hong Kong to refer to Indians or South Asian people
explanation_mandarin: 「阿叉」是香港粵語裡對印度裔、巴基斯坦裔、尼泊爾裔等南亞裔人士的俗稱或貶稱。此詞帶有歧視與貶義，屬於侮辱性用語，使用時應避免。
explanation_english: '阿叉' is a Hong Kong Cantonese slang term used to refer to Indian, Pakistani, Nepali and other South Asian people. It is derogatory and discriminatory; it is considered an insulting slur and should be avoided.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 喺香港，有啲人會用「阿叉」嚟稱呼南亞裔，但呢個字帶有貶義。
examples.jyutping_sentence: hai2 hoeng1 gong2, jau5 di1 jan4 wui5 jung6 "aa3 caa1" lei4 cing1 fu1 naam4 aa3 jai6, daan6 ni1 go3 zi6 daai3 jau5 bin2 ji6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 在香港，有些人會用「阿叉」來稱呼南亞裔，但這個字帶有貶義。
examples.english_sentence: In Hong Kong, some people use '阿叉' to refer to South Asians, but this word carries derogatory connotations.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你唔好叫佢阿叉，咁樣好冇禮貌又唔尊重。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 m4 hou2 giu3 keoi5 aa3 caa1, gam2 joeng6 hou2 mou5 lai5 maau6 jau6 m4 zyun1 zung3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你不要叫他「阿叉」，這樣很沒禮貌也不尊重。
examples.english_sentence: Don't call him '阿叉'; that's rude and disrespectful.

mandarin_meaning: 叔叔（對中年男子的稱呼）
english_meaning: uncle; middle-aged man (a respectful or informal address for an older man)
explanation_mandarin: 「阿叔」在粵語中常用來稱呼父親的弟弟（叔叔），或泛指中年男子。既可以作為親屬稱謂，也可用作對陌生或熟悉中年男性的稱呼，語氣較口語或親切。
explanation_english: In Cantonese, "阿叔" is commonly used to address a father's younger brother (uncle) or more generally a middle-aged man. It can be a kinship term or a casual/respectful way to refer to an older man; the tone is usually colloquial or familiar.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 阿叔，你好！
examples.jyutping_sentence: aa3 suk1, nei5 hou2!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 叔叔，你好！
examples.english_sentence: Hello, uncle!

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢係我阿叔，成日幫我照顧。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hai6 ngo5 aa3 suk1, sing4 jat6 bong1 ngo5 ziu3 gu3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他是我叔叔，經常幫我照顧。
examples.english_sentence: He's my uncle; he often helps take care of me.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢班阿叔每日都喺公園打太極。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 baan1 aa3 suk1 mui5 jat6 dou1 hai2 gung1 jyun4 daa2 taai3 gik6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 這群阿叔每天都在公園打太極。
examples.english_sentence: These uncles/middle-aged men practice tai chi in the park every day.

mandarin_meaning: 支支吾吾 / 吞吞吐吐（犹豫不决、说话含糊或支吾）
english_meaning: to hem and haw; to stammer or dither; to speak hesitantly or evasively
explanation_mandarin: 口語俚語，用來形容說話吞吞吐吐、支吾、猶豫不決或閃爍其詞，常用於批評在重要場合表現不果斷或回答不清楚的人。
explanation_english: A colloquial/slang Cantonese expression describing someone who speaks hesitantly, stammers, dithers, or evades answering directly. Often used to criticize indecisive or unclear responses.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 面試嗰陣，佢成日阿吱阿咗，答得唔清楚。
examples.jyutping_sentence: min6 si5 go2 zan6, keoi5 sing4 jat6 aa3 zi1 aa3 zo2, daap3 dak1 m4 cing1 co2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 面试的时候，他一直支支吾吾，回答得不清楚。
examples.english_sentence: During the interview, he kept hemming and hawing and couldn't answer clearly.

jyutping: aa3 zi1 aa3 zo2 mo1 lok6 go1
mandarin_meaning: （口語）嘰嘰喳喳、胡言亂語；無意義的閒聊
english_meaning: colloquial playful phrase for chattering or talking nonsense; meaningless babble
explanation_mandarin: 「阿吱阿咗摩洛哥」是一個廣東話的俚語，帶有擬聲和戲謔成分，常用來形容有人不停地嘰嘰喳喳、講些沒有重點或無聊的話。用法非正式，多見於香港口語。詞源不明，可能是模仿說話聲或為押韻的玩笑式語句。
explanation_english: “阿吱阿咗摩洛哥” is an informal Cantonese slang phrase with an onomatopoeic, playful feel. It’s used to describe someone chattering away, speaking nonsense, or engaging in pointless small talk. It’s nonstandard and chiefly used in casual Hong Kong speech; the exact origin is unclear and likely imitative or jocular.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢成日喺度阿吱阿咗摩洛哥，講啲冇用嘅嘢，真係好煩。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 sing4 jat6 hai2 dou6 aa3 zi1 aa3 zo2 mo1 lok6 go1, gong2 di1 mou5 jung6 ge3 je5, zan1 hai6 hou2 faan4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他經常在那裡嘰嘰喳喳、胡說八道，說些沒用的話，真的很煩。
examples.english_sentence: He/she is always jabbering nonsense over there, saying useless things — it's really annoying.

mandarin_meaning: 哥哥 / 大哥（称呼）
english_meaning: older brother; bro; a familiar/respectful way to address a man
explanation_mandarin: 「阿哥」是粵語中常用的稱呼，原意是指自己的哥哥（年長的兄弟）。在口語中也常用作對男性的親暱或尊稱（類似「大哥」或「兄弟」），語氣可親切或敬重，視語境而定。
explanation_english: “阿哥” is a Cantonese term originally meaning one’s older brother. It is also used colloquially to address a man in a familiar or respectful way (similar to “bro” or “big brother”), with tone depending on context.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢係我阿哥。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hai6 ngo5 aa3 go1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他是我的哥哥。
examples.english_sentence: He is my older brother.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 阿哥，你食咗未？
examples.jyutping_sentence: aa3 go1, nei5 sik6 zo2 mei6?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 哥哥，你吃了吗？
examples.english_sentence: Bro, have you eaten yet?

examples.cantonese_sentence: 多謝你，阿哥！
examples.jyutping_sentence: do1 ze6 nei5, aa3 go1!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 谢谢你，大哥！
examples.english_sentence: Thanks, bro!

mandarin_meaning: （口語）哥哥；對男性的親暱或非正式稱呼
english_meaning: An informal vocative meaning 'older brother' or a casual/affectionate way to address a male (like 'bro' or 'mister')
explanation_mandarin: 「阿哥哥」是廣東話口語稱呼，可用來稱呼親生或稱作「哥哥」的人，也可用作對非親屬男性的親暱或打趣稱呼。語氣可親切、撒嬌或帶調情意味，視語境而定。
explanation_english: An informal Cantonese form of address. It can mean 'older brother' when used literally, or be used affectionately/colloquially to address an unrelated male (often a young man). The tone may be friendly, playful, or flirtatious depending on context.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 阿哥哥，你可唔可以幫我拎一下呢袋嘢呀？
examples.jyutping_sentence: aa3 go1 go1, nei5 ho2 m4 ho2 ji5 bong1 ngo5 ling1 jat1 haa6 ni1 doi2 je5 aa3?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 哥哥，你可以幫我拿一下這袋東西嗎？
examples.english_sentence: Hey bro/mister, can you help me carry this bag for a moment?

mandarin_meaning: （口語）好了／好吧（相當於英語alrighty的音譯；表示同意、結束話題或緩和語氣）
english_meaning: alrighty (colloquial interjection used to agree, close a conversation, or soften a statement)
explanation_mandarin: 「阿哩吉諦」屬於粵語口語俗用，疑似從英語alrighty的音譯演變而來。常用作語句開頭或句尾，表示同意、結束某件事或用來緩和語氣、轉換話題。語感較隨意、幽默或戲謔，常見於年輕人或網絡用語中。
explanation_english: “阿哩吉諦” is a colloquial Cantonese expression likely derived from a phonetic rendering of English “alrighty.” It’s used as an interjection to express agreement, to close a topic, or to soften a remark. The tone is informal, often playful or joking, and it's commonly used among younger speakers or in online contexts.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 阿哩吉諦，你唔使擔心，我幫你搞掂。
examples.jyutping_sentence: aa1 lei1 gat1 dai3, nei5 m4 sai2 daam1 sam1, ngo5 bong1 nei5 gaau2 dim6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 好了，你不用擔心，我幫你處理好了。
examples.english_sentence: Alrighty, don't worry, I'll sort it out for you.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 阿哩吉諦，今次就算啦，我哋改日再傾。
examples.jyutping_sentence: aa1 lei1 gat1 dai3, gam1 ci3 zau6 syun3 laa1, ngo5 dei6 goi2 jat6 zoi3 king1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 好吧，這次就算了，我們改天再談。
examples.english_sentence: Alrighty, let's drop it this time. We'll talk again another day.

mandarin_meaning: 废文；无意义、浪费时间的文章或帖文
english_meaning: worthless text; pointless or waste-of-time writing (slang)
explanation_mandarin: 用來形容一篇文章或網上帖文內容沒有實質價值、只會浪費讀者時間，帶有貶義的俚語用法。
explanation_english: A slang term for an article or post that has no real value and wastes the reader's time; derogatory way to call writing 'garbage' or 'pointless'.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢篇文章係阿嘥文，睇完無收穫，唔好浪費時間。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 pin1 man4 zoeng1 hai6 aa3 saai1 man4, tai2 jyun4 mou5 sau1 wok6, m4 hou2 long6 fai3 si4 gaan1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这篇文章是废文，看完没有收获，不要浪费时间。
examples.english_sentence: This article is garbage writing — you get nothing from reading it; don't waste your time.

mandarin_meaning: （俚語）去世；排行第四（暱稱）
english_meaning: (slang) to die / pass away; (nickname) the fourth child (or person ranked fourth)
explanation_mandarin: 「阿四」在香港粵語中常作俚語，委婉或幽默地表示「死／去世」，例如「佢阿四咗」。另外也常用作暱稱或排行稱呼，指家中或群體中排行第四的人。
explanation_english: "阿四" in Hong Kong Cantonese is a slang term often used euphemistically or humorously to mean "to die" or "pass away" (e.g., "keoi aa3 sei3 zo2"). It is also used as a nickname to refer to the fourth-born child or the person ranked fourth in a group.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢昨晚阿四咗，成家人好傷心。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 zok6 maan5 aa3 sei3 zo2, sing4 gaa1 jan4 hou2 soeng1 sam1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他昨晚去世了，全家人很傷心。
examples.english_sentence: He passed away last night; the whole family was very sad.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我屋企嘅阿四負責煮飯同洗碗。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 uk1 kei5 ge3 aa3 sei3 fu6 zaak3 zyu2 faan6 tung4 sai2 wun2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们家里的排行第四负责做饭和洗碗。
examples.english_sentence: The fourth child in my family is responsible for cooking and washing dishes.

mandarin_meaning: （用來形容某人）賣弄風頭、愛出風頭
english_meaning: to show off; to hog the limelight (colloquial, mocking someone for acting pretentious)
explanation_mandarin: 「阿均賣大頭」是粵語口語說法，字面是指某個名叫「阿均」的人“賣大頭”，實際用來戲稱或嘲笑某人愛出風頭、賣弄或裝腔作勢。常用於非正式語境，語氣帶輕佻或揶揄。
explanation_english: This is a colloquial Cantonese expression literally meaning "Ah Gwan sells a big head." Figuratively it teases or criticizes someone for showing off, seeking attention, or acting pretentious. It is informal and often mildly mocking.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好理佢，阿均又賣大頭啫。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 lei5 keoi5, aa3 gwan1 jau6 maai6 daai6 tau4 ze1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 別理他，阿均又在賣弄風頭而已。
examples.english_sentence: Ignore him, Ah Gwan is just showing off again.

mandarin_meaning: 阿塞拜疆（國家名）
english_meaning: Azerbaijan (country)
explanation_mandarin: 阿塞拜疆是一個位於南高加索、里海西岸的國家，首都是巴庫，官方語言為阿塞拜疆語，與俄羅斯、伊朗、亞美尼亞等接壤。
explanation_english: A country in the South Caucasus on the western shore of the Caspian Sea; its capital is Baku and the official language is Azerbaijani. It borders Russia, Iran, and Armenia.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我下個月會去阿塞拜疆旅行。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 haa6 go3 jyut6 wui5 heoi3 aa3 sak1 baai3 goeng1 leoi5 hang4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我下个月会去阿塞拜疆旅行。
examples.english_sentence: I'm going to Azerbaijan next month to travel.

mandarin_meaning: 阿司匹林（止痛、退燒、消炎藥）
english_meaning: aspirin (acetylsalicylic acid) — a painkiller, antipyretic, anti-inflammatory and antiplatelet drug
explanation_mandarin: 阿士匹靈是對乙醯水楊酸的通俗譯名，常用作止痛、退燒和消炎，也可用於抗血小板治療。兒童使用需小心，某些情況下不建議給十歲以下兒童服用以避免瑞氏症風險。
explanation_english: A transliteration of aspirin (acetylsalicylic acid). Commonly used as an analgesic, antipyretic and anti-inflammatory drug, and sometimes as an antiplatelet agent. Caution is advised for children, as use in young children may be associated with Reye's syndrome.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我頭痛，食一粒阿士匹靈先。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 tau4 tung3, sik6 jat1 lap1 aa3 si6 pat1 ling4 sin1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我頭痛，先吃一顆阿司匹林。
examples.english_sentence: My head hurts — I'll take an aspirin first.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 阿士匹靈唔適合俾十歲以下嘅小朋友食，因為可能會引致瑞氏症。
examples.jyutping_sentence: aa3 si6 pat1 ling4 m4 sik1 hap6 bei2 sap6 seoi3 ji5 haa6 ge3 siu2 pang4 jau5 sik6, jan1 wai6 ho2 nang4 wui5 jan5 zi3 seoi6 si6 zing3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 阿司匹林不適合給十歲以下的小孩服用，因為可能導致瑞氏症。
examples.english_sentence: Aspirin is not recommended for children under ten because it may cause Reye's syndrome.

mandarin_meaning: 阿寿（用作人名或綽號，通常指年長男子或熟悉的鄰里長者）
english_meaning: A-Sau (a familiar nickname, usually for an older man or an elderly neighbor)
explanation_mandarin: 「阿壽」多用作口語化的綽號或稱呼，常指年紀較大的男性或社區裡熟悉的長者，有時帶親切或戲謔的語氣。
explanation_english: “A-Sau” is an informal nickname used to address or refer to an older man, often a familiar neighbor or elder. The tone can be affectionate or teasing depending on context.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 阿壽係我隔離嘅鄰居，佢好熱心。
examples.jyutping_sentence: aa3 sau6 hai6 ngo5 gaak3 lei4 ge3 leon4 geoi1, keoi5 hou2 jit6 sam1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 阿寿是我隔壁的邻居，他很热心。
examples.english_sentence: A-Sau is my next-door neighbor; he's very helpful.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 細路仔見到阿壽都會打招呼。
examples.jyutping_sentence: sai3 lou6 zai2 gin3 dou3 aa3 sau6 dou1 wui5 daa2 ziu1 fu1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 小孩子看到阿寿都会打招呼。
examples.english_sentence: Children greet A-Sau whenever they see him.

mandarin_meaning: 老大；家中或群體中的最年長者／首領
english_meaning: the eldest (child/sibling); boss or leader (informal)
explanation_mandarin: 口語稱呼，通常指家中最年長的孩子或兄姊；在某些情況下也可指某群體或社區中的首領、老大（非正式用法）。
explanation_english: A colloquial term typically used to refer to the eldest child or sibling in a family; informally it can also mean the leader or 'boss' of a group or neighborhood.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我阿大已經結咗婚。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 aa3 daai6 ji5 ging1 git3 zo2 fan1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我老大已经结婚了。
examples.english_sentence: My eldest (sibling) is already married.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 阿大，你食咗飯未？
examples.jyutping_sentence: aa3 daai6, nei5 sik6 zo2 faan6 mei6?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 阿大，你吃饭了吗？
examples.english_sentence: Ah-dai, have you eaten yet?

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢係我哋街坊嘅阿大，大家都怕佢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hai6 ngo5 dei6 gaai1 fong1 ge3 aa3 daai6, daai6 gaa1 dou1 paa3 keoi5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他是我们街坊的老大，大家都怕他。
examples.english_sentence: He's the boss/leader of our neighborhood; everyone is afraid of him.

mandarin_meaning: 老婆；太太（口語）
english_meaning: wife; the missus (colloquial)
explanation_mandarin: 粵語口語用法，通常指自己的或別人的妻子，相當於“老婆”或“太太”，有時帶玩笑或親暱語氣。
explanation_english: A colloquial Cantonese term for one's wife (or someone's wife), equivalent to 'wife' or 'the missus' and often used in an informal or jocular way.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我阿太今晚會返嚟食飯。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 aa3 taai3 gam1 maan5 wui5 faan1 lai4 sik6 faan6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我老婆今晚會回來吃飯。
examples.english_sentence: My wife will come back for dinner tonight.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你阿太喺邊度做嘢？
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 aa3 taai3 hai2 bin1 dou6 zou6 je5?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你老婆在哪裡工作？
examples.english_sentence: Where does your wife work?

examples.cantonese_sentence: 今朝阿太叫我去買餸。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gam1 ziu1 aa3 taai3 giu3 ngo5 heoi3 maai5 sung3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 今天早上老婆叫我去買菜。
examples.english_sentence: This morning my wife asked me to buy groceries.

mandarin_meaning: （口語）瘦弱的人，虛弱或消瘦
english_meaning: a skinny or frail person; (informal) thin/weak
explanation_mandarin: 「阿奀」是廣東話口語用法，通常帶有暱稱或略帶戲謔的語氣，用來形容或稱呼身形瘦弱、虛弱的人。
explanation_english: "Ah-on" (阿奀) is a Cantonese colloquial term, often used as a nickname or mildly teasing label for someone who is skinny or frail.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢係班上嘅阿奀，一啲都唔壯健。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hai6 baan1 soeng6 ge3 aa3 on1, jat1 di1 dou1 m4 zong6 gin6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他是班上瘦弱的人，一點都不壯健。
examples.english_sentence: He's the skinny one in the class, not strong at all.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好叫佢阿奀，佢最近病緊，精神唔係好好。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 giu3 keoi5 aa3 on1, keoi5 zeoi3 gan6 beng6 gan2, zing1 san4 m4 hai6 hou2 hou2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 不要叫他「阿奀」，他最近生病了，精神不太好。
examples.english_sentence: Don't call him 'Ah-On'; he's been ill recently and not very energetic.

mandarin_meaning: 女兒；小女孩；（口語、親暱的稱呼）
english_meaning: daughter; girl (colloquial, affectionate)
explanation_mandarin: 「阿女」是廣東話口語，常用來親暱地稱呼自己的女兒或小女孩，也可泛指年輕女性。
explanation_english: A Cantonese colloquial term used affectionately to refer to one's daughter or a young girl; can sometimes refer loosely to young females.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我個阿女五歲喇。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 go3 aa3 neoi5 ng5 seoi3 laa3。
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我女兒五歲了。
examples.english_sentence: My daughter is five years old.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 阿女，你今晚記得做功課呀。
examples.jyutping_sentence: aa3 neoi5, nei5 gam1 maan5 gei3 dak1 zou6 gung1 fo3 aa3。
examples.mandarin_sentence: 女兒，今晚記得做功課啊。
examples.english_sentence: Daughter, remember to do your homework tonight.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋嘅阿女已經考上大學。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 ge3 aa3 neoi5 ji5 ging1 haau2 soeng5 daai6 hok6。
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他們的女兒已經考上大學。
examples.english_sentence: Their daughter has already been admitted to university.

mandarin_meaning: （對父母輩女性的）姨媽、舅媽或長輩稱呼（廣東話）
english_meaning: aunt (Cantonese term for a female elder of the parental generation; often a father's sister or a sister-in-law)
explanation_mandarin: 「阿妗」是廣東話中對父母那一輩的女性長輩的稱呼，通常指父親一方的姊妹或姊妹的配偶，也可作為對同輩年長女性的尊稱。在不同家庭或地區使用上可能與「阿姨」「阿嬸」有所區別。
explanation_english: In Cantonese, "阿妗" is a form of address for a female elder of the parents' generation, often referring to a father's sister or a sister-in-law. It is used as a respectful way to address or refer to such relatives and can overlap in usage with other aunt terms depending on region and family.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 阿妗今日會來我屋企食飯。
examples.jyutping_sentence: aa3 gam2 gam1 jat6 wui5 loi4 ngo5 uk1 kei2 sik6 faan6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 阿妗今天會來我家吃飯。
examples.english_sentence: My aunt will come to my house for a meal today.

mandarin_meaning: 妹妹；小姑娘（用作稱呼年輕女性或表示親暱）
english_meaning: younger sister; girl; lass (informal/affectionate)
explanation_mandarin: 「阿妹」在廣東話中常用來指稱自己的妹妹，也可口語化地稱呼年輕女性或用作親暱、非正式的稱呼方式。語氣較口語，視語境可表示親密或隨意。
explanation_english: In Cantonese, "阿妹" commonly refers to a younger sister, and is also used colloquially to address a young woman in an affectionate or informal way. The term is casual and its tone depends on context.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我有個阿妹，佢而家仲喺中學讀書。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 jau5 go3 aa3 mui6, keoi5 ji4 gaa1 zung6 hai2 zung1 hok6 duk6 syu1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我有個妹妹，她現在還在中學念書。
examples.english_sentence: I have a younger sister; she's still in secondary school.

mandarin_meaning: 阿姆斯特丹（荷兰首都）
english_meaning: Amsterdam (city in the Netherlands)
explanation_mandarin: 阿姆斯特丹是荷兰的一座著名城市，中文译名为“阿姆斯特丹”，常用于指该城市本身或与其相关的事物。
explanation_english: The Chinese name for Amsterdam, a major city in the Netherlands; used to refer to the city itself or things related to it.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我下個月要去阿姆斯特丹旅行。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 haa6 go3 jyut6 jiu3 heoi3 aa3 mou5 si1 dak6 daan1 leoi5 hang4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我下个月要去阿姆斯特丹旅行。
examples.english_sentence: I'm going to Amsterdam next month.

mandarin_meaning: （敬稱或稱謂）姐姐；年長的女性
english_meaning: older sister; a respectful form of address for an older woman
explanation_mandarin: 「阿姐」在廣東話中常用來指親生的姐姐，或作為對年紀較長女性的稱呼（可帶尊敬或親切意味）。在香港亦常用於日常口語中稱呼年長或熟悉的女性。
explanation_english: In Cantonese, "阿姐" commonly refers to one's older sister, or is used as an address for an older woman (conveying respect or friendliness). It is widely used in Hong Kong Cantonese speech.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢係我阿姐，對我好好。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hai6 ngo5 aa3 ze2, deoi3 ngo5 hou2 hou2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 她是我姐姐，對我很好。
examples.english_sentence: She is my older sister and treats me very well.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 阿姐，你食咗飯未呀？
examples.jyutping_sentence: aa3 ze2, nei5 sik6 zo2 faan6 mei6 aa3?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 阿姐，你吃過飯了嗎？
examples.english_sentence: Miss/older sister, have you eaten yet?

examples.cantonese_sentence: 街市啲阿姐見到我就打招呼。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gaai1 si5 di1 aa3 ze2 gin3 dou3 ngo5 zau6 daa2 ziu1 fu1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 市場上的那些阿姐看到我就打招呼。
examples.english_sentence: The women at the market greet me when they see me.

mandarin_meaning: 姑媽／姑姑（父親的姊妹）
english_meaning: paternal aunt (father's sister)
explanation_mandarin: 「阿姑」是粵語中稱呼父親的姊妹（姑媽、姑姑）的稱呼，亦可在某些方言中泛指年長的女性長輩。
explanation_english: In Cantonese, "阿姑" is the term for a paternal aunt (father's sister). In some dialectal uses it can also refer generally to an older female relative or elder woman.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 阿姑聽日會嚟屋企食晚飯。
examples.jyutping_sentence: aa3 gu1 ting1 jat6 wui5 lai4 uk1 kei2 sik6 maan5 faan6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 姑媽明天會來家裡吃晚飯。
examples.english_sentence: My aunt will come to our house for dinner tomorrow.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我阿姑好鍾意整餅，成日教我煮嘢食。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 aa3 gu1 hou2 zung1 ji3 zing2 beng2, seng4 jat6 gaau3 ngo5 zyu2 je5 sik6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我姑媽很喜歡做糕點，經常教我做飯。
examples.english_sentence: My aunt loves baking and often teaches me how to cook.

mandarin_meaning: 阿姨（母亲的姐妹）；对年纪较大或熟识女性的称呼；有时指保姆或月嫂等女家务帮手
english_meaning: aunt (mother's sister); 'auntie' used to address a middle-aged woman; sometimes a female domestic helper/nanny
explanation_mandarin: 「阿姨」通常指母亲的姐妹（姨妈），也可作为对年纪比自己稍长或陌生但礼貌称呼的女性（类似“阿姨/大婶”）；在口语里也可指担任照顾家务或育婴工作的女性（如保姆、月嫂）。
explanation_english: “阿姨” primarily means a mother's sister (maternal aunt). It is also used as a polite form of address for middle-aged women (like 'auntie' or 'ma'am') and can refer informally to female domestic helpers or nannies.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我阿姨住喺旺角。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 aa3 ji4 zyu6 hai6 wong6 gok3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我阿姨住在旺角。
examples.english_sentence: My aunt lives in Mong Kok.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 阿姨，請問巴士站喺邊？
examples.jyutping_sentence: aa3 ji4, ceng2 man6 baa1 si2 zaam6 hai6 bin1?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 阿姨，请问公交车站在哪里？
examples.english_sentence: Excuse me, ma'am, where is the bus stop?

examples.cantonese_sentence: 阿姨係我哋屋企嘅保姆，幫手照顧細路。
examples.jyutping_sentence: aa3 ji4 hai6 ngo5 dei6 uk1 kei2 ge3 bou2 mou5, bong1 sau2 ziu3 gu3 sai3 lou6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 阿姨是我们家的保姆，帮忙照顾小孩。
examples.english_sentence: The ayi is our housekeeper; she helps take care of the children.

mandarin_meaning: 爱出风头；装腔作势；爱炫耀
english_meaning: show off; pretentious; boastful
explanation_mandarin: 用來形容一個人喜歡誇耀、裝腔作勢或愛出風頭，帶有貶義，常用於口語或俚語。
explanation_english: A Cantonese slang phrase used to describe someone who likes to show off, act pretentious, or boast; typically pejorative and used colloquially.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢成日阿威阿水，好難頂。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 seng4 jat6 aa3 wai1 aa3 seoi2, hou2 naan4 ding2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他整天爱出风头，真让人受不了。
examples.english_sentence: He shows off all the time; it's really unbearable.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 開會嗰陣佢又係阿威阿水，講啲無謂嘢嚟博人眼球。
examples.jyutping_sentence: hoi1 wui6 go2 zan6 keoi5 jau6 hai6 aa3 wai1 aa3 seoi2, gong2 di1 mou4 wai6 je5 lai4 bok3 jan4 ngaan5 kau4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 开会的时候他又在卖弄风头，说些没意义的话博取关注。
examples.english_sentence: He was showing off again during the meeting, saying meaningless things to attract attention.

mandarin_meaning: 奶奶 / 外婆；老太太（泛指年长的妇女）
english_meaning: grandmother; granny; old woman (elderly lady)
explanation_mandarin: 在粤语中，“阿婆”常用来称呼或指代祖母（奶奶或外婆），也可泛指年纪较大的妇女。有时带有亲切感，亦可用于描述路上的老人。
explanation_english: In Cantonese, "阿婆" is commonly used to refer to one's grandmother (paternal or maternal) or to an elderly woman in general. It can be affectionate or simply descriptive of an older lady.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我阿婆幾年前已經過身。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 aa3 po4 gei2 nin4 cin4 ji5 ging1 gwo3 san1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我奶奶/外婆在几年前已经去世了。
examples.english_sentence: My grandmother passed away a few years ago.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 街上有個阿婆需要幫手，等我上去扶佢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gaai1 soeng5 jau5 go3 aa3 po4 seoi1 jiu3 bong1 sau2, dang2 ngo5 soeng5 heoi3 fu4 keoi5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 街上有个老太太需要帮助，我上去扶她。
examples.english_sentence: There's an old lady on the street who needs help; I'll go and assist her.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 阿婆煲嘅湯好好味，成日都想返去食。
examples.jyutping_sentence: aa3 po4 bou1 ge3 tong1 hou2 hou2 mei6, seng4 jat6 dou1 soeng2 faan1 heoi3 sik6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 奶奶煲的汤很好喝，我经常想回去吃。
examples.english_sentence: Grandma's soup is delicious; I often want to go back and eat it.

mandarin_meaning: （口語/俚語）形容走路或做事非常慢，慢吞吞
english_meaning: Slang: to move or act extremely slowly; at a snail's pace
partOfSpeech_mandarin: 形容詞/動詞短語（口語/俚語）
explanation_mandarin: 用來戲謔或稍帶嘲諷地形容人走路或做事非常慢，好像老奶奶在比賽跑步一樣慢。
explanation_english: A colloquial/slang expression used jokingly or mildly mockingly to describe someone who walks or works very slowly, as if elderly people were racing.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你行得阿婆賽跑咁慢，趕唔切啦！
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 haang4 dak1 aa3 po4 coi3 paau2 gam3 maan6, gon2 m4 cit3 laa3!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你走得像阿婆賽跑那麼慢，趕不上了！
examples.english_sentence: You're moving at a snail's pace; you won't make it!

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢做嘢阿婆賽跑，成日拖泥帶水。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 zou6 je5 aa3 po4 coi3 paau2, seng4 jat6 to1 nei4 daai3 seoi2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他做事慢吞吞，總是拖拖拉拉。
examples.english_sentence: He works at a snail's pace, always dragging things out.

mandarin_meaning: 妈妈
english_meaning: mother; mom
explanation_mandarin: 粵語中對母親的稱呼，相當於普通話的「媽媽」，常用於日常生活中表示親暱或尊稱。
explanation_english: A Cantonese term for one's mother, equivalent to Mandarin 'māma'. Commonly used in everyday speech to address or refer to one's mom.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 阿媽喺屋企等你返嚟。
examples.jyutping_sentence: aa3 maa1 hai2 uk1 kei2 dang2 nei5 faan1 lai4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 妈妈在家等你回来。
examples.english_sentence: Mom is at home waiting for you to come back.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 阿媽話今晚要煮你鍾意嘅菜。
examples.jyutping_sentence: aa3 maa1 waa6 gam1 maan5 jiu3 zyu2 nei5 zung1 ji3 ge3 coi3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 妈妈说今晚要煮你喜欢的菜。
examples.english_sentence: Mom said she'll cook the dishes you like tonight.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 阿媽好關心你。
examples.jyutping_sentence: aa3 maa1 hou2 gwaan1 sam1 nei5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 妈妈很关心你。
examples.english_sentence: Mom cares about you a lot.

mandarin_meaning: 妈妈是女人
english_meaning: Mother is a woman.
explanation_mandarin: 字面意思是“妈妈是女人”。可作字面陈述，用来说明母亲的性别；在口语中也常用作反讽或提醒别人母親有情感、需要和個人權利，要求尊重。
explanation_english: Literally “Mother is a woman.” It can be a straightforward statement of fact. In colloquial Cantonese it’s also used sarcastically or emphatically to remind someone that mothers have feelings, needs, or rights and deserve respect.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好咁樣講阿媽係女人，你應該尊重佢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 gam2 joeng6 gong2 aa3 maa1 hai6 neoi5 jan4, nei5 jing1 goi1 zyun1 zung3 keoi5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 不要那样说「阿媽係女人」，你应该尊重她。
examples.english_sentence: Don't say 'Mom is a woman' like that; you should respect her.

jyutping: aa3 maa1 dou1 m4 jing6 dak1
mandarin_meaning: 連媽媽都認不出來
english_meaning: so changed that even one's mother wouldn't recognize (someone/thing)
explanation_mandarin: 用來形容某人或某物改變得非常大，甚至連媽媽也認不出來。常用於口語，帶有誇張或幽默語氣。
explanation_english: Used to describe someone or something that has changed so much that even their mother wouldn't recognize them. Often used colloquially with an exaggerated or humorous tone.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢換咗個新髮型，阿媽都唔認得佢啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 wun6 zo2 go3 faat3 jing4, aa3 maa1 dou1 m4 jing6 dak1 keoi5 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他換了新髮型，連媽媽都認不出他了。
examples.english_sentence: He got a new haircut — even his mother wouldn't recognize him.

mandarin_meaning: 嫂子（哥哥的妻子）；有時用作對年紀較大的已婚婦女或街坊婦人的稱呼
english_meaning: sister-in-law (older brother's wife); colloquially a respectful or familiar form of address for a married woman
explanation_mandarin: 「阿嫂」在粵語中主要指哥哥的妻子（即嫂子）。在口語中亦可用作對年紀稍長或已婚的婦女的稱呼，帶有親切或鄰里間的意味。
explanation_english: In Cantonese, "阿嫂" primarily means the older brother's wife (sister-in-law). It can also be used colloquially to address a married woman or a woman slightly older than the speaker, often with a friendly or neighborly tone.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 阿嫂，你今日食咗未？
examples.jyutping_sentence: aa3 sou2, nei5 gam1 jat6 sik6 zo2 mei6?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 嫂子，你今天吃了嗎？
examples.english_sentence: Sister-in-law, have you eaten today?

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢係我阿哥嘅阿嫂。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hai6 ngo5 aa3 go1 ge3 aa3 sou2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 她是我哥哥的妻子。
examples.english_sentence: She is my older brother's wife.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 阿嫂幫我帶細路，真係多謝你。
examples.jyutping_sentence: aa3 sou2 bong1 ngo5 daai3 sai3 lou6, zan1 hai6 do1 ze6 nei5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 嫂子幫我帶小孩，真的很謝謝你。
examples.english_sentence: My sister-in-law helped look after my child — thank you very much.

mandarin_meaning: 奶奶（父亲的母亲）
english_meaning: grandmother (paternal grandmother; grandma)
explanation_mandarin: 粤语中对父亲的母亲的称呼，等同于普通话的“奶奶”或“祖母”。
explanation_english: A Cantonese term used to refer to one's paternal grandmother (father's mother), equivalent to 'nǎinai' or 'grandma'.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我阿嫲而家住喺九龍。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 aa3 maa4 ji4 gaa1 zyu6 hai2 gau2 lung4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我奶奶现在住在九龙。
examples.english_sentence: My grandmother now lives in Kowloon.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋星期日去探阿嫲。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 sing1 kei4 jat6 heoi3 taam3 aa3 maa4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们星期天去看奶奶。
examples.english_sentence: We're going to visit grandma on Sunday.

mandarin_meaning: （人名的）阿嬋，對名叫「嬋」的女性的親暱稱呼
english_meaning: Ah Chaan — a familiar form of address for a woman named Chaan
explanation_mandarin: 「阿嬋」是粵語中常見的稱呼形式，阿＋單字名，用來親暱地稱呼名叫「嬋」的女性，常見於口語和人名暱稱。
explanation_english: “Ah Chaan” is a Cantonese familiar form of address formed by adding the prefix 阿 to a one-character given name. It is used to address or refer affectionately to a woman named 嬋.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 阿嬋，今晚你食咗未啊？
examples.jyutping_sentence: aa3 caan4, gam1 maan5 nei5 sik6 zo2 mei6 aa3?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 阿嬋，今晚你吃了嗎？
examples.english_sentence: Ah Chaan, have you eaten tonight?

mandarin_meaning: 嬸嬸／阿姨（對年長婦女的稱呼；傳統上指父親的弟媳）
english_meaning: auntie (traditionally the wife of one's paternal uncle; also a polite form of address for an older woman)
explanation_mandarin: 「阿嬸」原指父親的弟媳（舅父的配偶中的一種稱呼），在日常口語中也常用作對年紀較長的婦女的稱呼，相當於「嬸嬸」或口語的「阿姨」。
explanation_english: Originally refers to the wife of one's paternal uncle, but commonly used in colloquial speech as a polite or familiar form of address for an older woman (auntie).

examples.cantonese_sentence: 阿嬸今日嚟我屋企食晚飯。
examples.jyutping_sentence: aa3 sam2 gam1 jat6 lai4 ngo5 uk1 kei2 sik6 maan5 faan6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 嬸嬸今天來我家吃晚飯。
examples.english_sentence: Auntie came to my house for dinner tonight.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔該阿嬸，幫我攞杯水得唔得？
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 goi1 aa3 sam2, bong1 ngo5 lo2 bui1 seoi2 dak1 m4 dak1?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 謝謝嬸嬸，能幫我拿杯水嗎？
examples.english_sentence: Excuse me, Auntie — could you help me get a glass of water?

examples.cantonese_sentence: 嗰位阿嬸好好人，成日餵流浪貓。
examples.jyutping_sentence: go2 wai6 aa3 sam2 hou2 hou2 jan4, seng4 jat6 wai6 lau4 long4 maau1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 那位嬸嬸很好人，經常餵流浪貓。
examples.english_sentence: That auntie is very kind; she often feeds stray cats.

mandarin_meaning: 膽小；懦弱
english_meaning: cowardly; timid; a coward (slang)
explanation_mandarin: 廣東話口語/俚語，用來形容一個人膽小、懦弱或怕事，有時帶貶義，可作形容詞或稱呼。
explanation_english: A Cantonese colloquial/slang term used to describe someone who is cowardly or timid. It can be pejorative and is used as an adjective or a disparaging label.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你唔好咁阿孻，去問清楚啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 m4 hou2 gam2 aa3 naai6, heoi3 man6 cing1 co2 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你不要這麼膽小，去問清楚吧。
examples.english_sentence: Don't be such a coward; go ask and find out.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢成日驚事，大家都話佢阿孻。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 seng4 jat6 geng1 si6, daai6 gaa1 dou1 waa6 keoi5 aa3 naai6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他總是害怕事情，大家都說他很膽小。
examples.english_sentence: He's always afraid of things; everyone calls him a coward.

mandarin_meaning: 阿富汗 (Āfùhān)
english_meaning: Afghanistan (country)
explanation_mandarin: 阿富汗是一個位於中亞和南亞交界的國家，首都為喀布爾。由於長期的政治衝突與戰事，近年常見於國際新聞中。
explanation_english: Afghanistan is a country located at the crossroads of Central and South Asia; its capital is Kabul. It has frequently been in international news in recent years due to political conflict and warfare.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢話下個月會去阿富汗出差。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 waa6 haa6 go3 jyut6 wui5 heoi3 aa3 fu3 hon4 ceot1 caa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他说下个月会去阿富汗出差。
examples.english_sentence: He said he'll go to Afghanistan on a business trip next month.

mandarin_meaning: （口語）崩潰；失控；情緒崩潰或大為驚訝
english_meaning: colloquial slang for having a meltdown, collapsing emotionally, freaking out, or being extremely shocked
explanation_mandarin: 「阿崩」是香港粵語的口語俚語，常用來形容一個人情緒突然崩潰、失控或對某事感到極度驚訝、震驚。可用作動詞或形容狀態，語氣較口語化、非正式。
explanation_english: “阿崩” is Hong Kong Cantonese colloquial slang used to describe someone having an emotional breakdown, losing control, or being extremely shocked/astonished. It functions as a verb or descriptive state and is informal.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我見到成績單，真係阿崩。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 gin3 dou3 sing4 zik1 daan1, zan1 hai6 aa3 bang1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我看到成績單，真的崩潰了。
examples.english_sentence: I saw the report card and really had a breakdown.

mandarin_meaning: （廣東俚語）被徹底打敗、慘輸或遭受嚴重損失；也可用來形容場面一片混亂、被徹底摧毀
english_meaning: A Cantonese slang meaning to be totally thrashed/defeated or thoroughly ruined; can also describe a scene turned into a complete mess or being severely taken advantage of.
explanation_mandarin: 阿崩劏羊是一句廣東話口語俚語，帶有強烈形象性的暴力比喻（像把羊崩劏掉一樣），用來形容在比賽、交易或衝突中被徹底擊潰、慘敗或遭受重大損失；有時也用於形容場面非常混亂。語氣粗俗，偏向口語或街頭用語，常見於香港或廣東地區非正式語境。
explanation_english: “阿崩劏羊” is a Cantonese colloquial/slang expression that uses a vivid, violent metaphor (as if slaughtering a sheep) to describe being completely beaten, ruined, or suffering heavy losses—often in a match, deal, or confrontation. It can also describe a scene of utter chaos. The term is coarse and informal, mainly used in Hong Kong or Guangdong street speech.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 昨晚球賽我隊俾人阿崩劏羊，成場都冇得頂。
examples.jyutping_sentence: zok6 maan5 kau4 coi3 ngo5 deoi2 bei2 jan4 aa3 bang1 tong1 joeng4, sing4 coeng4 dou1 mou5 dak1 ding2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 昨晚比賽我們隊被人阿崩劏羊，整場都沒得頂（慘敗）。
examples.english_sentence: Last night's match our team got totally thrashed; the whole game was hopeless.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢投資失利，差唔多被阿崩劏羊晒，蝕咗好多錢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 tau4 zi1 sat1 lei6, caa1 m4 do1 bei2 aa3 bang1 tong1 joeng4 saai3, sik1 zo2 hou2 do1 cin2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他投資失利，差不多被阿崩劏羊光了，虧了很多錢。
examples.english_sentence: His investment failed and he was almost ruined—he lost a lot of money.

mandarin_meaning: 像狗一樣亂吠、大聲吵鬧；形容人愛無理取鬧或不停抱怨（貶義）
english_meaning: to yap like a dog; to make a loud fuss or commotion; describes someone who noisily complains or nags (derogatory)
explanation_mandarin: 香港廣東話俚語，用來形容某人大聲吵鬧、無理取鬧或不停抱怨，通常帶有貶義或不耐煩的語氣。
explanation_english: A Hong Kong Cantonese slang phrase used to describe someone who makes a loud fuss, nags, or complains incessantly; typically derogatory or used with annoyance.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢成日阿崩叫狗，搞到屋企好唔寧靜。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 seng4 jat6 aa3 beng1 giu3 gau2, gaau2 dou3 uk1 kei5 hou2 m4 ning4 zing6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他總是大吵大鬧，弄得家裡很不安寧。
examples.english_sentence: He keeps yapping like a dog and making a fuss, leaving the house very unsettled.

cantonese: 阿崩叫狗 - 越叫越走
jyutping: aa3 beng1 giu3 gau2 — jyut6 giu3 jyut6 zau2
mandarin_meaning: 越叫越走；比喻越是责备、呼喊或强逼，越把对方（人或动物）赶得更远。用于劝阻用责骂或强硬手段只会使情况更糟或把人赶走。
english_meaning: The more you shout, the more it runs away. A proverb meaning scolding, nagging, or forcing someone only pushes them further away; your efforts make the situation worse.
explanation_mandarin: 這句話字面是說越大聲叫狗，狗越會走遠；引申為責備或強逼別人，只會讓對方更遠離或更抗拒，常用來提醒別用硬性方法處理人際問題。
explanation_english: Literally says that the more you call a dog, the further it runs; figuratively it warns that scolding, nagging, or forcing someone will drive them away or worsen the situation. Often used to advise against harsh methods in interpersonal problems.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你成日咁鬧佢，真係阿崩叫狗——越叫越走。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 sing4 jat6 gam2 naau6 keoi5, zan1 hai6 aa3 beng1 giu3 gau2 — jyut6 giu3 jyut6 zau2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你老是这样骂他，真的越叫越走（只会把人越推越远）。
examples.english_sentence: You keep scolding him; it's really a case of 'the more you shout, the more he leaves' (you'll only push him further away).

cantonese: 阿崩吹簫 - 嘥聲壞氣
jyutping: aa3 beng1 ceoi1 siu1 —— saai1 seng1 waai6 hei3
mandarin_meaning: 白費口舌、徒然發脾氣，破壞氣氛
english_meaning: Making a fuss or talking for nothing—wasting breath and spoiling the mood
explanation_mandarin: 用來形容為了無關緊要的事大驚小怪或多說無益，反而浪費口舌、破壞氣氛或惹人生氣。
explanation_english: A colloquial Cantonese expression describing someone who makes a fuss or talks needlessly about trivial matters—wasting words and ruining the atmosphere.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你唔好成日阿崩吹簫——嘥聲壞氣，講重點啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 m4 hou2 sing4 jat6 aa3 beng1 ceoi1 siu1 —— saai1 seng1 waai6 hei3, gong2 cung4 dim2 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 別老是白費口舌、破壞氣氛，說重點吧。
examples.english_sentence: Don't keep making a fuss for nothing and ruining the mood—get to the point.

mandarin_meaning: （粗俗俚語）罵人用語，形容討厭或沒用的人，類似「混蛋」或「笨蛋」
english_meaning: A vulgar Cantonese insult used to call someone annoying/useless, roughly equivalent to "jerk" or "bastard" (derogatory)
explanation_mandarin: 「阿崩咬狗虱」為廣東話口語中的粗俗罵人用語，字面意義荒誕，實際用法是貶稱某人討厭、無用或令人鄙視。帶有地域性與口語性，常見於非正式訴求或情緒性對話中，來源與確切典故不詳。
explanation_english: This is a vulgar Cantonese slang insult. Literally nonsensical, it is used to denigrate someone as annoying, useless, or contemptible. It is regionally colloquial and used in informal, emotional speech. Exact origin is unclear.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢成日遲到，又唔做嘢，真係阿崩咬狗虱。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 seng4 jat6 ci4 dou3, jau6 m4 zou6 je5, zan1 hai6 aa3 beng1 ngaau5 gau2 sat1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他經常遲到，又不做事，真是個無用／討厭的人。
examples.english_sentence: He's always late and doesn't do any work — what a useless/annoying jerk.

mandarin_meaning: （粗俗俚語）形容對小事無理取鬧、行為荒唐或發脾氣
english_meaning: (coarse slang) someone who makes a fuss/acts irrationally over trivial matters
partOfSpeech_mandarin: 俚語 / 罵人用語（片語/名詞/形容詞用法）
explanation_mandarin: 「阿崩咬狗蝨」是香港粵語中較粗俗的俚語，字面可解作「咬狗蝨」，用來形容某人為小事大發脾氣或無理取鬧、行為荒唐。屬口語且帶貶義，應酌情使用。
explanation_english: “阿崩咬狗蝨” is a coarse Cantonese slang phrase (used in Hong Kong). Literally referencing “biting dog fleas,” it describes someone who makes a fuss, acts irrationally, or overreacts to trivial matters. It is colloquial and pejorative; use with caution.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你唔好做阿崩咬狗蝨啦，大家講得好好，無需要咁激動。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 m4 hou2 zou6 aa3 beng1 ngaau5 gau2 sat1 laa3, daai6 gaa1 gong2 dak1 hou2 hou2, mou5 seoi1 jiu3 gam2 gik1 dung6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 別做阿崩咬狗蝨了，大家說得很好，沒必要這麼激動。
examples.english_sentence: Don't act like that and make a fuss — we're having a perfectly reasonable conversation; there's no need to get so worked up.

mandarin_meaning: 買沒用的東西 / 浪費錢
english_meaning: to buy useless or unnecessary things; to waste money on pointless purchases
explanation_mandarin: 粵語口語俚語，字面是「阿崩買火石」，用來形容買一些沒用或不值得的東西，等於浪費錢或亂花錢。
explanation_english: A colloquial Cantonese slang phrase literally meaning 'Ah-Beng buys flint.' It is used to describe buying useless or unnecessary items — in other words, wasting money on pointless purchases.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢成日阿崩買火石，買啲無用嘅嘢，真係浪費錢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 seng4 jat6 aa3 beng1 maai5 fo2 sek6, maai5 di1 mou4 jung6 ge3 je5, zan1 hai6 long6 fai3 cin2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他總是買沒用的東西，真是浪費錢。
examples.english_sentence: He always buys useless things — it's really a waste of money.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 今次唔好再阿崩買火石，留返啲錢買啲實際有用嘅嘢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gam1 ci3 m4 hou2 zoi3 aa3 beng1 maai5 fo2 sek6, lau4 faan1 di1 cin2 maai5 di1 sat6 zai3 jung6 jau5 jung6 ge3 je5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 這次不要再買沒用的東西，把錢留起來買實際有用的東西。
examples.english_sentence: Don't buy useless stuff again this time; save the money for something practical.

mandarin_meaning: （字面）阿崩養狗。並非廣泛認可的成語或常用詞彙，屬罕見或地區性／網絡俚語。字面上指某人養狗；在特定語境下可被用作綽號、戲稱或帶輕蔑/調侃意味的稱呼，具體含義視語境而定。
english_meaning: Literal: "A-beng raises dogs." Not a widely recognized idiom — a rare/regional or internet slang expression. Literally means someone named (or nicknamed) 'A-beng' keeps dogs. In some contexts it may be used jokingly, as a nickname, or as a mild insult; the exact sense depends on context.
explanation_mandarin: 此詞並非標準廣東話成語或常見俗語，更多見於特定社群或網絡語境。表面意思是『阿崩養狗』，可直接指某人養狗，亦可能作為嘲諷、戲稱或綽號使用。由於用法不穩定，解讀要依賴上下文。
explanation_english: This expression is not a standard Cantonese idiom and is relatively rare. Literally it reads "A-beng raises dogs" and can simply mean someone keeps dogs. It may also function as a nickname, teasing remark, or mild insult in certain online or local contexts. Its meaning is context-dependent.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我聽到有人講佢係阿崩養狗，唔知係咪講佢鍾意養狗定係想嘲笑佢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 teng1 dou3 jau5 jan4 gong2 keoi5 hai6 aa3 beng1 joeng5 gau2, m4 zi1 hai6 mai6 gong2 keoi5 zung1 ji3 joeng5 gau2 ding6 hai6 soeng2 ciu1 siu3 keoi5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我听到有人说他是「阿崩养狗」，不知道是在说他喜欢养狗还是想嘲笑他。
examples.english_sentence: I heard someone say he's 'A-beng raises dogs' — I don't know if they mean he likes keeping dogs or if they're mocking him.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 阿崩養狗成日帶啲流浪狗返屋企，屋企成日好嘈。
examples.jyutping_sentence: aa3 beng1 joeng5 gau2 seng4 jat6 daai3 di1 lau4 long4 gau2 faan1 uk1 kei2, uk1 kei2 seng4 jat6 hou2 cou4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 阿崩养狗，经常带流浪狗回家，家里总是很吵。
examples.english_sentence: A-beng raises dogs and often brings stray dogs home; the house is always noisy.

mandarin_meaning: （對南亞裔人的）蔑稱或貶稱，常指印度、巴基斯坦、尼泊爾、孟加拉等南亞裔人士（具貶義）
english_meaning: A derogatory Cantonese slang term for people of South Asian descent (e.g., Indian, Pakistani, Nepalese, Bangladeshi); considered offensive
explanation_mandarin: 「阿差」是香港粵語中的俗稱/貶稱，用來指稱南亞裔人士。該詞含有貶義與歧視色彩，不宜使用。
explanation_english: “阿差” is a Cantonese colloquial/slang term used in Hong Kong to refer to South Asian people. It carries derogatory and discriminatory connotations and is considered offensive.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 喂，唔好用「阿差」呢個字，咁講好冒犯。
examples.jyutping_sentence: wai3, m4 hou2 jung6 aa3 caa1 ni1 go3 zi6, gam2 gong2 hou2 mou6 faan6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 喂，不要用「阿差」這個詞，這樣說很冒犯。
examples.english_sentence: Hey, don't use the term '阿差'; saying that is very offensive.

mandarin_meaning: 暱稱／人名；（口語）阿布扎比的簡稱；阿拉伯名字前綴 Abu 的音譯
english_meaning: a nickname/personal name; colloquial short form of Abu Dhabi; transliteration of Arabic 'Abu'
partOfSpeech_mandarin: 名詞（暱稱 / 地名縮寫 / 人名音譯）
explanation_mandarin: 「阿布」在粵語口語中常用作人名或暱稱，也可作「阿布扎比」的簡稱；有時是阿拉伯語名字前綴 Abu 的音譯。語境決定具體含義，屬非正式用法。
explanation_english: In Cantonese, '阿布' is commonly used as a personal nickname, can serve as a colloquial abbreviation for 'Abu Dhabi', and sometimes represents the transliteration of the Arabic name prefix 'Abu'. Meaning depends on context; it's informal.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 阿布今日唔返工？
examples.jyutping_sentence: aa3 bou3 gam1 jat6 m4 faan1 gung1?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 阿布今天不上班嗎？
examples.english_sentence: Is Ah Bu not coming to work today?

examples.cantonese_sentence: 聽講阿布嗰邊有間新酒店開幕。
examples.jyutping_sentence: teng1 gong2 aa3 bou3 go2 bin1 jau5 gaan1 san1 zau2 dim3 hoi1 muk6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 聽說阿布那邊有一家新酒店開幕。
examples.english_sentence: I heard there's a new hotel opening over in Abu Dhabi.

mandarin_meaning: 阿布哈兹（阿布哈茲）—位於南高加索、黑海東岸的地區，實際上為一個部分承認的分離地區/國家（與格魯吉亞存在領土爭議）
english_meaning: Abkhazia — a region on the eastern coast of the Black Sea in the South Caucasus; a partially recognized, de facto independent territory disputed with Georgia
explanation_mandarin: 阿布哈茲是位於高加索地區、黑海東岸的一個地區。自蘇聯解體後歷經衝突，實際上脫離格魯吉亞管轄並宣稱獨立，但僅獲少數國家承認，其政治地位具有爭議性。
explanation_english: Abkhazia is a region on the eastern shore of the Black Sea in the Caucasus. After the collapse of the Soviet Union it became a de facto independent, breakaway territory from Georgia; only a few countries recognize its independence and its political status remains disputed.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 阿布哈茲係一個位於高加索、喺黑海東岸嘅地區，政治地位有爭議。
examples.jyutping_sentence: aa3 bou3 haa1 zi1 hai6 jat1 go3 wai6 jyu1 gou1 gaa1 sok3, hai2 hak1 hoi2 dung1 ngon6 ge3 dei6 keoi1, zing3 zi6 dei6 wai6 jau5 zang1 ji6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 阿布哈茲是一個位於高加索、在黑海東岸的地區，政治地位有爭議。
examples.english_sentence: Abkhazia is a region in the Caucasus on the eastern coast of the Black Sea; its political status is disputed.

mandarin_meaning: 佛教音譯語（含阿彌、揭諦等音節），常出現在誦經或作為感嘆語；與「揭諦揭諦」同源，指向梵語 gate（意為「往彼岸去/到彼岸」）
english_meaning: A Buddhist transliteration/chant syllable (combines elements like 'Ami' and 'gate'); appears in sutra recitation or as an exclamation; related to the Sanskrit 'gate' meaning 'gone/gone to the other shore'.
explanation_mandarin: 「阿彌揭諦」並非現代口語常用詞，而是佛教誦經時出現的音譯性詞組；其中「揭諦」對應《心經》結偈中的梵語 gate，意為「已往/到彼岸」。在廣東話語境中，有時把此類音節作為感嘆或招呼用語，但主要屬於宗教用語或誦經文本。
explanation_english: This phrase is not a common everyday Cantonese term but a phonetic/transliterated string found in Buddhist recitation. '揭諦' corresponds to the Sanskrit 'gate' in the Heart Sutra (meaning 'gone' or 'gone to the other shore'). In Cantonese contexts the syllables may sometimes be used as an exclamatory utterance, but primarily it is a religious/chanting term.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 聽住師父念阿彌揭諦，心裡感覺好平靜。
examples.jyutping_sentence: teng1 zyu6 si1 fu2 nim6 aa3 mai4 kit3 dai3, sam1 leoi5 gam2 gok3 hou2 ping4 zing6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 聽着師父念「阿彌揭諦」，心裡感到很平靜。
examples.english_sentence: Listening to the master chant '阿彌揭諦' made me feel very calm.

mandarin_meaning: 阿弥陀佛（佛名），亦用作感叹词或祝福语
english_meaning: Amitābha (Buddha); used as an interjection or blessing
explanation_mandarin: 源自佛教的佛号，用以称念阿弥陀佛。在粤语中既可用于宗教礼拜，也是常见的感叹或祝福用语，表达惊讶、感激、松一口气或祈求平安。
explanation_english: Originally the Buddhist name/chant for Amitābha Buddha. In Cantonese it is used both in religious contexts and colloquially as an interjection or blessing to express surprise, relief, gratitude, or a wish for safety.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 阿彌陀佛，差啲就出事啦！
examples.jyutping_sentence: aa3 mei4 to4 fat6, caa1 di1 zau6 ceot1 si6 laa3!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 阿弥陀佛，差点儿就出事了！
examples.english_sentence: Amitabha — that was a close call!

examples.cantonese_sentence: 去到廟入面，大家都會講一聲阿彌陀佛。
examples.jyutping_sentence: heoi3 dou3 miu6 jap6 min6, daai6 gaa1 dou1 wui5 gong2 jat1 seng1 aa3 mei4 to4 fat6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 到了庙里，大家都会念一声阿弥陀佛。
examples.english_sentence: When entering the temple, everyone will say 'Amitabha.'

mandarin_meaning: 我們 / 咱們（方言借詞）
english_meaning: we / us (dialectal/slang)
explanation_mandarin: 「阿拉」原本是吳語（例如上海話）中表示「我們」或「咱們」的代詞。在粵語語境中屬於外來口語或戲謔性的用法，常用來模仿吳語口音或作為俏皮的「我們」。
explanation_english: “阿拉” originally comes from Wu dialects (e.g. Shanghainese) meaning “we/us.” In Cantonese contexts it is a borrowed, colloquial/slang usage—often playful or imitative—used to mean “we.”

examples.cantonese_sentence: 阿拉今晚一齊去食飯啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: aa3 laa1 gam1 maan5 jat1 cai4 heoi3 sik6 faan6 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我們今晚一起去吃飯吧。
examples.english_sentence: We're going to eat together tonight.

mandarin_meaning: 阿拉伯（指阿拉伯人、阿拉伯国家或阿拉伯语）
english_meaning: Arab; Arabian; Arabic (relating to Arab people, Arab countries, or the Arabic language)
explanation_mandarin: 用來指稱阿拉伯民族、阿拉伯諸國或與阿拉伯語、阿拉伯文化相關的事物，可作名詞或形容詞使用。
explanation_english: Refers to Arab people, Arab countries, or things related to the Arabic language or Arab culture. Can be used as a noun or an adjective.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我打算下年去阿拉伯國家旅行，想去睇金字塔。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 daa2 syun3 haa6 nin4 heoi3 aa3 laai1 baak3 gwok3 gaa1 leoi5 hang4, soeng2 heoi3 tai2 gam1 zi6 taap3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我打算明年去阿拉伯国家旅行，想去看金字塔。
examples.english_sentence: I plan to travel to an Arab country next year; I want to see the pyramids.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢係阿拉伯人，識講阿拉伯語。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hai6 aa3 laai1 baak3 jan4, sik1 gong2 aa3 laai1 baak3 jyu5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他是阿拉伯人，会说阿拉伯语。
examples.english_sentence: He is Arab and speaks Arabic.

mandarin_meaning: 阿拉伯数字
english_meaning: Arabic numerals (the digits 0–9)
explanation_mandarin: 指現代通用的數字符號系統，通常指 0 到 9 的阿拉伯數字，用於表示數量、編號等。
explanation_english: Refers to the numeral system commonly used today, i.e., the digits 0 through 9 used to represent numbers, quantities, and identifiers.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢本書用阿拉伯數字標示頁碼。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 bun2 syu1 jung6 aa3 laap6 bok3 sou3 zi6 biu1 si6 jip6 maa5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这本书用阿拉伯数字标示页码。
examples.english_sentence: This book uses Arabic numerals to indicate the page numbers.

mandarin_meaning: 阿拉斯加（美國的一個州）
english_meaning: Alaska (U.S. state)
explanation_mandarin: 阿拉斯加是美國的一個州，位於北美西北部，以寒冷氣候、廣袤的荒野、冰川和北極光著名。
