examples.english_sentence: On circuit diagrams, the anode is usually marked with a plus sign.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 喺電解槽入面，陽極會發生氧化反應，釋放電子。
examples.jyutping_sentence: hai2 din6 gaai2 cou4 jap6 min6, joeng4 gik6 wui5 faat3 sang1 joeng5 faa3 fan3 jing3, sik1 fong3 din6 zi2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 在电解槽中，阳极会发生氧化反应，释放电子。
examples.english_sentence: In an electrolytic cell, the anode undergoes oxidation reactions and releases electrons.

mandarin_meaning: 阳痿（勃起功能障碍）
english_meaning: Erectile dysfunction (inability to achieve or maintain an erection)
explanation_mandarin: 指男性無法達到或維持足夠勃起以進行性行為的病症，也稱為勃起功能障礙，可能由生理或心理因素引起。
explanation_english: A medical condition in which a man cannot achieve or maintain an erection sufficient for sexual intercourse; also called erectile dysfunction. Causes may be physical, psychological, or mixed.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 醫生話佢有陽痿，要接受治療。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ji1 sang1 waa6 keoi5 jau5 joeng4 wai2, jiu3 zip3 sau6 zi6 liu4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 医生说他有阳痿，需要接受治疗。
examples.english_sentence: The doctor said he has erectile dysfunction and needs treatment.

mandarin_meaning: 陽痿 / 勃起功能障礙
english_meaning: erectile dysfunction (impotence)
explanation_mandarin: 一種男性性功能障礙，指無法達到或維持足夠的陰莖勃起以進行性行為。
explanation_english: A male sexual dysfunction characterized by the inability to achieve or maintain an erection sufficient for sexual intercourse.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢最近有啲陽萎，去睇咗醫生。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 zeoi3 gan6 jau5 di1 joeng4 wai2, heoi3 tai2 zo2 ji1 sang1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他最近有點陽痿，去看過醫生。
examples.english_sentence: He's been experiencing some erectile dysfunction recently; he went to see a doctor.

mandarin_meaning: 阳间（指人间、阳世，和阴间相对）
english_meaning: the world of the living; the human world (as opposed to the underworld)
explanation_mandarin: 指生者所處的人間、陽世，常用來與「陰間」（冥界）相對，既有宗教語境也用於口語。
explanation_english: Refers to the realm of the living (the human world), used in contrast to the underworld. It appears in religious contexts and everyday speech.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你終於返到陽間啦！
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 zung1 jyu1 faan1 dou3 joeng4 gaan1 laa3!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你终于回到阳间了！
examples.english_sentence: You're finally back among the living!

examples.cantonese_sentence: 喺陽間做人，最緊要識得尊重同照顧其他人。
examples.jyutping_sentence: hai2 joeng4 gaan1 zou6 jan4, zeoi3 gan2 jiu3 sik1 dak1 zyun1 zung6 tung4 ziu3 gu3 kei4 taa1 jan4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 在人间做人的时候，最重要的是懂得尊重和照顾他人。
examples.english_sentence: In the world of the living, the most important thing is to know how to respect and take care of others.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 有啲人話佢死咗，但有人聲稱見到佢喺陽間出現。
examples.jyutping_sentence: jau5 di1 jan4 waa6 keoi5 sei2 zo2, daan6 jau5 jan4 seng1 cing1 gin3 dou2 keoi5 hai2 joeng4 gaan1 ceot1 jin2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 有些人说他已经死了，但有人声称在阳间见到他的出现。
examples.english_sentence: Some said he was dead, but someone claimed to have seen him appear in the world of the living.

mandarin_meaning: 角落；角隅
english_meaning: corner; nook; recess
explanation_mandarin: 表示物體或空間的角落、隅處，語感偏書面或文雅，用於描述角落位置。
explanation_english: Refers to the corner or nook of an object or space. The term is somewhat literary/formal and is used to describe a cornerly location.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 牆隅有條裂縫，要修理。
examples.jyutping_sentence: coeng4 jyu4 jau5 tiu4 lit6 fung4, jiu3 sau1 lei5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 牆角有一道裂縫，需要修理。
examples.english_sentence: There's a crack in the corner of the wall that needs repair.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 書架最隅嗰本書係我嘅。
examples.jyutping_sentence: syu1 gaa3 zeoi3 jyu4 go2 bun2 syu1 hai6 ngo5 ge3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 書架最角落那本書是我的。
examples.english_sentence: That book at the far corner of the shelf is mine.

mandarin_meaning: 隆 (lóng)：表示隆重、隆起、兴盛、繁荣等意思，常见于“隆重”“隆起”“兴隆”等词。
english_meaning: 隆: (pronounced lung4 in Cantonese) meaning grand/solemn, to bulge or rise, prosperous/booming.
explanation_mandarin: 「隆」在粵語讀作 lung4，常用於構成詞語如「隆重」（莊重、盛大）、「隆起」（表面凸起）、「興隆」（繁榮）等。可以用來形容場合的莊重或物體的隆起與事業的興盛。
explanation_english: In Cantonese pronounced lung4. Appears in words like '隆重' (grand/solemn), '隆起' (to bulge/raise), and '興隆' (prosperous). It can describe solemn/grand occasions, physical swelling or raised surfaces, or prosperity.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 今次嘅開幕典禮好隆重，邀請咗好多嘉賓。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gam1 ci3 ge3 hoi1 muk6 din2 lai5 hou2 lung4 zung6, jiu1 cing2 zo2 hou2 do1 gaa1 ban1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这次的开幕典礼很隆重，邀请了很多嘉宾。
examples.english_sentence: This opening ceremony is very grand; many guests were invited.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 地面因為沉降而隆起，條路出現裂縫，要小心行車。
examples.jyutping_sentence: dei6 min6 jan1 wai6 cam4 gong3 ji4 lung4 hei2, tiu4 lou6 ceot1 jin2 lit3 fung6, jiu3 siu2 sam1 hang4 ce1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 地面因为沉降而隆起，路面出现裂缝，开车要小心。
examples.english_sentence: The ground has bulged due to subsidence, causing cracks on the road — drive carefully.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 生意越做越興隆，公司開多咗間分店。
examples.jyutping_sentence: saang1 ji3 jyut6 zou6 jyut6 hing1 lung4, gung1 si1 hoi1 do1 zo2 gaan1 fan1 dim3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 生意越做越兴隆，公司开了更多分店。
examples.english_sentence: Business is becoming more prosperous; the company opened more branches.

mandarin_meaning: 隆乳 / 隆胸（指透過手術或植入義乳等方式增大乳房）
english_meaning: breast augmentation; (to undergo) breast enlargement surgery
partOfSpeech_mandarin: 動詞 / 名詞（醫學術語）
explanation_mandarin: 指透過手術、植入義乳或脂肪移植等方式增大乳房，既可作為名詞描述手術，也可作為動詞表示接受該手術。
explanation_english: Refers to surgical breast augmentation (e.g., implants or fat grafting) to enlarge the breasts. Can be used as a noun for the procedure or as a verb meaning to have the procedure.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢最近做咗隆乳，感覺好自然。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 zeoi3 gan6 zou6 zo2 lung4 jyu5, gam2 gok3 hou2 zi6 jin4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 她最近做了隆乳，感覺很自然。
examples.english_sentence: She recently had breast augmentation; it looks/feels very natural.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 如果唔滿意胸型，可以考慮做隆乳手術。
examples.jyutping_sentence: jyu4 gwo2 m4 maan5 ji3 hung1 jing4, ho2 ji5 haau2 leoi6 zou6 lung4 jyu5 sau2 seot6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 如果對胸型不滿意，可以考慮做隆乳手術。
examples.english_sentence: If you're not satisfied with your breast shape, you could consider getting breast augmentation surgery.

mandarin_meaning: 隆冬/深冬，指冬季最寒冷的時候
english_meaning: midwinter; the coldest part of winter
explanation_mandarin: 指冬季當中最冷、最嚴寒的時節，常用來描述天氣或季節的嚴寒程度。
explanation_english: Refers to the middle of winter or the coldest period of winter; used to describe very cold weather or the severity of the season.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 而家係隆冬，出門要著多啲衫。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ji4 gaa1 hai6 lung4 dung1, ceot1 mun4 jiu3 zoek3 do1 di1 saam1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 现在是隆冬，出门要多穿衣服。
examples.english_sentence: It's midwinter now; you should wear more clothes when going out.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 隆冬時節，湖面會結冰，唔好落去玩水。
examples.jyutping_sentence: lung4 dung1 si4 zit3, wu4 min6 wui5 git3 bing1, m4 hou2 lok6 heoi3 waan2 seoi2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 隆冬时节，湖面会结冰，不要下去玩水。
examples.english_sentence: During midwinter the lake surface will freeze; don't go in to play in the water.

mandarin_meaning: 隆胸（通过手术或植入义乳使乳房变大）
english_meaning: breast augmentation; to undergo breast augmentation (cosmetic surgery to enlarge the breasts)
explanation_mandarin: 指通过整形手术或植入假体（义乳）使乳房变大，属于美容整形范畴。
explanation_english: Refers to a cosmetic surgical procedure (or implantation of prostheses) to enlarge the breasts; a type of plastic/cosmetic surgery.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢話想隆胸，打算下個月去整。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 waa6 soeng2 lung4 hung1, daa2 syun3 haa6 go3 jyut6 heoi3 zing2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 她說想隆胸，打算下個月去做手術。
examples.english_sentence: She said she wants breast augmentation and plans to have the surgery next month.

mandarin_meaning: 隆起（向上凸起、鼓起）
english_meaning: to bulge up; to rise or swell upward; an uplifted/bulging area
explanation_mandarin: 表示表面、地形或物體向上凸起或鼓起；也可用於描述身體部位腫起。
explanation_english: Describes a surface, terrain, or object that rises or bulges upward; can also describe a swelling on the body.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 條路因為地震隆起咗，好難行。
examples.jyutping_sentence: tiu4 lou6 jan1 wai6 dei6 zan3 lung4 hei2 zo2, hou2 naan4 haang4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 那条路因为地震隆起了，很难通行。
examples.english_sentence: The road bulged up because of the earthquake, making it hard to pass.

mandarin_meaning: 隆重（lóngzhòng）：重大而正式、莊嚴的樣子
english_meaning: grand; solemn; ceremonious; formal
explanation_mandarin: 用來形容儀式、場合或舉止非常莊嚴、隆盛且正式。
explanation_english: Describes an occasion, manner, or event that is grand, solemn, ceremonious, and formal.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 公司為開幕安排咗一個隆重嘅儀式。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gung1 si1 wai6 hoi1 muk6 on1 paai4 zo2 jat1 go3 lung4 zung6 ge3 ji4 sik1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 公司为开幕安排了一个隆重的仪式。
examples.english_sentence: The company arranged a grand ceremony for the opening.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋要以隆重嘅方式紀念佢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 jiu3 ji5 lung4 zung6 ge3 fong1 sik1 gei3 nim6 keoi5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们要以隆重的方式纪念他。
examples.english_sentence: We will commemorate him in a solemn/grand manner.

mandarin_meaning: 把事情看得很重要並以隆重的儀式或態度對待；大肆鋪張
english_meaning: to treat something with great ceremony; to make a big deal out of something
explanation_mandarin: 表示以隆重或正式的方式對待某事，強調儀式性或重視程度，常用於描述活動、發布會或對事件的處理方式。
explanation_english: Indicates treating an event or matter in a grand or formal way, emphasizing ceremonial treatment or undue importance; often used to describe how launches, ceremonies, or matters are handled.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 公司對新產品嘅發布會隆重其事，請咗好多嘉賓同記者嚟採訪。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gung1 si1 deoi3 san1 caan2 ban2 ge3 faat3 bou3 wui2 lung4 zung6 kei4 si6, ceng2 zo2 hou2 do1 gaa1 ban1 tung4 gei3 ze2 lai4 coi2 fong2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 公司對新產品的發布會隆重其事，請了很多嘉賓和記者來採訪。
examples.english_sentence: The company treated the new product launch with great ceremony, inviting many guests and reporters to cover it.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 其實只係小事，冇需要隆重其事咁做。
examples.jyutping_sentence: kei4 sat6 zi2 hai6 siu2 si6, mou5 seoi1 jiu3 lung4 zung6 kei4 si6 gam2 zou6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 其實只是小事，沒有必要隆重其事地做。
examples.english_sentence: Actually it's just a small matter; there's no need to make a big fuss about it.

mandarin_meaning: 隆隆（拟声词）：形容雷声、引擎或大型物体持续有力的轰响
english_meaning: Rumbling (onomatopoeia for continuous deep, heavy sounds like thunder or engines)
explanation_mandarin: 用來模仿連續而沉重的聲音，如雷聲、火車或機器運轉時的聲響。
explanation_english: Used to imitate continuous, heavy sounds, such as thunder, trains, or large machinery operating.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 雷聲隆隆，下午可能會落大雨。
examples.jyutping_sentence: leoi4 sing1 lung4 lung4, haa6 ng5 ho2 nang4 wui5 lok6 daai6 jyu5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 雷声隆隆，下午可能会下大雨。
examples.english_sentence: Thunder rumbled; it might rain heavily this afternoon.

mandarin_meaning: 队 (duì)：队伍、团队、队列
english_meaning: team; group; line; queue; squad
explanation_mandarin: 表示由多人或多物組成的隊伍或隊列，可指運動隊、工作團隊、軍隊或排隊等情形。在粵語中常用於表示一隊人或一隊事物。
explanation_english: Denotes a team, group, or line/queue. Used for sports teams, work teams, squads, military units, or a line of people waiting.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋足球隊今日有比賽。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 zuk1 kau4 deoi6 gam1 jat6 jau5 bei2 coi3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们足球队今天有比赛。
examples.english_sentence: Our football team has a match today.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 超市門口有一長隊人等緊。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ciu1 si5 mun4 hau2 jau5 jat1 coeng4 deoi6 jan4 dang2 gan2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 超市门口有一长队人在等候。
examples.english_sentence: There's a long line of people at the supermarket entrance.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢而家係項目經理，帶住一隊新人。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 ji4 gaa1 hai6 hong6 muk6 ging1 lei5, daai3 zyu6 jat1 deoi6 san1 jan4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他现在是项目经理，带着一支新团队。
examples.english_sentence: He's now a project manager leading a team of new hires.

mandarin_meaning: 队伍；队列；一群有组织的人或排列成行的人
english_meaning: a line or formation of people; a team/group; ranks
explanation_mandarin: 表示一群排列成行或有組織的人員，常用於描述隊列、團隊或行進中的人群。
explanation_english: Refers to a group of people arranged in a line or an organized team; used to describe formations, ranks, or groups of people moving together.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 隊伍排得好整齊。
examples.jyutping_sentence: deoi6 ng5 paai4 dak1 hou2 zing2 cai4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 队伍排得很整齐。
examples.english_sentence: The line of people is arranged very neatly.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢加入咗救援隊伍。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 gaa1 jap6 zo2 gau3 wun4 deoi6 ng5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他加入了救援队伍。
examples.english_sentence: He joined the rescue team.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 遊行嘅隊伍慢慢行過馬路。
examples.jyutping_sentence: jau4 hang4 ge3 deoi6 ng5 maan6 maan6 haang4 gwo3 maa5 lou6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 游行的队伍慢慢走过马路。
examples.english_sentence: The procession slowly walked across the road.

mandarin_meaning: （俚語）昏倒、暈厥；（口語）被某人或某事迷倒、激動得不行
english_meaning: (slang) to faint; to collapse; (colloquial) to swoon or be overwhelmed (e.g. by emotion or attraction)
explanation_mandarin: 「隊冧」是香港粵語的俚語。可用來形容因疲倦、受驚或身體不適而暈倒、倒下；亦常用作誇張說法，表示被某人或某事打動、迷倒或激動得像要昏過去（類似「瘋狂尖叫／暈倒」）。
explanation_english: "隊冧" is Hong Kong Cantonese slang. It can describe physically fainting or collapsing due to tiredness, shock, or illness; it is also used hyperbolically to mean swooning or being overwhelmed by someone or something (e.g., extreme excitement or attraction).

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢行到一半隊冧咗，要人扶返屋企。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 haang4 dou3 jat1 bun3 deoi6 lam5 zo2, jiu3 jan4 fu4 faan1 uk1 kei5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他走到一半昏倒了，要人扶回家。
examples.english_sentence: He fainted halfway and needed someone to help him home.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 見到佢嘅偶像，班粉絲隊冧晒。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gin3 dou3 keoi5 ge3 ngau5 zoeng6, baan1 fan2 si1 deoi6 lam5 saai3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 看到他的偶像，粉絲都瘋狂地（像要）昏倒。
examples.english_sentence: When they saw their idol, the fans all swooned.

mandarin_meaning: 队友
english_meaning: teammate; team member
explanation_mandarin: 指同一隊伍或團隊中的成員，常用於體育、工作、小組或電子遊戲等情境。口語中亦可用於描述隊友表現（例如稱讚或抱怨）。
explanation_english: Refers to a member of the same team or group, used in contexts like sports, work, group projects, or online gaming. In colloquial use it can also comment on a teammate's performance (praise or complaint).

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢係我隊友，打機好犀利。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hai6 ngo5 deoi6 jau5, daa2 gei1 hou2 sai1 lei6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他是我的队友，打游戏很厉害。
examples.english_sentence: He's my teammate; he's great at gaming.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 比賽嗰陣，我個隊友犯咗錯，但我哋最後都贏咗。
examples.jyutping_sentence: bei2 coi3 go2 zan6, ngo5 go3 deoi6 jau5 faan6 zo2 co3, daan6 ngo5 dei6 zeoi3 hau6 dou1 jing4 zo2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 比赛的时候，我的队友犯了错，但我们最后还是赢了。
examples.english_sentence: During the match, my teammate made a mistake, but we still won in the end.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 喺小組報告中，我隊友準備咗大部分資料。
examples.jyutping_sentence: hai2 siu2 zou2 bou3 gou3 zung1, ngo5 deoi6 jau5 zeon2 bei6 zo2 daai6 bou6 fan6 zi1 liu2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 在小组报告中，我的队友准备了大部分资料。
examples.english_sentence: In the group presentation, my teammate prepared most of the materials.

mandarin_meaning: 队员
english_meaning: team member; squad member
explanation_mandarin: 指隶属于某个队伍或小组的人，例如运动队、工作小组或救援队等。
explanation_english: Refers to a person who belongs to a team or squad, such as a sports team, work group, or rescue team.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢係我哋足球隊嘅隊員。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hai6 ngo5 dei6 zuk1 kau4 deoi6 ge3 deoi6 jyun4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他是我们足球队的队员。
examples.english_sentence: He is a member of our football team.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 每位隊員都要準時到場練習。
examples.jyutping_sentence: mui5 wai2 deoi6 jyun4 dou1 jiu3 zeon2 si4 dou3 coeng4 lin6 zaap6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 每位队员都要准时到场练习。
examples.english_sentence: Every team member must arrive on time for practice.

mandarin_meaning: 相約一起去喝啤酒
english_meaning: to get together (with others) to drink beer; to go for beers
explanation_mandarin: 廣東話俚語，通常指一群人約好到酒吧、餐廳或其他地方一起喝啤酒，相當於「去喝啤酒/去飲啤酒」。
explanation_english: A Cantonese colloquial expression meaning to meet up with others to drink beer (go for beers).

examples.cantonese_sentence: 今晚大家去唔去隊啤？
examples.jyutping_sentence: gam1 maan5 daai6 gaa1 heoi3 m4 heoi3 deoi6 be1?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 今晚大家要不要一起去喝啤酒？
examples.english_sentence: Are we all going for beers tonight?

mandarin_meaning: 队形
english_meaning: formation; lineup; arrangement of a group
explanation_mandarin: 指隊伍或人群排列的方式或形狀，常用於軍事、體育、表演等情境，表示隊列、陣型的編排。
explanation_english: Refers to the arrangement or shape of a group or line — how members are positioned or organized. Commonly used for military formations, sports lineups, or performance choreographies.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 隊形唔整齊，教練話要重新排。
examples.jyutping_sentence: deoi6 jing4 m4 zing2 cai4, gaau3 lin6 waa6 jiu3 cung4 san1 paai4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 队形不整齐，教练说要重新排。
examples.english_sentence: The formation isn't neat; the coach said to rearrange it.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 行軍嘅時候要保持隊形，唔好亂走。
examples.jyutping_sentence: haang4 gwan1 ge3 si4 hau6 jiu3 bou2 ci4 deoi6 jing4, m4 hou2 lyun6 zau2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 行军的时候要保持队形，别乱走。
examples.english_sentence: When marching, keep the formation and don't wander off.

mandarin_meaning: （粗口）相當於「操／草」的感嘆或咒罵
english_meaning: A vulgar Cantonese expletive equivalent to 'fuck' or 'damn', used to express anger, annoyance or surprise
explanation_mandarin: 「隊草」為香港口語粗俗用語，常作感嘆詞或罵人之用，語源與單字「草/操」相關，使用時帶有強烈情緒與冒犯性，屬非正式用法。
explanation_english: “隊草” is a Hong Kong Cantonese vulgar slang term used as an expletive to express strong annoyance, anger or surprise. It is related to the swear word '草/操' and is informal and offensive — avoid in polite contexts.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 隊草！個巴士又塞車，遲到喇！
examples.jyutping_sentence: deoi6 cou2! go3 baa1 si2 jau6 sak1 ce1, ci4 dou3 laa3!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 操！公交车又堵车了，要迟到了！
examples.english_sentence: Fuck! The bus is stuck again — I'm going to be late!

mandarin_meaning: （口語/少見）一起喝酒、對飲（可能為「對酒」的變體或筆誤）
english_meaning: to drink together; to have a round of drinks (colloquial; possibly a variant/misspelling of 對酒)
explanation_mandarin: 「隊酒」在粵語中屬於口語用法或少見寫法，一般表示與人一同喝酒、碰杯或對飲。此詞可能源自或被混寫為「對酒」，用法多見於非正式語境。
explanation_english: “隊酒” is an informal/rare Cantonese expression meaning to drink together, clink glasses, or have a round of drinks. It may be a variant or misspelling of 對酒 (to drink/to toast). Usage is chiefly colloquial.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 今晚大家一齊隊酒慶祝一下啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gam1 maan5 daai6 gaa1 jat1 cai4 deoi6 zau2 hing3 zuk1 jat1 haa6 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 今晚大家一起喝一杯慶祝一下吧。
examples.english_sentence: Let's all have a drink together tonight to celebrate.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢每逢節日都會邀請朋友隊酒。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 mui5 fung4 zit3 jat6 dou1 wui5 jiu1 cing2 pang4 jau5 deoi6 zau2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他每逢節日都會邀請朋友一起喝酒。
examples.english_sentence: He invites friends to drink together on every holiday.

mandarin_meaning: 隊長 (duìzhǎng)
english_meaning: team leader; captain
explanation_mandarin: 指一個團隊或隊伍的負責人或領導者，負責帶領、指揮和協調隊員的工作或行動。
explanation_english: Refers to the person in charge or leader of a team or squad, responsible for guiding, directing, and coordinating the members' actions.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你係我哋嘅隊長，記住帶領大家。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 hai6 ngo5 dei6 ge3 deoi6 zoeng2, gei3 zyu6 daai3 ling5 daai6 gaa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你是我們的隊長，記得帶領大家。
examples.english_sentence: You're our team leader—remember to lead everyone.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 今次比賽我哋嘅隊長好有經驗。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gam1 ci3 bei2 coi3 ngo5 dei6 ge3 deoi6 zoeng2 hou2 jau5 ging1 jim6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 這次比賽我們的隊長很有經驗。
examples.english_sentence: Our team leader is very experienced in this competition.

mandarin_meaning: 隋（朝代）；隋姓
english_meaning: Sui (dynasty); Sui (surname)
explanation_mandarin: 指中國歷史上的隋朝（581–618年），亦可作為姓氏使用。隋朝在短時間內完成南北統一，對後世影響深遠。
explanation_english: Refers to the Sui dynasty of China (581–618 AD); also used as a surname. The Sui dynasty briefly unified Northern and Southern China and had significant historical impact.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 隋朝係中國歷史上其中一個短命嘅朝代。
examples.jyutping_sentence: seoi4 ciu4 hai6 zung1 gwok3 lik6 si2 soeng6 kei4 zung1 jat1 go3 dyun2 ming6 ge3 ciu4 doi6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 隋朝是中国历史上其中一个短命的朝代。
examples.english_sentence: The Sui dynasty was one of the short-lived dynasties in Chinese history.

mandarin_meaning: 壕溝；城邊的護溝；在復合詞中指城隍（地方守護神）
english_meaning: moat; defensive ditch around a city; in compounds refers to the City God (local protective deity)
explanation_mandarin: 「隍」本義為城郭周圍的壕溝，用以防禦。在複合詞如「城隍」中，指地方守護神或其廟宇（城隍廟）。
explanation_english: Originally refers to the moat or defensive ditch around a city. In compounds such as "城隍" it refers to the City God (a local protective deity) or its temple.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋今晚去城隍廟拜神。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 gam1 maan5 heoi3 sing4 wong4 miu6 baai3 san4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们今晚去城隍庙拜神。
examples.english_sentence: We're going to the City God Temple tonight to pray.

mandarin_meaning: 阶（jiē）：台阶；阶段；等级、阶层
english_meaning: step; stair; stage; rank; level
explanation_mandarin: 「階」可以指樓梯的每一級台階，也常用在複合詞表示階段（如「階段」）、等級或社會階層（如「高階」）。
explanation_english: “階” can refer to an individual stair step, and is also used in compounds to mean a stage/phase, a rank or level (e.g. in "stage" or "higher-level").

examples.cantonese_sentence: 樓梯有三十一階，我上到一半就攰。
examples.jyutping_sentence: lau4 tai1 jau5 saam1 sap6 jat1 gaai1, ngo5 soeng5 dou3 jat1 bun3 zau6 gui6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 楼梯有三十一阶，我上到一半就累了。
examples.english_sentence: The staircase has 31 steps; I got tired halfway up.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢段關係已經去到另一個階段。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 dyun6 gwaan1 hai6 ji5 ging1 heoi3 dou3 ling6 jat1 go3 gaai1 dyun6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这段关系已经进入另一个阶段。
examples.english_sentence: This relationship has entered another stage.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢依家係公司嘅高階主管。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 ji4 gaa1 hai6 gung1 si1 ge3 gou1 gaai1 zyu2 gun2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他现在是公司里的高阶主管（高级主管）。
examples.english_sentence: He is currently a senior manager at the company.

mandarin_meaning: 囚犯；被關押的人（亦可比喻受束縛或失去自由的人）
english_meaning: prisoner; inmate; (figuratively) someone trapped or deprived of freedom
explanation_mandarin: 指被關押的囚犯。在粵語語境中也常用作比喻，形容受制、被困或失去自由的人。
explanation_english: Denotes a person who is imprisoned or detained. In Cantonese it is also used figuratively to describe someone who is constrained, trapped, or deprived of freedom.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢而家係階下囚，因為被捕而等緊法庭審訊。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 ji4 gaa1 hai6 gaai1 haa6 cau4, jan1 wai6 bei6 bou6 ji4 dang2 gan2 faat3 teng4 sam2 seon3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他現在是階下囚，因為被捕正在等待法庭審訊。
examples.english_sentence: He is currently a prisoner, having been arrested and awaiting trial.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 自從公司裁員後，佢覺得自己變咗階下囚，冇得話事。
examples.jyutping_sentence: zi6 cung4 gung1 si1 coi4 jyun4 hau6, keoi5 gok3 dak1 zi6 gei2 bin3 zo2 gaai1 haa6 cau4, mou5 dak1 waa6 si6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 自從公司裁員後，他覺得自己變成了階下囚，沒有發言權。
examples.english_sentence: Since the company layoffs, he feels like a prisoner with no say.

mandarin_meaning: 阶乘（数学术语）
english_meaning: factorial (mathematical function)
explanation_mandarin: 階乘是對正整數 n 的運算，記作 n!，等於從 1 連乘到 n 的所有正整數的積。常用於排列、組合和概率等計算中。
explanation_english: The factorial of a nonnegative integer n, denoted n!, is the product of all positive integers from 1 to n. Commonly used in permutations, combinations, and probability.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 喺組合數學入面，n 階乘寫做 n!，等於 1×2×…×n。
examples.jyutping_sentence: hai2 zou2 hap6 sou3 hok6 jap6 min6, n gaai1 sing4 se2 zou6 n!, dang2 jyu4 1×2×…×n.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 在組合數學中，n 的階乘寫作 n!，等於 1×2×…×n。
examples.english_sentence: In combinatorics, the factorial of n, written n!, equals 1×2×…×n.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 5 嘅階乘係 120。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ng5 ge3 gaai1 sing4 hai6 120.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 5 的階乘是 120。
examples.english_sentence: The factorial of 5 is 120.

mandarin_meaning: 阶层 (社会或组织中不同的等级或层次)
english_meaning: level; tier; social class; hierarchy
explanation_mandarin: 指社會、組織或事物中不同的等級或層次，常用來描述權力、地位或資源分佈的差異。
explanation_english: Refers to different ranks or layers within a society, organization, or system; commonly used to describe differences in power, status, or resource distribution.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 喺呢間公司入面，管理階層同基層之間嘅溝通唔夠。
examples.jyutping_sentence: hai2 ni1 gaan1 gung1si1 jap6min6, gun2lei5 gaai1 cang4 tung4 gei1 cang4 zi1 gaan1 ge3 gau1tung1 m4 gau3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 在這家公司裡，管理階層和基層之間的溝通不夠。
examples.english_sentence: In this company, communication between the management level and the grassroots is insufficient.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 社會階層通常會影響一個人嘅教育機會同經濟地位。
examples.jyutping_sentence: se5 wui6 gaai1 cang4 tung1 soeng4 wui5 jing2 hoeng2 jat1 go3 jan4 ge3 gaau3 juk6 gei1 wui6 tung4 ging1 zai3 dei6 wai6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 社會階層通常會影響一個人的教育機會和經濟地位。
examples.english_sentence: Social class often influences a person's educational opportunities and economic status.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋喺公司入面係中層，屬於管理階層。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 hai2 gung1si1 jap6min6 hai6 zung1 cang4, suk6 jyu1 gun2lei5 gaai1 cang4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他們在公司裡是中層，屬於管理階層。
examples.english_sentence: They are middle-level staff in the company and belong to the management tier.

mandarin_meaning: 阶梯（楼梯）；比喻进步或发展的阶段/途径
english_meaning: staircase; steps; (figuratively) a stepping stone or stage in progress/advancement
explanation_mandarin: 指連續的一級級台階或樓梯，用於建築實物；也可作比喻，表示發展、升遷或達成目標過程中的階段或途徑。
explanation_english: Refers to a series of steps or a staircase in a building; can also be used metaphorically to mean a stage or stepping stone in development, progress, or advancement.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 嗰座大廈入面有一段長長嘅階梯。
examples.jyutping_sentence: go2 zo6 daai6 haa6 jap6 min6 jau5 jat1 dyun6 coeng4 coeng4 ge3 gaai1-tai1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 那座大厦里面有一段很长的阶梯。
examples.english_sentence: Inside that building there is a long flight of stairs.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢份獎學金係佢事業嘅重要階梯。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 fan6 zoeng2 hok6 gam1 hai6 keoi5 si6 jip6 ge3 zung6 jiu3 gaai1-tai1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这份奖学金是他事业的重要阶梯。
examples.english_sentence: This scholarship is an important stepping stone in his career.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 行階梯要小心，容易絆倒。
examples.jyutping_sentence: haang4 gaai1-tai1 jiu3 siu2-sam1, jung4-ji6 baan6-dou2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 走台阶要小心，很容易被绊倒。
examples.english_sentence: Be careful when walking the steps; it's easy to trip.

mandarin_meaning: 阶段 (jiēduàn)
english_meaning: stage; phase; period
explanation_mandarin: 表示一個過程或發展中的某個時期或階段。
explanation_english: Refers to a stage or phase within a process or development.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋而家喺一個重要嘅階段。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 ji4 gaa1 hai2 jat1 go3 zung6 jiu3 ge3 gaai1 dyun6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们现在处于一个重要的阶段。
examples.english_sentence: We are currently at an important stage.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 學習語言需要經歷唔同嘅階段。
examples.jyutping_sentence: hok6 zaap6 jyu5 jin4 seoi1 jiu3 ging1 lik6 m4 tung4 ge3 gaai1 dyun6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 学习语言需要经历不同的阶段。
examples.english_sentence: Learning a language requires going through different stages.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 醫生話我康復到下一個階段先至可以返工。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ji1 sang1 waa6 ngo5 hong1 fuk6 dou3 haa6 jat1 go3 gaai1 dyun6 sin1 zi3 ho2 ji5 faan1 gung1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 医生说我要康复到下一个阶段才能回去工作。
examples.english_sentence: The doctor said I can only return to work after I recover to the next stage.

mandarin_meaning: 樓梯用的磚塊（階梯磚）
english_meaning: step brick; brick used for stairs or steps
explanation_mandarin: 指用於鋪設或砌築樓梯踏步的磚塊，常見於戶外或某些建築的踏步表面。
explanation_english: Refers to bricks used for constructing or paving stair steps; commonly found on outdoor steps or as part of a building's stairway surface.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 工人用階磚砌好條樓梯。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gung1 jan4 jung6 gaai1 zyun1 kai3 hou2 tiu4 lau4 tai1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 工人用階磚砌好了那段樓梯。
examples.english_sentence: The workers used step bricks to build the staircase.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢啲階磚好滑，行路要小心。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 di1 gaai1 zyun1 hou2 waat6, haang4 lou6 jiu3 siu2 sam1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 這些階磚很滑，走路要小心。
examples.english_sentence: These step bricks are slippery; be careful when walking.

mandarin_meaning: 階級（社會或組織中按經濟地位、職位等劃分的等級）
english_meaning: class; social class; rank — levels within society or an organization based on status, position, or economic standing
explanation_mandarin: 指社會或組織內按經濟地位、職位、權力等劃分的不同等級或階層。
explanation_english: Refers to different levels or ranks within society or an organization, typically divided by economic status, position, or power.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 社會上有唔同嘅階級。
examples.jyutping_sentence: se5 wui6 soeng6 jau5 m4 tung4 ge3 gaai1 kap1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 社會上有不同的階級。
examples.english_sentence: There are different classes in society.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 工人階級同資產階級喺政治上有衝突。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gung1 jan4 gaai1 kap1 tung4 zi1 caan2 gaai1 kap1 hai2 zing3 zi6 soeng6 jau5 cung1 dat6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 工人階級和資產階級在政治上有衝突。
examples.english_sentence: The working class and the capitalist class have conflicts in politics.

mandarin_meaning: 阶级观念（对社会阶级差异、地位和等级关系的意识或看法）
english_meaning: class consciousness; awareness or mindset regarding social class differences, status, and hierarchy
explanation_mandarin: 指個人或群體對社會階級、地位差異及由此產生的待遇、尊重等關係的認知與態度。
explanation_english: Refers to an individual's or group's awareness and attitude toward social class distinctions, status differences, and the resulting treatment or respect.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢好有階級觀念，成日睇人有冇錢先尊重佢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hou2 jau5 gaai1 kap1 gwaan1 nim6, seng4 jat6 tai2 jan4 jau5 mou5 cin2 sin1 zyun1 zung6 keoi5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他很有階級觀念，總是先看對方有沒有錢才尊重他。
examples.english_sentence: He has strong class consciousness — he always respects people only if they have money.

mandarin_meaning: 随 (suí)：跟随、顺应、随意（见于随便、随时、随着等）
english_meaning: to follow; along with; as; casual/whatever (appears in compounds like '随便' meaning 'casual/whatever')
partOfSpeech_mandarin: 動詞 / 介詞 / 副詞（視語境而定）
explanation_mandarin: 表示跟随、順應、或者隨意、任意等意思。可單獨作動詞或作構詞成分，常見於隨便、隨時、隨著/隨住等短語中，用法靈活。
explanation_english: Denotes following, accompanying, compliance, or casualness. It can function as a verb or as part of compounds; commonly appears in words like 随便 (casual/whatever), 随时 (anytime), 随着/随住 (as/along with).

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你隨便揀啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 ceoi4 bin6 gaan2 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你隨便選吧。
examples.english_sentence: Just pick whichever you like.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你可以隨時打畀我。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 ho2 ji5 ceoi4 si4 daa2 bei2 ngo5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你可以隨時打給我。
examples.english_sentence: You can call me anytime.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 隨住天氣轉冷，大家著多件衫。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ceoi4 zyu6 tin1 hei3 zyun2 laang5, daai6 gaa1 zoek3 do1 gin6 saam1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 隨著天氣轉冷，大家多穿一件衣服。
examples.english_sentence: As the weather gets colder, everyone puts on an extra layer.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢隨我入咗去。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 ceoi4 ngo5 jap6 zo2 heoi3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他跟著我進去了。
examples.english_sentence: He followed me inside.

mandarin_meaning: 隔 (gé) — 隔开、隔离、隔着；也可表示每隔一段时间（如“隔日”）
english_meaning: to separate; to be apart/with something in between; also used to indicate regular intervals (e.g. 'every other day')
explanation_mandarin: 表示把兩者分開或中間有阻隔（如“隔牆”、“隔離”），也可用作時間上的間隔（如“隔日”、“隔兩天”）。
explanation_english: Indicates physical separation or something intervening between two things (e.g., '隔牆', '隔離'); can also mark temporal intervals (e.g., '隔日' = every other day).

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我屋企隔籬有間茶餐廳。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 uk1 kei2 gaak3 lei4 jau5 gaan1 caa4 caan1 teng1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我家隔壁有一家茶餐厅。
examples.english_sentence: There is a cha chaan teng next to my home.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋之間隔住一條街。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 zi1 gaan1 gaak3 zyu6 jat1 tiu4 gaai1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们之间隔着一条街。
examples.english_sentence: There is a street between them.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我隔日去跑步一次。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 gaak3 jat6 heoi3 paau2 bou6 jat1 ci3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我隔日去跑步一次。
examples.english_sentence: I go running every other day.

mandarin_meaning: 隔代（跳過一代或代間跨越），常用於描述祖父母代替父母撫養子女或世代之間的差異
english_meaning: intergenerational; across generations; skip a generation (often referring to grandparents raising grandchildren or generation gaps)
explanation_mandarin: “隔代”用來描述代與代之間跳過一代的現象，例如隔代教養（由祖父母代為撫養孫輩）或強調世代差異的情況。
explanation_english: “隔代” describes phenomena that span or skip a generation, such as grandparental caregiving (grandparents raising grandchildren) or highlighting intergenerational differences.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 而家好多家庭都有隔代教養嘅情況。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ji4 gaa1 hou2 do1 gaa1 ting4 dou1 jau5 gaak3 doi6 gaau3 joeng5 ge3 cing4 fong3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 現在很多家庭都有隔代教養的情況。
examples.english_sentence: Nowadays many families have situations of grandparental caregiving (skip-generation parenting).

mandarin_meaning: 隔离；分离；相隔
english_meaning: to be apart; separation; to be separated
partOfSpeech_mandarin: 動詞 / 名詞（書面或文言用法）
explanation_mandarin: 表示人或事物之間的分離或相隔。此詞在口語中較少見，偏書面或文言色彩，有時可與「相隔」「分別」通用；注意不要與「各別」（各自、分別地）混淆。
explanation_english: Indicates separation or being apart. The term is less common in spoken Cantonese and carries a literary/written tone. It can sometimes be used like '相隔' or '分別'. Do not confuse it with '各別' (each / respectively).

examples.cantonese_sentence: 兩個人隔別多年，今日終於重逢啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: loeng5 go3 jan4 gaak3 bit6 do1 nin4, gam1 jat6 zung1 jyu1 cung4 fung4 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 两个人隔别多年，今天终于重逢了。
examples.english_sentence: The two people had been apart for many years; today they finally reunited.

mandarin_meaning: 防止灰塵進入的網子；過濾灰塵的濾網（例如空調、抽油煙機或風扇上的隔塵網）
english_meaning: dust filter / dust screen — a mesh or filter that blocks or traps dust (e.g., in air conditioners, range hoods, fans)
explanation_mandarin: 指安裝在電器或窗戶等位置，用來阻擋或過濾灰塵的網狀物，需定期清洗或更換以維持效能。
explanation_english: Refers to a mesh or filter installed in appliances or openings to block or trap dust. It should be cleaned or replaced regularly to maintain performance.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 冷氣機嘅隔塵網要定期清理，唔係會影響冷氣效能。
examples.jyutping_sentence: laang5 hei3 gei1 ge3 gaak3 can4 mong5 jiu3 ding6 kei4 cing1 lei5, m4 hai6 wui5 jing2 hoeng2 laang5 hei3 haau6 nang4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 空調的隔塵網要定期清理，否則會影響冷氣效能。
examples.english_sentence: The air conditioner's dust filter should be cleaned regularly; otherwise it will affect the AC's performance.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 廚房嘅抽油煙機隔塵網塞滿咗，要換新或者清洗。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ceoi4 fong2 ge3 cau1 jau4 jim1 gei1 gaak3 can4 mong5 sak1 mun5 zo2, jiu3 wan6 san1 waak6 ze2 cing1 sai2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 厨房的抽油烟机隔尘网堵满了，要换新或清洗。
examples.english_sentence: The kitchen range hood's dust filter is clogged; it needs to be replaced or cleaned.

mandarin_meaning: 隔壁（邻居；隔壁）
english_meaning: next door; the neighbor/next-door (place or person)
explanation_mandarin: 表示緊鄰在旁邊的地方或居住在相鄰單位的人，常用來說「隔壁的（人/房間/單位）」。
explanation_english: Refers to the place immediately adjacent or the person living in the adjacent unit; commonly used to mean "the neighbor" or "next-door" (as in next-door person, room, or apartment).

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我住喺隔壁。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 zyu6 hai2 gaak3 bik1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我住在隔壁。
examples.english_sentence: I live next door.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 隔壁個細路成日好嘈。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gaak3 bik1 go3 sai3 lou6 sing4 jat6 hou2 cou4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 隔壁的小孩经常很吵。
examples.english_sentence: The neighbor's child is often very noisy.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 如果你需要，我可以去隔壁借啲鹽。
examples.jyutping_sentence: jyu4 gwo2 nei5 seoi1 jiu3, ngo5 ho2 ji5 heoi3 gaak3 bik1 ze3 di1 jim4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 如果你需要，我可以去隔壁借点儿盐。
examples.english_sentence: If you need, I can go next door to borrow some salt.

mandarin_meaning: 隔夜 (gé yè) — 过夜、留到第二天的；常指剩下或放置了一夜的食物
english_meaning: overnight; from the previous night; leftover (often referring to food that has been left overnight)
explanation_mandarin: 表示某物是從前一晚留下來或放了一晚，常用於描述食物隔夜後可能不新鮮，也可表示時間上的『過夜、隔夜』。
explanation_english: Indicates something that remained from the previous night or lasted overnight. Frequently used for food left overnight (often implying it may be stale), and can denote the temporal sense of 'overnight'.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢碗湯唔好飲，係隔夜嘅。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 wun2 tong1 m4 hou2 jam2, hai6 gaak3 je6 ge3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这碗汤不要喝，是隔夜的。
examples.english_sentence: Don't drink this bowl of soup; it's been left overnight.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我唔鍾意食隔夜飯，覺得唔新鮮。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 m4 zung1 ji3 sik6 gaak3 je6 faan6, gok3 dak1 m4 san1 sin1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我不喜欢吃隔夜饭，觉得不新鲜。
examples.english_sentence: I don't like eating leftover rice; it doesn't feel fresh.

mandarin_meaning: 隔夜的仇恨；旧怨、宿怨
english_meaning: an old grudge; lingering resentment (often carried over from a prior conflict)
explanation_mandarin: 指已存在的怨恨或仇恨（通常来自之前的争执或不快），仍然被记挂着或未能化解。
explanation_english: Refers to a grudge or resentment that remains after a conflict (often from a previous day or earlier incident) and has not been resolved.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋只係因為一啲小事爭吵，唔好變成隔夜仇。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 zi2 hai6 jan1 wai6 jat1 di1 siu2 si6 zang1 caau3, m4 hou2 bin3 sing4 gaak3 je6 cau4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们只是因为一些小事吵架，不要变成隔夜仇。
examples.english_sentence: We only argued over some small things; don't let it become an overnight grudge.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢對上次嗰件事仲有隔夜仇，所以唔肯幫手。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 deoi3 soeng6 ci3 go2 gin6 si6 zung6 jau5 gaak3 je6 cau4, so2 ji5 m4 hang2 bong1 sau2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他对上次那件事还有隔夜仇，所以不肯帮忙。
examples.english_sentence: He still holds a grudge about that last time, so he refuses to help.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好將隔夜仇帶返工，會影響團隊氣氛。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 zoeng1 gaak3 je6 cau4 daai3 faan1 gung1, wui5 jing2 hoeng2 tyun4 deoi2 hei3 fan1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 不要把隔夜仇带到工作中，会影响团队气氛。
examples.english_sentence: Don't bring grudges into work; they'll affect team morale.

mandarin_meaning: 隔夜的油条（字面）；引申指陈旧、过时的东西或话题
english_meaning: leftover youtiao (literal); figuratively something stale or outdated
explanation_mandarin: 字面上指前一天剩下來、已經放過夜的油炸鬼（油条）。口語中可用來形容某物或某話題陳舊、沒新意或不再受歡迎，帶貶義。
explanation_english: Literally refers to youtiao (oil-fried dough) that was left overnight. Colloquially used to describe something or a topic that is stale, outdated, or no longer appealing; often derogatory.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢條隔夜油炸鬼唔好食啦，拋咗佢啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 tiu4 gaak3 je6 jau4 zaa3 gwai2 m4 hou2 sik6 laa1, paau1 zo2 keoi5 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 這根隔夜的油條不能吃了，扔掉吧。
examples.english_sentence: This leftover youtiao isn't edible; throw it away.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你唔好再講啲隔夜油炸鬼嘢啦，冇新意。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 m4 hou2 zoi3 gong2 di1 gaak3 je6 jau4 zaa3 gwai2 je5 laa1, mou5 san1 ji3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 別再說那些陳舊的東西了，沒新意。
examples.english_sentence: Don't keep talking about that old stuff; it's not original.

cantonese: 隔夜油炸鬼 - 冇厘火氣
jyutping: gaak3 je6 jau4 zaa3 gwai2 — mou5 lei4 fo2 hei3
mandarin_meaning: 隔夜油条——没了火气
english_meaning: Overnight youtiao — no more 'heat' (i.e., anger/enthusiasm has cooled or freshness/energy has faded)
explanation_mandarin: 比喻經過一夜之後，原本的火氣、怒氣、熱情或新鮮感已經消失或減退。
explanation_english: A metaphor comparing an overnight fried dough (youtiao) that has lost its warmth/crispness to a situation where anger, enthusiasm, or freshness has cooled or faded after some time.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢今日唔嬲喇，隔夜油炸鬼——冇厘火氣。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 gam1 jat6 m4 nau1 laa3, gaak3 je6 jau4 zaa3 gwai2 — mou5 lei4 fo2 hei3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他今天不生氣了，隔夜油条——没了火气。
examples.english_sentence: He's not angry today — overnight youtiao, no more heat (his anger has cooled).

cantonese: 隔夜茶 - 唔倒唔安樂
jyutping: gaak3 je6 caa4 — m4 dou2 m4 on1 lok6
mandarin_meaning: 隔夜茶——不倒掉就不得安寧（比喻剩下的茶應該丟棄，否則讓人放心不下）
english_meaning: Overnight tea — if you don't pour it out you won't be at ease (i.e. leftover tea should be discarded; otherwise people will feel uneasy)
explanation_mandarin: 這是廣東話俗語，字面意思是隔夜的茶應該倒掉，否則會讓人感到不放心或擔心衛生，常用來提醒丟棄隔夜飲品或表達謹慎的生活習慣。
explanation_english: A Cantonese saying literally warning that overnight tea should be poured away or people won't feel at ease. It reflects concerns about hygiene and customary caution about drinking leftover beverages.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我阿媽成日話：隔夜茶——唔倒唔安樂，唔好飲隔夜嘅茶。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 aa3 maa1 seng4 jat6 waa6: gaak3 je6 caa4 — m4 dou2 m4 on1 lok6, m4 hou2 jam2 gaak3 je6 ge3 caa4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我妈妈常说：隔夜茶——不倒不安心，不要喝隔夜的茶。
examples.english_sentence: My mom always says: 'Overnight tea — if you don't pour it out you won't be at ease.' Don't drink tea that's been left overnight.

mandarin_meaning: 隔夜菜；隔夜飯菜
english_meaning: leftover dishes from the previous night; overnight cooked food
explanation_mandarin: 指前一天做好的熟食或菜餚，放置過夜後第二天仍然食用，通常會伴隨新鮮度或衛生疑慮。
explanation_english: Refers to cooked dishes prepared the day before and kept overnight to be eaten the next day; often carries implications about freshness and food safety.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢啲係隔夜餸，你要唔要加熱先食？
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 di1 hai6 gaak3 je6 sung3, nei5 jiu3 m4 jiu3 gaa1 jit6 sin1 sik6?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这些是隔夜菜，你要不要加热再吃？
examples.english_sentence: These are leftover dishes from last night; do you want to reheat them before eating?

examples.cantonese_sentence: 媽媽成日話唔好食隔夜餸，話會肚痛。
examples.jyutping_sentence: maa4 maa1 sing4 jat6 waa6 m4 hou2 sik6 gaak3 je6 sung3, waa6 wui5 tou5 tung3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 妈妈常常说不要吃隔夜菜，说会肚子痛。
examples.english_sentence: My mother always says don't eat overnight leftovers — she says they can cause stomachaches.

mandarin_meaning: 斷奶；停止母乳餵養
english_meaning: to wean (a baby or young animal) off breast milk; to stop breastfeeding/lactation
explanation_mandarin: （粵語口語）指讓嬰兒或幼獸停止吸吮母乳或母親停止泌乳，即斷奶。亦可指逐步或突然停止餵母乳的行為。
explanation_english: A colloquial Cantonese term meaning to wean a baby or young animal off breast milk, or for a mother to stop producing/feeding breast milk. Can refer to gradual or abrupt cessation of breastfeeding.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 媽媽準備幫BB隔奶，開始加固體食物。
examples.jyutping_sentence: maa4 maa1 zeon2 bei6 bong1 bi1 bi1 gaak3 naai5, hoi1 ci2 gaa1 gu3 tai2 sik6 mat6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 媽媽準備幫寶寶斷奶，開始添加固體食物。
examples.english_sentence: The mother is preparing to wean the baby and start introducing solid foods.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我打算下個月隔奶，返工就方便啲。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 daa2 syun3 haa6 go3 jyut6 gaak3 naai5, faan1 gung1 zau6 fong1 bin6 di1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我打算下個月斷奶，回去工作就方便一點。
examples.english_sentence: I plan to wean next month; returning to work will be a bit more convenient.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 嗰隻狗仔三個月已經隔奶，可以食乾糧。
examples.jyutping_sentence: go2 zek3 gau2 zai2 saam1 go3 jyut6 ji5 ging1 gaak3 naai5, ho2 ji5 sik6 gon1 loeng4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 那隻小狗三個月已經斷奶，可以吃乾糧。
examples.english_sentence: That puppy has been weaned at three months and can eat dry food.

mandarin_meaning: 隔山打牛（間接攻擊或以牽連他人來報復）
english_meaning: To attack or retaliate indirectly by targeting someone associated with the real target; attacking via an intermediary
explanation_mandarin: 形容不直接對目標出手，而是通過打擊與目標有關或間接的對象來攻擊或報復，常指連累無辜或旁及他人。
explanation_english: Describes attacking or taking revenge indirectly by going after parties related to the real target (e.g., family, friends, associates) rather than confronting the target directly; often results in harming innocent people.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你咁做係隔山打牛，會害到啲無辜嘅人。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 gam2 zou6 hai6 gaak3 saan1 daa2 ngau4, wui5 hoi6 dou3 di1 mou4 gu1 ge3 jan4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你這麼做是在隔山打牛，會連累無辜的人。
examples.english_sentence: What you're doing is 'hitting the cow across the mountain' — you're indirectly harming innocent people.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢想報復阿強，係隔山打牛，去鬧佢屋企人。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 soeng2 bou3fuk6 aa3 koeng4, hai6 gaak3 saan1 daa2 ngau4, heoi3 naau6 keoi5 uk1kei5 jan4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他想報復阿強，是隔山打牛，去罵他的家人。
examples.english_sentence: He wants to get back at Ah Keung but is acting indirectly by going after his family.

mandarin_meaning: 盲目購買 / 不看實物就購買
english_meaning: to buy sight unseen; to make a purchase or decision without checking; act rashly
explanation_mandarin: 字面為「在山那邊買牛」，引申指在未親自查看或了解情況下就匆忙購買或做決定，帶有盲目或魯莽的含義。
explanation_english: Literally 'buying a cow across the mountain.' Refers to buying or deciding without inspecting or understanding the situation — making a purchase/decision sight unseen or rashly.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢隔山買牛，唔問清楚就買咗部二手電話，結果有好多問題。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 gaak3 saan1 maai5 ngau4, m4 man6 cing1 co2 zau6 maai5 zo2 bou6 ji6 sau2 din6 waa2, git3 gwo2 jau5 hou2 do1 man6 tai4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他盲目購買，不弄清楚就買了一部二手手機，結果有很多問題。
examples.english_sentence: He bought sight unseen — he bought a second-hand phone without checking, and it turned out to have many problems.

mandarin_meaning: 隔岸观火
english_meaning: to stand by and watch (someone else's misfortune) without helping
explanation_mandarin: 比喻在一旁觀看別人的災難或困境而不出手相助，保持冷漠或袖手旁觀。
explanation_english: An idiom meaning to watch someone else's trouble or misfortune from the sidelines without intervening or offering help.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好做隔岸觀火，見到人有難就應該出手幫忙。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 zou6 gaak3 ngon6 gun1 fo2, gin3 dou2 jan4 jau5 naan6 zau6 jing1 goi1 ceot1 sau2 bong1 mong4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 不要只是隔岸观火，看到别人有困难就应该出手帮忙。
examples.english_sentence: Don't just stand by and watch; when you see someone in trouble you should step in and help.

mandarin_meaning: 隔天；隔日（表示下一天或每隔一天）
english_meaning: the next day; every other day (context-dependent)
explanation_mandarin: 「隔日」用來表示時間，視上下文可解作「下一天」或「每隔一天（每兩天一次）」。常用作時間副詞。
explanation_english: Used as a time expression meaning either "the next day" or "every other day" (once every two days), depending on context.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我隔日去跑步，保持健康。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 gaak3 jat6 heoi3 paau2 bou6, bou2 ci4 gin6 hong1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我隔天去跑步，保持健康。
examples.english_sentence: I go jogging every other day to stay healthy.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 會議延遲咗，佢話隔日再開。
examples.jyutping_sentence: wui6 ji5 jin4 ci4 zo2, keoi5 waa6 gaak3 jat6 zoi3 hoi1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 會議延遲了，他說隔日再開。
examples.english_sentence: The meeting was postponed; he said it would be held the next day.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 醫生話藥要隔日食一次。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ji1 sang1 waa6 joek6 jiu3 gaak3 jat6 sik6 jat1 ci3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 醫生說藥要隔天吃一次。
examples.english_sentence: The doctor said to take the medicine once every other day.

mandarin_meaning: 隔油池（油脂分离池/隔油器）
english_meaning: grease trap / grease interceptor / oil separator (a tank or device that separates oils and fats from wastewater)
explanation_mandarin: 一种安装在排水系统中的装置或池子，用来拦截、分离厨房废水中的油脂和悬浮物，防止下水道堵塞和环境污染。
explanation_english: A device or tank installed in drainage systems to trap and separate oils, fats, and suspended solids from wastewater, preventing drain blockages and environmental contamination.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 餐廳要定期清理隔油池，唔係排水渠會塞住。
examples.jyutping_sentence: caan1 teng1 jiu3 ding6 kei4 cing1 lei5 gaak3 jau4 ci4, m4 hai6 paai4 seoi2 keoi4 wui5 sak1 zyu6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 餐厅要定期清理隔油池，不然排水沟会堵塞。
examples.english_sentence: The restaurant must clean the grease trap regularly, otherwise the drains will get clogged.

mandarin_meaning: 隔油汤壶
english_meaning: oil-separating soup pot / fat separator (for soups)
explanation_mandarin: 厨房用具，用来将煲汤或炖煮后表面的油脂与汤分离，便于倒走浮油，留下较清的汤。通常有导流或过滤设计。
explanation_english: A kitchen utensil used to separate floating oil/fat from soups or broths after cooking, allowing the oil to be poured off while retaining the clearer soup. Often designed with a spout or filter.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋煲完老火湯，要用隔油湯壺把浮油倒走，先至可以俾細路飲。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 bou1 jyun4 lou5 fo2 tong1, jiu3 jung6 gaak3 jau4 tong1 wu4 ba2 fau4 jau4 dou2 zau2, sin1 zi3 ho2 ji5 bei2 sai3 lou6 jam2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们煲完老火汤，要用隔油汤壶把浮油倒走，才可以给小孩喝。
examples.english_sentence: After we've finished simmering the soup, use an oil-separating soup pot to remove the floating oil so it's okay for the kids to drink.

mandarin_meaning: 牽涉/涉及（間接或被動地被牽連）
english_meaning: to be implicated or involved (often indirectly); to get drawn into
explanation_mandarin: 粵語用詞，表示被牽連或介入某件事，常帶有間接或不願意參與的含義。
explanation_english: A Cantonese expression meaning to be implicated in or drawn into something, often with a sense of indirect involvement or reluctance.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我唔想隔涉你哋嘅事，大家自己解決啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 m4 soeng2 gaak3 sip3 nei5 dei6 ge3 si6, daai6 gaa1 zi6 gei2 gaai2 kyut3 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我不想牽涉你們的事，大家自己解決吧。
examples.english_sentence: I don't want to get involved in your affairs; please settle it among yourselves.

mandarin_meaning: （口語/俚語）冷落、忽視或對某人斷聯（類似“ghost”）
english_meaning: slang for ignoring someone or suddenly cutting off contact (to ghost someone)
explanation_mandarin: 「隔渣」是廣東話口語／網絡俚語，用來形容刻意不理會某人、冷落或突然斷絕聯絡，含貶義或不滿的語氣。
explanation_english: “隔渣” is Cantonese slang used to describe deliberately ignoring someone, giving them the cold shoulder, or suddenly cutting off contact (similar to the English slang “ghost”). It typically carries a negative or dismissive tone.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢啱啱同我講完電話，之後就開始隔渣我，完全唔覆我訊息。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 aam1 aam1 tung4 ngo5 gong2 jyun4 din6 waa2, zi1 hau6 zau6 hoi1 ci2 gaak3 zaa1 ngo5, wun4 cyun4 m4 fuk1 ngo5 seon3 sik1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他剛和我通完電話，之後就開始冷落我，完全不回我的訊息。
examples.english_sentence: He just finished a call with me, and then started ghosting me — he completely stopped replying to my messages.

mandarin_meaning: 隔火层 / 防火层（用來阻止火勢蔓延的結構或區域；也可引申指人際或組織間的緩衝隔離）
english_meaning: firebreak / firestop layer (a structural or designated layer/zone that prevents the spread of fire; can be used metaphorically as a buffer or barrier between people or groups)
explanation_mandarin: 通常指建築或設備中用來防止火勢擴散的隔離層或構造；在口語中也可用作比喻，指在雙方之間保持的一道隔離或緩衝。
explanation_english: Usually refers to a layer or structure in a building or system designed to stop fire from spreading; colloquially it can be used metaphorically to mean a barrier or buffer kept between parties.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 嗰座樓嘅隔火層做得唔夠好，火好容易擴散。
examples.jyutping_sentence: go2 zo6 lau4 ge3 gaak3 fo2 cang4 zou6 dak1 m4 gau3 hou2, fo2 hou2 jung4 ji6 kwaa3 saan3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 那栋楼的隔火层做得不够好，火很容易蔓延。
examples.english_sentence: The firebreaks in that building aren't done well; a fire can spread easily.

mandarin_meaning: 隔热（阻隔或減少熱量傳遞）
english_meaning: to insulate against heat; heat-insulating
explanation_mandarin: 表示阻隔或減少熱量的傳遞，既可以作動詞（為某物隔熱），也可以作形容詞（具有隔熱性能）。
explanation_english: Refers to blocking or reducing the transfer of heat. Can be used as a verb (to insulate against heat) or as an adjective (heat-insulating).

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢塊玻璃有隔熱層，可以擋住太陽嘅熱。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 faai3 bo1 lei4 jau5 gaak3 jit6 cang4, ho2 ji5 dong2 zyu6 taai3 joeng4 ge3 jit6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 這塊玻璃有隔熱層，可以擋住太陽的熱。
examples.english_sentence: This pane of glass has an insulating layer that can block the heat from the sun.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 夏天要裝隔熱窗，先唔會成日開冷氣。
examples.jyutping_sentence: haa6 tin1 jiu3 zong1 gaak3 jit6 coeng1, sin1 m4 wui5 sing4 jat6 hoi1 laang5 hei3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 夏天要裝隔熱窗，才不會經常開冷氣。
examples.english_sentence: In summer, we should install heat-insulating windows so we don't have to run the air conditioner all the time.

mandarin_meaning: 隔墙有耳
english_meaning: Walls have ears; be careful what you say because someone may be listening
explanation_mandarin: 用來提醒人說話要謹慎，因為可能有人在偷聽或旁觀。
explanation_english: A proverb warning people to be careful about what they say because someone might be eavesdropping.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 開會講嘢要小心，隔牆有耳。
examples.jyutping_sentence: hoi1 wui6 gong2 je5 jiu3 siu2 sam1, gaak3 coeng4 jau5 ji5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 开会讲话要小心，隔墙有耳。
examples.english_sentence: Be careful what you say in the meeting — walls have ears.

mandarin_meaning: 隔空；远程、从远处或通过媒介进行
english_meaning: remotely; from a distance; across space
explanation_mandarin: 表示在不同的空间或透過媒介、遠距離進行某個動作或交流，常用於描述遠端溝通、隔空批評、隔空點名等情況。
explanation_english: Indicates doing something across space or via a medium at a distance. Commonly used to describe remote communication or actions done 'from afar' (e.g., remote criticism, calling someone out indirectly).

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢喺社交媒體隔空批評我哋。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hai2 se5 gaau1 mui4 tai2 gaak3 hung1 pai1 ping4 ngo5 dei6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他在社交媒體上隔空批評我們。
examples.english_sentence: He criticized us remotely on social media.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 今次會議由總部隔空主持，大家用視像會議連線。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gam1 ci3 wui6 ji5 jau4 zung2 bou6 gaak3 hung1 zyu2 ci4, daai6 gaa1 jung6 si6 zoeng6 wui6 ji5 lin4 sin3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 這次會議由總部隔空主持，大家用視訊會議連線。
examples.english_sentence: This meeting was hosted remotely by headquarters; everyone connected via video conference.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢喺貼文隔空點名你，你有冇睇到？
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hai2 tip3 man4 gaak3 hung1 dim2 ming4 nei5, nei5 jau5 mou5 tai2 dou3?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他在貼文裡隔空點名你，你有沒有看到？
examples.english_sentence: He indirectly called you out in the post — did you see it?

mandarin_meaning: 隔壁；鄰近
english_meaning: next door; adjacent; neighboring
explanation_mandarin: 表示在隔壁或鄰近的地方，可用來指鄰居或相鄰的位置。
explanation_english: Indicates the place next door or adjacent; used to refer to a neighboring location or neighbor.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢住喺我隔籬。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 zyu6 hai2 ngo5 gaak3 lei4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他住在我隔壁。
examples.english_sentence: He/She lives next door to me.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 隔籬嗰個阿婆好熱情，成日請我飲茶。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gaak3 lei4 go2 go3 aa3 po4 hou2 jit6 cing4, sing4 jat6 ceng2 ngo5 jam2 caa4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 隔壁的那位老太太很热情，经常请我喝茶。
examples.english_sentence: The neighborly old lady is very friendly; she often invites me for tea.

mandarin_meaning: 隔壁的邻居（住在相邻住户的人）
english_meaning: the neighbors next door; the people/household living adjacent to one's residence
explanation_mandarin: 指與自己家或住處相鄰的住戶或人，通常特指住在隔壁的人。
explanation_english: Refers to the person or household living next to one's home; specifically the neighbor in the adjacent unit.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我同隔籬鄰舍成日交換食物。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 tung4 gaak3 lei4 leon4 se3 sing4 jat6 gaau1 wun6 sik6 mat6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我和隔壁的邻居经常互相交换食物。
examples.english_sentence: My neighbors next door and I often exchange food.

mandarin_meaning: 隔壁邻居
english_meaning: next-door neighbor; the people living in the house next to yours
explanation_mandarin: 指住在隔壁的鄰居或隔壁的住戶，常用於口語。
explanation_english: Refers to the neighbors living next door or the household next to one's own; commonly used in colloquial speech.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我隔籬隣舍成日好吵。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 gaak3 lei4 leon4 se2 sing4 jat6 hou2 cau2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我隔壁的邻居经常很吵。
examples.english_sentence: My neighbors next door are often noisy.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你可唔可以幫我叫隔籬隣舍收下包裹？
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 ho2 m4 ho2 ji5 bong1 ngo5 giu3 gaak3 lei4 leon4 se2 sau1 haa5 baau1 gwo2?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你能不能幫我請隔壁邻居代收包裹？
examples.english_sentence: Could you ask the neighbors next door to receive the parcel for me?

mandarin_meaning: 覺得別人家的東西或處境總是更好（類似「別人的月亮比較圓／隔壁的草比較綠」）
english_meaning: to think others' possessions or circumstances are better than one's own (similar to "the grass is greener on the other side")
explanation_mandarin: 用來形容人常常覺得別人的東西或生活條件比自己好，帶有羨慕或忌妒的意味，常用來提醒別人不要過分羨慕他人。
explanation_english: Used to describe the tendency to think others' belongings or life circumstances are better; conveys envy or longing and is often used to remind people not to be overly envious.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好成日覺得隔籬飯香，自己都有好嘢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 sing4 jat6 gok3 dak1 gaak3 lei4 faan6 hoeng1, zi6 gei2 dou1 jau5 hou2 je5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 不要總覺得鄰居的飯菜更香，你自己也有好的東西。
examples.english_sentence: Don't always think the neighbor's rice smells better; you have good things too.

mandarin_meaning: 隔绝；切断联系
english_meaning: to isolate; to cut off; to sever connections; to block access
explanation_mandarin: 使人或事物與外界或其他對象中斷聯繫或隔離，表示連繫、通路被切斷或阻隔。
explanation_english: To cause a person or thing to be separated from others or from a source; to sever connections, block access, or isolate.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 因為疫情，呢個社區同外界隔絕咗幾個月。
examples.jyutping_sentence: jan1 wai6 jik6 cing4, ni1 go3 se5 keoi1 tung4 ngoi6 gaai3 gaak3 zyut6 zo2 gei2 go3 jyut6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 因為疫情，這個社區與外界隔絕了幾個月。
examples.english_sentence: Because of the pandemic, this community was cut off from the outside world for several months.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 如果你成日唔同佢聯絡，關係會慢慢被隔絕。
examples.jyutping_sentence: jyu4 gwo2 nei5 sing4 jat6 m4 tung4 keoi5 lyun4 lok3, gwaan1 hai6 wui5 maan6 maan6 bei6 gaak3 zyut6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 如果你整天不和他聯絡，關係會慢慢被隔絕。
examples.english_sentence: If you never stay in touch with them, the relationship will gradually be severed.

mandarin_meaning: 隔阂；疏远
english_meaning: estrangement; barrier; emotional distance
explanation_mandarin: 指人与人之间在感情或沟通上的隔阂，导致关系疏远或不亲近。
explanation_english: Refers to a barrier or emotional distance between people that results in poor communication or a strained relationship.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋之間有啲隔膜，講嘢都唔太自在。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 zi1 gaan1 jau5 di1 gaak3 mok6, gong2 je5 dou1 m4 taai3 zi6 zoi6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们之间有些隔阂，说话都不太自在。
examples.english_sentence: There is some distance between them; they don't feel comfortable talking.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 自從嗰次吵交之後，屋企人之間出現咗隔膜。
examples.jyutping_sentence: zi6 cung4 go2 ci3 caau3 gaau1 zi1 hau6, uk1 kei2 jan4 zi1 gaan1 ceot1 jin2 zo2 gaak3 mok6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 自从那次吵架之后，家人之间出现了隔阂。
examples.english_sentence: Since that argument, there's been a rift among family members.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 要修補個隔膜，需要多啲溝通同理解。
examples.jyutping_sentence: jiu3 sau1 bou2 go3 gaak3 mok6, seoi1 jiu3 do1 di1 kau1 tung1 tung4 lei5 gaai2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 要修补隔阂，需要多一些沟通和理解。
examples.english_sentence: To mend the rift, more communication and understanding are needed.

mandarin_meaning: 隔行如隔山 (gé háng rú gé shān) — 不同行业之间相去甚远，意指转行或跨界困难，应尊重专业技能与经验。
english_meaning: Different trades are as far apart as mountains — it's hard to switch professions or transfer skills; respect specialists and their experience.
explanation_mandarin: 用來形容不同職業或行業之間差別大，互相難以替代或理解，強調專業性和經驗的重要性，提醒人們不要輕視別人的專業。
explanation_english: Describes the large gap between different professions or industries; implies skills and knowledge are not easily transferable and that professional experience should be respected.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你唔好諗住轉行好易，隔行如隔山，唔熟行內嘅嘢會好難上手。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 m4 hou2 nam2 zyu6 zyun2 hong4 hou2 ji6, gaak3 hong4 jyu4 gaak3 saan1, m4 suk6 hong4 noi6 ge3 je5 wui5 hou2 naan4 soeng6 sau2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你不要以为转行很容易，隔行如隔山，不熟悉行内的事情很难上手。
examples.english_sentence: Don't think changing professions is easy; different trades are as far apart as mountains — being unfamiliar with the industry's matters makes it hard to get the hang of it.

mandarin_meaning: 隔邻；隔壁、邻近的（人或地方）
english_meaning: next-door; neighboring; adjacent (person or place)
explanation_mandarin: 表示住在隔壁或旁邊的鄰居，或形容事物彼此相鄰、靠近。
explanation_english: Refers to someone or something next door or nearby; can denote a neighbor (noun) or describe adjacency (adjective).

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我隔鄰個阿叔成日幫我拎嘢，佢好好人。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 gaak3 leon4 go3 aa3 suk1 sing4 jat6 bong1 ngo5 ling1 je5, keoi5 hou2 hou2 jan4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我隔邻的那位叔叔经常帮我拿东西，他很好人。
examples.english_sentence: The uncle next door often helps me carry things; he's a very nice person.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我隔鄰屋企最近裝修，好嘈。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 gaak3 leon4 uk1 kei2 zeoi3 gan6 zong1 sau1, hou2 cou4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我隔邻的那户人家最近在装修，很吵。
examples.english_sentence: My neighbors are renovating recently; it's very noisy.

mandarin_meaning: 隔开 / 分开
english_meaning: to separate; to put apart; to keep at a distance
explanation_mandarin: 表示把事物或人分開、使保持距離；也可指在時間或空間上分隔處理。
explanation_english: Means to separate things or people, keeping them apart; can also refer to separating items or events in time or space.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋隔開坐。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 gaak3 hoi1 co5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他們分開坐。
examples.english_sentence: They sit apart.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 將兩件事隔開處理。
examples.jyutping_sentence: zoeng1 loeng5 gin6 si6 gaak3 hoi1 cyu3 lei5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 把兩件事分開處理。
examples.english_sentence: Handle the two matters separately.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 請把水果隔開擺，唔好放埋一齊。
examples.jyutping_sentence: cing2 baa2 seoi2 gwo2 gaak3 hoi1 baai2, m4 hou2 fong3 maai4 jat1 cai4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 請把水果分開擺，不要放在一起。
examples.english_sentence: Please place the fruits separately; don't put them together.

mandarin_meaning: 隔阂（人與人之間的隔離、不和或誤解）
english_meaning: estrangement; rift; barrier — an emotional or communicative gap between people
explanation_mandarin: 指人與人之間因誤解、距離、價值觀不同或溝通不良而產生的心理或情感上的隔離與不和。
explanation_english: Refers to an emotional or communicative barrier between people caused by misunderstandings, distance, differing values, or poor communication.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我同佢之間有好大嘅隔閡，好耐都冇好好溝通。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 tung4 keoi5 zi1 gaan1 jau5 hou2 daai6 ge3 gaak3 wat6, hou2 noi6 dou1 mou5 hou2 hou2 gau1 tung1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我和他之間有很大的隔阂，已經很久沒有好好溝通了。
examples.english_sentence: There is a big rift between him and me; we haven't communicated properly for a long time.

mandarin_meaning: 阻隔；阻礙；隔閡
english_meaning: to block or obstruct; an obstacle; emotional distance or barrier
explanation_mandarin: 表示阻擋、妨礙或有隔閡。可作動詞（阻擋、阻礙某事）或作名詞（阻隔、障礙、隔閡）。
explanation_english: Indicates an obstruction, hindrance, or emotional distance. Can be used as a verb (to block/hinder) or as a noun (an obstacle or a barrier/awkwardness).

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我同佢之間有啲隔阻，依家唔太傾偈。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 tung4 keoi5 zi1 gaan1 jau5 di1 gaak3 zo2, ji4 gaa1 m4 taai3 king1 gai2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我和他之間有點隔閡，現在不太聊天。
examples.english_sentence: There's some distance between him and me; we don't chat much now.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 路畀大水淹，隔阻咗村入面嘅交通。
examples.jyutping_sentence: lou6 bei2 daai6 seoi2 jim4, gaak3 zo2 zo2 cyun1 jap6 min6 ge3 gaau1 tung1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 路被大水淹沒，阻隔了村內的交通。
examples.english_sentence: The road was flooded and cut off the village's transportation.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢啲手續未齊，隔阻咗佢申請簽證。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 di1 sau2 zuk6 mei6 cai4, gaak3 zo2 zo2 keoi5 san1 cing2 cim1 zing3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他的手續未齊，阻礙了他申請簽證。
examples.english_sentence: His paperwork wasn't complete, which prevented him from applying for the visa.

mandarin_meaning: 隔壁；旁边；（也可作“隔离”表示分开/隔离）
english_meaning: next to; beside; nearby (can also mean to isolate/quarantine in formal contexts)
partOfSpeech_mandarin: 方位詞 / 副詞（有時作動詞，表示隔離）
partOfSpeech_english: locative adverb / preposition (can also be a verb meaning to isolate/quarantine)
explanation_mandarin: 表示在某人或某物的旁邊或鄰近位置（相當於普通話的「隔壁」或「旁邊」）。在一些語境中亦可表示「隔離、隔開」的動詞意思。
explanation_english: Indicates that something is next to or adjacent to something else (equivalent to Mandarin '隔壁' or '旁边'). In some contexts it can also mean to separate or quarantine.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我屋企隔離有間新咖啡店。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 uk1 kei2 gaak3 lei4 jau5 gaan1 san1 kaa1 fe1 dim3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我家隔壁有一家新咖啡店。
examples.english_sentence: There's a new coffee shop next door to my house.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢就住喺隔離。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 zau6 zyu6 hai2 gaak3 lei4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他就住在隔壁。
examples.english_sentence: He lives next door.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 因為有確診個案，嗰座大廈要隔離。
examples.jyutping_sentence: jan1 wai6 jau5 kok3 zing3 go3 on3, go2 zo6 daai6 haa6 jiu3 gaak3 lei4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 因為有確診病例，那栋大楼要隔離（隔离/封鎖）。
examples.english_sentence: Because there are confirmed cases, that building has to be quarantined.

mandarin_meaning: 隔靴搔癢（gé xuē sāo yǎng）：比喻做事方法不對或只觸及表面，不能解決根本問題，徒勞無功。
english_meaning: To scratch an itch through the shoe (idiom): to take ineffective or superficial actions that fail to address the real issue.
explanation_mandarin: 用來形容辦事或解決問題的方法不得要領，只是處理表面現象，無法觸及或解決根本。
explanation_english: Used to describe actions or solutions that miss the point and only deal with surface symptoms, thus failing to solve the underlying problem.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢個解釋完全係隔靴搔癢，根本冇解決問題。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 go3 gaai2 sik1 jyun4 cyun4 hai6 gaak3 wo1 sou1 joeng5, gan1 bun2 mou5 gaai2 kyut3 man6 tai4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他/她的解释完全是隔靴搔痒，根本没有解决问题。
examples.english_sentence: His/her explanation is completely scratching an itch through the shoe; it doesn't solve the problem at all.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 公司淨係做啲表面措施，其實只係隔靴搔癢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gung1 si1 zing6 hai6 zou6 di1 biu2 min6 cou3 si1, kei4 sat6 zi2 hai6 gaak3 wo1 sou1 joeng5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 公司只是做一些表面的措施，其实只是隔靴搔痒。
examples.english_sentence: The company is only taking superficial measures; in fact they're just scratching an itch through the shoe.

mandarin_meaning: 隔音（阻隔或減少聲音傳播的措施或材料）
english_meaning: soundproofing; to soundproof (materials or measures that block or reduce transmission of sound)
explanation_mandarin: 指用來阻隔或減少聲音傳播的材料或處理方法，可指隔音設備、隔音工程或動作（如對房間進行隔音）。常見於建築、室內設計與音響相關領域。
explanation_english: Refers to materials or measures used to block or reduce the transmission of sound. Can be a noun (soundproofing) or a verb (to soundproof). Commonly used in construction, interior design, and audio applications.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢間房隔音幾好，聽唔到隔離單位嘅電視聲。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 gaan1 fong2 gaak3 jam1 gei2 hou2, teng1 m4 dou2 gaak3 lei4 daan1 wai6 ge3 din6 si6 seng1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这间房隔音很好，听不到隔壁单位的电视声。
examples.english_sentence: This room is well soundproofed; you can't hear the neighbor's TV.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我想裝隔音門嚟減少街道噪音。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 soeng2 zong1 gaak3 jam1 mun4 lai4 gaam2 siu2 gaai1 dou6 zou2 jam1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我想装隔音门来减少街道噪音。
examples.english_sentence: I want to install a soundproof door to reduce street noise.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 如果要隔音好一啲，應該喺牆上加隔音材料。
examples.jyutping_sentence: jyu4 gwo2 jiu3 gaak3 jam1 hou2 jat1 di1, jing1 goi1 hai2 coeng4 soeng6 gaa1 gaak3 jam1 coi4 liu6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 如果要让隔音更好，应该在墙上加隔音材料。
examples.english_sentence: If you want better soundproofing, you should add soundproofing materials to the walls.

mandarin_meaning: 隕（yǔn）：坠落、掉落；（多用于陨石、陨落、殒命等）
english_meaning: to fall; to drop; to perish (used in contexts like meteorite falling or someone/something falling/dying)
explanation_mandarin: 表示從高處或天上掉下、墜落，常見於「隕石」、「隕落」、「殞命」等詞語，屬比較書面或書面化的詞彙。
explanation_english: Indicates falling or dropping from a height or the sky; commonly appears in words like '隕石' (meteorite), '隕落' (to fall), '殞命' (to perish). It is relatively formal/literary.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 一塊隕石由天上隕落，擊中咗屋頂。
examples.jyutping_sentence: jat1 faai3 wan5 sek6 jau4 tin1 soeng6 wan5 lok6, gik1 zung6 zo2 uk1 deng2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 一块陨石从天上坠落，击中了屋顶。
examples.english_sentence: A meteorite fell from the sky and struck the roof.

mandarin_meaning: 陨石（從太空落到地球表面的岩石或金屬塊）
english_meaning: meteorite (a rock or metal fragment from space that lands on Earth)
explanation_mandarin: 指從外太空進入大氣層並能夠落到地表的天然岩石或金屬碎片，常用於地質與天文學研究。
explanation_english: Refers to a natural rock or metal fragment from outer space that survives passage through the atmosphere and falls to the Earth's surface; commonly studied in geology and astronomy.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 嗰塊隕石好珍貴，已經捐咗俾博物館。
examples.jyutping_sentence: go2 faai3 wan5 sek6 hou2 zan1 gwai3, ji5 ging1 gyun1 zo2 bei2 bok3 mat6 gun2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 那塊陨石很珍贵，已經捐给博物馆了。
examples.english_sentence: That meteorite is very precious; it has already been donated to the museum.

mandarin_meaning: 陨石坑
english_meaning: meteorite crater; impact crater
explanation_mandarin: 由隕石或其他天體撞擊地表形成的圓形或椭圓形凹陷，常稱為陨石坑或撞擊坑，分布於地球及其他行星、衛星表面。
explanation_english: A circular or elliptical depression on a planetary surface formed by the impact of a meteorite or other celestial body; commonly called a meteorite crater or impact crater and found on Earth and other planets or moons.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 科學家喺沙漠度發現咗一個好大嘅隕石坑。
examples.jyutping_sentence: fo1 hok6 gaa1 hai2 saa1 mok6 dou6 faat3 jin6 zo2 jat1 go3 hou2 daai6 ge3 wan2 sek6 haang1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 科学家在沙漠发现了一个很大的陨石坑。
examples.english_sentence: Scientists discovered a large meteorite crater in the desert.

mandarin_meaning: （陨落）掉落、失去生命或失勢；常用於書面語
english_meaning: to fall; to perish; to fall from power or status; often used in literary/written contexts
explanation_mandarin: 表示從高處掉落或喪失生命、地位等，語氣偏書面或文學性，既可指物體墜落（如隕石），也可指人或勢力的消亡或衰退。
explanation_english: Denotes falling from a height or the loss of life/status. The term is literary/formal and can refer to physical falling (e.g., a meteor) or the demise/decline of a person or power.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 一塊隕石喺夜晚隕落，造成咗好大嘅破壞。
examples.jyutping_sentence: jat1 faai3 wan5 sek6 hai2 je6 maan5 wan5 lok6, zou6 sing4 zo2 hou2 daai6 ge3 po3 waai6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 一塊隕石在夜晚墜落，造成了很大的破壞。
examples.english_sentence: A meteorite fell during the night, causing great damage.

mandarin_meaning: 狭窄；隘口（山口）；引申为狭隘、局促
english_meaning: narrow; narrow pass (mountain pass); figuratively: narrow-minded or cramped
explanation_mandarin: 表示空间狭窄或局促，可指地形上的隘口（山隘、关隘），也可引申表示性格或观点上的狭隘。
explanation_english: Denotes something narrow or cramped; can refer to a geographic narrow pass (mountain pass) and is also used figuratively to mean narrow-minded or limited.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢條路好隘，兩部車過唔到。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 tiu4 lou6 hou2 ngaai3, loeng5 bou6 ce1 gwo3 m4 dou2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这条路很狭窄，两辆车通过不了。
examples.english_sentence: This road is very narrow; two cars can't pass.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢個山隘係古代嘅軍事要衝。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 go3 saan1 ngai3 hai6 gu2 doi6 ge3 gwan1 si6 jiu3 cung1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这个山隘是古代的军事要冲。
examples.english_sentence: This mountain pass was a strategic military point in ancient times.

mandarin_meaning: 裂縫；空隙（拼音：xì）
english_meaning: gap; crack; fissure; a small opening or interval; figuratively, a rift or opportunity
explanation_mandarin: 表示物體上的裂縫或空隙，也可以比喻人與人之間的裂痕、間隔或可利用的空檔。
explanation_english: Refers to a physical crack, fissure, or small space; can also be used figuratively for a rift between people, an interval, or an opportunity.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 牆身有條隙，水會滲入屋企，要快啲補好。
examples.jyutping_sentence: coeng4 san1 jau5 tiu4 gwik1, seoi2 wui5 sam3 jap6 uk1 kei5, jiu3 faai3 di1 bou2 hou2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 牆身有裂縫，水會滲入屋內，應該盡快修補。
examples.english_sentence: There's a crack in the wall; water can seep into the house, so it should be repaired quickly.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋之間出咗隙，大家都唔再信任對方。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 zi1 gaan1 ceot1 zo2 gwik1, daai6 gaa1 dou1 m4 zoi6 seon3 jam6 deoi3 fong1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他們之間出現了裂隙，大家都不再信任對方。
examples.english_sentence: A rift has developed between them; everyone no longer trusts the other party.

mandarin_meaning: 際；（表示邊際、場合、時刻，常用於構詞）
english_meaning: boundary; occasion; time; used in compounds to indicate situation or relationship
partOfSpeech_mandarin: 名詞 / 詞綴（構詞成分）
explanation_mandarin: 「際」可表示邊界或界限，也可用來指場合、時刻，常見於複合詞中（如「交際」、「際遇」）。
explanation_english: The character denotes a boundary or edge and can indicate an occasion or moment. It commonly appears in compound words (e.g., "交際", "際遇") to convey situation, relation, or fate.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢好識同人交際，唔怕生人。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hou2 sik1 tung4 jan4 gaau1 zai3, m4 paa3 saang1 jan4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他很會與人交際，不怕生人。
examples.english_sentence: He is good at socializing with people and isn't afraid of strangers.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢嘅際遇幾波折，但都堅持咗落去。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 ge3 zai3 jyu6 gei2 bo1 zit3, daan6 dou1 gin1 ci4 zo2 lok6 heoi3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他的際遇經歷了許多波折，但還是堅持下去。
examples.english_sentence: His fortunes went through many setbacks, but he still persisted.

mandarin_meaning: 际遇（jìyù）：指一個人一生中遭遇的境遇或命運，常用來描述人生的際遇好壞或坎坷。
english_meaning: Fortunes; fate; the circumstances one encounters in life—often referring to the ups and downs or opportunities and hardships of a person's life.
explanation_mandarin: 「際遇」用來表示一個人在生活中所遇到的境況、遭遇或命運，含有好壞、順逆交替的含義。
explanation_english: Refers to the circumstances or fortunes a person meets in life; carries the sense of varied experiences, including both favorable and adverse events.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢嘅際遇幾坎坷，一路走嚟好唔容易。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 ge3 zai3 jyu6 gei2 ham2 fo2, jat1 lou6 zau2 lai4 hou2 m4 jung4 ji6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他的际遇很坎坷，一路走来很不容易。
examples.english_sentence: His fortunes have been quite rough; it's been hard for him all along.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 人生嘅際遇難以預料，唔好太早放棄希望。
examples.jyutping_sentence: jan4 sang1 ge3 zai3 jyu6 naan4 ji5 jyu6 liu6, m4 hou2 taai3 zou2 fong3 hei3 hei1 mong6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 人生的际遇难以预料，不要太早放弃希望。
examples.english_sentence: Life's fortunes are unpredictable; don't give up hope too soon.

mandarin_meaning: 障（常用於「障礙」）表示阻礙、妨礙或阻塞
english_meaning: barrier; obstacle; impediment
explanation_mandarin: 單字「障」在粵語中讀作 zoeng3，常見於詞語如「障礙」，表示阻礙或妨礙，也用於描述無障礙等情況。
explanation_english: The character '障' is pronounced zoeng3 in Cantonese and commonly appears in compounds like '障礙' (obstacle). It denotes a barrier, obstruction, or impediment and appears in contexts such as 'barrier-free'.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 依家工程未做晒，行人路仲有障礙。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ji1 gaa1 gung1 cing4 mei6 zou6 saai3, hang4 jan4 lou6 zung6 jau5 zoeng3 ngai6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 現在工程還沒完成，人行道上還有障礙物。
examples.english_sentence: The construction isn't finished yet; there are still obstacles on the sidewalk.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢間商場有完善嘅無障礙設施。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 gaan1 soeng1 coeng4 jau5 jyun4 sin6 ge3 mou4 zoeng3 ngai6 cit3 si1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 這間商場有完善的無障礙設施。
examples.english_sentence: This mall has comprehensive barrier-free facilities.

mandarin_meaning: 障碍；阻碍、妨碍，指妨碍进行的事物或困难
english_meaning: obstacle; barrier; hindrance; impediment
explanation_mandarin: 指妨礙事情進行或達成的事物或情況，可指實體的障礙物或抽象的困難與阻礙。
explanation_english: Refers to something that hinders progress or achievement; can mean a physical barrier or an abstract difficulty or impediment.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢個工程有好多障礙，要慢慢解決。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 go3 gung1 cing4 jau5 hou2 do1 zoeng3 ngoi6, jiu3 maan6 maan6 gaai2 kyut3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这个工程有很多障碍，需要慢慢解决。
examples.english_sentence: This project has many obstacles and needs to be dealt with gradually.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 語言障礙令佢好難融入社區。
examples.jyutping_sentence: jyu5 jin4 zoeng3 ngoi6 ling6 keoi5 hou2 naan4 jung4 jap6 se5 keoi1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 语言障碍让他很难融入社区。
examples.english_sentence: Language barriers make it hard for him to integrate into the community.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢因為受傷而有行動障礙，需要拐杖。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 jan1 wai6 sau6 soeng1 ji4 jau5 hang4 dung6 zoeng3 ngoi6, seoi1 jiu3 gwaai2 zoeng6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他因为受伤而有行动障碍，需要拐杖。
examples.english_sentence: He has mobility impairment due to an injury and needs a cane.

mandarin_meaning: 隧（隧道）
english_meaning: tunnel
explanation_mandarin: 表示供車輛或行人通過的地下或穿山的通道，常見於合成詞如「隧道」。單字本身多用於複合詞中。
explanation_english: Refers to an underground or through-the-mountain passage for vehicles or pedestrians; commonly appears in compounds such as "隧道". The character is usually used in compounds.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢條隧道好長，開車要小心。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 tiu4 seoi6 dou6 hou2 coeng4, hoi1 ce1 jiu3 siu2 sam1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这条隧道很长，开车要小心。
examples.english_sentence: This tunnel is very long; be careful when driving.

mandarin_meaning: 隧道巴士；行駛於隧道（尤指過海隧道）的公共巴士
english_meaning: tunnel bus; a public bus that travels through road tunnels (often cross-harbour routes)
explanation_mandarin: 「隧巴」是香港口語，為「隧道巴士」的簡稱，通常指行駛於路面隧道（例如過海隧道）的公共巴士，用以區別其他路線或交通工具。
explanation_english: A Hong Kong colloquial term, short for 'tunnel bus' (隧道巴士). It refers to public buses that run through road tunnels—often cross-harbour routes—and is used to distinguish these services from other bus or rail options.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我通常搭隧巴過海去灣仔，慳時間。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 tung1 soeng4 daap3 seoi6 baa1 gwo3 hoi2 heoi3 waan1 zai2 , haan2 si4 gaan1 .
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我通常坐隧道巴士過海去灣仔，省時間。
examples.english_sentence: I usually take the tunnel bus across the harbour to Wan Chai; it saves time.

mandarin_meaning: 隧道 (suìdào)
english_meaning: tunnel
explanation_mandarin: 指為車輛或行人通行而在地下、山體或其他障礙物內開鑿或建造的通道。
explanation_english: A passageway constructed through or under land, a mountain, or other obstacles for vehicles or pedestrians to pass through.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢條隧道好長，駕車入隧道要減速。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 tiu4 seoi6 dou6 hou2 coeng4, gaa3 ce1 jap6 seoi6 dou6 jiu3 gaam2 cuk1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 這條隧道很長，開車進入要減速。
examples.english_sentence: This tunnel is very long; slow down when driving into it.

mandarin_meaning: 随（suí）：跟随、顺从；随意、随便；表示随着或根据。
english_meaning: to follow; to go along with; to depend on; as one wishes; casual/random
partOfSpeech_mandarin: 动词 / 介词 / 副词
explanation_mandarin: 用来表示跟随、顺从（如“随行”），也可表示随意、不拘束（如“随便”），或表示随着、根据（如“随市场变化”）。
explanation_english: Used to indicate following or going along with something; can also mean casual/as one wishes; or indicate 'along with' or 'depending on'.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你想點做就隨你啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 soeng2 dim2 zou6 zau6 seoi4 nei5 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你想怎么做就随你吧。
examples.english_sentence: Do as you wish.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我隨手關埋燈。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 seoi4 sau2 gwaan1 maai4 dang1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我顺手把灯关上。
examples.english_sentence: I'll turn off the lights as I go.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 價錢會隨市場波動而改變。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gaa3 cin2 wui5 seoi4 si5 coeng4 bo1 dung6 ji4 goi2 bin3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 价格会随市场波动而改变。
examples.english_sentence: Prices will change depending on market fluctuations.

mandarin_meaning: 随之而来
english_meaning: to follow; to come along with; to result as a consequence
explanation_mandarin: 表示某一事件或變化發生後，另一件事作為結果或伴隨情況出現。
