explanation_english: Literally a shirt with lights or LEDs that lights up and is especially eye-catching at night. Colloquially used to describe clothing (or a person's style) that is flashy, gaudy, or attention-seeking.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢件電燈杉好搶眼，夜晚行街好易畀人見到。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 gin6 din6 dang1 saam1 hou2 coeng2 ngaan5, je6 maan5 hang4 gaai1 hou2 ji6 bei2 jan4 gin3 dou2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他的發光衫很搶眼，晚上逛街很容易被人看到。
examples.english_sentence: His light-up shirt is eye-catching; it's easy to be seen when walking around at night.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你咁著電燈杉去公司，會畀人話你太浮誇。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 gam2 zoek3 din6 dang1 saam1 heoi3 gung1 si1, wui5 bei2 jan4 waa6 nei5 taai3 fau4 kwaa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你這樣穿發光衫去公司，會被人說你太浮誇。
examples.english_sentence: If you wear such a flashy light-up shirt to the office, people will say you're too over the top.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 細路最鍾意啲有電燈杉嘅衫或者玩具。
examples.jyutping_sentence: sai3 lou6 zeoi3 zung1 ji3 di1 jau5 din6 dang1 saam1 ge3 saam1 waak6 ze2 waan6 geoi6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 小朋友最喜歡那些有發光設計的衣服或玩具。
examples.english_sentence: Kids love clothes or toys with light-up features the most.

jyutping: din6 dang1 saam1 gwaa3 lou5 syu2 soeng1
mandarin_meaning: 形容穿著或行為花哨、俗氣地炫耀
english_meaning: to dress or behave in a gaudy, tacky way to show off
explanation_mandarin: 用來譏諷或形容某人刻意打扮得很花哨、俗氣，目的是吸引別人注意或炫耀，帶有嘲諷意味。
explanation_english: A colloquial Hong Kong Cantonese phrase used mockingly to describe someone who dresses or acts in an ostentatious, tacky way to attract attention or show off.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢成日著啲電燈杉掛老鼠箱，行出街好搶眼但好俗氣。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 sing4 jat6 zoek3 di1 din6 dang1 saam1 gwaa3 lou5 syu2 soeng1, haang4 ceot1 gaai1 hou2 coeng2 ngaan5 daan6 hou2 zuk6 hei3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他經常穿得很花哨、俗氣地炫耀，出門很搶眼但很俗氣。
examples.english_sentence: He always dresses in a gaudy, tacky way to show off; he stands out on the street but looks vulgar.

jyutping: din6 dang1 cyu5 gwaa3 lou5 syu2 soeng1
mandarin_meaning: 被放鴿子／被放飛機
english_meaning: to be stood up (for a meeting/date); to be left waiting when someone fails to show up
explanation_mandarin: 香港口語俚語，形容約好見面但對方沒有出現或放人鴿子，讓人獨自等待或被耽擱。
explanation_english: A Hong Kong Cantonese slang phrase describing being stood up — arranged to meet someone but they do not turn up, leaving one waiting or abandoned.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 阿明約咗小美出嚟，點知畀人電燈柱掛老鼠箱，等咗半個鐘都冇人。
examples.jyutping_sentence: aa3 ming4 joek3 zo2 siu2 mei5 ceot1 lai4, dim2 zi1 bei2 jan4 din6 dang1 cyu5 gwaa3 lou5 syu2 soeng1, dang2 zo2 bun3 go3 zung1 dou1 mou5 jan4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 阿明約了小美出來，結果被人放鴿子，等了半小時都沒人。
examples.english_sentence: Ming arranged to meet Mei, but she stood him up — he waited half an hour and no one showed.

mandarin_meaning: （電）燈泡
english_meaning: light bulb; electric bulb
explanation_mandarin: 字面指電燈的燈膽（燈泡），是香港廣東話中常用來稱呼燈泡的說法。
explanation_english: Literally 'light bulb'; the common Cantonese term for an electric light bulb.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 屋企個電燈膽壞咗，要換一個。
examples.jyutping_sentence: uk1 kei2 go3 din6 dang1 daam2 waai6 zo2, jiu3 wun6 jat1 go3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 家裡的電燈泡壞了，要換一個。
examples.english_sentence: The light bulb at home is broken; we need to replace it.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 換電燈膽之前記住斷電。
examples.jyutping_sentence: wun6 din6 dang1 daam2 zi1 cin4 gei3 zyu6 dyun6 din6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 換燈泡之前記得先斷電。
examples.english_sentence: Remember to turn off the power before replacing the light bulb.

mandarin_meaning: （日本特攝）假面騎士電王；電王（作品名或角色名）
english_meaning: Kamen Rider Den-O (the Japanese tokusatsu series and its title character)
explanation_mandarin: 「電王」通常指2007年的日本特攝作品《假面騎士電王》或其主角，作品以時空與列車為題材，在華語圈常簡稱為「電王」。
explanation_english: Refers to the 2007 Japanese tokusatsu series 'Kamen Rider Den-O' or its title character. The series centers on time travel and train motifs and is commonly shortened to 'Den‑O' or '電王' in Chinese.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我細個好鍾意睇《假面騎士電王》，電王好型。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 sai3 go3 hou2 zung1 ji3 tai2 gaa2 min6 kei4 si6 din6 wong4, din6 wong4 hou2 jing4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我小時候很喜歡看《假面騎士電王》，電王很帥。
examples.english_sentence: I loved watching Kamen Rider Den‑O when I was a kid — Den‑O is really cool.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢今日著咗電王T恤去派對，好醒目。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 gam1 jat6 zoek3 zo2 din6 wong4 T seot1 heoi3 paai3 deoi6, hou2 sing2 muk6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他今天穿了电王T恤去派对，很醒目。
examples.english_sentence: He wore a Den‑O T‑shirt to the party today — it stood out.

mandarin_meaning: 电疗（電療）：利用電流或電磁刺激治療疾病的醫療方法，亦可指電休克等以電擊為手段的治療
english_meaning: Electrotherapy: medical treatments that use electrical currents or electromagnetic stimulation; can include techniques like TENS or electroconvulsive therapy (ECT)
explanation_mandarin: 電療是指用電流或電刺激作為治療手段的醫療方法，應用範圍包括痛症管理（如經皮電刺激）和某些精神科治療（如電休克／電痙攣療法）。日常口語中有時專指電休克療法。
explanation_english: Electrotherapy refers to medical treatments that use electrical currents or stimulation. It covers a range of applications from pain management (e.g., TENS) to psychiatric treatments such as electroconvulsive therapy (ECT). In everyday speech it may specifically refer to shock therapy.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 醫生話我需要做電療去減輕痛楚。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ji1 sang1 waa6 ngo5 seoi1 jiu3 zou6 din6 liu4 heoi3 gaam2 heng1 tung3 co2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 医生说我需要做电疗来减轻疼痛。
examples.english_sentence: The doctor said I need electrotherapy to relieve the pain.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 電休克喺某啲情況下屬於一種電療，但會有副作用。
examples.jyutping_sentence: din6 jau1 hak1 hai6 mau5 di1 cing4 fong3 haa6 suk6 jyu1 jat1 zung2 din6 liu4, daan6 wui5 jau5 fuk6 zok3 jung6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 电休克在某些情况下属于一种电疗，但会有副作用。
examples.english_sentence: Electroconvulsive therapy (ECT) is a type of electrotherapy in certain cases, but it can have side effects.

mandarin_meaning: 電眼（迷人的眼睛、會放電的眼神）
english_meaning: captivating/seductive eyes; someone with an attractive, 'electric' gaze
explanation_mandarin: 口語俚語，用來形容某人眼神或眼睛非常有魅力，像會 '放電' 一樣讓人心動或被吸引。
explanation_english: Colloquial slang describing eyes or a gaze that are very attractive or seductive, as if 'sending electric sparks' and making others feel attracted.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢有對電眼，好吸引人。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 jau5 deoi3 din6 ngaan5, hou2 kap1jan5 jan4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他/她有一雙迷人的眼睛，很吸引人。
examples.english_sentence: He/She has captivating eyes; very attractive.

mandarin_meaning: 电码
english_meaning: code; cipher; telegraph/electronic code
explanation_mandarin: 用於電訊、電報或數據編碼的符號系統或加密方式，例如摩斯電碼或其他編碼系統。
explanation_english: A system of symbols or encodings used for electronic or telegraphic communication or data encoding/encryption (e.g., Morse code or other coding systems).

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢用咗一套複雜嘅電碼去傳送機密資料。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 jung6 zo2 jat1 tou3 fuk1 zaap6 ge3 din6 maa5 heoi3 cyun4 sung3 gei1 mat6 zi1 liu2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他用了套复杂的电码去传送机密资料。
examples.english_sentence: He used a complex code to transmit confidential data.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 二戰期間，軍隊經常用摩斯電碼通訊。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ji6 zin3 kei4 gaan1, gwan1 deoi3 ging1 soeng4 jung6 mo1 si1 din6 maa5 tung1 seon3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 二战期间，军队经常用摩斯电码通信。
examples.english_sentence: During WWII, armies often used Morse code for communication.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 如果唔識解，呢個電碼幾難破解。
examples.jyutping_sentence: jyu4 gwo2 m4 sik1 gaai2, ni1 go3 din6 maa5 gei2 naan4 pok3 gaai2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 如果不懂解读，这个电码很难破解。
examples.english_sentence: If you don't know how to read it, this code is quite hard to crack.

mandarin_meaning: 电磁（与电和磁相关）
english_meaning: electromagnetic (relating to electricity and magnetism)
partOfSpeech_mandarin: 形容词 / 名词（组合词前缀）
explanation_mandarin: 「電磁」指與電和磁相關的性質或現象，常用作複合詞的前綴，如電磁場、電磁波、電磁技術等。
explanation_english: Refers to properties or phenomena related to electricity and magnetism. Commonly used as a combining form/prefix in compounds such as electromagnetic field, electromagnetic wave, and electromagnetic technology.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢部機器用咗電磁技術嚟運作。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 bou6 gei1 hei3 jung6 zo2 din6 ci4 gei6 seot6 lai4 wan6 zok3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这台机器用了电磁技术来运作。
examples.english_sentence: This machine operates using electromagnetic technology.

mandarin_meaning: 电磁波（由变化的电场和磁场以波的形式传播的现象）
english_meaning: electromagnetic wave
explanation_mandarin: 由变化的电场和磁场相互作用产生并以波的形式传播的能量形式，包含无线电波、微波、红外线、可见光、紫外线、X射线等。
explanation_english: A form of energy propagated as oscillating electric and magnetic fields; includes radio waves, microwaves, infrared, visible light, ultraviolet, X-rays, etc.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 手機會發出電磁波，但一般能量好低，對人體影響仍然有爭議。
examples.jyutping_sentence: sau2 gei1 wui5 faat3 ceot1 din6 ci4 bo1, daan6 jat1 bun1 nang4 loeng6 hou2 dai1, deoi3 jan4 tai2 jing2 hoeng2 jing4 jin4 jau5 zang1 ji3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 手机会发出电磁波，但一般能量很低，对人体的影响仍有争议。
examples.english_sentence: Mobile phones emit electromagnetic waves, but the energy is generally very low and their effect on the human body is still debated.

mandarin_meaning: 电磁炮（利用电磁力发射弹丸的武器）
english_meaning: Railgun; an electromagnetic launcher that uses electromagnetic forces to accelerate and fire projectiles.
explanation_mandarin: 一種通過產生強大電磁力來加速並發射彈丸的裝置或武器，常出現在軍事研究與科幻作品中。
explanation_english: A device or weapon that uses powerful electromagnetic forces to accelerate and launch projectiles; commonly discussed in military research and science fiction.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 科研團隊成功試射咗新型電磁炮。
examples.jyutping_sentence: fo1 jin4 tyun4 deoi2 sing4 gung1 si3 se6 zo2 san1 jing4 din6 ci4 paau3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 科研团队成功试射了新型电磁炮。
examples.english_sentence: The research team successfully test-fired a new model of railgun.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 喺科幻電影入面，電磁炮通常被描繪成強力武器。
examples.jyutping_sentence: hai2 fo1 waan6 din6 jing2 jap6 min6, din6 ci4 paau3 tung1 soeng4 bei6 miu4 kui3 sing4 koeng4 lik6 mou5 hei3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 在科幻電影裡，電磁炮通常被描繪成強大的武器。
examples.english_sentence: In sci-fi movies, railguns are often depicted as powerful weapons.

mandarin_meaning: 电磁炉 (diàn cí lú)
english_meaning: induction cooker; induction stove
explanation_mandarin: 一种利用电磁感应原理将电能直接转化为热能，加热有磁性的锅具以进行烹饪的家用或便携式炉具。
explanation_english: A household or portable cooking appliance that uses electromagnetic induction to directly heat magnetic cookware for cooking.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 屋企冇煤氣爐，淨係得部電磁爐。
examples.jyutping_sentence: uk1 kei5 mou5 mui4 hei3 lou4, zing6 hai6 dak1 bou6 din6 ci4 lou4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们家没有煤气炉，只有一台电磁炉。
examples.english_sentence: We don't have a gas stove at home; we only have an induction cooker.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 用電磁爐煮嘢要用有磁性底嘅鍋。
examples.jyutping_sentence: jung6 din6 ci4 lou4 zyu2 je5 jiu3 jung6 jau5 ci4 sing3 dai2 ge3 wo1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 用电磁炉做饭需要使用底部有磁性的锅。
examples.english_sentence: When using an induction cooker you need cookware with a magnetic base.

mandarin_meaning: 电磁炮（diàncí pào），指利用电磁力发射弹丸的武器或装置，亦常用于科幻或动漫指擁有类似能力的设定（如「超电磁炮」）
english_meaning: electromagnetic cannon / railgun (a weapon or device that uses electromagnetic forces to launch projectiles); also used in fiction/pop culture to name abilities (e.g., 'Railgun')
explanation_mandarin: 電磁砲是指利用電磁力（例如軌道炮或線圈砲概念）將彈丸加速發射的武器或裝置。在小說、動漫中亦常作為超能力或特殊武器的名稱。
explanation_english: A device or weapon that uses electromagnetic forces (e.g., railgun or coilgun concepts) to accelerate and launch projectiles. It is also used in fiction and anime as the name of abilities or special attacks.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 軍方展示咗一門新式電磁砲，射程遠、威力大。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gwan1 fong1 zin2 si6 zo2 jat1 mun4 san1 sik1 din6 ci4 paau3, se3 cing4 jyun5, wai1 lik6 daai6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 军方展示了一门新式的电磁炮，射程远、威力大。
examples.english_sentence: The military displayed a new type of railgun; it has long range and great power.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 喺嗰套動畫入面，主角嘅能力叫電磁砲，可以控制金屬同發出強烈嘅電磁衝擊。
examples.jyutping_sentence: hai2 go2 tou3 dung6 waa6 jap6 min6, zyu2 gok3 ge3 nang4 lik6 giu3 din6 ci4 paau3, ho2 ji5 hung3 zai3 gam1 cuk3 tung4 faat3 ceot1 koeng4 lit6 ge3 din6 ci4 cung1 gik1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 在那部动画里，主角的能力叫做“电磁炮”，可以控制金属并发出强烈的电磁冲击。
examples.english_sentence: In that anime, the protagonist's ability is called a 'railgun'; it can manipulate metal and emit powerful electromagnetic shocks.

mandarin_meaning: 电磁轨道炮（又稱電磁砲）
english_meaning: electromagnetic railgun
explanation_mandarin: 一种利用电磁力沿导轨加速并发射弹丸的武器装置，不使用传统火药推动，而是通过强大的电流在导轨间产生洛伦兹力将弹丸加速到极高速度，常见于科研和军事研制中。
explanation_english: A weapon (railgun) that uses electromagnetic forces to accelerate a projectile along conductive rails. Instead of chemical propellants, strong electric currents create Lorentz forces that propel the projectile to very high velocities; studied for research and military applications.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 軍方話佢哋已經成功試射咗一門電磁軌炮。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gwan1 fong1 waa6 keoi5 dei6 ji5 ging1 sing4 gung1 si3 se6 zo2 jat1 mun4 din6 ci4 gwai2 paau3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 军方称他们已经成功试射了一门电磁轨道炮。
examples.english_sentence: The military said they have successfully test-fired a railgun.

mandarin_meaning: 電磁軌道砲 / 電磁砲（以電磁力發射彈丸的武器）
english_meaning: electromagnetic railgun (a weapon that uses electromagnetic forces to launch projectiles)
explanation_mandarin: 一種利用電磁力（如洛倫茲力）在導軌上加速並發射彈丸的武器，無需傳統化學推進劑，能達到極高的初速與射程。
explanation_english: A weapon that uses electromagnetic forces (e.g., the Lorentz force) to accelerate a projectile along conductive rails; it requires no chemical propellant and can achieve very high muzzle velocities and long range.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 軍方最近測試咗一門新式電磁軌砲，射程好遠。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gwan1 fong1 zeoi3 gan6 cak1 si3 zo2 jat1 mun4 san1 sik1 din6 ci4 gwai2 paau3, se6 cing4 hou2 jyun5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 軍方最近測試了一門新型的電磁軌道砲，射程很遠。
examples.english_sentence: The military recently tested a new-type electromagnetic railgun; its range is very long.

mandarin_meaning: 电磁铁 (diàncítiě)
english_meaning: electromagnet
explanation_mandarin: 由電流產生磁場，能吸引或控制鐵磁性物質的裝置，常用於起重、分離或實驗等場合。
explanation_english: A device that generates a magnetic field when an electric current flows through it, capable of attracting or controlling ferromagnetic materials; commonly used for lifting, separation, or laboratory experiments.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 工廠用電磁鐵吊起鋼板，搬運好方便。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gung1 cong2 jung6 din6 ci4 tit3 diu3 hei2 gong1 baan2, bun1 wan6 hou2 fong1 bin6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 工厂用电磁铁吊起钢板，搬运很方便。
examples.english_sentence: The factory uses an electromagnet to lift steel plates; it's very convenient for transport.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 實驗室用電磁鐵做磁場實驗。
examples.jyutping_sentence: sat6 jim6 sat1 jung6 din6 ci4 tit3 zou6 ci4 coeng4 sat6 jim6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 实验室用电磁铁做磁场实验。
examples.english_sentence: The laboratory uses an electromagnet to perform magnetic field experiments.

mandarin_meaning: 電子競技（簡稱「電競」或「电竞」）
english_meaning: e-sports; electronic sports (competitive video gaming)
explanation_mandarin: 指以電子遊戲為比賽項目、由選手或隊伍進行的競技活動，包含職業比賽、聯賽與線上對戰等形式。
explanation_english: Refers to competitive gaming using video games as the contest—players or teams compete in tournaments, leagues, and online matches; includes professional e-sports.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我成日打電競，準備參加比賽。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 sing4 jat6 daa2 din6 ging3, zeon2 bei6 caam1 gaa1 bei2 coi3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我經常打電競，準備參加比賽。
examples.english_sentence: I often play e-sports and I'm preparing to enter a competition.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 台上的電競選手好緊張。
examples.jyutping_sentence: toi4 soeng6 dik1 din6 ging3 syun2 sau2 hou2 gan2 zoeng1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 台上的電競選手很緊張。
examples.english_sentence: The e-sports player on stage was very nervous.

mandarin_meaning: 手电筒
english_meaning: flashlight; torch
explanation_mandarin: 指便攜式的照明工具，通常由電池或可充電電池供電，用來在黑暗環境中照明。
explanation_english: A portable handheld electric light, typically powered by batteries or a rechargeable cell, used for illumination in dark places.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 夜晚行山記得帶埋個電筒。
examples.jyutping_sentence: je6 maan5 hang4 saan1 gei3 dak1 daai3 maai4 go3 din6 tung4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 晚上爬山記得帶上手電筒。
examples.english_sentence: Remember to bring a flashlight when hiking at night.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 今朝停電，冇燈，攞支電筒啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gam1 ziu1 ting4 din6, mou5 dang1, lo2 zi1 din6 tung4 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 今天早上停電，沒燈了，拿手電筒吧。
examples.english_sentence: The power went out this morning and there's no light—take a flashlight.

mandarin_meaning: 电箱 / 配电箱
english_meaning: electrical box; distribution box; junction box
explanation_mandarin: 指放置电力设备（如断路器、保险丝、配电盘等）的金属或塑料箱，用于配电、保护和线路连接。可指室内楼宇内的电箱，也可指街道或小区内的户外配电箱或电力箱。
explanation_english: A metal or plastic box housing electrical equipment (breakers, fuses, distribution panels, etc.) used for distributing and protecting electrical circuits. Can refer to indoor building boxes or outdoor street/utility boxes.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 個電箱壞咗，要叫師傅嚟修。
examples.jyutping_sentence: go3 din6 soeng1 waai6 zo2, jiu3 giu3 si1 fu1 lai4 sau1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 电箱坏了，要叫师傅来修。
examples.english_sentence: The electrical box is broken; we need to call a technician to fix it.

mandarin_meaning: （口語縮略）電吉他
english_meaning: electric guitar (colloquial/abbreviated)
explanation_mandarin: 「電結」為口語縮略，通常指「電結他」或「電吉他」，即電聲吉他。此用法較常見於香港或粵語口語中。
explanation_english: A colloquial abbreviation for "electric guitar" (電結他 / 電吉他). This usage is common in Hong Kong Cantonese speech.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我買咗把電結，今晚就試下彈。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 maai5 zo2 baa2 din6 git3, gam1 maan5 zau6 si3 haa5 taan4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我买了一把电吉他，今晚就试着弹。
examples.english_sentence: I bought an electric guitar; I'll try playing it tonight.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢係我哋樂隊嘅電結手。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hai6 ngo5 dei6 ngok6 deoi6 ge3 din6 git3 sau2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他是我们乐队的电吉他手。
examples.english_sentence: He's the electric guitarist in our band.

mandarin_meaning: 电吉他
english_meaning: electric guitar
explanation_mandarin: 一種利用拾音器和電子放大裝置將弦振動轉換並放大的吉他，常見於搖滾、流行等音樂風格。
explanation_english: A type of guitar that uses pickups and electronic amplification to convert and amplify string vibrations; commonly used in rock, pop, and other music styles.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢喺樂隊入面彈電結他。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hai2 ngok6 deoi6 jap6 min6 taan4 din6 git3 taa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他在樂隊裡彈電吉他。
examples.english_sentence: He plays the electric guitar in the band.

mandarin_meaning: 电工胶带；绝缘胶带
english_meaning: electrical tape; insulating tape
explanation_mandarin: 用来包裹电线、提供绝缘与保护的胶带，通常为PVC等绝缘材料制成，常用于修补或固定电线和电器接头。
explanation_english: Adhesive tape used to wrap electrical wires to provide insulation and protection, typically made of PVC or similar insulating material; commonly used to repair or secure wiring and electrical connections.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢條燈線外面嘅膠皮裂咗，快啲用電綫膠布包返好先。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 tiu4 dang1 sin3 ngoi6 min6 ge3 gaau1 pei4 lit6 zo2, faai3 di1 jung6 din6 sin3 gaau1 bou3 baau1 faan1 hou2 sin1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这条灯线外面的塑料皮裂了，快点用电工胶带包好。
examples.english_sentence: The insulation on this light's wire is cracked; quickly wrap it with electrical tape.

mandarin_meaning: 电工胶带；电气绝缘胶带
english_meaning: electrical tape; insulating tape
explanation_mandarin: 指用於包裹電線以做絕緣、防水或固定用途的膠帶，常見於家居維修或電工施工。
explanation_english: Adhesive tape used to wrap wires for insulation, waterproofing, or securing; commonly used in household repairs and electrical work.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 條延長線嘅電線露咗芯，快啲用電綫膠紙包返先啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: tiu4 jin4 coeng4 sin3 ge3 din6 sin3 lou6 zo2 sam1, faai3 di1 jung6 din6 sin3 gaau1 zi2 baau1 faan1 sin1 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 延长线的电线露了芯，快点用电工胶带包起来。
examples.english_sentence: The extension cord's wire is exposed; quickly wrap it with electrical tape.

mandarin_meaning: 电网（diànwǎng）
english_meaning: power grid; electrical grid
explanation_mandarin: 指供應電力的網絡系統，通常包含發電、輸電與配電等構成的整體電力網絡。
explanation_english: Refers to the network system that supplies electricity, typically including generation, transmission, and distribution components of the overall power system.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 颱風吹壞咗電網，成個區冇電。
examples.jyutping_sentence: toi4 fung1 ceoi1 waai6 zo2 din6 mong5, seng4 go3 keoi1 mou5 din6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 台风吹坏了电网，整个地区停电。
examples.english_sentence: The typhoon damaged the power grid, leaving the entire district without electricity.

mandarin_meaning: 电线 (diànxiàn)
english_meaning: electric wire; power line; electrical cable
explanation_mandarin: 用于传输电力或电信号的导线，常见于建筑物内外或电力线路，用以输送电能或连接电器。
explanation_english: Conductive wire used to transmit electricity or electrical signals, commonly found in buildings or on power lines to supply power or connect electrical devices.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢條電線好危險，唔好亂摸。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 tiu4 din6 sin3 hou2 ngai4him2, m4 hou2 lyun6 mo1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这根电线很危险，别乱摸。
examples.english_sentence: This electrical wire is dangerous; don't touch it.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 颱風過後，電線斷咗，成條街冇電。
examples.jyutping_sentence: toi4 fung1 gwo3 hau6, din6 sin3 dyun6 zo2, sing4 tiu4 gaai1 mou5 din6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 台风过后，电线断了，整条街没电了。
examples.english_sentence: After the typhoon, the power lines were cut and the whole street lost electricity.

mandarin_meaning: 電工膠帶；絕緣膠布
english_meaning: electrical tape; insulating tape
explanation_mandarin: 用於包裹電線或接點以絕緣、防水或固定的膠布，常見於電氣維修和家居修理中。
explanation_english: A pressure-sensitive adhesive tape used to insulate, protect, or secure electrical wires and connections; commonly used in electrical work and household repairs.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 電視後面啲電線散晒，我用電線膠布包返好啲。
examples.jyutping_sentence: din6 si6 hau6 min6 di1 din6 sin3 saan3 saai3, ngo5 jung6 din6 sin3 gaau1 bou3 baau1 faan1 hou2 di1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 電視後面的電線都鬆掉了，我用電工膠帶包好一些。
examples.english_sentence: The wires behind the TV came loose; I wrapped them with electrical tape to secure them.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 買啲電線膠布嚟修理電扇嘅線。
examples.jyutping_sentence: maai5 di1 din6 sin3 gaau1 bou3 lei4 sau1 lei5 din6 syun3 ge3 sin3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 買一些電工膠帶來修理電扇的電線。
examples.english_sentence: Buy some electrical tape to fix the fan's wiring.

mandarin_meaning: 电线胶带 / 电工胶带
english_meaning: electrical tape (insulating tape for wires)
explanation_mandarin: 用于包裹、绝缘或固定电线的胶带，通常由PVC等绝缘材料制成，有多种颜色以便标示或区分用途。
explanation_english: A tape used to wrap, insulate, or secure electrical wires; typically made from PVC or similar insulating materials and available in various colors for identification or protection.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你記唔記得買電線膠紙？
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 gei3 m4 gei3 dak1 maai5 din6 sin3 gaau1 zi2?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你记得买电线胶带吗？
examples.english_sentence: Do you remember to buy electrical tape?

examples.cantonese_sentence: 抽屜入面有一卷黑色電線膠紙。
examples.jyutping_sentence: cau1 tai3 jap6 min6 jau5 jat1 gyun2 hak1 sik1 din6 sin3 gaau1 zi2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 抽屉里面有一卷黑色电线胶带。
examples.english_sentence: There's a roll of black electrical tape in the drawer.

mandarin_meaning: 电缆 (diànlǎn)
english_meaning: electric cable; power cable
explanation_mandarin: 指用於輸送電能的絕緣導線及護套等組合，用於電力傳輸和配電系統。
explanation_english: A set of insulated conductors and protective sheathing used to transmit electrical power, commonly used in power transmission and distribution systems.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 條電纜斷咗，成個街區停電。
examples.jyutping_sentence: tiu4 din6 laam5 dyun6 zo2, sing4 go3 gaai1 keoi1 ting4 din6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 电缆断了，整个街区停电。
examples.english_sentence: The cable snapped and the whole neighborhood lost power.

mandarin_meaning: 打電話聯繫；電話聯絡
english_meaning: to contact (someone) by phone; to call
explanation_mandarin: 口語或書面語中常用的詞，指通過電話與對方聯繫或通知對方。
explanation_english: A neutral term meaning to get in touch with or notify someone by telephone.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你可唔可以今晚電聯我？
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 ho2 m4 ho2 ji5 gam1 maan5 din6 lyun4 ngo5?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你今晚可以打電話聯絡我嗎？
examples.english_sentence: Can you call me tonight?

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我會遲啲電聯公司確認細節。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 wui5 ci4 di1 din6 lyun4 gung1 si1 kok3 jing6 sai3 zit3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我會稍後打電話聯絡公司確認細節。
examples.english_sentence: I'll call the company later to confirm the details.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 等陣有消息我會電聯你。
examples.jyutping_sentence: dang2 zan6 jau5 siu1 sik1 ngo5 wui5 din6 lyun4 nei5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 有消息的話我會打電話聯絡你。
examples.english_sentence: I'll call you if there's any news.

mandarin_meaning: 电能
english_meaning: electrical energy
explanation_mandarin: 指以電的形式存在或傳輸的能量，常用於描述發電、儲能與消耗等過程。
explanation_english: Energy in the form of electricity; commonly used to describe generation, storage, transmission, and consumption of electrical energy.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢度嘅電能主要來自天然氣發電廠。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 dou6 ge3 din6 nang4 zyu2 jiu3 loi4 zi6 tin1 jin4 hei3 fat3 din6 cong4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这里的电能主要来自天然气发电厂。
examples.english_sentence: The electrical energy here mainly comes from a natural gas power plant.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 如果想保存電能，可以用蓄電池儲存。
examples.jyutping_sentence: jyu4 gwo2 soeng2 bou2 cyun4 din6 nang4, ho2 ji5 jung6 zuk6 din6 ci4 co5 cyun4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 如果想保存电能，可以用蓄电池储存。
examples.english_sentence: If you want to store electrical energy, you can use batteries.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 電能可以轉換成光能或者熱能。
examples.jyutping_sentence: din6 nang4 ho2 ji5 zyun2 wun6 sing4 gwong1 nang4 waak6 ze2 jit6 nang4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 电能可以转化成光能或者热能。
examples.english_sentence: Electrical energy can be converted into light energy or thermal energy.

mandarin_meaning: 电脑 (diànnǎo)
english_meaning: computer
explanation_mandarin: 指能進行資料處理和運算的電子裝置或系統，通常指個人電腦、伺服器或工作站等。
explanation_english: An electronic device or system that processes data and performs computations, typically referring to personal computers, servers, or workstations.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我啱啱買咗部新電腦，用嚟做設計同埋打機。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 ngaam1 ngaam1 maai5 zo2 bou6 san1 din6 nou5, jung6 lai4 zou6 cit3 gai3 tung4 maai4 daa2 gei1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我刚刚买了台新电脑，用来做设计和打游戏。
examples.english_sentence: I just bought a new computer to do design work and play games.

mandarin_meaning: 电脑钥匙 / 密钥（用于解锁电脑或做软件授权/加密的凭证，可指密码、加密密钥或硬件加密狗）
english_meaning: computer key / cryptographic key (a credential used to unlock a computer or for software licensing/encryption; can be a password, cryptographic key, or hardware dongle)
explanation_mandarin: 指用來解鎖電腦或作軟件授權、加密用途的「鑰匙」或憑證，範圍包括密碼、加密密鑰或硬件加密狗等。屬於科技/資訊領域用語，日常也可口語化稱呼授權裝置或密鑰為「電腦匙」。
explanation_english: Refers to a 'key' or credential used to unlock a computer or for software licensing/encryption. This can mean a password, a cryptographic key, or a hardware dongle. It's a technology/information-security term and may be used colloquially to refer to licensing devices or keys.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我唔見咗個電腦匙，入唔到公司網絡。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 m4 gin3 zo2 go3 din6 nou5 si4, jap6 m4 dou2 gung1 si1 mong5 lok3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我不見了電腦鑰匙，進不了公司網絡。
examples.english_sentence: I lost the computer key and can't access the company's network.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢個軟件要有電腦匙先用得，冇嘅話要買授權。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 go3 jyun5 gin6 jiu3 jau5 din6 nou5 si4 sin1 jung6 dak1, mou5 ge3 waa6 jiu3 maai5 sau6 kyun4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 這個軟件需要電腦鑰匙才能使用，沒有的話要購買授權。
examples.english_sentence: This software requires a computer key to run; without one you need to buy a license.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 公司俾我一個加密狗當電腦匙，用嚟登入系統。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gung1 si1 bei2 ngo5 jat1 go3 gaa1 mat6 gau2 dong3 din6 nou5 si4, jung6 lai4 dang1 jap6 hai6 tung2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 公司給了我一個加密狗當作電腦鑰匙，用來登入系統。
examples.english_sentence: The company gave me a dongle as a computer key to log into the system.

mandarin_meaning: 電腦周邊（電腦周邊設備）
english_meaning: computer peripherals; computer accessories
explanation_mandarin: 指與電腦連接或配合使用的外部設備或配件，如滑鼠、鍵盤、打印機、顯示器等。
explanation_english: Refers to external devices or accessories connected to or used with a computer, such as a mouse, keyboard, printer, monitor, etc.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我想買啲電腦周邊，例如滑鼠同鍵盤。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 soeng2 maai5 di1 din6 nou5 zau1 bin1, lai6 jyu4 waat6 syu2 tung4 gin6 pun4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我想買一些電腦周邊，例如滑鼠和鍵盤。
examples.english_sentence: I want to buy some computer peripherals, such as a mouse and keyboard.

mandarin_meaning: 电脑扫描；用电脑或扫描仪将图像或文件数字化；在医疗上也可指电脑断层扫描（CT）。
english_meaning: computer scan; scanning performed by a computer or scanner to digitize images or documents; in medical contexts can refer to a computed tomography (CT) scan.
partOfSpeech_mandarin: 名词 / 动词短语（视语境而定）
explanation_mandarin: 指使用电脑或扫描仪将实体文件、图片或影像转换为数字档案；在医学语境下常为电脑断层扫描（CT）的简称或泛称。
explanation_english: Refers to using a computer or scanner to convert physical documents, pictures, or images into digital files; in medical contexts it is often shorthand for a computed tomography (CT) scan.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋要把啲文件用電腦掃描儲存起嚟。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 jiu3 baa2 di1 man4 gin6 jung6 din6 nou5 sou3 miu4 co5 cyun4 hei2 lai4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们要把这些文件用电脑扫描保存起来。
examples.english_sentence: We need to scan these documents with a computer/scanner and save them.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 醫生話要做個電腦掃描睇下情況。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ji1 sang1 waa6 jiu3 zou6 go3 din6 nou5 sou3 miu4 tai2 haa5 cing4 fong3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 医生说要做个电脑扫描看看情况（即电脑断层扫描/CT）。
examples.english_sentence: The doctor says we need to do a computer scan (a CT scan) to check the condition.

mandarin_meaning: 電腦桌
english_meaning: computer desk
explanation_mandarin: 指用來放置電腦及相關設備的桌子，通常會有線材管理、抽屜或置物架等設計。
explanation_english: A desk used to hold a computer and related equipment, often featuring cable management, drawers, or shelves.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我想買張新嘅電腦枱，因為我啲線太亂。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 soeng2 maai5 zoeng1 san1 ge3 din6 nou5 toi4, jan1 wai6 ngo5 di1 sin3 taai3 lyun6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我想買張新的電腦桌，因為我的線太亂了。
examples.english_sentence: I want to buy a new computer desk because my cables are too messy.

mandarin_meaning: 电脑病毒 (diànnǎo bìngdú)
english_meaning: computer virus
explanation_mandarin: 一種能夠自我複製並感染電腦系統或文件的惡意程式，可能會破壞資料、竊取資訊或令系統失效。
explanation_english: A malicious program that can replicate itself and infect computer systems or files; it can corrupt data, steal information, or cause systems to malfunction.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我部電腦中咗病毒，要送去維修。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 bou6 din6 nou5 zung1 zo2 beng6 duk6, jiu3 sung3 heoi3 wai4 sau1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我的電腦中了病毒，要送去維修。
examples.english_sentence: My computer got a virus and needs to be sent for repair.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好亂開啲可疑嘅電郵附件，可能係電腦病毒。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 lyun6 hoi1 di1 ho2 ji4 ge3 din6 jau4 fu6 gin6, ho2 nang4 hai6 din6 nou5 beng6 duk6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 不要亂開可疑的電子郵件附件，可能是電腦病毒。
examples.english_sentence: Don't open suspicious email attachments; they might be computer viruses.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 防病毒軟件可以幫你掃描並清除電腦病毒。
examples.jyutping_sentence: fong4 beng6 duk6 jyun5 gin6 ho2 ji5 bong1 nei5 sou3 miu4 bing6 cing1 ceoi4 din6 nou5 beng6 duk6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 防病毒軟體可以幫你掃描並清除電腦病毒。
examples.english_sentence: Antivirus software can help scan for and remove computer viruses.

mandarin_meaning: 电脑白痴 / 电脑盲（不会用电脑或对电脑非常不懂的人）
english_meaning: computer idiot; someone who is clueless about computers or very bad at using them
explanation_mandarin: 口語用法，指對電腦完全不懂或操作能力很差的人，可作貶義或自嘲用。
explanation_english: A colloquial term referring to a person who is completely clueless about computers or very poor at using them; can be used derogatorily or self-deprecatingly.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我係電腦白痴，連最基本嘅電郵都唔識用。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 hai6 din6 nou5 baak6 ci1, lin4 zeoi3 gei1 bun2 ge3 din6 jau4 dou1 m4 sik1 jung6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我是电脑白痴，连最基本的电邮都不会用。
examples.english_sentence: I'm a computer idiot — I can't even use basic email.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好笑佢哋係電腦白痴，教下佢就得。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 siu3 keoi5 dei6 hai6 din6 nou5 baak6 ci1, gaau3 haa6 keoi5 zau6 dak1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 不要嘲笑他们是电脑白痴，教一下就行了。
examples.english_sentence: Don't laugh at them for being computer-illiterate; just teach them.

mandarin_meaning: 电脑白痴 / 电脑盲（对电脑非常不懂或不会使用的人）
english_meaning: computer idiot; someone who is very bad with computers or computer-illiterate
explanation_mandarin: 粤语俚语，用来形容对电脑完全不懂或不会使用的人，既可自嘲也可带有贬义。
explanation_english: A Cantonese slang term used to describe someone who is completely inept with computers. It can be used self-deprecatingly or insultingly.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我係電腦白癡，連基本嘅操作都唔識。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 hai6 din6 nou5 baak6 ci1, lin4 gei1 bun2 ge3 cou3 zok3 dou1 m4 sik1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我是一個電腦白痴，連基本操作都不會。
examples.english_sentence: I'm a computer idiot; I don't even know the basic operations.

mandarin_meaning: 电脑程序；计算机程序
english_meaning: computer program; a set of instructions that tells a computer how to perform tasks
explanation_mandarin: 指一组由程序设计语言编写的指令，用来让计算机执行特定任务或功能。
explanation_english: A collection of coded instructions written in a programming language that directs a computer to perform specific tasks or functions.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我寫咗一個電腦程式，可以自動整理資料。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 se2 zo2 jat1 go3 din6 nou5 cing4 sik1, ho2 ji5 zi6 dung6 zing2 lei5 zi1 liu2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我写了一个电脑程序，可以自动整理资料。
examples.english_sentence: I wrote a computer program that can automatically organize data.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢個電腦程式有錯，要除錯先可以用。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 go3 din6 nou5 cing4 sik1 jau5 co3, jiu3 ceoi4 co3 sin1 ho2 ji5 jung6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这个电脑程序有错误，要先除错才能使用。
examples.english_sentence: This computer program has bugs; it needs to be debugged before it can be used.

mandarin_meaning: 电动船；以电力为动力的船只
english_meaning: electric boat; a boat powered by electricity (battery, shore power, or fuel cell)
explanation_mandarin: 指以電力（如電池或燃料電池）作為推進動力的船隻，常見於渡輪、觀光船或短途接駁船，優點是噪音低、排放少。
explanation_english: Refers to a boat propelled by electric power (batteries, fuel cells, or shore power). Commonly used for ferries, sightseeing boats, or short-distance shuttles; advantages include lower noise and reduced emissions.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋下星期坐電船去長洲，聽講又寧靜又環保。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 haa6 sing1 kei4 co5 din6 syun4 heoi3 coeng4 zau1, teng1 gong2 jau6 ning4 zing6 jau6 waan4 bou2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们下星期乘电船去长洲，听说又安静又环保。
examples.english_sentence: We're taking an electric boat to Cheung Chau next week; I heard it's quiet and eco-friendly.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 市政府計劃用電船替換部分柴油渡輪以減低污染。
examples.jyutping_sentence: si5 zing3 fu2 gai3 waak6 jung6 din6 syun4 tai3 wun6 bou6 fan6 ci3 jau4 dou6 leon4 ji5 gaam2 dai1 wuai6 jim2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 市政府计划用电船替换部分柴油渡轮以降低污染。
examples.english_sentence: The city government plans to replace some diesel ferries with electric boats to reduce pollution.

mandarin_meaning: 电芯 (电池内部的电化学单元)
english_meaning: battery cell; the electrochemical unit inside a battery
explanation_mandarin: 指電池內部的電化學單元，負責儲存和釋放電能，是電池的基本組成部分。
explanation_english: Refers to the electrochemical unit inside a battery responsible for storing and releasing electrical energy; the basic building block of a battery.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 部手機嘅電芯老化，要換新電池。
examples.jyutping_sentence: bou6 sau2 gei1 ge3 din6 sam1 lou5 faa3, jiu3 wun6 san1 din6 ci4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 手机的电芯老化了，需要更换新电池。
examples.english_sentence: The phone's battery cell has aged and needs a new battery.

mandarin_meaning: 电荷 (diànhé)
english_meaning: electric charge
explanation_mandarin: 電荷是物體或粒子所帶的電性量，可為正電荷或負電荷，影響電磁相互作用。
explanation_english: Electric charge is a property of matter carried by particles or objects, which can be positive or negative and governs electromagnetic interactions.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 電子帶負電荷，質子帶正電荷。
examples.jyutping_sentence: din6 zi2 daai3 fu6 din6 ho4, zat1 zi2 daai3 zing3 din6 ho4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 电子带负电荷，质子带正电荷。
examples.english_sentence: Electrons carry negative electric charge, and protons carry positive electric charge.

mandarin_meaning: 电蒸炉
english_meaning: electric steamer (kitchen appliance for steaming food)
explanation_mandarin: 一种厨房电器，利用电力产生蒸汽或以电热元件加热来蒸煮食物，常用于蒸包点心、蔬菜和鱼类。
explanation_english: A kitchen appliance that uses electricity to generate steam (or direct electric heating) to cook or steam food; commonly used for steaming dim sum, vegetables, and fish.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我新買咗部電蒸爐，今個週末用嚟蒸餸。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 san1 maai5 zo2 bou6 din6 zing1 lou4, gam1 go3 zau1 mut6 jung6 lai4 zing1 sung3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我新买了一个电蒸炉，这个周末用来蒸菜。
examples.english_sentence: I just bought a new electric steamer; I'll use it to steam dishes this weekend.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢部電蒸爐可以一次過蒸兩層齊全嘅點心。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 bou6 din6 zing1 lou4 ho2 ji5 jat1 ci3 gwo3 zing1 loeng5 cang4 cai4 cyun4 ge3 dim2 sam1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这台电蒸炉可以一次蒸两层齐全的点心。
examples.english_sentence: This electric steamer can steam two full layers of dim sum at once.

mandarin_meaning: 电蒸笼 (厨房电器，用电产生蒸汽蒸食物)
english_meaning: electric steamer (kitchen appliance that steams food using electricity)
explanation_mandarin: 指一種廚房電器，利用電力加熱產生蒸汽來蒸煮食物，功能類似傳統蒸籠或電蒸鍋，適合蒸菜、包點等。
explanation_english: A kitchen appliance that uses electricity to generate steam for cooking food. It functions like a traditional steamer or electric steam pot and is used for steaming vegetables, dim sum, and other dishes.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我喺屋企買咗個新電蒸籠，蒸餸方便好多。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 hai2 uk1 kei2 maai5 zo2 go3 san1 din6 zing1 lung4, zing1 sung3 fong1 bin6 hou2 do1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我在家買了一個新的電蒸籠，蒸菜方便多了。
examples.english_sentence: I bought a new electric steamer for my home; steaming dishes is much more convenient.

mandarin_meaning: 电蒸锅 (电动蒸锅，用於蒸食物的厨房电器)
english_meaning: electric steamer (an electric appliance used for steaming food)
explanation_mandarin: 一种家用电器，用蒸汽来蒸煮食物，如蒸饭、蒸菜或包子，操作方便且常有多种预设模式。
explanation_english: A household electric appliance that uses steam to cook food (e.g., rice, vegetables, buns). It is convenient to use and often has multiple preset modes.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我買咗部新嘅電蒸鍋，用嚟蒸飯同蒸菜。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 maai5 zo2 bou6 san1 ge3 din6 zeng1 wo1, jung6 lai4 zeng1 faan6 tung4 zeng1 coi3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我买了台新的电蒸锅，用来蒸饭和蒸菜。
examples.english_sentence: I bought a new electric steamer to steam rice and vegetables.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢部電蒸鍋有幾個預設模式，好易用。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 bou6 din6 zeng1 wo1 jau5 gei2 go3 jyu6 cit3 mou6 sik1, hou2 ji6 jung6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这台电蒸锅有几个预设模式，很容易使用。
examples.english_sentence: This electric steamer has several preset modes and is easy to use.

mandarin_meaning: 电蚊拍（电击式灭蚊拍）
english_meaning: electric mosquito swatter (electric flyswatter / electric racket)
explanation_mandarin: 一種用高壓電網拍打並電擊蚊蟲的家用裝置，常用於室內或戶外驅蚊。
explanation_english: A household device with an electrified mesh used to swat and electrocute mosquitoes and other flying insects; commonly used indoors or outdoors to kill insects.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 夏天屋企蚊好多，我買咗部電蚊拍。
examples.jyutping_sentence: haa6 tin1 uk1 kei2 man1 hou2 do1, ngo5 maai5 zo2 bou6 din6 mun4 paak3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 夏天家裡蚊子很多，我買了一個電蚊拍。
examples.english_sentence: There are a lot of mosquitoes at home in summer, so I bought an electric mosquito swatter.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好畀細路仔玩電蚊拍，好危險。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 bei2 sai3 lou6 zai2 waan2 din6 mun4 paak3, hou2 ngai4 him2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 不要讓小孩子玩電蚊拍，很危險。
examples.english_sentence: Don't let children play with the electric mosquito swatter; it's dangerous.

mandarin_meaning: 电视
english_meaning: television; TV
explanation_mandarin: 指用來接收或播放影像和聲音節目的電子設備或媒體（例如電視機或電視節目）。
explanation_english: Refers to the electronic device or medium used to receive or broadcast video and audio programs (e.g., a television set or TV programs).

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我今晚想睇電視。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 gam1 maan5 soeng2 tai2 din6 si6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我今晚想看电视。
examples.english_sentence: I want to watch TV tonight.

mandarin_meaning: 电视剧
english_meaning: television drama; TV series; TV show
explanation_mandarin: 指在電視上播放的戲劇性節目，通常由多集組成，講述一系列人物和連貫的故事情節。
explanation_english: A drama program broadcast on television, typically made up of multiple episodes that follow a continuous or related storyline.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你有冇睇過嗰套新嘅電視劇？
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 jau5 mou5 tai2 gwo3 go2 tou3 san1 ge3 din6 si6 kek6?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你有沒有看過那部新的電視劇？
examples.english_sentence: Have you watched that new TV drama?

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢套電視劇每晚八點播出。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 tou3 din6 si6 kek6 mui5 maan5 baat3 dim2 bo3 ceot1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 這部電視劇每晚八點播出。
examples.english_sentence: This TV series airs at 8 PM every night.

mandarin_meaning: 電視台
english_meaning: television station; TV station
explanation_mandarin: 指負責製作或播送電視節目的機構或台站。
explanation_english: An organization or station that produces and broadcasts television programs.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 嗰間電視台今晚有直播足球比賽。
examples.jyutping_sentence: go2 gaan1 din6 si6 toi4 gam1 maan5 jau5 zik6 bo3 zuk1 kau4 bei2 coi3。
examples.mandarin_sentence: 那家電視台今晚有直播足球比賽。
examples.english_sentence: That TV station has a live broadcast of a soccer match tonight.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 電視台已經通知我哋改期拍攝節目。
examples.jyutping_sentence: din6 si6 toi4 ji5 ging1 tung1 zi1 ngo5 dei6 goi2 kei4 paak3 sip3 zit3 muk6。
examples.mandarin_sentence: 電視台已經通知我們把節目改期拍攝。
examples.english_sentence: The TV station has already informed us to reschedule the program's filming.

mandarin_meaning: 電視的邊框（外框、顯示器的邊緣）
english_meaning: TV frame; television bezel (the border or bezel around a TV screen)
explanation_mandarin: 指電視機或顯示器周圍的邊框或外殼邊緣（bezel），有時也用來指畫面四周的框線或邊緣。
explanation_english: Refers to the border or bezel around a television or monitor (the outer frame around the screen). Can also be used to refer to the framing around the picture.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢部電視嘅電視框有啲刮花，睇落唔靚。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 bou6 din6 si6 ge3 din6 si6 kwong1 jau5 di1 gwaat3 faa1, tai2 lok6 m4 leng3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 這台電視的邊框有些刮痕，看起來不漂亮。
examples.english_sentence: The bezel/frame of this TV has some scratches; it doesn't look nice.

mandarin_meaning: 电视机
english_meaning: television; TV set
explanation_mandarin: 指用來接收並播放電視節目的家用電子裝置，即電視機（TV）。
explanation_english: A household electronic device that receives and displays television broadcasts; a television set.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我屋企部電視機壞咗，要唔要搵人嚟修理？
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 uk1 kei2 bou6 din6 si6 gei1 waai6 zo2, jiu3 m4 jiu3 wan2 jan4 lai4 sau1 lei5?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我家的电视机坏了，要不要找人来修理？
examples.english_sentence: My TV at home is broken — should I get someone to fix it?

mandarin_meaning: 靠電視吃飯 / 靠上電視賺錢
english_meaning: to make a living from television; to rely on TV appearances/work to earn money
explanation_mandarin: 廣東話俚語，字面上是「用電視的汁拌飯」，引申為靠電視曝光或電視工作來賺錢或維生，語氣有時帶輕蔑或貶義，暗示依靠表面光環或炒作而非實質本領。
explanation_english: A Cantonese slang phrase literally meaning "TV sauce over rice." It refers to making a living from television—relying on TV appearances or TV-related work to earn money. It can carry a slightly derogatory tone, implying dependence on exposure or hype rather than substantive skills.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢而家淨係靠電視汁撈飯，唔使再做其他嘢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 ji4 gaa1 zing6 hai6 kaau3 din6 si6 zap1 laau1 faan6, m4 sai2 zoi3 zou6 kei4 taa1 je5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他現在只靠上電視賺錢，不用再做其他事。
examples.english_sentence: He now only makes a living from TV; he doesn't need to do anything else.

mandarin_meaning: 一邊看電視一邊吃飯（俗語／俚語）
english_meaning: to eat while watching TV (colloquial/slang)
explanation_mandarin: 俗語/口語用法，指在吃飯時同時看電視。通常用來描述把電視當作用餐時的背景或陪伴，有時帶有不禮貌或分心的負面含義。
explanation_english: A colloquial Cantonese phrase meaning to eat while watching television. It describes using TV as accompaniment or background during meals and can imply distraction or impoliteness in some contexts.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 好多家庭鍾意電視汁送飯，邊食邊睇電視。
examples.jyutping_sentence: hou2 do1 gaa1 ting4 zung1 ji3 din6 si6 zap1 sung3 faan6, bin1 sik6 bin1 tai2 din6 si6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 許多家庭喜歡一邊吃飯一邊看電視。
examples.english_sentence: Many households like to eat while watching TV.

mandarin_meaning: 電視迷 / 電視控（指非常喜歡看電視、追劇的人）
english_meaning: TV addict; TV fanatic; someone who watches a lot of television (often binge-watches)
explanation_mandarin: 口語粵語俚語，指對看電視非常著迷、經常追劇或看大量節目的人，帶有戲謔或半開玩笑的語氣。
explanation_english: Colloquial Cantonese slang for a person who is very into watching television—frequently binge-watches or watches lots of programs. Often used playfully or teasingly.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢係個電視精，成日追劇，追到半夜先瞓。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hai6 go3 din6 si6 zing1, sing4 jat6 zeoi1 kek6, zeoi1 dou3 bun3 je6 sin1 fan3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他是個電視迷，總是追劇，追到半夜才睡。
examples.english_sentence: He's a TV addict—always binge-watching dramas until midnight before going to bed.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 屋企有個電視精，一有新劇開播，佢就坐喺梳化一坐就唔郁。
examples.jyutping_sentence: uk1 kei2 jau5 go3 din6 si6 zing1, jat1 jau5 san1 kek6 hoi1 bo3, keoi5 zau6 zok3 hai2 so1 faa3 jat1 zok3 zau6 m4 juk6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 家裡有個電視迷，一有新劇開播，他就坐在沙發上一坐不動。
examples.english_sentence: There's a TV junkie at home—when a new show airs he sits on the sofa and doesn't move.

mandarin_meaning: 电解
english_meaning: electrolysis; to electrolyze
explanation_mandarin: 电解是指利用电能使化学物质发生分解或促成化学反应的过程。可用作名词（如“电解过程”）或动词（如“电解水”）。在工业与实验室常用于电解水、提取金属等。
explanation_english: Electrolysis: the process of using electrical current to drive a chemical decomposition or reaction. Can be used as a noun (the electrolysis process) or a verb (to electrolyze something). Common in labs and industry for splitting water, extracting metals, etc.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 電解水可以分解出氫同氧。
examples.jyutping_sentence: din6 gaai2 seoi2 ho2 ji5 fan1 gaai2 ceot1 heng1 tung4 joeng5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 电解水可以把水分解成氢和氧。
examples.english_sentence: Electrolyzing water can decompose it into hydrogen and oxygen.

mandarin_meaning: 电解液 (diànjiě yè)
english_meaning: electrolyte (a conductive liquid used in batteries or electrolysis)
explanation_mandarin: 指能够导电的液体，常用于电池或电解过程中的导电溶液，含离子并能传导电流。
explanation_english: A liquid that conducts ions; the conductive solution used in batteries or during electrolysis, containing ions that allow electric current to flow.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 如果電池入面嘅電解液洩漏，會好危險，可能會腐蝕機殼或者燒傷。
examples.jyutping_sentence: jyu4 gwo2 din6 ci4 jap6 min6 ge3 din6 gaai2 jik6 sit3 lau6, wui5 hou2 ngai4 him2, ho2 nang4 wui5 fu3 sik1 gei1 hok3 waak6 ze2 siu1 soeng1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 如果电池里面的电解液泄漏，会很危险，可能会腐蚀机壳或造成烧伤。
examples.english_sentence: If the electrolyte inside a battery leaks, it can be very dangerous; it may corrode the casing or cause burns.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 做實驗嘅時候，電解液要小心處理，戴手套同埋護目鏡。
examples.jyutping_sentence: zou6 sat6 jim6 ge3 si4 hau6, din6 gaai2 jik6 jiu3 siu2 sam1 cyu2 lei5, daai3 sau2 tou3 tung4 maai4 wu6 muk6 geng3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 做实验的时候，电解液要小心处理，戴手套和护目镜。
examples.english_sentence: When doing experiments, handle electrolytes carefully; wear gloves and safety goggles.

mandarin_meaning: 电解质 (diànjiězhì)
english_meaning: electrolyte
explanation_mandarin: 在溶液中能电离成阳离子和阴离子的物质，能导电（例如 Na+、K+、Cl-），在生理和化学过程中很重要。
explanation_english: A substance that dissociates into ions in solution and conducts electricity (e.g., Na+, K+, Cl-); important in physiological and chemical processes.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 跑完步之後，除咗飲水，仲要補返電解質。
examples.jyutping_sentence: paau2 jyun4 bou6 zi1 hau6, ceoi4 zo2 jam2 seoi2, zung6 jiu3 bou2 faan1 din6 gaai2 zat1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 跑完步之后，除了喝水外，也要补充电解质。
examples.english_sentence: After finishing a run, besides drinking water, you should also replenish electrolytes.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 醫生話你啲電解質有問題，可能要入院打點滴補返。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ji1 sang1 waa6 nei5 di1 din6 gaai2 zat1 jau5 man6 tai4, ho2 nang4 jiu3 jap6 jyun2 daa2 dim2 dik1 bou2 faan1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 医生说你的电解质有问题，可能需要住院输液来补充。
examples.english_sentence: The doctor said your electrolytes are abnormal; you may need to be hospitalized and receive IV fluids to replenish them.

mandarin_meaning: 电讯 / 电信（通信行业、通信服务）
english_meaning: telecommunications; telecom
explanation_mandarin: 指與電子通信有關的服務或行業，包括電話、互聯網、無線通訊等傳遞訊息的技術與系統。
explanation_english: Refers to services or the industry related to electronic communication, including telephone, internet, and wireless communication technologies and systems for transmitting information.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋公司係做電訊生意嘅。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 gung1 si1 hai6 zou6 din6 seon3 saang1 ji3 ge3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们公司从事电讯业务。
examples.english_sentence: Their company is engaged in the telecommunications business.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋今日因為電訊故障冇法上網。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 gam1 jat6 jan1 wai6 din6 seon3 gu3 zong6 mou5 faat3 soeng5 mong5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们今天因为电讯故障无法上网。
examples.english_sentence: We couldn't access the internet today because of a telecommunications outage.

mandarin_meaning: 电话 (diànhuà)
english_meaning: telephone; phone; phone call
explanation_mandarin: 指用于语音通话的设备（固定电话或手机），也可泛指打电话的行为。
explanation_english: Refers to a device for voice calls (landline or mobile) and can also refer to the act of making a phone call.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你有冇電話？
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 jau5 mou5 din6waa2?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你有没有电话？
examples.english_sentence: Do you have a phone?

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我而家打電話俾你。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 ji4gaa1 daa2 din6waa2 bei2 nei5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我现在打电话给你。
examples.english_sentence: I'll call you now.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 電話響咗。
examples.jyutping_sentence: din6waa2 hoeng3 zo2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 电话响了。
examples.english_sentence: The phone rang.

mandarin_meaning: 电话亭
english_meaning: telephone booth; phone booth
explanation_mandarin: 指設置於公共場所、供人打電話的亭子或小房間，隨著手機普及，電話亭越來越少見。
explanation_english: A small booth or enclosure in a public place where people could make telephone calls. With the spread of mobile phones, telephone booths have become increasingly rare.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 而家好少見到電話亭，大家都用手機。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ji4 gaa1 hou2 siu2 gin3 dou3 din6 waa2 ting4, daai6 gaa1 dou1 jung6 sau2 gei1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 現在很少見到電話亭，大家都用手機。
examples.english_sentence: You rarely see telephone booths nowadays; everyone uses mobile phones.

mandarin_meaning: 电话卡
english_meaning: phone card; SIM card; prepaid calling card
explanation_mandarin: 指用於打電話或上網的卡片，既可指預付費的電話卡（儲值卡/通話卡），也常用來指手機的SIM卡。
explanation_english: Refers to a card used for making calls or accessing mobile data; can mean a prepaid calling card/credit card or commonly a mobile SIM card.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我張電話卡冇錢，要加值。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 zoeng1 din6 waa6 kaa1 mou5 cin2, jiu3 gaa1 zik6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我的电话卡没钱了，要充值。
examples.english_sentence: My phone card has no credit; I need to top it up.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 去便利店買張電話卡就可以上網同打電話。
examples.jyutping_sentence: heoi3 bin6 lei6 dim3 maai5 zoeng1 din6 waa6 kaa1 zau6 ho2 ji5 soeng5 mong5 tung4 daa2 din6 waa6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 去便利店买一张电话卡就可以上网和打电话。
examples.english_sentence: You can buy a phone card at a convenience store to get online and make calls.

mandarin_meaning: 電話卡（可指預付電話卡或SIM卡）
english_meaning: phone card (e.g. a calling/prepaid card or a SIM card)
explanation_mandarin: 口語用法，指用來撥打電話或上網的卡片，例如公共電話的預付卡或手機的SIM卡。在香港日常會話中常用「咭」表示「卡」。
explanation_english: A colloquial term for a phone card — either a prepaid/calling card for phones or a SIM card for mobile devices. In Hong Kong Cantonese, 咭 is commonly used to mean 'card'.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我部電話壞咗，連電話咭都唔見咗。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 bou6 din6 waa2 waai6 zo2, lin4 din6 waa2 kaat1 dou1 m4 gin3 zo2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我的手機壞了，連電話卡也不見了。
examples.english_sentence: My phone broke and even the phone card (SIM) is missing.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 去旅行之前我買咗張預付電話咭，用嚟打本地電話比較方便。
examples.jyutping_sentence: heoi3 leoi5 hang4 zi1 cin4 ngo5 maai5 zo2 zoeng1 jyu6 fu6 din6 waa2 kaat1, jung6 lai4 daa2 bun2 dei6 din6 waa2 biu2 gaau3 fong1 bin6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 去旅行之前我買了一張預付電話卡，用來打當地電話比較方便。
examples.english_sentence: Before traveling I bought a prepaid phone card; it's more convenient for calling local numbers.

mandarin_meaning: 电话座 / 电话底座（电话的底座或充电座、支架）
english_meaning: telephone base; phone dock/cradle; charging stand
explanation_mandarin: 指电话的底座或支架，通常用于固定座机或作手机的充电底座/支架。既可指旧式座机的機座，也可指用來放置或充電手機的底座。
explanation_english: Refers to the base or cradle of a telephone (or a docking/charging stand). It can mean the base of a traditional landline handset or a charging dock/stand used to hold or charge a mobile phone.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我部電話放喺電話座度充電。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 bou6 din6 waa2 fong3 hai2 din6 waa2 zo6 dou6 cung1 din6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我把手机放在充电座上充电。
examples.english_sentence: I put my phone on the charging dock to charge it.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 公司入面嘅電話座壞咗，要換一個。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gung1 si1 jap6 min6 ge3 din6 waa2 zo6 waai6 zo2, jiu3 wun6 jat1 go3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 公司里的电话座坏了，要换一个。
examples.english_sentence: The office telephone base is broken; we need to replace it.

mandarin_meaning: 电话筒 / 听筒
english_meaning: telephone handset; telephone receiver
explanation_mandarin: 指電話上手持用以講話與聽聲音的部分，舊式座機或有線電話常見。
explanation_english: The part of a telephone that you hold to speak and listen; commonly refers to the handset/receiver on landline phones.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 舊式座機嘅電話筒好重。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gau6 sik1 zo6 gei1 ge3 din6 waa6 tung4 hou2 cung5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 舊式座機的聽筒很重。
examples.english_sentence: The handset of old-style landline phones is heavy.

mandarin_meaning: 电话簿（电话簿／电话号码簿）
english_meaning: phone book; telephone directory; contact list
explanation_mandarin: 指收錄人名及電話號碼的名錄，可以是紙本的電話簿或電子裝置上的聯絡人清單。
explanation_english: A directory that lists names and telephone numbers; can refer to a physical book or an electronic contact list on a device.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你有冇睇電話簿？我想搵佢嘅電話號碼。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 jau5 mou5 tai2 din6 waa6 bou2? ngo5 soeng2 wan2 keoi5 ge3 din6 waa6 hou6 maa5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你有没有看电话簿？我想找他的电话号码。
examples.english_sentence: Did you check the phone book? I want to find his phone number.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 而家冇人買電話簿，大家都用手提電話入面嘅聯絡人。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ji4 gaa1 mou5 jan4 maai5 din6 waa6 bou2, daai6 gaa1 dou1 jung6 sau2 tai4 din6 waa6 jap6 min6 ge3 lyun4 lok3 jan4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 现在没人买电话簿，大家都用手机里的联系人。
examples.english_sentence: Nobody buys phone books now; everyone uses the contacts in their mobile phones.

mandarin_meaning: 電話線
english_meaning: telephone line; phone line
explanation_mandarin: 用於連接電話設備並傳輸語音或數據信號的電線或電纜，通常指固定的座機電話線路。
explanation_english: A wire or cable used to connect telephone equipment and transmit voice or data signals; typically refers to a fixed landline connection.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 屋企嘅電話線斷咗，我打唔到電話。
examples.jyutping_sentence: uk1 kei2 ge3 din6 waa6 sin3 dyun6 zo2, ngo5 daa2 m4 dou3 din6 waa6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 家裡的電話線斷了，我打不了電話。
examples.english_sentence: The telephone line at home is cut, I can't make a call.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你幫我睇下電話線有冇插好？
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 bong1 ngo5 tai2 haa5 din6 waa6 sin3 jau5 mou5 caap3 hou2?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你幫我看看電話線有沒有插好？
examples.english_sentence: Can you check whether the telephone line is properly plugged in for me?

mandarin_meaning: 电话号码 (diànhuà hàomǎ)
english_meaning: telephone number; phone number
explanation_mandarin: 表示用來聯絡電話的數字序列，用以撥打或記錄聯絡方式。
explanation_english: A sequence of digits assigned to a telephone line or mobile device used to make or receive calls; a phone number.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 可唔可以畀我你嘅電話號碼？
examples.jyutping_sentence: ho2 m4 ho2 ji5 bei2 ngo5 nei5 ge3 din6 waa2 hou6 maa5?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你可以把你的电话号码给我吗？
examples.english_sentence: Can you give me your phone number?

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我唔記得咗屋企電話號碼。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 m4 gei3 dak1 zo2 uk1 kei2 din6 waa2 hou6 maa5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我忘記了家裡的電話號碼。
examples.english_sentence: I forgot my home phone number.

mandarin_meaning: 电费
english_meaning: electricity bill; electric charge
explanation_mandarin: 指用電所需支付的費用，通常由供電公司根據用電量計算並按月或按季收取。
explanation_english: The charge for electricity consumption, usually calculated by the power company based on usage and billed monthly or quarterly.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 今個月嘅電費好貴。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gam1 go3 jyut6 ge3 din6 fai3 hou2 gwai3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这个月的电费很贵。
examples.english_sentence: This month's electricity bill is very expensive.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你收到張電費單未？
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 sau1 dou3 zoeng1 din6 fai3 daan1 mei6?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你收到电费单了吗？
examples.english_sentence: Have you received the electricity bill?

mandarin_meaning: 打電話祝賀／發賀電
english_meaning: to call or send an electronic message to congratulate (someone)
explanation_mandarin: 口語用法，指用電話或其他電訊方式向人表示祝賀或致賀。
explanation_english: A colloquial Cantonese verb meaning to congratulate someone by phone or via an electronic message.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 記得電賀佢，佢啱啱升職。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gei3 dak1 din6 ho6 keoi5, keoi5 aam1 aam1 sing1 zik1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 記得打電話祝賀他，他剛剛升職。
examples.english_sentence: Remember to call and congratulate him — he just got promoted.

mandarin_meaning: 电路
english_meaning: electrical circuit; circuit (electronic or electrical wiring/system)
explanation_mandarin: 指電流流通的路徑或系統，通常用來表示電子或電力系統中的連接線路、迴路或電路板上的電路配置。
explanation_english: Refers to a path or system for electric current, typically the connected wiring, components, or PCB traces that form an electronic or electrical circuit.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢個電路短路咗，成個屋企都冇電。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 go3 din6 lou6 dyun2 lou6 zo2, sing4 go3 uk1 kei5 dou1 mou5 din6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这个电路短路了，整个屋子都没电。
examples.english_sentence: This circuit shorted; the whole house has no power.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 技術員要拆開電路板檢查有冇壞嘅元件。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gei6 seot6 jyun4 jiu3 caak3 hoi1 din6 lou6 baan2 gim2 caa4 jau5 mou5 waai6 ge3 jyun4 gin6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 技术员要拆开电路板检查有没有坏的元件。
examples.english_sentence: The technician needs to open the circuit board to check for damaged components.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢課電子學會教你點樣設計簡單電路。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 fo3 din6 zi2 hok6 wui5 gaau3 nei5 dim2 joeng6 cit3 gai3 gaan2 daan1 din6 lou6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这堂电子学会教你怎样设计简单的电路。
examples.english_sentence: This electronics class will teach you how to design basic circuits.

mandarin_meaning: 电路板；印刷电路板（PCB）
english_meaning: circuit board; printed circuit board (PCB)
explanation_mandarin: 指用於電子設備中，承載電子元件並連接電路的板子，通常指印刷電路板（PCB）。
explanation_english: A board used in electronic devices that holds electronic components and provides electrical connections; usually refers to a printed circuit board (PCB).

examples.cantonese_sentence: 部電腦壞咗，技術員話係電路板燒壞，要換一塊。
examples.jyutping_sentence: bou6 din6 nou5 waai6 zo2, gei6 seot6 jyun4 waa6 hai6 din6 lou6 baan2 siu1 waai6, jiu3 wun6 jat1 faai3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 电脑坏了，技术员说是电路板烧坏了，需要换一块。
examples.english_sentence: The computer broke; the technician said the circuit board burned out and needs to be replaced.

mandarin_meaning: 电车（有轨电车，路面有轨的电力驱动车辆）
english_meaning: tram; streetcar (an electric, rail-based vehicle that runs on tracks in the street)
explanation_mandarin: 指以电力驱动、在路面轨道上行驶的公共交通车辆。香港口语中也常用「叮叮」指代香港的有轨电车（雙層電車）。
explanation_english: Refers to an electrically powered rail vehicle that runs on street tracks. In Hong Kong, the trams (often double-decker) are commonly called "ding ding".

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我聽日坐電車去中環。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 ting1 jat6 co5 din6 ce1 heoi3 zung1 waan4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我明天坐电车去中环。
examples.english_sentence: I'm taking the tram to Central tomorrow.

mandarin_meaning: 电车站 / 有轨电车站（停靠电车的站台）
english_meaning: tram stop; streetcar stop
explanation_mandarin: 指有轨电车（在香港俗称「电车」或「叮叮」）停靠的站台或车站，用於表示乘客上下車的地點。
explanation_english: Refers to the stop or station where trams (streetcars) pick up and drop off passengers; commonly used in Hong Kong to denote tram stops.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我喺電車站等緊人。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 hai2 din6 ce1 zaam6 dang2 gan2 jan4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我在电车站等人。
examples.english_sentence: I'm waiting for someone at the tram stop.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 下一個電車站就係中環。
examples.jyutping_sentence: haa6 jat1 go3 din6 ce1 zaam6 zau6 hai6 zung1 waan4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 下一站就是中环。
examples.english_sentence: The next tram stop is Central.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 電車站附近有好多小食檔。
examples.jyutping_sentence: din6 ce1 zaam6 fu6 gan6 jau5 hou2 do1 siu2 sik6 dong3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 电车站附近有很多小吃摊。
examples.english_sentence: There are many food stalls near the tram stop.

mandarin_meaning: 电子邮件
english_meaning: email; electronic mail
explanation_mandarin: 「電郵」是「電子郵件」的口語或書面縮寫，指透過網絡傳送的郵件。
explanation_english: Colloquial Cantonese term for "email" (electronic mail), referring to messages sent via the internet.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我啱啱寄咗封電郵俾佢，佢仲未覆我。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 aam1 aam1 gei3 zo2 fung1 din6 jau4 bei2 keoi5, keoi5 zung6 mei6 fuk1 ngo5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我刚刚给他发了一封电子邮件，他还没回复我。
examples.english_sentence: I just sent him an email; he hasn't replied yet.

mandarin_meaning: 电锯 (diànjù)
english_meaning: chainsaw; electric saw
explanation_mandarin: 指以電力驅動，用於切割木材或其他材料的工具，常見於伐木、園藝或建築工地，操作時需注意安全。
explanation_english: A power tool driven by electricity used to cut wood or other materials (commonly a chainsaw); often used in logging, gardening, or construction. Requires careful handling for safety.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋要買部電鋸去砍樹。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 jiu3 maai5 bou6 din6 geoi3 heoi3 ham2 syu6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们要买一台电锯去砍树。
examples.english_sentence: We need to buy a chainsaw to cut down the tree.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 用電鋸要小心，否則好容易受傷。
examples.jyutping_sentence: jung6 din6 geoi3 jiu3 siu2 sam1, fau2 zak1 hou2 jung4 ji6 sau6 soeng1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 用电锯要小心，否则很容易受伤。
examples.english_sentence: Be careful when using a chainsaw; otherwise it's easy to get injured.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 電鋸嘅聲好嘈，戴埋耳罩啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: din6 geoi3 ge3 seng1 hou2 cou4, daai3 maai4 ji5 zaau3 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 电锯的声音很吵，戴上耳罩吧。
examples.english_sentence: The chainsaw is very loud; put on your ear protectors.

mandarin_meaning: 电表 (diànbiǎo)
english_meaning: electricity meter
explanation_mandarin: 用來計量用電量的儀表，通常安裝在住宅或建築物外，由電力公司讀取以計算電費。
explanation_english: A device that measures electrical energy consumption, usually installed at a residence or building and read by the power company to calculate the electricity bill.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我屋企個電錶壞咗，要打電話畀電力公司修理。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 uk1 kei2 go3 din6 biu1 waai6 zo2, jiu3 daa2 din6 waa2 bei2 din6 lik6 gung1 si1 sau1 lei5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我家裡的電表壞了，要打電話給電力公司修理。
examples.english_sentence: The electricity meter at my place is broken; I need to call the power company to fix it.

mandarin_meaning: 电镀 (diàn dù)
english_meaning: electroplate; electroplating (to electroplate)
explanation_mandarin: 指利用電化學方法在金屬或其他材料表面沉積一層金屬的工藝，常用於防護、抗腐蝕或改變外觀。
explanation_english: The process of depositing a metal coating onto the surface of a metal or other material using electrochemical methods; used for protection, corrosion resistance, or altering appearance.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢啲金屬件要電鍍先唔會生鏽。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 di1 gam1 seot6 gin6 jiu3 din6 duk6 sin1 m4 wui5 saang1 zau3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这些金属件要电镀才能不生锈。
examples.english_sentence: These metal pieces need to be electroplated so they won't rust.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢條頸鍊可以電鍍成金色。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 tiu4 geng2 lin2 ho2 ji5 din6 duk6 sing4 gam1 sik1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这条项链可以电镀成金色。
examples.english_sentence: This necklace can be electroplated to a gold color.

mandarin_meaning: 电钟（以电力驱动的时钟，常指插电或电子式的时钟）
english_meaning: electric clock (a clock powered by electricity, e.g., plug-in or electronic clock)
explanation_mandarin: 指以電力驅動的時鐘，常見為插電或電子式的掛鐘、座鐘或鬧鐘，不同於純機械或僅用電池的時鐘。
explanation_english: Refers to a clock powered by electricity—commonly a plug-in or electronic wall/desk clock or alarm—distinct from purely mechanical or battery-only clocks.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我屋企個電鐘壞咗，要換一個。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 uk1 kei2 go3 din6 zung1 waai6 zo2, jiu3 wun6 jat1 go3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我家裡的電鐘壞了，要換一個。
examples.english_sentence: The electric clock at my home broke; I need to replace it.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢部電鐘係插電嘅，唔駛靠電池。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 bou6 din6 zung1 hai6 caap3 din6 ge3, m4 sai2 kaau3 din6 ci4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 這個電鐘是插電的，不用靠電池。
examples.english_sentence: This electric clock plugs into the mains; it doesn't need batteries.

mandarin_meaning: 电钻 (diànzuān)
english_meaning: electric drill
explanation_mandarin: 一種以電力驅動，用來鑽孔或擰螺絲的手持或固定工具。
explanation_english: A power tool driven by electricity used for drilling holes or driving screws; can be handheld or bench-mounted.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我想借你部電鑽用一陣。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 soeng2 ze3 nei5 bou6 din6 zyun3 jung6 jat1 zan6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我想借你的電鑽用一會兒。
examples.english_sentence: I'd like to borrow your drill for a moment.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 施工嗰陣要戴安全眼鏡同手套，使用電鑽要好小心。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gung1 cong4 go2 zan6 jiu3 daai3 ngon1 cyun4 ngaan5 geng2 tung4 sau2 tou3, si6 jung6 din6 zyun3 jiu3 hou2 siu2 sam1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 施工時要戴安全護目鏡和手套，使用電鑽要非常小心。
examples.english_sentence: During construction wear safety goggles and gloves; be very careful when using the drill.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢買咗部新電鑽，成日喺屋企整嘢用。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 maai5 zo2 bou6 san1 din6 zyun3, sing4 jat6 hai6 uk1 kei2 zing2 je5 jung6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他買了新的電鑽，經常在家用來修東西。
examples.english_sentence: He bought a new drill and often uses it at home to fix things.

mandarin_meaning: 电阻；（电路中的）阻碍电流的元件或阻抗
english_meaning: electrical resistance; resistor (a component that opposes electric current)
explanation_mandarin: 指在电路中对电流产生阻碍的物理量或元件（如电阻器），常用符号R，单位为欧姆（Ω）。
explanation_english: The property or component in an electrical circuit that opposes the flow of electric current (resistance or a resistor). Symbol: R. Unit: ohm (Ω).

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢個電阻壞咗，要換個。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 go3 din6 zo2 waai6 zo2, jiu3 wun6 go3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这个电阻坏了，要换一个。
examples.english_sentence: This resistor is broken and needs to be replaced.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 電阻嘅單位係歐姆（Ω）。
examples.jyutping_sentence: din6 zo2 ge3 daan1 wai6 hai6 au1 mou5 (Ω).
examples.mandarin_sentence: 电阻的单位是欧姆（Ω）。
examples.english_sentence: The unit of resistance is the ohm (Ω).

examples.cantonese_sentence: 如果電阻增大，通過嘅電流會減少。
examples.jyutping_sentence: jyu4 gwo2 din6 zo2 zang1 daai6, tung1 gwo3 ge3 din6 lau4 wui5 gaam2 siu2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 如果电阻增大，通过的电流会减少。
examples.english_sentence: If the resistance increases, the current passing through will decrease.

mandarin_meaning: 电陶炉（电陶炉）：一种以电加热、表面为陶瓷或玻璃陶瓷的厨房炉具，用于加热或烹饪，属辐射/对流加热，区别于需磁性锅具的电磁炉。
english_meaning: electric ceramic stove / ceramic hob — an electric cooker with a glass-ceramic surface and radiant heating element (not an induction cooker).
explanation_mandarin: 电陶炉是一种以电能加热、表面为陶瓷或玻璃陶瓷的家用炉具，内部通常为电热管或卤素灯管，通过辐射或对流传热，加热时可搭配各种材质的锅具，使用上与电磁炉不同。
explanation_english: An electric ceramic stove (ceramic hob) is a household cooker with a glass-ceramic surface and a radiant electric heating element (e.g., halogen or heating coil). It heats by radiation/convection and can be used with most types of cookware; it is not the same as an induction cooker.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我買咗個新嘅電陶爐，煲湯好方便。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 maai5 zo2 go3 san1 ge3 din6 tou4 lou4, bou1 tong1 hou2 fong1 bin6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我买了一个新的电陶炉，煮汤很方便。
examples.english_sentence: I bought a new electric ceramic stove; it's very convenient for making soup.

mandarin_meaning: 电风扇 (diàn fēng shàn)
english_meaning: electric fan; electric/portable fan
explanation_mandarin: 用電驅動的風扇，用來促進空氣流通或降溫，常見於家庭和辦公場所。
explanation_english: A fan powered by electricity used to circulate air or cool a space; commonly found in homes and offices.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 夏天咁熱，屋企冇冷氣，我就靠住電風扇瞓覺。
examples.jyutping_sentence: haa6 tin1 gam2 jit6, uk1 kei2 mou5 laang5 hei3, ngo5 zau6 kaau3 zyu6 din6 fung1 sin3 fan3 gaau3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 夏天那麼熱，家裡沒有冷氣，我就靠電風扇睡覺。
examples.english_sentence: It's so hot in summer; there's no air conditioning at home, so I sleep with an electric fan.

mandarin_meaning: 电饭煲（diànfànbāo）
english_meaning: electric rice cooker; rice cooker
explanation_mandarin: 一种用于煮饭的家用电器，也称为电饭锅。通常由内胆、加热元件和控温装置组成，除了煮饭外也可用于焖、蒸或做一些简易菜式和甜点。
explanation_english: An electric appliance used to cook rice, also called a rice cooker. It typically has an inner pot, heating element, and temperature control, and can be used for cooking rice as well as steaming, stewing, or making simple dishes and desserts.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我啱啱買咗個電飯煲。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 ngaam1 ngaam1 maai5 zo2 go3 din6 faan6 bou1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我刚刚买了一个电饭煲。
examples.english_sentence: I just bought a rice cooker.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 用電飯煲整蛋糕都得。
examples.jyutping_sentence: jung6 din6 faan6 bou1 zing2 daan6 gou1 dou1 dak1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 用电饭煲做蛋糕也可以。
examples.english_sentence: You can even make a cake with a rice cooker.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 屋企個電飯煲壞咗，要唔要我幫你修？
examples.jyutping_sentence: uk1 kei5 go3 din6 faan6 bou1 waai6 zo2, jiu3 m4 jiu3 ngo5 bong1 nei5 sau1?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 家里的电饭煲坏了，要不要我帮你修？
examples.english_sentence: The rice cooker at home is broken; do you want me to help fix it?

mandarin_meaning: 電話詐騙
english_meaning: phone scam; telephone fraud
explanation_mandarin: 「電騙」是香港廣東話俗語，指透過電話（有時亦包含來自電話號碼的訊息或語音通話相關詐騙）進行的詐騙行為，通常以騙取錢財或個人資料為目的。
explanation_english: “電騙” is Cantonese slang (commonly used in Hong Kong) referring to telephone scams — fraudulent schemes carried out by phone calls (and sometimes related messages) aiming to trick victims into sending money or revealing sensitive information.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我差啲俾電騙呃錢，幸好及時發現冇事。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 caa1 di1 bei2 din6 pin3 ng6 cin2, hang6 hou2 kap6 si4 faat3 jin4 mou5 si6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我差點被電話詐騙騙走錢，幸好及時發現沒事。
examples.english_sentence: I almost got scammed out of money by a phone scam; luckily I noticed in time and everything was okay.

mandarin_meaning: 燙髮（用電熱或化學方法把頭髮燙成捲髮）
english_meaning: perm; to get a perm (to curl hair using heat/chemical treatment)
explanation_mandarin: 在香港廣東話中，「電髮」指利用電熱或化學藥水把頭髮燙成捲或波浪狀。可用作動詞（去電髮）或名詞（做個電髮）。
explanation_english: In Cantonese, '電髮' refers to perming hair—creating curls or waves using heat or chemical treatments. It is used both as a verb ('to get a perm') and as a noun ('a perm').

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我聽日去髮型屋電髮，想整啲大波浪。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 ting1 jat6 heoi3 faat3 jing4 uk1 din6 faat3, soeng2 zing2 di1 daai6 bo1 long6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我明天去美髮店燙髮，想弄成大捲波浪。
examples.english_sentence: I'm going to the hair salon tomorrow to get a perm; I want big wavy curls.

mandarin_meaning: 電動剃鬚刀（電動刮鬍刀）
english_meaning: electric shaver / electric razor
explanation_mandarin: 指以電力驅動用來剃除鬍鬚的工具。此詞為香港廣東話常用稱呼，也可寫作電動剃鬚刀或電動刮鬍刀。
explanation_english: Refers to a device powered by electricity used for shaving facial hair. This is the common Cantonese term in Hong Kong for an electric shaver.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我買咗部新嘅電鬚刨，好好用。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 maai5 zo2 bou6 san1 ge3 din6 sou1 paau4, hou2 hou2 jung6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我買了一部新的電動剃鬚刀，很好用。
examples.english_sentence: I bought a new electric shaver; it's really useful.

mandarin_meaning: 電鳗（能發電的淡水魚）
english_meaning: electric eel (a freshwater fish that generates electric shocks)
explanation_mandarin: 電鰻指一種能產生電流用以捕食或防衛的淡水魚（學名 Electrophorus），主要分布於南美洲亞馬遜流域。牠不是真正的鰻魚，但外形似鰻。
explanation_english: An electric eel is a freshwater fish (genus Electrophorus) capable of producing strong electric shocks for hunting and defense. It is native to South America (Amazon basin) and is eel-like in appearance but not a true eel.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 嗰條電鰻會放電，唔好企得太近。
examples.jyutping_sentence: go2 tiu4 din6 maan4 wui5 fong3 din6, m4 hou2 kei5 dak1 taai3 gan6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 那條電鰻會放電，別站得太近。
examples.english_sentence: That electric eel can emit electric shocks; don't stand too close.

mandarin_meaning: 需要；必須
english_meaning: need; require; must (formal)
explanation_mandarin: 表示需要或必須，語氣偏正式或書面語，常見於複合詞如「需要」「必需」「如需」。
explanation_english: Indicates need or requirement; used often in formal or written contexts. Frequently appears in compounds such as "需要", "必需", or "如需".

examples.cantonese_sentence: 辦證需帶身份證。
examples.jyutping_sentence: baan6 zing3 seoi1 daai3 san1 fan6 zing3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 办证需要带身份证。
examples.english_sentence: You need to bring your ID to apply for the certificate.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢件事需盡快處理。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 gin6 si6 seoi1 zeon6 faai3 cyu2 lei5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这件事需要尽快处理。
examples.english_sentence: This matter needs to be handled as soon as possible.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 如需幫忙，請話我知。
examples.jyutping_sentence: jyu4 seoi1 bong1 mong4, cing2 waa6 ngo5 zi1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 如需帮助，请告诉我。
examples.english_sentence: If you need help, please let me know.

mandarin_meaning: 需求（xūqiú）—— 需要、對某物或服務的要求或市場上對某物的需求量
english_meaning: demand; need; requirement
partOfSpeech_english: noun (can also be used as a verb)
explanation_mandarin: 表示個人或市場對某種商品、服務或條件的需要或渴求，常用於經濟、商業或心理層面。主要作名詞，也可在較正式或書面語中作動詞使用。
explanation_english: Indicates the need or desire for something, or the quantity demanded in a market. Commonly used in economic, business, and personal contexts. Primarily a noun but can be used as a verb in formal/registered contexts.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 公司想增加產品嘅市場需求，於是做咗一個用戶調查。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gung1 si1 soeng2 zang1 gaa1 caan2 ban2 ge3 si5 coeng4 seoi1 kau4, jyu1 si2 zou6 zo2 jat1 go3 jung6 wu6 diu6 caa4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 公司想增加產品的市場需求，所以做了一個用戶調查。
examples.english_sentence: The company wants to increase the market demand for its product, so it conducted a user survey.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 每個人都有基本嘅情感需求。
examples.jyutping_sentence: mui5 go3 jan4 dou1 jau5 gei1 bun2 ge3 cing4 gam2 seoi1 kau4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 每個人都有基本的情感需求。
examples.english_sentence: Everyone has basic emotional needs.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢個項目需求大量資金同人手先可以推行。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 go3 hong6 muk6 seoi1 kau4 daai6 loeng6 zi1 gam1 tung4 jan4 sau2 sin1 ho2 ji5 teoi1 hang4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 這個項目需要大量資金和人手才能推行。
examples.english_sentence: This project requires a large amount of funding and manpower to be implemented.

mandarin_meaning: 需要 (xūyào)
english_meaning: to need; to require; need (noun)
explanation_mandarin: 作动词时表示缺少或必须有某物、某人或做某事；作名词时表示需求或必要性。
explanation_english: As a verb, indicates lacking or requiring something, someone, or an action; as a noun, denotes a need or requirement.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我需要你幫我一吓。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 seoi1 jiu3 nei5 bong1 ngo5 jat1 haa5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我需要你帮我一下。
examples.english_sentence: I need you to help me for a moment.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 如果有需要，隨時打畀我。
examples.jyutping_sentence: jyu4 gwo2 jau5 seoi1 jiu3, ceoi4 si4 daa2 bei2 ngo5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 如果有需要，随时打给我。
examples.english_sentence: If you need anything, call me anytime.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢份工作需要好高嘅專業知識。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 fan6 gung1 zok3 seoi1 jiu3 hou2 gou1 ge3 zyun1 jip6 zi1 sik1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这份工作需要很高的专业知识。
examples.english_sentence: This job requires a high level of professional knowledge.

mandarin_meaning: 在需要的時候 / 必要時
english_meaning: when necessary; as needed; if needed
explanation_mandarin: 表示在有需要的時候採取某種行動或情況，例如「需要時可以聯絡我」。
explanation_english: Indicates a time when something is necessary and an action or condition should occur; equivalent to "when necessary" or "as needed."

examples.cantonese_sentence: 有需要時，記得搵我幫手。
examples.jyutping_sentence: jau5 seoi1 jiu3 si4, gei3 dak1 wan2 ngo5 bong1 sau2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 有需要時，記得找我幫忙。
examples.english_sentence: If/when necessary, remember to ask me for help.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 需要時可以打電話畀我。
examples.jyutping_sentence: seoi1 jiu3 si4 ho2 ji5 daa2 din6 waa2 bei2 ngo5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 需要時可以打電話給我。
examples.english_sentence: You can call me when necessary.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我會將資料備份，需要時就可以恢復。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 wui5 zoeng1 zi1 liu2 bei6 fan6, seoi1 jiu3 si4 zau6 ho2 ji5 fui1 fuk6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我會把資料備份，需要時就可以恢復。
examples.english_sentence: I'll back up the data so it can be restored when necessary.

mandarin_meaning: 天空、天際（書面用語）
english_meaning: sky; heavens (literary)
explanation_mandarin: 表示天空、天際，常見於書面語或詞語中（如「凌霄」）。在古典或文學語境中用於描寫高遠的天空或天際景象。
explanation_english: Refers to the sky or heavens; primarily literary. Commonly appears in compounds such as '凌霄' to describe rising or lofty skies.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢想凌霄而上，追求更高嘅目標。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 soeng2 ling4 siu1 ji4 soeng5, zeoi1 kau4 gang3 gou1 ge3 muk6 biu1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他想凌霄而上，追求更高的目标。
examples.english_sentence: He wants to soar to the heavens, pursuing higher goals.

mandarin_meaning: 霆（雷霆），指雷電或猛烈的懲罰、怒氣，常見於合成詞如「雷霆」
english_meaning: (thunder/ thunderbolt) thunder; used in compounds like 'leiting' to mean thunder or metaphorically great wrath or severe punishment
explanation_mandarin: 「霆」本義與雷電有關，現多用於合成詞（如「雷霆」）來形容巨大的雷聲或比喻猛烈的怒氣或嚴厲的懲罰，單字單獨使用較少見。
explanation_english: The character refers to thunder or thunderbolt. It is most often used in compounds (e.g. '雷霆') to describe powerful thunder or, figuratively, fierce wrath or severe punishment. The single character is rarely used alone in everyday speech.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢嘅怒氣如雷霆般猛烈，大家都唔敢出聲。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 ge3 nou6 hei3 jyu4 leoi4 ting4 baan1 wing6 lit6, daai6 gaa1 dou1 m4 gam2 ceot1 seng1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他的怒气如雷霆般猛烈，大家都不敢出声。
examples.english_sentence: His anger was as fierce as thunder, and everyone dared not make a sound.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 政府決定用雷霆手段打擊貪污，決不寬待。
examples.jyutping_sentence: zing3 fu2 kyut3 ding6 jung6 leoi4 ting4 sau2 dyun6 daa2 gik1 taam1 wu1, kyut3 bat1 fun1 doi6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 政府决定用雷霆手段打击贪污，决不宽待。
