examples.english_sentence: This person looks familiar to me.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢聽落有啲面熟，係咪之前同我哋講過嘢？
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 teng1 lok6 jau5 di1 min6 suk6, hai6 mai6 zi1 cin4 tung4 ngo5 dei6 gong2 gwo3 je5?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他听起来有点面熟，是不是之前跟我们说过话？
examples.english_sentence: He sounds a bit familiar — did he talk to us before?

examples.cantonese_sentence: 嗰幅畫好面熟，但我諗唔起係邊度睇過。
examples.jyutping_sentence: go2 fuk1 waa6 hou2 min6 suk6, daan6 ngo5 lam2 m4 hei2 hai6 bin1 dou6 tai2 gwo3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 那幅画很面熟，但我想不起在哪儿见过。
examples.english_sentence: That painting looks very familiar, but I can't recall where I've seen it.

mandarin_meaning: 厚顏無恥的人
english_meaning: a shameless person; someone brazen or thick-skinned
explanation_mandarin: 用來形容一個人非常厚顏無恥、臉皮很厚，做錯事或被揭發時仍不覺羞愧或不承認錯誤。
explanation_english: Used to describe someone who is shameless and thick-skinned — they show no shame and may refuse to admit mistakes even when exposed.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢做錯嘢都仲面燃大士，死唔認錯。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 zou6 co3 je5 dou1 zung6 min6 jin4 daai6 si6, sei2 m4 jing6 co3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他做錯事還厚著臉皮不認錯。
examples.english_sentence: He did something wrong and still shamelessly refuses to admit it.

mandarin_meaning: 丢脸；感到尴尬
english_meaning: to be embarrassed; to lose face; to be in an awkward/embarrassing situation
explanation_mandarin: 「面燶」是廣東話俗語，字面上可解作「臉被燒焦」，引申為在公眾或別人面前感到丟臉或尷尬。
explanation_english: "面燶" is a Cantonese colloquial expression literally meaning "face burned," used figuratively to describe feeling embarrassed, ashamed, or losing face in front of others.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 聽到佢咁講，我真係面燶晒。
examples.jyutping_sentence: teng1 dou3 keoi5 gam2 gong2, ngo5 zan1 hai6 min6 laan6 saai3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 听到他那样说，我真是丢脸极了。
examples.english_sentence: Hearing him say that, I was really embarrassed.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你唔好咁樣做，會令你面燶。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 m4 hou2 gam2 joeng6 zou6, wui5 ling6 nei5 min6 laan6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你别那样做，会让你丢脸。
examples.english_sentence: Don't do that, it'll make you lose face.

mandarin_meaning: 臉上顯得尷尬、窘迫或羞愧的樣子
english_meaning: having an embarrassed, sheepish, or awkward expression
explanation_mandarin: 「面燶燶」是香港口語，形容一個人臉色或表情顯得尷尬、窘迫或不好意思，好像被難為或羞愧了。
explanation_english: A Hong Kong colloquial expression describing someone who looks embarrassed, sheepish, or awkward — their facial expression shows discomfort or shame.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 阿仔考試唔及格，返到屋企面燶燶，唔敢望阿爸。
examples.jyutping_sentence: aa3 zai2 haau2 si3 m4 kap6 gaak3, faan1 dou3 uk1 kei5 min6 laam6 laam6, m4 gam2 mong6 aa3 baa4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 兒子考試不及格，回到家裡臉上很尷尬，不敢看爸爸。
examples.english_sentence: The son failed the exam; when he got home he looked sheepish and didn't dare to look at his dad.

mandarin_meaning: 面上的小痘痘/粉刺
english_meaning: small pimples or whiteheads on the face
explanation_mandarin: 廣東話俗語，指長在臉上的小丘疹或粉刺，常用來描述青春期或皮脂分泌旺盛引起的痘痘。
explanation_english: A Cantonese colloquial term for small pimples or whiteheads on the face, commonly used to describe acne-related bumps from puberty or oily skin.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 近排我面上出咗好多面珠，真係煩。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gan6 paai4 ngo5 min6 soeng6 ceot1 zo2 hou2 do1 min6 zyu1, zan1 hai6 faan4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 最近我脸上长了很多面珠，真烦。
examples.english_sentence: Lately I've had a lot of pimples on my face; it's really annoying.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢個面布滿咗面珠，建議去睇皮膚科處理。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 go3 min6 bou3 mun5 zo2 min6 zyu1, gin3 ji5 heoi3 tai2 pei4 fu1 fo1 cyu2 lei5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他/她的脸上满是面珠，建议去看皮肤科处理。
examples.english_sentence: Their face is covered with pimples; it's recommended to see a dermatologist for treatment.

mandarin_meaning: 满脸痘痘／长满粉刺（俚语）
english_meaning: covered in pimples / acne-ridden (slang)
explanation_mandarin: 「面珠墩」為香港粵語俚語，字面上是「臉上像珠子一樣凸起的東西」，用來形容臉上長滿痘痘或粉刺，帶有口語、略帶幽默或貶義的語氣。
explanation_english: A Hong Kong Cantonese slang term literally meaning "face-bead-mound." It describes a face covered with pimples or acne, used colloquially (often humorously or disparagingly).

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你成個面都係面珠墩，快啲去睇皮膚科啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 sing4 go3 min6 dou1 hai6 min6 zyu1 deon1, faai3 di1 heoi3 tai2 pei4 fu1 fo1 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你整張臉都是痘痘，快點去看皮膚科吧。
examples.english_sentence: Your whole face is covered in pimples — go see a dermatologist.

mandarin_meaning: 面瘫（臉部麻痺）；（口語）面無表情、呆板表情
english_meaning: facial palsy (facial paralysis); (informal) expressionless face, poker face
explanation_mandarin: 「面癱」可指醫學上的面部癱瘓（如顏面神經麻痺），導致臉部一側無力或表情不對稱；在口語中也常用來形容一個人面無表情、表情僵硬或冷面不動。
explanation_english: “面癱” can refer to the medical condition facial palsy (facial paralysis), causing weakness or asymmetry of the face. Informally, it’s used to describe someone who is expressionless or has a stiff, unresponsive facial expression (poker face).

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢最近好似得咗面癱，一邊面歪咗。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 zeoi3 gan6 hou2 ci5 dak1 zo2 min6 taan1, jat1 bin1 min6 waai1 zo2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他最近好像得了面瘫，嘴角歪了一邊。
examples.english_sentence: He recently seems to have facial palsy; one side of his mouth is drooping.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢成日都面癱，無論發生咩事都冇表情。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 sing4 jat6 dou1 min6 taan1, mou4 leon6 faat3 saang1 me1 si6 dou1 mou5 biu2 cing4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他總是面癱，無論發生什麼事都沒有表情。
examples.english_sentence: He's always expressionless; no matter what happens he shows no expression.

mandarin_meaning: 脸皮；（食物）面皮（如陕北/陕西的凉拌面皮）
english_meaning: face/skin (literal); dumpling/wrapper or regional cold noodle/pancake called 'mianpi' (food); figuratively: shamelessness, thick-skinned (having a lot of nerve)
explanation_mandarin: 1) 字面：指臉的皮膚或用於包裹食物的麵皮。2) 引申：指臉皮、面子，常用來表示厚臉皮或無恥（例如『很有面皮』表示很厚臉皮）。
explanation_english: 1) Literal: the skin of the face or a sheet/wrapper made of dough used in some foods. 2) Figurative: one's 'face' — used to indicate shamelessness or being thick-skinned ('having a lot of nerve').

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢真係好有面皮，做錯嘢都唔會認錯。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 zan1 hai6 hou2 jau5 min6 pei4, zou6 co3 je5 dou1 m4 wui5 jing6 co3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他真的是很有脸皮，做错事也不会认错。
examples.english_sentence: He's really shameless; he won't admit his mistakes.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我好想食陝西嘅面皮，嗰種涼拌面皮好開胃。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 hou2 soeng2 sik6 saan2 sai1 ge3 min6 pei4, go2 zung2 loeng4 baan6 min6 pei4 hou2 hoi1 wai6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我很想吃陕西的面皮，那种凉拌面皮很开胃。
examples.english_sentence: I really want to eat Shaanxi mianpi; that kind of cold seasoned mianpi is very appetizing.

mandarin_meaning: 臉皮厚／厚臉皮（厚顏無恥，臉面厚）
english_meaning: thick-skinned; shameless; brazen
explanation_mandarin: 表示一個人臉皮很厚，不容易害羞或感到羞愧，常用來形容厚顏無恥或不知悔改的人。
explanation_english: Describes someone who is 'thick-skinned'—not easily embarrassed or ashamed; often used to describe a shameless or brazen person.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢真係面皮厚，明知道錯仲唔道歉。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 zan1 hai6 min6 pei4 hau5, ming4 zi1 dou3 co3 zung6 m4 dou6 hip3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他真是臉皮厚，明知道錯還不道歉。
examples.english_sentence: He's really thick-skinned; he knows he's wrong but still won't apologize.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 喺街市講價，你要面皮厚啲先有機會平啲。
examples.jyutping_sentence: hai2 gaai1 si5 gong2 gaa3, nei5 jiu3 min6 pei4 hau5 di1 sin1 jau5 gei1 wui6 peng4 di1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 在菜市場講價要厚臉皮才有可能買到便宜一點。
examples.english_sentence: At the market, you need to be a bit thick-skinned to have a chance of getting a lower price.

mandarin_meaning: 面盆 / 臉盆 / 洗臉盆
english_meaning: washbasin; basin (used for washing face, hands, vegetables, etc.)
explanation_mandarin: 指用來盛水或洗臉、洗手、洗菜等的盆子，常見於浴室、廁所或家居日常使用。香港粵語中常直接稱為「面盆」。
explanation_english: A basin used to hold water for washing the face, hands, vegetables, etc. Commonly found in bathrooms, toilets, or used around the home. In Hong Kong Cantonese it is commonly called "面盆".

examples.cantonese_sentence: 廁所入面有個面盆可以洗手。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ci3 so2 jap6 min6 jau5 go3 min6 pun4 ho2 ji5 sai2 sau2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 厕所里面有个面盆可以洗手。
examples.english_sentence: There is a basin in the restroom where you can wash your hands.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 阿媽用面盆洗菜。
examples.jyutping_sentence: aa3 maa1 jung6 min6 pun4 sai2 coi3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 妈妈用面盆洗菜。
examples.english_sentence: Mom uses a basin to wash vegetables.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 朝早我喺面盆度洗面。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ziu1 zou2 ngo5 hai2 min6 pun4 dou6 sai2 min6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 早上我在面盆那裡洗脸。
examples.english_sentence: In the morning I wash my face at the basin.

mandarin_meaning: 面貌；容貌；样子（亦可指事物的面貌、面貌的改变）
english_meaning: face; appearance; aspect (of a person or thing)
explanation_mandarin: 指人的脸或外表，也可引申为事物的面貌或样子。常见於成语，如“面目全非”、“面目可憎”。
explanation_english: Refers to a person's face or outward appearance; can also denote the aspect or look of something. Frequently appears in idioms such as '面目全非' (completely changed) or '面目可憎' (detestable-looking).

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢而家嘅面目同以前完全唔同。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 ji4 gaa1 ge3 min6 muk6 tung4 ji5 cin4 jyun4 cyun4 m4 tung4
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他现在的面目和以前完全不同。
examples.english_sentence: His appearance now is completely different from before.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢做咗啲惡事，真係面目可憎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 zou6 zo2 di1 ngok6 si6, zan1 hai6 min6 muk6 ho2 zang1
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他做了些坏事，真是面目可憎。
examples.english_sentence: He committed some bad deeds; he is truly repulsive.

mandarin_meaning: 面貌完全改變；大變樣
english_meaning: to be completely changed or unrecognizable; to have undergone a drastic transformation
explanation_mandarin: 形容事物或人的樣子、狀態發生巨大改變，與原來完全不同或難以辨認。
explanation_english: Describes something or someone whose appearance or condition has changed so much that it looks completely different or is unrecognizable.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 大火之後，成條街面目全非，連啲熟悉嘅地標都唔見咗。
examples.jyutping_sentence: daai6 fo2 zi1 hau6, sing4 tiu4 gaai1 min6 muk6 cyun4 fei1, lin4 di1 suk6 sik1 ge3 dei6 biu1 dou1 m4 gin3 zo2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 大火以後，整條街面目全非，連熟悉的地標都不見了。
examples.english_sentence: After the big fire, the whole street was unrecognizable; even familiar landmarks were gone.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 經過多年重建，舊區面目全非，已經變得現代化好多。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ging1 gwo3 do1 nin4 cung4 gin3, gau6 keoi1 min6 muk6 cyun4 fei1, ji5 ging1 bin3 dak1 jin6 doi6 faa3 hou2 do1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 經過多年重建，舊區面目全非，已經變得現代化很多。
examples.english_sentence: After years of reconstruction, the old district was completely transformed and became much more modern.

mandarin_meaning: 面目可憎（形容令人討厭、可惡或令人厭惡的外表或表情）
english_meaning: odious; repulsive; hateful (describing a look, appearance, or behavior that provokes disgust or dislike)
explanation_mandarin: 用來形容外貌、表情或言行讓人感到厭惡、討厭或想避開，帶有強烈負面評價。
explanation_english: Used to describe someone's appearance, expression, or behavior that is so hateful or repulsive that it provokes disgust or a desire to avoid them.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢成日擺出嗰種面目可憎嘅樣，冇人想同佢傾偈。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 sing4 jat6 baai2 ceot1 go2 zung2 min6 muk6 ho2 zang1 ge3 joeng6, mou5 jan4 soeng2 tung4 keoi5 king1 gai2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他總是擺出那副面目可憎的樣子，沒人想和他聊天。
examples.english_sentence: He always puts on such an odious look; nobody wants to chat with him.

mandarin_meaning: 面容模糊、不清晰；也可比喻变得认不出来或面目全非
english_meaning: having a blurred or indistinct face/features; unrecognizable; figuratively, drastically changed or unrecognizable
explanation_mandarin: 用來形容人的面容或影像看不清楚、輪廓不清；引申為變得面目全非、認不出來。
explanation_english: Used to describe a person's face or an image that is unclear or indistinct in outline; can be extended figuratively to mean someone or something has changed so much as to be unrecognizable.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 張相太模糊，佢嘅面目模糊到認唔出嚟。
examples.jyutping_sentence: zoeng1 soeng2 taai3 mou4 wu4, keoi5 ge3 min6 muk6 mou4 wu4 dou3 jing6 m4 ceot1 lai4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 照片太模糊，他的面目模糊到认不出来。
examples.english_sentence: The photo is so blurry that his face is unrecognizable.

mandarin_meaning: 面容凶惡、狰狞，表情凶狠、可怕
english_meaning: having a ferocious, grim, or ghastly appearance; looking savage or menacing
explanation_mandarin: 用來形容人的面容或表情非常凶惡、扭曲或可怕，常因憤怒、受傷或兇狠的狀態而表現出來，也可做比喻用。
explanation_english: Describes a person's face or expression as extremely fierce, distorted, or terrifying—often due to anger, injury, or violent intent. Can also be used figuratively.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 嗰個罪犯面目猙獰，嚇到啲路人四散而逃。
examples.jyutping_sentence: go2 go3 zeoi6 faan6 min6 muk6 zang1 ning4, haak3 dou3 di1 lou6 jan4 sei3 saan3 ji4 tou4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 那个罪犯面目狰狞，把路人都吓得四散逃跑。
examples.english_sentence: The criminal's face was ferocious and ghastly, scaring passersby into scattering and fleeing.

mandarin_meaning: 面相（面相學／相術）— 通過觀察面部特徵來推測性格、運勢、命運等
english_meaning: physiognomy; face-reading — judging character, fate, or luck by a person's facial features
explanation_mandarin: 指研究和觀察人的面部特徵（如額頭、眉毛、鼻子等）以判斷其性格或運勢的一種民間術數或觀察方法。
explanation_english: Refers to the traditional practice of observing facial features (forehead, eyebrows, nose, etc.) to infer a person's character, luck, or destiny.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 有啲人好信面相，覺得睇面相可以知命運。
examples.jyutping_sentence: jau5 di1 jan4 hou2 seon3 min6 soeng3, gok3 dak1 tai2 min6 soeng3 ho2 ji5 zi1 ming6 wan6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 有些人很信面相，覺得看面相可以知道命運。
examples.english_sentence: Some people strongly believe in face-reading, thinking it can reveal a person's fate.

mandarin_meaning: 面积 (miànjī)
english_meaning: area (surface area, usually measured in square units)
explanation_mandarin: 表示平面或物体表面的大小，通常以平方单位（例如平方米、平方呎）来计量。
explanation_english: Refers to the size of a surface or region, usually measured in square units (e.g., square meters, square feet).

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢個商場嘅總面積有十萬平方呎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 go3 soeng1 coeng4 ge3 zung2 min6 zik1 jau5 sap6 maan6 ping4 fong1 cek3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这个商场的总面积有十万平方英尺。
examples.english_sentence: The mall's total area is 100,000 square feet.

mandarin_meaning: 臉紅
english_meaning: to blush; to have a red/flushed face
explanation_mandarin: 形容臉部變紅，常因害羞、尷尬、憤怒、運動或發燒等引起。
explanation_english: Describes the face turning red or becoming flushed, commonly caused by blushing from embarrassment or shyness, anger, physical exertion, or fever.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢俾人讚嘅時候就面紅咗。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 bei2 jan4 zam3 ge3 si4 hau6 zau6 min6 hung4 zo2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他被人讚美的時候就臉紅了。
examples.english_sentence: He blushes when he is praised.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢跑完步成個面都紅晒。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 paau2 jyun4 bou6 sing4 go3 min6 dou1 hung4 saai3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他跑完步整個臉都紅了。
examples.english_sentence: After running, his whole face was flushed.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢俾人鬧到面紅耳赤。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 bei2 jan4 naau6 dou3 min6 hung4 ji5 cek3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他被人罵到面紅耳赤。
examples.english_sentence: He was scolded until he was red in the face.

mandarin_meaning: 臉紅紅（臉泛紅、害羞或尷尬時臉色發紅）
english_meaning: blushing; having a flushed/red face (due to shyness, embarrassment, fever, or strong emotion)
explanation_mandarin: 用來形容臉部發紅的狀態，常見於害羞、尷尬、害怕或情緒激動時，也可指因發燒或運動而臉紅。
explanation_english: Describes a reddened face — commonly used for blushing from shyness or embarrassment, but can also indicate flushing from fever, exertion, or strong emotions.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢見到心儀嘅人就面紅紅，好可愛。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 gin3 dou2 sam1 ji4 ge3 jan4 zau6 min6 hung4-hung4, hou2 ho2 oi3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他看到心儀的人就臉紅紅，很可愛。
examples.english_sentence: He gets all red in the face when he sees the person he likes — it's really cute.

mandarin_meaning: 臉紅耳赤
english_meaning: face and ears flushed; blushing or flushed from anger/embarrassment/excitement
explanation_mandarin: 形容因為生氣、害羞或激動而臉色發紅，耳朵也泛紅的樣子。
explanation_english: Describes someone whose face and ears have turned red due to anger, embarrassment, or strong emotion.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢畀人當眾指責，氣到面紅耳赤。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 bei2 jan4 dong3 zung3 zi2 zaak3, hei3 dou3 min6 hung4 ji5 cek3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他被人当众指责，气得脸红耳赤。
examples.english_sentence: He was publicly criticized and got so angry that his face and ears turned red.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 有人讚佢靚，佢即刻面紅耳赤，害羞地笑咗。
examples.jyutping_sentence: jau5 jan4 zaan3 keoi5 leng3, keoi5 zik1 hak1 min6 hung4 ji5 cek3, hoi6 sau1 de1 siu3 zo2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 有人夸他长得漂亮，他立刻脸红耳赤，害羞地笑了。
examples.english_sentence: When someone complimented his looks, he immediately blushed and smiled shyly.

mandarin_meaning: （相当于）脸红脸绿；形容在争执或激动时脸色大起大落、慌张或愤怒
english_meaning: Literally 'face red, face green' — an idiom describing someone becoming visibly agitated, flushed or upset (often during a heated argument or embarrassment)
explanation_mandarin: 「面紅面綠」用來形容人在激動、爭論或尷尬時，臉色出現紅、綠（或變化很大）的情況，表示情緒激烈或慌張。
explanation_english: This Cantonese idiom describes a person whose facial color changes dramatically (red, green, etc.) due to agitation, embarrassment, or a heated argument — indicating strong emotion or fluster.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢喺會議入面同客人鬧到面紅面綠。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hai2 wui6 ji5 jap6 min6 tung4 haak3 jan4 naau6 dou3 min6 hung4 min6 luk6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他在会议上和客户吵得面红面绿。
examples.english_sentence: He argued heatedly with the client in the meeting.

mandarin_meaning: 面纱 (miàn shā)：覆盖于面部的薄纱，或比喻遮掩事物的东西
english_meaning: veil (a thin piece of fabric worn over the face); figuratively, something that conceals
explanation_mandarin: 指覆蓋在臉上的薄紗或布料，用於遮掩面容或裝飾；亦可引申為遮掩真相或意圖的事物。
explanation_english: A thin piece of fabric worn over the face for concealment or decoration; can also be used metaphorically for anything that hides the truth or intentions.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢戴住面紗，好難認出佢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 daai3 zyu6 min6 saa1, hou2 naan4 jing6 ceot1 keoi5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 她戴着面纱，很难认出她。
examples.english_sentence: She is wearing a veil; it's hard to recognize her.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 傳統新娘會戴面紗，象徵純潔。
examples.jyutping_sentence: cyun4 tung2 san1 noeng4 wui5 daai3 min6 saa1, zoeng6 zing1 seon4 git6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 传统新娘会戴面纱，象征纯洁。
examples.english_sentence: A traditional bride wears a veil, symbolizing purity.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 要揭開貪污嘅面紗，真相先會浮現。
examples.jyutping_sentence: jiu3 kit3 hoi1 taam1 wu1 ge3 min6 saa1, zan1 soeng6 sin1 wui5 fau4 jin6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 要揭开贪污的面纱，真相才会浮现。
examples.english_sentence: We must lift the veil of corruption for the truth to emerge.

mandarin_meaning: 洗臉用的盆（洗面盆、臉盆）
english_meaning: washbasin; face basin (a bowl used for washing the face or hands)
explanation_mandarin: 指放在衛生間或浴室中用來洗臉或洗手的盆。在廣東話口語中可用來指洗面盆或臉盆。
explanation_english: Refers to a basin placed in a bathroom or washroom used for washing the face or hands. In Cantonese usage it denotes a washbasin/face basin.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋要買個新面缽放喺廁所。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 jiu3 maai5 go3 san1 min6 but3 fong3 hai2 ci3 so2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我們要買一個新的洗臉盆放在廁所裡。
examples.english_sentence: We need to buy a new washbasin for the bathroom.

mandarin_meaning: 拜神／參拜聖像；拜見重要人物或偶像
english_meaning: to pay respects (to a deity) at a temple; to have an audience with or meet an important person/celebrity (slang)
explanation_mandarin: 「面聖」原意為到廟裡或聖地參拜、向神明行禮求平安；在口語或流行語境下，也可指去見某位重要人物或偶像（有時帶求簽、求祝福或拍照的意味）。
explanation_english: Originally refers to visiting a temple or sacred place to pay respects to a deity; in colloquial/slang use it can also mean meeting or having an audience with an important person or a celebrity (often with the nuance of seeking favour, blessings, or taking a photo).

examples.cantonese_sentence: 新年我哋會去面聖，拜下神，祈求平安。
examples.jyutping_sentence: san1 nin4 ngo5 dei6 wui5 heoi3 min6 sing3, baai3 haa5 san4, kei4 kau4 ping4 on1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 新年我們會去拜神，祈求平安。
examples.english_sentence: For the New Year we go to the temple to pay respects and pray for safety.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 昨日喺演唱會見到偶像，我終於有機會面聖，仲影咗張相。
examples.jyutping_sentence: zo2 jat6 hai2 jin2 coeng3 wui6 gin3 dou2 ngau5 zoeng6, ngo5 zung1 jyu1 jau5 gei1 wui6 min6 sing3, zung6 jing2 zo2 zoeng1 soeng2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 昨天在演唱會看到偶像，我終於有機會見到（面聖），還拍了張照。
examples.english_sentence: Yesterday at the concert I saw my idol — I finally got to meet them and even took a photo.

mandarin_meaning: 面膜 (miànmó)，用於護膚、敷在臉上的產品
english_meaning: facial mask; a skincare product applied to the face (e.g., sheet mask or cream mask)
explanation_mandarin: 指敷在臉上以補水、滋養或護理皮膚的產品，常見款式有紙質（片狀）面膜和塗抹式面膜。
explanation_english: A product applied to the face for skincare purposes such as moisturizing or nourishing; common types include sheet masks and cream masks.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 今晚我敷咗一片面膜，好滋潤。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gam1maan5 ngo5 fuk1 zo2 jat1 pin3 min6 mok6, hou2 zi1 jeon6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 今晚我敷了一片面膜，很滋潤。
examples.english_sentence: I used a face mask tonight; it's very moisturizing.

mandarin_meaning: 面临 (miànlín) — 遇到或即將遇到（某種情況、困難或挑戰）
english_meaning: to face; to be faced with; to be confronted with (a situation, difficulty, challenge)
explanation_mandarin: 表示遇到或即將遇到某種情況、問題或困難，常用於正式或書面語，例如面臨危機、面臨挑戰。
explanation_english: Indicates encountering or being about to encounter a situation, problem, or difficulty. Commonly used in formal or written contexts (e.g., facing a crisis, facing a challenge).

examples.cantonese_sentence: 公司正面臨財政困難。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gung1 si1 zing3 min6 lam4 coi4 zing3 kwan3 naan4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 公司正面临财政困难。
examples.english_sentence: The company is facing financial difficulties.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋面臨一個艱難嘅決定。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 min6 lam4 jat1 go3 gaan1 naan4 ge3 kyut3 ding6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们面临一个艰难的决定。
examples.english_sentence: We're facing a difficult decision.

mandarin_meaning: 面色；臉色
english_meaning: complexion; facial expression; look (of health or mood)
explanation_mandarin: 表示臉部的顏色或神情，常用來描述一個人的健康狀況或情緒反應，例如面色蒼白、面色凝重等。
explanation_english: Refers to the color or appearance of the face and one's facial expression; commonly used to describe someone's health or emotional state (e.g., pale complexion, worried look).

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢今日面色唔好，可能病咗。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 gam1 jat6 min6 sik1 m4 hou2, ho2 nang4 beng6 zo2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他今天臉色不好，可能生病了。
examples.english_sentence: He looks unwell today; he might be sick.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你睇吓佢面色，佢好似唔開心。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 tai2 haa5 keoi5 min6 sik1, keoi5 hou2 ci5 m4 hoi1 sam1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你看看他的臉色，他好像不開心。
examples.english_sentence: Look at his expression; he seems unhappy.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 醫生話佢面色蒼白，要留醫觀察。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ji1 sang1 waa6 keoi5 min6 sik1 cong1 baak6, jiu3 lau4 ji1 gun1 caat3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 醫生說他面色蒼白，要留院觀察。
examples.english_sentence: The doctor said he looked pale and needs to be kept for observation.

mandarin_meaning: 外衣；外穿的上衣（口語）
english_meaning: outer shirt; top (worn over an undershirt)
explanation_mandarin: 口語用法，指在外面穿的上衣或外衫，通常與內衫或底衫相對。
explanation_english: A colloquial term for an outer shirt or top worn over inner layers (as opposed to an undershirt).

examples.cantonese_sentence: 出街要記得着件面衫，外面有風。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ceot1 gaai1 jiu3 gei3 dak1 zoek3 gin6 min6 saam1, ngoi6 min6 jau5 fung1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 出門記得穿上外衣，外面有風。
examples.english_sentence: Remember to put on an outer shirt before going out — it's windy outside.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢間舖賣唔同款式嘅面衫，好多顏色揀。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 gaan1 pou3 maai6 m4 tung4 fun2 sik1 ge3 min6 saam1, hou2 do1 ngaan4 sik1 gaan2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 這家店賣不同款式的上衣，有很多顏色可選。
examples.english_sentence: This shop sells different styles of tops — there are lots of colors to choose from.

mandarin_meaning: （香港俚語）口罩
english_meaning: face mask (slang, literally 'face trousers')
explanation_mandarin: 「面褲」是香港的非正式俚語，字面意思是「面上的褲子」，用來幽默或戲謔地指口罩或面罩，不屬於正式用語。
explanation_english: “面褲” is a Hong Kong colloquial/slang term literally meaning “face trousers.” It humorously refers to a face mask or face covering (i.e. 口罩). It is informal and used playfully.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 出街記得戴好你個面褲，保護自己同他人。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ceot1 gaai1 gei3 dak1 daai3 hou2 nei5 go3 min6 fu3, bou2 wu6 zi6 gei2 tung4 taa1 jan4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 出門記得把你的口罩戴好，保護自己和他人。
examples.english_sentence: Remember to wear your face mask when going out to protect yourself and others.

mandarin_meaning: 面诊（面对面就诊；也可指通过面相观察进行诊断）
english_meaning: face-to-face (in-person) medical consultation; (also) facial diagnosis (physiognomy)
explanation_mandarin: 通常指醫生與病人面對面進行診察或診療，也可用於中醫通過觀察面相來判斷病情的情況。
explanation_english: Usually refers to a doctor seeing a patient in person (face-to-face consultation). It can also mean the traditional Chinese medicine practice of diagnosing by observing the face (physiognomy).

examples.cantonese_sentence: 醫生話我需要面診，不能只電話跟進。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ji1 sang1 waa6 ngo5 seoi1 jiu3 min6 zan2, bat1 nang4 zi2 din6 waa2 gan1 zeon3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 医生说我需要面诊，不能只用电话跟进。
examples.english_sentence: The doctor said I need an in-person consultation; it can't be handled by phone alone.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 中醫會從面相做面診，睇下五官同膚色有冇問題。
examples.jyutping_sentence: zung1 ji1 wui5 cung4 min6 soeng1 zou6 min6 zan2, tai2 haa5 ng5 gun1 tung4 fu1 sik1 jau5 mou5 man6 tai4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 中医会通过面相做面诊，看看五官和肤色有没有问题。
examples.english_sentence: A TCM practitioner may diagnose by observing the face, checking facial features and skin color for issues.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 診所通知話明天要返去面診，記得帶埋病歷。
examples.jyutping_sentence: zan2 so2 tung1 zi1 waa6 ming4 tin1 jiu3 faan1 heoi3 min6 zan2, gei3 dak1 daai3 maai4 beng6 lik6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 诊所通知说明天要来面诊，记得带上病历。
examples.english_sentence: The clinic notified me to come for an in-person appointment tomorrow; remember to bring your medical records.

mandarin_meaning: 面试
english_meaning: interview (e.g., job interview)
explanation_mandarin: 指應徵者與僱主或面試官進行面對面的評估與問答，以評估是否適合某個職位或角色。
explanation_english: A meeting or process in which an applicant is questioned and evaluated (often for a job) to determine suitability for a position or role.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我聽日有個面試，要著得專業啲。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 ting1 jat6 jau5 go3 min6 si3, jiu3 zoek3 dak1 zyun1 jip6 di1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我明天有個面試，要穿得專業一點。
examples.english_sentence: I have an interview tomorrow; I need to dress more professionally.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 面試時記得帶埋履歷表同推薦信。
examples.jyutping_sentence: min6 si3 si4 gei3 dak1 daai3 maai4 leoi5 lik6 biu2 tung4 teoi1 zin3 seon3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 面试時記得帶上履歷表和推薦信。
examples.english_sentence: Remember to bring your resume and recommendation letters to the interview.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 公司會喺星期五面試應徵者。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gung1 si1 wui5 hai2 sing1 kei4 ng5 min6 si3 jing3 zaang1 ze2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 公司會在星期五面試應徵者。
examples.english_sentence: The company will interview applicants on Friday.

mandarin_meaning: 面试官
english_meaning: interviewer
explanation_mandarin: 在招聘或錄取過程中負責對應聘者進行面試、評估其能力與適配性的人。
explanation_english: A person who conducts interviews during a hiring or selection process, assessing candidates' qualifications and fit.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 聽日我有個面試，希望面試官唔會太嚴格。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ting1 jat6 ngo5 jau5 go3 min6 si3, hei1 mong6 min6 si3 gun1 m4 wui5 taai3 jim4 gaak3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 明天我有個面試，希望面試官不會太嚴格。
examples.english_sentence: I have an interview tomorrow; I hope the interviewer won't be too strict.

mandarin_meaning: 面谈（当面交谈或进行面对面面试）
english_meaning: to have a face-to-face talk; to interview in person
explanation_mandarin: 表示當面交談或面對面進行談話、詢問或面試，可用於工作面試、醫患溝通或正式會談等場合。
explanation_english: Refers to talking face-to-face or conducting an in-person interview/meeting. Used for job interviews, medical consultations, or formal meetings.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋下星期要面談應徵者。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 haa6 sing1 kei4 jiu3 min6 taam4 jing3 zing1 ze2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们下星期要面谈应征者。
examples.english_sentence: We will have face-to-face interviews with the applicants next week.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 醫生要求病人親身面談病情。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ji1 sang1 jiu1 kau4 beng6 jan4 can1 san1 min6 taam4 beng6 cing4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 医生要求病人亲身面谈病情。
examples.english_sentence: The doctor asked the patient to discuss their condition in person.

mandarin_meaning: 面议（可当面商讨；（薪资等）可协商）
english_meaning: to be discussed in person; negotiable (e.g., salary)
explanation_mandarin: 表示某事項需當面討論或條件可協商，常見於招聘信息中指薪酬可商議。
explanation_english: Indicates that something should be discussed in person or that terms are negotiable; commonly used in job postings to mark salary as negotiable.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢份工嘅人工可以面議。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 fan6 gung1 ge3 jan4 gung1 ho2 ji5 min6 ji5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 這份工作的薪水可以面議。
examples.english_sentence: The salary for this job is negotiable.

mandarin_meaning: 面貌 (miàn mào)：外表、容貌、面容；也可指事物或環境的表面狀態或面貌
english_meaning: appearance; looks; visage; the aspect or outward appearance of a person, place, or thing
explanation_mandarin: 表示人的外表或容貌，也可用來描述城市、景觀等的外在樣貌或面貌變化，語氣較書面。
explanation_english: Refers to a person's outward appearance or visage; can also describe the outward aspect of a place or thing (e.g., the appearance of a city). The term is relatively formal.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢嘅面貌令人難忘。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 ge3 min6 maau6 ling6 jan4 naan4 mong4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他的面貌令人難忘。
examples.english_sentence: His appearance is unforgettable.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢座城市嘅面貌改變咗好多。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 zo6 sing4 si5 ge3 min6 maau6 goi2 bin3 zo2 hou2 do1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 這座城市的面貌改變了很多。
examples.english_sentence: The appearance of this city has changed a lot.

mandarin_meaning: 面部（臉部）
english_meaning: face; facial area
explanation_mandarin: 指人的臉的部位，常在醫學、護膚或描述外觀時使用。
explanation_english: Refers to the facial area of a person; commonly used in medical, skincare, or appearance-related contexts.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 請用溫水清洗面部。
examples.jyutping_sentence: cing2 jung6 wan1 seoi2 cing1 sai2 min6 bou6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 请用温水清洗面部。
examples.english_sentence: Please wash your face with warm water.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 面部紅腫可能係過敏反應。
examples.jyutping_sentence: min6 bou6 hung4 zung2 ho2 nang4 hai6 gwo3 man5 faan2 jing3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 面部红肿可能是过敏反应。
examples.english_sentence: Facial swelling and redness may be an allergic reaction.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢對自己面部嘅斑點好在意。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 deoi3 zi6 gei2 min6 bou6 ge3 baan1 dim2 hou2 zoi6 ji3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他/她对自己面部的斑点很在意。
examples.english_sentence: He/she is very concerned about the spots on their face.

mandarin_meaning: 板着脸；面露不悦；撅着脸
english_meaning: sulky; wearing a sullen or displeased facial expression
explanation_mandarin: 粵語口語，用來形容人面部表情不高興、悶悶不樂或有點生氣，通常表示某人板著臉或擺臭臉的樣子。
explanation_english: A colloquial Cantonese expression describing someone who has a sulky, sullen, or displeased look on their face — essentially 'giving a sour face' or sulking.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你點解面阻阻咁？發生咩事？
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 dim2 gaai2 min6 zo2 zo2 gam2? faat3 saang1 me1 si6?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你為什麼板著臉？發生了什麼事？
examples.english_sentence: Why are you sulking? What happened?

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢考唔到第一名，返屋企就面阻阻。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 haau2 m4 dou2 dai6 jat1 ming4, faan1 uk1 kei5 zau6 min6 zo2 zo2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他考不到第一名，回家就板著臉。
examples.english_sentence: He didn't get first place on the exam and came home sulking.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 早晨見到你面阻阻，希望你今日會好啲。
examples.jyutping_sentence: zou2 san4 gin3 dou3 nei5 min6 zo2 zo2, hei1 mong6 nei5 gam1 jat6 wui5 hou2 di1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 早上見到你板著臉，希望你今天會好一點。
examples.english_sentence: I saw you looking sulky this morning; hope you'll feel better today.

mandarin_meaning: 臉色發青 / 臉色蒼白
english_meaning: to look pale/ashen; to have a greenish or sickly complexion
explanation_mandarin: 用來形容臉色變得發青或蒼白，通常因為害怕、驚嚇、噁心或生病而出現，是口語中描述臉色的用法。
explanation_english: Describes a person whose face becomes pale or greenish, usually due to fear, shock, nausea, or illness. A colloquial adjective used to describe facial complexion.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 見到血佢即刻面青咗，講唔出話來。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gin3 dou3 hyut3 keoi5 zik1 haak1 min6 cing1 zo2, gong2 m4 ceot1 waa6 loi4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 看到血他立刻臉色發青，說不出話來。
examples.english_sentence: He turned pale at the sight of blood and couldn't speak.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 收到嗰封信之後，佢面青咗，唔知發生咩事。
examples.jyutping_sentence: sau1 dou3 go2 fung1 seon3 zi1 hau6, keoi5 min6 cing1 zo2, m4 zi1 fat1 sang1 me1 si6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他收到那封信後臉色發青，不知道發生了什麼事。
examples.english_sentence: After receiving the letter, he looked pale and didn't know what had happened.

mandarin_meaning: 面色發青、嘴唇發白，形容非常驚恐或因病嚴重而憔悴
english_meaning: face turns pale/greenish and lips white; describes someone extremely frightened, shocked, or severely ill and looking very pale
explanation_mandarin: 「面青口唇白」用來形容一個人因驚嚇、驚恐或病重而臉色蒼白、嘴唇失去血色的樣子。
explanation_english: This idiom describes a person whose face has gone pale (greenish) and lips turned white, typically from extreme fear, shock, or severe illness.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 見到嗰條蛇，佢即刻面青口唇白，驚到話都講唔出嚟。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gin3 dou2 go2 tiu4 se4, keoi5 zik1 hak1 min6 ceng1 hau2 seon4 baak6, ging1 dou3 waa6 dou1 gong2 m4 ceot1 lai4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 看到那條蛇，他立刻面色發青、嘴唇發白，嚇得連話都說不出來。
examples.english_sentence: When he saw the snake, he immediately went pale and white-lipped, so frightened he couldn't even speak.

mandarin_meaning: 脸色发青／面色发绿（表示因害怕、恶心或生病而脸色不好）
english_meaning: to look pale/greenish; to appear sick, nauseous, or frightened
explanation_mandarin: 口語說法，形容臉色發青或顯得不舒服，通常因為害怕、噁心、暈眩或身體不適所致。
explanation_english: A colloquial Cantonese expression describing someone's face looking green/pale, indicating sickness, nausea, shock, or fear.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 見到血嗰一刻，佢面青青，差啲就嘔。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gin3 dou2 hyut3 go2 jat1 hak1, keoi5 min6 ceng1 ceng1, caa1 di1 zau6 au2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 看到血的那一刻，他脸色发青，差点就要吐了。
examples.english_sentence: When he saw the blood, his face turned greenish — he almost vomited.

mandarin_meaning: 面面俱到；事事周全，沒有遺漏
english_meaning: to be comprehensive; to cover all aspects; to leave no loose ends; satisfy all parties
explanation_mandarin: 表示在各個方面都顧及到、沒有遺漏，形容處理得周全、圓滿。
explanation_english: Describes something that is thorough and covers every aspect without omission; often used to say a plan, explanation, or arrangement is comprehensive and satisfactory to all sides.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢個計劃寫得面面俱圓，老闆好滿意。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 go3 gai3 waak6 se2 dak1 min6 min6 geoi1 jyun4, lou5 baan2 hou2 mun5 ji3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他的計劃寫得面面俱圓，老闆很滿意。
examples.english_sentence: His plan is thorough and leaves no gaps; the boss is very pleased.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 為咗面面俱圓，佢哋花咗好耐時間溝通，確保冇人唔開心。
examples.jyutping_sentence: wai4 zo2 min6 min6 geoi1 jyun4, keoi5 dei6 faa1 zo2 hou2 noi6 si4 gaan3 kau1 tung1, kok3 bou2 mou5 jan4 m4 hoi1 sam1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 為了面面俱圓，他們花了很長時間溝通，確保沒有人不高興。
examples.english_sentence: To make everything satisfactory, they spent a long time communicating to ensure no one was unhappy.

mandarin_meaning: 面面相觑 / 相顾无言
english_meaning: to look at one another in awkward silence; to be at a loss for words
explanation_mandarin: 形容互相看着对方，不知道说什么或感到尴尬、茫然的样子。
explanation_english: Describes people looking at each other, unsure what to say — an awkward or bewildered silence.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 發生咗意外之後，大家面面相覷，唔知講咩好。
examples.jyutping_sentence: faat3 saang1 zo2 ji3 ngoi6 zi1 hau6, daai6 gaa1 min6 min6 soeng1 kwat3, m4 zi1 gong2 me1 hou2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 发生了意外之后，大家面面相觑，不知道说什么好。
examples.english_sentence: After the accident, everyone looked at one another in silence, not knowing what to say.

mandarin_meaning: 從各個方面全面觀察／考慮（面面俱到）
english_meaning: a comprehensive view; to consider/examine from all angles
explanation_mandarin: 指從各個方面或角度全面地觀察、分析或考慮事情，強調不遺漏任何一面。
explanation_english: Refers to examining or considering something from all aspects or angles; emphasizes being thorough and not overlooking any facet.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 做呢份風險評估，我哋要做一個面面觀嘅分析，唔好遺漏任何細節。
examples.jyutping_sentence: zou6 ni1 fan6 fung1 him2 ping4 gu1, ngo5 dei6 jiu3 zou6 jat1 go3 min6 min6 gwaan1 ge3 fan1 sik1, m4 hou2 wai4 lau6 jam6 ho4 sai3 zit3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 做這份風險評估，我們要做一個面面觀的分析，不要遺漏任何細節。
examples.english_sentence: When doing this risk assessment, we need a comprehensive analysis and must not miss any details.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢對呢個議題好有面面觀，咩角度都諗到。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 deoi3 ni1 go3 ji5 tai4 hou2 jau5 min6 min6 gwaan1, me1 gok3 dou6 dou1 lam2 dou3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他對這個議題有很全面的看法，從各個角度都有想過。
examples.english_sentence: He has a comprehensive perspective on this issue and has considered it from every angle.

mandarin_meaning: 面前 / 表面
english_meaning: in front of; surface / appearance
partOfSpeech_mandarin: 名詞 / 介詞短語（口語用法）
explanation_mandarin: 廣東話口語，用來表示「在某人或某物的面前」（相當於普通話的「面前」）或指事物的外表、表面（相當於「表面」）。具體含義視語境而定。
explanation_english: A colloquial Cantonese term used to indicate 'in front of' (in someone's presence) or to refer to the surface/appearance of something. The exact meaning depends on context.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好喺佢面頭講佢嘅私事。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 hai2 keoi5 min6 tau4 gong2 keoi5 ge3 si1 si6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 不要在他面前提他的私事。
examples.english_sentence: Don't bring up his private matters in front of him.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢件衫面頭好靚，但質料唔好。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 gin6 saam1 min6 tau4 hou2 leng3, daan6 zat1 liu6 m4 hou2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这件衣服表面很好看，但材质不好。
examples.english_sentence: The surface of this shirt looks nice, but the material isn't good.

mandarin_meaning: 面颊（臉部兩側的肉質部分）
english_meaning: cheek (the fleshy part on either side of the face)
explanation_mandarin: 指人的臉部兩側、位於眼睛下方的有肉部分，即臉頰，可指單邊或雙邊。
explanation_english: Refers to the fleshy part on either side of the face below the eyes — the cheek. Can refer to one cheek or both.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢笑到面頰都紅晒。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 siu3 dou3 min6 gaap3 dou1 hung4 saai3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他/她笑到面頰都紅了。
examples.english_sentence: He/She smiled until their cheeks turned red.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 醫生檢查佢面頰嘅傷口。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ji1 sang1 gim2 caa4 keoi5 min6 gaap3 ge3 soeng1 hau2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 醫生檢查了他面頰上的傷口。
examples.english_sentence: The doctor examined the wound on his cheek.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我喺面頰塗咗防曬霜。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 hai2 min6 gaap3 tou4 zo2 fong4 saai3 soeng1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我在面頰上塗了防曬霜。
examples.english_sentence: I applied sunscreen to my cheeks.

mandarin_meaning: 面额
english_meaning: face value; denomination
explanation_mandarin: 指貨幣、票據、禮券等上面標示的金額或票面價值，也可用於表示標示的金額大小（如票面價值）。
explanation_english: The amount printed or stated on currency, tickets, vouchers, etc.; the face value or denomination. Can also refer to the stated monetary amount of an item.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢張百元紙幣嘅面額係一百蚊。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 zoeng1 baak3 jyun4 zi2 bai3 ge3 min6 ngok6 hai6 jat1 baak3 man1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这张一百元纸币的面额是100元。
examples.english_sentence: The face value of this one-hundred-dollar banknote is 100 dollars.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好淨係睇面額，要睇實際價值。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 zing6 hai6 tai2 min6 ngok6, jiu3 tai2 sat6 zai3 gaa3 zik6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 不要只看面额，要看实际价值。
examples.english_sentence: Don't only look at the face value; consider the actual value.

mandarin_meaning: 面色发黄、蜡黄，形容脸色不好或显得虚弱、疲惫
english_meaning: sallow; having a yellowish, unhealthy-looking complexion; appearing unwell or fatigued
explanation_mandarin: 用于形容脸色呈黄色或蜡黄色，通常表示身体虚弱、病态、疲倦或营养不良。
explanation_english: Describes a yellowish or sallow facial complexion, typically indicating poor health, weakness, fatigue, or lack of sleep/nutrition.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢做完通宵之後，成日面黃黃，好似唔夠瞓。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 zou6 jyun4 tung1 siu1 zi1 hau6, sing4 jat6 min6 wong4 wong4, hou2 ci5 m4 gau3 fan3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他通宵工作之后，整天脸色发黄，好像没睡够。
examples.english_sentence: After pulling an all-nighter, he looked sallow all day, as if he hadn't had enough sleep.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 見到佢面黃黃，我就帶佢去睇醫生。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gin3 dou2 keoi5 min6 wong4 wong4, ngo5 zau6 daai3 keoi5 heoi3 tai2 ji1 sang1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 看到他面色发黄，我就带他去看医生。
examples.english_sentence: Seeing that his face was sallow, I took him to see a doctor.

mandarin_meaning: 臉龐；面容
english_meaning: face; visage; countenance
explanation_mandarin: 指人的臉龐、面貌，屬較書面或文雅的用法，可用來描述外表或表情特徵。
explanation_english: Refers to a person's face or visage; a more literary/formal term used to describe facial appearance or features.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 老人家嘅面龐滿佈皺紋，充滿故事。
examples.jyutping_sentence: lou5 jan4 gaa1 ge3 min6pong4 mun5 bou3 zau3man4, cung1 mun5 gu3si6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 老人的臉龐滿是皺紋，充滿故事。
examples.english_sentence: The old person's face was covered in wrinkles, full of stories.

mandarin_meaning: 害羞；靦腆（常見於詞語「靦腆」）
english_meaning: shy; bashful; embarrassed (often appears in the compound '靦腆')
explanation_mandarin: 表示害羞、不好意思，常與「腆」合用為「靦腆」，形容人含蓄、羞怯。
explanation_english: Indicates feeling shy or embarrassed. Often used in the compound '靦腆' to describe someone bashful or reserved.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢見到陌生人就顯得好靦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 gin3 dou2 mak6 sang1 jan4 zau6 hin2 dak1 hou2 tin2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他見到陌生人就顯得很害羞。
examples.english_sentence: He looks very shy when he meets strangers.

mandarin_meaning: 腼腆、害羞
english_meaning: shy; bashful; timid; reserved
explanation_mandarin: 形容一個人因害羞或不善表達而顯得拘謹、不自然。
explanation_english: Describes a person who appears shy, bashful, or reserved—often awkward or reluctant to show feelings openly.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢見到生人會靦腆咁笑。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 gin3 dou3 saang1 jan4 wui5 min5 tin2 gam2 siu3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他見到生人會靦腆地笑。
examples.english_sentence: He smiles shyly when he sees strangers.

mandarin_meaning: 靥（yè）；酒窝、笑窝（面颊上的小凹陷）
english_meaning: dimple (a small hollow in the cheek, especially visible when smiling)
explanation_mandarin: 指面頰上因肌肉或皮下結構形成的小凹陷，微笑時常會出現，即俗稱的酒窩或笑窩。
explanation_english: Refers to a small hollow on the cheek formed by muscle or subcutaneous structure, commonly seen when smiling — also known as a dimple.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢笑嘅時候面頰有兩個靨，好得意。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 siu3 ge3 si4hau6 min6 gaap3 jau5 loeng5 go3 jip6, hou2 dak1 ji3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他笑的时候面颊上有两个靥，很可爱。
examples.english_sentence: When he/she smiles there are two dimples on the cheeks — very cute.

mandarin_meaning: 皮革；改革；革除（職務）
english_meaning: leather; to reform; to dismiss (from office)
explanation_mandarin: 1) 指經過鞣製的動物皮材（皮革）。2) 作動詞時可表示改革、革新，或革除職務、罷免。
explanation_english: 1) Refers to leather (animal hide tanned for use). 2) As a verb, it can mean to reform/innovate or to remove/dismiss from a post.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢因為貪污被革職喇。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 jan1 wai6 taam1 wu1 bei6 gaak3 zik1 laa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他因為貪污被革職了。
examples.english_sentence: He was dismissed for corruption.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 公司要進行技術革新，否則會落後。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gung1 si1 jiu3 zeon3 hang4 gei6 seot6 gaak3 san1, fau2 zak1 wui5 lok6 hau6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 公司要進行技術革新，否則會落後。
examples.english_sentence: The company needs to carry out technological innovation, otherwise it will fall behind.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢件外套係用皮革整嘅。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 gin6 ngoi6 tou3 hai6 jung6 pei4 gaak3 zing2 ge3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 這件外套是用皮革做的。
examples.english_sentence: This coat is made of leather.

mandarin_meaning: 革命 (gémìng)
english_meaning: revolution; radical upheaval or fundamental change
partOfSpeech_english: noun; can also be used as a verb
explanation_mandarin: 指為推翻舊有政治、社會或經濟制度而進行的根本性變革，也可泛指徹底的改革或顛覆性的改變。
explanation_english: Refers to a fundamental change, especially the overthrow of an existing political, social, or economic system; can also mean a radical reform or transformative upheaval.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢場革命改變咗成個社會嘅結構。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 coeng4 gaak3 ming6 goi2 bin3 zo2 sing4 go3 se5 wui6 ge3 git3 kau3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这场革命改变了整个社会的结构。
examples.english_sentence: This revolution changed the structure of the entire society.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋鼓吹用和平方式推動改革，而唔係暴力革命。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 gu2 ceoi1 jung6 wo4 ping4 fong1 sik1 teoi1 dung6 goi2 gaak3, ji4 m4 hai6 bou6 lik6 gaak3 ming6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们鼓吹通过和平方式推动改革，而不是暴力革命。
examples.english_sentence: They advocate promoting reforms by peaceful means, not by violent revolution.

mandarin_meaning: 騙人、唬弄、開玩笑（俚語）
english_meaning: to fool/trick someone; to pull someone's leg; to talk nonsense (slang)
explanation_mandarin: 「革扯」為廣東話俚語，用來形容欺騙、哄騙別人或說大話、開玩笑，語氣較口語化，有時帶輕蔑或不信任的意味。
explanation_english: A Cantonese slang verb used to describe fooling or deceiving someone, pulling someone's leg, or talking nonsense. It is informal and can carry a dismissive or distrustful tone.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你唔好革扯我。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 m4 hou2 gaak3 ce2 ngo5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 別騙我。
examples.english_sentence: Don't fool me.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢成日革扯人，講嘢唔可靠。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 sing4 jat6 gaak3 ce2 jan4, gong2 je5 m4 ho2 kaau3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他常常騙人，說話不可靠。
examples.english_sentence: He often tricks people; his words can't be trusted.

mandarin_meaning: 革新（géxīn）：改革、创新、进行改良或更新
english_meaning: reform; innovate; to introduce reforms; innovation
explanation_mandarin: 指對制度、方法、技術等進行改良或更新，以適應新情況或提升效率。
explanation_english: To reform or renew systems, methods, or technologies; to bring about innovation or improvements.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 政府提出咗一啲政策，打算革新教育體系。
examples.jyutping_sentence: zing3 fu2 tai4 ceot1 zo2 jat1 di1 zing3 caak3, daa2 syun3 gaak3 san1 gaau3 juk6 tai2 hai6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 政府提出了一些政策，打算革新教育体系。
examples.english_sentence: The government proposed some policies and plans to reform the education system.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢間初創公司嘅最大優勢係佢哋嘅科技革新。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 gaan1 co1 cong3 gung1 si1 ge3 zeoi3 daai6 jau1 si6 hai6 keoi5 dei6 ge3 fo1 gei6 gaak3 san1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这家初创公司的最大优势是他们的科技革新。
examples.english_sentence: The biggest advantage of this startup is their technological innovations.

mandarin_meaning: 革職／革职（解除職務，罷免職位）
english_meaning: to dismiss from a post; to remove from office; to sack
explanation_mandarin: 表示解除某人的職務，從公職或公司職位中罷免或撤換該人。
explanation_english: Refers to removing someone from their job or official position; to dismiss or sack someone from their post.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 政府已經革職咗嗰名官員。
examples.jyutping_sentence: zing3 fu2 ji5 ging1 gaak3 zik1 zo2 go2 ming4 gun1 jyun4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 政府已經革職了那名官員。
examples.english_sentence: The government has already dismissed that official from his post.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 如果證據屬實，公司會考慮革職佢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: jyu4 gwo2 zing3 geoi3 suk6 sat6, gung1 si1 wui5 haau2 leoi6 gaak3 zik1 keoi5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 如果證據屬實，公司會考慮革職他/她。
examples.english_sentence: If the evidence is true, the company will consider dismissing him/her.

mandarin_meaning: 解除職務、革職或被迫辭職
english_meaning: to remove from office; to dismiss or force someone to resign
explanation_mandarin: 指公司、機構或上級解除某人的職務，或以壓力使其辭職，側重於被撤職或被迫退位、退職。
explanation_english: Refers to an organization or superior removing someone from their post, or forcing them to resign — emphasizes being dismissed or pressured to step down.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 公司決定革退佢，佢今日就收咗行李走人。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gung1 si1 kyut3 ding6 gaak3 teoi3 keoi5, keoi5 gam1 jat6 zau6 sau1 zo2 hang4 lei5 zau2 jan4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 公司决定革退他，他今天就收拾行李离开了。
examples.english_sentence: The company decided to dismiss him; he packed his things and left today.

mandarin_meaning: 去掉、废除或剔除（某种制度、习惯、弊端或人员等）
english_meaning: to abolish; to remove; to eradicate (e.g., a practice, system, malpractice, or personnel)
explanation_mandarin: 表示取消、废除或剔除某种不良制度、习惯、弊端或免去某人的职务，常用于正式语境。
explanation_english: Indicates cancelling, abolishing, or removing a bad system, custom, malpractice, or dismissing a person from a post; commonly used in formal contexts.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 政府決定革除嗰個貪污官員嘅職務。
examples.jyutping_sentence: zing3 fu2 kyut3 ding6 gaak3 ceoi4 go2 go3 taam1 wu1 gun1 jyun4 ge3 zik1 mou6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 政府决定革除那个贪污官员的职务。
examples.english_sentence: The government decided to remove the corrupt official from his position.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 要革除陳規陋習，首先要由教育入手。
examples.jyutping_sentence: jiu3 gaak3 ceoi4 can4 gwai1 lau6 zaap6, sau2 sin1 jiu3 jau4 gaau3 juk6 jap6 sau2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 要革除陈规陋习，首先要从教育入手。
examples.english_sentence: To eradicate outdated and bad customs, we must start with education.

mandarin_meaning: 韌（有韌性；堅韌）
english_meaning: tough; resilient; tenacious; pliable
explanation_mandarin: 表示材料有拉伸且不易斷裂的特性；也可比喻人具有堅韌、不輕易放棄的性格。
explanation_english: Describes a material that is flexible and resistant to breaking; metaphorically, it describes a person who is tenacious and unlikely to give up easily.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢塊橡膠好靭，唔容易裂。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 faai3 zoeng6 gaau1 hou2 jan6, m4 jung6 ji6 lit3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 這塊橡膠很有韌性，不容易裂開。
examples.english_sentence: This piece of rubber is very tough and doesn't crack easily.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢好靭，做嘢唔會輕易放棄。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hou2 jan6, zou6 je5 m4 wui5 hing1 ji6 fong3 hei3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他很有韌性，做事不會輕易放棄。
examples.english_sentence: He is very tenacious and doesn't give up easily when working on something.

mandarin_meaning: 靴子（例如長靴、短靴）
english_meaning: boot; boots
explanation_mandarin: 表示一種包覆腳部、通常高於一般鞋面的鞋類，常用來指靴子或長靴。
explanation_english: A type of footwear that covers the foot and often the ankle or lower leg; commonly refers to boots (e.g., long boots).

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我新買咗對長靴，好舒服。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 san1 maai5 zo2 deoi3 coeng4 hyut3, hou2 syu1 fuk6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我新買了一雙長靴，很舒服。
examples.english_sentence: I just bought a pair of long boots; they're very comfortable.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 落雨記得帶靴，唔好著涼。
examples.jyutping_sentence: lok6 jyu5 gei3 dak1 daai3 hyut3, m4 hou2 zoek3 loeng4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 下雨記得帶靴子，別著涼。
examples.english_sentence: Bring boots when it rains so you don't catch a cold.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢成日著運動鞋，極少著靴。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 sing4 jat6 zoek3 wan6 dung6 haai4, gik6 siu2 zoek3 hyut3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他經常穿運動鞋，很少穿靴子。
examples.english_sentence: He often wears sneakers and seldom wears boots.

mandarin_meaning: 非常驕傲／自大的（粵語口語）
english_meaning: very arrogant or conceited (colloquial Cantonese expression)
explanation_mandarin: 以「鼻子大」比喻自負、擺架子，前面加上「靴咁大」用來誇張其程度，通常用來批評某人很傲慢或自以為是。
explanation_english: Compares someone's nose to being as big as a boot as a humorous/exaggerated way to say they are vain or arrogant. It's a colloquial Cantonese expression used to criticize boastful or stuck-up behaviour.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢中咗大獎之後，就靴咁大個鼻，成日擺架子。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 zung1 zo2 daai6 zoeng2 zi1 hau6, zau6 hyut3 gam2 daai6 go3 bei6, sing4 jat6 baai2 gaa3 zi2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他中了一等奖之後，就變得很驕傲，整天擺架子。
examples.english_sentence: After winning the big prize, he became very arrogant and acted stuck-up all the time.

mandarin_meaning: （谎言、借口或掩饰）非常明显，无法掩盖；露出破绽
english_meaning: blatantly obvious; painfully obvious (an attempt to hide something that is easily seen through)
explanation_mandarin: 廣東話俗語，用來形容某些藉口、謊言或掩飾明顯得不能再明顯，人人都看得出來。常用來嘲諷或指責別人掩飾失敗。
explanation_english: A Cantonese colloquial/idiomatic expression used to describe an excuse, lie, or cover-up that is so obvious everyone can see through it. Often used to mock or call out someone's failed attempt to hide something.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你講嗰啲理由，靴咁大隻腳，邊個會信呀？
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 gong2 go2 di1 lei5 jau4, hyut3 gam2 daai6 zek3 goek3, bin1 go3 wui5 seon3 aa3?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你说的那些理由太明显了，谁会信呢？
examples.english_sentence: Those reasons you gave are blatantly obvious — who would believe them?

mandarin_meaning: 靶（靶子、目標）
english_meaning: target (e.g., for shooting or archery); goal/aim
explanation_mandarin: 指供射箭、射擊等練習或比賽時作為目標的物體，也可泛指目標或指向的對象。
explanation_english: Refers to an object used as a target in shooting, archery, etc.; can also be used more generally to mean a goal or target.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋去靶場練習射擊。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 heoi3 baa2 coeng4 lin6 zaap6 se6 gik1
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们去靶场练习射击。
examples.english_sentence: We're going to the shooting range to practice shooting.

mandarin_meaning: 鞋子（罕用字，為「鞋」的異體字）
english_meaning: shoe; footwear (rare/archaic character, variant of '鞋')
explanation_mandarin: 「靸」是一個較罕見的漢字，常作「鞋」的異體字，用於指鞋子或古代某類鞋履。在粵語口語中可用來指一般的鞋，但寫作上多用「鞋」。
explanation_english: 靸 is a rare/archaic character often used as a variant of 鞋 (shoe). It refers to footwear; in Cantonese speech it can denote shoes, though standard writing uses 鞋.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我今朝著靸去返工。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 gam1 ziu1 zoek3 haai4 heoi3 faan1 gung1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我今天早上穿上鞋去上班。
examples.english_sentence: This morning I put on my shoes to go to work.

mandarin_meaning: 鞋；鞋子（xié）
english_meaning: shoe; footwear
explanation_mandarin: 用於覆蓋和保護腳部的服飾或鞋具，泛指各種鞋類。
explanation_english: Footwear that covers and protects the foot; refers generally to all kinds of shoes.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我啲鞋好舊，想買對新鞋。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 di1 haai4 hou2 gau6, soeng2 maai5 deoi3 san1 haai4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我的鞋很舊，想買一雙新鞋。
examples.english_sentence: My shoes are very old; I want to buy a new pair.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 出街記得著鞋，唔好赤腳。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ceot1 gaai1 gei3 dak1 zoek3 haai4, m4 hou2 cek3 goek3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 出門記得穿鞋，不要赤腳。
examples.english_sentence: Remember to wear shoes when going out; don't go barefoot.

mandarin_meaning: 鞋子和屐子（泛指各種鞋類）
english_meaning: shoes and clogs (colloquially: footwear in general)
explanation_mandarin: 廣東話的口語說法，字面為「鞋仔」和「屐仔」，常用來泛指鞋類或在舖頭、市集的銷售用語；「仔」帶有小巧或親暱語氣。
explanation_english: A colloquial Cantonese expression literally meaning "shoes and clogs." It is often used to refer to footwear in general (common in shops/markets); the suffix "-zai" is a diminutive/affectionate marker.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢間舖頭賣鞋仔屐仔，好多款式任你揀。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 gaan1 pou3 tau4 maai6 haai4 zai2 gai3 zai2, hou2 do1 fun2 sik1 jam6 nei5 gaan2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 這間店賣鞋子和屐子，款式很多任你選。
examples.english_sentence: This shop sells shoes and clogs; there are many styles for you to choose from.

mandarin_meaning: 鞋匠（修鞋或製鞋的工匠）
english_meaning: cobbler; shoemaker; shoe repairer
explanation_mandarin: 指專門修理或製作鞋子的工匠，常在街市或小店幫人補鞋、換底等。
explanation_english: A craftsman who makes or repairs shoes; typically fixes, patches, or replaces soles in a small shop or market stall.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我爸爸以前係一個鞋匠，經常幫人修鞋。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 baa4 baa1 ji5 cin4 hai6 jat1 go3 haai4 zoeng6, ging1 soeng4 bong1 jan4 sau1 haai4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我爸爸以前是一個鞋匠，經常幫人修鞋。
examples.english_sentence: My father used to be a cobbler; he often repaired people's shoes.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 隻鞋壞咗，要搵鞋匠整返先得。
examples.jyutping_sentence: zek3 haai4 waai6 zo2, jiu3 wan2 haai4 zoeng6 zeng2 faan1 sin1 dak1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 這隻鞋壞了，要找鞋匠修理才行。
examples.english_sentence: The shoe is damaged; we need to find a cobbler to fix it.

mandarin_meaning: 鞋垫
english_meaning: insole; shoe insole; shoe insert
explanation_mandarin: 放在鞋內用以增加舒適度、減震或調整鞋內空間以保護腳部的墊子。
explanation_english: A pad placed inside a shoe to increase comfort, provide cushioning, reduce pressure or adjust the fit.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢對鞋好唔舒服，我要換個鞋墊。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 deoi3 haai4 hou2 m4 syu1 fuk6, ngo5 jiu3 wun6 go3 haai4 din6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 這雙鞋很不舒服，我要換個鞋墊。
examples.english_sentence: These shoes are very uncomfortable; I need to change the insole.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢買咗一對鞋墊，係為咗幫腳減壓。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 maai5 zo2 jat1 deoi3 haai4 din6, hai6 wai6 zo2 bong1 goek3 gaam2 aat3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他買了一對鞋墊，是為了幫腳減壓。
examples.english_sentence: He bought a pair of insoles to help relieve pressure on his feet.

mandarin_meaning: 鞋带 (xiédài)
english_meaning: shoelace
explanation_mandarin: 綁在鞋子上用來固定鞋面的細繩或帶子，用於綁緊鞋子。
explanation_english: A cord or lace used to fasten or secure shoes by tying them.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你嘅鞋帶鬆咗，要綁好先。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 ge3 haai4 daai3 sung1 zo2, jiu3 bong2 hou2 sin1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你的鞋带松了，要系好才行。
examples.english_sentence: Your shoelace is loose; tie it properly first.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 跑步嘅時候，我嘅鞋帶甩咗，要停低綁返。
examples.jyutping_sentence: paau2 bou6 ge3 si4 hau6, ngo5 ge3 haai4 daai3 lat1 zo2, jiu3 ting4 dai1 bong2 faan1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 跑步的时候，我的鞋带掉了，要停下来重新系好。
examples.english_sentence: While running my shoelace came undone; I need to stop and tie it again.

mandarin_meaning: 鞋码
english_meaning: shoe size
explanation_mandarin: 指鞋的尺寸或大小，即鞋码。常用于询问合适的鞋号或购买鞋子时确认尺寸。
explanation_english: Refers to the size of a shoe — the measurement or number used to indicate how large the shoe is. Commonly used when asking for or specifying a shoe size.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你鞋度係幾多？
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 haai4 dou6 hai6 gei2 do1?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你的鞋码是多少？
examples.english_sentence: What's your shoe size?

mandarin_meaning: 鞋抽：放鞋子的抽屜（口語、非標準用法）
english_meaning: shoe drawer (colloquial) — a drawer used to store shoes
explanation_mandarin: 「鞋抽」是較口語的說法，指用來放鞋子的抽屜或抽屜式的收納空間。標準或常見的說法包括「鞋櫃」或「鞋抽屜」。
explanation_english: A colloquial Cantonese expression referring to a drawer for storing shoes (i.e., a shoe drawer). More standard terms are "shoe cabinet" (鞋櫃) or "shoe drawer" (鞋抽屜).

examples.cantonese_sentence: 把鞋放返入鞋抽啦，唔好亂擺屋企。
examples.jyutping_sentence: baa2 haai4 fong3 faan1 jap6 haai4 cau1 laa1, m4 hou2 lyun6 baai2 uk1 kei2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 把鞋放回鞋抽，不要亂放在家裡。
examples.english_sentence: Put the shoes back into the shoe drawer; don't leave them lying around the house.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 張床下邊有個鞋抽，可以擺幾對鞋。
examples.jyutping_sentence: zoeng1 cong4 haa6 bin1 jau5 go3 haai4 cau1, ho2 ji5 baai2 gei2 deoi3 haai4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 床下有一個鞋抽，可以放幾雙鞋。
examples.english_sentence: There's a shoe drawer under the bed that can hold several pairs of shoes.

mandarin_meaning: 被當眾羞辱 / 丟臉
english_meaning: to be humiliated (especially publicly); to be made to lose face
explanation_mandarin: 廣東話俚語，字面上是「鞋打在面上」，比喻在別人面前被羞辱、丟臉或遭受重大打擊。
explanation_english: A Cantonese slang phrase literally meaning 'shoe hits the face'; figuratively it describes being humiliated or losing face, especially in public.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢喺大庭廣眾下講錯嘢，結果俾人鞋抽面。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hai6 daai6 ting4 gwong2 zung3 haa6 gong2 co3 je5, git3 gwo2 bei2 jan4 haai4 cau1 min6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他在大庭廣眾下說錯話，結果被人當眾羞辱。
examples.english_sentence: He said the wrong thing in public and ended up being humiliated.

mandarin_meaning: 鞋底
english_meaning: shoe sole
explanation_mandarin: 指鞋子的底部，即鞋底。此詞較書面或帶有方言色彩，在口語中常以「鞋底」稱呼。
explanation_english: Refers to the bottom part of a shoe — the sole. This term is somewhat literary or dialectal; in everyday speech people usually say "鞋底" (haai4 dai2) or "sole."

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢對鞋嘅鞋掌已經磨得好薄，要補底啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 deoi3 haai4 ge3 haai4 zoeng2 ji5 ging1 mo4 dak1 hou2 bok6, jiu3 bou2 dai2 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 這雙鞋的鞋底已經磨得很薄，要補底了。
examples.english_sentence: The soles of these shoes have worn very thin; they need resoling.

mandarin_meaning: 鞋油（擦亮和保養皮鞋的產品）
english_meaning: shoe polish (product for shining and caring for leather shoes)
explanation_mandarin: 鞋油是用來擦亮、上色和保養皮革製品（如皮鞋）的產品，常見為膏狀或液體，可延長皮鞋壽命並保持光澤。
explanation_english: Shoe polish is a product used to shine, color, and care for leather items (such as shoes). It commonly comes in cream or liquid form and helps extend the life and appearance of leather footwear.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我買咗支新鞋油，今晚抹返對皮鞋先。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 maai5 zo2 zi1 san1 haai4 jau4, gam1 maan5 mat6 faan1 deoi3 pei4 haai4 sin1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我買了支新的鞋油，今晚先把皮鞋擦一擦。
examples.english_sentence: I bought a new shoe polish; I'll polish my leather shoes tonight.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 阿姨教我點樣用鞋油保養皮鞋，咁可以延長佢哋嘅壽命。
examples.jyutping_sentence: aa3 ji4 gaau3 ngo5 dim2 joeng6 jung6 haai4 jau4 bou2 joeng5 pei4 haai4, gam2 ho2 ji5 jin4 coeng4 keoi5 dei6 ge3 sau6 ming6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 阿姨教我怎样用鞋油保养皮鞋，这样可以延长它们的寿命。
examples.english_sentence: My aunt taught me how to use shoe polish to care for leather shoes; that can extend their lifespan.

mandarin_meaning: （口語、少見）形容鞋子摩擦發出聲響或穿起來令人不舒服（如磨腳、太熱或太緊）
english_meaning: Colloquial/rare Cantonese term — an onomatopoeic description of shoes rubbing/squeaking or being uncomfortable (e.g. causing blisters, too hot, or too tight).
partOfSpeech_mandarin: 口語形容詞 / 擬聲詞
explanation_mandarin: 「鞋烚烚」為廣東話的擬聲或口語用法，並非標準詞彙。通常用來形容鞋子在行走時發出摩擦或黏滯的聲響，或指鞋子穿起來不舒服（磨腳、太熱或太緊）。此詞較罕見與地區性強，視語境可偏向聲響描寫或不適感描述。
explanation_english: “鞋烚烚” is a colloquial, onomatopoeic Cantonese expression (rare/regional). It usually describes shoes that make a rubbing/squeaking or sticky sound when walking, or shoes that are uncomfortable to wear (chafe, too hot, or too tight). Usage is limited and context-dependent — it can emphasize sound or discomfort.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢對鞋好鞋烚烚，行幾步就磨腳。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 deoi3 haai4 hou2 haai4 wat6 wat6, haang4 gei2 bou6 zau6 mo4 dou3 goek3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 這雙鞋很「鞋烚烚」，走幾步就磨腳。
examples.english_sentence: These shoes are really 'haai wat wat' — after a few steps they rub my feet.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 落雨個日著湿咗條膠鞋，行路成日鞋烚烚，聽到好煩。
examples.jyutping_sentence: lok6 jyu5 go3 jat6 zoek3 sap1 zo2 tiu4 gaau1 haai4, haang4 lou6 sing4 jat6 haai4 wat6 wat6, teng1 dou3 hou2 faan4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 下雨天穿著濕了的膠鞋，走路一直鞋烚烚，聽起來很煩人。
examples.english_sentence: On rainy days wearing wet rubber shoes, they keep making that 'haai wat wat' sound when I walk — it's annoying to hear.

mandarin_meaning: 鞋码；鞋子的尺码
english_meaning: shoe size
explanation_mandarin: 表示鞋子的尺寸或尺码，用來表示穿鞋合適的大小。
explanation_english: Refers to the size of a shoe; the measurement used to indicate which shoe fits.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你嘅鞋碼係幾多？
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 ge3 haai4 maa5 hai6 gei2 do1?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你的鞋码是多少？
examples.english_sentence: What's your shoe size?

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢對鞋冇我嘅鞋碼，試唔到。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 deoi3 haai4 mou5 ngo5 ge3 haai4 maa5, si3 m4 dou2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这双鞋没有我的鞋码，试不了。
examples.english_sentence: This pair doesn't come in my shoe size, I can't try them on.

mandarin_meaning: （靴子的）筒部；鞋子的筒形部分（可稱為靴筒）
english_meaning: the shaft/upper tube of a boot or high-top shoe; the part that surrounds the lower leg
explanation_mandarin: 指靴子或高筒鞋包裹小腿的部分，即鞋子由脚面向上延伸形成的筒狀結構，決定鞋子是否為高筒、保暖及支撐性。
explanation_english: Refers to the shaft or tubular upper part of a boot or high-top shoe that surrounds the lower leg; it determines height, warmth and support of the footwear.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢啲鞋筒好高，好啱冬天著。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 di1 haai4 tung2 hou2 gou1, hou2 aam1 dung1 tin1 zoek3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 它的鞋筒很高，很適合冬天穿。
examples.english_sentence: Its boot shaft is high, very suitable for wearing in winter.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢個鞋筒用料厚，保暖性好。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 go3 haai4 tung2 jung6 liu6 hau5, bou2 nyun5 sing3 hou2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 這個鞋筒用料厚，保暖性好。
examples.english_sentence: This boot shaft uses thick materials and is good at retaining heat.

mandarin_meaning: 鞋跟
english_meaning: heel (of a shoe)
explanation_mandarin: 指鞋子的後跟部分，用來支撐腳跟並承受部分體重，常見於各類鞋款（例如高跟鞋、皮鞋、運動鞋等）。
explanation_english: Refers to the heel of a shoe—the rear part that supports the heel and bears part of the body's weight. Found on many types of footwear (e.g., high heels, dress shoes, sneakers).

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢對高跟鞋啲鞋踭好窄，著唔舒服。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 deoi3 gou1 gan1 haai4 di1 haai4 zang1 hou2 zaak3, zoek3 m4 syu1 fuk6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 這雙高跟鞋的鞋跟很窄，穿起來不舒服。
examples.english_sentence: The heels of these high-heeled shoes are very narrow and uncomfortable to wear.

mandarin_meaning: 鞋錢；買鞋用的錢。口語上也可指少量的錢或零用錢。
english_meaning: Literally "shoe money" — money for buying shoes; colloquially, a small amount of money or pocket money.
explanation_mandarin: 「鞋金」是廣東話的口語說法，字面意思是用來買鞋的錢。除字面用法外，亦可泛指一筆不大的錢、零用錢或象徵性的小額支付。常用於日常會話，較少出現在正式書面語中。
explanation_english: “鞋金” is a Cantonese colloquial term literally meaning money for shoes. Besides the literal sense, it can be used more generally to refer to a small sum of money, pocket money, or a token payment. It is informal and typically used in spoken Cantonese.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 細路要買鞋，屋企人俾咗啲鞋金畀佢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: sai3 lou6 jiu3 maai5 haai4, uk1 kei2 jan4 bei2 zo2 di1 haai4 gam1 bei2 keoi5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 小孩子要買鞋，家人給了他一些鞋錢。
examples.english_sentence: The child needs new shoes; the family gave him some money for shoes.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 嗰啲錢只係啲鞋金，唔值得計較。
examples.jyutping_sentence: go2 di1 cin2 zi2 hai6 di1 haai4 gam1, m4 zik1 dak1 gai3 gaau3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 那些錢只是些小錢，不值得計較。
examples.english_sentence: That money is just pocket change; it's not worth arguing about.

mandarin_meaning: （擬聲）鞋子發出颯颯／沙沙聲，形容走路或被風吹時鞋子的聲音
english_meaning: onomatopoeia for shoes making a rustling/flapping sound (noisy footsteps, flapping shoes)
explanation_mandarin: 用來模仿或描寫鞋子在行走或受風時發出的颯颯、沙沙聲，常用於口語狀態描寫，形容鞋底鬆、拖鞋拍打或濕葉上的踏步聲。
explanation_english: Used as an onomatopoeic expression to depict the rustling or flapping sound made by shoes when walking or blown by wind; commonly used in colloquial speech to describe loose soles, flapping flip‑flops, or footsteps on dry leaves.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢對拖鞋唔啱碼，行路成日鞋颯颯響。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 deoi3 to1 haai4 m4 aap3 maa5, hang4 lou6 sing4 jat6 haai4 saat3 saat3 hoeng2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他那雙拖鞋不合腳，走路總是鞋子颯颯作響。
examples.english_sentence: His flip‑flops don't fit; they keep flapping when he walks.

mandarin_meaning: 马鞍；骑马用的座具
english_meaning: saddle (a seat placed on a horse for riding)
explanation_mandarin: 指放在马背上供骑手坐的座具，亦可泛指类似鞍状的物件或结构。
explanation_english: Refers to a saddle — the seat placed on a horse's back for a rider; can also refer to saddle-shaped objects or structures.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢啲馬鞍好舊，要換一個新鞍。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 di1 maa5 on1 hou2 gau6, jiu3 wun6 jat1 go3 san1 on1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他的马鞍很旧，需要换一个新的马鞍。
examples.english_sentence: His saddle is very old; he needs to replace it with a new saddle.

mandarin_meaning: 在馬鞍前後，形容緊跟侍奉、事事服侍或跟隨在側
english_meaning: Literally 'in front of the saddle and behind the horse'; figuratively, to attend closely to someone, follow closely, or be constantly at someone's side to serve them
explanation_mandarin: 比喻緊跟在主人或重要人物身邊伺候、服侍或追隨，常用以形容侍從或忠心跟隨的人。
explanation_english: A figurative expression meaning to stay close to and attend to someone at all times; to follow around and serve someone closely.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢一向喺老闆鞍前馬後，乜嘢事都肯幫手。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 jat1 hoeng3 hai6 lou5 baan2 on1 cin4 maa5 hau6, mat1 je5 si6 dou1 hang2 bong1 sau2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他一直在老闆鞍前馬後，什麼事都願意幫忙。
examples.english_sentence: He has always tended to the boss, attending to him closely and willing to help with anything.

mandarin_meaning: 鞍馬 (ān mǎ)：1. 鞍和馬，指馬匹及其配備；2. 體操項目——鞍馬（pommel horse）；3.（書面）指奔波、行程或長期奔走。
english_meaning: saddle and horse; pommel horse (gymnastics apparatus); (literary) travel / being constantly on the move.
explanation_mandarin: “鞍馬”在廣東話中既可指字面意思的鞍和馬，也常見於成語如“鞍馬勞頓”表示奔波勞累；在現代語境下亦可指體操項目中的鞍馬器械（pommel horse）。
explanation_english: In Cantonese, “鞍馬” can refer literally to saddle and horse, appear in idioms like “鞍馬勞頓” meaning weary from travel, and also denotes the pommel horse apparatus in gymnastics.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢係校隊嘅體操員，專攻鞍馬項目。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hai6 haau6 deoi2 ge3 tai2 cou1 jyun4, zyun1 gung1 ngon1 maa5 hong6 muk6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他是校隊的體操運動員，專攻鞍馬項目。
examples.english_sentence: He's a school-team gymnast who specializes in the pommel horse.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 近排工作好忙，要成日跑來跑去，真係鞍馬勞頓。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gan6 paai4 gung1 zok3 hou2 mong4, jiu3 sing4 jat6 paau2 loi4 paau2 heoi3, zan1 hai6 ngon1 maa5 lou4 deon6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 最近工作很忙，要經常奔波，真是鞍馬勞頓。
examples.english_sentence: I've been really busy lately, constantly on the go — truly worn out from running around.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 古時候戰士出陣都會帶住鞍馬。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gu2 si4 hau6 zin3 si6 ceot1 zan3 dou1 wui5 daai3 zyu6 ngon1 maa5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 古代士兵出陣時常備有鞍馬。
examples.english_sentence: In ancient times warriors often went into battle with saddle and horse.

mandarin_meaning: 巩（巩固、巩强）
english_meaning: to consolidate; to strengthen; to secure
explanation_mandarin: 「鞏」常用於合成詞如「鞏固」、「鞏實」，表示使穩固、加強、穩住（地位、成果、基礎等）。
explanation_english: The character is commonly used in compounds such as 鞏固 and 鞏實, meaning to make firm, strengthen, or secure (e.g., position, gains, foundations).

examples.cantonese_sentence: 政府想鞏固經濟復甦嘅成果。
examples.jyutping_sentence: zing3 fu2 soeng2 gung2 gu3 ging1 zai3 fuk6 sou1 ge3 sing4 gwo2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 政府想巩固经济复苏的成果。
examples.english_sentence: The government wants to consolidate the gains of the economic recovery.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢用咗好多措施去鞏實佢嘅地位。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 jung6 zo2 hou2 do1 cou3 sik1 heoi3 gung2 sat6 keoi5 ge3 dei6 wai6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他用了很多措施去巩固他的地位。
examples.english_sentence: He used many measures to strengthen his position.

mandarin_meaning: 巩固；加强、稳固某种状态或基础
english_meaning: to consolidate; to strengthen or secure (a position, foundation, or state)
explanation_mandarin: 表示使某事物變得穩固或更有保障，通常指強化基礎、地位或成果以防後退或動搖。
explanation_english: Means to make something firm or more secure; usually refers to strengthening a foundation, position, or achievement to prevent regression or instability.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 政府要鞏固經濟基礎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: zing3fu2 jiu3 gung2gu3 ging1zai3 gei1co2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 政府要巩固经济基础。
examples.english_sentence: The government needs to consolidate the economic foundation.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋要鞏固學生對語文嘅基礎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5dei6 jiu3 gung2gu3 hok6saang1 deoi3 jyu5man4 ge3 gei1co2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们要巩固学生对语文的基础。
examples.english_sentence: We need to strengthen students' foundation in language studies.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢努力工作，想鞏固自己喺公司嘅地位。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 nou5lik6 gung1 zok3, soeng2 gung2gu3 zi6gei2 hai2 gung1si1 ge3 dei6wai6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他努力工作，想巩固自己在公司的地位。
examples.english_sentence: He works hard to consolidate his position in the company.

mandarin_meaning: 鞘（qiào）：刀劍等的護套；也指生物體內的套狀構造或外殼
english_meaning: sheath; scabbard (cover for a blade); also a sheath-like structure in biology
explanation_mandarin: 指包裹或保護刀劍的套子（刀鞘、劍鞘），在專業或科學語境下也可指生物體上的鞘狀結構。
explanation_english: Refers to a protective cover for blades (e.g., sword scabbard). In biology or technical contexts, it can denote a sheath-like structure.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 用完把劍，要記住將佢收返入鞘裏。
examples.jyutping_sentence: jung6 jyun4 baa2 gim3, jiu3 gei3 zyu6 zoeng1 keoi5 sau1 faan1 jap6 siu4 leoi5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 用完劍，要記得把它收回鞘裡。
examples.english_sentence: After using the sword, remember to put it back into its sheath.

mandarin_meaning: 抚养、培养；（在合成词中）弯身行礼（如“鞠躬”）
english_meaning: to raise or rear (children); in compounds (e.g. 鞠躬) to bow
explanation_mandarin: 「鞠」原指撫養、養育，文言中常見；在現代漢語多見於合成詞，如「鞠躬」表示行禮弯身致敬。
explanation_english: The character originally means to raise or rear (children) in classical usage; in modern usage it often appears in compounds such as 鞠躬, meaning to bow as a gesture of respect.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢見到觀眾就鞠咗個躬。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 gin3 dou2 gun1 zung3 zau6 guk1 zo2 go3 gung1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他看到觀眾就鞠了一躬。
examples.english_sentence: He bowed to the audience when he saw them.

mandarin_meaning: 鞠躬（jūgōng）——鞠躬、行礼，表示敬意、感谢或道歉。
english_meaning: to bow (bend the body forward) — to show respect, gratitude, or apology.
explanation_mandarin: 用身體前屈以示敬意、感謝或道歉，常見於正式場合、禮節或表演謝幕時。
explanation_english: A physical act of bending the upper body forward to show respect, gratitude, or apology; commonly used in formal contexts, etiquette, or at curtain calls.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 上台謝幕嗰陣，演員向觀眾鞠躬。
examples.jyutping_sentence: soeng5 toi4 ze6 mok6 go2 zan6, jin2 jyun4 hoeng3 gun1 zung3 guk1 gung1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 上台谢幕时，演员向观众鞠躬。
examples.english_sentence: When taking the curtain call, the actors bowed to the audience.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢向長輩鞠躬，表示尊敬。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hoeng3 coeng4 bui3 guk1 gung1, biu2 si6 zyun1 ging3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他向长辈鞠躬，表示尊敬。
examples.english_sentence: He bowed to his elders to show respect.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 雖然唔係每個文化都鞠躬，但喺日本鞠躬係常見嘅禮節。
examples.jyutping_sentence: seoi1 jan4 m4 hai6 mui5 go3 man4 faa3 dou1 guk1 gung1, daan6 hai6 jat6 bun2 guk1 gung1 hai6 soeng4 gin3 ge3 lai5 zit3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 虽然不是所有文化都有鞠躬，但在日本鞠躬是常见的礼节。
examples.english_sentence: Although not all cultures bow, bowing is a common etiquette in Japan.

mandarin_meaning: 鞠躬尽瘁（jūgōng jìncuì）：盡心竭力、奉獻到極點（常含為公事、他人鞠躬盡瘁的意涵）
english_meaning: to devote oneself wholeheartedly; to give one's all; to exert oneself to the utmost (often for a cause or duty)
explanation_mandarin: 形容把全部心力都奉獻出去、竭盡所能，常用以稱讚為公職或某一目標不辭勞苦、盡心盡力的人。
explanation_english: Describes dedicating all one's effort and energy, doing everything possible for a cause or duty; often used to praise someone who works tirelessly and selflessly.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 為咗公司嘅發展，佢鞠躬盡瘁，日日加班，從來冇怨言。
examples.jyutping_sentence: wai6 zo2 gung1si1 ge3 faat3zin2, keoi5 juk1 gung1 zeon6 zeoi3, jat6 jat6 gaa1 baan1, cung4 loi4 mou5 jyun6 jin4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 為了公司的發展，他鞠躬盡瘁，天天加班，從不抱怨。
examples.english_sentence: For the company's development, he devoted himself wholeheartedly, working overtime every day and never complaining.

mandarin_meaning: （常见于“鞦韆”）秋千，指荡秋千的器具，古字
english_meaning: An archaic character used in 鞦韆 (qiūqiān) meaning a swing (playground swing)
explanation_mandarin: 漢字「鞦」较少单独使用，常出现在合成词“鞦韆”中，表示秋千、荡秋千的器具或动作，属于古字或书面用字。
explanation_english: The character 鞦 is rarely used alone and typically appears in the compound 鞦韆 (qiūqiān), meaning a swing. It is an archaic/literary character referring to the swing apparatus or the act of swinging.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 公園入面有個鞦韆，細路仔鍾意喺度盪。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gung1 jyun4 jap6 min6 jau5 go3 cau1 cin1, sai3 lou6 zai2 zung1 ji3 hai2 dou6 dong6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 公园里面有一个鞦韆，小孩子喜欢在那里荡秋千。
examples.english_sentence: There is a swing in the park; children like to swing there.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢個字「鞦」通常只喺「鞦韆」入面見到，唔常單獨使用。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 go3 zi6 'cau1' tung1 soeng4 zi2 hai6 'cau1 cin1' jap6 min6 gin3 dou2, m4 soeng4 daan1 duk6 si6 jung6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这个字“鞦”通常只在“鞦韆”里面看到，不常单独使用。
examples.english_sentence: The character '鞦' is usually only seen in '鞦韆' and is not often used on its own.

mandarin_meaning: 秋千 (qiūqiān)
english_meaning: swing (playground swing)
explanation_mandarin: 指供人盪的遊樂設施，通常懸掛在鏈子或繩子上，多見於公園或遊樂場。
explanation_english: A play apparatus consisting of a seat suspended by chains or ropes for swinging, commonly found in parks and playgrounds.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 細路成日去公園玩鞦韆。
examples.jyutping_sentence: sai3 lou6 sing4 jat6 heoi3 gung1 jyun4 waan2 cau1 cin1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 小孩子经常去公园玩秋千。
examples.english_sentence: The kids often go to the park to play on the swings.

mandarin_meaning: 鞭；鞭子；鞭打（用作名詞或動詞）
english_meaning: whip; to whip, to flog; (figuratively) to urge or drive
explanation_mandarin: 鞭通常指用來抽打的長條工具（鞭子），作動詞時表示用鞭子抽打或比喻性地鞭策、鞭撻。
explanation_english: Refers to a long flexible instrument used for striking (a whip). As a verb, it means to strike with a whip or, figuratively, to urge, spur, or drive someone on.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢用鞭打馬。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 jung6 bin1 daa2 maa5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他用鞭子抽打马。
examples.english_sentence: He used a whip to beat the horse.

mandarin_meaning: （比喻）在對方已無法回應或已離世的情況下，繼續公開批評、羞辱或責難對方（字面為「鞭打屍體」）
english_meaning: To continue to publicly criticize, humiliate, or attack someone who cannot respond or is no longer present (literally 'whip the corpse'); to pile on or 'beat a dead horse.'
explanation_mandarin: 用來形容在對方已經無法反駁或不在場的情況下，仍然反覆批評或挖苦，帶有不人道或過度的貶抑意味。
explanation_english: Used to describe repeatedly criticizing or mocking someone who can no longer defend themselves or is absent; carries the sense of being excessive or inhumane.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 啲網民成日鞭屍，真係冇人性。
examples.jyutping_sentence: di1 mong5 man4 seng4 jat6 bin1 si1, zan1 hai6 mou5 jan4 sing3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 一些網民總是在網上鞭屍，真的沒有一點人性。
examples.english_sentence: Some netizens keep piling on online; it's really inhumane.

mandarin_meaning: 鞭打；抽打（也可比喻严厉处罚或批评）
english_meaning: to whip; to lash (literally); to severely punish or harshly criticize (figuratively)
explanation_mandarin: 动词：用鞭子等工具抽打某人；引申为严厉处罚或严厉批评。
explanation_english: Verb: to beat someone with a whip or similar instrument; figuratively, to impose harsh punishment or harshly criticize.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 古代犯人會畀人鞭打做刑罰。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gu2 doi6 faan6 jan4 wui5 bei2 jan4 bin1 daa2 zou6 jing4 fat6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 古代犯人会被人鞭打作为刑罚。
examples.english_sentence: In ancient times, criminals would be whipped as punishment.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 老闆喺會議度鞭打個團隊，話佢哋做得唔好。
examples.jyutping_sentence: lou5 baan2 hai2 wui6 ji5 dou6 bin1 daa2 go3 tyun4 deoi6, waa6 keoi5 dei6 zou6 dak1 m4 hou2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 老板在会议上严厉批评团队，说他们做得不好。
examples.english_sentence: The boss harshly criticized the team during the meeting, saying they did a poor job.

mandarin_meaning: 鞭撻（biān tà）：嚴厲斥責、抨擊；字面亦可指用鞭子鞭打
english_meaning: to chastise or lash out at; to severely criticize or reprimand (literal: to whip)
explanation_mandarin: 指用言語或文字對某人或某事進行嚴厲批評或譴責。此詞在正式或書面語中常見，字面上也有用鞭打的意思。
explanation_english: Refers to harshly criticizing or condemning someone or something, often used in formal or written contexts. Literally can also mean to whip.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢項政策受到社會嘅鞭撻。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 hong6 zing3 caak3 sau6 dou3 se5 wui6 ge3 bin1 taat3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 這項政策受到社會的廣泛抨擊。
