examples.english_sentence: This policy has been widely criticized by the public.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 新政策遭到社會嘅鞭撻，政府要盡快回應。
examples.jyutping_sentence: san1 zing3 caak3 zou1 dou3 se5 wui6 ge3 bin1 taat3, zing3 fu2 jiu3 zeon6 faai3 wui4 jing3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 新政策遭到社會的抨擊，政府需要儘快回應。
examples.english_sentence: The new policy was lambasted by society; the government needs to respond quickly.

mandarin_meaning: 鞭炮 (biānpào)
english_meaning: firecrackers
explanation_mandarin: 一种用纸和火药制成，在节庆或仪式中燃放以产生响声、热闹气氛或驱邪的燃放物。
explanation_english: Explosive devices made of paper and gunpowder that are set off during festivals or ceremonies to produce loud bangs, create a festive atmosphere, or ward off evil.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 新年我哋會放鞭炮慶祝。
examples.jyutping_sentence: san1 nin4 ngo5 dei6 wui5 fong3 bin1 paau3 hing3 zuk1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 新年我们会放鞭炮庆祝。
examples.english_sentence: We set off firecrackers to celebrate the New Year.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 媽媽叫我唔好喺屋企放鞭炮，太危險。
examples.jyutping_sentence: maa4 maa1 giu3 ngo5 m4 hou2 hai2 uk1 kei2 fong3 bin1 paau3, taai3 ngai4 him2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 妈妈叫我不要在家放鞭炮，太危险了。
examples.english_sentence: Mom told me not to set off firecrackers at home; it's too dangerous.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 鞭炮聲嚇到條狗走咗。
examples.jyutping_sentence: bin1 paau3 seng1 haak3 dou3 tiu4 gau2 zau2 zo2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 鞭炮声把狗吓跑了。
examples.english_sentence: The sound of firecrackers scared the dog away.

mandarin_meaning: 鞭策：督促、激勵他人更加努力（動詞）
english_meaning: to urge or spur someone on; to encourage or admonish someone to make greater effort
explanation_mandarin: 用言語或行動督促、激勵別人更加努力、奮發，多用於正式或書面語境。
explanation_english: To urge, spur on, or encourage someone to work harder or strive; often used in contexts where admonition or encouragement pushes someone toward better performance.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 老師經常鞭策學生唔好懈怠。
examples.jyutping_sentence: lou5 si1 ging1 soeng4 bin1 caak3 hok6 saang1 m4 hou2 haai6 doi6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 老師經常鞭策學生不要懈怠。
examples.english_sentence: The teacher often urges students not to slack off.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 父母嘅期望鞭策住佢努力追夢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: fu6 mou5 ge3 kei4 mong6 bin1 caak3 zyu6 keoi5 nou5 lik6 zeoi1 mung6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 父母的期望鞭策著他努力追夢。
examples.english_sentence: His parents' expectations spur him on to work hard to pursue his dreams.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 公司嘅上司經常鞭策我哋，提高工作表現。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gung1 si1 ge3 soeng6 si1 ging1 soeng4 bin1 caak3 ngo5 dei6, tai4 gou1 gung1 zok3 biu2 jin6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 公司的上司經常鞭策我們，提高工作表現。
examples.english_sentence: The company's superiors often urge us to improve our performance at work.

mandarin_meaning: 比喻力量或權力到不了某個地方，無法干預或幫助（字面：鞭子太長，抽不到末端）。
english_meaning: An idiom meaning one's influence, power, or ability cannot reach a certain place or situation; beyond one's reach; unable to help or intervene.
explanation_mandarin: 用來形容權力、能力或資源無法覆蓋到某處或解決某事，達不到預期效果。
explanation_english: Used to describe a situation where authority, ability, or resources cannot extend to a place or solve a problem — unable to achieve the desired effect.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 政府嘅資源大多集中喺大城市，偏遠地區嘅需要往往鞭長莫及。
examples.jyutping_sentence: zing3 fu2 ge3 zi1 jyun4 daai6 do1 zaap6 zung1 hai2 daai6 sing4 si5, pin1 jyun5 dei6 keoi1 ge3 seoi1 jiu3 wong5 wong5 bin1 coeng4 mok6 kap6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 政府的資源大多集中在大城市，偏遠地區的需要往往鞭長莫及。
examples.english_sentence: Government resources are mostly concentrated in big cities, and the needs of remote areas are often beyond reach.

mandarin_meaning: 缰（缰绳），控制的绳索；引申为控制、约束
english_meaning: rein; bridle (the strap used to control a horse); figuratively, control or restraint
explanation_mandarin: 指套在馬嘴上用以控制馬匹的繩索或皮帶（缰绳）。也可用作比喻，表示對事物的控制或約束。
explanation_english: Refers to the strap or rope (rein/bridle) used to control a horse. Can also be used metaphorically to mean control or restraint.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 騎馬嘅時候，要拴好韁繩，唔好畀馬失控。
examples.jyutping_sentence: kei4 maa5 ge3 si4 hau6, jiu3 syun1 hou2 goeng1 sing4, m4 hou2 bei2 maa5 sat1 hung3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 騎馬的時候，要拴好缰绳，不要讓馬失控。
examples.english_sentence: When riding a horse, fasten the reins securely so the horse doesn't get out of control.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 老闆話要收緊韁，唔好咁放鬆。
examples.jyutping_sentence: lou5 baan2 waa6 jiu3 sau1 gan2 goeng1, m4 hou2 gam2 fong3 sung1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 老板說要收緊缰繩，不要那麼放鬆。
examples.english_sentence: The boss said to tighten the reins — don't be so lax.

mandarin_meaning: 表示鞑靼（塔塔爾）人，常見於「韃靼」一詞，指歷史上的蒙古/韃靼等民族
english_meaning: Tatar (Tartar) — referring to the historical Tatar/Tataric peoples; appears in the compound '韃靼' (Tartar)
explanation_mandarin: 「韃」字常用於「韃靼」，指鞑靼或塔塔爾等歷史民族名稱，在現代漢語中屬於古稱或專有名詞用法。
explanation_english: The character is used in the word '韃靼' to denote the Tatars (Tartar/Tatar peoples). It is an historical/ethnonym and is mainly encountered in literary or historical contexts.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 嗰啲史書記載韃靼人曾經入侵我哋嘅北方。
examples.jyutping_sentence: go2 di1 si2 syu1 gei3 zoi6 daat6 daat6 jan4 cang4 ging1 jap6 cam1 ngo5 dei6 ge3 bak1 fong1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 那些史書記載韃靼人曾經入侵我們的北方。
examples.english_sentence: Those historical records note that the Tatars once invaded our northern regions.

mandarin_meaning: 秋千 (qiān)；常見於合成詞「鞦韆」，指兒童遊樂用的盪具
english_meaning: swing (as in playground swing); the character commonly appears in the compound '鞦韆' (swing)
explanation_mandarin: 「韆」為較少單獨使用的漢字，多見於合成詞「鞦韆」，用來指兒童遊樂的盪具（即秋千）。在現代漢語中通常以「秋千/鞦韆」出現。
explanation_english: A relatively uncommon standalone character, usually seen in the compound '鞦韆' meaning a swing (playground swing). Rarely used alone in modern usage.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 公園入面有個鞦韆，好多細路仔鍾意喺度玩。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gung1 jyun4 jap6 min6 jau5 go3 cau1 cin1, hou2 do1 sai3 lou6 zai2 zung1 ji3 hai2 dou6 waan2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 公園裡有個鞦韆，很多小孩喜歡在那裡玩。
examples.english_sentence: There's a swing in the park; many children like to play on it.

mandarin_meaning: 秋千 (遊樂設施，用繩或鐵鏈懸掛，可供搖晃、供兒童遊玩)
english_meaning: swing (playground apparatus suspended by ropes or chains for rocking/playing)
explanation_mandarin: 「韆鞦」為較古或書面用法，指可以搖晃的座椅式遊樂設施，現代常用詞為「秋千」。
explanation_english: A literary/old-fashioned term for a swing — the suspended seat apparatus used for rocking, commonly called "秋千" (qiūqiān) in Mandarin.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 公園入面有個韆鞦，好多小朋友喺度玩。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gung1 jyun4 jap6 min6 jau5 go3 cin1 cau1, hou2 do1 siu2 pang4 jau5 hai2 dou6 waan2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 公园里有一个秋千，很多小朋友在玩。
examples.english_sentence: There is a swing in the park; many children are playing on it.

mandarin_meaning: （古）用於駱駝或馬等負重的鞍具或包裹；駝馬背上的負重器具
english_meaning: archaic term for a pack-saddle or harness used to carry loads on animals (e.g. horses, camels)
explanation_mandarin: 韉為古代詞彙，指安置於馬、駱駝等背部以承載貨物的鞍具或包裹，現代書面語較少使用，常見於古籍文獻中。
explanation_english: A historical/archaic term referring to a pack-saddle or load-bearing harness placed on the backs of animals such as horses or camels. Rare in modern usage and mainly found in classical texts.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 嗰匹馬背上綁咗一個韉，用嚟裝貨。
examples.jyutping_sentence: go2 pat1 maa5 bui3 soeng6 bong2 zo2 jat1 go3 gin1, jung6 lai4 zong1 fo3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 那匹馬背上綁著一個韉，用來裝貨。
examples.english_sentence: The horse had a pack-saddle on its back for carrying goods.

mandarin_meaning: （读作 wéi）指鞣制的皮革；亦为姓氏（韦）
english_meaning: Chinese character '韋' (Mandarin: wéi); tanned leather; also a Chinese surname (Wei)
explanation_mandarin: 漢字“韋”，古時指鞣製的皮革，現今多用於表示皮革相關事物或作為姓氏使用。
explanation_english: The character '韋' originally denotes tanned leather; today it is most commonly seen referring to leather-related items or as a Chinese surname (Wei).

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我有個朋友姓韋。
examples.jyutping_sentence: Ngo5 jau5 go3 pang4 jau5 sing3 Wai4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我有一个朋友姓韦。
examples.english_sentence: I have a friend whose surname is Wei.

mandarin_meaning: 坚韧、有弹性、不易断裂或轻易放弃
english_meaning: tough; resilient; tenacious; not easily broken or giving up
explanation_mandarin: 表示物體或性質堅韧、有彈性、不易斷裂；也可形容人意志堅定、不易放棄。常與“性”構成“韌性”。
explanation_english: Describes something that is tough or resilient and not easily broken; can also describe a person's tenacity and persistence. Often used as '韌性' (resilience).

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢塊膠好韌，唔易斷。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 faai3 gaau1 hou2 jan6, m4 ji6 dyun6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这块橡胶很有韧性，不容易断裂。
examples.english_sentence: This piece of rubber is very tough; it doesn't break easily.

mandarin_meaning: 韧力（rènlì），指材料抗破壞、抗斷裂的能力；也可比喻人或團體在逆境中堅持、不輕易屈服的能力。
english_meaning: Toughness; resilience — the ability of a material to resist fracture or damage, or a person's/team's ability to persist and withstand adversity.
explanation_mandarin: 可用於材料科學，表示物料在受力時吸收能量而不易斷裂；亦可用於心理或團隊語境，表示面對困難時的堅韌與恢復能力。
explanation_english: Used in materials science to describe a material's ability to absorb energy and resist fracture; also used in psychological or social contexts to describe toughness or the ability to recover and persist under hardship.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢喺比賽入面顯示咗好強嘅韌力，最後都追返嚟贏咗。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hai6 bei2 coi3 jap6 min6 hin2 si6 zo2 hou2 koeng4 ge3 jan6 lik6, zeoi3 hau6 dou1 zeoi1 faan2 lai4 jeng4 zo2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他在比赛中表现出很强的韧力，最后也追回来赢了。
examples.english_sentence: He showed great resilience in the match and came back to win.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢種膠料有好高嘅韌力，用嚟做保護層唔易破。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 zung2 gaau1 liu6 jau5 hou2 gou1 ge3 jan6 lik6, jung6 lai4 zou6 bou2 wu6 cang4 m4 ji5 po3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这种胶料韧力很高，用来做保护层不容易破。
examples.english_sentence: This type of rubber has high toughness; used as a protective layer it does not break easily.

mandarin_meaning: 韌帶（連接骨與骨，支撐關節的纖維性結締組織）
english_meaning: ligament (fibrous connective tissue that connects bones and stabilizes joints)
explanation_mandarin: 連接骨與骨、支撐關節的纖維性結締組織。常見於膝、踝等關節，受傷時會扭傷或斷裂。
explanation_english: A band of fibrous connective tissue that connects bones and stabilizes joints. Commonly found in knees and ankles; can be sprained or torn.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我聽醫生話佢嘅膝頭韌帶斷咗，要做手術。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 teng1 ji1 sang1 waa6 keoi5 ge3 sat1 tau4 jan6 daai3 dyun6 zo2, jiu3 zou6 sau2 seot6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我聽醫生說他的膝部韌帶斷了，要做手術。
examples.english_sentence: The doctor said his knee ligament was torn and needs surgery.

mandarin_meaning: 韧性（rènxìng）：指材料或個體抗折、抗壓或恢復能力，表示堅韌或彈性的性質。
english_meaning: Resilience; toughness — the quality of a material or person to resist breaking, withstand pressure/impact, or recover.
explanation_mandarin: 用來描述物質或人的耐受與回復能力，既可指材料在受力時不易斷裂，也可指人在面對困難時持續堅持、恢復的能力。
explanation_english: Used to describe the durability and recovery ability of a material or a person; can refer to a material's resistance to breaking under stress or a person's capacity to persist and recover from difficulties.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢做事好有韌性，遇到困難都唔輕易放棄。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 zou6 si6 hou2 jau5 jan6 sing3, jyu6 dou3 kwan3 naan4 dou1 m4 hing1 ji5 fong3 hei3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他做事很有韧性，遇到困难都不轻易放弃。
examples.english_sentence: He/She is very resilient at work and doesn't give up easily when facing difficulties.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢種物料有好高嘅韌性，抗撞擊能力好強。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 zung2 mat6 liu6 jau5 hou2 gou1 ge3 jan6 sing3, kong3 zong6 gik1 nang4 lik6 hou2 koeng4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 這種材料具有很高的韌性，抗衝擊能力很強。
examples.english_sentence: This material has high toughness and strong impact resistance.

mandarin_meaning: （物）堅韌、耐用；（口語，指人）厚臉皮、臉皮厚
english_meaning: (for materials) tough, durable; (colloquial, for people) thick-skinned, shameless
explanation_mandarin: 「韌皮」原本可指皮革等材料堅韌、不易撕裂或損壞；在口語中也常用來形容人臉皮厚、不容易被責備或羞愧而認錯。
explanation_english: Literally refers to leather or material that is tough and not easily torn; colloquially used to describe a person who is thick-skinned or shameless and unlikely to admit mistakes.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢塊牛皮好韌皮，用嚟做鞋好啱。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 faai3 ngau4 pei4 hou2 jan6 pei4, jung6 lai4 zou6 haai4 hou2 aam1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 這塊牛皮很韌，用來做鞋很合適。
examples.english_sentence: This piece of cowhide is very tough; it's suitable for making shoes.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢真係好韌皮，明明做錯嘢都唔肯認錯。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 zan1 hai6 hou2 jan6 pei4, ming4 ming4 zou6 co3 je5 dou1 m4 hang2 jing6 co3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他真是很厚臉皮，明明做錯事也不肯認錯。
examples.english_sentence: He's really thick-skinned; even when he clearly did something wrong, he won't admit it.

mandarin_meaning: 又黏又執著／很頑固、難以擺脫
english_meaning: clingy/tenacious; stubbornly persistent or hard to shake off
explanation_mandarin: 粵語俚語，用來形容人或事非常黏、執著或難以擺脫，既有頑強的意思，也帶有黏人的含意。
explanation_english: A Cantonese slang term describing someone or something that is clingy, tenacious, or stubbornly persistent — hard to get rid of or let go.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢成日都韌黐黐，唔肯放手。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 sing4 jat6 dou1 jan6 ci1 ci1, m4 hang2 fong3 sau2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他總是又黏又執著，不肯放手。
examples.english_sentence: He/She is always clingy and stubborn, and won't let go.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢個問題韌黐黐，討論咗幾年都未解決。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 go3 man6 tai4 jan6 ci1 ci1, tou2 leon6 zo2 gei2 nin4 dou1 mei6 gaai2 kyut3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 這個問題很頑固，討論了好幾年都沒解決。
examples.english_sentence: This problem is stubbornly persistent; it's been discussed for years without resolution.

mandarin_meaning: 韩；韩国（常用作缩写）；姓氏；古代诸侯国之一
english_meaning: Han (character); often short for Korea (as in 韓國); a surname; an ancient state
explanation_mandarin: “韓”字可指韓國（如韓國人、韓文）、為漢字姓氏（如韓先生），亦可指古代的一個諸侯國。在現代中文中常作為與朝鮮半島相關的詞語之字首或縮寫。
explanation_english: The character '韓' typically denotes Korea (as a shorthand or in compounds like 韓國, 韓文), is used as a surname (Mr./Ms. Han), and historically refers to an ancient state. In modern usage it's commonly seen in words related to the Korean peninsula.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢係韓國人。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hai6 hon4 gwok3 jan4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他/她是韩国人。
examples.english_sentence: He/She is Korean.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 韓先生今晚會嚟。
examples.jyutping_sentence: hon4 sin1 saang1 gam1 maan5 wui5 lai4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 韩先生今晚会来。
examples.english_sentence: Mr. Han will come tonight.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我想學韓文。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 soeng2 hok6 hon4 man4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我想学韩文/韩语。
examples.english_sentence: I want to learn Korean (language).

mandarin_meaning: 韩信点兵
english_meaning: Han Xin counts the troops (to muster, arrange or display forces); figuratively, to take stock of or deploy personnel/resources or to show off one’s command
explanation_mandarin: 典出史書，原指韓信點算調度兵力。現多用來比喻清點、調集或安排人力與資源，或形容排兵布陣、展示實力，有時含炫耀掌控力的意味。
explanation_english: From the historical anecdote about Han Xin counting his troops. Literally about mustering and arranging military forces; figuratively used to mean taking stock of, organizing or deploying personnel/resources, or demonstrating one’s command or tactical arrangement.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 打仗之前，將軍要韓信點兵，安排好每隊人手。
examples.jyutping_sentence: daa2 zoeng3 zi1 cin4, zoeng1 gwan1 jiu3 hon4 seon3 dim2 bing1, on1 paai4 hou2 mui5 deoi6 jan4 sau2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 打仗之前，将军要韩信点兵，安排好每队人手。
examples.english_sentence: Before going into battle, the general must 'Han Xin count the troops' — i.e. arrange each unit's manpower.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 搞活動之前要韓信點兵，否則到時人手唔夠。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gaau2 wut6 dung6 zi1 cin4 jiu3 hon4 seon3 dim2 bing1, fau2 zak1 dou3 si4 jan4 sau2 m4 gau3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 举办活动之前要韩信点兵，否则到时人手不够。
examples.english_sentence: Before organizing the event you need to 'Han Xin count the troops'; otherwise you'll be short-handed.

mandarin_meaning: 韩剧 (韓國電視劇)
english_meaning: Korean drama (TV series from South Korea)
explanation_mandarin: 指來自韓國的電視劇或劇集，通常包括愛情劇、偶像劇、歷史劇等多種題材，近年在華語地區及全球廣受歡迎。
explanation_english: Refers to television dramas produced in South Korea, covering genres such as romance, idol dramas, and historical series; widely popular in Chinese-speaking regions and worldwide.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我最近好鍾意睇韓劇。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 zeoi3 gan6 hou2 zung1 ji3 tai2 hon4 kek6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我最近很喜歡看韓劇。
examples.english_sentence: I've been really into watching Korean dramas recently.

mandarin_meaning: 韩国
english_meaning: Korea (commonly refers to the Republic of Korea / South Korea)
explanation_mandarin: 位于朝鲜半岛南部的国家，全称大韩民国。现代汉语中“韩国”通常指南韩（大韩民国）。
explanation_english: A country in East Asia located on the southern part of the Korean Peninsula; officially the Republic of Korea. In modern usage, it commonly refers to South Korea.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我好想去韓國旅行。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 hou2 soeng2 heoi3 hon4 gwok3 leoi5 hang4
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我很想去韩国旅行。
examples.english_sentence: I really want to travel to Korea.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 韓國嘅文化同飲食都好有特色。
examples.jyutping_sentence: hon4 gwok3 ge3 man4 faa3 tung4 jam2 sik6 dou1 hou2 jau5 dak1 sik1
examples.mandarin_sentence: 韩国的文化和饮食都很有特色。
examples.english_sentence: Korean culture and cuisine are very distinctive.

mandarin_meaning: 韓國男生；（香港俗語）對韓國文化著迷的人（戲稱）
english_meaning: a Korean guy; (Hong Kong slang) someone who is obsessed with Korean culture (joking/colloquial)
explanation_mandarin: 「韓國仔」在廣東話中可指韓國的男性（口語用法）；在香港也常用作俗稱或戲稱，形容特別喜歡韓國流行文化（如K-pop、韓劇、韓妝等）的人。
explanation_english: In Cantonese, "韓國仔" can mean a Korean male (colloquial). In Hong Kong it is also used slangily or jokingly to describe someone who is especially into Korean pop culture (K-pop, K-dramas, Korean cosmetics, etc.).

examples.cantonese_sentence: 嗰個韓國仔好靚仔。
examples.jyutping_sentence: go2 go3 hon4 gwok3 zai2 hou2 leng3 zai2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 那個韓國男生很帥。
examples.english_sentence: That Korean guy is very handsome.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢成日追韓劇、買韓國嘢，朋友成日話佢係半個韓國仔。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 sing4 jat6 zeoi1 hon4 kek6, maai5 hon4 gwok3 je5, pang4 jau5 sing4 jat6 waa6 keoi5 hai6 bun3 go3 hon4 gwok3 zai2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他老是追韓劇、買韓國的東西，朋友總說他像半個韓國仔（半個韓國人）。
examples.english_sentence: He always watches K-dramas and buys Korean stuff; his friends always say he's like half a Korean (meaning he's really into Korean culture).

mandarin_meaning: 韓國的貨幣（韓元的舊寫或異寫）
english_meaning: Korean won (currency of South Korea; an archaic/variant form)
explanation_mandarin: 指韓國的貨幣，現代常寫作「韓元」或「韓圓」；「韓圜」屬較少見或舊式的寫法，常出現在書面或歷史文獻中。
explanation_english: Refers to the currency of South Korea. Modern standard forms are '韓元' or '韓圓'; '韓圜' is a less common or archaic variant, mainly seen in older or formal texts.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我下個禮拜要去韓國，要換啲韓圜。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 haa6 go3 lai5 baai3 jiu3 heoi3 hon4 gwok3, jiu3 wun6 di1 hon4 jyun4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我下個星期要去韩国，要换一些韩圆（/韩元）。
examples.english_sentence: I'm going to South Korea next week and need to exchange some Korean won.

mandarin_meaning: 朝鲜战争
english_meaning: Korean War (1950–1953)
explanation_mandarin: 指1950年至1953年在朝鲜半岛发生的战争，主要交战方为朝鲜（北）与韩国（南），并牵涉到中国、美国及联合国部队等。
explanation_english: Refers to the Korean War fought on the Korean Peninsula from 1950 to 1953, primarily between North Korea and South Korea, with involvement from China, the United States, and United Nations forces.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢喺歷史課學到韓戰嘅背景。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hai2 lik6 si2 fo3 hok6 dou3 hon4 zin3 ge3 bui3 ging2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他在历史课学到韩战的背景。
examples.english_sentence: He learned about the background of the Korean War in history class.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 韓戰係一九五零年至一九五三年之間嘅戰爭。
examples.jyutping_sentence: hon4 zin3 hai6 jat1 gau2 ng5 ling4 nin4 zi3 jat1 gau2 ng5 saam1 nin4 zi1 gaan1 ge3 zin3 zeng1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 韩战是一九五零年至一九五三年之间的战争。
examples.english_sentence: The Korean War was a war between 1950 and 1953.

mandarin_meaning: 韩文（指韓國語言或以韓文字書寫的文字）
english_meaning: Korean (language) / Korean written text (e.g., Hangul)
explanation_mandarin: 指韓國的語言或以韓文字書寫的文字。在中文語境中常用來指韓語或韓文文本。
explanation_english: Refers to the Korean language or Korean written text (e.g., Hangul). Commonly used to denote the Korean language or Korean text.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我想學韓文，所以去報咗個課。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 soeng2 hok6 hon4-man4, so2 ji5 heoi3 bou3 zo2 go3 fo3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我想学韩文，所以报了个课。
examples.english_sentence: I want to learn Korean, so I signed up for a class.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢本書係用韓文寫嘅。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 bun2 syu1 hai6 jung6 hon4-man4 se2 ge3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这本书是用韩文写的。
examples.english_sentence: This book is written in Korean.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 電影啲對白係韓文，但有中文字幕。
examples.jyutping_sentence: din6 jing2 di1 deoi3 baak6 hai6 hon4-man4, daan6 jau5 zung1 man4 zi6 muk6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 电影的对白是韩文，但有中文字幕。
examples.english_sentence: The movie's dialogue is in Korean, but there are Chinese subtitles.

mandarin_meaning: 韩服（韓國傳統服飾）
english_meaning: Hanbok (traditional Korean clothing)
explanation_mandarin: 指韓國的傳統服飾，通常包括男女古典服裝款式，現今常在婚禮、傳統節慶、表演或文化活動中出現。
explanation_english: Refers to traditional Korean clothing (hanbok), the classical garments of the Korean peninsula, commonly seen at weddings, festivals, performances, and cultural events.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我想買一套韓服去影相。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 soeng2 maai5 jat1 tou3 hon4 fuk6 heoi3 jing2 soeng2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我想买一套韩服去拍照。
examples.english_sentence: I want to buy a hanbok to take photos.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 婚禮上有啲嘉賓穿住韓服，好有特色。
examples.jyutping_sentence: fan1 lai5 seong6 jau5 di1 gaa1 ban1 cyun1 zyu6 hon4 fuk6, hou2 jau5 dak6 sik1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 婚礼上有些嘉宾穿着韩服，很有特色。
examples.english_sentence: Some guests at the wedding were wearing hanbok; it looked very distinctive.

mandarin_meaning: 韩流（hánliú）
english_meaning: Korean Wave; Hallyu (the popularity of South Korean pop culture)
explanation_mandarin: 指源自韓國的流行文化潮流，包括音樂（如K-pop）、電視劇、時尚、美妝等在全球或特定地區廣泛流行的現象。
explanation_english: Refers to the wave of popular culture originating in South Korea—music (e.g. K-pop), TV dramas, fashion, beauty trends, etc.—that has gained wide popularity internationally or in particular regions.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 而家好多人受韓流影響，成日追韓劇、聽K-pop。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ji4 gaa1 hou2 do1 jan4 sau6 hon4 lau4 jing2 hoeng2, sing4 jat6 zeoi1 hon4 kek6, teng1 K-pop.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 现在很多人受韩流影响，经常追看韩剧、听K-pop。
examples.english_sentence: These days many people are influenced by the Korean Wave; they often watch Korean dramas and listen to K-pop.

mandarin_meaning: 韓式燒烤（韓國烤肉）
english_meaning: Korean barbecue (Korean-style grilled meat)
explanation_mandarin: 「韓燒」是香港粵語的口語用法，指韓國風味的燒烤，通常指提供韓式烤肉的餐廳或料理方式。
explanation_english: A Hong Kong Cantonese colloquial term for Korean-style barbecue (Korean BBQ), typically referring to restaurants or the style of grilled meat dishes.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 今晚去邊啊？去食韓燒啦！
examples.jyutping_sentence: gam1 maan5 heoi3 bin1 aa3? heoi3 sik6 hon4 siu1 laa1!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 今晚去哪裡？去吃韓式燒烤吧！
examples.english_sentence: Where are we going tonight? Let's go eat Korean BBQ!

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢間韓燒好正，肉好新鮮，醬汁又好味。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 gaan1 hon4 siu1 hou2 zeng3, juk6 hou2 san1 sin1, zoeng3 zap1 jau6 hou2 mei6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 這家韓式燒烤很好，肉很新鮮，醬汁也很好吃。
examples.english_sentence: This Korean BBQ place is great — the meat is very fresh and the sauces taste great.

mandarin_meaning: 韩语 / 韩国语（指韩国使用的语言）
english_meaning: Korean (language)
explanation_mandarin: 指韓國（包括南韓或廣義上的朝鮮半島）使用的語言，也常寫作「韓文」或「韓國語」。
explanation_english: Refers to the Korean language spoken in Korea (often written as 'Korean' or 'Korean language').

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我而家喺學韓語。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 ji4 gaa1 hai2 hok6 hon4 jyu5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我现在在学韩语。
examples.english_sentence: I'm learning Korean right now.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你識唔識講韓文？
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 sik1 m4 sik1 gong2 hon4 man4?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你会不会说韩语？
examples.english_sentence: Can you speak Korean?

mandarin_meaning: 罕見古字，常用於古書、人名或文獻中，含有正直、信義或美好品德的涵義（現代較少單獨使用）
english_meaning: A rare/archaic Chinese character, found in classical texts and names; carries senses of virtue, righteousness, or trustworthiness; seldom used in modern Cantonese.
explanation_mandarin: 「韙」為罕用漢字，多見於古籍或人名，表示正直、信義或美好品德等意涵。現代漢語與粵語中很少單獨使用，通常作人名或文獻用字出現。
explanation_english: The character is rare and mostly appears in classical literature or personal names. It conveys meanings related to virtue, righteousness, or trustworthiness. It is not commonly used independently in modern Cantonese.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢個字「韙」喺古書入面見到，依家好少人用。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 go3 zi6 'wai4' hai2 gu2 syu1 jap6 min6 gin3 dou3, ji1 gaa1 hou2 siu2 jan4 jung6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这个字「韙」在古书中见到，现在很少人使用。
examples.english_sentence: The character '韙' appears in classical texts and is rarely used today.

mandarin_meaning: 韬（tāo）：原指藏兵器、隱蔽武器；引申為隱藏才幹或暫時不露鋒芒，或與軍事、策略有關。
english_meaning: Tao (to sheath/conceal); originally to hide weapons or sheath a sword; extended meaning to conceal one's abilities or keep a low profile; also related to strategy/tactics.
explanation_mandarin: 「韜」字本義為收納、藏匿兵器或隱蔽鋒芒，常見於成語如「韜光養晦」，表示暫時隱藏實力、保持低調，也用於表示策略或兵法相關的概念。
explanation_english: The character originally means to sheath or hide weapons; metaphorically it means to hide one's talents or keep a low profile (as in the idiom 'hide one's light and nurture obscurity'). It can also relate to strategy or tactics.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢而家韜光養晦，暫時唔想出風頭。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 ji4gaa1 tou4 gwong1 joeng5 fui3, zaam6si4 m4 soeng2 ceot1 fung1 tau4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他現在韜光養晦，暫時不想出風頭。
examples.english_sentence: He is keeping a low profile for now and doesn't want to stand out.

mandarin_meaning: 韬光养晦（tāo guāng yǎng huì）：隐藏锋芒、保守低调，等待时机再行动。
english_meaning: To conceal one's abilities and bide one's time; keep a low profile and wait for the right opportunity.
explanation_mandarin: 指暫時隱藏自己的才能或鋒芒，低調行事，等待有利的時機再採取行動或出手。
explanation_english: Refers to temporarily hiding one's talents or strengths, acting modestly or keeping a low profile while waiting for a favorable moment to act.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢近排選擇韜光養晦，唔喺公開場合講太多計劃。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 gan6 paai4 syun2 zaak6 tou4 gwong1 joeng5 fui3, m4 hai2 gung1 hoi1 coeng4 hap6 gong2 taai3 do1 gai3 waak6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他最近選擇韜光養晦，在公開場合不談太多計劃。
examples.english_sentence: He has recently chosen to keep a low profile and not discuss his plans in public.

mandarin_meaning: 藏、隱藏；胸中懷有（才華、志向）
english_meaning: to hide or conceal; to harbor (talent, ambition) — latent or reserved
explanation_mandarin: 古文字義為藏匿、收藏。引申為胸中隱藏（才華、志向等），多見於文言或書面語。
explanation_english: A classical/literary verb meaning to hide or conceal something (to keep it stored or tucked away). It is also used metaphorically for harboring talent or ambition that is not yet revealed.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢胸中韞才，遲啲會顯露出嚟。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hung1 zung1 wan3 coi4, ci4 di1 wui5 hin2 lou6 ceot1 lai4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他胸中有才，遲早會顯露出來。
examples.english_sentence: He harbors talent in his chest; sooner or later it will be revealed.

mandarin_meaning: 隱藏；暫時不透露
english_meaning: to hide; to keep something to oneself; to hold back (information)
explanation_mandarin: 「韞住」源自文言，用於粵語時多作口語詞，表示將某事或某物隱藏、收起或暫時不說出來，含有保留或暫緩透露的意思。
explanation_english: Derived from classical usage, in Cantonese '韞住' is used colloquially to mean conceal, keep something tucked away, or temporarily not reveal information — i.e., to hold back or keep something to oneself.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你唔使急，呢啲嘢暫時韞住先唔好講出嚟。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 m4 sai2 gap1, ni1 di1 je5 zaam6 si4 wan6 zyu6 sin1 m4 hou2 gong2 ceot1 lai4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你不用急，這些事情暫時先隱瞞不要說出來。
examples.english_sentence: Don't rush — keep these things to yourself for now; don't say them out loud yet.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢發現問題，但決定韞住唔講，睇下之後點樣發展。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 faat3 jin6 man6 tai4, daan6 kyut3 ding6 wan6 zyu6 m4 gong2, tai2 haa5 zi1 hau6 dim2 joeng6 faat3 zin2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他發現了問題，但決定暫時隱藏不說，看看之後怎麼發展。
examples.english_sentence: He discovered a problem but decided to keep it to himself for now and see how things develop.

mandarin_meaning: 韞櫝（yùn dú）—把珍寶放在匣櫝裡，比喻將貴重之物或才華隱藏起來，不輕易示人。
english_meaning: Literally 'to hide in a box'; originally means placing a treasure in a chest. Figuratively, to conceal valuables or one's talents and not reveal them.
explanation_mandarin: 源自古代把珍寶韞（藏）於櫝（匣）中。常用來形容懷才不露或把貴重東西收藏不示人。
explanation_english: Originally refers to placing valuables inside a box. Often used metaphorically to describe hiding one's talents or keeping valuable things to oneself.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢成日韞𨋢，唔肯表露自己嘅才華。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 sing4 jat6 wan6 duk6 m4 hang2 biu2 lou6 zi6 gei2 ge3 coi4 waa4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他成日韞櫝，不肯表露自己的才華。
examples.english_sentence: He always hides his talents and refuses to reveal them.

mandarin_meaning: 韭（通常指韭菜）
english_meaning: Chinese chives (garlic chives); leek
explanation_mandarin: 指葱科的一类蔬菜，常见为韭菜，叶片扁平，味道辛香，用于炒菜、包餃子等烹調。
explanation_english: Refers to an Allium vegetable (commonly Chinese chives/garlic chives). It has flat leaves and a pungent aroma, commonly used in cooking such as stir-fries and dumpling fillings.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 今晚買啲韭菜返屋企整餃子啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gam1 maan5 maai5 di1 gau2 coi3 faan1 uk1 kei2 zing2 gaau2 zi2 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 今晚買些韭菜回家包餃子吧。
examples.english_sentence: Buy some chives tonight and make dumplings at home.

mandarin_meaning: 韭菜（jiǔcài）；在網絡/股市語境中指被反覆剝削或被割韭菜的散戶、韭菜群體
english_meaning: Chinese chives; (slang) 'chives' — retail investors or ordinary people repeatedly exploited or taken advantage of
explanation_mandarin: 1. 指一種常見的蔬菜——韭菜。2. 引申為網絡和金融圈的俚語，稱那些在股市或投資中反覆被割韭菜（被剝削、遭受損失）的散戶或普通投資者。
explanation_english: 1. A common vegetable — Chinese chives. 2. Figuratively (slang) used in online and financial contexts to refer to retail investors or ordinary people who are repeatedly exploited or suffer losses (i.e., 'being harvested' like chives).

examples.cantonese_sentence: 今晚食咩？我買咗啲韭菜，整餃子啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gam1 maan5 sik6 me1? ngo5 maai5 zo2 di1 gau2 coi3, zing2 gaau2 zi2 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 今晚吃什麼？我買了些韭菜，包餃子吧。
examples.english_sentence: What are we eating tonight? I bought some chives — let's make dumplings.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 嗰啲大戶又喺股市度割韭菜，啲散戶蝕得好慘。
examples.jyutping_sentence: go2 di1 daai6 wu6 jau6 hai2 gu2 si5 dou6 got3 gau2 coi3, di1 saan2 wu6 sik1 dak1 hou2 caam2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 那些大戶又在股市里割韭菜，散戶亏得很惨。
examples.english_sentence: Those big players are cutting chives in the stock market again — the retail investors are losing badly.

jyutping: gau2 coi3 ming6 — jat1 zoeng2 zau6 got3
mandarin_meaning: 韭菜命——一长就被割（网络俚语，指一旦有成长或盈利就被反复收割的人或群体）
english_meaning: ‘Chives fate’ — once you grow, you get cut (internet slang for people who are repeatedly 'harvested' or exploited as soon as they gain)
partOfSpeech_mandarin: 网络俚语 / 比喻短语
explanation_mandarin: 「韭菜命——一長就割」是網絡用語，把人比作韭菜，指散戶或容易被利用、反覆被收割的群體，一有成長或盈利就被割韭菜。
explanation_english: An internet slang metaphor comparing people to chives: those who are repeatedly 'harvested' — typically inexperienced retail investors or easily exploited groups — who get taken advantage of as soon as they show growth or profit.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 好多散戶好似都係韭菜命，一長就割。
examples.jyutping_sentence: hou2 do1 saan3 wu6 hou2 ci5 dou1 hai6 gau2 coi3 ming6, jat1 zoeng2 zau6 got3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 很多散户好像都是韭菜命，一长就被割。
examples.english_sentence: Many retail investors seem to be 'chives' — as soon as they grow, they're harvested.

mandarin_meaning: 韭黄（為在遮光或掩蔽下栽培或燙煮以去除葉綠素的韭菜嫩莖，呈黃色，常用於中式料理）
english_meaning: yellow chives (garlic chive shoots rendered pale/yellow by blanching or etiolating; a culinary ingredient)
explanation_mandarin: 韭黃是指通過遮光栽培或焯過而使葉綠素減少、呈黃色的韭菜嫩莖，口感鮮嫩，常用於炒菜、餃子餡、粥點等中式料理中。
explanation_english: 韭黃 refers to garlic chive shoots that have been grown or treated to remove chlorophyll so they appear yellow. They are tender and commonly used in Chinese cooking—stir-fries, dumpling fillings, congee, and dim sum.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢碟韭黃炒得唔錯，夾埋牛肉一齊食更好味。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 dip6 gau2 wong4 caau2 dak1 m4 co3, gaap3 maai4 ngau4 juk6 jat1 cai4 sik6 gang3 hou2 mei6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 這盤韭黃炒得不錯，和牛肉一起吃更美味。
examples.english_sentence: This plate of stir-fried yellow chives is pretty good; it's even tastier when eaten with beef.

mandarin_meaning: 韭菜（jiǔ、常指大蒜香味的蔬菜）
english_meaning: chive; Chinese/garlic chive
explanation_mandarin: 一種葱科蔬菜，常用於中式料理，如包餃子、煎餅或餡料，具有特殊蒜香味。
explanation_english: A leafy allium (Chinese or garlic chive) used as a vegetable in Chinese cooking—commonly used in dumplings, pancakes, and fillings—known for its garlicky aroma.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 市場有賣新鮮嘅韮，今晚買返啲做餃子。
examples.jyutping_sentence: si5 coeng4 jau5 maai6 san1 sin1 ge3 gau2, gam1 maan5 maai5 faan1 di1 zou6 gaau2 zi2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 市場有賣新鮮的韭菜，今晚買一些回來包餃子。
examples.english_sentence: The market has fresh chives; I'll buy some tonight to make dumplings.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢個韮菜餅好好味，係用新鮮嘅韮整嘅。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 go3 gau2 coi3 beng2 hou2 hou2 mei6, hai6 jung6 san1 sin1 ge3 gau2 zing2 ge3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 這個韭菜餅很好吃，是用新鮮的韭菜做的。
examples.english_sentence: This chive pancake is delicious; it's made with fresh chives.

mandarin_meaning: 韭菜（jiǔcài），一種蔬菜；在網絡語境中也指被反覆收割的散戶/韭菜族
english_meaning: Chinese chives (garlic chives); (slang) retail investors who are repeatedly 'harvested'
explanation_mandarin: 韮菜是一種葉狀蔬菜（Allium tuberosum），味道帶蒜香，常用於中式烹調。另在網絡或金融語境中，“韮菜”作俚語，指容易被割韭菜的散戶或被反覆榨取的群體。
explanation_english: Chinese chives are a leafy vegetable (Allium tuberosum) with a garlicky flavor, commonly used in Chinese cooking. In Internet/financial slang, 'chives' refers to retail investors or groups who are repeatedly exploited.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我今晚買咗啲韮菜，打算整韮菜餃。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 gam1 maan5 maai5 zo2 di1 gau2 coi3, daa2 syun3 zing2 gau2 coi3 gaau2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我今晚買了些韭菜，打算包韭菜餃子。
examples.english_sentence: I bought some chives tonight to make chive dumplings.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 市場啲韮菜好新鮮，好香。
examples.jyutping_sentence: si5 coeng4 di1 gau2 coi3 hou2 san1 sin1, hou2 hoeng1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 市場上的韭菜很新鮮，很香。
examples.english_sentence: The chives at the market are very fresh and fragrant.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 股市入面好多新手散戶成日畀人當韮菜，不停畀人收割。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gu2 si5 jap6 min6 hou2 do1 san1 sau2 saan3 wu6 sing4 jat6 bei2 jan4 dong3 gau2 coi3, bat1 ting4 bei2 jan4 sau1 got3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 在股市裡，很多新手散戶經常被當作韭菜，不停被收割。
examples.english_sentence: In the stock market, many inexperienced retail investors are treated like 'chives'—constantly harvested.

mandarin_meaning: 罕見漢字（無固定現代用法）
english_meaning: A rare/archaic Chinese character; no fixed modern usage in Cantonese
explanation_mandarin: 「韲」為罕見或古字，現代粵語中很少單獨使用。部分資料會將其視為某些字的異體或古寫法，故沒有穩定的詞義或廣泛流通的讀音。
explanation_english: The character '韲' is a rare or archaic Chinese character and is seldom used in modern Cantonese. It is primarily a written character with no stable, widely attested meaning or pronunciation in contemporary usage; sometimes treated as a variant form of other characters in historical texts.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢個字「韲」好罕見，喺現代粵語好少使用。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 go3 zi6 'kei4' hou2 hon2 gin3, hai6 jin6 doi6 jyut6 jyu5 hou2 siu2 si6 jung6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这个字「韲」很罕见，在现代粤语中很少使用。
examples.english_sentence: The character '韲' is very rare and is seldom used in modern Cantonese.

mandarin_meaning: 声；声音；音调
english_meaning: sound; tone; pitch; audio
explanation_mandarin: 表示聲音、音質或音調等與聲響有關的概念，常見於複合詞如「聲音」「高音」「低音」「走音」等，用於描述聽覺現象與音頻特性。
explanation_english: Refers to sound, tone, pitch, or audio quality. Commonly used in compounds such as 'sound' (聲音), 'high note' (高音), 'low note' (低音), and 'out of tune' (走音). Used to describe auditory phenomena and audio characteristics.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你聽到啲音未？
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 teng1 dou3 di1 jam1 mei6?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你听到声音了吗？
examples.english_sentence: Did you hear the sound?

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢唱歌走音喇。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 coeng3 go1 zau2 jam1 laa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他唱歌跑调了。
examples.english_sentence: He's singing out of tune.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢首歌有高音同低音嘅轉變。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 sau2 go1 jau5 gou1 jam1 tung4 dai1 jam1 ge3 zyun2 bin3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这首歌有高音和低音的变化。
examples.english_sentence: This song has changes between high and low notes.

mandarin_meaning: 音樂遊戲 / 節奏遊戲
english_meaning: rhythm game / music game
explanation_mandarin: 指以音樂或節奏為核心玩法的電子遊戲類型，玩家需依照節奏按鍵或操作（例如Beatmania、Guitar Hero、osu!等）。在口語中常用「音game」來泛指這類遊戲或玩這類遊戲的行為。
explanation_english: Refers to a genre of video games centered on music and rhythm, where players press buttons or perform actions in time with the music (e.g., Beatmania, Guitar Hero, osu!). Colloquially, Cantonese speakers use "音game" to refer to these games or the act of playing them.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我鍾意打音game，啲節奏幾好玩。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 zung1 ji3 daa2 jam1 geim1, di1 zit3 zau6 gei2 hou2 waan2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我喜歡玩音樂遊戲，這些節奏很有趣。
examples.english_sentence: I like playing rhythm games; the rhythms are really fun.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 成班朋友今晚去唱K定係玩音game？
examples.jyutping_sentence: sing4 baan1 pang4 jau5 gam1 maan5 heoi3 coeng3 kei1 ding6 hai6 waan2 jam1 geim1?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 一群朋友今晚去唱K還是玩音樂遊戲？
examples.english_sentence: Are we going to karaoke or play rhythm games tonight?

mandarin_meaning: 音位（語音系統中區分詞義的最小抽象單位）
english_meaning: phoneme (the smallest abstract unit in a language's sound system that distinguishes meaning)
explanation_mandarin: 表示在語音系統中用來區分詞義的基本抽象單位，不等同於具體的語音實現（音位變體稱為同位音/變體）。
explanation_english: Refers to the basic abstract unit in a language's sound system used to distinguish word meanings; distinct from concrete phonetic realizations (allophones).

examples.cantonese_sentence: 音位係語言學入面用嚟分別詞義嘅最細語音單位。
examples.jyutping_sentence: jam1 wai6 hai6 jyu5jin4hok6 jap6min6 jung6 lai4 fan1 bit6 ci4 ji3 ge3 zeoi3 sai3 jyu5 jam1 daan1 wai6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 音位是语言学中用来区分词义的最小语音单位。
examples.english_sentence: A phoneme is the smallest unit of sound in a language used to distinguish word meanings.

mandarin_meaning: 音像（指聲音和影像的資料或製品，亦可指音像設備或音像業）
english_meaning: audio-visual; audiovisual materials or products (audio and video recordings; audiovisual equipment)
explanation_mandarin: 指包含聲音和影像的資料或產品，例如錄音、錄影、CD、DVD 等；也可用來泛指音像設備或音像相關的行業與資料。
explanation_english: Refers to materials or products that contain both sound and images, such as audio recordings, videos, CDs, DVDs; can also refer to audiovisual equipment or the audiovisual sector.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢間舖主要賣音像產品，例如唱片同錄影帶。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 gaan1 pou3 zyu2 jiu3 maai6 jam1-zoeng6 caan2-ban2, lai6-jyu4 coeng3-pin2 tung4 luk6-jing2 daai3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这家店主要卖音像产品，例如唱片和录像带。
examples.english_sentence: This shop mainly sells audio-visual products, such as records and videotapes.

mandarin_meaning: 音名（音樂術語）：表示音高的名稱，例如固有音名「do、re、mi」或字母表示的C、D、E等。
english_meaning: The names of musical pitches/notes — the labels used to identify pitch (e.g. solfège do, re, mi or letter names C, D, E).
explanation_mandarin: 指用來表示或辨認音高的名稱，常見於音樂理論和音樂教學中，用於描述音階中的各個音。
explanation_english: Refers to the names used to denote or identify musical pitches. Common in music theory and education to label notes within a scale.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 今堂音樂課，老師教我哋識讀音名同做視唱練習。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gam1 tong4 jam1 ngok6 fo3, lou5 si1 gaau3 ngo5 dei6 sik1 duk6 jam1 ming4 tung4 zou6 si6 coeng3 lin6 zaap6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 今天的音乐课，老师教我们识读音名并做视唱练习。
examples.english_sentence: In today's music class, the teacher taught us to read note names and do solfège exercises.

mandarin_meaning: 音域（指聲音的頻率或音高範圍）
english_meaning: vocal/instrumental range; the range of pitches or frequencies
explanation_mandarin: 指聲音的頻率或音高範圍，特別用於描述歌手或樂器能發出的最低與最高音。
explanation_english: Refers to the range of pitches or frequencies of a sound, commonly used to describe the lowest and highest notes a singer or instrument can produce.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢嘅音域好闊，可以唱到高音同低音。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 ge3 jam1 wik6 hou2 fut3, ho2 ji5 coeng3 dou3 gou1 jam1 tung4 dai1 jam1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他的音域很寬，可以唱到高音和低音。
examples.english_sentence: His vocal range is wide; he can sing both high and low notes.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢把小提琴音域唔算太闊，但音色好靚。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 baa2 siu2 tai4 kam4 jam1 wik6 m4 syun3 taai3 fut3, daan6 jam1 sik1 hou2 leng3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 這把小提琴的音域不算太寬，但音色很好。
examples.english_sentence: This violin's range isn't very wide, but the tone is beautiful.

mandarin_meaning: 音容宛在（yīn róng wǎn zài）：指對逝者的聲音與容貌記憶鮮明，彷彿仍在眼前，常用於悼念或緬懷。
english_meaning: As if someone's voice and appearance are still present; vividly remembered (usually referring to the deceased).
explanation_mandarin: 用以形容對已故者的聲音與容貌印象深刻、歷歷在目，常用於悼念、緬懷場合。
explanation_english: Describes that a deceased person's voice and appearance remain vividly in one's memory, as if they are still present; commonly used in contexts of mourning or remembrance.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢雖已離世，但佢嘅音容宛在，令我好似仲見到佢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 seoi1 ji5 lei4 sai3, daan6 keoi5 ge3 jam1 jung4 jyun2 zoi6, ling6 ngo5 hou2 ci5 zung6 gin3 dou6 keoi5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他雖已離世，但他的音容宛在，讓我彷彿還能見到他。
examples.english_sentence: Although he has passed away, his voice and appearance are vividly remembered; it feels as if I can still see him.

mandarin_meaning: 音带／錄音帶（用於錄製或保存聲音的磁帶）
english_meaning: audio tape; magnetic tape used for recording or storing sound (e.g., cassette tapes, reel-to-reel)
explanation_mandarin: 指用於錄製或保存聲音的磁性介質，如卡式錄音帶或磁帶卷，也可泛指各類音訊錄製媒介。
explanation_english: Refers to magnetic tape used to record or store sound (such as cassette tapes or reel-to-reel tapes); can also be used more generally for audio recording media.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我喺屋企搵到幾盒舊音帶，裏面有我細個時候錄嘅歌。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 hai2 uk1 kei2 wan2 dou3 gei2 hap6 gau6 jam1 daai3, leoi5 min6 jau5 ngo5 sai3 go3 si4 hau6 luk6 ge3 go1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我在家找到幾盒舊音帶，裡面有我小時候錄的歌。
examples.english_sentence: I found a few boxes of old audio tapes at home; they contain songs I recorded when I was a kid.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 電台會重播一段舊音帶，當作節目資料。
examples.jyutping_sentence: din6 toi4 wui5 cung4 bo3 jat1 dyun6 gau6 jam1 daai3, dong3 zok3 zit3 muk6 zi1 liu6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 電台會重播一段舊音帶，作為節目資料。
examples.english_sentence: The radio station will rebroadcast an old audio tape as program material.

mandarin_meaning: 錄音／（音樂）節拍
english_meaning: to record audio / (musical) beat
explanation_mandarin: 「音拍」在粵語中可用作動詞，指用器材拍攝或記錄聲音（相當於「錄音」）；也可作名詞，指音樂中的節拍或拍子。
explanation_english: In Cantonese, "音拍" can be a verb meaning to record or capture sound (similar to "record audio"); it can also be a noun referring to a musical beat or rhythm.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你可唔可以幫我音拍一段聲？
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 ho2 m4 ho2 ji5 bong1 ngo5 jam1 paak3 jat1 dyun6 seng1?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你可以幫我錄一段音嗎？
examples.english_sentence: Can you help me record a piece of audio?

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢首歌個音拍好穩，啱晒跳舞。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 sau2 go1 go3 jam1 paak3 hou2 wan2, aam1 saai3 tiu3 mou5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 這首歌的節拍很穩，正好可以跳舞。
examples.english_sentence: The beat of this song is very steady—perfect for dancing.

mandarin_meaning: 音效 (yīnxiào)
english_meaning: sound effect; audio effect
explanation_mandarin: 指電影、電視、遊戲或廣播等媒體中製作或使用的各種聲音效果，用以增強氣氛、強化動作或表現情緒。
explanation_english: Refers to sounds created or used in media (films, TV, games, radio) to enhance atmosphere, emphasize actions, or convey emotions.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 電影入面啲音效好震撼。
examples.jyutping_sentence: din6 jing2 jap6 min6 di1 jam1 haau6 hou2 zan3 ham6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 電影裡面的音效很震撼。
examples.english_sentence: The sound effects in the movie are very impressive.

mandarin_meaning: 音效卡 / 聲卡（電腦或裝置用來處理音頻信號的硬體）
english_meaning: sound card (hardware that processes audio signals)
explanation_mandarin: 指電腦或其他電子設備上用來處理、輸入或輸出音頻信號的擴充硬體，常稱為聲卡，用於改進或輸出更高品質的音效。
explanation_english: A hardware component (often an expansion card) in a computer or device that processes, inputs, or outputs audio signals. Commonly used to provide or improve audio quality.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我啱啱換咗張新音效卡，聲音清晰咗好多。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 aam1 aam1 wun6 zo2 zoeng1 san1 jam1 haau6 kaa1, seng1 jam1 cing1 sik1 zo2 hou2 do1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我剛換了一張新的音效卡，聲音清晰了很多。
examples.english_sentence: I just replaced the sound card; the audio is much clearer now.

mandarin_meaning: 音乐
english_meaning: music
explanation_mandarin: 指由旋律、節奏、和聲等元素組成的聲音藝術，用來表達情感、傳達訊息或娛樂人們。
explanation_english: Refers to the art of organized sound made up of melody, rhythm, harmony, etc.; used to express emotions, convey messages, or entertain.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我好鐘意聽音樂。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 hou2 zung1 ji3 teng1 jam1 ngok6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我很喜歡聽音樂。
examples.english_sentence: I really like listening to music.

mandarin_meaning: 音乐人（yīnyuèrén），指从事音乐创作、演奏或表演等音乐工作的人
english_meaning: musician; a person who works in music (composer, performer, instrumentalist, producer, etc.)
explanation_mandarin: 指從事音樂創作、演奏、編曲、製作或其他音樂相關工作的專業人士或從業者，既可指表演者也可指幕後創作人。
explanation_english: Refers to someone engaged in musical work — composing, performing, arranging, producing, or other music-related professions; can mean both performers and behind-the-scenes creators.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢係一個好有才華嘅音樂人。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hai6 jat1 go3 hou2 jau5 coi4 waa4 ge3 jam1 ngok6 jan4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他/她是一位很有才华的音乐人。
examples.english_sentence: He/She is a very talented musician.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 香港而家有好多獨立音樂人，經常喺小場地表演。
examples.jyutping_sentence: hoeng1 gong2 ji4 gaa1 jau5 hou2 do1 duk6 lap6 jam1 ngok6 jan4, ging1 soeng4 hai2 siu2 coeng4 dei6 biu2 jin2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 香港现在有很多独立音乐人，经常在小场地表演。
examples.english_sentence: There are many independent musicians in Hong Kong now; they often perform in small venues.

mandarin_meaning: 音樂劇
english_meaning: musical (musical theatre)
explanation_mandarin: 以音樂、歌曲和舞蹈結合的舞台劇形式，通常有劇情、角色和編排的歌舞場面。
explanation_english: A stage production combining music, songs, and dance to tell a story; a form of musical theatre.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋下星期去睇一齣音樂劇，好唔好？
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 haa6 sing1 kei4 heoi3 tai2 jat1 cat1 jam1 ngok6 kek6, hou2 m4 hou2?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我們下星期去看一齣音樂劇，好嗎？
examples.english_sentence: Shall we go see a musical next week?

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢套音樂劇好出名，門票已經賣晒。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 tou3 jam1 ngok6 kek6 hou2 ceot1 ming4, mun4 piu3 ji5 ging1 maai6 saai3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 這齣音樂劇很有名，門票已經賣完了。
examples.english_sentence: This musical is very famous; the tickets are already sold out.

mandarin_meaning: 音樂家（從事音樂創作、演奏或指揮的人）
english_meaning: musician (a person who composes, performs, or conducts music)
explanation_mandarin: 指從事音樂創作、演奏、指揮或以音樂為職業或專業的人。
explanation_english: A person who composes, performs, conducts, or professionally practices music.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢想成為一位音樂家。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 soeng2 sing4 wai4 jat1 wai6 jam1 ngok6 gaa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他想成為一位音樂家。
examples.english_sentence: He/She wants to become a musician.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢位音樂家今晚會喺大會堂演出。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 wai6 jam1 ngok6 gaa1 gam1 maan5 wui5 hai2 daai6 wui6 tong4 jin2 ceot1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 這位音樂家今晚會在大會堂演出。
examples.english_sentence: This musician will perform at the City Hall tonight.

mandarin_meaning: 音樂感（對音樂的感知或表現能力，如節奏感、旋律感）
english_meaning: musicality; a sense of music — the ability to perceive and express music (including rhythm and melody)
explanation_mandarin: 指一個人對音樂的感知與表現能力，包括節奏感、旋律感、音色分辨等方面的敏感度與表現力。
explanation_english: Refers to a person's ability to perceive and express music — encompassing rhythm sense, melodic sense, timbre discrimination, and general musical expression.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢有好強嘅音樂感，唔使教就識跟住節奏拍手。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 jau5 hou2 koeng4 ge3 jam1 ngok6 gam2, m4 sai2 gaau3 zau6 sik1 gan1 zyu6 zit3 zau2 paak3 sau2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他有很強的音樂感，不用教就能跟著節奏拍手。
examples.english_sentence: He has a strong musical sense; he can clap along to the beat without being taught.

mandarin_meaning: 音乐会 (yīnyuèhuì)
english_meaning: concert; musical performance
explanation_mandarin: 指现场演奏或演唱音乐的活动或表演，通常为正式或公开的音乐会。
explanation_english: A live event where music is performed or sung, typically a formal or public musical performance.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我下個禮拜會去聽一場古典音樂會。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 haa6 go3 lai5 baai3 wui5 heoi3 teng1 jat1 coeng4 gu2 din2 jam1 ngok6 wui6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我下个礼拜会去听一场古典音乐会。
examples.english_sentence: I'm going to attend a classical concert next week.

mandarin_meaning: 音乐盒 (yīnyuè hé)
english_meaning: music box
explanation_mandarin: 一种小型机械盒子，通常有发条或内部机械装置，能够播放预设的旋律。常作为玩具、装饰或纪念品。
explanation_english: A small mechanical box, often wound by a key, that plays a preset melody. Commonly used as a toy, decorative item, or keepsake.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 細個嘅時候，阿媽送咗我一隻音樂盒。
examples.jyutping_sentence: sai3 go3 ge3 si4 hau6, aa3 maa1 sung3 zo2 ngo5 jat1 zek3 jam1 ngok6 hap6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 小时候，妈妈送了我一个音乐盒。
examples.english_sentence: When I was little, my mother gave me a music box.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 每次聽到音樂盒開始轉動，嗰段旋律都令我好放鬆。
examples.jyutping_sentence: mui5 ci3 teng1 dou3 jam1 ngok6 hap6 hoi1 ci2 zyun2 dung6, go2 dyun6 syun4 leot6 dou1 ling6 ngo5 hou2 fong3 sung1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 每次听到音乐盒开始转动，那段旋律都让我很放松。
examples.english_sentence: Every time the music box starts turning, its melody always makes me feel relaxed.

mandarin_meaning: 表示語音的符號或記號（如國際音標、注音等）
english_meaning: phonetic symbol; phonetic transcription
explanation_mandarin: 指用來表示語音的符號或標記，用以標示字詞的發音，例如國際音標（IPA）或其他拼音/注音符號。
explanation_english: Refers to symbols or notations used to indicate pronunciation of sounds or words (e.g., the International Phonetic Alphabet or other phonetic marks).

examples.cantonese_sentence: 學廣東話嘅時候，睇音標好有幫助。
examples.jyutping_sentence: hok6 gwong2 dung1 waa2 ge3 si4 hau6, tai2 jam1 biu1 hou2 jau5 bong1 zo6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 學廣東話的時候，看音標很有幫助。
examples.english_sentence: When learning Cantonese, looking at the phonetic transcription is very helpful.

mandarin_meaning: 音响柜 / 音箱
english_meaning: speaker cabinet; audio/stereo cabinet
explanation_mandarin: 指放置音响设备（如扬声器、功放等）的柜子，或泛指家庭/商用的音响设备外壳或组合。
explanation_english: Refers to a cabinet that houses audio equipment (speakers, amplifiers, etc.), or more generally the housing/assembly of a home or commercial audio system.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 新買嗰部音櫃擺咗喺客廳，聲音好好。
examples.jyutping_sentence: san1 maai5 go2 bou6 jam1 gwai6 baai2 zo2 hai2 haak3 teng1, seng1 jam1 hou2 hou2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 新买的那个音响柜放在客厅，声音很好。
examples.english_sentence: The newly bought speaker cabinet is in the living room; the sound is very good.

mandarin_meaning: 音高是否準確（音準）
english_meaning: pitch accuracy; being in tune
explanation_mandarin: 指聲音的音高是否準確，常用於唱歌、樂器調音或聲音練習等場合。
explanation_english: Refers to how accurate the pitch is; commonly used when talking about singing, instrument tuning, or vocal practice.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢唱歌嘅時候音準好準。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 coeng3 go1 ge3 si4 hau6 jam1 zeon2 hou2 zeon2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他/她唱歌的時候音準很準。
examples.english_sentence: His/her pitch is very accurate when singing.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唱卡拉OK要注意音準同節奏。
examples.jyutping_sentence: coeng3 kaa1 laa1 o1 kei4 jiu3 zyu3 ji3 jam1 zeon2 tung4 zit3 zau6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 唱卡拉OK要注意音準和節奏。
examples.english_sentence: When singing karaoke, pay attention to pitch and rhythm.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢用電子調音器整好結他嘅音準。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 jung6 din6 zi2 diu6 jam1 hei3 zing2 hou2 git3 taa1 ge3 jam1 zeon2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他用電子調音器把吉他的音準調好了。
examples.english_sentence: He tuned his guitar with an electronic tuner.

mandarin_meaning: 音痴（听觉上走音／五音不全），指唱歌跑调或无法准确分辨音高的人
english_meaning: tone-deaf; someone who cannot sing in tune or has poor sense of pitch
explanation_mandarin: 用來形容一個人在音高辨識或唱歌方面很差，常常跑調或五音不全。有時也口語化用作自嘲或形容不擅長音樂的人。
explanation_english: Describes someone who has poor pitch perception or cannot sing in tune. Often used conversationally to describe or self-deprecate about lacking musical ability.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好笑我，我係音痴，唱歌成日走音。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 siu3 ngo5, ngo5 hai6 jam1ci1, coeng3go1 sing4jat6 zau2jam1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 別笑我，我是音痴，唱歌總是走音。
examples.english_sentence: Don't laugh at me — I'm tone-deaf; I always sing off-key.

mandarin_meaning: 音痴（指對音高、節奏等沒有良好音感，唱歌走音的人）
english_meaning: tone-deaf; a person who cannot sing in tune or lacks sense of pitch
explanation_mandarin: 口語用詞，指對音樂或歌唱沒有良好音感，經常走音或分不清音高的人，有時帶幽默或輕鬆貶義。
explanation_english: A colloquial term for someone who lacks a good sense of pitch and often sings off-key. Often used humorously or lightly pejorative.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢唱歌好有自信，但係佢係音癡，成日走音。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 coeng3 go1 hou2 jau5 zi6 seon3, daan6 hai6 keoi5 hai6 jam1 ci1, seng4 jat6 zau2 jam1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他唱歌很有自信，但他很走音（是个音痴）。
examples.english_sentence: He sings with a lot of confidence, but he's tone-deaf and often sings off-key.

mandarin_meaning: 音程（音樂術語）：兩個音高之間的距離
english_meaning: musical interval — the distance between two pitches
explanation_mandarin: 指在音樂中，兩個音高之間的距離或相對關係，常用於和聲與旋律分析，例如純八度、大三度等。
explanation_english: Refers to the distance or relationship between two pitches in music; a basic concept in harmony and melody (e.g., perfect octave, major third).

examples.cantonese_sentence: 學和聲嘅時候，要了解各種音程之間嘅關係。
examples.jyutping_sentence: hok6 wo4seng1 ge3 si4hau6, jiu3 liu5gaai2 gok3zung2 jam1 cing4 zi1gaan1 ge3 gwaan1hai6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 學習和聲的時候，要了解各種音程之間的關係。
examples.english_sentence: When studying harmony, you need to understand the relationships between different intervals.

mandarin_meaning: 音符（表示音高和時值的記號）
english_meaning: musical note (a symbol representing pitch and duration)
explanation_mandarin: 用於樂譜上的記號，表示音的音高和時長（時值），例如全音符、四分音符等。
explanation_english: A symbol used in sheet music to indicate the pitch and duration (note value) of a sound, e.g., whole notes, quarter notes.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 嗰張譜上面啲音符寫得好清楚。
examples.jyutping_sentence: go2 zoeng1 pou2 soeng6 min6 di1 jam1 fu4 se2 dak1 hou2 cing1 co2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 那張譜子上的音符寫得很清楚。
examples.english_sentence: The notes on that sheet music are written very clearly.

mandarin_meaning: 音箱（扬声器、喇叭）
english_meaning: speaker; loudspeaker; speaker cabinet
explanation_mandarin: 指播放聲音的設備，通常指揚聲器或喇叭，用來把電訊號轉換成聲音並放大輸出。
explanation_english: A device that plays sound, typically a loudspeaker or speaker cabinet that converts electrical signals into audible sound and amplifies it.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 今晚個派對要用大音箱先夠聲。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gam1 maan5 go3 paai3 deoi6 jiu3 jung6 daai6 jam1 soeng1 sin1 gau3 seng1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 今晚的派对需要用大音箱才够响。
examples.english_sentence: Tonight's party needs big speakers to be loud enough.

mandarin_meaning: 音节
english_meaning: syllable
explanation_mandarin: 語音學術語，指語音中由一個或多個音素組成並以一個元音或能作元音的音素為核心的發音單位，用來計算詞或字的讀音長度。
explanation_english: A linguistic unit of pronunciation typically built around a vowel (or syllabic consonant), possibly with initial and final consonants. Syllables are used to count pronunciation units in words.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢個字有三個音節。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 go3 zi6 jau5 saam1 go3 jam1 zit3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这个字有三个音节。
examples.english_sentence: This word has three syllables.

mandarin_meaning: 音素（語音學中的最小能區分語義的語音單位，常對應為「音位／音素」，學術用語依語境有所區分）
english_meaning: phoneme (the smallest distinctive sound unit in a language)
explanation_mandarin: 在語音學中，指語言裡最小的語音單位，能區分詞義或語音對比。不同語言會有不同的音素系統，學術上「音素」與「音位」的用法會有細微差別。
explanation_english: In phonetics/linguistics, refers to the smallest sound unit in a language that can distinguish meaning. Different languages have different sets of phonemes; the terms 'phoneme' and related technical labels can have nuanced distinctions in linguistics.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 喺語音學入面，音素係指語言入面最細嘅能區分意思嘅語音單位。
examples.jyutping_sentence: hai2 jyu5 jam1 hok6 jap6 min6 , jam1 sou3 hai6 zi2 jyu5 jin4 jap6 min6 zeoi3 sai3 ge3 nang4 keoi1 fan1 ji3 si1 ge3 jyu5 jam1 daan1 wai6 .
examples.mandarin_sentence: 在語音學裡，音素是指語言中最小能區分意思的語音單位。
examples.english_sentence: In phonetics, a phoneme is the smallest sound unit in a language that can distinguish meaning.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 英語入面 /p/ 同 /b/ 係兩個唔同嘅音素。
examples.jyutping_sentence: jing1 jyu5 jap6 min6 /p/ tung4 /b/ hai6 loeng5 go3 m4 tung4 ge3 jam1 sou3 .
examples.mandarin_sentence: 在英語中 /p/ 和 /b/ 是兩個不同的音素。
examples.english_sentence: In English, /p/ and /b/ are two different phonemes.

mandarin_meaning: 音色（yīnsè），指聲音的音質或音色特性
english_meaning: timbre; tone color — the characteristic quality of a sound that distinguishes different sources (voices or instruments) even when pitch and loudness are the same
explanation_mandarin: 音色指聲音所具有的獨特音質或色彩，用以區別不同的樂器或聲音來源，即使音高和響度相同，音色仍會不同。
explanation_english: Timbre (tone color) refers to the distinctive quality of a sound that allows us to distinguish different instruments or voices even when pitch and loudness are the same.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 聽完佢唱歌，我好鍾意佢嘅音色。
examples.jyutping_sentence: teng1 jyun4 keoi5 coeng3 go1, ngo5 hou2 zung1 ji3 keoi5 ge3 jam1 sik1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 听完他唱歌，我很喜欢他的音色。
examples.english_sentence: After hearing him sing, I really like his timbre.

mandarin_meaning: 音訊（音讯）：消息、聯絡的消息
english_meaning: news; message; contact (information from someone)
explanation_mandarin: 指人與人之間的消息或聯絡，常用於表示是否收到某人的消息，例如「音訊全無／有音訊」。
explanation_english: Refers to news or contact from someone — information about whether someone has communicated. Often used in phrases like 'no news' or 'have news'.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我已經好耐冇佢嘅音訊。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 ji5 ging1 hou2 noi6 mou5 keoi5 ge3 jam1 seon3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我已經很久沒有他的音訊。
examples.english_sentence: I haven't heard from him in a long time.

mandarin_meaning: 音讯全无（完全没有任何消息或联络）
english_meaning: No news at all; completely out of contact
explanation_mandarin: 表示完全沒有任何消息或聯繫，常用來形容在一段時間內沒有收到對方的來信、電話或回覆。
explanation_english: Indicates a complete lack of news or contact; commonly used to describe not receiving messages, calls, or replies from someone for a period of time.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 自從佢去咗美國之後，成半年都音訊全無。
examples.jyutping_sentence: zi6 cung4 keoi5 heoi3 zo2 mei5 gwok3 zi1 hau6, sing4 bun3 nin4 dou1 jam1 seon3 cyun4 mou4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 自从他去美国后，半年都音讯全无。
examples.english_sentence: Ever since he went to the US, there's been no news from him for half a year.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我打咗好多次電話都冇人接，真係音訊全無。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 daa2 zo2 hou2 do1 ci3 din6 waa2 dou1 mou5 jan4 zip3, zan1 hai6 jam1 seon3 cyun4 mou4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我打了很多次电话都没人接，真是音讯全无。
examples.english_sentence: I've called many times and nobody answered—there's truly no contact.

mandarin_meaning: 音调（指语言的声调、语调或声音的高低起伏）
english_meaning: tone; pitch; intonation (the pitch or contour of a sound or lexical tone in language)
explanation_mandarin: 指語言中的聲調或語音的高低起伏，也可泛指聲音的音色或腔調。在粵語中，音調對詞義有決定性作用。
explanation_english: Refers to the tone or pitch contour in language or sound; can also mean timbre or intonation. In Cantonese, tones are phonemic and can change word meanings.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 學廣東話要好好練習音調，唔同音調會改變意思。
examples.jyutping_sentence: hok6 gwong2 dung1 waa2 jiu3 hou2 hou2 lin6 zaap6 jam1 diu6, m4 tung4 jam1 diu6 wui5 goi2 bin3 ji3 si1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 学广东话要好好练习音调，不同的音调会改变意思。
examples.english_sentence: When learning Cantonese you should practice tones carefully; different tones can change the meaning.

mandarin_meaning: 音译
english_meaning: transliteration; to transliterate (rendering a word by its sound)
explanation_mandarin: 把外語詞按原詞發音轉寫成本語言的文字或拼音。與意譯相對，強調保留原詞的發音而不是直接翻譯其含義。
explanation_english: Rendering a word from one language into another by representing its pronunciation rather than its meaning; to write or adapt a foreign word based on its sound. Opposite of translating by meaning.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢個外國嘅名係音譯嚟嘅。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 go3 ngoi6 gwok3 ge3 meng2 hai6 jam1 jik6 lai4 ge3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这个外国的名字是音译过来的。
examples.english_sentence: This foreign name is a transliteration.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 好多外來詞係用音譯，例如「咖啡」。
examples.jyutping_sentence: hou2 do1 ngoi6 loi4 ci4 hai6 jung6 jam1 jik6, lai6 jyu6 'gaa3 fe1'.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 很多外来词是用音译的，例如“咖啡”。
examples.english_sentence: Many loanwords are transliterated, for example 'coffee'.

mandarin_meaning: 朗讀；念出聲；按字的讀音讀出
english_meaning: to read aloud; phonetic reading; reading a character/word by its pronunciation
explanation_mandarin: 指把文字按其發音念出來，常用於語文教學中的朗讀練習或描述字詞的讀音。
explanation_english: Refers to reading text aloud according to pronunciation; commonly used in language teaching for oral reading exercises or to describe a character/word's pronunciation.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 老師叫我哋做音讀練習。
examples.jyutping_sentence: lou5 si1 giu3 ngo5 dei6 zou6 jam1 duk6 lin6 zaap6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 老師叫我們做音讀練習。
examples.english_sentence: The teacher asked us to do reading-aloud exercises.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢個字有兩個音讀，粵語同普通話唔同。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 go3 zi6 jau5 loeng5 go3 jam1 duk6, jyut6 jyu5 tung4 pou2 tung1 waa6 m4 tung4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这个字有两个音读，粤语和普通话不同。
examples.english_sentence: This character has two pronunciations; the Cantonese and Mandarin readings differ.

mandarin_meaning: 音質（yīnzhì）：聲音的品質
english_meaning: sound quality
explanation_mandarin: 指聲音的品質，包括清晰度、音色、頻率響應、失真等特性，常用來描述耳機、喇叭、錄音或直播等聲音表現。
explanation_english: Refers to the quality of sound, including clarity, timbre, frequency response, distortion, etc.; commonly used to describe headphones, speakers, recordings, or live audio performance.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢對耳機嘅音質真係幾好，細節都聽到。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 deoi3 ji5 gei1 ge3 jam1zat1 zan1hai6 gei2 hou2, sai3zit3 dou1 teng1 dou3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 這副耳機的音質真的不錯，細節都能聽到。
examples.english_sentence: The sound quality of these headphones is really good; you can hear the details.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 聽直播嗰陣，好明顯音質有啲差，要換條線。
examples.jyutping_sentence: teng1 zik6bo3 go2 zan6, hou2 ming4hin2 jam1zat1 jau5 di1 caa1, jiu3 wun6 tiu4 sin3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 聽直播的時候，音質很明顯有點差，要換一條線。
examples.english_sentence: When listening to the live stream, the sound quality was noticeably poor — need to change the cable.

mandarin_meaning: 音速（聲音在介質中傳播的速度）
english_meaning: speed of sound; sonic speed; (figuratively) extremely fast
explanation_mandarin: 指聲音在某種介質（例如空氣、水、固體）中傳播的速度；在日常語境中也可用作比喻，表示極快的速度。
explanation_english: The speed at which sound travels through a medium (e.g., air, water, solids). In everyday use it can also be used figuratively to describe something extremely fast.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 戰鬥機衝破音速嘅時候會有音爆。
examples.jyutping_sentence: zin3 dau3 gei1 cung1 po3 jam1 cuk1 ge3 si4 hau6 wui5 jau5 jam1 baau3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 戰鬥機突破音速的時候會產生音爆。
examples.english_sentence: When a fighter jet breaks the sound barrier, it produces a sonic boom.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢跑得快到好似要達到音速。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 paau2 dak1 faai3 dou3 hou2 ci5 jiu3 daat6 dou3 jam1 cuk1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他跑得那麼快，好像要達到音速了。
examples.english_sentence: He runs so fast it seems like he's reached the speed of sound.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 聲速會受溫度影響，通常溫度越高聲速越快。
examples.jyutping_sentence: sing1 cuk1 wui5 sau6 wun1 dou6 jing2 hoeng2, tung1 soeng4 wun1 dou6 jyut6 gou1 sing1 cuk1 jyut6 faai3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 音速會受到溫度影響，通常溫度越高音速越快。
examples.english_sentence: The speed of sound is affected by temperature; generally, higher temperatures increase the speed of sound.

mandarin_meaning: 音量（聲音的大小）
english_meaning: volume (sound level)
explanation_mandarin: 表示聲音的大小或強弱，常用於電子設備、播放和錄音等場景。
explanation_english: Refers to the loudness or intensity of sound; commonly used for electronic devices, playback, and recording contexts.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你可唔可以將電視個音量調低啲？
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 ho2 m4 ho2 ji5 zoeng1 din6 si6 go3 jam1 loeng6 tiu4 dai1 di1?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你能不能把電視的音量調低一點？
examples.english_sentence: Can you turn down the TV volume a bit?

examples.cantonese_sentence: 聽音樂嘅時候，音量唔好太大，保護耳朵。
examples.jyutping_sentence: teng1 jam1 ngok6 ge3 si4 hau6, jam1 loeng6 m4 hou2 taai3 daai6 sing1, bou2 wu6 ji5 do2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 聽音樂的時候，音量不要太大，保護耳朵。
examples.english_sentence: When listening to music, don't make the volume too loud; protect your ears.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 錄音嗰陣，音量太高會爆聲，要調低啲。
examples.jyutping_sentence: luk6 jam1 go2 zan6, jam1 loeng6 taai3 gou1 wui5 baau3 seng1, jiu3 tiu4 dai1 di1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 錄音時音量太高會爆音，需要調低一點。
examples.english_sentence: During recording, if the volume is too high it will clip; you need to lower it a bit.

mandarin_meaning: 音阶 (yīn jiē)
english_meaning: musical scale; scale (sequence of pitches)
explanation_mandarin: 音樂術語，指按音高排列的一系列音符，用以構成旋律與調式（例如大調、小調等）。
explanation_english: A musical term referring to an ordered sequence of pitches used to form melodies and modes (for example major or minor scales).

examples.cantonese_sentence: 學琴時要熟悉各種音階，咁樣先可以彈出唔同嘅調子。
examples.jyutping_sentence: hok6 kam4 si4 jiu3 suk6 sik1 gok3 zung2 jam1 gaai1, gam2 joeng6 sin1 ho2 ji5 taan4 ceot1 m4 tung4 ge3 diu6 zi2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 学琴时要熟悉各种音阶，这样才能弹出不同的调子。
examples.english_sentence: When learning the piano you should familiarize yourself with different scales so you can play in different keys.

mandarin_meaning: 音韵学（研究语言声音系统的学科）
english_meaning: phonology (the study of the sound system of a language, including phonemes, tones, and prosody)
explanation_mandarin: 語言學的一個分支，研究語音系統、音位、韻律（如聲調、重音）及其在語言中的規律和變化。
explanation_english: A branch of linguistics that studies the sound system of languages, including phonemes, tones, syllable structure, and prosodic patterns and their systematic behaviors.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢係音韻學教授，專門研究漢語方言嘅聲調變化。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hai6 jam1 wan6 hok6 gaau3 sau6, zyun1 mun4 jin4 gau3 hon3 jyu5 fong1 jin4 ge3 sing1 diu6 bin3 faa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他是音韵学教授，专门研究汉语方言的声调变化。
examples.english_sentence: He is a phonology professor who specializes in studying tone changes in Chinese dialects.

mandarin_meaning: 音响（聲音、聲學或音響設備，如揚聲器、音響系統）
english_meaning: sound; audio; audio equipment (e.g., loudspeakers, stereo system)
explanation_mandarin: 可以指聲音或聲學效果，也常用來指音響設備如揚聲器、音響系統，涵蓋硬體與整體的音響效果。
explanation_english: Refers to sound or acoustics, and commonly to audio equipment such as loudspeakers or a stereo system; covers both the hardware and the overall audio effect.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋買咗一套新嘅音響。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 maai5 zo2 jat1 tou3 san1 ge3 jam1 hoeng2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们买了一套新的音响。
examples.english_sentence: We bought a new stereo system.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 音響出咗問題，要搵人修理。
examples.jyutping_sentence: jam1 hoeng2 ceot1 zo2 man6 tai4, jiu3 wan2 jan4 sau1 lei5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 音响有问题，需要找人修理。
examples.english_sentence: The audio system has a problem; we need to get someone to fix it.

cantonese: 音響窮三代，攝影累全家
jyutping: jam1 hoeng2 kung4 saam1 doi6, sip3 jing2 leoi6 cyun4 gaa1
mandarin_meaning: 玩音響會讓三代都窮，攝影會連累全家（意指這些嗜好非常燒錢）
english_meaning: A humorous proverb saying that hi‑fi audio can make three generations poor and photography can strain the whole family — i.e. these hobbies are very expensive.
explanation_mandarin: 這句話用誇張的說法表達玩音響和攝影等嗜好非常花錢，可能讓家庭經濟吃緊。
explanation_english: An ironic Cantonese saying that exaggerates how costly hobbies like audio equipment and photography can be — suggesting they can financially burden individuals or families.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 阿Sam話想買部高級相機，阿媽笑住話：「音響窮三代，攝影累全家。」
examples.jyutping_sentence: aa3 Sam1 waa6 soeng2 maai5 bou6 gou1 kap1 soeng1 gei1, aa3 maa1 siu3 zyu6 waa6: 'jam1 hoeng2 kung4 saam1 doi6, sip3 jing2 leoi6 cyun4 gaa1'.
examples.mandarin_sentence: Sam說想買一台高級相機，媽媽笑著說：「音響窮三代，攝影累全家。」
examples.english_sentence: Sam said he wanted to buy a high‑end camera; his mom laughed and said, 'Audio makes three generations poor, and photography burdens the whole family.'

mandarin_meaning: 音頻（與聲音相關的頻率或以聲音形式存在的資料，如音檔、播客段落等）
english_meaning: audio; audio frequency; audio clip or recording
explanation_mandarin: 指與聲音有關的頻率或以聲音形式存在的資料或媒體，例如音檔、錄音或線上播客的段落。
explanation_english: Refers to sound-related frequencies or data in sound form, such as audio files, recordings, or segments of podcasts.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你可以將嗰段音頻上傳俾我聽嗎？
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 ho2 ji5 zoeng1 go2 dyun6 jam1 pan4 soeng5 cyun4 bei2 ngo5 teng1 maa3?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你可以把那段音頻上傳給我聽嗎？
examples.english_sentence: Can you upload that audio clip for me to listen to?

examples.cantonese_sentence: 嗰個網站有好多免費嘅音頻教學。
examples.jyutping_sentence: go2 go3 mong5 zaam6 jau5 hou2 do1 min5 fai3 ge3 jam1 pan4 gaau3 hok6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 那個網站有很多免費的音頻教學。
examples.english_sentence: That website has lots of free audio lessons.

mandarin_meaning: 音高 (yīngāo)
english_meaning: pitch (the perceived highness or lowness of a sound)
explanation_mandarin: 指聲音的高低或頻率，常用於音樂和語音學，描述音符或語音的高度感。
explanation_english: Refers to the perceived highness or lowness of a sound (its pitch). Commonly used in music and phonetics to describe the relative height of notes or tones.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢首歌嘅音高好高，我唱唔到。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 sau2 go1 ge3 jam1 gou1 hou2 gou1, ngo5 coeng3 m4 dou3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这首歌的音高很高，我唱不上去。
examples.english_sentence: The pitch of this song is very high; I can't sing it.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你可以將音高調低嚟配合女歌手嘅聲線。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 ho2 ji5 zoeng1 jam1 gou1 tiu4 dai1 lai4 pui3 hap6 neoi5 go1 sau2 ge3 sing1 sin3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你可以把音高调低来配合女歌手的声线。
examples.english_sentence: You can lower the pitch to match the female singer's vocal range.

mandarin_meaning: 韵（yùn）：押韵、韵律；韵味、风格、魅力
english_meaning: rhyme; rhythm; charm; tonal quality; poetic resonance
explanation_mandarin: 表示声音上的押韵或韵律，也常用来指作品或言语的韵味、风格与魅力。
explanation_english: Refers to rhyme or rhythmic quality in sound; also used to describe the charm, style, or poetic resonance of speech or work.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢首歌好有韵味，旋律同聲線都好吸引。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 sau2 go1 hou2 jau5 wan6 mei6, syun4 leot6 tung4 seng1 sin3 dou1 hou2 kap1 jan5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这首歌很有韵味，旋律和声线都很吸引。
examples.english_sentence: This song has a lot of charm; the melody and vocal tone are very appealing.

mandarin_meaning: （sháo）指美好的青春、光陰；也作地名（如韶山）。
english_meaning: Refers to beautiful youth or the prime of life/time; also appears in place names (e.g. Shaoshan).
partOfSpeech_mandarin: 名詞（多見於合成詞，如「韶華」「韶光」「韶山」；文言中亦可作形容義）
explanation_mandarin: 「韶」字多用於表示青春美好的時光，如「韶華」「韶光」。另外也是地名用字，如湖南的「韶山」。屬於較書面或文言的用法。
explanation_english: The character typically denotes beautiful youth or the prime of life (seen in compounds like "韶華" or "韶光"). It is also used in place names such as Shaoshan. Usage is literary or formal.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 毛澤東係韶山人。
examples.jyutping_sentence: mou4 zaak6 dung1 hai6 siu4 saan1 jan4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 毛泽东是韶山人。
examples.english_sentence: Mao Zedong was from Shaoshan.

mandarin_meaning: 韶关（地名），中国广东省的地级市
english_meaning: Shaoguan, a prefecture-level city in northern Guangdong Province, China
explanation_mandarin: 位于中国广东省北部的地级市，为一个地名，通常用于指代该城市及其行政区域。
explanation_english: A prefecture-level city in northern Guangdong Province, China. Used as a place name referring to the city and its administrative area.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我下個禮拜會去韶關旅行。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 haa6 go3 lai5 baai3 wui5 heoi3 siu4 gwaan1 leoi5 hang4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我下个礼拜会去韶关旅行。
examples.english_sentence: I'll go to Shaoguan for a trip next week.

mandarin_meaning: 韵 (yùn)：诗词的押韵、语音的音韵，或事物的韵味（风格、魅力）
english_meaning: rhyme; rhyme scheme; sonority/phonetic quality; charm or nuance (literary/cultural flavor)
explanation_mandarin: 指诗词末尾的押韵（韵脚）、語音的聲韻特徵，或用來形容事物/言语具有的独特风格和韵味。
explanation_english: Refers to the rhyme in poetry (ending sounds), the phonetic/sonic quality of speech, or the particular charm/nuance/style of something.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢首詩嘅韻腳好工整，讀落好順口。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 sau2 si1 ge3 wan6 gok3 hou2 gung1 zing2, duk6 lok6 hou2 seon6 hau2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这首诗的韵脚很工整，读起来很顺口。
examples.english_sentence: The rhymes in this poem are very neat; it reads smoothly.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢講嘢好有一種古典嘅韻味。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 gong2 je5 hou2 jau5 jat1 zung2 gu2 din2 ge3 wan6 mei6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他/她说话很有一种古典的韵味。
examples.english_sentence: He/she speaks with a certain classical charm.

mandarin_meaning: 風流韻事；情事（常指婚外或隱秘的戀情/風流往事）
english_meaning: a romantic or sexual affair; a liaison (often secret or scandalous)
explanation_mandarin: 指男女之間的風流或情事，常含婚外情、緋聞或可被傳謠的私情之意，語氣可帶貶義或八卦意味。
explanation_english: Refers to romantic or sexual affairs between people, often implying extramarital or secret liaisons; can carry connotations of scandal or gossip.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 公司傳出老細有啲韻事，成日畀人講。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gung1 si1 cyun4 ceot1 lou5 sai3 jau5 di1 wan6 si6, sing4 jat6 bei2 jan4 gong2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 公司傳出老闆有些風流韻事，大家總是在議論。
examples.english_sentence: There are rumors that the boss had some affairs; people keep talking about it.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢話嗰啲只係舊日嘅韻事，唔想再提。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 waa6 go2 di1 zi2 hai6 gau6 jat6 ge3 wan6 si6, m4 soeng2 zoi3 tai4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他說那些只是過去的風流韻事，不想再提。
examples.english_sentence: He said those were just past romantic affairs and doesn't want to bring them up again.

mandarin_meaning: 韵味（指事物或人的風格、情趣或美感）
english_meaning: charm; artistic/poetic flavor; distinctive appeal
explanation_mandarin: 指作品、人物或事物散發出的美感、風格或情趣，常用來形容有藝術性、含蓄或獨特的魅力。
explanation_english: Refers to the aesthetic quality, style, or subtle charm emitted by a work, person, or thing—often used to describe artistic, refined, or distinctive appeal.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢個作品好有韻味，睇落有深度。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 go3 zok3 ban2 hou2 jau5 wan6 mei6, tai2 lok6 jau5 sam1 dou6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 這件作品很有韻味，看起來很有深度。
examples.english_sentence: This piece has a lot of charm; it looks quite profound.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢件旗袍好有韻味，襯你嘅氣質。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 gin6 kei4 paau4 hou2 jau5 wan6 mei6, can3 nei5 ge3 hei3 zat1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 這件旗袍很有韻味，襯托你的氣質。
examples.english_sentence: This qipao is very graceful and suits your temperament.

mandarin_meaning: 韵尾 (yùnwěi)
english_meaning: coda (rhyme ending of a syllable)
explanation_mandarin: 在音韻學中，韻尾指音節的結尾部分，通常是元音後面的輔音或閉口，如 -p、-t、-k、-m、-n、-ng 等，對粵語等語言的聲母韻母結構和押韻有重要作用。
explanation_english: In phonology, the '韻尾' (coda) is the final part of a syllable, typically a consonant following the vowel (e.g. -p, -t, -k, -m, -n, -ng). It plays an important role in syllable structure, pronunciation and rhyme patterns, especially in Cantonese.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 學廣東話時要注意韻尾，否則會聽唔清楚。
examples.jyutping_sentence: hok6 gwong2 dung1 waa2 si4 jiu3 zyu3 ji3 wan6 mei5, fau2 zak1 wui5 teng1 m4 cing1 co2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 學廣東話時要注意韻尾，否則會聽不清楚。
examples.english_sentence: When learning Cantonese you should pay attention to the codas, otherwise you won't hear them clearly.

mandarin_meaning: 韵律（yùnlǜ），指诗歌、语言或音乐中有规律的节奏与抑扬变化
english_meaning: rhythm; meter; cadence (the regular pattern of beats, stresses, or intonation in speech, poetry, or music)
explanation_mandarin: 指語言、詩歌或音樂中由節奏、重音與音高變化所形成的規律性模式，常用來描述節拍和押韻的感覺。
explanation_english: Refers to the regular patterns of timing, stress, and pitch changes in speech, poetry, or music; used to describe beat, meter, and the sense of flow or cadence.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢首歌嘅韻律好有感染力，令人想跳舞。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 sau2 go1 ge3 wan6 leot6 hou2 jau5 gam2 jim5 lik6, ling6 jan4 soeng2 tiu3 mou5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这首歌的韵律很有感染力，让人想跳舞。
examples.english_sentence: The rhythm of this song is very expressive; it makes people want to dance.

mandarin_meaning: 藝術游泳（又稱花樣游泳）
english_meaning: artistic swimming (formerly synchronized swimming)
explanation_mandarin: 一種競技性水上運動，結合游泳、舞蹈與體操動作，通常配合音樂進行，強調動作的節奏感與隊形協調。
explanation_english: A competitive aquatic sport combining swimming, dance, and gymnastics movements performed to music, emphasizing rhythm, coordination, and synchronized formations. Formerly called synchronized swimming.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢參加咗學校嘅韻律泳隊，成日練習同步動作同耐力。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 caam1 gaa1 zo2 hok6 haau6 ge3 wan6 leot6 wing6 deoi6, sing4 jat6 lin6 zaap6 tung4 bou6 dung6 zok3 tung4 noi6 lik6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他/她参加了学校的艺术游泳队，天天练习同步动作和耐力。
examples.english_sentence: He/She joined the school's artistic swimming team and practices synchronized moves and endurance every day.

mandarin_meaning: 韻文（yùnwén）：指有格律、押韻的詩歌或詩體文學，與散文相對。
english_meaning: verse; metrical poetry; poetic writing (poetry as opposed to prose)
explanation_mandarin: 指具有韻律和押韻特徵的文體，如古典詩詞或現代詩，通常強調節奏與音韻美，與散文（無格律）相對。
explanation_english: Refers to literary works that employ rhythm and rhyme—poetry or verse (e.g., classical poems, metrical verse). Emphasizes rhythmic and phonetic qualities, contrasted with prose.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 喺中文課我哋學咗好多中國古典嘅韻文。
examples.jyutping_sentence: hai2 zung1 man4 fo3 ngo5 dei6 hok6 zo2 hou2 do1 zung1 gwok3 gu2 din2 ge3 wan6 man4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 在中文課上我們學了很多中國古典的韻文。
examples.english_sentence: In Chinese class we studied many pieces of classical Chinese verse.

mandarin_meaning: 韵母
english_meaning: rime (the vowel and any final consonant of a syllable)
explanation_mandarin: 韻母是音節中除聲母外的部分，通常包括介音、主元音和韻尾（如元音或尾音）。在語音學中用來描述音節的元音及其結尾。
explanation_english: The rime (韻母) is the part of a syllable excluding the initial (initial consonant). It typically comprises the medial, nucleus (vowel) and coda (final consonant). Used in phonology to describe a syllable's vowel and ending.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 學廣東話要先學聲母同韻母。
examples.jyutping_sentence: hok6 gwong2 dung1 waa2 jiu3 sin1 hok6 seng1 mou5 tung4 wan6 mou5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 学广东话要先学声母和韵母。
examples.english_sentence: To learn Cantonese, you should first learn initials and rimes.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢啲韻母嘅發音你要多練習。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 di1 wan6 mou5 ge3 faat3 jam1 nei5 jiu3 do1 lin6 zaap6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这些韵母的发音你要多练习。
examples.english_sentence: You need to practice the pronunciation of these rimes a lot.

mandarin_meaning: 韵头
english_meaning: medial (glide) / rhyme head
explanation_mandarin: 指音節中位於聲母與主要元音之間的滑音或介音，例如 /j/、/w/。在粵語音韻學中，韻頭常用來描述介音或韻母的起始部分。
