examples.english_sentence: If you're interested, ask whether the lease will be transferred together.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋喺報紙登咗一個頂讓廣告，賣埋所有設備。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 hai2 bou3 zi2 dang1 zo2 jat1 go3 ding2 joeng6 gwong2 gou3, maai6 maai4 so2 jau5 cit3 bei6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他們在報紙登了一則頂讓廣告，連所有設備一起賣掉。
examples.english_sentence: They placed a 'for transfer' ad in the paper, selling all the equipment along with it.

mandarin_meaning: 撞到/踢到腳趾
english_meaning: to stub (one's) toe; to hit one's toe
explanation_mandarin: 口語用法，指不小心用腳撞到或踢到桌腳、凳角等，使腳趾受傷或感到劇痛。
explanation_english: A colloquial Cantonese verb meaning to accidentally hit or kick your toe on something (e.g., table leg), causing pain or minor injury.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 啱啱行路嗰陣撞到桌腳，頂趾痛到喊。
examples.jyutping_sentence: aam1 aam1 haang4 lou6 go2 zan6 zong6 dou3 zoek3 goek3, ding2 zi2 tung3 dou3 haam3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 剛才走路的時候撞到桌腳，把腳趾撞痛得要哭了。
examples.english_sentence: I just hit my toe on the table leg while walking; it hurt so much I almost cried.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 行路唔好望手機，小心會頂趾。
examples.jyutping_sentence: haang4 lou6 m4 hou2 mong6 sau2 gei1, siu2 sam1 wui5 ding2 zi2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 走路不要看手機，小心會撞到腳趾。
examples.english_sentence: Don't look at your phone while walking; be careful you might stub your toe.

mandarin_meaning: 人字拖 / 夾腳拖（拖鞋的一種）
english_meaning: flip-flops; thong sandals (open-toe sandals with a thong between the toes)
explanation_mandarin: 一種在兩個腳趾之間有一條帶子夾住的拖鞋（人字拖），屬於非正式、夏天或去海灘時常穿的休閒鞋。
explanation_english: A type of open-toe sandal with a Y-shaped thong that fits between the toes (flip-flops). Casual, informal footwear commonly worn in summer or at the beach.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 夏天我成日著頂趾鞋出街，幾輕便。
examples.jyutping_sentence: haa6 tin1 ngo5 seng4 jat6 zoek3 ding2 zi2 haai4 ceot1 gaai1, gei2 heng1 bin6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 夏天我常常穿人字拖出門，很方便。
examples.english_sentence: In summer I often wear flip-flops when going out; they're quite convenient.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 公司唔准著頂趾鞋返工，要著正式鞋。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gung1 si1 m4 zeon2 zoek3 ding2 zi2 haai4 faan1 gung1, jiu3 zoek3 zing3 sik1 haai4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 公司不准穿人字拖上班，要穿正式的鞋子。
examples.english_sentence: The company doesn't allow flip-flops at work; you have to wear formal shoes.

mandarin_meaning: 敬酒／跟酒（在飲酒場合接受別人的敬酒或被迫喝酒）
english_meaning: to accept a toast / to drink (often in response to a toast or under social pressure); to drink heavily or keep up with rounds
explanation_mandarin: 「頂酒」為廣東話俗語，指在飲酒場合接受別人的敬酒或被迫跟人喝酒；亦可指硬飲、拼命喝、跟別人喝到不讓步的行為。
explanation_english: A Cantonese slang verb meaning to accept a toast or drink in response to someone’s offer (often under social pressure); can also mean to drink heavily or keep up with others' rounds.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你唔好逼我頂酒，我今晚真係唔想飲。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 m4 hou2 bik1 ngo5 ding2 zau2, ngo5 gam1 maan5 zan1 hai6 m4 soeng2 jam2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你不要逼我敬酒，我今晚真的不想喝酒。
examples.english_sentence: Don't force me to drink; I really don't want to drink tonight.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢成晚都係頂酒，第二朝好攰同頭痛。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 seng4 maan5 dou1 hai6 ding2 zau2, dai6 ji6 ziu1 hou2 gui6 tung4 tau4 tung3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他整晚都在拼命喝酒，第二天早上很累又頭痛。
examples.english_sentence: He kept drinking all night and felt tired and had a headache the next morning.

mandarin_meaning: 猛踩刹车；突然中止（行动/计划）
english_meaning: to slam on the brakes; to stop abruptly (literal and figurative)
explanation_mandarin: 口語/俚語，原指駕駛時突然猛踩剎車使車輛快速停下；引申可指迅速或果斷地中止某項行動或計劃。
explanation_english: A colloquial/slang expression originally meaning to brake hard while driving to stop quickly; figuratively it can mean to abruptly halt or terminate an action or plan.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 司機見前面有部車衝出，立即頂閘停車。
examples.jyutping_sentence: si1 gei1 gin3 cin4 min6 jau5 bou6 ce1 cung1 ceot1, lap6 zik1 ding2 zaap6 ting4 ce1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 司机看到前面有辆车冲出来，立刻猛踩刹车停下。
examples.english_sentence: The driver saw a car dart out in front and slammed on the brakes to stop.

mandarin_meaning: 頂端；最上面；（用於複合詞）直接上司
english_meaning: top; the topmost/upper part; in front; (in compounds) immediate superior
partOfSpeech_mandarin: 名詞／方位詞（亦可作複合詞成分）
explanation_mandarin: 表示位於最上方或最前面的方位；在複合詞中如「頂頭上司」可指直接的上司或上級。
explanation_english: Denotes the topmost or upper/forward position. In compounds (e.g. 頂頭上司) it can refer to an immediate superior or direct boss.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 相片掛喺牆嘅頂頭。
examples.jyutping_sentence: soeng1 pin3 gwaa3 hai2 coeng4 ge3 ding2 tau4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 照片掛在牆的最上面。
examples.english_sentence: The photo is hung at the top of the wall.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢係我嘅頂頭上司。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hai6 ngo5 ge3 ding2 tau4 soeng5 si1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他/她是我的直接上司。
examples.english_sentence: He/She is my immediate supervisor.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我坐喺佢嘅頂頭，咩都睇到佢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 co5 hai2 keoi5 ge3 ding2 tau4, me1 dou1 tai2 dou3 keoi5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我坐在他/她的前面，什麼都看得到他/她。
examples.english_sentence: I sat in front of him/her and could see everything he/she did.

mandarin_meaning: 直属上司；直接上级
english_meaning: immediate/direct superior; one's immediate boss
explanation_mandarin: 粵語用語，指在職場中直接管理或指揮你的上級，也就是你的直屬上司。
explanation_english: A Cantonese term for the superior who directly manages or oversees you at work—your immediate or direct boss.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我今日要見頂頭上司，討論個項目進度。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 gam1 jat6 jiu3 gin3 ding2 tau4 soeng5 si1, tou2 leon6 go3 hong6 muk6 zeon3 dou6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我今天要見直属上司，討論項目的進度。
examples.english_sentence: I have to meet my immediate supervisor today to discuss the project's progress.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 如果頂頭上司唔批准你加薪，你會點做？
examples.jyutping_sentence: jyu4 gwo2 ding2 tau4 soeng5 si1 m4 pei1 zeon2 nei5 gaa1 san1, nei5 wui5 dim2 zou6?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 如果直属上司不批准你加薪，你會怎麼做？
examples.english_sentence: If your immediate supervisor doesn't approve your raise, what would you do?

mandarin_meaning: 當頭一棒；迎頭一擊
english_meaning: a knockout blow; a sudden heavy blow or setback; a shocking surprise
explanation_mandarin: 原指打在頭頂上的一擊；比喻突然遭受的重大打擊或令人震驚的消息、挫折。
explanation_english: Literally a blow to the top of the head; figuratively a sudden heavy blow, setback, or shocking piece of news that stuns someone.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我以為可以成功，點知最後畀咗個頂頭槌。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 ji5wai6 ho2ji5 sing4gung1, dim2 zi1 zeoi6hau6 bei2 zo2 go3 ding2 tau4 ceoi4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我以為可以成功，結果最後吃了一個當頭一棒。
examples.english_sentence: I thought it would succeed, but in the end I was dealt a heavy blow.

mandarin_meaning: 打頭陣；率先出面、帶頭做某事
english_meaning: to go first; to take the lead; to be the first to take action
explanation_mandarin: 用來表示在一群人或一個行動中率先開始或擔任先鋒，常用於鼓勵或描述有人帶頭做事的情況。
explanation_english: Used to indicate taking the lead or being the first to start an action among a group; often used to describe someone volunteering to go first or lead an effort.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 今次個項目要有人頂頭陣，你願唔願意？
examples.jyutping_sentence: gam1 ci3 go3 hong6 muk6 jiu3 jau5 jan4 ding2 tau4 zan6, nei5 jyun6 m4 jyun6 ji3?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 這次這個項目要有人打頭陣，你願不願意？
examples.english_sentence: This project needs someone to go first—are you willing?

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢做事唔驚失敗，經常肯頂頭陣去試新嘢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 zou6 si6 m4 geng1 sat1 baai6, ging1 soeng4 hang2 ding2 tau4 zan6 heoi3 si3 san1 je5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他做事不怕失敗，經常願意打頭陣去嘗試新東西。
examples.english_sentence: He's not afraid of failure and often volunteers to be the first to try new things.

mandarin_meaning: 顶嘴、顶撞；固执、倔强
english_meaning: to talk back/argue; to be stubborn or defiant; unwilling to yield
explanation_mandarin: 粤语口语，表示和别人顶嘴、顶撞或很固执、不肯让步的态度。
explanation_english: A colloquial Cantonese expression meaning to talk back or defy someone; can also describe a person who is stubborn and unwilling to give in.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 小明好頂頸，老師叫佢做功課佢都唔做。
examples.jyutping_sentence: siu2 ming4 hou2 ding2 geng2, lou5 si1 giu3 keoi5 zou6 gung1 fo3 keoi5 dou1 m4 zou6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 小明很倔强，老师叫他做功课他都不做。
examples.english_sentence: Xiaoming is very stubborn — when the teacher tells him to do his homework he still won't do it.

mandarin_meaning: 顶风作案（在明知有风險或禁令下仍公然作案）
english_meaning: to brazenly commit an offense; to openly and defiantly carry out wrongdoing despite risks or prohibitions
explanation_mandarin: 形容在明知有風險、警告或禁令的情況下，仍然公然或無所顧忌地做違法或不當的事情，帶有挑釁、明目張膽之意。
explanation_english: Describes acting openly and defiantly to commit illegal or improper acts despite warnings, risks, or prohibitions; conveys brazenness and provocation.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢竟然喺警察面前頂風作案，真係夠膽。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 ging2 jin4 hai2 ging2 caat3 min6 cin4 ding2 fung1 zoek3 on3, zan1 hai6 gau3 daam2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他竟然在警察面前顶风作案，真是够胆。
examples.english_sentence: He actually committed the offense in front of the police — really gutsy.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 有啲違規嘅商鋪明知有封條都頂風作案，繼續營業。
examples.jyutping_sentence: jau5 di1 wai4 gwai1 ge3 soeng1 pou3 ming4 zi1 jau5 fung1 tiu4 dou1 ding2 fung1 zoek3 on3, gai3 zuk6 jing4 jip6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 有些违规的商铺明知贴了封条仍然顶风作案，继续营业。
examples.english_sentence: Some shops blatantly defied the notices and continued operating despite being ordered to close.

mandarin_meaning: 顶点 (dǐngdiǎn) — 最高点、顶端；在数学中指顶点或极值。
english_meaning: Apex, peak, summit, or vertex; in mathematics, a vertex or extremum.
explanation_mandarin: 表示事物的最高點或最頂端；在數學中可指多邊形的頂點或函數的極值（最高或最低點）。
explanation_english: Refers to the highest point or summit of something; in mathematics, it denotes a vertex (e.g., of a polygon) or an extremum of a function.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 經過多年努力，佢終於到達事業嘅頂點。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ging1 gwo3 do1 nin4 nou5 lik6, keoi5 zung1 jyu1 dou3 daat6 si6 jip6 ge3 ding2 dim2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 经过多年努力，他终于到达事业的顶点。
examples.english_sentence: After many years of hard work, he finally reached the pinnacle of his career.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 喺幾何學入面，頂點係多邊形嘅角。
examples.jyutping_sentence: hai2 gei2 ho4 hok6 jap6 min6, ding2 dim2 hai6 do1 bin1 jing4 ge3 gok3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 在几何学中，顶点是多边形的角。
examples.english_sentence: In geometry, a vertex is a corner of a polygon.

mandarin_meaning: 顷 / 頃 (qǐng)：一会儿、片刻、短时间
english_meaning: a short while; a moment; a brief period of time
partOfSpeech_mandarin: 名词（表示时间的短暂长度）
explanation_mandarin: 表示短暫的時間、片刻，常見於書面語或成語中，如「頃刻之間」。
explanation_english: Denotes a brief period of time or moment; often found in written language and idiomatic expressions such as '頃刻之間'.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 頃刻之間，天色就暗晒。
examples.jyutping_sentence: hing2 hak1 zi1 gaan1, tin1 sik1 zau6 am3 saai3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 頃刻之間，天色就暗下來了。
examples.english_sentence: In an instant, the sky darkened.

mandarin_meaning: 片刻；瞬间（qǐngkè）
english_meaning: a moment; an instant; a very short period of time
explanation_mandarin: 表示極短的時間，與“片刻”“瞬間”意思相近。常見用法如“頃刻之間”，可作名詞或副詞使用。
explanation_english: Indicates a very short span of time (a moment or an instant). Often used in the phrase 'in an instant' (e.g. 'in a moment'); can function as a noun or adverb.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 未等佢反應，頃刻之間佢已經走咗。
examples.jyutping_sentence: mei6 dang2 keoi5 faan2 jing3, hing2 hak1 zi1 gaan1 keoi5 ji5 ging1 zau2 zo2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 还未等他反应，眨眼之间他已经走了。
examples.english_sentence: Before he could react, he had already left in an instant.

mandarin_meaning: 項 (xiàng)：条目、项目、事项；亦可作量词（如一项任务）；古义可指颈项。
english_meaning: item; project; clause; (measure word) an item/term; (archaic) nape of the neck
explanation_mandarin: 「項」在粵語讀作 hong6，常用作名詞或量詞，表示某一條目、項目或事項（如「一項工作」、「呢項研究」）。在古文中也可指頸項。
explanation_english: Pronounced hong6 in Cantonese. Used as a noun or classifier to denote an item, project, clause, or matter (e.g. 'this item', 'one project'). It can also have an archaic meaning referring to the nape of the neck.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢項工作好難做。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 hong6 gung1 zok3 hou2 naan4 zou6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这项工作很难做。
examples.english_sentence: This task is difficult to do.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋要完成三項任務。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 jiu3 jyun4 sing4 saam1 hong6 jam6 mou6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们要完成三项任务。
examples.english_sentence: We need to complete three tasks.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你對呢項研究有咩意見？
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 deoi3 ni1 hong6 jin4 gau3 jau5 me1 ji3 gin3?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你对这项研究有什么意见？
examples.english_sentence: Do you have any comments on this research project?

mandarin_meaning: 项目 (xiàngmù)
english_meaning: item; project; entry; listing
explanation_mandarin: 指清單或計劃中的單獨條目，或一項具體的工作、工程或計劃。
explanation_english: Refers to an individual entry in a list or a distinct project/task — a specific work item, program, or listing.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢個項目已經完成咗。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 go3 hong6 muk6 ji5 ging1 jyun4 sing4 zo2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这个项目已经完成了。
examples.english_sentence: This project has already been completed.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 公司啱啱批咗兩個新項目。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gung1 si1 aam1 aam1 pai1 zo2 loeng5 go3 san1 hong6 muk6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 公司刚刚批准了两个新项目。
examples.english_sentence: The company just approved two new projects.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢份報告有好多項目需要處理。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 fan6 bou3 gou3 jau5 hou2 do1 hong6 muk6 seoi1 jiu3 cyu2 lei5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这份报告有很多项目需要处理。
examples.english_sentence: This report has many items that need to be handled.

jyutping: hong6 zong1 mou5 gim3, ji3 zoi6 pui3 gung1
mandarin_meaning: 项庄舞剑，意在沛公（表面做一件事，实际另有目的；别有用心）
english_meaning: An action that is a pretext for an ulterior motive; ostensibly doing one thing while actually intending to target someone (from the historical allusion of Xiang Zhuang's sword dance intended to harm Liu Bang).
explanation_mandarin: 出自史記：項莊以舞劍為掩飾，實際目的是要暗算沛公（劉邦）。現用來形容表面一套、實際另有目的的行為。
explanation_english: From a historical anecdote in which Xiang Zhuang feigns a sword dance but actually intends to attack Liu Bang (the Lord of Pei). Used to describe actions that are a pretext for hidden intentions.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢嗰個所謂建議好似項莊舞劍，意在沛公，根本係想拉低我哋部門。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 go2 go3 so2 wai6 gin3 ji5 hou2 ci5 hong6 zong1 mou5 gim3, ji3 zoi6 pui3 gung1, gan1 bun2 hai6 soeng2 laai1 dai1 ngo5 dei6 bou6 mun4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他那個所謂的建議好像項莊舞劍，意在沛公，根本是想拉低我們部門。
examples.english_sentence: His so‑called suggestion is like 'Xiang Zhuang dancing with a sword, intending Pei Gong' — it has an ulterior motive; he just wants to undermine our department.

mandarin_meaning: 项链 (xiàngliàn)
english_meaning: necklace
explanation_mandarin: 指戴在頸部的裝飾性鏈子或首飾，常由金屬、珍珠、寶石等製成，可作裝飾或象徵意義。
explanation_english: An ornamental chain or string worn around the neck, typically made from metal, pearls, gemstones, etc., used for decoration or symbolic purposes.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢條項鍊好靚，喺邊度買㗎？
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 tiu4 hong6 lin6 hou2 leng3, hai2 bin1 dou6 maai5 gaa3?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 這條項鍊很漂亮，是在哪裡買的？
examples.english_sentence: This necklace is really pretty; where did you buy it?

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢送咗條項鍊畀我做生日禮物。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 sung3 zo2 tiu4 hong6 lin6 bei2 ngo5 zou6 saang1 jat6 lai5 mat6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他送了一條項鍊給我，作為生日禮物。
examples.english_sentence: He gave me a necklace as a birthday present.

mandarin_meaning: 項鏈 / 項飾（戴在頸部的飾品）
english_meaning: necklace (neck ornament)
explanation_mandarin: 佩戴在頸部的飾品，通常由金屬、寶石或其他材料製成，可作裝飾或象徵意義。
explanation_english: An ornament worn around the neck, typically made of metal, gemstones, or other materials; used for decoration or symbolic purposes.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢戴咗條金項鍊，好靚。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 daai3 zo2 tiu4 gam1 hong6lin2, hou2 leng3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 她戴著一條金項鍊，很漂亮。
examples.english_sentence: She is wearing a gold necklace; it's very pretty.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我唔小心將項鍊弄斷咗。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 m4 siu2 sam1 zoeng1 hong6lin2 nung6 dyun6 zo2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我不小心把項鍊弄斷了。
examples.english_sentence: I accidentally broke the necklace.

mandarin_meaning: 項鍊 / 頸鍊（佩戴於頸部的飾品）
english_meaning: necklace (a piece of jewelry worn around the neck)
explanation_mandarin: 戴在頸部的裝飾品，通常由金屬、寶石、珠子或其他材料製成，可作為配飾或紀念物。
explanation_english: A piece of jewelry worn around the neck, typically made from metal, gemstones, beads, or other materials, used as an accessory or keepsake.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢頸上戴住條項鏈，好靚。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 geng2 soeng6 daai3 zyu6 tiu4 hong6 lin2, hou2 leng3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 她脖子上戴着一條項鍊，很漂亮。
examples.english_sentence: She is wearing a necklace; it's very pretty.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢條項鏈係你買俾我？
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 tiu4 hong6 lin2 hai6 nei5 maai5 bei2 ngo5?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 這條項鍊是你買給我的嗎？
examples.english_sentence: Did you buy me this necklace?

examples.cantonese_sentence: 條項鏈斷咗，要拎去珠寶店維修。
examples.jyutping_sentence: tiu4 hong6 lin2 dyun6 zo2, jiu3 ling1 heoi3 zyu1 bou2 dim3 wai4 sau1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 項鍊斷了，要拿去珠寶店維修。
examples.english_sentence: The necklace broke; I need to take it to the jewelry shop for repair.

mandarin_meaning: 顺（顺利、顺从、顺着）
english_meaning: smooth; to go along with/comply; in order
explanation_mandarin: 表示事情进行得顺利、没有阻碍；也可表示顺从、按照某个方向或顺序去做。
explanation_english: Indicates that something is going smoothly or without obstacles; can also mean to go along with or comply, or to follow a direction/order.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 今次旅行好順，冇遇到交通問題。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gam1 ci3 leoi5 hang4 hou2 seon6, mou5 jyu6 dou3 gaau1 tung1 man6 tai4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这次旅行很顺利，没遇到交通问题。
examples.english_sentence: This trip went smoothly; we didn't encounter any traffic problems.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你就順佢啦，唔好頂嘴。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 zau6 seon6 keoi5 laa1, m4 hou2 deng2 zeoi2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你就顺着他吧，别顶嘴。
examples.english_sentence: Just go along with him; don't argue.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 辦手續好順，幾快就批咗。
examples.jyutping_sentence: baan6 sau2 zuk6 hou2 seon6, gei2 faai3 zau6 pai1 zo2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 办手续很顺利，很快就批了。
examples.english_sentence: The procedures went smoothly and were approved quickly.

mandarin_meaning: 順序；名次；次序
english_meaning: order; sequence; ranking; position
explanation_mandarin: 表示在某一序列、比賽或排隊中的先後次序或名次，也可指處理事項的先後順序。
explanation_english: Indicates the order or rank in a sequence, competition, queue, or the priority/sequence for handling items.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 今次比賽我嘅順位係第三。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gam1 ci3 bei2 coi3 ngo5 ge3 seon6 wai6 hai6 dai6 saam1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 這次比賽我的名次是第三。
examples.english_sentence: My ranking in this competition is third.

mandarin_meaning: 顺着 / 顺便
english_meaning: along; in the process; while doing so; go along with
explanation_mandarin: 常用于粤语口语，表示顺着某个方向或在做某事的过程中顺便、同时去做另一件事，或表示按照某个方向/建议去做。
explanation_english: A colloquial Cantonese phrase used to indicate doing something along the way or in the process (i.e., 'while doing that, also do X'), or to go along with/ follow a suggestion or direction.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你順住行啦，前面有間咖啡店。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 seon6 zyu6 haang4 laa1, cin4 min6 jau5 gaan1 gaa3 fe1 dim3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你顺着走吧，前面有一家咖啡店。
examples.english_sentence: Just walk along this way — there's a café ahead.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你煮緊飯嗰陣可以順住洗菜。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 zyu2 gan2 faan6 go2 zan6 ho2 ji5 seon6 zyu6 sai2 coi3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你煮饭的时候可以顺便洗菜。
examples.english_sentence: When you're cooking, you can also wash the vegetables at the same time.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋順住佢個提議去做啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 seon6 zyu6 keoi5 go3 tai4 ji5 heoi3 zou6 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们按照他的提议去做吧。
examples.english_sentence: Let's go along with his suggestion.

mandarin_meaning: 順便 (shùnbiàn)
english_meaning: incidentally; while (doing something); in passing; conveniently
explanation_mandarin: 表示在做一件事的同時，順帶做另一件事，帶有方便或湊巧的意思。
explanation_english: Used to indicate doing something additionally or incidentally while doing another action; implies convenience or taking the opportunity.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我返公司嘅時候順便買咗杯咖啡。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 faan1 gung1 si1 ge3 si4 hau6 seon6 bin6 maai5 zo2 bui1 gaa3 fe1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我回公司時順便買了一杯咖啡。
examples.english_sentence: I bought a cup of coffee on my way back to the office.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你去街市買菜嘅時候可以順便幫我買啲蘋果嗎？
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 heoi3 gaai1 si5 maai5 coi3 ge3 si4 hau6 ho2 ji5 seon6 bin6 bong1 ngo5 maai5 di1 ping4 gwo2 maa3?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你去菜市場買菜的時候可以順便幫我買些蘋果嗎？
examples.english_sentence: When you go to the market to buy vegetables, could you buy some apples for me as well?

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我想順便問下，你星期六有冇時間？
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 soeng2 seon6 bin6 man6 haa5, nei5 sing1 kei4 luk6 jau5 mou5 si4 gaan3?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我想順便問一下，你星期六有沒有時間？
examples.english_sentence: I want to ask in passing—do you have time on Saturday?

mandarin_meaning: 趁機、順便
english_meaning: take the opportunity to do something; do something while at it
explanation_mandarin: 廣東話口語用語，表示趁某個機會或順路做某事，通常帶有順便幫忙或取得便利的含義。
explanation_english: A Cantonese colloquial phrase meaning to take advantage of an opportunity or do something while you're at it; often implies doing a favor or making a convenient arrangement.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你今日去市區買衫，順個靚便幫我買件返工衫啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 gam1 jat6 heoi3 si5 keoi1 maai5 saam1, seon6 go3 leng3 bin6 bong1 ngo5 maai5 gin6 faan1 gung1 saam1 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你今天去市区买衣服，顺便帮我买一件上班的衣服吧。
examples.english_sentence: You're going to the city to buy clothes today—while you're at it, could you buy me a work shirt?

examples.cantonese_sentence: 如果你經過便利店，順個靚便幫我買包牛奶返嚟。
examples.jyutping_sentence: jyu4 gwo2 nei5 ging1 gwo3 bin6 lei6 dim3, seon6 go3 leng3 bin6 bong1 ngo5 maai5 baau1 ngau4 naai5 faan1 lai4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 如果你经过便利店，顺便帮我买一包牛奶带回来。
examples.english_sentence: If you pass by the convenience store, could you pick up a pack of milk for me while you're at it?

examples.cantonese_sentence: 老細今日唔喺公司，順個靚便我哋傾返嗰個案子。
examples.jyutping_sentence: lou5 sai3 gam1 jat6 m4 hai2 gung1 si1, seon6 go3 leng3 bin6 ngo5 dei6 king1 faan1 go2 go3 on3 zi2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 老板今天不在公司，顺便我们商量一下那个案子。
examples.english_sentence: The boss isn't in the office today, so we took the opportunity to discuss that case.

mandarin_meaning: 顺其自然
english_meaning: let nature take its course; go with the flow; don't force things
explanation_mandarin: 表示順應事物的自然發展，不刻意干涉或強求，接受結果的態度。
explanation_english: Expresses accepting the natural development of events without forcing or intervening; an attitude of letting outcomes happen naturally.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔使太擔心，順其自然啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 sai2 taai3 daam1 sam1, seon6 kei4 zi6 jin4 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 不用太担心，顺其自然吧。
examples.english_sentence: Don't worry too much, let nature take its course.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 而家已經做晒我能做嘅，剩低就順其自然。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ji4 gaa1 ji5 ging1 zou6 saai3 ngo5 nang4 zou6 ge3, zing6 dai1 zau6 seon6 kei4 zi6 jin4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 现在已经做完我能做的，剩下的就顺其自然。
examples.english_sentence: I've already done everything I can; what's left I'll let take its natural course.

mandarin_meaning: 顺利
english_meaning: smooth; successful; without a hitch
explanation_mandarin: 表示事情進行得順暢、沒有阻礙或困難，常用來形容過程或結果。
explanation_english: Indicates that something proceeds smoothly or successfully without obstacles; commonly used to describe a process or outcome.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 祝你考試順利！
examples.jyutping_sentence: zuk1 nei5 haau2 si3 seon6 lei6!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 祝你考试顺利！
examples.english_sentence: Good luck on your exam! (Hope it goes smoothly.)

examples.cantonese_sentence: 生意做得好順利，大家都好開心。
examples.jyutping_sentence: saang1 ji3 zou6 dak1 hou2 seon6 lei6, daai6 gaa1 dou1 hou2 hoi1 sam1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 生意做得很顺利，大家都很开心。
examples.english_sentence: Business is going very smoothly, and everyone is happy.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 路上行車好順利，冇塞車。
examples.jyutping_sentence: lou6 soeng6 hang4 ce1 hou2 seon6 lei6, mou5 sak1 ce1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 路上开车很顺利，没有堵车。
examples.english_sentence: The drive went smoothly; there were no traffic jams.

mandarin_meaning: 顺势；顺势而为，借助形势或趋势采取行动。
english_meaning: to go with the momentum; to act according to the situation; to take advantage of an opportunity created by circumstances.
explanation_mandarin: 表示順應形勢或趨勢而採取行動，通常是利用當下的有利局面或機會去做某事。
explanation_english: Indicates acting in accordance with the prevailing situation or momentum, often seizing an advantageous opportunity to do something.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢提出咗個好主意，我順勢跟佢做。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 tai4 ceot1 zo2 go3 hou2 zyu2 ji3, ngo5 seon6 sai3 gan1 keoi5 zou6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他提出了個好主意，我順勢跟他做。
examples.english_sentence: He suggested a good idea, so I went along with him.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 投資市場一路上升，大家順勢買入。
examples.jyutping_sentence: tau4 zi1 si5 coeng4 jat1 lou6 soeng5 sing1, daai6 gaa1 seon6 sai3 maai5 jap6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 投資市場一路上升，大家順勢買入。
examples.english_sentence: As the market kept rising, everyone bought in following the trend.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋話唔使我幫手，我就順勢走咗。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 waa6 m4 sai2 ngo5 bong1 sau2, ngo5 zau6 seon6 sai3 zau2 zo2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他們說不需要我幫忙，我就順勢離開了。
examples.english_sentence: They said they didn't need my help, so I took the opportunity to leave.

mandarin_meaning: 顺口（说话顺畅、容易说出口；也可指食物味道好入口）
english_meaning: smooth to say; easy to say; glib; pleasant to the mouth (also: tasty/palatable)
explanation_mandarin: 用來形容話語流暢、容易說出口，或形容食物味道容易入口、好吃。
explanation_english: Describes speech that is smooth and easy to say (glib), or food that is easy on the palate and tasty.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢道菜好順口，我食咗兩碟。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 dou6 coi3 hou2 seon6 hau2, ngo5 sik6 zo2 loeng5 dip6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这道菜很顺口，我吃了两盘。
examples.english_sentence: This dish is very tasty; I ate two plates.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢講嘢好順口，但有時唔夠實際。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 gong2 je5 hou2 seon6 hau2, daan6 jau5 si4 m4 gau3 sat6 zai3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他说话很顺口，但有时不够实际。
examples.english_sentence: He speaks smoothly, but sometimes isn't very practical.

mandarin_meaning: 顺口溜：押韵、朗朗上口的短句或小诗，常用于娱乐、讽刺或记忆。
english_meaning: catchy rhyme; a short, easy-to-remember rhymed phrase or jingle often used for humor, satire, or persuasion.
explanation_mandarin: 順口溜指簡短、押韻且容易上口的句子或小詩，通常即興或民間流傳，用來逗趣、諷刺或幫助記憶。
explanation_english: A short, rhymed, and easily remembered phrase or verse that is often improvised or passed among people; used for amusement, mockery, persuasion, or mnemonic purposes.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢句順口溜好易記。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 geoi3 seon6 hau2 lau4 hou2 ji6 gei3
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这句顺口溜很容易记住。
examples.english_sentence: This catchy rhyme is easy to remember.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢用咗一段順口溜嚟諷刺對方。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 jung6 zo2 jat1 dyun6 seon6 hau2 lau4 lei4 fung2 ci3 deoi3 fong1
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他用了段顺口溜来讽刺对方。
examples.english_sentence: He used a snappy rhyme to mock the other person.

mandarin_meaning: 顺境 (shùn jìng)：有利、順利的處境或時期
english_meaning: favorable circumstances; a smooth or prosperous period
explanation_mandarin: 指順利、有利的處境或時期，生活或事業發展平穩、沒有重大阻礙。
explanation_english: Refers to favorable circumstances or a period when things are going smoothly and without significant obstacles.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 而家佢喺順境，冇乜好擔心嘅。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ji4 gaa1 keoi5 hai6 seon6 ging2, mou5 mat1 hou2 daam1 sam1 ge3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他現在處於順境，沒什麼好擔心的。
examples.english_sentence: He's currently in favorable circumstances; there's not much to worry about.

mandarin_meaning: 順便
english_meaning: incidentally; by the way; in passing
explanation_mandarin: 表示順便做某事或附帶提及某件事，常用於口語，相當於「順便」。
explanation_english: Used to indicate doing something incidentally or mentioning something in passing; commonly used in speech, equivalent to 'by the way' or 'incidentally'.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我今晚去超市，順帶買啲牛奶返嚟。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 gam1 maan5 heoi3 ciu1 si5, seon6 daai3 maai5 di1 ngau4 naai5 faan1 lai4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我今晚去超市，順便買點牛奶回來。
examples.english_sentence: I'm going to the supermarket tonight; I'll buy some milk while I'm at it.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你幫我睇下份文件，順帶講返你嘅意見。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 bong1 ngo5 tai2 haa5 fan6 man4 gin2, seon6 daai3 gong2 faan1 nei5 ge3 ji3 gin3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你幫我看一下文件，順便說說你的意見。
examples.english_sentence: Please check the document for me, and by the way tell me your opinion.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 順帶一提，佢下個月會返香港。
examples.jyutping_sentence: seon6 daai3 jat1 tai4, keoi5 haa6 go3 jyut6 wui5 faan1 hoeng1 gong2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 順便提一下，他下個月會回香港。
examples.english_sentence: By the way, he's coming back to Hong Kong next month.

mandarin_meaning: 顺便一提 / 顺便提一下
english_meaning: by the way; incidentally; a side remark
explanation_mandarin: 用于引出附带说明或顺便提到的事项，通常不是主要话题，起提示或补充作用。
explanation_english: Used to introduce an incidental remark or additional point; a way to mention something in passing that is not the main topic.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 順帶一提，聽日開會要早啲到。
examples.jyutping_sentence: seon6 daai3 jat1 tai4, ting1 jat6 hoi1 wui6 jiu3 zou2 di1 dou3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 顺便一提，明天开会要早点到。
examples.english_sentence: By the way, for tomorrow's meeting, please arrive a bit earlier.

mandarin_meaning: 顺序
english_meaning: order; sequence
explanation_mandarin: 指事物排列的次第或先後的次序，表示先後順序或安排的規律。
explanation_english: Refers to the arrangement or order of items or events; the sequence or order in which things occur or are arranged.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 請排隊，保持順序。
examples.jyutping_sentence: cing2 paai4 deoi6, bou2 ci4 seon6 zeoi6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 请排队，保持顺序。
examples.english_sentence: Please queue and keep the order.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 做嘢要有順序，先做重要嗰啲。
examples.jyutping_sentence: zou6 je5 jiu3 jau5 seon6 zeoi6, sin1 zou6 zung6 jiu3 go2 di1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 做事要有顺序，先做重要的那些。
examples.english_sentence: When working, you should follow a sequence—do the important tasks first.

mandarin_meaning: 顺延；延期、推迟到较晚的时间
english_meaning: postpone; defer; to move something to a later date/time
explanation_mandarin: 把原定的时间或安排向后推移，延后进行或举行。
explanation_english: To delay or defer an event, meeting, or arrangement so that it takes place at a later time or date.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 因為天氣惡劣，今次活動順延兩個星期。
examples.jyutping_sentence: jan1 wai6 tin1 hei3 ok3 lit6, gam1 ci3 wut6 dung6 seon6 jin4 loeng5 go3 sing1 kei4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 因为天气恶劣，本次活动顺延两星期。
examples.english_sentence: Due to bad weather, this event has been postponed for two weeks.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 會議因故順延，開會時間會另行通知。
examples.jyutping_sentence: wui6 ji5 jan1 gu3 seon6 jin4, hoi1 wui6 si4 gaan3 wui5 ling6 hang4 tung1 zi1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 会议因故顺延，开会时间会另行通知。
examples.english_sentence: The meeting has been postponed due to unforeseen reasons; the new time will be announced separately.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 如果落雨，比賽會順延到下星期日舉行。
examples.jyutping_sentence: jyu4 gwo2 lok6 jyu5, bei2 coi3 wui5 seon6 jin4 dou3 haa6 sing1 kei4 jat6 geoi2 hang4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 如果下雨，比赛会顺延到下星期日举行。
examples.english_sentence: If it rains, the match will be postponed to next Sunday.

mandarin_meaning: 討好別人／好相處，容易遷就別人的人或行為
english_meaning: accommodating; pleasing others; easy-going or inclined to give in to others
explanation_mandarin: 「順得人」用來形容一個人容易遷就或討好別人，常帶有容易被利用或不夠堅持自身立場的含意，也可泛指好相處、容易配合他人的性格。
explanation_english: Used to describe someone who is accommodating or eager to please others. It can imply being easy-going and cooperative, but sometimes carries a negative sense of being easily taken advantage of or lacking firmness.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢太順得人，成日畀人利用。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 taai3 seon6 dak1 jan4, sing4 jat6 bei2 jan4 lei6 jung6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他太討好別人，經常被人利用。
examples.english_sentence: He is too accommodating and often gets taken advantage of.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 老闆鍾意請啲順得人，因為易溝通。
examples.jyutping_sentence: lou5 baan2 zung1 ji3 ceng2 di1 seon6 dak1 jan4, jan1 wai6 ji6 gau1 tung1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 老闆喜歡請那些好相處的人，因為容易溝通。
examples.english_sentence: Bosses like to hire accommodating people because they're easier to communicate with.

jyutping: seon6 dak1 go1 cing4 sat1 sou2 ji3
mandarin_meaning: 討好一方而得罪另一方；難以兩全其美（討好哥哥卻失去嫂子的歡心）
english_meaning: To please one party while displeasing another; can't please everyone (literally: please the brother's feelings but lose the sister-in-law's).
explanation_mandarin: 粵語俗語，形容做事只討好一方，結果惹另一方不滿，兩頭都不得好處。
explanation_english: A Cantonese saying describing a situation where an action pleases one side but angers another, leaving no one satisfied.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你咁樣做只係順得哥情失嫂意，反而兩邊都唔開心。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 gam2 joeng6 zou6 zi2 hai6 seon6 dak1 go1 cing4 sat1 sou2 ji3, faan2 ji5 loeng5 bin1 dou1 m4 hoi1 sam1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你這樣做只是討好哥哥，卻失了嫂子的心，反而兩邊都不高興。
examples.english_sentence: What you're doing only pleases your brother but upsets your sister-in-law; as a result, neither side is happy.

mandarin_meaning: 顺从；服从；听从
english_meaning: to obey; to submit; submissive; compliant
explanation_mandarin: 表示服从或听从他人的意愿、命令或安排，可用作动词（顺从某人/某事）或形容词（表示顺从、易服从）。
explanation_english: Expresses obedience or yielding to another's wishes, commands, or arrangements. Used as a verb ('to comply/obey') or an adjective ('submissive/compliant').

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢好順從父母嘅安排。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hou2 seon6 cung4 fu6 mou5 ge3 on1 paai4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他很顺从父母的安排。
examples.english_sentence: He is very obedient to his parents' arrangements.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好咁順從人，學識表達自己嘅意見。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 gam2 seon6 cung4 jan4, hok6 sik1 biu2 daat6 zi6 gei2 ge3 ji3 gin3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 不要那么顺从别人，学会表达自己的意见。
examples.english_sentence: Don't be so submissive to others; learn to express your own opinions.

mandarin_meaning: 顺德（中國廣東省佛山市下轄區，亦指順德地區）
english_meaning: Shunde (a district of Foshan City in Guangdong Province, China)
explanation_mandarin: 順德是廣東省佛山市的一個區，歷史悠久，以美食（順德菜）、家居製造和嶺南文化聞名。
explanation_english: Shunde is a district of Foshan in Guangdong Province, China, known for its culinary tradition (Shunde cuisine), furniture/manufacturing industry, and Lingnan culture.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我聽日會返順德探親。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 ting1 jat6 wui5 faan1 seon6 dak1 taam3 can1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我明天會回順德探親。
examples.english_sentence: I'm going back to Shunde tomorrow to visit relatives.

mandarin_meaning: 合心意 / 顺利 / 称心如意
english_meaning: to one's liking; satisfactory; going smoothly
explanation_mandarin: 「順意」在廣東話中用作形容詞，表示合乎心意、令人滿意或事情進行順利。常見於口語，用法類似「順心」「合意」。
explanation_english: In Cantonese, '順意' is an adjective meaning that something is to one's liking, satisfactory, or proceeding smoothly. It is commonly used in colloquial speech, similar to '順心' or 'to one's satisfaction'.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 希望你一切都順意。
examples.jyutping_sentence: hei1 mong6 nei5 jat1 cit3 dou1 seon6 ji3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 希望你一切順心如意。
examples.english_sentence: Hope everything goes as you wish.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢份設計係咪你覺得順意？
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 fan6 cit3 gai3 hai6 mai6 nei5 gok3 dak1 seon6 ji3?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这份设计你觉得合你的心意吗？
examples.english_sentence: Do you find this design to your liking?

examples.cantonese_sentence: 如果你對安排唔順意，講聲我哋可以改。
examples.jyutping_sentence: jyu4 gwo2 nei5 deoi3 ngon1 paai4 m4 seon6 ji3, gong2 seng1 ngo5 dei6 ho2 ji5 goi2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 如果你對安排不滿意，跟我們說可以更改。
examples.english_sentence: If you're not happy with the arrangement, tell us and we can change it.

mandarin_meaning: 順應（適應、配合外在環境或意見）
english_meaning: to conform to; to adapt to; to comply with
explanation_mandarin: 指按照外在環境、潮流或他人意見而改變、調整或配合。
explanation_english: To adjust or adapt oneself to external circumstances, trends, or others' views; to comply or go along with.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢順應潮流，開始做短片創作。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 seon6 jing3 ciu4 lau4, hoi1 ci2 zou6 dyun2 pin2 cong3 zok3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他順應潮流，開始做短片創作。
examples.english_sentence: He followed the trend and started making short videos.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 政府要順應民意，修訂條例。
examples.jyutping_sentence: zing3 fu2 jiu3 seon6 jing3 man4 ji3, sau1 ding6 tiu4 lai6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 政府要順應民意，修訂條例。
examples.english_sentence: The government needs to respond to public opinion and revise the ordinance.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 面對氣候轉變，我哋要順應自然，改變生活習慣。
examples.jyutping_sentence: min6 deoi3 hei3 hau6 zyun2 bin3, ngo5 dei6 jiu3 seon6 jing3 zi6 jin4, goi2 bin3 sang1 wut6 zaap6 gwaan3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 面對氣候變化，我們要順應自然，改變生活習慣。
examples.english_sentence: Facing climate change, we should adapt to nature and change our living habits.

mandarin_meaning: 顺手（顺便、方便时顺带做某事，或趁机取走/顺手牵羊，视语境而定）
english_meaning: conveniently; while you're at it; handy (can also imply taking advantage of the situation depending on context)
explanation_mandarin: 表示在做一件事的同時，順便做另一件事或趁機拿走某物。語氣可中性（順便）或根據語境帶有貶義（順手牽羊）。
explanation_english: Used to indicate doing something additionally because it is convenient or 'while you're at it'; depending on context it can be neutral (doing something conveniently) or imply opportunistic taking.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你順手幫我攞埋本書啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 seon6 sau2 bong1 ngo5 lo2 maai4 bun2 syu1 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你順便幫我把那本書拿一下吧。
examples.english_sentence: Could you take that book for me while you're at it?

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我出街買嘢，順手買多包牛奶。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 ceot1 gaai1 maai5 je5, seon6 sau2 maai5 do1 baau1 ngau4 naai5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我出門買東西，順便多買了一包牛奶。
examples.english_sentence: I went out to buy something and picked up an extra pack of milk while I was at it.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 見到冇人，佢就順手拎咗支筆走。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gin3 dou3 mou5 jan4, keoi5 zau6 seon6 sau2 ling1 zo2 zi1 bat1 zau2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 看到沒人，他就順手拿走了一支筆。
examples.english_sentence: Seeing no one around, he took a pen while he was at it.

mandarin_meaning: 顺手牵羊（趁机偷拿、顺手拿走别人的东西）
english_meaning: to opportunistically steal or help oneself to something; to take advantage of a situation to take someone else's property
explanation_mandarin: 指趁機將別人的東西順手拿走，含有偷竊或趁機佔便宜的意思，用於描述機會主義的偷拿行為或貶義地形容占小便宜。
explanation_english: Refers to taking something from someone else opportunistically—literally 'leading a sheep away in passing'—used to describe petty theft or taking advantage of a situation to help oneself; often has a negative connotation.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢行過間舖，見到枱上有部電話，就順手牽羊攞走咗。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 haang4 gwo3 gaan1 pou3, gin3 dou3 toi4 soeng6 jau5 bou6 din6 waa2, zau6 seon6 sau2 hin1 joeng4 lo2 zau2 zo2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他经过那家店，看到桌上有一部手机，就顺手牵羊把它拿走了。
examples.english_sentence: He walked past the shop, saw a phone on the table, and helped himself to it.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 做生意要誠實，唔好順手牽羊。
examples.jyutping_sentence: zou6 saang1 ji3 jiu3 sing4 sat6, m4 hou2 seon6 sau2 hin1 joeng4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 做生意要诚实，不要顺手牵羊。
examples.english_sentence: In business be honest; don't take what's not yours.

mandarin_meaning: （口語）頂替看攤、暫時代班
english_meaning: (colloquial) to cover someone's stall/shift temporarily; to take over someone's post for a short time
explanation_mandarin: 「順攤」是廣東話口語，常用於街市、小販或擺檔的情境，指在別人暫時離開時代為看攤或頂替營業。亦可引申為暫時代替別人的工作或崗位。
explanation_english: “順攤” is Cantonese colloquial usage often used in market or stall contexts. It means to cover someone’s stall or temporarily take over their duties when they step away. It can also be extended to mean covering someone’s shift or job for a short period.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 阿珍要走一陣，你可唔可以幫佢順攤？
examples.jyutping_sentence: aa3 zan1 jiu3 zau2 jat1 zan6, nei5 ho2 m4 ho2 ji5 bong1 keoi5 seon6 taan1?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 阿珍要離開一會兒，你可以幫她看攤嗎？
examples.english_sentence: Ah Jan needs to leave for a while — can you cover her stall?

examples.cantonese_sentence: 今晚夜市人手唔夠，要有人順攤先得。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gam1 maan5 je6 si5 jan4 sau2 m4 gau3, jiu3 jau5 jan4 seon6 taan1 sin1 dak1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 今晚夜市人手不夠，得有人頂摊才行。
examples.english_sentence: The night market is short-staffed tonight; someone needs to cover a stall.

mandarin_meaning: 顺时针
english_meaning: clockwise
explanation_mandarin: 表示旋轉或運動的方向，與鐘表的指針運動方向相同。
explanation_english: Denotes the direction of rotation or movement that follows the same direction as the hands of a clock.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你要順時針扭緊螺絲，唔好反方向。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 jiu3 seon6 si4 zam1 nau2 gan2 lo4 si1, m4 hou2 faan2 fong1 hoeng3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你要顺时针拧紧螺丝，不要反方向。
examples.english_sentence: You need to tighten the screw clockwise, not the other way.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 個鐘嘅指針係順時針轉。
examples.jyutping_sentence: go3 zung1 ge3 zi2 zam1 hai6 seon6 si4 zam1 zyun2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 钟表的指针是顺时针转的。
examples.english_sentence: The hands of the clock move clockwise.

mandarin_meaning: 順境 / 順利（形容處境良好、事情順利）
english_meaning: favorable circumstances; things going smoothly; prosperity
explanation_mandarin: 粵語中表示處境良好、事務進展順利或運氣好的說法。相當於普通話的「順境」或「順利」。
explanation_english: A Cantonese expression meaning favorable circumstances, things going smoothly, or being in a prosperous/fortunate state. Equivalent to Mandarin '顺境' or '順利'.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢最近好順景，出咗幾單大生意。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 zeoi3 gan6 hou2 seon6 ging2, ceot1 zo2 gei2 daan1 daai6 saang1 ji3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他最近很順景，接了好幾單大生意。
examples.english_sentence: He's been lucky recently and landed several big deals.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我希望你以後都順景。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 hei1 mong6 nei5 ji5 hau6 dou1 seon6 ging2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我希望你以後都順景。
examples.english_sentence: I hope things go well for you from now on.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢排工作唔太順景，要加把勁。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 paai4 gung1 zok3 m4 taai3 seon6 ging2, jiu3 gaa1 baa2 ging6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 這陣子工作不太順景，要加把勁。
examples.english_sentence: Work hasn't been going very smoothly lately; we need to try harder.

mandarin_meaning: 顺畅；流畅；顺利、畅通
english_meaning: smooth; fluent; unobstructed
explanation_mandarin: 表示事情、流程、語言等進行得沒有阻滯或障礙，通暢自然，容易理解或運作。
explanation_english: Describes something (a process, speech, traffic, etc.) that proceeds without obstruction or difficulty — smooth, fluent, and easy to follow or operate.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 今次會議進行得好順暢，大家好快就傾掂晒。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gam1 ci3 wui6 ji5 zeon3 hang4 dak1 hou2 seon6 coeng3, daai6 gaa1 hou2 faai3 zau6 king1 dim6 saai3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这次会议进行得很顺畅，大家很快就谈妥了。
examples.english_sentence: This meeting proceeded very smoothly; everyone reached an agreement quickly.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢講嘢好順暢，一啲都唔結巴。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 gong2 je5 hou2 seon6 coeng3, jat1 di1 dou1 m4 git3 baat3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他说话很顺畅，一点也不结巴。
examples.english_sentence: He speaks very fluently and doesn't stutter at all.

mandarin_meaning: 暫時替人看檔/頂班；幫忙代管攤位或工作一段時間
english_meaning: to temporarily cover someone's stall/shift; to take over duties for a short time
explanation_mandarin: 粵語俗語，指暫時替別人看檔口或頂替工作（例如幫忙看攤位、頂班），通常是短時間內代為處理本來由對方負責的事務。
explanation_english: A Cantonese colloquialism meaning to temporarily cover someone else's stall or shift — to take over their duties for a short period (e.g., minding a stall, covering a shift).

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我有啲事要出一陣，你可唔可以幫我順檔半個鐘？
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 jau5 di1 si6 jiu3 ceot1 jat1 zan6, nei5 ho2 m4 ho2 ji5 bong1 ngo5 seon6 dong3 bun3 go3 zung1?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我有事要出去一會，你可以幫我暫時頂一下班嗎？
examples.english_sentence: I need to step out for a bit — can you cover my stall/shift for half an hour?

mandarin_meaning: 按顺序；依次
english_meaning: in order; sequentially; one after another
explanation_mandarin: 表示按照先後順序、一個接一個地進行，常用於指示行動或處理事項的次序。
explanation_english: Indicates that actions are to be carried out in sequence, one after another; used to specify the order of actions or steps.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 請大家順次上台發言。
examples.jyutping_sentence: cing2 daai6 gaa1 seon6 ci3 soeng5 toi4 faat3 jin4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 请大家依次上台发言。
examples.english_sentence: Please come up to speak in turn.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 為了安全，乘客要順次上下車。
examples.jyutping_sentence: wai6 liu5 on1 cyun4, sing4 haak3 jiu3 seon6 ci3 soeng5 haa6 ce1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 为了安全，乘客要依次上下车。
examples.english_sentence: For safety, passengers should get on and off the vehicle in order.

mandarin_meaning: 順從的民眾；不太發聲、遵從現狀的普通市民
english_meaning: a compliant or docile citizen; someone who goes along with authorities or the status quo
explanation_mandarin: 「順民」常用來形容那些不太發表意見、順從現狀或遵從規則的普通民眾，有時帶有貶義或調侃意味。
explanation_english: “順民” describes people who are passive, compliant, or go along with the status quo; it often implies a mildly derogatory or ironic tone.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢成日話自己係順民，唔想捲入政治爭拗。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 sing4 jat6 waa6 zi6 gei2 hai6 seon6 man4, m4 soeng2 gyun2 jap6 zing3 zi6 zang1 ngau3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他常說自己是順民，不想捲入政治爭議。
examples.english_sentence: He always says he's a compliant citizen and doesn't want to get involved in political disputes.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 做事守規矩、唔太發聲，嗰班人係典型嘅順民。
examples.jyutping_sentence: zou6 si6 sau2 kwai1 geoi2, m4 taai3 faat3 seng1, go2 baan1 jan4 hai6 din2 jing4 ge3 seon6 man4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 做事守規矩、不太發聲，那些人是典型的順民。
examples.english_sentence: Those who follow rules and rarely speak up are typical '順民'.

mandarin_meaning: 順從、遷就、討好或安撫他人以平息情緒
english_meaning: to appease or placate someone; to humour or go along with someone to keep the peace
explanation_mandarin: 口語用法，表示為了平息對方情緒或維持和氣而順從、遷就或討好對方。
explanation_english: Colloquial Cantonese verb meaning to placate or humour someone — to comply or make concessions to calm someone down or keep harmony.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你唔好咁固執，順氣吓佢啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 m4 hou2 gam2 gu3 zap1, seon6 hei3 haa5 keoi5 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你別那麼固執，順著他/她一下吧。
examples.english_sentence: Don't be so stubborn — humour him/her a little.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 為咗維持和氣，我哋唯有順佢啲要求。
examples.jyutping_sentence: wai6 zo2 wai4 ci4 wo4 hei3, ngo5 dei6 wai4 jau5 seon6 keoi5 di1 jiu1 kau4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 為了維持和氣，我們只好順著他的要求一些。
examples.english_sentence: To keep the peace, we have to go along with some of his requests.

mandarin_meaning: 趁着顺利、方便的时候施予或索取的人情；指在顺手或有利的情况下帮忙或占便宜
english_meaning: a favor given or asked because it's convenient; helping or asking for help when circumstances make it easy—an opportunistic or convenience favor often used to maintain social ties
explanation_mandarin: 粵語俗語，指趁著情況順利或方便時給予或要求人情（幫忙）；通常含有順勢而為或因方便而行的意思，可能是隨手的幫忙或利用機會索取好處。
explanation_english: A Cantonese colloquial phrase meaning a favor done or requested because it is convenient or opportune; it implies taking advantage of a favorable situation to help someone or to ask for help—often a casual, situational favor.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢幫我係順水人情，唔使太感激。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 bong1 ngo5 hai6 seon6 seoi2 jan4 cing4, m4 sai2 taai3 gam2 gik1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他幫我是順水人情，不必太感激。
examples.english_sentence: He helped me as a convenience favor; you don't need to be too grateful.

mandarin_meaning: 顺水推舟（比喻乘势而为、趁有利时机推动事情）
english_meaning: To take advantage of favourable circumstances; to go with the flow and push something forward
explanation_mandarin: 比喻顺着有利的形势或机会去做某事，趁势推动或促成事情的发展。
explanation_english: An idiom meaning to act according to favorable circumstances or to take advantage of an opportunity to advance or facilitate something.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 而家機會難得，唔好錯過，順水推舟做落去啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ji4 gaa1 gei1 wui6 naan4 dak1, m4 hou2 co3 gwo3, seon6 seoi2 teoi1 zau1 zou6 lok6 heoi3 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 现在机会难得，不要错过，顺水推舟把事情做下去吧。
examples.english_sentence: This is a rare opportunity—don't miss it; take advantage of the situation and go ahead with it.

mandarin_meaning: 顺流（顺着水流；顺应潮流/随波逐流）
english_meaning: to go with the current; to go downstream; figuratively, to go with the flow or follow a trend
explanation_mandarin: 字面意思是順著水流方向移動（如船順流而下）。引申義可指順應潮流或趨勢，跟隨大方向行事，有時帶中性或負面（隨波逐流）的含義，視語境而定。
explanation_english: Literally means moving with the water current (e.g., a boat going downstream). Figuratively it means to go with the flow or follow a trend; depending on context it can be neutral or slightly negative (as in ‘just following others’).

examples.cantonese_sentence: 艘船順流而下，好快就到碼頭。
examples.jyutping_sentence: sou1 syun4 seon6 lau4 ji4 haa6 hou2 faai3 zau6 dou3 maa5 tau4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 船顺流而下，很快就到码头。
examples.english_sentence: The boat went downstream and reached the pier quickly.

mandarin_meaning: 順利、順暢、流暢；省事、順手（粵語口語）
english_meaning: smooth; going smoothly; fluent; effortless; convenient (colloquial Cantonese)
explanation_mandarin: 粵語口語用詞，形容事情進展順暢、做起來流利或省事、順手，常用於日常對話。
explanation_english: A colloquial Cantonese adjective used to describe that something proceeds smoothly, is fluent or effortless, or is convenient/handy. Common in everyday speech.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢單嘢做得幾順溜，唔使我幫手。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 daan1 je5 zou6 dak1 gei2 seon6 lau4, m4 sai2 ngo5 bong1 sau2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 這件事做得很順利，不用我幫忙。
examples.english_sentence: This task went quite smoothly; I didn't need to help.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢講嘢好順溜，大家都易明白。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 gong2 je5 hou2 seon6 lau4, daai6 gaa1 dou1 ji5 ming4 baak6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他說話很流暢，大家都容易明白。
examples.english_sentence: He speaks very smoothly; everyone can understand easily.

mandarin_meaning: 顺滑 (shùn huá)
english_meaning: smooth; silky; slick (describing texture or feel)
explanation_mandarin: 用來形容觸感或口感光滑、細緻、沒有阻礙或粗糙感。
explanation_english: Describes a tactile or mouthfeel that is smooth, silky, and free of resistance or roughness.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢個蛋糕好順滑，入口即化。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 go3 daan6 gou1 hou2 seon6 waat6, jap6 hau2 zik1 faa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这个蛋糕很顺滑，入口即化。
examples.english_sentence: This cake is very smooth and melts in your mouth.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢啲頭髮好順滑，用咗新洗頭水？
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 di1 tau4 faat3 hou2 seon6 waat6, jung6 zo2 san1 sai2 tau4 seoi2?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他的头发很顺滑，是用了新的洗发水吗？
examples.english_sentence: Their hair is very smooth—did they use a new shampoo?

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢部手機嘅觸控屏好順滑，操作好順手。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 bou6 sau2 gei1 ge3 zuk1 hung3 ping4 hou2 seon6 waat6, cou1 zok3 hou2 seon6 sau2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这部手机的触控屏很顺滑，操作很顺手。
examples.english_sentence: The touchscreen on this phone is very smooth and easy to operate.

mandarin_meaning: 靠岸；上岸；擱淺（使船隻或人到達岸邊）
english_meaning: to land / come ashore; (of a boat) to beach or run aground
explanation_mandarin: 指船隻或人順利到達或靠近岸邊、上岸；在某些情況下也可指船隻擱淺。用於描述靠岸、登岸或擱淺的動作或狀態。
explanation_english: Refers to a boat or people arriving at or reaching the shore; can also mean a vessel becoming beached or running aground. Used to describe the action or state of coming ashore.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 條船終於順灘，大家安全上岸。
examples.jyutping_sentence: tiu4 syun4 zung1 jyu1 seon6 taan1, daai6 gaa1 on1 cyun4 soeng5 ngon6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 那艘船終於靠岸了，大家安全上岸。
examples.english_sentence: The boat finally came ashore; everyone got ashore safely.

mandarin_meaning: 遵守紅綠燈／按交通信號燈通行
english_meaning: to obey the traffic lights; to follow traffic signals (wait for green, don't run a red light)
explanation_mandarin: 口語用法，常用於廣東話中，表示按照交通燈號通行（等綠燈行、不闖紅燈）。
explanation_english: A colloquial Cantonese expression meaning to follow traffic signals (e.g. wait for the green light and don't run a red light).

examples.cantonese_sentence: 過馬路要順燈，唔好衝燈。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gwo3 maa5 lou6 jiu3 seon6 dang1, m4 hou2 cung1 dang1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 过马路要遵守红绿灯，不要闯红灯。
examples.english_sentence: When crossing the road, obey the traffic lights; don't run a red light.

mandarin_meaning: 顺理成章：按照道理自然发展，合乎逻辑
english_meaning: to proceed naturally and logically; coherent and reasonable
partOfSpeech_mandarin: 成语（可作状语或形容词短语）
explanation_mandarin: 表示事情按照道理、合乎逻辑地发展或完成，通常用來描述結果自然、沒有牴觸。
explanation_english: Describes something that develops or is resolved in a natural, logical way; used to indicate that the outcome is coherent and to be expected.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 經過多次討論，個計劃就順理成章噉通過咗。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ging1 gwo3 do1 ci3 tou2 leon6, go3 gai3 waak6 zau6 seon6 lei5 sing4 zoeng1 gam2 tung1 gwo3 zo2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 经过多次讨论，这个计划就顺理成章地通过了。
examples.english_sentence: After several discussions, the plan was approved as a natural and logical outcome.

mandarin_meaning: 顺产（自然分娩）
english_meaning: natural childbirth; vaginal delivery
explanation_mandarin: 指通过阴道自然分娩，不进行剖宫产。用于描述生产方式及产程情况。
explanation_english: Refers to childbirth through the vagina without a cesarean section; a natural delivery. Used to describe the mode of delivery and related conditions.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢今朝順產，媽媽同個BB都平安。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 gam1 ziu1 seon6 caan2, maa4 maa1 tung4 go3 BB dou1 ping4 on1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 她今天早上顺产，妈妈和宝宝都平安。
examples.english_sentence: She had a natural delivery this morning; both mother and baby are safe.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 醫生建議如果情況允許，可以嘗試順產。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ji1 sang1 gin3 ji5 jyu4 gwo2 cing4 fong3 wan2 heoi2, ho2 ji5 coeng4 si3 seon6 caan2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 医生建议如果情况允许，可以尝试顺产。
examples.english_sentence: The doctor suggested that, if conditions allow, she can try for a natural delivery.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 順產比剖腹產恢復得快，但都要視乎母體情況。
examples.jyutping_sentence: seon6 caan2 bei2 pou3 fuk1 caan2 fui1 fuk6 dak1 faai3, daan6 dou1 jiu3 si6 fu1 mou5 tai2 cing4 fong3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 顺产比剖腹产恢复得快，但也要视乎母体情况。
examples.english_sentence: Recovery from a natural delivery is faster than from a cesarean, but it depends on the mother's condition.

mandarin_meaning: 順眼（看着顺眼；令人赏心悦目）
english_meaning: pleasing to the eye; easy on the eyes; agreeable in appearance or impression
explanation_mandarin: 用來形容外觀、擺設、舉止或整體印象讓人看起來舒服、討喜，屬口語用法。
explanation_english: A colloquial Cantonese adjective meaning that someone's appearance, behavior, or overall impression is pleasing or agreeable to look at.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你個打扮好順眼。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 go3 daa2 baan6 hou2 seon6 ngaan5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你的打扮很順眼。
examples.english_sentence: Your outfit is pleasing to the eye.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢間餐廳嘅擺設好順眼。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 gaan1 caan1 teng1 ge3 baai2 cit3 hou2 seon6 ngaan5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 這間餐廳的擺設很順眼。
examples.english_sentence: The decor of this restaurant is pleasing to the eye.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢啲舉止令我唔太順眼。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 di1 geoi2 zi2 ling6 ngo5 m4 taai3 seon6 ngaan5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他的舉止讓我覺得不太順眼。
examples.english_sentence: His behavior doesn't sit well with me.

mandarin_meaning: 顺路
english_meaning: on the way; along the way; incidentally if it's on someone's route
partOfSpeech_mandarin: 副詞 / 形容詞性短語
explanation_mandarin: 表示某地或某事在順路的路線上，可用於請人幫忙或表示順道經過。
explanation_english: Indicates that a place or action is on someone's route; used to say something is along the way or to ask someone to do something while passing by.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你順路嘅話，幫我買杯奶茶啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 seon6 lou6 ge3 waa6, bong1 ngo5 maai5 bui1 naai5 caa4 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你顺路的话，帮我买杯奶茶吧。
examples.english_sentence: If you're passing by, please buy me a milk tea.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢住喺我返工順路嘅地方。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 zyu6 hai2 ngo5 faan1 gung1 seon6 lou6 ge3 dei6 fong1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他住在我上班顺路的地方。
examples.english_sentence: He lives on the way to my workplace.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我順路送你返屋企囉。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 seon6 lou6 sung3 nei5 faan1 uk1 kei2 lo1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我顺路送你回家吧。
examples.english_sentence: I'll drop you home since it's on my way.

mandarin_meaning: 順便 / 順路
english_meaning: on the way; incidentally; while at it
explanation_mandarin: 表示在前往某處或做某事的路上，順便做另一件事。相當於普通話的「順便」或「順路」。
explanation_english: Used to indicate doing something incidentally while going somewhere or doing another action; equivalent to 'on the way' or 'incidentally'.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我返公司嘅時候順道買杯咖啡。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 faan1 gung1 si1 ge3 si4 hau6 seon6 dou6 maai5 bui1 gaa3 fe1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我去公司的時候順便買了一杯咖啡。
examples.english_sentence: I bought a cup of coffee on my way to the office.

mandarin_meaning: 顺路/顺手，顺便做某事
english_meaning: doing something because it's on the way or convenient; doing something incidentally while passing by
explanation_mandarin: 表示因为某地点在顺路或顺手，所以顺便帮忙或做某件事。为香港粤语的口语用法，相当于普通话的“顺路/顺便”。
explanation_english: A colloquial Cantonese phrase used to indicate doing something because it's on the way or convenient—i.e. taking the opportunity to do something incidentally while passing by.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我順頭順路去街市，幫你買條魚得唔得？
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 seon6 tau4 seon6 lou6 heoi3 gaai1 si5, bong1 nei5 maai5 tiu4 jyu4 dak1 m4 dak1?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我顺路去菜市场，帮你买一条鱼可以吗？
examples.english_sentence: I'm going to the market on the way—can I buy a fish for you?

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢話今日順頭順路送嘢過嚟，所以我唔使特登出門。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 waa6 gam1 jat6 seon6 tau4 seon6 lou6 sung3 je5 gwo3 lai4, so2 ji5 ngo5 m4 sai2 dak6 dang1 ceot1 mun4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他说今天顺路把东西送过来，所以我不用特地出门。
examples.english_sentence: He said he'd drop the stuff off since it's on his way today, so I don't need to go out specially.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你順頭順路經過我公司，幫我拎份文件返嚟得唔得？
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 seon6 tau4 seon6 lou6 ging1 gwo3 ngo5 gung1 si1, bong1 ngo5 ling1 fan6 man4 gin2 faan1 lai4 dak1 m4 dak1?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你顺路经过我公司，帮我拿份文件回来可以吗？
examples.english_sentence: If you happen to pass my office, can you pick up the document for me?

mandarin_meaning: 顺风；顺利、旅途平安（常用于祝愿）
english_meaning: literally 'favorable wind'; used to wish someone a smooth or safe journey; tailwind; favorable conditions
explanation_mandarin: 原指顺着风向，航行或行程较为顺利。常用作祝愿语（如“一路顺风”），表示祝对方旅途平安顺利，有时也指有利的条件或顺利进展。
explanation_english: Originally refers to sailing with the wind (making travel easier). Commonly used as a well-wishing expression (e.g., '一路順風' / 'have a safe trip') to wish someone a smooth, safe, or successful journey. It can also mean a tailwind or generally favorable conditions.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 祝你一路順風，早啲返嚟。
examples.jyutping_sentence: zuk1 nei5 jat1 lou6 seon6 fung1, zou2 di1 faan1 lai4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 祝你一路顺风，早点回来。
examples.english_sentence: Wish you a safe journey, come back soon.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 今朝風向啱啱好係順風，船會快啲到碼頭。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gam1 ziu1 fung1 hoeng3 aam1 aam1 hou2 hai6 seon6 fung1, syun4 wui5 faai3 di1 dou3 maa5 tau4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 今早风向正好是顺风，船会快一点到码头。
examples.english_sentence: This morning the wind is a tailwind, the boat will reach the pier a bit sooner.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 開張大吉，希望生意順風。
examples.jyutping_sentence: hoi1 zoeng1 daai6 gat1, hei1 mong6 saang1 ji3 seon6 fung1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 开张大吉，希望生意顺风。
examples.english_sentence: Congratulations on the opening — may your business go smoothly.

mandarin_meaning: 顺风旗（指示风向的小旗；比喻见风转舵、随风倒的人或事物）
english_meaning: wind flag / windsock (a flag that shows wind direction); figuratively, a weather-vane person or thing — someone who follows the prevailing trend or changes stance with circumstances
explanation_mandarin: 1) 字面上指用来指示风向的小旗或风向标。2) 引申为比喻，形容见风转舵、随波逐流或随时改变立场的人或事物。
explanation_english: 1) Literally, a small flag used to indicate wind direction. 2) Figuratively, a metaphor for a person or thing that shifts with the prevailing trend or changes position opportunistically.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 機場掛咗條順風旗，話晒今日風向穩定，飛機可以準時起飛。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gei1 coeng4 gwaa3 zo2 tiu4 seon6 fung1 kei4，waa6 saat3 gam1 jat6 fung1 hoeng3 wan2 ding6，fei1 gei1 ho2 ji5 zeon2 si4 hei2 fei1。
examples.mandarin_sentence: 机场挂了一面顺风旗，说明今天风向稳定，飞机可以准时起飞。
examples.english_sentence: The airport put up a wind flag, indicating the wind is steady today and flights can take off on time.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢好似順風旗咁，見風就轉，冇固定立場。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hou2 ci5 seon6 fung1 kei4 gam2，gin3 fung1 zau6 zyun2，mou5 gu3 ding6 lap6 coeng4。
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他像顺风旗一样，见风就转，没有固定立场。
examples.english_sentence: He's like a weather vane, turning with the wind and having no fixed stance.

mandarin_meaning: 听觉非常灵敏的人；来源于民间传说，常与“千里眼”成对出现，也可指爱偷听、容易听到别人谈话的人。
english_meaning: Someone with extremely keen hearing; (figuratively) an eavesdropper or person who overhears things easily. Originates from Chinese folklore, often paired with 'Thousand-Mile Eye'.
explanation_mandarin: “顺风耳”原为民间传说中的神通，能随风听到远处的声音。现在常用来形容听力特别好的人，或比喻爱偷听、容易被听到的人或事。
explanation_english: Literally 'wind-following ears'; a folkloric ability to hear sounds carried by the wind. Used to describe someone with very sharp hearing or, figuratively, an eavesdropper who easily overhears others.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 小心啲，唔好喺度講秘密，會畀順風耳聽到。
examples.jyutping_sentence: siu2 sam1 di1, m4 hou2 hai2 dou6 gong2 bei3 mat6, wui5 bei2 seon6 fung1 ji5 teng1 dou3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 小心点，不要在这里说秘密，会被顺风耳听到。
examples.english_sentence: Be careful, don't talk about secrets here—you'll be overheard by someone with sharp ears (an eavesdropper).

mandarin_meaning: 搭顺风车；顺路搭车的人或搭车的行为（也可比喻乘人之便、搭便车）
english_meaning: hitch a ride; a ride given by someone going the same way; figuratively, to take advantage of someone else's effort
explanation_mandarin: “順風車”原指順路而搭的便車，即搭別人順路開車的人。口語中也常用作比喻，表示趁機佔便宜或搭別人的便宜不付出代價。
explanation_english: Literally a ride given by someone going the same way (a lift). Commonly used colloquially to mean catching a free ride or taking advantage of others' efforts.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你今晚去灣仔，我可唔可以搭你個順風車？
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 gam1 maan5 heoi3 waan1 zai2, ngo5 ho2 m4 ho2 ji5 daap3 nei5 go3 seon6 fung1 ce1?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你今晚去湾仔，我可以搭你的顺风车吗？
examples.english_sentence: Are you going to Wan Chai tonight? Can I catch a ride with you?

mandarin_meaning: 一帆风顺；顺利；没有阻碍
english_meaning: smooth sailing; everything goes smoothly; without obstacles
partOfSpeech_mandarin: 成語 / 形容詞或副詞
explanation_mandarin: 用來形容事情進展順利、沒有阻滯或困難，也常用作祝福語。字面意思是風水都順，像順風行船般平穩。
explanation_english: Used to describe things proceeding smoothly without obstacles, and often used as a blessing. Literally 'favorable wind and favorable water', like sailing with the wind.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 祝你新年事事順風順水。
examples.jyutping_sentence: zuk1 nei5 san1 nin4 si6 si6 seon6 fung1 seon6 seoi2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 祝你新年事事顺风顺水。
examples.english_sentence: Wishing you a new year where everything goes smoothly.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢做生意越做越大，真係順風順水。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 zou6 saang1 ji3 jyut6 zou6 jyut6 daai6, zan1 hai6 seon6 fung1 seon6 seoi2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他做生意越做越大，真是顺风顺水。
examples.english_sentence: His business keeps growing; it's really going very smoothly.

mandarin_meaning: 顺风顺水 / 进展顺利
english_meaning: smooth sailing; things are going smoothly
explanation_mandarin: 廣東話口語用語，形容事情進展順利、很順暢或運氣好，類似「順風順水」或「一帆風順」。
explanation_english: A Cantonese colloquial expression meaning that things are progressing smoothly or one is having good luck—similar to 'smooth sailing' or 'going with the flow.'

examples.cantonese_sentence: 今個月生意好好，真係順風駛𢃇。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gam1 go3 jyut6 saang1 ji3 hou2 hou2, zan1 hai6 seon6 fung1 saai2 do6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这个月生意很好，真是顺风驶舵（順風順水）。
examples.english_sentence: Business has been great this month—it's really smooth sailing.

mandarin_meaning: 愚笨、迟钝（古今用法少见，常见于方言或书面）
english_meaning: dull-witted; slow; foolish (archaic or dialectal usage)
explanation_mandarin: “頇”用來形容人愚钝、迟缓或反应慢，多见于书面或方言（如粤语）的用法，现代普通话中较少使用。
explanation_english: “頇” describes someone who is dull-witted or slow to react. It is mainly an archaic or dialectal term (used in Cantonese and in literary contexts) and is uncommon in modern Mandarin.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 嗰個人好頇，成日做錯嘢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: go2 go3 jan4 hou2 hon1, sing4 jat6 zou6 co3 je5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 那个人很愚笨，总是做错事。
examples.english_sentence: That person is very dull-witted and always makes mistakes.

mandarin_meaning: 須 / 需 / 必須 (xū) — 必要、必需
english_meaning: must; need to; be necessary
explanation_mandarin: 表示必需、必然要做的事，在現代書面語與口語中用作“必須、需要”。
explanation_english: Indicates necessity or obligation (must/need). Used as a modal/auxiliary to express that something is required.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 根據公司規定，你須出席明天嘅會議。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gan1 geoi3 gung1 si1 gwai1 ding6, nei5 seoi1 ceot1 zik6 ming4 tin1 ge3 wui6 ji5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 根据公司规定，你必须出席明天的会议。
examples.english_sentence: According to company rules, you must attend tomorrow's meeting.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你唔須擔心，我會幫你。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 m4 seoi1 daam1 sam1, ngo5 wui5 bong1 nei5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你不必担心，我会帮你。
examples.english_sentence: You don't need to worry; I'll help you.

mandarin_meaning: 须知：需要知道的重要事项；注意事项。
english_meaning: Important information or notice; things to be aware of.
explanation_mandarin: “須知”通常用作名词，指在使用、參與或處理某事之前應該了解或注意的重要事項或說明。
explanation_english: “須知” is used as a noun meaning important information or notices—items one should know or be aware of before using, participating in, or handling something.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 使用須知已經放喺包裝盒入面，請細心閱讀。
examples.jyutping_sentence: si6 jung6 syu1 zi1 ji5 ging1 fong3 hai2 baau1 zong1 hap6 jap6 min6, cing2 sai3 sam1 jyut6 duk6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 使用须知已经放在包装盒里面，请仔细阅读。
examples.english_sentence: The instructions/important notices are placed inside the packaging; please read them carefully.

mandarin_meaning: 需要
english_meaning: need; require
explanation_mandarin: 表示有必要或必須做某事，相當於「需要」。在口語或書面語中都可使用。
explanation_english: Indicates necessity or requirement to do something, equivalent to "need". Usable in both spoken and written contexts.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你須要帶身份證出嚟。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 seoi1 jiu3 daai3 san1 fan6 zing3 ceot1 lei4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你需要帶身份證出來。
examples.english_sentence: You need to bring your ID.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 今日唔須要返工，老闆話放假。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gam1 jat6 m4 seoi1 jiu3 faan1 gung1, lou5 baan2 waa6 fong3 gaa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 今天不需要上班，老板說放假。
examples.english_sentence: We don't need to work today; the boss said it's a day off.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋須要再討論多次先可以決定。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 seoi1 jiu3 zoi3 tou2 leon6 do1 ci3 sin1 ho2 ji5 kyut3 ding6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我們需要再討論多一次才能決定。
examples.english_sentence: We need to discuss it again before deciding.

mandarin_meaning: 颂（讚揚、歌頌；頌歌、頌詞）
english_meaning: to praise or eulogize; an ode or eulogistic poem/song
explanation_mandarin: 「頌」通常指用歌詩或言辭讚揚、歌頌，用以表達敬意或讚美；在書面或文言語境中亦可指頌歌、頌詞等文體。
explanation_english: ‘頌’ generally means to praise or eulogize, often expressed in song or poetic form; in literary contexts it can refer to an ode or eulogistic composition.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 政府喺紀念大會上頌揚嗰啲為市民付出嘅前輩。
examples.jyutping_sentence: zing3 fu2 hai2 gei2 nim6 daai6 wui2 soeng6 zung6 joeng4 go2 di1 wai6 si5 man4 fu6 ceot1 ge3 cin4 bui3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 政府在纪念大会上颂扬那些为市民付出的前辈。
examples.english_sentence: At the memorial ceremony, the government praised the predecessors who had contributed to serving the citizens.

mandarin_meaning: 颂赞；称颂、赞美
english_meaning: to praise; to extol; to eulogize
explanation_mandarin: 用來表示對人或事物的讚美或讚揚，語氣較書面或正式。
explanation_english: Used to express praise or to extol someone or something; the tone is relatively formal or literary.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 嗰篇報道成日頌讚嗰位藝術家，好似冇提批評咁。
examples.jyutping_sentence: go2 pin1 bou3 dou6 seng4 jat6 zung6 zaan3 go2 wai6 ngai6 seot6 gaa1, hou2 ci5 mou5 tai4 pai1 ping4 gam2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 那篇报道一直颂赞那位艺术家，似乎没有提及批评。
examples.english_sentence: The article kept praising the artist, as if there were no criticism.

mandarin_meaning: 预（表示事先准备、预计、预约等）
english_meaning: to prepare in advance; to anticipate; to reserve/appoint (used in compounds)
partOfSpeech_mandarin: 动词（常用于复合词，如：预备、预约、预报），也可表示“事先”
partOfSpeech_english: verb (commonly appears in compounds); prefix/adverbial use indicating 'in advance'
explanation_mandarin: “預”表示事先准备、预计或预订等含义，通常与其他字组成词语（如“預備”、“預約”、“預報”），也可表示“事先、提前”。
explanation_english: The character indicates preparing in advance, anticipating, or making reservations/appointments. It commonly appears in compound words (e.g., 預備 prepare, 預約 reserve, 預報 forecast) and can convey the sense of 'in advance'.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋要預備好會議資料。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 jiu3 jyu6 bei6 hou2 wui6 ji5 zi1 liu6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们要预备好会议资料。
examples.english_sentence: We need to prepare the meeting materials.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你可以預約醫生嘅時間嗎？
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 ho2 ji5 jyu6 joek3 ji1 sang1 ge3 si4 gaan1 maa3?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你可以预约医生的时间吗？
examples.english_sentence: Can you make an appointment with the doctor?

examples.cantonese_sentence: 天氣預報話聽日會落雨。
examples.jyutping_sentence: tin1 hei3 jyu6 bou3 waa6 ting1 jat6 wui5 lok6 jyu5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 天气预报说明天会下雨。
examples.english_sentence: The weather forecast says it will rain tomorrow.

mandarin_meaning: 预备 / 准备
english_meaning: to prepare; preparation; to get ready
explanation_mandarin: 表示事先安排或準備某件事，既可以作動詞（做準備），也可以作名詞（準備、預備事項）。常用於日常會話和正式場合。
explanation_english: Indicates making preparations or getting ready for something. It can function as a verb (to prepare) or as a noun (preparation). Used in everyday and formal contexts.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋預備好未？
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 jyu6 bei6 hou2 mei6?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我們準備好嗎？
examples.english_sentence: Are we ready?

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你要預備多啲現金。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 jiu3 jyu6 bei6 do1 di1 jin6 gam1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你要準備多一點現金。
examples.english_sentence: You should prepare more cash.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 考試之前要做足預備。
examples.jyutping_sentence: haau2 si3 zi1 cin4 jiu3 zou6 zuk1 jyu6 bei6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 考試之前要做好充分的準備。
examples.english_sentence: Make thorough preparations before the exam.

mandarin_meaning: 预兆（yùzhào）：预示将要发生的迹象、征兆
english_meaning: omen; sign; portent — an indication that something (often forthcoming) is likely to happen
explanation_mandarin: 指预示某种事情将要发生的迹象或征兆，常用于表示即将发生的情况（可中性或带有不好的含义）。
explanation_english: Refers to a sign or indication that something is about to occur; often used to denote a portent (sometimes with a negative connotation).

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢啲烏雲同強風係暴雨嚟緊嘅預兆。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 di1 wu1 wan4 tung4 koeng4 fung1 hai6 bou6 jyu5 lai4 gan2 ge3 jyu6 ziu6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 這些烏雲和強風是暴雨即將來臨的預兆。
examples.english_sentence: These dark clouds and strong winds are signs that a heavy storm is coming.

mandarin_meaning: 预先；事先
english_meaning: in advance; beforehand
explanation_mandarin: 表示提前或事先做某事，用來說明在主要動作之前已經完成或安排的情況。
explanation_english: An adverb indicating that something is done ahead of time or beforehand; used to state that an action or arrangement is made prior to the main event.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 如果你會遲到，請預先打個電話畀我。
examples.jyutping_sentence: jyu4 gwo2 nei5 wui5 ci4 dou3, cing2 jyu6 sin1 daa2 go3 din6 waa2 bei2 ngo5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 如果你会迟到，请预先打个电话给我。
examples.english_sentence: If you're going to be late, please call me in advance.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 老闆要求我哋預先交報告。
examples.jyutping_sentence: lou5 baan2 jiu1 kau4 ngo5 dei6 jyu6 sin1 gaau1 bou3 gou3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 老板要求我们预先提交报告。
examples.english_sentence: The boss asked us to submit the report in advance.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你可以預先喺網上登記。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 ho2 ji5 jyu6 sin1 hai2 mong5 seong6 dang1 gei3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你可以预先在网上登记。
examples.english_sentence: You can register online in advance.

mandarin_meaning: 预告 (事先通知；预告、预告片)
english_meaning: to announce or notify in advance; a preview or trailer
explanation_mandarin: 表示事先告知、公布某事（如活動、播出時間等）；在影視語境中也指預告片或片段，用以介紹即將上映的作品。
explanation_english: To announce or notify something in advance (such as an event or air time); in media contexts it can also refer to a preview or trailer for an upcoming film or TV show.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 電視台已經預告咗下星期會播出新劇。
examples.jyutping_sentence: din6 si6 toi4 ji5 ging1 jyu6 gou3 zo2 haa6 sing1 kei4 wui5 bo3 ceot1 san1 kek6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 電視台已經預告了下星期會播出新劇。
examples.english_sentence: The TV station has already announced that it will air the new drama next week.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 公司已經預告下個月會調整班表，大家要留意通知。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gung1 si1 ji5 ging1 jyu6 gou3 haa6 go3 jyut6 wui5 tiu4 zing2 baan1 biu2, daai6 gaa1 jiu3 lau4 ji3 tung1 zi1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 公司已經預告下個月會調整班表，大家要留意通知。
examples.english_sentence: The company has already announced it will adjust the schedule next month; everyone should pay attention to the notice.

mandarin_meaning: 预告；事先通告；（电影、电视的）预告片
english_meaning: to announce in advance; advance notice; (noun) a preview or trailer (for a movie/TV program)
explanation_mandarin: 表示事先通告或提前公布某事，也可指電影或電視節目的預告片（trailer）。
explanation_english: To announce or notify something beforehand; can also refer to a preview or trailer for a film or TV show.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 電視台今晚會預告聽日嘅節目。
examples.jyutping_sentence: din6 si6 toi4 gam1 maan5 wui5 jyu6 gou3 ting1 jat6 ge3 zit3 muk6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 電視台今晚會預告明天的節目。
examples.english_sentence: The TV station will preview/tell the schedule for tomorrow's program tonight.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 電影嘅預告片已經上咗網。
examples.jyutping_sentence: din6 jing2 ge3 jyu6 gou3 pin3 ji5 ging1 soeng5 zo2 mong5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 電影的預告片已經上線了。
examples.english_sentence: The movie's trailer has already been released online.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢事先冇預告就遲到，令大家好唔方便。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 si6 sin1 mou5 jyu6 gou3 zau6 ci4 dou6, ling6 daai6 gaa1 hou2 m4 fong1 bin6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他事先沒有預告就遲到，讓大家很不方便。
examples.english_sentence: He didn't notify in advance and arrived late, causing inconvenience to everyone.

mandarin_meaning: （已經）預料到 /（已經）預訂、預約
english_meaning: already expected / already reserved (booked)
explanation_mandarin: 「預咗」是粵語中「預」加上完成體標記「咗」，常用於表示已經預料到某事（已經料到）或已經預先安排/預訂（已經訂好）。具體含義視語境而定。
explanation_english: In Cantonese, "預咗" is "預" plus the perfective marker "咗". It can mean "already expected" (something was anticipated) or "already reserved/booked" (something was arranged beforehand). The exact meaning depends on context.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我預咗佢會遲到。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 jyu6 zo2 keoi5 wui5 ci4 dou3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我（已經）預料到他會遲到。
examples.english_sentence: I already expected that he would be late.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我喺餐廳預咗枱，唔使擔心。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 hai2 caan1 teng1 jyu6 zo2 toi2, m4 sai2 daam1 sam1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我在餐廳已經預訂了座位，不用擔心。
examples.english_sentence: I already reserved a table at the restaurant, no need to worry.

mandarin_meaning: 预售（在正式开售前先行出售或接受预订）
english_meaning: pre-sale; to pre-sell or accept pre-orders before the official release
explanation_mandarin: 指在正式發售之前先行出售或接受預訂，常見於房地產、演唱會門票或產品上市等情況。
explanation_english: Refers to selling or accepting orders before the official sale or release. Commonly used for real estate, concert tickets, and product launches.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 新樓今日開始預售，開價仲未公布，想買就要留意。
examples.jyutping_sentence: san1 lau4 gam1 jat6 hoi1 ci2 jyu6 sau6, hoi1 gaa3 zung6 mei6 gung1 bou3, soeng2 maai5 zau6 jiu3 lau4 ji3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 新樓今天開始預售，開價還沒有公布，想買的話要留意。
examples.english_sentence: The new development starts its presale today; the price hasn't been announced yet, so if you want to buy you should pay attention.

mandarin_meaning: 预报 (yùbào)
english_meaning: forecast; predict; report in advance (often used for weather)
explanation_mandarin: 指事先對天氣或其他情況作出預測或通報，常用於氣象報告或公告。
explanation_english: To predict or report something in advance, commonly used for weather forecasts or official advisories.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 電台預報話聽日會落雨。
examples.jyutping_sentence: din6 toi4 jyu6 bou3 waa6 ting1 jat6 wui5 lok6 jyu5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 电台预报说明天会下雨。
examples.english_sentence: The radio forecast says it will rain tomorrow.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 氣象局預報本週有颱風，要注意安全。
examples.jyutping_sentence: hei3 zoeng6 guk6 jyu6 bou3 bun2 zau1 jau5 toi4 fung1, jiu3 zyu3 ji3 ngon1 cyun4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 气象局预报本周有台风，要注意安全。
examples.english_sentence: The meteorological bureau forecasts a typhoon this week; take care.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 天文台會預報風向同降雨機率，出門前最好睇一睇。
examples.jyutping_sentence: tin1 man4 toi4 wui5 jyu6 bou3 fung1 hoeng3 tung4 gong3 jyu5 gei1 leot6, ceot1 mun4 cin4 zeoi3 hou2 tai2 jat1 tai2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 天文台会预报风向和降雨概率，出门前最好看一看。
examples.english_sentence: The observatory will forecast wind direction and chances of rain; it's best to check before going out.

mandarin_meaning: 预定；预订；预约（提前保留或安排）
english_meaning: to reserve; to book; to schedule (to arrange or set aside in advance)
explanation_mandarin: 表示事先安排或保留某物或某時段（如位子、票、時間等），常用於訂位、訂票或安排時間。
explanation_english: Indicates arranging or reserving something in advance (such as a seat, ticket, or time slot); commonly used for booking or scheduling.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我已經預定咗下星期五嘅機票。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 ji5 ging1 jyu6 ding6 zo2 haa6 sing1 kei4 ng5 ge3 gei1 piu3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我已经预定了下星期五的机票。
examples.english_sentence: I have already booked the plane ticket for next Friday.

mandarin_meaning: 预感 (yùgǎn) — 对将来可能发生的事情产生的一种直觉或预先感觉，常带有不安或预兆的意味。
english_meaning: premonition; a foreboding or intuitive feeling that something (often negative) is going to happen
explanation_mandarin: 对未来某事有一种模糊的感觉或直觉，可能是好是坏，但常常带有不安或警示意味。
explanation_english: A vague intuitive feeling about something that will happen in the future; often a sense of foreboding or a premonition.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我今日有種唔妙嘅預感。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 gam1 jat6 jau5 zung2 m4 miu6 ge3 jyu6 gam2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我今天有種不妙的預感。
examples.english_sentence: I have a bad premonition today.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢預感到嗰次投資會失敗，之後果然係咁。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 jyu6 gam2 dou3 go2 ci3 tau4 zi1 wui5 sat1 baai6, zi1 hau6 gwo2 jin4 hai6 gam2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他預感到那次投資會失敗，之後果然如此。
examples.english_sentence: He had a premonition that the investment would fail, and it turned out to be true.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔使再等，佢好似有預感就打電話嚟。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 sai2 zoi3 dang2, keoi5 hou2 ci5 jau5 jyu6 gam2 zau6 daa2 din6 waa2 lai4.
