examples.english_sentence: I don't care about titles; I mainly want work that suits me.

mandarin_meaning: 笨蛋；固執或頭腦遲鈍的人（口語、貶義）
english_meaning: idiot; thick-headed person; stubborn/slow-witted (colloquial, derogatory)
explanation_mandarin: 「頭鎚」是廣東話的口語用法，通常用來形容一個人愚蠢、固執、不聽勸告，帶有貶義或戲謔的語氣。
explanation_english: A Cantonese colloquial/slang term used to describe someone as stupid, thick-headed, or stubborn. It is often derogatory or teasing in tone.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢成日都係個頭鎚，唔肯聽人嘅意見。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 sing4 jat6 dou1 hai6 go3 tau4 ceoi4, m4 hang2 teng1 jan4 ge3 ji3 gin3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他總是個固執、笨拙的人，不肯聽別人的意見。
examples.english_sentence: He's always such a thick-headed person, refusing to listen to others' opinions.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 今次考試做得唔好，我真係頭鎚。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gam1 ci3 haau2 si3 zou6 dak1 m4 hou2, ngo5 zan1 hai6 tau4 ceoi4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 這次考試考得不好，我真是個笨蛋。
examples.english_sentence: I did badly on this exam — I'm such an idiot.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你咁樣做真係頭鎚！
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 gam2 joeng6 zou6 zan1 hai6 tau4 ceoi4!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你這樣做真是愚蠢！
examples.english_sentence: What you're doing is really stupid!

mandarin_meaning: 帶頭者；頭目（口語）
english_meaning: leader; ringleader; head (colloquial)
explanation_mandarin: 「頭鑼」原意為鑼隊中的首位鑼手，後引申為帶領者或領頭的人。口語用法，可中性表示領導者，也可帶有貶義指帶頭鬧事或犯罪的頭目。
explanation_english: Literally 'head gong' (leader of the gong players); figuratively it means the leader or ringleader. Colloquial usage — can be neutral for a leader or negative when referring to the ringleader of trouble or crime.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 喺呢個項目入面，阿文係頭鑼，其他人要聽佢安排。
examples.jyutping_sentence: hai2 ni1 go3 hong6 muk6 jap6 min6, aa3 man4 hai6 tau4 lo4, kei4 taa1 jan4 jiu3 teng1 keoi5 on1 paai4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 在這個項目裡，阿文是頭鑼，其他人要聽他的安排。
examples.english_sentence: In this project, Ah Man is the leader; the others should follow his arrangements.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 警察話佢係打劫案嘅頭鑼，已經拘捕咗。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ging2 caat3 waa6 keoi5 hai6 daa2 gip6 on3 ge3 tau4 lo4, ji5 ging1 geoi1 bou6 zo2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 警察說他是搶劫案的頭目，已經被拘捕了。
examples.english_sentence: The police said he was the ringleader of the robbery and has already been arrested.

mandarin_meaning: 長子；第一個出生的兒子
english_meaning: eldest son; firstborn son
explanation_mandarin: 表示家中出世最早的兒子，為俗語用法，多用於口語或地區方言中。
explanation_english: Refers to the male child who is born first in a family. This is a colloquial/regional term commonly used in speech.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢係我哋屋企嘅頭長仔。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hai6 ngo5 dei6 uk1 kei2 ge3 tau4 zoeng2 zai2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他是我們家的長子。
examples.english_sentence: He is the eldest son in our family.

mandarin_meaning: 面子；體面；聲望、重要地位（常見於「頭面人物」、「有頭有面」等）
english_meaning: face; prestige; prominence or respectable status (often used in compounds/idioms such as '頭面人物', '有頭有面')
explanation_mandarin: 表示面子、體面或具有名望、重要地位的意思。常用於複合詞或成語中，如「頭面人物」（重要人物）或「有頭有面」（有面子、體面）。
explanation_english: Denotes face/ prestige or having prominence and respectable status. Commonly appears in compounds or idioms, e.g. '頭面人物' (a prominent person) or '有頭有面' (to be well-regarded or have social standing).

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢係公司入面嘅頭面人物。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hai6 gung1si1 jap6min6 ge3 tau4 min6 jan4 mat6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他是公司裡的頭面人物。
examples.english_sentence: He is a prominent figure in the company.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢而家好有頭有面，成日去啲高級場所。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 ji4 gaa1 hou2 jau5 tau4 jau5 min6, sing4 jat6 heoi3 di1 gou1 kap1 coeng4 soeng5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他現在很有面子，經常去高級場所。
examples.english_sentence: He's very respectable now and often goes to upscale places.

mandarin_meaning: 头顶（人的头部最上方）；头的正上方；也可作动词，表示用头顶着或顶在头上
english_meaning: the top of the head; directly above one's head; (verb) to hold or support something on the head
explanation_mandarin: 指頭部的最上方或某物位於人的頭的正上方；作動詞時表示用頭去頂住或承托物件。
explanation_english: Refers to the top or crown of the head, or something located directly above the head. As a verb it can mean to support or balance something on one's head.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 太陽好猛，曬到我個頭頂都痛。
examples.jyutping_sentence: taai3 joeng4 hou2 maang6, saai3 dou3 ngo5 go3 tau4 ding2 dou1 tung3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 太阳很强，晒得我的头顶都痛。
examples.english_sentence: The sun is so strong that the top of my head even hurts.

mandarin_meaning: 氣得頭頂冒煙 / 氣炸了
english_meaning: to be extremely angry; furious (literally: smoke coming out of the top of the head)
explanation_mandarin: 口語說法，形容人非常生氣或憤怒，像要冒煙一樣。常用來表示瞬間或極度的憤怒。
explanation_english: A colloquial Cantonese expression describing someone who is extremely angry or furious, as if 'smoke is coming out of their head.' Used to convey sudden or intense anger.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 聽到件事係佢做嘅，我真係頭頂出煙。
examples.jyutping_sentence: teng1 dou6 gin6 si6 hai6 keoi5 zou6 ge3, ngo5 zan1 hai6 tau4 deng2 ceot1 jin1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 聽到那件事是他做的，我真是氣得頭頂冒煙。
examples.english_sentence: When I heard he did it, I was furious (literally: smoke was coming out of my head).

mandarin_meaning: （口語）頭目、領頭人
english_meaning: leader; boss; ringleader (colloquial)
explanation_mandarin: 在粵語口語中用來指某個團隊、計劃或行動的領導者或負責人。有時帶有戲謔或貶義，指擅自當家作主的人。
explanation_english: A colloquial Cantonese term for the person in charge of a group, project, or action. Can be used neutrally for a leader or jokingly/pejoratively for someone who acts like the boss.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢係呢個計劃嘅頭頭，所有決定都由佢話事。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hai6 ni1 go3 gai3waak6 ge3 tau4 tau4, so2 jau5 kyut3 ding6 dou1 jau4 keoi5 waa6 si6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他是這個計劃的頭目，所有決定都由他說了算。
examples.english_sentence: He is the leader of this project; all decisions are made by him.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你唔好做頭頭，大家分工合作咪好喇。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 m4 hou2 zou6 tau4 tau4, daai6 gaa1 fan1 gung1 hap6 zok3 mai5 hou2 laa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你不要當頭頭，大家分工合作就好了。
examples.english_sentence: Don't try to act like the boss; it's better if everyone divides the work and cooperates.

mandarin_meaning: 從頭到尾；整個來龍去脈；全部
english_meaning: from start to finish; the whole thing; all the ins and outs
explanation_mandarin: 口語用語，表示整件事從開始到結束的全部內容或來龍去脈，強調完整性或細節。
explanation_english: A colloquial Cantonese expression meaning the entire matter from beginning to end — all the details or the whole story; often used in casual speech to emphasize completeness.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你可唔可以講清楚件事嘅頭頭尾尾？
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 ho2 m4 ho2 ji5 gong2 cing1 co2 gin6 si6 ge3 tau4 tau4 mei5 mei5?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你能不能把这件事的來龍去脈講清楚？
examples.english_sentence: Can you explain the whole story (all the ins and outs) of this matter?

mandarin_meaning: 非常能幹／很厲害
english_meaning: very capable; pretty impressive; top-notch
explanation_mandarin: 廣東話口語/俚語，用來形容人或事做得很好、很稱職或很厲害，帶有肯定或讚賞的語氣。
explanation_english: A Cantonese colloquial/slang expression used to describe someone or something as very capable, competent, or impressive; conveys approval or praise.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢個師父做嘢頭頭掂掂，放心交俾佢啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 go3 si1 fu2 zou6 je5 tau4 tau4 dim6 dim6, fong3 sam1 gaau1 bei2 keoi5 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这个师傅做事非常能干，放心交给他吧。
examples.english_sentence: This master/worker is very capable; feel free to entrust it to him.

mandarin_meaning: 條理清楚；說話或做事有條有理
english_meaning: to speak or present matters in a clear, logical, and orderly way; well-organized
explanation_mandarin: 形容說話或做事有條理、講得清楚有理，讓人容易理解或接受。
explanation_english: Describes someone who speaks or acts in an orderly, logical, and coherent manner, making their points easy to understand or persuasive.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢講嘢講得頭頭是道，大家都信佢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 gong2 je5 gong2 dak1 tau4 tau4 si6 dou6, daai6 gaa1 dou1 seon3 keoi5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他說話說得頭頭是道，大家都相信他。
examples.english_sentence: He speaks very coherently; everyone believes him.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢份報告寫得頭頭是道，上司好滿意。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 fan6 bou3 gou3 se2 dak1 tau4 tau4 si6 dou6, soeng6 si1 hou2 mun5 ji3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 這份報告寫得頭頭是道，上司很滿意。
examples.english_sentence: This report is written very clearly and logically; the boss is very pleased.

mandarin_meaning: 接二連三倒楣；諸事不順
english_meaning: To have one misfortune after another; to be very unlucky; everything goes wrong
partOfSpeech_mandarin: 成語/口語（形容詞性短語）
explanation_mandarin: 口語化的廣東話慣用語，形容一個人連續遇到壞運氣或麻煩，事情接二連三出錯或不順利。
explanation_english: A colloquial Cantonese idiom describing a state of continuous bad luck or misfortune — things keep going wrong one after another.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 近排佢真係頭頭碰着黑，成日有啲嘢出問題。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gan6 paai4 keoi5 zan1 hai6 tau4 tau4 pung3 zoek6 hak1, seng4 jat6 jau5 di1 je5 ceot1 man6 tai4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 最近他真是接二連三倒楣，老是有事情出問題。
examples.english_sentence: Lately he's been really unlucky — things keep going wrong for him.

mandarin_meaning: 接二連三倒霉；事事不順
english_meaning: to have persistent bad luck; one misfortune after another; everything goes wrong
explanation_mandarin: 粵語口語說法，形容運氣很差、接二連三遇到麻煩或不順的事。
explanation_english: A Cantonese colloquial expression describing a run of bad luck or continuous misfortunes; things keep going wrong.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 最近我真係頭頭碰著黑，做咩嘢都唔順利。
examples.jyutping_sentence: zeoi3 gan6 ngo5 zan1 hai6 tau4 tau4 pung3 zoek3 hak1, zou6 me1 je5 dou1 m4 seon6 lei6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 最近我真是接二連三倒霉，做什麼都不順利。
examples.english_sentence: Lately I've been really unlucky — nothing I do goes smoothly.

mandarin_meaning: 頭顱（tóu lú）：頭、頭顱骨
english_meaning: head; skull
explanation_mandarin: 指人的頭部或頭顱骨，屬較書面或醫學用語，也可用於描述遺骸或受傷的情況。
explanation_english: Refers to a person's head or skull. It is a more formal/literary or medical term, and is also used when describing remains or head injuries.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢嘅頭顱腫咗，要去睇醫生。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 ge3 tau4 lou4 zung2 zo2, jiu3 heoi3 tai2 ji1 sang1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他的頭顱腫了，要去看醫生。
examples.english_sentence: His head is swollen; he needs to see a doctor.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 考古學家發現咗古代人嘅頭顱遺骸。
examples.jyutping_sentence: haau2 gu2 hok6 gaa1 faat3 jin4 zo2 gu2 doi6 jan4 ge3 tau4 lou4 wai4 hoi4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 考古學家發現了古代人的頭顱遺骸。
examples.english_sentence: Archaeologists discovered the skull remains of ancient people.

mandarin_meaning: 头风；因着风或着凉引起的头部不适（头痛、头晕或类似感冒的症状）
english_meaning: A colloquial Cantonese term for head discomfort caused by exposure to wind/chill—headache, dizziness, or head-cold symptoms
explanation_mandarin: 廣東話口語，通常指因着風、受寒或著涼而引起的頭部不適，例如頭痛、頭暈或有類似感冒的感覺。屬於俗稱而非現代醫學專有名詞。
explanation_english: A colloquial Cantonese expression referring to head-related discomfort caused by wind or chills—commonly headaches, dizziness, or symptoms like a head cold. It is a folk/colloquial medical term rather than a precise clinical diagnosis.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我而家有啲頭風，頭好痛。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 ji4 gaa1 jau5 di1 tau4 fung1, tau4 hou2 tung3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我现在有点头风，头很痛。
examples.english_sentence: I have a bit of 'tau fung' now; my head really hurts.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢著咗風，所以有頭風，要去睇醫生。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 zoek6 zo2 fung1, so2 ji5 jau5 tau4 fung1, jiu3 heoi3 tai2 ji1 sang1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他着凉了，所以有头风，要去看医生。
examples.english_sentence: He caught a chill, so he has a head problem ('tau fung') and needs to see a doctor.

mandarin_meaning: 头饰
english_meaning: head ornament; hair accessory; headdress
explanation_mandarin: 用于装饰头部或头发的饰品，例如发夹、发冠、头带或装饰性别针等。
explanation_english: An ornamental item worn on the head or in the hair, such as hair clips, combs, headbands, decorative pins, or small headdresses.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢戴咗一件好靚嘅頭飾。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 daai3 zo2 jat1 gin6 hou2 leng3 ge3 tau4 sik1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 她戴了一件很漂亮的头饰。
examples.english_sentence: She was wearing a very beautiful head ornament.

mandarin_meaning: 冠軍；第一名（賽馬中指獲得第一名的馬），引申為最出色或領先者
english_meaning: first-place horse; champion; winner; frontrunner (originally in horse racing, figuratively the top person or winner)
explanation_mandarin: 原指賽馬中獲得第一名的馬（冠軍馬），泛指比賽或競爭中的第一名、冠軍或領先者，也可用於比喻某領域的佼佼者。
explanation_english: Originally the horse that finishes first in a race (the champion horse); figuratively, it refers to the first-place winner, champion, or frontrunner in competitions or contexts.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 今場賽馬，嗰匹馬贏咗，做咗頭馬。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gam1 coeng4 coi3 maa5, go2 pat1 maa5 jing4 zo2, zou6 zo2 tau4 maa5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 這場賽馬，那匹馬贏了，成了冠軍。
examples.english_sentence: In this horse race, that horse won and became the champion.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢係班上嘅頭馬，成日攞第一名。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hai6 baan1 soeng6 ge3 tau4 maa5, sing4 jat6 lo2 dai6 jat1 ming4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他是班上的第一名，總是拿第一名。
examples.english_sentence: He's the top student in the class, always getting first place.

mandarin_meaning: 头发 (tóu fǎ)
english_meaning: hair (on the head)
explanation_mandarin: 指人頭部的毛髮，通常特指頭上的髮絲或髮型，也可泛指毛髮。
explanation_english: Refers to the hair on a person's head; commonly denotes hair strands, the hair as a whole, or hairstyle.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你啲頭髮好靚呀。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 di1 tau4 faat3 hou2 leng3 aa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你的头发很漂亮。
examples.english_sentence: Your hair is very pretty.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我啱啱剪咗頭髮。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 aam1 aam1 gin2 zo2 tau4 faat3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我刚剪了头发。
examples.english_sentence: I just got my hair cut.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢嘅頭髮好捲。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 ge3 tau4 faat3 hou2 gyun2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他的头发很卷。
examples.english_sentence: His hair is very curly.

mandarin_meaning: 不確定／罕見的廣東話詞彙，字形（𩓥）極為罕見，缺乏標準讀音與一致釋義。根據字形與結構推測，可能為擬聲或口語化形容詞，用來形容頭腦昏沉、糊塗或有點暈眩的狀態；也有可能是地方變體或書寫錯誤（例如替代「頭瓜瓜」「頭暈暈」等）。
english_meaning: Uncertain/rare Cantonese expression. The character 𩓥 is extremely uncommon and lacks a standard pronunciation or established meaning. It is likely an onomatopoeic or colloquial form used to describe feeling dizzy, muddled, or dazed; it may also be a regional variant or a misspelling of forms like "頭暈暈".
explanation_mandarin: 「頭𩓥𩓥」所用的中間字（𩓥）屬罕見字，現行字典與語料庫中鮮少記載，因而缺乏穩定讀音與準確詞義。口語語境中，這類重疊結構（如「頭____」＋重疊）常作擬聲或形容頭腦狀態之用，例如「頭暈暈」「頭重重」。若見到本詞，應小心其可能為地區性口語、私人創造或書寫錯誤，解釋時可參考上下文並比對常見替代詞。
explanation_english: The middle character 𩓥 is a very rare character with little to no documentation, so the pronunciation and precise meaning are not standardized. In colloquial Cantonese, doubled forms attached to 頭 (head) are often onomatopoeic or descriptive of head sensations (e.g., "頭暈暈" for dizzy). Encountering this form likely indicates a regional colloquialism, a nonce word, or a spelling/encoding variant. Interpretations should rely on context and comparison with common alternatives.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我今日頭𩓥𩥗𩓥，做嘢提唔起精神。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 gam1 jat6 tau4 [𩓥][𩓥], zou6 je5 tai4 m4 hei2 zing1 san4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我今天頭有點暈，做事提不起精神。
examples.english_sentence: My head feels a bit dizzy today; I can't muster any energy to work.

mandarin_meaning: 颊；面颊（臉的兩側）
english_meaning: cheek (the fleshy side of the face)
explanation_mandarin: 指臉的兩側，位於眼睛下方、鼻子與耳朵之間的那部分肉。常見於複合詞如「面頰」、「頰骨」。
explanation_english: Refers to the cheek—the fleshy area on either side of the face, below the eyes and between the nose and the ear. Appears in compounds like "cheek" and "cheekbone."

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢兩邊面頰都紅晒。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 loeng5 bin1 min6 gaap3 dou1 hung4 saai3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他兩邊面頰都紅了。
examples.english_sentence: Both of his/her cheeks are all red.

mandarin_meaning: 下巴；點頭（如「頷首」）
english_meaning: chin; to nod (as in 'to nod one's head')
explanation_mandarin: 「頷」本義指人的下巴或下顎，為名詞；在詞語如「頷首」中用作動詞，表示點頭或表示同意。
explanation_english: The character 頷 primarily refers to the chin or jaw (noun). It is also used as a verb in expressions like 頷首, meaning to nod (to indicate agreement).

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢頷首表示同意。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 ham6 sau2 biu2 si6 tung4 ji3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他頷首表示同意。
examples.english_sentence: He nodded to indicate agreement.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢摸住個頷，好似諗緊嘢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 mo2 zyu6 go3 ham6, hou2 ci5 lam2 gan2 je5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他摸著下巴，好像在想事情。
examples.english_sentence: He stroked his chin as if thinking.

mandarin_meaning: 詩歌中的第二聯（通常指律詩的第三、第四句）
english_meaning: The second couplet (usually lines 3–4) in a classical Chinese regulated verse (lüshi)
explanation_mandarin: 在古典詩歌，特別是律詩中，一首八句的詩常分為四聯：首聯、頷聯、頸聯、尾聯。頷聯指第三、第四句，通常承接首聯並鋪陳中段內容，起承上啟下的作用。
explanation_english: In classical Chinese poetry—especially lüshi (regulated verse)—an eight-line poem is commonly divided into four couplets: opening (shoulian), hànlián (second couplet), jinglian (third couplet), and closing. The hànlián comprises lines 3 and 4 and typically bridges and develops the poem between the opening and the middle.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢首律詩嘅頷聯寫得好精練，承上啟下。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 sau2 leot6 si1 ge3 ham6 lyun4 se2 dak1 hou2 zing1 lin6, sing4 soeng6 kai2 haa6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这首律诗的頷联写得很精练，承上启下。
examples.english_sentence: The second couplet (hànlián) of this lüshi is written very concisely and serves to connect the preceding and following parts.

mandarin_meaning: 脖子 / 颈
english_meaning: neck
explanation_mandarin: 指連接頭部與軀幹的身體部位（脖子、頸部）。在粵語中亦出現在一些口語詞彙如“卡頸”（瓶頸、卡住）或描述頸部受傷的動詞短語中。
explanation_english: Refers to the body part connecting the head and torso (the neck). In Cantonese it appears in colloquial expressions such as “卡頸” (bottleneck / stuck) and in phrases describing neck injury or pain.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢頸痛，要睇醫生。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 geng2 tung3, jiu3 tai2 ji1 sang1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他/她脖子疼，要看医生。
examples.english_sentence: His/her neck hurts; they need to see a doctor.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢扭親頸，行唔到路。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 nau2 can1 geng2, haang4 m4 dou3 lou6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他扭伤了脖子，走不了路。
examples.english_sentence: He twisted his neck and can't walk.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢個工序係整個生產流程嘅卡頸，搞到生產好慢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 go3 gung1 sou3 hai6 zing2 go3 saang1 caan2 lau4 cing4 ge3 kaa1 geng2, gaau2 dou3 saang1 caan2 hou2 maan6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这个工序是整个生产流程的瓶颈，导致生产很慢。
examples.english_sentence: This process is the bottleneck in the whole production flow, causing production to be very slow.

mandarin_meaning: 喉嚨；咽喉；要害、咽喉要點（比喻重要的控制點）
english_meaning: throat; gullet; choke point; a critical/vital point (figurative)
explanation_mandarin: 「頸喉」在粵語中本義是指人的喉嚨、咽喉部位；引申義常用來比喻某個事物或區域的要害、關鍵控制點（如掌握供應鏈的頸喉）。
explanation_english: In Cantonese, 頸喉 literally means the throat. Figuratively it refers to a crucial or strategic choke point — a place or resource whose control gives decisive power.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我頸喉痛，好唔舒服。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 geng2 hau4 tung3, hou2 m4 syu1 fuk6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我的喉嚨痛，覺得很不舒服。
examples.english_sentence: My throat hurts; I feel very uncomfortable.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋掌握住呢個行業嘅頸喉，其他公司好難競爭。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 zoeng2 ngok6 zyu6 ni1 go3 hong4 jip6 ge3 geng2 hau4, kei4 taa1 gung1 si1 hou2 naan4 ging6 zang1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们掌握着这个行业的咽喉，其他公司很难竞争。
examples.english_sentence: They control the industry's choke point, making it hard for other companies to compete.

mandarin_meaning: （1）衣領上靠近頸部的鈕扣（上扣）；（2）比喻關鍵位置或關鍵人物、樞紐。
english_meaning: (1) the collar/top button of a shirt; (2) figuratively, a chokepoint or a linchpin — a key position or person.
explanation_mandarin: 「頸喉鈕」可指衣服領口靠近頸部的鈕扣（字面意思），也常用作比喻，表示在結構、系統或組織中的關鍵位置或起決定作用的人或事。
explanation_english: Literally the button at the collar near the neck. Figuratively used to refer to a critical point, chokepoint, or a key person who controls or determines the outcome.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我件恤衫嘅頸喉鈕甩咗，要縫返。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 gin6 seot1 saam1 ge3 ging2 hau4 nau2 lat1 zo2, jiu3 fung4 faan1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我的襯衫的頸部那顆鈕扣掉了，要縫回去。
examples.english_sentence: The collar button of my shirt fell off; I need to sew it back on.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 喺公司入面佢係個頸喉鈕，一停佢啲決策成個項目就冇得做。
examples.jyutping_sentence: hai2 gung1 si1 jap6 min6 keoi5 hai6 go3 ging2 hau4 nau2, jat1 ting4 keoi5 di1 kyut3 zaak3 seng4 go3 hong6 muk6 zau6 mou5 dak1 zou6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 在公司裡他是個關鍵人物，一旦他停止決策，整個項目就無法進行。
examples.english_sentence: In the company he's the linchpin — if he stops making decisions the whole project can't proceed.

mandarin_meaning: 項圈 / 頸圈（戴在脖子上的環，可指飾品如項鍊或實用的寵物項圈/頸托）
english_meaning: neck ring / collar; choker; (pet) collar; neck brace (context-dependent)
explanation_mandarin: 指戴在頸部的環狀物，可作裝飾（如頸圈、項鏈、項圈）或實用用途（如寵物頸圈、頸托）。
explanation_english: A ring or band worn around the neck. It can be an accessory (a choker or necklace) or a functional collar (e.g., a pet collar or medical neck brace), depending on context.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你記得幫隻狗戴返個頸圈呀。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 gei3 dak1 bong1 zek3 gau2 daai3 faan1 go3 geng2 hyun1 aa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你記得幫那隻狗把項圈戴回來。
examples.english_sentence: Remember to put the collar back on that dog.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢戴住個頸圈，好有型。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 daai3 zyu6 go3 geng2 hyun1 hou2 jau5 jing4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 她戴著項圈，很有型／很酷。
examples.english_sentence: She's wearing a choker — it looks cool.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 因為頸椎受傷，醫生叫我戴頸圈休息。
examples.jyutping_sentence: jan1 wai6 geng2 zeoi1 sau6 soeng1, ji1 sang1 giu3 ngo5 daai3 geng2 hyun1 jau1 sik1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 因為頸椎受傷，醫生叫我戴頸圈休息。
examples.english_sentence: Because of a neck (vertebra) injury, the doctor told me to wear a neck brace to rest.

mandarin_meaning: 颈巾；围巾
english_meaning: scarf; neckerchief; neck scarf
explanation_mandarin: 指圍在頸部用以保暖或裝飾的布料或配件，常見於秋冬季，也可作為時尚配件。
explanation_english: A piece of cloth or accessory worn around the neck for warmth or decoration; commonly used in cold weather or as a fashion item.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 天氣凍，記得戴頸巾呀。
examples.jyutping_sentence: tin1 hei3 dung3, gei3 dak1 daai3 geng2 gan1 aa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 天气冷，记得戴颈巾啊。
examples.english_sentence: It's cold; remember to wear your scarf.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢條頸巾好靚，係邊度買㗎？
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 tiu4 geng2 gan1 hou2 leng3, hai6 bin1 dou6 maai5 gaa3?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他/她的围巾很漂亮，在哪儿买的？
examples.english_sentence: Her scarf is really pretty — where did she buy it?

mandarin_meaning: 固执；倔强
english_meaning: stubborn; headstrong; obstinate
explanation_mandarin: 粵語俗語，用來形容一個人固執、倔強、不願讓步或承認錯誤。
explanation_english: A Cantonese slang adjective describing someone who is stubborn, headstrong, unwilling to concede or admit mistakes.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢真係好頸性，唔肯承認自己錯。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 zan1 hai6 hou2 geng2 sing3, m4 hang2 sing4 jing6 zi6 gei2 co3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他真的很固执，不肯承認自己錯誤。
examples.english_sentence: He's really stubborn and won't admit he's wrong.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你唔好咁頸性，商量下先啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 m4 hou2 gam2 geng2 sing3, soeng1 loeng4 haa5 sin1 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你不要這麼倔強，先商量一下吧。
examples.english_sentence: Don't be so stubborn—discuss it first.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢因為面子問題變得好頸性，唔肯接受幫忙。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 jan1 wai6 min6 zi2 man6 tai4 bin3 dak1 hou2 geng2 sing3, m4 hang2 zip3 sau6 bong1 mong4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 因為面子問題他變得很固執，不接受別人的幫助。
examples.english_sentence: Because of pride, he became very stubborn and refused to accept help.

mandarin_meaning: 固執、頑固
english_meaning: stubborn; obstinate; stiff-necked
explanation_mandarin: 粵語口語，形容人固執、不願意妥協或改變想法，類似「頸硬」。
explanation_english: A colloquial Cantonese term describing someone who is stubborn or unwilling to compromise or change their mind (literally 'neck stiff').

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢成日頸梗，唔肯聽人意見。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 sing4 jat6 geng2 gang2, m4 hang2 teng1 jan4 ji3 gin3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他經常很固執，不肯聽別人的意見。
examples.english_sentence: He's often very stubborn and won't listen to other people's opinions.

mandarin_meaning: 頸部僵硬、肩膀疼痛
english_meaning: stiff neck and sore shoulders; neck stiffness with shoulder pain
partOfSpeech_mandarin: 名詞短語（描述身體症狀）
explanation_mandarin: 廣東話常用說法，表示頸部感到僵硬且肩膀疼痛，常由落枕、睡姿不良或久坐姿勢不當引起。
explanation_english: A Cantonese expression meaning the neck is stiff and the shoulders hurt, often due to sleeping awkwardly (a crick in the neck), poor posture, or muscle strain.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我朝早起身頸梗膊痛，轉唔到頭。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 ziu1 zou2 hei2 san1 geng2 gang2 bok3 tung3, zyun2 m4 dou2 tau4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我今天早上起床頸部僵硬、肩膀疼，轉不了頭。
examples.english_sentence: I woke up this morning with a stiff neck and sore shoulders; I can't turn my head.

mandarin_meaning: 颈椎（颈部的脊椎骨）
english_meaning: cervical vertebrae; neck vertebra
explanation_mandarin: 頸椎指頸部的脊椎骨，位於脊柱最上端，支撐頭部並保護脊髓。頸椎受傷或退化常引起頸部疼痛、僵硬或神經症狀。
explanation_english: The cervical vertebrae—the bones of the neck portion of the spine. They support the head and protect the spinal cord. Injury or degeneration can cause neck pain, stiffness, or neurological symptoms.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 最近長時間坐喺電腦前，我覺得頸椎好痠痛。
examples.jyutping_sentence: zeoi3 gan6 coeng4 si4 gaan3 zo6 hai2 din6 nou5 cin4, ngo5 gok3 dak1 geng2 zeoi1 hou2 syun1 tung3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 最近长时间坐在电脑前，我觉得颈椎很酸痛。
examples.english_sentence: I've been sitting at the computer for long periods recently; my cervical vertebrae feel very sore.

mandarin_meaning: 口渴（口語）
english_meaning: thirsty (colloquial)
explanation_mandarin: 廣東話口語說法，字面為「頸渴」，用來表示身體口渴、想喝東西，有時用來加強程度（很渴）。
explanation_english: A colloquial Cantonese expression literally meaning "neck-thirsty." It is used to say one is physically thirsty or strongly wants a drink.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我而家好頸渴，去買杯凍檸茶啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 ji4 gaa1 hou2 geng2 hot3, heoi3 maai5 bui1 dung3 ning4 caa4 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我現在很口渴，去買杯凍檸茶吧。
examples.english_sentence: I'm really thirsty right now; let's buy a cold lemon tea.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 跑咗十公里之後，個人超級頸渴，要飲足水。
examples.jyutping_sentence: paau2 zo2 sap6 gung1 lei5 zi1 hau6, go3 jan4 ciu1 kap1 geng2 hot3, jiu3 jam2 zuk1 seoi2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 跑了十公里之後，人非常口渴，需要喝足夠的水。
examples.english_sentence: After running ten kilometers, I was extremely thirsty and needed to drink plenty of water.

mandarin_meaning: 颈部化脓性肿/颈部疖肿（方言/舊詞）
english_meaning: a boil/abscess on the neck; scrofula-like neck swelling (dialectal/archaic)
explanation_mandarin: 「頸癘」為廣東話方言詞，指頸部出現的化膿性腫塊、疖或類似頸部疽瘡的病變，多屬地方用語或舊稱，現代漢語常說頸部膿腫、頸部疖或頸瘡。
explanation_english: A Cantonese/dialectal term referring to a pus-filled sore, boil, or abscess on the neck (or scrofula-like neck swelling). It is a regional/older term; modern Mandarin/English usually say neck abscess, boil, or neck lump.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢頸上起咗個頸癘，成日好痛，應該去睇醫生。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 ging2 soeng6 hei2 zo2 go3 ging2 lik6, sing4 jat6 hou2 tung3, jing1 goi1 heoi3 tai2 ji1 sang1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他頸上起了一個頸癘，總是很痛，應該去看醫生。
examples.english_sentence: He has a neck abscess; it keeps hurting. He should go see a doctor.

mandarin_meaning: 頸部瘰癧（頸部淋巴結腫大或瘰癧，常由感染或結核導致的腫塊）
english_meaning: Scrofula on the neck; a lump/swelling of the neck lymph nodes (often due to infection or tuberculous lymphadenitis).
explanation_mandarin: 粵語詞，指頸部出現瘰癧或淋巴結腫塊，通常由感染（包括結核性淋巴結炎）引起，可能伴有疼痛或化膿，需要醫療處理。
explanation_english: A Cantonese term for scrofula or swollen lymph node(s) on the neck. It denotes a lump or abscess in the neck, often caused by infection (including tuberculous lymphadenitis), and may be painful or suppurate; medical attention is usually advised.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢頸度起咗個頸癧，要去睇醫生。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 geng2 dou6 hei2 zo2 go3 geng2 lik6, jiu3 heoi3 tai2 ji1 saang1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他頸部長了一個瘰癧，要去看醫生。
examples.english_sentence: He has developed a scrofula lump on his neck and needs to see a doctor.

mandarin_meaning: （口語）掐住脖子；比喻對人施加壓力、控制或限制，使人難以自由行動（例如經濟或工作上的壓迫）
english_meaning: Colloquial: literally 'to clamp the neck'; figuratively to pressure, squeeze, coerce, or control someone (e.g., financially or at work).
explanation_mandarin: 口語用法，原指箍住頸部，現多用作比喻，表示對人施壓、限制或控制，讓對方難以脫身或自由處理事務。
explanation_english: A colloquial expression literally meaning to clamp the neck; used figuratively to describe putting pressure on, coercing, or otherwise restricting someone (financially, professionally, etc.).

examples.cantonese_sentence: 老細成日對員工頸箍，做乜都要交代。
examples.jyutping_sentence: lou5 sai3 sing4 jat6 deoi3 jyun4 gung1 geng2 gu1, zou6 mat1 dou1 jiu3 gaau1 doi6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 老板經常對員工施壓，什麼事都要交代。
examples.english_sentence: The boss constantly puts pressure on the staff and demands explanations for everything.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我供樓壓力好大，畀銀行頸箍，啲錢唔夠用。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 gung1 lau4 aat3 lik6 hou2 daai6, bei2 ngan4 hong4 geng2 gu1, di1 cin2 m4 gau3 jung6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我還房貸的壓力很大，被銀行壓得喘不過氣，錢不夠用。
examples.english_sentence: My mortgage is a huge burden — the bank is squeezing me financially and I don't have enough money.

mandarin_meaning: 項鍊（頸鏈），戴在脖子上的飾物（注意：「頸聯」為錯別字，正確為「頸鏈」/「項鍊」）
english_meaning: necklace; an ornament worn around the neck (note: "頸聯" is a nonstandard/misspelling of "頸鏈")
explanation_mandarin: 「頸聯」並非常用正字，常見為錯別字或誤寫，正確應為「頸鏈」（傳統字「鏈」，粵語讀作 lin6），意思是戴在頸部的飾物，即項鍊或項鏈。
explanation_english: “頸聯” is a nonstandard or mistaken writing. The correct character is 鏈 (jyutping: lin6) as in 頸鏈, meaning a necklace — an ornament worn around the neck.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 好多廣東人寫錯「頸鏈」做「頸聯」。
examples.jyutping_sentence: hou2 do1 gwong2 dung1 jan4 se2 co3 'geng2 lin6' zou6 'geng2 lyun4'.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 很多廣東人把「頸鏈」錯寫成「頸聯」。
examples.english_sentence: Many Cantonese people mistakenly write '頸鏈' as '頸聯'.

mandarin_meaning: 等到脖子都長（等很久）
english_meaning: to have been waiting a very long time; to be kept waiting
explanation_mandarin: 粵語口語/俚語，字面是「脖子都長了」，用來形容等得很久，帶有不耐煩或抱怨的語氣。
explanation_english: A Cantonese colloquial/slang phrase literally meaning "the neck has grown," used to say one has been waiting a very long time and is annoyed or fed up.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我喺門口等咗半個鐘，等到頸都長。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 hai2 mun4 hau2 dang2 zo2 bun3 go3 zung1, dang2 dou3 geng2 dou1 coeng4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我在門口等了半個小時，等得脖子都長了。
examples.english_sentence: I waited at the door for half an hour — I've been waiting forever.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你話今晚會嚟，點解到而家都未嚟？等到我頸都長喇！
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 waa6 gam1 maan5 wui5 lai4, dim2 gaai2 dou3 ji4 gaa1 dou1 mei6 lai4? dang2 dou3 ngo5 geng2 dou1 coeng4 laa3!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你說今晚會來，為什麼到現在還沒來？我等得都快等到脖子長了！
examples.english_sentence: You said you'd come tonight — why haven't you arrived yet? I've been waiting so long!

mandarin_meaning: 頸鍊 / 項鍊（項鏈）
english_meaning: necklace (a chain or decorative item worn around the neck)
explanation_mandarin: 戴在頸部的裝飾品，通常由金屬鏈、珠串或其他吊飾組成，也可以指具有裝飾或身份象徵的頸部飾物。
explanation_english: A decorative item worn around the neck, typically a metal chain, string of beads, or pendant; can serve as ornamentation or a symbol of status.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢戴住條金頸鍊，好靚。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 daai3 zyu6 tiu4 gam1 geng2 lin6, hou2 leng3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他戴著一條金項鍊，很漂亮。
examples.english_sentence: He/She is wearing a gold necklace; it's very pretty.

mandarin_meaning: 項鍊（佩戴在頸部的飾品）
english_meaning: necklace (a piece of jewelry worn around the neck)
explanation_mandarin: 指佩戴於頸部的飾品或鍊子，通常用金屬、珠寶或繩子製成，可作裝飾或紀念用途。
explanation_english: A piece of jewelry or chain worn around the neck, typically made of metal, gemstones, or cord, used for decoration or as a keepsake.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢戴咗條好靚嘅頸鍊。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 daai3 zo2 tiu4 hou2 leng3 ge3 geng2 lin6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 她戴了一條很漂亮的項鍊。
examples.english_sentence: She wore a beautiful necklace.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我唔小心遺失咗條頸鍊。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 m4 siu2 sam1 wai4 sat1 zo2 tiu4 geng2 lin6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我不小心把項鍊弄丟了。
examples.english_sentence: I accidentally lost my necklace.

mandarin_meaning: 項鍊 (項链)
english_meaning: necklace
explanation_mandarin: 指戴在脖子上的裝飾鏈子或吊墜，通常由金屬、珠寶或其他材質製成，用作配飾或紀念品。
explanation_english: A decorative chain or pendant worn around the neck, typically made of metal, gems, or other materials, used as jewelry or a keepsake.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢戴住條頸鏈，好靚。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 daai3 zyu6 tiu4 geng2 lin6, hou2 leng3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 她戴着那條項鍊，很漂亮。
examples.english_sentence: She's wearing a necklace; it's very pretty.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我唔見咗條頸鏈，唔知擺喺邊。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 m4 gin3 zo2 tiu4 geng2 lin6, m4 zi1 baai2 hai2 bin1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我不見了我的項鍊，不知道放在哪裡。
examples.english_sentence: I lost my necklace; I don't know where I put it.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢條頸鏈係金定係銀？
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 tiu4 geng2 lin6 hai6 gam1 ding6 hai6 ngan4?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 這條項鍊是金的還是銀的？
examples.english_sentence: Is this necklace made of gold or silver?

mandarin_meaning: 颓：衰落、消沉、萎靡，也可指物體下垂
english_meaning: to decline; drooping; dejected; decadent; listless
explanation_mandarin: 表示精神或狀態衰落、消沉、不振作，或指物體鬆弛下垂；常見於複合詞如“頹廢”、“頹喪”。
explanation_english: Indicates a state of decline, dejection, or listlessness, or physical drooping; commonly appears in compounds like '頹廢' (decadent) or '頹喪' (dejected).

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢最近好頹，成日唔想出街亦唔想做嘢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 zeoi3 gan6 hou2 teoi4, sing4 jat6 m4 soeng2 ceot1 gaai1 jik1 m4 soeng2 zou6 je5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他最近很颓废，总是不想出门也不想做事。
examples.english_sentence: He's been very down lately; he never wants to go out or do anything.

mandarin_meaning: 颓丧（情绪低落、沮丧）
english_meaning: dejected; dispirited; despondent; downcast
explanation_mandarin: 用來形容情緒低落、意志消沉、沒有精神或喪失鬥志的狀態。
explanation_english: Describes a state of low spirits or loss of energy and motivation; feeling dejected or downcast.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢啲成績咁差，成日都好頹喪。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 di1 sing4 zik1 gam2 caa1, sing4 jat6 dou1 hou2 teoi4 song3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他的成绩这么差，整天都很颓丧。
examples.english_sentence: His grades are so bad; he's been feeling very dejected all the time.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 最近天氣一直落雨，大家心情有啲頹喪。
examples.jyutping_sentence: zeoi3 gan6 tin1 hei3 jat1 zik6 lok6 jyu5, daai6 gaa1 sam1 cing4 jau5 di1 teoi4 song3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 最近天气一直下雨，大家心情有点颓丧。
examples.english_sentence: Lately it's been raining non-stop; everyone's been feeling a bit down.

mandarin_meaning: 残垣断瓦；破败不堪的建筑或环境
english_meaning: ruined walls and broken tiles; dilapidated, in ruins
explanation_mandarin: 形容房屋或环境破败，常用来描写残破的建筑和凄凉的景象。
explanation_english: Describes buildings or surroundings that are dilapidated and ruined; often used to depict a scene of decay and desolation.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 舊街區多處頹垣敗瓦，行落去好淒涼。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gau6 gaai1 keoi1 do1 cyu3 teoi4 jyun4 baai6 ngaa5, haang4 lok6 heoi3 hou2 cai1 loeng4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 旧街区多处残垣断瓦，走过去很凄凉。
examples.english_sentence: The old neighborhood is full of ruined walls and broken tiles; walking through it feels very bleak.

mandarin_meaning: 颓废 (tuífèi)
english_meaning: decadent; demoralized; listless; in a state of decline or lacking energy and motivation
explanation_mandarin: 形容精神萎靡、缺乏鬥志或生活、道德等方面衰落、頹喪的狀態或風格。
explanation_english: Describes a state or style marked by decline, lack of energy or morale, listlessness, or moral/creative decay.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢最近好頹廢，成日冇動力，連打工都唔想返。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 zeoi3 gan6 hou2 teoi4 fai3, sing4 jat6 mou5 dung6 lik6, lin4 daa2 gung1 dou1 m4 soeng2 faan1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他最近很颓废，整天没有动力，甚至不想去上班。
examples.english_sentence: He's been very demotivated lately, lacking energy and doesn't even want to go to work.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢幅畫有種頹廢嘅美，表現出城市衰敗同無奈。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 fuk1 waa2 jau5 zung2 teoi4 fai3 ge3 mei5, biu2 jin2 ceot1 sing4 si5 seoi1 baai6 tung4 mou4 noi6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 這幅畫有一種颓废之美，表現出城市衰敗與無奈。
examples.english_sentence: This painting has a decadent beauty, conveying the city's decline and helplessness.

mandarin_meaning: 游手好闲；无所事事；（有时）靠别人养活、当饭票
english_meaning: to loaf around; to be idle; (sometimes) to freeload/live off others
explanation_mandarin: 粵語口語俚語，表示整天無所事事、打發時間；在某些語境下也可指依靠別人生活或不工作卻有得吃喝。
explanation_english: A Cantonese slang term meaning to laze about or be idle. In some contexts it can imply freeloading or living off others without working.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢辭咗工之後整日頹飯，乜都唔做。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 ci4 zo2 gung1 zi1 hau6 zing2 jat6 teoi4 faan6, mat1 dou1 m4 zou6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他辞了职之后整天无所事事，什么都不做。
examples.english_sentence: After he quit his job, he loafs around all day and does nothing.

mandarin_meaning: 频（表示次数或频率，常用於合成词如“频率”“频繁”“频道”）
english_meaning: frequency; frequent (denotes repetition or rate; commonly appears in compounds)
partOfSpeech_mandarin: 形容詞/名詞（多用作構詞成分或前綴，在合成詞中出現）
partOfSpeech_english: adjective / noun (commonly a bound morpheme/prefix in compounds)
explanation_mandarin: “頻”用來表示事情發生的次數或頻率，常見於詞語如“頻率”、“頻繁”、“頻道”。單獨使用較少，多數作為合成詞的一部分。
explanation_english: “頻” denotes repetition or rate (how often something happens). It commonly appears in compounds such as "frequency", "frequent", and "channel" rather than as a standalone word.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 收音機嘅頻率唔穩定，收唔到台。
examples.jyutping_sentence: sau1 jam1 gei1 ge3 pan4 leot6 m4 wan5 ding6, sau1 m4 dou2 toi4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 收音机的频率不稳定，收不到台。
examples.english_sentence: The radio's frequency is unstable; it can't pick up the station.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 最近嗰部電腦故障得好頻繁，要攞去維修。
examples.jyutping_sentence: zeoi3 gan6 go2 bou6 din6 nou5 gu3 zoeng6 dak1 hou2 pan4 faan4, jiu3 lo2 heoi3 wai4 sau1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 最近那台电脑故障得很频繁，要拿去维修。
examples.english_sentence: That computer has been failing very frequently lately; it needs to be taken in for repairs.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我搵唔到個頻道，你幫手轉台一下。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 wan2 m4 dou3 go3 pan4 dou6, nei5 bong1 sau2 zyun3 toi4 jat1 haa5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我找不到那个频道，你帮忙换台一下。
examples.english_sentence: I can't find that channel—can you help switch the channel?

mandarin_meaning: 频繁发生；屡次发生 (pín réng)
english_meaning: occur frequently; repeatedly; happening often
explanation_mandarin: 表示某種事情屢次發生、頻繁出現，多用來形容不好的現象反覆出現。
explanation_english: Indicates that something happens repeatedly or frequently; often used to describe undesirable events that occur again and again.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 最近路上意外頻仍，大家出門要小心。
examples.jyutping_sentence: zeoi3 gan6 lou6 soeng6 ji3 ngoi6 pan4 jing4, daai6 gaa1 ceot1 mun4 jiu3 siu2 sam1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 最近路上意外频仍，大家出门要小心。
examples.english_sentence: Accidents on the roads have been happening frequently lately; everyone should be careful when going out.

mandarin_meaning: 罕見詞語（可能為人名或音譯）
english_meaning: rare/obscure term; likely a personal name or a transliteration
partOfSpeech_mandarin: 名詞（專有名詞 / 罕見）
explanation_mandarin: 「頻倫」並非常見的粵語詞彙，常見用法是作為人名、地名或外文名稱的音譯。若在語境中出現而非作為專有名詞，可能是打字、轉寫或用詞誤用。
explanation_english: “頻倫” is not a common Cantonese lexical item. It is most likely used as a proper noun (personal name, place name) or as a transliteration of a foreign name. If encountered outside a name context, it may be a typo or transcription error.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我琴日見到一個人叫頻倫，佢好友善。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 kam4 jat6 gin3 dou3 jat1 go3 jan4 giu3 pan4 leon4, keoi5 hou2 jau5 sin6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我昨天遇到一個叫頻倫的人，他很友善。
examples.english_sentence: I met someone named 'Pinlun' yesterday; he was very friendly.

mandarin_meaning: 頻繁
english_meaning: frequent; occurring often
explanation_mandarin: 表示事情發生的頻率高、次數多，常用來形容事件或情況經常出現。
explanation_english: Indicates a high frequency of occurrence; used to describe events or situations that happen repeatedly or often.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 最近收到嘅投訴變得幾頻密，我哋要重視。
examples.jyutping_sentence: zeoi3 gan6 sau1 dou3 ge3 tau4 sou3 bin3 dak1 gei2 pan4 mat6, ngo5 dei6 jiu3 zung6 si6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 最近收到的投訴變得很頻繁，我們要重視。
examples.english_sentence: We've been receiving complaints more frequently recently; we need to take them seriously.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 近年颱風來得頻密，市民要有準備。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gan6 nin4 toi4 fung1 loi4 dak1 pan4 mat6, si5 man4 jiu3 jau5 zeon2 bei6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 近年颱風來得頻繁，市民要有準備。
examples.english_sentence: Typhoons have been occurring more frequently in recent years; residents should be prepared.

mandarin_meaning: 带宽 / 频带宽度
english_meaning: bandwidth (the width of a frequency band; also network/data capacity)
explanation_mandarin: 表示訊號或頻帶的頻率範圍寬度；在網路或通訊領域常用來指數據傳輸能力（帶寬）。
explanation_english: Refers to the width of a frequency band of a signal; in networking/telecommunications it commonly denotes data transmission capacity.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢條網絡嘅頻寬太細，上網好慢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 tiu4 mong5 lok3 ge3 pan4 fun1 taai3 sai3, soeng5 mong5 hou2 maan6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 這個網絡的頻寬太小，上網很慢。
examples.english_sentence: The network's bandwidth is too small, the internet is very slow.

mandarin_meaning: 頻繁撲向／搭訕（某人）
english_meaning: to repeatedly pounce on or hit on someone; to make persistent advances
explanation_mandarin: 口語/俚語用法，指經常向某人撲上去或搭訕，帶有騷擾或令人煩惱的意味。
explanation_english: A colloquial/slang Cantonese term meaning to repeatedly pounce on or hit on someone; implies persistent advances that are often annoying or intrusive.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢成日喺朋友圈度頻撲啲女仔，真係好煩。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 sing4 jat6 hai2 pang4 jau5 hyun1 dou6 pan4 pok3 di1 neoi5 zai2, zan1 hai6 hou2 faan4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他經常在朋友圈裡對女孩子頻繁搭訕，真的很煩。
examples.english_sentence: He frequently hits on girls in our friend circle; it's really annoying.

mandarin_meaning: 频率 (pín lǜ)
english_meaning: frequency; rate (how often something occurs per unit time; in physics, cycles per second)
explanation_mandarin: 表示單位時間內某事件出現的次數；在物理學中常指每秒循環次數（赫茲）。
explanation_english: Indicates how often an event occurs per unit time; in physics it commonly refers to the number of cycles per second (hertz).

examples.cantonese_sentence: 收音機調唔到啱嘅頻率。
examples.jyutping_sentence: sau1 jam1 gei1 tiu4 m4 dou2 aap3 ge3 pan4 leot6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 收音机调不到正确的频率。
examples.english_sentence: The radio can't tune to the correct frequency.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢運動嘅頻率太低，要加多啲練習。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 wan6 dung6 ge3 pan4 leot6 taai3 dai1, jiu3 gaa1 do1 di1 lin6 zaap6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他運動的頻率太低，需要增加練習。
examples.english_sentence: His exercise frequency is too low; he needs to practice more.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 喺統計入面，頻率指一件事發生嘅次數。
examples.jyutping_sentence: hai2 tung2 gai3 jap6 min6, pan4 leot6 zi2 jat1 gin6 si6 faat3 sang1 ge3 ci3 sou3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 在統計中，頻率指一件事發生的次數。
examples.english_sentence: In statistics, frequency refers to the number of times an event occurs.

mandarin_meaning: 频繁（经常发生、重复出现）
english_meaning: frequent; occurring often; repeatedly happening
explanation_mandarin: 表示某種事情或現象在短時間內多次發生、出現頻率高。
explanation_english: Indicates that an event or phenomenon occurs many times within a short period; high frequency of occurrence.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 最近佢出差嘅次數好頻繁，都冇時間休息。
examples.jyutping_sentence: zeoi3 gan6 keoi5 ceot1 caai1 ge3 ci3 sou3 hou2 pan4 faan4, dou1 mou5 si4 gaan3 jau1 sik1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 最近他出差的次數很頻繁，都沒有時間休息。
examples.english_sentence: Lately he has been on business trips very frequently and has no time to rest.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 近排交通意外頻繁，政府表示會加強交通安全措施。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gan6 paai4 gaau1 tung1 ji3 ngoi6 pan4 faan4, zing3 fu2 biu2 si6 wui5 gaa1 koeng4 gaau1 tung1 on1 cyun4 cou3 sik1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 最近交通事故頻繁，政府表示會加強交通安全措施。
examples.english_sentence: Traffic accidents have been frequent recently; the government says it will strengthen traffic safety measures.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 如果你頻繁更改計劃，團隊會唔容易適應。
examples.jyutping_sentence: jyu4 gwo2 nei5 pan4 faan4 gang1 goi2 gai3 waak6, tyun4 deoi2 wui5 m4 jung4 ji6 sik1 jing3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 如果你頻繁更改計劃，團隊會不容易適應。
examples.english_sentence: If you frequently change the plan, the team will not find it easy to adapt.

mandarin_meaning: （非標準詞）可能指與頻率相關的能量或能力，常見於技術或書面語境
english_meaning: A non-standard term likely referring to frequency-related energy or capability; typically used in technical or written contexts
explanation_mandarin: 「頻能」並非廣東話常用詞。字面由「頻」（頻率、頻繁）和「能」（能力、能量）組成，通常在技術文件或專業討論中用作合成詞，可能表示與頻率有關的能量、頻率特性或系統的頻率能力。
explanation_english: Not a common Cantonese lexical item. Literally combines "frequency" (頻) and "ability/energy" (能). It is typically a coined or technical compound used in written or specialist contexts to denote frequency-related energy, frequency characteristics, or a system's frequency capability.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 工程師話要調整嗰部儀器嘅頻能數據。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gung1 cing4 si1 waa6 jiu3 tiu4 zing2 go2 bou6 ji4 hei3 ge3 pan4 nang4 sou3 geoi3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 工程师说要调整那台仪器的“頻能”数据。
examples.english_sentence: The engineer said we need to adjust the '頻能' data of that instrument.

mandarin_meaning: 頻譜（指頻率上的能量或強度分佈）
english_meaning: spectrum; frequency spectrum (distribution of energy or intensity over frequencies)
explanation_mandarin: 表示按頻率排列的能量或強度分佈，常用於電子工程、訊號處理、聲學與光學，用來描述訊號或光的頻率成分。
explanation_english: Refers to the distribution of energy or intensity across frequencies. Commonly used in electronics, signal processing, acoustics, and optics to describe a signal's or light's frequency components.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 工程師用頻譜分析器去睇個訊號嘅頻譜。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gung1 cing4 si1 jung6 pan4 pou2 fan1 sik1 hei3 heoi3 tai2 go3 seon3 hou6 ge3 pan4 pou2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 工程師使用頻譜分析器檢查訊號的頻譜。
examples.english_sentence: The engineer used a spectrum analyzer to check the signal's spectrum.

mandarin_meaning: 频繁蹒跚；走路或行动不稳，常常摇晃
english_meaning: to stumble or stagger frequently; to move unsteadily or wobble often
explanation_mandarin: 「頻蹸」為粵語口語或方言用詞（較罕見），用來形容人走路或動作經常不穩、搖晃或蹣跚。有時被視為「蹌」的變體，用於強調頻繁發生。
explanation_english: A Cantonese colloquial/rare term describing someone who repeatedly stumbles or moves unsteadily. It can be seen as a variant of 蹌, emphasizing the frequent occurrence of staggering or wobbling.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢最近行路成日頻蹸，可能腳痛或者暈。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 zeoi3 gan6 haang4 lou6 seng4 jat6 pan4 coeng1, ho2 nang4 goek3 tung3 waak6 ze2 wan1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他最近走路經常蹣跚，可能腳痛或者頭暈。
examples.english_sentence: He has been stumbling a lot when walking lately; he might have a sore foot or feel dizzy.

mandarin_meaning: 罕見詞，可能指頻繁轉動的輪子或機械零件；在某些語境也可能是專有名詞或術語。
english_meaning: A rare term, possibly referring to a wheel that rotates frequently or a mechanical component; in some contexts it may be a proper noun or a specialized term.
explanation_mandarin: 「頻輪」不是常見的粵語詞彙。一種可能的理解是指一個會頻繁旋轉的輪子或機械部件；也可能出現在專業術語或專有名稱中。使用時應注意語境或確認來源。
explanation_english: Not a common Cantonese word. One plausible interpretation is a wheel or mechanical part that turns frequently; it may also appear as a technical term or proper name. Usage is rare and context-dependent.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢個機器入面好似有個頻輪，經常轉得好快。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 go3 gei1 hei3 jap6 min6 hou2 ci5 jau5 go3 pan4 leon4, ging1 soeng4 zyun3 dak1 hou2 faai3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这个机器里面好像有个频轮，经常转得很快。
examples.english_sentence: It seems there is a '頻輪' inside this machine; it spins very quickly.

mandarin_meaning: 频道
english_meaning: channel (TV/radio/online); frequency band; communication channel
explanation_mandarin: 通常指電視、電台或網絡上的頻道，也可指頻率範圍或通訊/傳輸的通道。
explanation_english: Usually refers to a channel on TV, radio, or online; can also mean a frequency band or a communication/transmission channel.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 今晚轉台，呢個頻道有套好電影。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gam1 maan5 zyun2 toi4, ni1 go3 pan4 dou6 jau5 tou3 hou2 din6 jing2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 今晚换台，这个频道有一部好电影。
examples.english_sentence: Switch channels tonight; this channel is showing a good movie.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你可以按遙控器選擇不同頻道嚟睇新聞。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 ho2 ji5 on3 jiu4 hung3 hei3 syun2 zaak6 bat1 tung4 pan4 dou6 lai4 tai2 san1 man4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你可以按遥控器选择不同频道来看新闻。
examples.english_sentence: You can use the remote to select different channels to watch the news.

mandarin_meaning: 频繁；屡次
english_meaning: frequently; repeatedly; repeatedly and often
explanation_mandarin: 用來表示某個動作或情況發生得多次、反覆或頻繁，常用於修飾動詞。
explanation_english: Used to indicate that an action or situation occurs many times, repeatedly, or frequently; commonly modifies verbs.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢返工遲到，頻頻向老闆道歉。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 faan1 gung1 ci4 dou3, pan4 pan4 hoeng3 lou5 baan2 dou6 hei3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他上班迟到，频频向老板道歉。
examples.english_sentence: He came to work late and kept apologizing to the boss.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 新聞報導指出，該地區近日頻頻發生地震。
examples.jyutping_sentence: san1 man4 bou3 dou6 zik1 ceot1, goi1 dei6 keoi1 zeon3 gan6 pan4 pan4 faat3 sang1 dei6 zan3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 新闻报道指出，该地区近日频频发生地震。
examples.english_sentence: News reports indicate that the area has been experiencing frequent earthquakes recently.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢喺會議上頻頻發言，表現得好積極。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hai2 wui6 ji5 soeng6 pan4 pan4 faat3 jin4, biu2 jin2 dak1 hou2 zik1 gik6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他在会议上频频发言，表现得很积极。
examples.english_sentence: He spoke up repeatedly during the meeting, showing a very proactive attitude.

mandarin_meaning: 频频扑扑（拟声词），形容反复扑动、拍打或心脏/心口频繁扑动
english_meaning: An onomatopoeic expression meaning repeatedly flapping/ fluttering or pounding (e.g. wings or a fluttering heartbeat)
partOfSpeech_mandarin: 拟声词（可作动词或副词）
partOfSpeech_english: onomatopoeia (can function as verb or adverb)
explanation_mandarin: 「頻頻撲撲」是廣東話的叠詞擬聲詞，用來形容反复拍動、扑動或心口/心臟急促跳動的狀態，常用於描寫鳥翼、昆蟲翅膀或心跳等。
explanation_english: A Cantonese reduplicated onomatopoeia describing repeated flapping, beating or a fluttering/pounding sensation (for example wings flapping or a rapidly beating heart). Used to depict quick, repetitive motions or sensations.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 隻雀仔成日頻頻撲撲，飛來飛去好煩。
examples.jyutping_sentence: zek3 zoek3 zai2 sing4 jat6 pan4 pan4 puk1 puk1, fei1 loi4 fei1 heoi3 hou2 faan4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 那隻小鳥不停地頻頻撲動翅膀，飛來飛去，很煩人。
examples.english_sentence: That little bird keeps flapping its wings repeatedly and flying back and forth; it's annoying.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 每次見到佢，我心口就頻頻撲撲，講唔出嘢嚟。
examples.jyutping_sentence: mui5 ci3 gin3 dou3 keoi5, ngo5 sam1 hau2 zau6 pan4 pan4 puk1 puk1, gong2 m4 ceot1 je5 lai4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 每次看到他/她，我的心口就頻頻撲撲，說不出話來。
examples.english_sentence: Every time I see him/her, my chest flutters repeatedly and I can't say anything.

mandarin_meaning: 經常、頻繁（帶粗口語氣，口語用法）
english_meaning: to do something repeatedly/frequently (colloquial, vulgar intensifier)
partOfSpeech_mandarin: 副詞 / 動詞（口語、粗俗）
explanation_mandarin: 「頻𠹹」為粵語口語用法，表示某事頻繁發生或一再重複。字形中的第二個字帶有粗口語氣（類似常見粗口字），屬非正式、口語或網絡用語，使用時注意場合。
explanation_english: “頻𠹹” is a Cantonese colloquial slang used to indicate something happening repeatedly or frequently. The second character carries a coarse/vulgar tone (used as an intensifier). It is informal and may be offensive in polite contexts.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢成日頻𠹹敲門，真係好煩。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 seng4 jat6 pan4 lan2 haau1 mun4, zan1 hai6 hou2 faan4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他老是頻繁敲門，真的很煩。
examples.english_sentence: He keeps knocking on the door frequently; it's really annoying.

mandarin_meaning: 赖 / 賴（依赖；耍赖）
english_meaning: to rely on; to shirk/blame/act shamelessly (colloquial)
explanation_mandarin: 表示依靠、依赖；在口语或贬义场合可表示耍赖、推脱责任或不讲理（如“賴皮”、“耍賴”）。
explanation_english: Expresses depending on or relying upon something; colloquially it can mean to act shamelessly, shirk responsibility, or refuse to accept blame (e.g. "laai6 pei4", "play the rogue").

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你唔好賴我，係你自己啲錯。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 m4 hou2 laai6 ngo5, hai6 nei5 zi6 gei2 di1 co3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 不要赖我，这是你自己的错。
examples.english_sentence: Don't blame me; it's your own fault.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢成日賴皮，唔肯還錢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 sing4 jat6 laai6 pei4, m4 hang2 waan4 cin2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他总是耍赖，不肯还钱。
examples.english_sentence: He always acts shamelessly and refuses to pay back the money.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋唔可以完全賴運氣，仲要努力。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 m4 ho2 ji5 jyun4 cyun4 laai6 wan6 hei3, zung6 jiu3 nou5 lik6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们不能完全靠运气，还要努力。
examples.english_sentence: We can't rely solely on luck; we still need to work hard.

mandarin_meaning: 颓（如颓废、颓丧），表示衰落、萎靡或消沉
english_meaning: decline; decayed; dispirited; listless (often as in 'decadent' or 'dejected')
explanation_mandarin: 「頽」常用以形容精神萎靡、消沉或事物衰敗、沒落。可見於詞語如「頽廢」、「頽喪」。
explanation_english: Used to describe a state of decline or decay, or a dispirited/listless mood. Appears in compounds such as '頽廢' (decadent) or '頽喪' (dejected).

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢最近好頽，冇心機做嘢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 zeoi3 gan6 hou2 teoi4, mou5 sam1 gei1 zou6 je5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他最近很頽（頹喪），沒心情做事。
examples.english_sentence: He's been very dispirited lately and has no motivation to work.

mandarin_meaning: 游手好閒、懶散或靠別人過活（俚語）
english_meaning: to loaf around; to be idle or freeload (slang)
explanation_mandarin: 形容人懶散、無所事事或不願工作，常含有靠別人或無所作為的負面意思。
explanation_english: Describes someone who loafs around, is idle or unwilling to work; often carries a negative sense of freeloading or being unproductive.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢而家失咗工，成日頽飯喺屋企，唔肯搵新工。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 ji4 gaa1 sat1 zo2 gung1, sing4 jat6 teoi4 faan6 hai2 uk1 kei2, m4 hang2 wan2 san1 gung1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他現在失業了，整天在家裡頹廢、遊手好閒，不肯找新工作。
examples.english_sentence: He's unemployed now and loafs around at home all day, refusing to look for a new job.

mandarin_meaning: 颗 (kē) — 量词，用于计数小而圆或独立的个体，如珠子、糖果、种子、牙齿、心脏、星星等。
english_meaning: kē — a measure word/classifier for small, typically round or discrete items (e.g. beads, candies, seeds), also used for teeth, hearts, stars, etc.
explanation_mandarin: 「顆」是中文的量词，用来計數小而圓或獨立的個體（如一顆糖、一顆珠子、一顆牙）。在粵語中讀作 fo1，可用於口語與書面語。在某些搭配中會優於或與「粒」「個」互換。
explanation_english: “顆” (jyutping: fo1) is a Chinese classifier used to count small, often round or discrete items (e.g. a candy, a bead, a tooth, a heart). In Cantonese it is pronounced fo1. It overlaps with classifiers like 'lap1' (粒) and 'go3' (個) but appears in specific collocations.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 阿媽俾咗我一顆糖。
examples.jyutping_sentence: aa3 maa1 bei2 zo2 ngo5 jat1 fo1 tong4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 媽媽給了我一顆糖。
examples.english_sentence: Mom gave me a piece of candy.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 醫生要拔走嗰顆壞牙。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ji1 sang1 jiu3 baat3 zau2 go2 fo1 waai6 ngaa4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 醫生需要拔掉那顆壞牙。
examples.english_sentence: The dentist needs to pull out that bad tooth.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢有一顆善良嘅心。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 jau5 jat1 fo1 sin6 loeng4 ge3 sam1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他有一顆善良的心。
examples.english_sentence: He has a kind heart.

mandarin_meaning: 颗粒 (kēlì)
english_meaning: granule; grain; pellet; granular
explanation_mandarin: 指小的粒状物或颗粒状的质地，可用来描述物质由许多小颗粒组成的状态。
explanation_english: Refers to small particles or granules; used to describe a granular texture or individual tiny grains.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢啲藥係顆粒狀，好易吞服。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 di1 joek6 hai6 fo1-lap1 zong6, hou2 ji6 tan1 fuk6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 這些藥是顆粒狀，很容易吞服。
examples.english_sentence: These medicines are in granule form and are easy to swallow.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 砂糖通常係細細顆粒，方便溶喺飲品入面。
examples.jyutping_sentence: saa1 tong4 tung1 soeng4 hai6 sai3 sai3 fo1-lap1, fong1 bin6 jung4 hei2 jam2 ban2 jap6 min6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 砂糖通常是細小的顆粒，方便溶在飲品裡面。
examples.english_sentence: Sugar is usually in fine granules, making it easy to dissolve in drinks.

mandarin_meaning: 题；题目、问题、标题
english_meaning: question; problem; topic; title
explanation_mandarin: 表示題目、問題或標題，也可作動詞表示為作品或物品命名、題詞等。常見於試題、文章標題等語境。
explanation_english: Refers to a question, problem, topic, or title. It can also be used as a verb meaning to inscribe or give a title. Commonly used for exam questions, article titles, etc.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢條題好難，我唔識做。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 tiu4 tai4 hou2 naan4, ngo5 m4 sik1 zou6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这道题很难，我不会做。
examples.english_sentence: This question is very difficult; I can't do it.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你幫我諗個題先啦，文章仲未有標題。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 bong1 ngo5 nam2 go3 tai4 sin1 laa1, man4 zoeng1 zung6 mei6 jau5 biu1 tai4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你先帮我想一个题目，文章还没有标题。
examples.english_sentence: Help me come up with a title first; the article doesn't have a title yet.

mandarin_meaning: 题型（tíxíng）：指考试或练习中题目的类型或形式，例如选择题、填空题、简答题等。
english_meaning: question type; the format or type of a test/exam question (e.g., multiple-choice, fill-in-the-blank, essay).
explanation_mandarin: 指在試卷或練習裡，題目的種類或形式，通常用來分類應如何作答或評分。
explanation_english: Refers to the category or format of questions in an exam or practice paper, used to classify how to answer or mark them.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢份練習卷有幾種題型：選擇題、填空題同簡答題。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 fan6 lin6 zaap6 gyun2 jau5 gei2 zung2 tai4 jing4: syun2 zaak6 tai4, tin4 hung1 tai4 tung4 gaan2 daap3 tai4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 這份練習卷有幾種題型：選擇題、填空題和簡答題。
examples.english_sentence: This practice paper has several question types: multiple-choice, fill-in-the-blank, and short-answer questions.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 做考試前要先了解各種題型嘅答題方法。
examples.jyutping_sentence: zou6 haau2 si3 cin4 jiu3 sin1 liu5 gaai2 gok3 zung2 tai4 jing4 ge3 daap3 tai4 fong1 faat3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 考試前要先了解各種題型的作答方法。
examples.english_sentence: Before taking the exam, you should first understand the answering methods for each question type.

mandarin_meaning: 題外話（tíwàihuà）——與主題無關的話，插話或順帶提及的內容
english_meaning: an off-topic remark; a comment that is beside the point; an aside (by the way)
explanation_mandarin: 指偏離或不屬於當前討論主題的話，常用來插入補充、轉移話題或順便提及與主題無直接關係的內容。
explanation_english: Refers to a remark that departs from the current topic; used as an aside, to add irrelevant information, or to change the subject.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 題外話，聽日你有冇時間出嚟飲嘢？
examples.jyutping_sentence: tai4 ngoi6 waa6, teng1 jat6 nei5 jau5 mou5 si4 gaan3 ceot1 lai4 jam2 je5?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 題外話，明天你有空出來喝一杯嗎？
examples.english_sentence: By the way, are you free to go out for a drink tomorrow?

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我唔想講題外話，但係佢個提議真係同我哋討論主題無關。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 m4 soeng2 gong2 tai4 ngoi6 waa6, daan6 hai6 keoi5 go3 tai4 ji5 zan1 hai6 tung4 ngo5 dei6 tou2 leon6 zyu2 tai4 mou4 gwaan1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我不想說題外話，但他的提議確實與我們討論的主題無關。
examples.english_sentence: I don't want to make an off-topic remark, but his proposal is indeed unrelated to the topic we're discussing.

mandarin_meaning: 題字 / 題詞（寫在書畫、匾額、紀念品等上的文字；也可作動詞，指為某物寫上題字或題詞）
english_meaning: inscription; to inscribe or write a dedicatory/title inscription on something (e.g., a painting, album, plaque)
explanation_mandarin: 指寫在書畫、匾額、相簿、紀念品等上的文字，常作為題名、祝福或紀念；也可作為動詞，表示替某物寫上這些文字。
explanation_english: Refers to words written on paintings, plaques, photo albums, or commemorative items—often a title, dedication, or blessing. Can be used as a noun (an inscription) or as a verb (to inscribe/write the inscription).

examples.cantonese_sentence: 可唔可以幫我喺相簿封面題字？
examples.jyutping_sentence: ho2 m4 ho2 ji5 bong1 ngo5 hai2 soeng1 bou2 fung1 min6 tai4 zi6?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你可以幫我在相簿封面題字嗎？
examples.english_sentence: Can you help write an inscription on the photo album cover for me?

examples.cantonese_sentence: 開幕嗰日，市長親自為新館題字。
examples.jyutping_sentence: hoi1 muk6 go2 jat6, si5 zoeng2 can1 zi6 wai6 san1 gun2 tai4 zi6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 開幕那天，市長親自為新館題字。
examples.english_sentence: On the opening day, the mayor personally inscribed the inscription for the new hall.

mandarin_meaning: 題材（主題、素材）
english_meaning: subject matter; theme; topic; material for creative work
explanation_mandarin: 題材指作品（如小說、電影、文章等）所取材的主題或內容，也可指某件事或話題作為創作或討論的素材。
explanation_english: Refers to the subject matter or theme of a work (e.g., novel, film, article); can also mean a topic or material used for creative or discussion purposes.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢本小說嘅題材好特別，講緊科技同人性嘅衝突。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 bun2 siu2 seot3 ge3 tai4 coi4 hou2 dak6 bit6, gong2 gan2 fo1 gei6 tung4 jan4 sing3 ge3 cung1 dat6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 這本小說的題材很特別，講述科技與人性的衝突。
examples.english_sentence: The subject matter of this novel is unusual; it deals with the conflict between technology and human nature.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 導演想搵一個更貼地嘅題材拍成電影。
examples.jyutping_sentence: dou6 jin2 soeng2 wan2 jat1 go3 gang3 tip3 dei6 ge3 tai4 coi4 paak3 seng4 din6 jing2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 導演想找一個更接地氣的題材拍成電影。
examples.english_sentence: The director wants to find a more down-to-earth subject to make into a film.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢篇報導冇新嘅題材，大部分係重複以前嘅資料。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 pin1 bou3 dou6 mou5 san1 ge3 tai4 coi4, daai6 bou6 fan6 hai6 cung4 fuk1 ji5 cin4 ge3 zi1 liu2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 這篇報導沒有新的題材，大部分是重複以前的資料。
examples.english_sentence: This report has no new material; most of it repeats earlier information.

mandarin_meaning: 题目
english_meaning: question; topic; title; problem
explanation_mandarin: 表示考試、練習或討論中的題目、問題或標題。可指考題、討論題或文章的標題或主題。
explanation_english: Refers to a question, problem, topic, or title used in exams, exercises, discussions, or written works. Can mean a test question, discussion topic, or the title/subject of a piece.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢條題目好難，我唔識做。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 tiu4 tai4 muk6 hou2 naan4, ngo5 m4 sik1 zou6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 這道題目很難，我不會做。
examples.english_sentence: This question is difficult; I don't know how to do it.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 老師話下星期考試會有幾條題目係關於歷史。
examples.jyutping_sentence: lou5 si1 waa6 haa6 sing1 kei4 haau2 si3 wui5 jau5 gei2 tiu4 tai4 muk6 hai6 gwaan1 jyu1 lik6 si2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 老師說下星期的考試會有幾道關於歷史的題目。
examples.english_sentence: The teacher said next week's exam will have several questions about history.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢篇論文嘅題目好有創意。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 pin1 leon6 man4 ge3 tai4 muk6 hou2 jau5 cong3 ji3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 這篇論文的題目很有創意。
examples.english_sentence: The title of this paper is very creative.

mandarin_meaning: 額；額頭；（數量的）額度、配額
english_meaning: forehead; quota/amount/limit (of something)
explanation_mandarin: 「額」可指人體的額頭位置，也可用於表示數量或金額上的限額、配額等。
explanation_english: “額” can mean the forehead on the human head, and it is also used to refer to a quota, limit, or allocated amount.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢額頭有汗。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 ngok6 tau4 jau5 hon4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他額頭有汗。
examples.english_sentence: He has sweat on his forehead.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 公司增加咗預算額度。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gung1 si1 zang1 gaa1 zo2 jyu6 syun3 ngok6 dou6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 公司增加了預算額度。
examples.english_sentence: The company increased the budget quota.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢次嘅開支係額外嘅開支。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 ci3 ge3 hoi1 zi1 hai6 ngok6 ngoi6 ge3 hoi1 zi1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 這次的開支是額外的開支。
examples.english_sentence: This expense is an extra/unexpected expense.

mandarin_meaning: 额外
english_meaning: extra; additional; supplementary
explanation_mandarin: 表示超出原有範圍或數量的，指附加的、額外的。
explanation_english: Indicates something beyond the original scope or quantity; extra, additional, or supplementary.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 公司會俾員工額外嘅加班費。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gung1 si1 wui5 bei2 jyun4 gung1 ngok6 ngoi6 ge3 gaa1 baan1 fai3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 公司会给员工额外的加班费。
examples.english_sentence: The company will give employees extra overtime pay.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢個服務可能需要額外收費。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 go3 fuk6 mou6 ho2 nang4 seoi1 jiu3 ngok6 ngoi6 sau1 fai3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这个服务可能需要额外收费。
examples.english_sentence: This service may require extra charges.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我額外準備咗一份禮物畀佢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 ngok6 ngoi6 zeon2 bei6 zo2 jat1 fan6 lai5 mat6 bei2 keoi5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我额外准备了一份礼物给他/她。
examples.english_sentence: I prepared an extra gift for him/her.

mandarin_meaning: 额度（如信用额度、数据额度、配额等）
english_meaning: limit or quota (e.g. credit limit, data allowance, allocation)
explanation_mandarin: 指在金融、數據或資源分配上的上限或可用量，表示可使用或分配的數額限制。
explanation_english: Refers to a limit or allocated amount for things like credit, data, or resource quotas; it denotes how much is available or allowed.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 銀行提高咗我嘅信用額度。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngan4 hong4 tai4 gou1 zo2 ngo5 ge3 seon3 jung6 ngok6 dou6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 银行提高了我的信用额度。
examples.english_sentence: The bank raised my credit limit.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你本月嘅數據額度仲有冇？
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 bun2 jyut6 ge3 sou3 gei3 ngok6 dou6 zung6 jau5 mou5?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你本月的数据额度还有吗？
examples.english_sentence: Do you still have any data allowance left this month?

examples.cantonese_sentence: 公司嘅採購額度好有限，唔可以買太多。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gung1 si1 ge3 coi2 gou3 ngok6 dou6 hou2 jau5 haan6, m4 ho2 ji5 maai5 taai3 do1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 公司的采购额度很有限，不能买太多。
examples.english_sentence: The company's purchasing quota is very limited, so we can't buy too much.

mandarin_meaning: 拍手稱慶、慶幸
english_meaning: to clap one's hands in celebration; to express relief or rejoice at a fortunate outcome
explanation_mandarin: 表示對某事感到慶幸或高興，像拍手慶賀一樣，多用於遇到幸運或避免災禍時的慶幸心情。
explanation_english: An idiom meaning to express joy or relief (literally 'raise one's hands to celebrate'), often used when a fortunate turn of events occurs or a disaster is averted.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 公司及時發現漏洞，避免咗大損失，大家都額手稱慶。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gung1 si1 kap6 si4 faat3 jin6 lau6 dung6, bei6 min5 zo2 daai6 syun2 sat1, daai6 gaa1 dou1 ngok6 sau2 cing1 hing3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 公司及時發現漏洞，避免了重大損失，大家都額手稱慶。
examples.english_sentence: The company discovered the loophole in time and avoided a huge loss; everyone was relieved and rejoiced.

mandarin_meaning: （名额）已满；满额
english_meaning: fully booked; no more spots (quota filled)
explanation_mandarin: 表示名额、报名或座位等已经没有剩余，无法再接受新的申请或预约。
explanation_english: Indicates that slots, seats, or quotas are filled and no more applications or reservations can be accepted.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 今次工作坊名額已經額滿，唔好再報名。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gam1 ci3 gung1 zok3 fong1 ming4 ngaak6 ji5 ging1 ngaak6 mun5 , m4 hou2 zoi3 bou3 ming4 .
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这次工作坊的名额已经额满，请不要再报名。
examples.english_sentence: The workshop is already fully booked; please do not register anymore.

mandarin_meaning: 不是一個常見詞彙，可能為音譯或拼寫錯誤（例如誤寫的「艾菲爾」相關音譯或虛構地名）
english_meaning: Not a standard Cantonese term; likely a mistransliteration or misspelling (possibly an attempt to transliterate 'Eiffel' or a fictional peak/place name)
partOfSpeech_mandarin: 名詞（可能為音譯或地名）
explanation_mandarin: 「額菲爾士峰」並非常見或正式的粵語詞彙。根據字符與讀音推測，可能是某人對外來地名（例如「艾菲爾」等）的音譯、拼寫錯誤或創作出的虛構山峰名稱。在正式語境或地圖上通常找不到這個名稱。
explanation_english: “額菲爾士峰” is not a commonly used or established Cantonese term. Based on the characters and pronunciation, it is likely a phonetic transliteration, a misspelling of an imported name (for example something like 'Eiffel'), or a fictional peak name. It does not appear in formal usage or official place-name lists.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 其實「額菲爾士峰」唔係正式地名，好可能係拼寫或者音譯錯誤。
examples.jyutping_sentence: kei4 sat6 「ngok6 fei1 ji5 si6 fung1」 m4 hai6 zing3 sik1 dei6 ming4, hou2 ho2 nang4 hai6 ping3 se2 waak6 ze2 jam1 jik6 co3 ng6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 其實“額菲爾士峰”不是正式地名，很可能是拼寫或者音譯錯誤。
examples.english_sentence: "額菲爾士峰" is not an official place name; it is likely a misspelling or mistransliteration.

synonyms: 艾菲爾峰（可能的音譯形式，非正式）

mandarin_meaning: 額角（頭部側面靠近太陽穴和額頭的部位）
english_meaning: temple (the side area of the forehead/head near the hairline and the temple)
explanation_mandarin: 指頭部額頭兩側、接近太陽穴和髮際的部位，是解剖和日常描述中常用來指出受傷或疼痛位置的詞語。
explanation_english: Refers to the temple or corner of the forehead—the area on the side of the head near the forehead, hairline, and the temple. Used anatomically and in everyday speech to indicate injuries or pain in that area.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 籃球打到佢額角，流咗啲血。
examples.jyutping_sentence: laam4 kau4 daa2 dou3 keoi5 ngok6 gok3, lau4 zo2 di1 hyut3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 籃球打到他的額角，流了些血。
examples.english_sentence: The basketball hit his temple and he bled a little.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 醫生建議喺額角敷冰袋，幫手消腫同止痛。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ji1 sang1 gin3 ji3 hai6 ngok6 gok3 fuk1 bing1 doi2, bong1 sau2 siu1 zung2 tung4 zi2 tung3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 醫生建議在額角敷冰袋，幫助消腫和止痛。
examples.english_sentence: The doctor recommended applying an ice pack to the temple to help reduce swelling and relieve pain.

mandarin_meaning: 额头 (é tóu)
english_meaning: forehead
explanation_mandarin: 指頭部前上方的部位，位於髮際線與眉毛之間。
explanation_english: The part of the head above the eyes and between the hairline and the eyebrows; the forehead.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我額頭撞親咗，好痛。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 ngok6 tau4 zong6 can1 zo2, hou2 tung3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我撞到了额头，很痛。
examples.english_sentence: I hit my forehead; it hurts a lot.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢額頭有汗，可能係好熱。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 ngok6 tau4 jau5 hon4, ho2 nang4 hai6 hou2 jit6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他额头有汗，可能很热。
examples.english_sentence: He has sweat on his forehead; he might be very hot.

mandarin_meaning: 下颌；颚（下巴附近的骨骼或部位）
english_meaning: jaw; mandible (the lower jaw or the area around the chin)
explanation_mandarin: 指口部的下颌或颚部，常用於描述下巴附近的骨骼、疼痛或外傷等情況。
explanation_english: Refers to the jaw (the lower jaw or mandible) or the area around the chin; commonly used when describing the jawbone, pain, or injuries in that area.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢個顎骨有啲問題，要去睇牙醫。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 go3 ngok3 gwat1 jau5 di1 man6 tai4, jiu3 heoi3 tai2 ngaa4 ji1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他的下颌骨有些問題，要去看牙醫。
examples.english_sentence: He has some problems with his jawbone and needs to see a dentist.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 個細路跌親，顎撞親，喊咗好耐。
examples.jyutping_sentence: go3 sai3 lou6 dit3 can1, ngok3 zong6 can1, haam3 zo2 hou2 noi6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 小孩跌倒，撞到下頜，哭了很久。
examples.english_sentence: The child fell, hit his jaw, and cried for a long time.

mandarin_meaning: 腭裂（先天性腭部裂隙，亦稱顎裂或腭裂畸形）
english_meaning: cleft palate (a congenital split or opening in the hard or soft palate)
explanation_mandarin: 指先天性上腭或軟腭發生裂隙的畸形（即腭裂），常伴隨進食、發音與耳部問題，需要醫療或手術治療。
explanation_english: Refers to a congenital fissure in the hard or soft palate (cleft palate). It can affect feeding, speech, and ear health and often requires medical or surgical treatment.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 嗰個嬰兒有顎裂，醫生話要盡快做修補手術。
examples.jyutping_sentence: go2 go3 jing1 ji4 jau5 ngok6 lit6, ji1 sang1 waa6 jiu3 zeon6 faai3 zou6 sau1 bou2 sau2 seot6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 那個嬰兒有顎裂，醫生說要盡快做修補手術。
examples.english_sentence: The infant has a cleft palate; the doctor said surgery to repair it should be done as soon as possible.

mandarin_meaning: 颚骨 / 下颌骨（指上下颌的骨骼）
english_meaning: jawbone (the bones of the jaw; includes upper and lower jaws)
explanation_mandarin: 顎骨指口腔前方的骨骼，通常包括上顎骨與下顎骨，是構成頜部的主要骨骼結構。
explanation_english: The jawbone refers to the bones forming the jaw area, typically including the upper (maxilla) and lower (mandible) jaw bones; they form the main bony structure of the jaw.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 醫生話佢顎骨斷咗，可能要做手術。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ji1 sang1 waa6 keoi5 ngok6 gwat1 dyun6 zo2, ho2 nang4 jiu3 zou6 sau2 seot6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 医生说他的颚骨断了，可能要做手术。
examples.english_sentence: The doctor said his jawbone is broken; he might need surgery.

mandarin_meaning: 面容；臉面；顏色
english_meaning: face; facial appearance; color
explanation_mandarin: 「顏」主要指面容或臉面，也常用於構成詞語表示顏色或外表吸引力（例如「顏色」、「顏值」）。
explanation_english: Refers to the face or facial appearance; also used in compounds to mean color or attractiveness (e.g., "顏色" for color, "顏值" for attractiveness).

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢好注重顏面，唔想俾人睇低佢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hou2 zyu3 zung6 ngaan4 min6, m4 soeng2 bei2 jan4 tai2 dai1 keoi5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他很注重顏面，不想讓人看低他。
examples.english_sentence: He cares a lot about his face/reputation and doesn't want people to look down on him.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢幅畫嘅顏色好靚。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 fuk1 waa6 ge3 ngaan4 sik1 hou2 leng3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 這幅畫的顏色很漂亮。
examples.english_sentence: The colors of this painting are beautiful.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢顏值高，好多人鍾意佢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 ngaan4 zik6 gou1, hou2 do1 jan4 zung1 ji3 keoi5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他的顏值很高，很多人喜歡他。
examples.english_sentence: He's good-looking; many people like him.

mandarin_meaning: 顏值／外貌值（評估一個人外表吸引力的俗稱）
english_meaning: face value; attractiveness score — a colloquial term for someone's physical attractiveness
explanation_mandarin: 網絡語，指用來衡量或描述一個人外貌吸引力的「分數」或價值，常用於口語或媒體討論外表。
explanation_english: An internet/slang term referring to a 'score' or value assessing someone's physical attractiveness; commonly used in casual speech and online discussions about looks.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢顏值好高，成日有好多人追住佢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 ngaan4 zik6 hou2 gou1, seng4 jat6 jau5 hou2 do1 jan4 zeoi1 zyu6 keoi5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他顏值很高，經常有很多人追他。
examples.english_sentence: He/She has a high face value and often has many people chasing after them.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 顏值唔係一切，但係可以加分。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngaan4 zik6 m4 hai6 jat1 cai3, daan6 hai6 ho2 ji5 gaa1 fan1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 顏值不是一切，但可以加分。
examples.english_sentence: Looks aren't everything, but they can add points.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 而家網上有啲網站會俾人打顏值分，好多人都會上去睇。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ji4 gaa1 mong5 seong6 jau5 di1 mong5 zaam6 wui5 bei2 jan4 daa2 ngaan4 zik6 fan1, hou2 do1 jan4 dou1 wui5 soeng5 heoi3 tai2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 現在網上有些網站會給人打顏值分，很多人都會去看。
examples.english_sentence: Nowadays some websites rate people's attractiveness, and a lot of people go to check.

mandarin_meaning: 颜射（面部射精）
english_meaning: Facial (ejaculation onto someone's face)
explanation_mandarin: 指在性行為或成人影片中將精液射在他人臉部的行為，屬於粗俗的性用語。
explanation_english: Refers to the act of ejaculating onto someone's face in sexual activity or adult films; a vulgar sexual slang term.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 喺啲成人片入面，顏射係一種常見嘅性行為。
examples.jyutping_sentence: hai2 di1 sing4 jan4 pin2 jap6 min6, ngaan4 se6 hai6 jat1 zung2 soeng4 gin3 ge3 sing3 hang4 wai4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 在一些成人电影中，颜射是一种常见的性行为。
examples.english_sentence: In some adult films, facial (ejaculation onto the face) is a common sexual act.

mandarin_meaning: 颜文字（用文字或符号组成的表情，亦称顔文字、kaomoji）
english_meaning: Text-based emoticons/kaomoji — facial expressions made from characters and symbols
explanation_mandarin: 指用文字、標點或符號組成的臉部表情符號（如 (^_^)、(╯︵╰,)），常在網絡聊天或社交媒體用來表達情緒。此類表情源自日本（稱為kaomoji/顔文字）。
explanation_english: Refers to facial expressions created from text, punctuation, and symbols (e.g. (^_^), (╯︵╰,)). Commonly used in online chats and social media to convey emotions. Originated in Japan as kaomoji (顔文字).

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我好鍾意用顏文字，嚟表達唔同嘅情緒。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 hou2 zung1 ji3 jung6 ngaan4 man4 zi6, lai4 biu2 daat6 m4 tung4 ge3 cing4 seoi3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我很喜欢用颜文字来表达不同的情绪。
examples.english_sentence: I like using emoticons (kaomoji) to express different emotions.

mandarin_meaning: 顏料（yán liào）：用於著色的物質，如繪畫、印刷或塗料中使用的顏色材料。
english_meaning: pigment; paint; coloring material used to give color in painting, printing, or coatings.
explanation_mandarin: 顏料是用來給物體或材料添加顏色的物質，常見於繪畫、塗裝、印刷等用途，形式有粉末、液體或膏狀。
explanation_english: A substance used to impart color to materials; commonly used in painting, coatings, and printing. Pigments can be in powder, liquid, or paste form.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我買咗啲新顏料，想畫幅畫。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 maai5 zo2 di1 san1 ngaan4 liu6, soeng2 waa6 fuk1 waa6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我買了一些新的顏料，想畫一幅畫。
examples.english_sentence: I bought some new pigments and want to paint a picture.

mandarin_meaning: 颜面尽失；丢脸；受辱
english_meaning: to lose face; to be humiliated or publicly embarrassed
explanation_mandarin: 粤语俚语，字面意思“脸碎”，用来形容颜面受损、丢脸、被当众揭穿或羞辱，常用于口语场景。
explanation_english: Cantonese slang literally meaning "face shattered." It describes losing face, being humiliated, exposed, or embarrassed—used informally.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢喺會上被老細當住責罵，當場顏碎晒。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hai2 wui6 soeng5 bei6 lou5 sai3 dong3 zyu6 zaak3 maa6, dong1 coeng4 ngaan4 seoi3 saai3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他在会议上被老板当众责骂，当场丢脸了。
examples.english_sentence: He was scolded by his boss at the meeting and was publicly humiliated.

mandarin_meaning: 颜色；脸色、表情或态度
english_meaning: color; (someone's) complexion, facial expression, or attitude
explanation_mandarin: 可指物件的顏色，也常用來指人的臉色或表情、態度（例如“睇人顏色行事”）。
explanation_english: Can refer to the color of an object, and is also commonly used to refer to a person's complexion, facial expression, or attitude (e.g., 'act based on someone's mood').

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢幅畫嘅顏色好鮮艷。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 fuk1 waa6 ge3 ngaan4 sik1 hou2 sin1 jim6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这幅画的颜色很鲜艳。
examples.english_sentence: The colors of this painting are very bright.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你唔好睇人顏色行事，咁樣唔公平。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 m4 hou2 tai2 jan4 ngaan4 sik1 hang4 si6, gam2 joeng6 m4 gung1 ping4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你不要看人脸色办事，这样不公平。
examples.english_sentence: Don't make decisions based on someone's mood; it's not fair.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢見到個訊息之後，顏色變得好差。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 gin3 dou3 go3 seon3 sik1 zi1 hau6, ngaan4 sik1 bin3 dak1 hou2 caa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他看到那条消息后，脸色变得很糟。
examples.english_sentence: After he saw the message, his complexion got really bad.

mandarin_meaning: 色情內容；猥褻的圖片或訊息（俚語）
english_meaning: Erotic/pornographic content; lewd pictures or messages (slang)
partOfSpeech_mandarin: 口語/俚語，名詞（亦可作動詞使用）
explanation_mandarin: 香港粵語俚語，用來指帶有性暗示或猥褻性的訊息、圖片或騷擾行為。語氣非正式，帶有貶義或不雅意味，常用於抱怨收到性騷擾內容。
explanation_english: Hong Kong Cantonese slang referring to sexually suggestive or pornographic messages/images or sexual advances. Informal and somewhat vulgar; often used to complain about receiving sexual/harassing content.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢成日send啲顏色波畀我，令我好唔舒服。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 sing4 jat6 send3 di1 ngaan4 sik1 bo1 bei2 ngo5, ling6 ngo5 hou2 m4 syu1 fuk6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他老是傳送些色情內容給我，讓我很不舒服。
examples.english_sentence: He keeps sending me sexual pictures/messages, which makes me very uncomfortable.

mandarin_meaning: 彩色笔
english_meaning: colored pens / colored markers
explanation_mandarin: 指用來塗色或畫畫的彩色筆，常見於文具與美術用品，可指水性或油性彩色筆。
