mandarin_meaning: 喝醉了
english_meaning: to be very drunk / to have gotten wasted
explanation_mandarin: 口語廣東話表達，表示喝酒喝得很多而醉了，常用於描述人醉酒的狀態。
explanation_english: Colloquial Cantonese expression meaning someone has drunk a lot and become intoxicated.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢尋晚飲大咗，今日仲未醒返。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 cam4 maan5 jam2 daai6 zo2, gam1 jat6 zung6 mei6 seng2 faan1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他昨晚喝醉了，今天還沒清醒。
examples.english_sentence: He got very drunk last night and hasn't sobered up today.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我唔想去酒吧，好驚會飲大咗。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 m4 soeng2 heoi3 zau2 baa1, hou2 geng1 wui6 jam2 daai6 zo2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我不想去酒吧，怕會喝醉。
examples.english_sentence: I don't want to go to the bar; I'm afraid I'll get drunk.

mandarin_meaning: 喝奶 / 吃奶（包括母乳喂养或喝奶制品）
english_meaning: to drink milk; to breastfeed (for infants) or consume milk/formula
explanation_mandarin: “飲奶”字面意思是喝奶。可以指嬰兒吃奶（包括母乳喂養）或成年人喝牛奶、奶粉等奶製品。語境上多用於描述嬰兒餵養或飲用奶類飲品。
explanation_english: Literally 'drink milk'. It can refer to an infant breastfeeding or drinking formula, and also to drinking milk or milk-based beverages. Commonly used when describing infant feeding or consuming milk products.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 嬰兒每日要飲奶幾次。
examples.jyutping_sentence: jing1 ji4 mui5 jat6 jiu3 jam2 naai5 gei2 ci3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 婴儿每天要喝奶好几次。
examples.english_sentence: Babies need to drink milk several times a day.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 媽媽話想親自餵阿B飲人奶。
examples.jyutping_sentence: maa4 maa1 waa6 soeng2 can1 zi6 wai3 aa3 bi1 jam2 jan4 naai5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 妈妈说想亲自喂宝宝吃奶（母乳喂养）。
examples.english_sentence: The mother said she wants to feed the baby herself (breastfeed).

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我唔鐘意飲牛奶，但會飲豆漿。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 m4 zung1 ji3 jam2 ngau4 naai5, daan6 wui5 jam2 dau6 zoeng1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我不喜欢喝牛奶，但会喝豆浆。
examples.english_sentence: I don't like milk, but I will drink soy milk.

mandarin_meaning: 宴会；参加宴会/宴席
english_meaning: banquet; feast; to attend a banquet
partOfSpeech_english: noun (can also be used as a verb/verb phrase)
explanation_mandarin: 指有酒水和食物的宴席或參加此類宴席，常見於婚宴、公司宴會、親友聚餐等場合。
explanation_english: Refers to a banquet or feast with food and drinks, or the act of attending such an event. Commonly used for weddings, company dinners, and social gatherings.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 今晚公司有個飲宴，你會唔會去？
examples.jyutping_sentence: gam1 maan5 gung1 si1 jau5 go3 jam2 jin6, nei5 wui5 m4 wui5 heoi3?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 今晚公司有个宴会，你会不会去？
examples.english_sentence: There's a company banquet tonight — will you go?

mandarin_meaning: 中彈；被槍擊（俚語）
english_meaning: to get shot; to be shot/killed by gunfire (slang); figuratively, to take the fall or suffer consequences for someone else
explanation_mandarin: 原指被子彈擊中（可能受傷或死亡），為香港粵語俚語；也可引申為替人承擔責任或受牽連。
explanation_english: Originally means being hit by a bullet (wounded or killed); a Hong Kong Cantonese slang term. It can also be used figuratively to mean taking the blame or suffering consequences on behalf of someone else.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 新聞話有個男人喺街上俾人伏住飲彈喇。
examples.jyutping_sentence: san1 man4 waa6 jau5 go3 naam4 jan4 hai2 gaai1 soeng6 bei2 jan4 fuk6 zyu6 jam2 daan6 laa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 新闻说有个男人在街上被人伏击中弹了。
examples.english_sentence: The news reported that a man was ambushed on the street and got shot.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 公司出事，老細想搵人頂罪，但冇人肯飲彈。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gung1 si1 ceot1 si6, lou5 sai3 soeng2 wan2 jan4 deng2 zeoi6, daan6 mou5 jan4 hang2 jam2 daan6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 公司出了事，老板想找人顶罪，但没人愿意替他承担责任。
examples.english_sentence: The company got into trouble; the boss wanted to find someone to take the blame, but no one was willing to take the fall.

mandarin_meaning: 能喝 / 喝得下（表示喝的能力或承受量）
english_meaning: can drink / able to drink (indicating ability or capacity to drink, especially alcohol or swallow)
partOfSpeech_mandarin: 動詞片語（表示能力的能願/補語結構）
explanation_mandarin: 「飲得」由動詞「飲」加上能力補語「得（dak1）」構成，用來表示能否或能夠喝、吞下或承受酒量／飲料量。常與其他補語連用，如「飲得落」「飲得多」，否定形式為「飲唔得」。
explanation_english: "飲得" is formed by the verb 飲 (to drink) plus the potential/complement 得 (dak1). It expresses ability or capacity to drink or to swallow (e.g., alcohol tolerance or whether one can finish/swallow something). It often combines with other complements (e.g. 飲得落, 飲得多) and negates as 飲唔得.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢飲得多，酒量好勁。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 jam2 dak1 do1, zau2 loeng6 hou2 ging6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他喝得很多，酒量很厲害。
examples.english_sentence: He drinks a lot; he has a high alcohol tolerance.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢個藥好苦，我飲唔得落。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 go3 joek6 hou2 fu2, ngo5 jam2 m4 dak1 lok6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 這藥太苦，我吞不下去。
examples.english_sentence: This medicine is too bitter; I can't swallow it.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 如果你飲得，我哋今晚去酒吧飲幾杯。
examples.jyutping_sentence: jyu4 gwo2 nei5 jam2 dak1, ngo5 dei6 gam1 maan5 heoi3 zau2 baa1 jam2 gei2 bui1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 如果你能喝，我們今晚去酒吧喝幾杯。
examples.english_sentence: If you can drink, we'll go to the bar tonight for a few drinks.

mandarin_meaning: 能喝酒／酒量好
english_meaning: to be able to hold one's liquor; have a high tolerance for alcohol
explanation_mandarin: 口語廣東話說法，表示一個人酒量好、能喝很多酒而不容易醉，也可指能一口喝下或喝得下整杯飲品的能力（視語境而定）。
explanation_english: A colloquial Cantonese expression meaning someone has a strong tolerance for alcohol (can drink a lot without getting drunk). Depending on context it can also mean someone can finish a cup in one go or can swallow a drink easily.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢飲得杯落，唔易醉。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 jam2 dak1 bui1 lok6, m4 ji6 zeoi3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他酒量很好，不容易醉。
examples.english_sentence: He can drink a lot and doesn't get drunk easily.

mandarin_meaning: 含恨；抱憾（因失敗、無法如願或無法報仇而心裡不甘、懷恨）
english_meaning: to swallow one's resentment; to be left with regret; (literary) to die with regret/hatred
explanation_mandarin: 表示因為失敗、未能如願或未能報仇而心中懷恨、抱憾；在文語中也可指“含恨而終”。常用於口語和成語式表達。
explanation_english: Indicates feeling resentment or lingering regret after failure or being unable to achieve revenge; literally 'to drink hatred'. In literary use it can mean 'to die with resentment.' Used as a verb phrase.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 今次佢最後輸咗，真係飲恨。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gam1 ci3 keoi5 zeoi3 hau6 syu1 zo2, zan1 hai6 jam2 han6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这次他最后输了，只能含恨而归。
examples.english_sentence: He lost in the end this time and had to swallow his resentment.

mandarin_meaning: 喝闷酒；借酒消愁
english_meaning: to drink alcohol out of boredom or melancholy; to drown one's sorrows
explanation_mandarin: 指因悶、煩惱或傷心而獨自喝酒，通常含有鬱悶、消愁或撒嬌耍脾氣的意味。
explanation_english: To drink alone out of boredom, sadness, or to drown one's sorrows; often implies moping or sulking while drinking.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢成日一個人喺屋企飲悶酒，唔想同人傾偈。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 sing4 jat6 jat1 go3 jan4 hai2 uk1 kei5 jam2 mun6 zau2, m4 soeng2 tung4 jan4 king1 gai2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他经常一个人在家喝闷酒，不想和别人聊天。
examples.english_sentence: He often drinks alone at home out of boredom/sadness and doesn't want to talk to others.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 分手之後，佢成個月都係飲悶酒。
examples.jyutping_sentence: fan1 sau2 zi1 hau6, keoi5 sing4 go3 jyut6 dou1 hai6 jam2 mun6 zau2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 分手之后，他整个月都在喝闷酒。
examples.english_sentence: After the breakup, he spent a whole month drinking to drown his sorrows.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好成日叫佢唔好飲悶酒，試下陪佢傾下偈。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 sing4 jat6 giu3 keoi5 m4 hou2 jam2 mun6 zau2, si3 haa5 pui4 keoi5 king1 haa5 gai2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 别总是叫他不要喝闷酒，试着陪他聊聊。
examples.english_sentence: Don't always tell him not to drink to drown his sorrows; try keeping him company and talking.

mandarin_meaning: 饮料 (供饮用的液体)
english_meaning: beverage; drink (a liquid intended for consumption, e.g., water, juice, soda, tea)
explanation_mandarin: 指供人饮用的各种液体，如果汁、汽水、茶、咖啡等。
explanation_english: Refers to liquids intended for drinking, such as water, juice, soda, tea, coffee, etc.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 天氣咁熱，買杯凍飲料啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: tin1 hei3 gam2 jit6, maai5 bui1 dung3 jam2 liu6 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 天氣這麼熱，買杯冰飲料吧。
examples.english_sentence: It's so hot, buy a cold drink.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 超市裏面有好多唔同種類嘅飲料。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ciu1 si5 leoi5 min6 jau5 hou2 do1 m4 tung4 zung2 leoi6 ge3 jam2 liu6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 超市裡面有很多不同種類的飲料。
examples.english_sentence: There are many different kinds of beverages in the supermarket.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢款飲料冇糖，啱減肥嘅人飲。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 fun2 jam2 liu6 mou5 tong4, aam1 gaam2 fei4 ge3 jan4 jam2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 這款飲料不含糖，適合減肥的人喝。
examples.english_sentence: This drink has no sugar, suitable for people who are dieting.

mandarin_meaning: 喝早茶 / 吃点心
english_meaning: to go for morning tea (yum cha); to eat dim sum
explanation_mandarin: 「飲早茶」是粵語常用的動詞短語，指到茶樓或酒樓喝早茶、吃點心（即飲茶、吃廣式點心），常作為朋友或家庭的社交聚會活動，尤其在週末或早上。
explanation_english: “飲早茶” (jam2 zou2 caa4) is a Cantonese verb phrase meaning to go for morning tea or yum cha — i.e., to eat dim sum and drink tea. It commonly refers to a social meal at a teahouse or restaurant, often with family or friends, especially on weekends.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 星期日我哋約埋朋友去飲早茶。
examples.jyutping_sentence: sing1 kei4 jat6 ngo5 dei6 joek3 maai4 pang4 jau5 heoi3 jam2 zou2 caa4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 星期天我们约了朋友去喝早茶／吃点心。
examples.english_sentence: On Sunday we arranged to go for morning tea with friends.

mandarin_meaning: 喝一杯；喝酒；碰杯（常用於邀請喝酒或表示一起喝酒、乾杯）
english_meaning: to have a drink (usually alcoholic); to go for a drink; to clink glasses/to toast
explanation_mandarin: 「飲杯」是廣東話的口語說法，常用於邀請他人一起喝酒或表示去喝一杯，亦可指碰杯、乾杯。多在非正式社交場合使用，常見於香港用語。
explanation_english: “飲杯” (jam2 bui1) is a Cantonese colloquial expression meaning to have a drink (usually alcoholic), to go for a drink, or to clink glasses/to toast. It's commonly used in informal social contexts, especially in Hong Kong.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 今晚去飲杯啦！
examples.jyutping_sentence: gam1 maan5 heoi3 jam2 bui1 laa1!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 今晚去喝一杯吧！
examples.english_sentence: Let's go for a drink tonight!

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋食咗飯先去飲杯。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 sik6 zo2 faan6 sin1 heoi3 jam2 bui1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我們吃完飯再去喝一杯。
examples.english_sentence: We'll eat first, then go for a drink.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 客戶請我哋飲杯，傾下合作嘅事。
examples.jyutping_sentence: haak3 wu6 cing2 ngo5 dei6 jam2 bui1, king1 haa5 hap6 zok3 ge3 si6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 客戶請我們喝一杯，談談合作的事。
examples.english_sentence: The client treated us to a drink to discuss the collaboration.

mandarin_meaning: 喝橙汁
english_meaning: drink orange juice
explanation_mandarin: 字面意思是喝橙汁，通常用於日常飲食或點飲品的情境，表示喝某種果汁的動作。
explanation_english: Literally 'drink orange juice'; a verb phrase used in everyday contexts to indicate consuming orange juice or choosing it as a beverage.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 朝早我會飲橙汁，唔飲咖啡。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ziu1 zou2 ngo5 wui5 jam2 caang4 zap1, m4 jam2 gaa3 fe1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 早上我會喝橙汁，不喝咖啡。
examples.english_sentence: In the morning I drink orange juice, not coffee.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你想飲橙汁定汽水？
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 soeng2 jam2 caang4 zap1 ding6 hei3 seoi2?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你想喝橙汁還是汽水？
examples.english_sentence: Do you want orange juice or soda?

mandarin_meaning: 去唱K/去卡拉OK唱歌並喝酒
english_meaning: to go sing karaoke (KTV) while drinking; to go drinking and singing
explanation_mandarin: 「飲歌」是香港粵語俚語，字面是「喝酒唱歌」，通常指與朋友到卡拉OK/唱K場地一邊唱歌一邊飲酒消遣。
explanation_english: A Hong Kong Cantonese slang phrase literally meaning "drink and sing." It usually refers to going to karaoke (KTV) with friends to sing while drinking alcohol.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋今晚去飲歌啦！
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 gam1 maan5 heoi3 jam2 go1 laa1!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们今晚去唱K喝酒吧！
examples.english_sentence: Let's go to karaoke and drink tonight!

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢成日鍾意同朋友去飲歌。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 sing4 jat6 zung1 ji3 tung4 pang4 jau5 heoi3 jam2 go1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他/她经常喜欢和朋友去唱K喝酒。
examples.english_sentence: He/She often likes to go to karaoke and drink with friends.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 今晚唔想去酒吧，想去飲歌唱吓歌。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gam1 maan5 m4 soeng2 heoi3 zau2 baa1, soeng2 heoi3 jam2 go1 coeng3 haa5 go1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 今晚不想去酒吧，想去唱K唱幾首歌。
examples.english_sentence: I don't want to go to a bar tonight; I want to go to karaoke and sing a few songs.

mandarin_meaning: 在項目或交易結束時捞取最後一筆好處或尾款（帶貶義，常指貪污、回扣或私吞最後的利益）
english_meaning: to pocket the last bit of profit/kickback at the end of a project or transaction (pejorative; often implies skimming, bribery, or taking the final cut)
explanation_mandarin: 廣東話俚語，通常用來形容在工程、交易或活動接近尾聲時，某些人趁機拿走最後的利益、回扣或尾款。
explanation_english: A Cantonese slang verb describing the act of taking the remaining benefits, kickbacks, or final payment at the end of a job, project, or transaction—often with negative connotations of skimming or corruption.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 工程快做完，啲人喺度等住飲水尾。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gung1 cing4 faai3 zou6 jyun4, di1 jan4 hai2 dou6 dang2 zyu6 jam2 seoi2 mei5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 工程快要完成了，有些人在等着捞最後一筆好處（捞尾款）。
examples.english_sentence: The project is almost finished, and some people are waiting to pocket the leftover money.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 老細話要小心，唔好畀人飲水尾。
examples.jyutping_sentence: lou5 sai3 waa6 jiu3 siu2 sam1, m4 hou2 bei2 jan4 jam2 seoi2 mei5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 老闆說要小心，不要讓別人把最後的利益捞走。
examples.english_sentence: The boss said be careful; don't let others skim off the final profits.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢成日飲水尾，大家都唔信佢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 sing4 jat6 jam2 seoi2 mei5, daai6 gaa1 dou1 m4 seon3 keoi5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他經常捞尾款，大家都不信任他。
examples.english_sentence: He always pockets the last cut, so nobody trusts him.

mandarin_meaning: 饮水思源 (yǐn shuǐ sī yuán) — 饮水要想到水的来源，比喻不忘本、感恩回报。
english_meaning: Literally 'when drinking water, think of its source' — an idiom meaning to remember one's origins and be grateful to those who helped you.
explanation_mandarin: 成语，字面意思是喝水时想着水的来源。比喻不忘本，怀有感恩之心，对帮助过自己的人心存感激。
explanation_english: An idiom literally meaning 'when drinking water, think of its source.' It advises one to remember one's roots and to be grateful to those who have helped.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋要飲水思源，唔好忘記幫過我哋嘅人。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 jiu3 jam2 seoi2 si1 jyun4, m4 hou2 mong4 gei3 bong1 gwo3 ngo5 dei6 ge3 jan4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们要饮水思源，不要忘记帮助过我们的人。
examples.english_sentence: We should remember where our blessings come from and not forget the people who have helped us.

mandarin_meaning: 饮水机（供應飲用水的機器）
english_meaning: water dispenser; water cooler
explanation_mandarin: 指用來供應飲用水的設備，常見於公司、學校或公眾場所，可提供冷水或熱水/溫水。
explanation_english: A device that dispenses drinking water, commonly found in offices, schools, and public places; can provide cold and/or hot water.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 公司樓下有部新嘅飲水機，大家可以拎杯水飲。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gung1 si1 lau4 haa6 jau5 bou6 san1 ge3 jam2 seoi2 gei1, daai6 gaa1 ho2 ji5 ling1 bui1 seoi2 jam2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 公司楼下有一台新的饮水机，大家可以去倒杯水喝。
examples.english_sentence: There's a new water dispenser downstairs at the company; everyone can get a cup of water.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 學校啲飲水機壞咗，要通知管理處整返。
examples.jyutping_sentence: hok6 haau6 di1 jam2 seoi2 gei1 waai6 zo2, jiu3 tung1 zi1 gun2 lei5 cyu3 zing2 faan1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 学校的饮水机坏了，要通知管理处修理。
examples.english_sentence: The school's water dispenser is broken; we need to inform administration to have it fixed.

mandarin_meaning: 默默地哭泣；含泪或抑制住哭声
english_meaning: to cry quietly; to sob silently or suppress one's sobs
explanation_mandarin: “飲泣”指默默地或抑制着哭泣，不大出声，常用于描述悲伤但不想引人注意的哭泣方式。可见于书面或口语表达。
explanation_english: “飲泣” describes crying quietly or suppressing sobs—crying with little or no sound, often to avoid attracting attention. Used in both written and spoken Cantonese.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢喺角落度飲泣，無人留意佢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hai2 gok3 lok3 dou6 jam2 kap1 , mou5 jan4 lau4 ji3 keoi5 .
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他在角落里默默地哭泣，沒有人注意他。
examples.english_sentence: He was quietly crying in the corner; no one noticed him.

mandarin_meaning: 喝湯
english_meaning: to drink soup; to have soup
explanation_mandarin: 字面意思是喝湯。在粤语中通常用作动词短语，表示吃/喝汤类食物。這不是一個特別的成語或俚語，而是日常用語。
explanation_english: Literally "drink soup." In Cantonese it is a common verb phrase meaning to have or drink soup. It is everyday usage rather than a fixed idiom or slang.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 今晚我哋去飲湯啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gam1 maan5 ngo5 dei6 heoi3 jam2 tong1 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 今晚我们去喝汤吧。
examples.english_sentence: Let's go have soup tonight.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 啲湯好熱，慢慢飲。
examples.jyutping_sentence: di1 tong1 hou2 jit6, maan6 maan6 jam2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 汤很热，慢慢喝。
examples.english_sentence: The soup is hot, drink it slowly.

mandarin_meaning: 饮用（用于喝或表示可供饮用的）
english_meaning: to drink; to consume as a beverage; potable (suitable for drinking)
explanation_mandarin: 表示用于喝的用途或表示可供饮用（如“饮用水”）。也可指摄入、吞服（若指禁忌则表示不要饮用）。
explanation_english: Indicates use for drinking or that something is suitable for drinking (potable). Can be used as a verb ('to drink/ingest') or as an adjective ('drinkable').

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢啲藥係外用嘅，唔可以飲用。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 di1 joek6 hai6 ngoi6 jung6 ge3, m4 ho2 ji5 jam2 jung6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这些药是外用的，不能饮用。
examples.english_sentence: These medicines are for external use; they must not be taken orally.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 政府話呢個水源係可以飲用嘅，一般唔使煮沸。
examples.jyutping_sentence: zing3 fu2 waa6 ni1 go3 seoi2 jyun4 hai6 ho2 ji5 jam2 jung6 ge3, jat1 baan1 m4 sai2 zyu2 faau3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 政府说这个水源是可以饮用的，一般不用煮沸。
examples.english_sentence: The government says this water source is potable; generally it doesn't need to be boiled.

mandarin_meaning: （口語/物件）飲用的管子；吸管
english_meaning: drinking tube; straw
explanation_mandarin: 指用來喝液體的管狀物，日常可指一次性塑膠吸管或其他飲用管。有時與「飲管」「吸管」通用。
explanation_english: Refers to a tubular object used for drinking liquids—commonly a disposable plastic straw or other drinking tube. Often used interchangeably with '吸管' or 'drinking straw'.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 一次性飲筒唔好亂擲，要放喺垃圾桶入面。
examples.jyutping_sentence: jat1 ci3 sing3 jam2 tung4 m4 hou2 lyun6 zaak6, jiu3 fong3 hai2 laap6 saap3 tung4 jap6 min6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 一次性吸管不要乱扔，要放在垃圾桶里。
examples.english_sentence: Don't throw away disposable straws carelessly; put them in the trash bin.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢杯奶茶冇飲筒，要用杯口飲。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 bui1 naai5 caa4 mou5 jam2 tung4, jiu3 jung6 bui1 hau2 jam2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这杯奶茶没有吸管，要直接用杯口喝。
examples.english_sentence: This milk tea doesn't have a straw—you'll have to drink from the cup.

mandarin_meaning: 吸管
english_meaning: drinking straw
explanation_mandarin: 指用來吸取飲料的細長管子，常見材質有塑膠、紙或金屬等。
explanation_english: A thin tube used to sip beverages; commonly made of plastic, paper, or metal.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你要唔要飲管？
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 jiu3 m4 jiu3 jam2 gun2?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你要不要吸管？
examples.english_sentence: Do you want a straw?

mandarin_meaning: 喝早茶／去喝茶吃點心（廣東話習俗）
english_meaning: to go for yum cha (drink tea and eat dim sum)
explanation_mandarin: 「飲茶」為廣東話用語，字面是喝茶，實際上常指到茶樓喝茶、點心（點心時段通常為早午時段）的社交用餐習慣與活動。
explanation_english: Literally 'drink tea' in Cantonese; commonly refers to the practice of going to a tea house for tea and dim sum (yum cha), a social meal and cultural routine in Cantonese-speaking communities.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 今朝去飲茶，食咗好多點心。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gam1 ziu1 heoi3 jam2 caa4, sik6 zo2 hou2 do1 dim2 sam1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 今天去喝早茶，吃了很多點心。
examples.english_sentence: We went for yum cha this morning and ate a lot of dim sum.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋星期日約咗去飲茶。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 sing1 kei4 jat6 joek3 zo2 heoi3 jam2 caa4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我們星期天約好去喝早茶。
examples.english_sentence: We planned to go for yum cha on Sunday.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 香港人好鍾意週末去飲茶，當成社交活動。
examples.jyutping_sentence: hoeng1 gong2 jan4 hou2 zung1 ji3 zau1 mut6 heoi3 jam2 caa4, dong3 sing4 se5 gaau1 wut6 dung6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 香港人很喜歡在週末去喝早茶，當作社交活動。
examples.english_sentence: Hongkongers like to go for yum cha on weekends as a social activity.

mandarin_meaning: 喝茶闲聊 / 在网上发无关紧要的灌水帖子
english_meaning: to chat idly (literally 'drink tea and flood with posts') — to shoot the breeze or post filler/chatty content online
explanation_mandarin: 俚语，字面为“喝茶＋灌水”，常指朋友聚在一起喝茶闲聊，或在网上发表无关紧要、刷存在感的帖子以打发时间。
explanation_english: A slang phrase literally combining 'drink tea' and 'flood with posts'. It refers to social idle chat over dim sum or to posting casual/filler content online — i.e., shooting the breeze.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋今晚約埋一齊去飲茶灌水，冇咩目的就係吹下水。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 gam1 maan5 joek3 maai4 jat1 cai4 heoi3 jam2 caa4 gun3 seoi2, mou5 me1 muk6 dik1 zau6 hai6 ceoi1 haa5 seoi2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们今晚约在一起去喝茶闲聊，没什么目的就是随便聊天。
examples.english_sentence: We're meeting tonight to have dim sum and chat idly — no particular purpose, just to shoot the breeze.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 上次佢喺討論區發咗一大堆飲茶灌水嘅帖，搞到大家都睇唔下去。
examples.jyutping_sentence: soeng6 ci3 keoi5 hai2 tou2 leon6 keoi1 faat3 zo2 jat1 daai6 deoi1 jam2 caa4 gun3 seoi2 ge3 tip3, gaau2 dou3 daai6 gaa1 dou1 tai2 m4 haa6 heoi3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 上次他在讨论区发了很多无聊灌水的帖子，搞得大家都看不下去。
examples.english_sentence: Last time he posted a bunch of filler/chatty posts in the forum, and everyone couldn't be bothered to read them.

mandarin_meaning: 喝姜酒（多用于坐月子等傳統補身習俗）
english_meaning: to drink ginger wine (often in the postpartum confinement tradition)
explanation_mandarin: 「飲薑酒」指飲用由薑和酒釀製的飲品，華人傳統中常在坐月子或感覺受寒時飲用，認為可暖身、活血、補氣。現代亦有無酒精或薑茶的替代品，餵哺母乳者需注意酒精攝入。
explanation_english: “飲薑酒” literally means to drink ginger wine. In Chinese tradition it is commonly consumed during postpartum confinement (zuo yue) or when one feels cold, believed to warm the body and help circulation. Nowadays alcohol-free ginger tea is often used as an alternative; breastfeeding mothers should be cautious about alcohol intake.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 阿媽坐月嗰陣要飲薑酒，話可以暖身同補氣。
examples.jyutping_sentence: aa3 maa1 co5 jyut6 go2 zan6 jiu3 jam2 goeng1 zau2, waa6 ho2 ji5 nyun5 san1 tung4 bou2 hei3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 妈妈坐月子的时候要喝姜酒，说可以暖身和补气。
examples.english_sentence: When mum was in postpartum confinement she had to drink ginger wine; they say it warms the body and replenishes qi.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 依家有啲人驚酒精，就飲無酒精嘅薑茶代替飲薑酒。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ji1 gaa1 jau5 di1 jan4 geng1 zau2 zing1, zau6 jam2 mou4 zau2 zing1 ge3 goeng1 caa4 doi6 tai3 jam2 goeng1 zau2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 现在有些人怕酒精，就喝无酒精的姜茶来代替喝姜酒。
examples.english_sentence: Nowadays some people avoid alcohol, so they drink alcohol-free ginger tea instead of ginger wine.

mandarin_meaning: （衣服）吸水／被弄濕
english_meaning: clothes get soaked / absorb water or sweat
explanation_mandarin: 口語用法，指衣服被雨水、汗水或其他液體浸濕或吸收了水分（相當於「衣服濕了/吸水」）。
explanation_english: Colloquial Cantonese expression meaning that clothing has become wet or has absorbed liquid (e.g., rain or sweat).

examples.cantonese_sentence: 啱啱出去俾雨淋，件衫飲晒水。
examples.jyutping_sentence: aam1 aam1 ceot1 heoi3 bei2 jyu5 lam4, gin6 saam1 jam2 saai3 seoi2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 剛剛出去被雨淋，衣服全都濕透了。
examples.english_sentence: I just went out and got rained on; my clothes are completely soaked.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 夏天做運動會出汗，件衫都飲咗汗。
examples.jyutping_sentence: haa6 tin1 zou6 wan6 dung6 wui5 ceot1 hon4, gin6 saam1 dou1 jam2 zo2 hon4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 夏天運動會出汗，衣服都被汗水浸濕了。
examples.english_sentence: In summer when exercising you sweat and your clothes get damp with sweat.

mandarin_meaning: 喝酒
english_meaning: to drink alcohol; to go drinking
explanation_mandarin: 表示飲用含酒精的飲料或參加喝酒的活動，可指偶爾小酌或聚會飲酒。
explanation_english: Refers to consuming alcoholic beverages or taking part in drinking activities; can mean having a drink casually or drinking at social gatherings.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我今晚想去飲酒。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 gam1 maan5 soeng2 heoi3 jam2 zau2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我今晚想去喝酒。
examples.english_sentence: I want to go drinking tonight.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好飲太多酒，小心身體。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 jam2 taai3 do1 zau2, siu2 sam1 san1 tai2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 不要喝太多酒，小心身体。
examples.english_sentence: Don't drink too much alcohol; take care of your health.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 公司年會大家一齊飲酒慶祝。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gung1 si1 nin4 wui6 daai6 gaa1 jat1 cai4 jam2 zau2 hing3 zuk1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 公司年会大家一起喝酒庆祝。
examples.english_sentence: At the company's annual party everyone drank to celebrate.

mandarin_meaning: 喝醉
english_meaning: to get drunk; to become intoxicated
explanation_mandarin: 表示喝酒後達到醉酒的狀態或變得醉醺醺。
explanation_english: Indicates drinking alcohol to the point of being intoxicated or becoming drunk.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我尋晚飲醉喇。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 cam4maan5 jam2 zeoi3 laa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我昨晚喝醉了。
examples.english_sentence: I got drunk last night.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你唔好飲醉揸車。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 m4 hou2 jam2 zeoi3 zaa1 ce1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你不要酒後駕車。
examples.english_sentence: Don't drink and drive.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢一飲就容易醉。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 jat1 jam2 zau6 jung4 ji6 zeoi3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他一喝就容易醉。
examples.english_sentence: He gets drunk easily when he drinks.

mandarin_meaning: 先得好处 / 先占便宜
english_meaning: to be the first to take advantage; to grab the initial benefit
explanation_mandarin: 比喻在事情開始時先取得好處或佔便宜，常含有先發制人或佔先機的意思，有時帶貶義。
explanation_english: An idiom meaning to be the first to enjoy the benefits or take advantage; to grab the first share. Often implies getting the better part early and can carry a negative connotation.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋一收到消息就買入，飲頭啖湯。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 jat1 sau1 dou3 siu1 sik1 zau6 maai5 jap6, jam2 tau4 daam2 tong1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们一收到消息就买入，先占了便宜。
examples.english_sentence: They bought in as soon as they got the news, grabbing the first advantage.

mandarin_meaning: 饮食
english_meaning: eating and drinking; food; diet
explanation_mandarin: 指吃喝、食物或飲食習慣；也可泛指與食物相關的文化或產業。
explanation_english: Refers to eating and drinking—food and dietary habits; can also refer to food culture or the food industry.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢間餐廳嘅飲食選擇好豐富，啱素食者。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 gaan1 caan1 teng1 ge3 jam2 sik6 syun2 zaak6 hou2 fung1 fu3, aam1 sou3 sik6 ze2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这家餐厅的饮食选择很丰富，适合素食者。
examples.english_sentence: This restaurant has a wide variety of food choices, suitable for vegetarians.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 醫生話要改善飲食，少油少鹽。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ji1 sang1 waa6 jiu3 goi2 sin6 jam2 sik6, siu2 jau4 siu2 jim4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 医生说要改善饮食，少油少盐。
examples.english_sentence: The doctor said to improve your diet — less oil, less salt.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 香港人嘅飲食文化好講究。
examples.jyutping_sentence: hoeng1 gong2 jan4 ge3 jam2 sik6 man4 faa3 hou2 gong2 gau3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 香港人的饮食文化很讲究。
examples.english_sentence: Hong Kong people place great emphasis on food culture.

mandarin_meaning: 餐飲業／飲食業
english_meaning: food and beverage industry; catering/hospitality industry
explanation_mandarin: 指提供飲食服務的產業，包括餐廳、酒樓、咖啡店、外賣、宴會餐飲等相關行業。
explanation_english: Refers to the industry that provides food and beverage services, including restaurants, cafes, takeaways, catering, and related businesses.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 飲食業受疫情影響，好多餐廳都要暫時關門。
examples.jyutping_sentence: jam2 sik6 jip6 sau6 jik6 cing4 jing2 hoeng2, hou2 do1 caan1 teng1 dou1 jiu3 zaam6 si4 gwaan1 mun4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 飲食業受疫情影響，很多餐廳都要暫時關門。
examples.english_sentence: The food and beverage industry has been affected by the pandemic; many restaurants have to close temporarily.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢喺飲食業做廚師，朝早就要起身開始準備食材。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hai2 jam2 sik6 jip6 zou6 cyu4 si1, ziu1 zou2 zau6 jiu3 hei2 san1 hoi1 ci2 zeon2 bei6 sik6 coi4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他在飲食業當廚師，一大早就要起床開始準備食材。
examples.english_sentence: He works as a chef in the food and beverage industry; he has to get up early to start preparing ingredients.

mandarin_meaning: 吃吃喝喝；饮食；为生计而吃喝
english_meaning: to eat and drink; daily eating and drinking; making a living by working for food; social dining
explanation_mandarin: “飲飲食食”是粤语口语的叠词，字面意思是“吃吃喝喝”。常用来表示日常饮食、生活起居，或指为生计而工作、应付日常生活，也可指随意地吃喝或社交性地吃喝。
explanation_english: “飲飲食食” is a Cantonese colloquial reduplicated phrase literally meaning “to eat and drink.” It is used to refer to daily meals and everyday life, making a living (working to support oneself), or casual/social eating and drinking.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋成日去茶餐廳飲飲食食，傾計到夜先返屋企。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 sing4 jat6 heoi3 caa4 caan1 teng1 jam2 jam2 sik6 sik6, king1 gai3 dou3 je6 sin1 faan1 uk1 kei5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们经常去茶餐厅吃吃喝喝，聊天到很晚才回家。
examples.english_sentence: We often go to cha chaan tengs to eat and drink, chatting until late before going home.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢喺市區搵工，就係為咗飲飲食食。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hai6 si5 keoi1 wan2 gung1, zau6 hai6 wai6 zo2 jam2 jam2 sik6 sik6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他在市区找工作，就是为了生计。
examples.english_sentence: He looks for work in the city to make a living.

mandarin_meaning: 吃饱喝足；吃喝玩乐，安于享乐
english_meaning: Literally 'eat until full and drink until drunk'; idiomatically to live in indulgence—only eating, drinking and enjoying oneself, being idle or complacent
explanation_mandarin: 原字面意思是吃飽、喝醉，引申為只顧吃喝享樂、生活安逸不思進取或對現實不負責任的批評用語。
explanation_english: Originally means to eat until full and drink until drunk; figuratively used to criticize someone who lives in indulgence—only concerned with eating and drinking and not taking responsibility or striving.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢成日淨係識飲飽食醉，唔做嘢，點會有前途？
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 seng4 jat6 zing6 hai6 sik1 jam2 baau2 sik6 zeoi3, m4 zou6 je5, dim2 wui5 jau5 cin4 tou4?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他整天只知道吃喝玩乐，不工作，怎麼會有前途？
examples.english_sentence: He only knows how to eat and drink all day and doesn't work—how could he have a future?

mandarin_meaning: 饮鸩止渴
english_meaning: To drink poison to quench thirst; to take a harmful short-term remedy that causes greater harm later
explanation_mandarin: 比喻用有害或不當的方法暫時解決眼前的困難，結果會造成更大的損害或長遠的問題。
explanation_english: A metaphor for using a harmful or improper measure to solve an immediate problem, resulting in greater damage or long-term negative consequences.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 為咗一時方便，佢竟然飲鴆止渴，做咗啲會害自己嘅決定。
examples.jyutping_sentence: wai6 zo2 jat1 si4 fong1 bin6, keoi5 ging2 jin4 jam2 zam6 zi2 hot3, zou6 zo2 di1 wui5 hoi6 zi6 gei2 ge3 kyut3 ding6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 为了暂时的方便，他竟然饮鸩止渴，做了会害自己的决定。
examples.english_sentence: For the sake of short-term convenience, he resorted to a harmful quick fix — making decisions that would hurt himself.

mandarin_meaning: 糖、糖膏或麥芽糖（古稱），多見於複合詞如「飴糖」「麥芽飴」
english_meaning: candy; sugar syrup; maltose (archaic/variant for sweets)
explanation_mandarin: 「飴」為古漢語字，原指糖或糖漿、麥芽糖等甜味物質，現多用於複合詞（如飴糖、麥芽飴），指各類糖果或糖漿。
explanation_english: The character 飴 (jyutping: ji4) historically denotes candy, sugar syrup, or maltose. It is now mainly seen in compounds (e.g. 飴糖, 麥芽飴) referring to candies or sweet syrups.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 阿婆買咗啲飴糖畀我。
examples.jyutping_sentence: aa3 po4 maai5 zo2 di1 ji4 tong4 bei2 ngo5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 奶奶买了些糖果给我。
examples.english_sentence: Grandma bought me some candies.

mandarin_meaning: 喂养；饲养 (sì)
english_meaning: to feed; to rear; to keep (animals)
explanation_mandarin: 表示喂养或饲养动物，常見於書面語或合成詞如「飼養」、「飼料」。
explanation_english: Indicates feeding or rearing animals; commonly used in written form or in compounds such as "飼養" (to rear) and "飼料" (feed).

examples.cantonese_sentence: 農場用特別嘅飼料去飼豬。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nung4 coeng4 jung6 dak6 bit6 ge3 si3 liu6 heoi3 si3 zyu1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 农场用特殊的饲料来饲养猪。
examples.english_sentence: The farm uses special feed to raise pigs.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 細個喺鄉下，我哋會自己飼鴨。
examples.jyutping_sentence: sai3 go3 hai2 hoeng1 haa6, ngo5 dei6 wui5 zi6 gei2 si3 aap3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 小时候在乡下，我们会自己饲养鸭子。
examples.english_sentence: When I was young in the countryside, we used to raise ducks ourselves.

mandarin_meaning: 饲料 (sìliào)，用來餵養動物的食物
english_meaning: animal feed; fodder; food given to livestock or pets
explanation_mandarin: 指用來餵養動物（如家畜、寵物）的食物或混合飼料，常用於畜牧業或寵物飼養。
explanation_english: Refers to food given to animals (such as livestock or pets), often a formulated or mixed feed used in farming or pet care.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢包飼料係畜牧場用嘅。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 baau1 si6 liu6 hai6 cuk1 muk6 coeng4 jung6 ge3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 這包飼料是畜牧場用的。
examples.english_sentence: This bag of feed is for use on the farm.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 每日早晨要畀狗食飼料。
examples.jyutping_sentence: mui5 jat6 zou2 san4 jiu3 bei2 gau2 sik6 si6 liu6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 每天早上要給狗吃飼料。
examples.english_sentence: You need to give the dog feed every morning.

mandarin_meaning: 饲养 (sìyǎng)
english_meaning: to raise; to rear; to keep (animals)
explanation_mandarin: 指飼育動物，提供食物、住所和照顧，使其生長或繁殖。
explanation_english: Refers to raising or keeping animals — providing food, shelter, and care so they grow or reproduce.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢喺鄉下飼養咗幾隻雞同埋一頭牛。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hai2 hoeng1 haa6 si6 joeng5 zo2 gei2 zek3 gai1 tung4 maai4 jat1 tau4 ngau4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他在鄉下飼養了幾隻雞和一頭牛。
examples.english_sentence: He raises several chickens and a cow in the countryside.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋唔可以喺屋企飼養危險動物。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 m4 ho2 ji5 hai2 uk1 kei5 si6 joeng5 ngai4 him2 dung6 mat6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我們不可以在家裡飼養危險動物。
examples.english_sentence: We cannot keep dangerous animals at home.

mandarin_meaning: 饱（不再餓；滿足）
english_meaning: full (not hungry); satisfied; can imply 'fed up' in some contexts
explanation_mandarin: 表示吃飽、不再感到飢餓；也可引申為滿足或對某事感到厭倦、受夠。
explanation_english: Indicates not being hungry after eating (full); can also be used figuratively to mean satisfied or fed up with something.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我食飽喇。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 sik6 baau2 laa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我吃饱了。
examples.english_sentence: I'm full.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你食飽未？
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 sik6 baau2 mei6?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你吃饱了吗？
examples.english_sentence: Have you eaten (are you full)?

examples.cantonese_sentence: 今餐好好味，我食到飽晒。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gam1 caan1 hou2 hou2 mei6, ngo5 sik6 dou3 baau2 saai3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这顿饭很好吃，我吃到饱了。
examples.english_sentence: This meal was delicious — I ate until I was completely full.

mandarin_meaning: 吃得非常飽，飽得快滿到胸口（粵語口語）
english_meaning: extremely full (from eating); literally 'full up to the chest' (Cantonese colloquial)
explanation_mandarin: 粵語口語表達，用來形容吃得非常飽，有時帶有誇張或幽默成分，表示已經吃不下更多東西。
explanation_english: A Cantonese colloquial expression used to describe being extremely full after eating. Literally 'full up to the chest.' Often used humorously or exaggeratively to say you can't eat any more.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我食咗嗰餐海鮮，真係飽到上心口，仲食唔落甜品。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 sik6 zo2 go2 caan1 hoi2 sin1, zan1 hai6 bou2 dou3 soeng5 sam1 hau2, zung6 sik6 m4 lok6 tim4 ban2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我吃了那頓海鮮，真的飽到胸口，還吃不下甜點。
examples.english_sentence: I ate that seafood meal and I'm so full I can't eat dessert.

mandarin_meaning: 饱受（遭受大量或长期的负面影响或痛苦）
english_meaning: to suffer; to endure (a lot or for a long time), usually negative things such as criticism, damage, pollution, hardship
explanation_mandarin: 表示遭受大量或長期的不良影響或痛苦，常接負面的名詞，如批評、折磨、污染等。
explanation_english: Indicates suffering or enduring a great deal of (often negative) impact over time; commonly used with negative nouns like criticism, bullying, pollution, etc.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢幾年佢飽受傳媒嘅批評。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 gei2 nin4 keoi5 bou2 sau6 cyun4 mui4 ge3 pai1 ping4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 這幾年他飽受媒體的批評。
examples.english_sentence: He has suffered heavy criticism from the media in recent years.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 居民話嗰條河飽受污染，唔可以游水。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gei1 man4 waa6 go2 tiu4 ho4 bou2 sau6 wu1 jim5, m4 ho2 ji5 jau4 seoi2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 居民說那條河飽受污染，不能游泳。
examples.english_sentence: Residents say that the river has been heavily polluted and people cannot swim.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 個學生長期飽受同學欺凌。
examples.jyutping_sentence: go3 hok6 saang1 coeng4 kei4 bou2 sau6 tung4 hok6 hei1 ling4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 那位學生長期飽受同學的欺凌。
examples.english_sentence: That student has long endured bullying from classmates.

mandarin_meaning: 饱和（bǎohé）：達到最大容量或濃度的狀態；使達到飽和
english_meaning: saturation; saturated; to saturate
partOfSpeech_mandarin: 名詞 / 形容詞 / 動詞（視語境而定）
explanation_mandarin: 表示達到最大容量、濃度或無法再增加的狀態。例如色彩飽和表示顏色鮮明，市場飽和表示需求已接近飽和，化學上表示溶液不能再溶解更多溶質。
explanation_english: Indicates a state of maximum capacity or concentration where no more can be added. Used for color (highly saturated), markets (saturated market), or chemistry (a solution that cannot dissolve more solute).

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢幅相嘅色彩好飽和，睇落好鮮艷。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 fuk6 soeng2 ge3 sik1 coi2 hou2 baau2 wo4, tai2 lok6 hou2 sin1 jim6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 這張照片的色彩很飽和，看起來很鮮豔。
examples.english_sentence: The colors in this photo are highly saturated and look very vivid.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢個行業已經飽和，冇太多新嘅商機。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 go3 hong4 jip6 ji5 ging1 baau2 wo4, mou5 taai3 do1 san1 ge3 soeng1 gei1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 這個行業已經飽和，沒有太多新的商機。
examples.english_sentence: This industry is already saturated; there aren't many new business opportunities.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 溶液已經達到飽和狀態，加唔到更多嘅溶質。
examples.jyutping_sentence: jung4 jik6 ji5 ging1 daat6 dou3 baau2 wo4 zong6 taai3, gaa1 m4 dou3 gang1 do1 ge3 jung4 zat1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 溶液已經達到飽和狀態，加入不了更多的溶質。
examples.english_sentence: The solution has reached saturation; you can't add more solute.

mandarin_meaning: 饱和点
english_meaning: saturation point
explanation_mandarin: 指系統、溶液、市場或個人承受能力等達到可以容納或承受的最大限度，超過此點進一步增加投入或壓力通常不會產生顯著變化，或會出現飽和/析出等現象。
explanation_english: Refers to the maximum point at which a system, solution, market, or a person's capacity is saturated; beyond this point, adding more input or pressure produces little additional effect or causes saturation/precipitation phenomena.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 溶液到咗飽和點，就會有晶體沉澱。
examples.jyutping_sentence: jung4 jik6 dou3 zo2 baau2 wo4 dim2, zau6 wui5 jau5 zing1 tai2 cam4 din6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 溶液到达饱和点，就会有晶体沉淀。
examples.english_sentence: When the solution reaches its saturation point, crystals will precipitate.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我今日真係到咗工作嘅飽和點，要休息下先。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 gam1 jat6 zan1 hai6 dou3 zo2 gung1 zok3 ge3 baau2 wo4 dim2, jiu3 jau1 sik1 haa5 sin1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我今天真的达到工作的饱和点，需要休息一下。
examples.english_sentence: I'm really at my work saturation point today; I need to rest.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 顏色調到飽和點，畫面會覺得太刺眼。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngaan4 sik1 tiu4 dou3 baau2 wo4 dim2, waa6 min6 wui5 gok3 dak1 taai3 ci3 ngaan5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 把颜色调到饱和点，画面会显得太刺眼。
examples.english_sentence: If you adjust the colors to the saturation point, the image will look too harsh.

jyutping: baau2 m4 sei2 ngo6 m4 can1
mandarin_meaning: 既不富裕也不至於貧窮，處於勉強過活或剛好夠用的中等狀態
english_meaning: A middling condition — neither well-off nor destitute; just getting by or adequate but not comfortable
explanation_mandarin: 用來形容處於一種中等、勉強維持的狀態：既不寬裕也不窮困，剛好夠用但儲蓄或改善生活較難。
explanation_english: Used to describe a middling or marginal state — not rich enough to be comfortable, not poor enough to be desperate; you can get by but can't improve or save much.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 而家啲人工係飽唔死、餓唔親，夠支付日常開支，但儲唔到錢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ji4 gaa1 di1 jan4 gung1 hai6 baau2 m4 sei2, ngo6 m4 can1, gau3 zi1 fu6 jat6 soeng4 hoi1 zi1, daan6 co5 m4 dou3 cin2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 現在的薪水處於飽唔死、餓唔親的狀態，夠支付日常開銷，但存不了錢。
examples.english_sentence: My current salary is 'bao m4 sei2, ngo6 m4 can1' — it covers daily expenses but I can't save any money.

mandarin_meaning: 饱尝；充分经历（常指痛苦或挫折）
english_meaning: to have fully experienced or 'tasted' (often used for unpleasant experiences or hardships)
explanation_mandarin: 表示充分地经历或尝到某种滋味，常用于指苦楚、挫折或不愉快的经历。
explanation_english: Indicates having thoroughly experienced or tasted something, typically used for hardships, suffering, or setbacks.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢飽嘗失敗，但最後仍然堅持落去。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 bou2 soeng4 sat1 baai6, daan6 zeoi6 hau6 jing4 jin4 gin1 ci4 lok6 heoi3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他饱尝失败，但最后仍然坚持下去。
examples.english_sentence: He has tasted many failures, but in the end he still persisted.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 經過多年嘅挫折，佢飽嘗人生嘅苦澀。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ging1 gwo3 do1 nin4 ge3 co3 zit3, keoi5 bou2 soeng4 jan4 sang1 ge3 fu2 sik1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 经过多年的挫折，她饱尝了人生的苦涩。
examples.english_sentence: After years of setbacks, she has fully tasted life's bitterness.

mandarin_meaning: 吃得太飽而感到噎塞或不舒服
english_meaning: to be so full that one feels choked or uncomfortably satiated
explanation_mandarin: 指吃得太飽而出現噎塞、胸腹脹悶或不舒服的感覺。既可指字面上的噎住，也可用作形容吃得過飽而不想再吃的狀態。
explanation_english: Describes being so full that one feels a choking or uncomfortable, bloated sensation. Can be literal (something stuck in the throat) or figurative (overly satiated and unwilling to eat more).

examples.cantonese_sentence: 食咗兩碗飯，真係飽噎，連甜品都唔想食。
examples.jyutping_sentence: sik6 zo2 loeng5 wun2 faan6, zan1 hai6 baau2 jip6, lin4 tim4 ban2 dou1 m4 soeng2 sik6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 吃了兩碗飯，真的飽噎，連甜點都不想吃。
examples.english_sentence: I ate two bowls of rice and felt so full I didn’t even want dessert.

mandarin_meaning: 博學；學識淵博
english_meaning: well-educated; learned; erudite
explanation_mandarin: 表示受過良好教育或學問豐富，屬文言或書面用語，常用於形容有學問的人。
explanation_english: Indicates someone who is well-educated or highly learned. A literary/formal term often used to describe a person with extensive knowledge.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢係個飽學嘅教授，學生都好尊敬佢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hai6 go3 baau2 hok6 ge3 gaau3 sau6, hok6 saang1 dou1 hou2 zyun1 ging3 keoi5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他是一位博學的教授，學生都很尊敬他。
examples.english_sentence: He is a learned professor, and his students all respect him.

mandarin_meaning: 温饱（有足够的吃穿，生活安稳）
english_meaning: Having enough food and clothing; materially comfortable; well-fed and warm
explanation_mandarin: 表示有足夠的食物和衣物，基本生活無憂，物質上溫飽安穩。
explanation_english: Indicates having sufficient food and clothing; being materially comfortable and not worried about basic needs.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢而家生活飽暖，唔使為生計擔心。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 ji4 gaa1 saang1 wut6 baau2 nyun5, m4 sai2 wai6 saang1 gai3 daam1 sam1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他现在生活饱暖，不用为生计担心。
examples.english_sentence: He now lives comfortably with enough food and clothing and doesn't have to worry about making a living.

mandarin_meaning: 饱暖思淫欲（当生活温饱、安逸时，人们容易生起淫欲或追求享乐）
english_meaning: When people are well-fed and warm they begin to think of lust — i.e., once material needs are met, people may become indulgent in sensual or immoral desires.
explanation_mandarin: 一個成語，意思是當人們生活溫飽、安逸時，容易放縱欲望，特別指淫慾或追求享樂，常用來形容物質滿足會引發道德或行為上的放縱。
explanation_english: An idiom meaning that when basic material needs are satisfied (well-fed and warm), people tend to indulge in lustful or pleasure-seeking desires. Often used to remark that material comfort can lead to moral laxity or indulgence.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 依家生活咁好，真係應驗咗「飽暖思淫慾」。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ji1 gaa1 sang1 wut6 gam2 hou2, zan1 hai6 jing3 jim6 zo2 bou2 nyun5 si1 jam4 juk6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 现在生活这么好，真应验了“饱暖思淫欲”。
examples.english_sentence: Now that life is so comfortable, it truly proves the saying 'when people are well-fed and warm, they think of lust'.

mandarin_meaning: 飽暖思淫欲 (bǎo nuǎn sī yín yù) — 指人在溫飽後產生的淫慾或追求享樂的不良念頭。
english_meaning: When well-fed and warm one begins to think of lust; comforts of life lead to indulgent or lascivious desires.
explanation_mandarin: 形容人在生活得到溫飽安定之後，可能開始放縱慾望或追求享樂，常帶有貶義或警示意味。
explanation_english: Describes how people, after their basic material needs are met, may start indulging in sexual or hedonistic desires; often used with a critical or cautionary tone.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 社會越嚟越好，但有啲人飽暖思淫欲，開始追求享樂。
examples.jyutping_sentence: se5 wui6 jyut6 lai4 jyut6 hou2, daan6 jau5 di1 jan4 baau2 nyun5 si1 jam4 juk6, hoi1 ci2 zeoi1 kau4 hoeng2 lok6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 社會越來越好，但有些人飽暖思淫欲，開始追求享樂。
examples.english_sentence: As society improves, some people, once their basic needs are met, begin to indulge in lust and pursue pleasure.

mandarin_meaning: 饱经风霜；经历过许多艰难困苦或岁月的磨练
english_meaning: to have weathered many hardships; to be seasoned by life's trials
explanation_mandarin: 形容一个人经历过很多风霜艰辛，阅历深、稳重或饱经世故。
explanation_english: Describes someone who has experienced many hardships or the tests of time, implying deep experience, steadiness, or worldliness.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 經過咁多事，佢已經飽歷風霜，冇乜嘢會令佢驚訝。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ging1 gwo3 gam2 do1 si6, keoi5 ji5 ging1 baau2 lik6 fung1 soeng1, mou5 mat1 je5 wui5 ling6 keoi5 ging1 ngaa6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 经历了这么多事，他已经饱经风霜，没什么会让他惊讶。
examples.english_sentence: After going through so much, he has weathered many hardships and isn't easily surprised.

mandarin_meaning: 飽得要命；吃得很飽
english_meaning: so full (I'm going to burst); full to death
partOfSpeech_mandarin: 形容詞 / 感嘆詞（口語）
explanation_mandarin: 口語用法，表示吃得非常飽，常帶誇張或幽默意味。也可作感嘆詞。
explanation_english: A colloquial Cantonese expression meaning extremely full after eating; often used hyperbolically or humorously as an exclamation.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 今晚食咗咁多嘢，飽死喇。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gam1 maan5 sik6 zo2 gam2 do1 je5, baau2 sei2 laa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 今晚吃了這麼多，飽得要命。
examples.english_sentence: I ate so much tonight — I'm so full.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢間餐廳啲份量好大，食到飽死。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 gaan1 caan1 teng1 di1 fan6 loeng6 hou2 daai6, sik6 dou3 baau2 sei2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 這家餐廳份量很大，吃到飽死。
examples.english_sentence: The portions at this restaurant are huge — you can eat until you're stuffed.

mandarin_meaning: （俚語）吃得非常飽，通常帶誇張或幽默的語氣
english_meaning: A slang/exclamatory phrase meaning to be extremely full after eating (humorous/exaggerated)
partOfSpeech_mandarin: 感叹词 / 形容词短语
explanation_mandarin: 「飽死荷蘭豆」是香港廣東話的口語俚語，用來誇張或幽默地表示吃得非常飽、吃不下了。字面上把「飽死」和「荷蘭豆」結合，並無字面意義，多在熟人或非正式場合使用。
explanation_english: “飽死荷蘭豆” is a Cantonese colloquial/slang expression used humorously or exaggeratively to say one is extremely full and cannot eat more. The phrase is figurative rather than literal and is common in informal, familiar contexts.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 今餐食咗咁多，依家真係飽死荷蘭豆，冇肚再食啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gam1 caan1 sik6 zo2 gam2 do1, ji4 gaa1 zan1 hai6 baau2 sei2 ho4 laan4 dou6, mou5 tou5 zoi3 sik6 laa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 這一頓吃了那麼多，我現在真的飽得要命，沒法再吃了。
examples.english_sentence: I ate so much this meal — I'm absolutely stuffed; I can't eat another bite.

cantonese: 飽死荷蘭豆，餓死旱芹菜
jyutping: baau2 sei2 ho4 laan4 dau6, ngo6 sei2 hon6 kan4 coi3
mandarin_meaning: 比喻只注重表面或次要享受，忽略了主要需要或實質內容，結果即使有些小享受也解決不了實際問題。
english_meaning: A Cantonese proverb meaning to focus on superficial or minor comforts while neglecting essentials—being satisfied by trivial things but lacking what truly matters.
explanation_mandarin: 這句廣東話俗語用來批評只追求表面、次要的東西而忽視根本或實際需要，常用於指責做事不務實或顧此失彼的情況。
explanation_english: This Cantonese saying criticizes placing importance on superficial or minor things while ignoring fundamental needs. It's used to describe impractical behavior or misplaced priorities.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 做嘢要實際啲，唔好淨係追求表面，否則就係飽死荷蘭豆，餓死旱芹菜。
examples.jyutping_sentence: zou6 je5 jiu3 sat6 zai3 di1, m4 hou2 zing6 hai6 zeoi1 kau4 biu2 min6, fau2 zak1 zau6 hai6 baau2 sei2 ho4 laan4 dau6, ngo6 sei2 hon6 kan4 coi3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 做事要實際一點，不要只講表面，否則就是飽死荷蘭豆，餓死旱芹菜。
examples.english_sentence: Be more practical in your work—don't just focus on appearances, otherwise you'll end up satisfied by trivial things but lacking the essentials.

cantonese: 飽死荷蘭豆，餓死韭菜頭
jyutping: baau2 sei2 ho4 laan4 dau6, ngo6 sei2 gau2 coi3 tau4
mandarin_meaning: 饱死吃荷兰豆，饿死吃韭菜头（形容無論處於哪種情況都有缺點或麻煩，常用來諷刺或自嘲「兩頭都不好」的處境）
english_meaning: Literally, 'die full from eating snow peas, die hungry from eating chive heads' — used humorously to say that whichever option you have, there's a problem; you're stuck in a no-win situation.
explanation_mandarin: 一句廣東俗語，用來形容不管選擇哪一種情況都會有壞處或麻煩，表示進退兩難或無可避免的困境，語氣可帶諷刺或幽默。
explanation_english: A Cantonese proverb used to describe situations where every choice has downsides — essentially a no-win dilemma. It’s often said jokingly or sarcastically to highlight that neither outcome is good.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你話而家每樣嘢都有利弊，真係飽死荷蘭豆，餓死韭菜頭。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 waa6 ji4 gaa1 mui5 joeng6 je5 dou1 jau5 lei6 bai6, zan1 hai6 baau2 sei2 ho4 laan4 dau6, ngo6 sei2 gau2 coi3 tau4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你說現在每件事都有利弊，真是饱死吃荷兰豆，饿死吃韭菜头。
examples.english_sentence: You say everything now has pros and cons — it's one of those 'damned if you do, damned if you don't' situations.

mandarin_meaning: 貪吃鬼；吃得很多的人（口語）
english_meaning: glutton; someone who eats a lot (informal, often teasing)
explanation_mandarin: 粵語俚語，用來形容貪吃或吃得很多的人，語氣可帶戲謔或輕微責備。
explanation_english: A Cantonese slang term used to describe someone who eats a lot (a glutton). The tone is often teasing or mildly reproachful.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你個飽死鬼，又搶晒我啲零食！
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 go3 baau2 sei2 gwai2, jau6 coeng2 saai3 ngo5 di1 ling4 sik6!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你這個貪吃鬼，又把我的零食都搶光了！
examples.english_sentence: You glutton, you grabbed all my snacks again!

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢係個十足嘅飽死鬼，見到甜品就停唔到。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hai6 go3 sap6 zuk1 ge3 baau2 sei2 gwai2, gin3 dou3 tim4 ban2 zau6 ting4 m4 dou3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他完全是個貪吃鬼，一看到甜點就停不下來。
examples.english_sentence: He's a total glutton; he can't stop when he sees desserts.

mandarin_meaning: 吃得太飽並感到脹悶、消化不良（亦可引申為停滯、不順）
english_meaning: feeling overfull or bloated (after eating); indigestion; can also mean stagnation or being sated/unwilling to continue
explanation_mandarin: 口語用詞，主要形容吃得太飽、肚子脹悶或消化不良的不舒服感；在某些語境下亦可用作比喻，表示停滯或對事物感到膩滯。
explanation_english: A colloquial Cantonese term describing the uncomfortable feeling of being too full, bloated, or having indigestion after eating. Figuratively, it can also describe stagnation or being fed up/satiated.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我今日食咗好多嘢，依家覺得好飽滯，肚仔脹脹。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 gam1jat6 sik6 zo2 hou2 do1 je5, ji1 gaa1 gok3 dak1 hou2 baau2 zai6, tou5 zai2 zoeng3 zoeng3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我今天吃了很多東西，現在覺得很飽滯，肚子脹脹的。
examples.english_sentence: I ate a lot today and now feel very stuffed and bloated.

mandarin_meaning: 饱满 (bǎomǎn)
english_meaning: plump; full; abundant; well-rounded
explanation_mandarin: 形容事物充實、圓潤或程度達到飽和，既可用於描述外形（如水果飽滿），也可用於描述聲音、情感等（如嗓音飽滿）。
explanation_english: Describes something that is full, plump, or abundant; can refer to physical fullness (e.g., fruit), or figurative fullness such as a rich voice or well-developed quality.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢啲葡萄好飽滿，食落好鮮甜。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 di1 pou4 tou4 hou2 baau2 mun5, sik6 lok6 hou2 sin1 tim4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这些葡萄很饱满，吃起来很鲜甜。
examples.english_sentence: These grapes are very plump and taste very fresh and sweet.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢嘅嗓音好飽滿，唱歌好有感染力。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 ge3 song2 jam1 hou2 baau2 mun5, coeng3 go1 hou2 jau5 gam2 jim5 lik6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他的嗓音很饱满，唱歌很有感染力。
examples.english_sentence: His voice is very full and rich; he sings with great expressiveness.

mandarin_meaning: 饱经风霜（饱经风霜）
english_meaning: to have weathered many hardships; seasoned; weather-beaten
explanation_mandarin: 形容經歷過許多艱辛、挫折或歲月的摧殘，通常用來描述人或事物經歷滄桑、見多識廣或外表顯得沧桑。
explanation_english: Describes someone or something that has endured many hardships, trials, or the wear of time; often used to mean 'seasoned' or 'weather-beaten'.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢喺呢行做咗幾十年，已經飽經風霜，處事好穩重。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hai2 ni1 hong4 zou6 zo2 gei2 sap6 nin4, ji5 ging1 bou2 ging1 fung1 soeng1, cyu5 si6 hou2 wan2 zung6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他在這行做了幾十年，已經飽經風霜，處事很穩重。
examples.english_sentence: He has worked in this field for decades and has weathered many hardships; he handles things very steadily.

mandarin_meaning: 吃飽 / 肚子飽
english_meaning: to be full (after eating)
explanation_mandarin: 廣東話口語，表示吃飽了，肚子不再餓。常用於日常對話。
explanation_english: A Cantonese colloquial phrase meaning that one is full after eating; commonly used in everyday speech.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我食咗兩碗飯，宜家已經飽肚。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 sik6 zo2 loeng5 wun2 faan6, ji4gaa1 ji5ging1 baau2 tou5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我吃了兩碗飯，現在已經飽了。
examples.english_sentence: I ate two bowls of rice; I'm already full.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你飽肚未？
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 baau2 tou5 mei6?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你吃飽了嗎？
examples.english_sentence: Are you full?

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我未飽肚，仲想食甜品。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 mei6 baau2 tou5, zung6 soeng2 sik6 tim4ban2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我還沒吃飽，還想吃甜點。
examples.english_sentence: I'm not full yet; I still want to eat dessert.

mandarin_meaning: 饱读诗书
english_meaning: well-read; learned; extensively read in literature
explanation_mandarin: 形容人读过许多书，学识渊博，对文学或学问很有见解。
explanation_english: Describes someone who has read extensively and is highly knowledgeable or erudite, especially in literature.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢飽讀詩書，講起古典文學好有見解。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 baau2 duk6 si1 syu1, gong2 hei2 gu2 din2 man4 hok6 hou2 jau5 gin3 gaai2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他饱读诗书，对古典文学很有见解。
examples.english_sentence: He is well-read and has insightful views on classical literature.

mandarin_meaning: 裝飾、點綴；（用於「飾演」時）扮演（角色）
english_meaning: to adorn, decorate, embellish; (in 飾演) to play/portray a role
explanation_mandarin: 「飾」主要作動詞，表示用裝飾物使物件變得美觀或點綴，也可用於「飾演」表示扮演某個角色；常見於複合詞如「裝飾」「修飾」「飾演」。
explanation_english: Used mainly as a verb meaning to adorn, decorate, or embellish. In compounds like "飾演" it means to play or portray a role. Commonly appears in words such as "裝飾" (decorate) and "修飾" (modify/embellish).

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢喺電影入面飾演一個反派角色。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hai2 din6 jing2 jap6 min6 sik1 jin2 jat1 go3 faan2 paai3 gok3 sik1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他在電影裡飾演一個反派角色。
examples.english_sentence: He plays a villain in the movie.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋用啲燈飾嚟裝飾間屋。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 jung6 di1 dang1 sik1 lai4 zong1 sik1 gaan1 uk1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我們用一些燈飾來裝飾房子。
examples.english_sentence: We use some lights/ornaments to decorate the house.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢啲說法經常修飾事實。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 di1 syut3 faat3 ging1 soeng4 sau1 sik1 si6 sat6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他的說法經常修飾事實。
examples.english_sentence: His statements often embellish the facts.

mandarin_meaning: 饰品；用于装饰或搭配服装的物品
english_meaning: accessories; decorative items (e.g., jewelry, ornaments)
explanation_mandarin: 指用來搭配衣物或作為裝飾的物品，例如耳環、項鍊、手鍊等。
explanation_english: Items used to complement clothing or serve as decoration, such as earrings, necklaces, and bracelets.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我啱啱買咗幾件飾品，覺得好靚。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 aam1 aam1 maai5 zo2 gei2 gin6 sik1 ban2, gok3 dak1 hou2 leng3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我刚买了几件饰品，觉得很漂亮。
examples.english_sentence: I just bought a few accessories and they look really pretty.

mandarin_meaning: 饰柜 / 首饰柜 / 陈列柜
english_meaning: display cabinet; jewelry cabinet; cabinet for ornaments
explanation_mandarin: 指用來擺放飾品、首飾或陳列小物的櫃子，常見於家居或店舖，用以收納或展示裝飾品。
explanation_english: A cabinet used to store or display ornaments, jewelry, or small decorative items; commonly found in homes or shops for storage or display.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我啲首飾都放喺飾櫃入面。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 di1 sau2 sik1 dou1 fong3 hai2 sik1 gwai6 jap6 min6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我的首饰都放在饰柜里面。
examples.english_sentence: I keep all my jewelry in the display cabinet.

mandarin_meaning: 饰演
english_meaning: to portray; to play (a role)
explanation_mandarin: 在戲劇、電影或電視劇中扮演某個角色，負責表演該角色的言行與形象。
explanation_english: To portray or play a character in a drama, film, or TV show; to take on and perform a role.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢喺新電影入面飾演一個警察。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hai6 san1 din6 jing2 jap6 min6 sik3 jin2 jat1 go3 ging2 caat3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他在新電影中飾演一名警察。
examples.english_sentence: He plays a policeman in the new movie.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢今次飾演嘅角色好有挑戰性。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 gam1 ci3 sik3 jin2 ge3 gok3 sik1 hou2 jau5 tiu1 zin3 sing3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他這次飾演的角色很有挑戰性。
examples.english_sentence: The role he plays this time is very challenging.

mandarin_meaning: 飾品；裝飾用的物品
english_meaning: ornament; accessory; decorative item
explanation_mandarin: 指用來裝飾或搭配服飾、居家或其他物品的配件，例如項鍊、耳環、胸針、飾帶等。
explanation_english: Refers to items used to decorate or complement clothing, homes, or other objects, such as necklaces, earrings, brooches, and decorative trims.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢成日買啲飾物嚟配佢啲衫。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 seng4 jat6 maai5 di1 sik1 mat6 lai4 pui3 keoi5 di1 saam1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他/她總是買飾品來搭配他的衣服。
examples.english_sentence: He/She always buys accessories to match their clothes.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢啲飾物好精緻，好適合做禮物。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 di1 sik1 mat6 hou2 zing1 zi6, hou2 sik1 hap6 zou6 lai5 mat6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 這些飾品很精緻，很適合做禮物。
examples.english_sentence: These accessories are delicate and make great gifts.

mandarin_meaning: 金飾；用黃金製作的飾品
english_meaning: gold jewelry; gold ornaments
explanation_mandarin: 指用黃金製成的裝飾品或首飾，常見於婚嫁、賀禮或傳統贈送場合。
explanation_english: Refers to ornaments or jewelry made of gold, often given as gifts or used in weddings and other ceremonial occasions.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢結婚嗰日收咗好多飾金，主要係金項鍊同金戒指。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 git3 fan1 go2 jat6 sau1 zo2 hou2 do1 sik1 gam1, zyu2 jiu3 hai6 gam1 hong6 lin6 tung4 gam1 gaai3 zi2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 她結婚那天收到了很多金飾，主要是金項鍊和金戒指。
examples.english_sentence: She received a lot of gold jewelry on her wedding day, mainly gold necklaces and gold rings.

mandarin_meaning: 饺（饺子）
english_meaning: dumpling (jiaozi)
explanation_mandarin: 指用面皮包裹餡料後煮、煎或蒸的食品，常见於中国菜；常用於合成词如水饺、煎饺等。
explanation_english: Refers to a food made by wrapping filling in dough and then boiling, pan-frying, or steaming; common in Chinese cuisine. Often appears in compounds like 'shuǐjiǎo' (boiled dumplings) or 'jiānjiǎo' (pan-fried dumplings).

examples.cantonese_sentence: 今晚食水餃好唔好？
examples.jyutping_sentence: gam1 maan5 sik6 seoi2 gaau2 hou2 m4 hou2?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 今晚吃水饺，好不好？
examples.english_sentence: Shall we eat boiled dumplings tonight?

examples.cantonese_sentence: 嗰間餐廳嘅煎餃好出名。
examples.jyutping_sentence: go2 gaan1 caan1 teng1 ge3 zin1 gaau2 hou2 ceot1 ming4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 那家餐厅的煎饺很有名。
examples.english_sentence: The pan-fried dumplings at that restaurant are famous.

mandarin_meaning: 饺子（中式水饺）
english_meaning: dumpling (Chinese dumpling, typically boiled/steamed/pan-fried)
explanation_mandarin: 餃子是一種中式食品，通常用麵皮包住肉或菜等餡料，可水煮、蒸或煎食用，常在家庭聚會或節慶時出現。
explanation_english: A Chinese food made by wrapping fillings (meat, vegetables, etc.) in a dough skin; commonly boiled, steamed, or pan-fried. Often eaten at family gatherings and festivals.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 今晚我哋食餃子啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gam1 maan5 ngo5 dei6 sik6 gaau2 zi2 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 今晚我们吃饺子吧。
examples.english_sentence: Let's eat dumplings tonight.

mandarin_meaning: 饼（各類以麵粉或澱粉為主料製成的糕點、餅乾或薄餅）
english_meaning: biscuit / cake / pastry / flatbread (general term for baked or fried dough-based snacks)
explanation_mandarin: 泛指用麵粉、糖、油或餡料等製成的各種糕點或餅類，例如月餅、餅乾、薄餅等。在粵語日常用語中也常用於組成複合詞（如月餅、蛋餅）。
explanation_english: A general term for various pastries, cakes, biscuits, or flatbreads made from flour or starch and often sweetened or filled. Commonly appears in compound words (e.g., mooncake, pancake, biscuits).

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我買咗啲餅畀你。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 maai5 zo2 di1 beng2 bei2 nei5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我買了一些餅給你。
examples.english_sentence: I bought some biscuits/cakes for you.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 中秋節大家都會食月餅。
examples.jyutping_sentence: zung1 cau1 zit3 daai6 gaa1 dou1 wui5 sik6 jyut6 beng2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 中秋節大家都會吃月餅。
examples.english_sentence: Everyone eats mooncakes during the Mid-Autumn Festival.

mandarin_meaning: 饼干 (bǐnggān)
english_meaning: biscuit; cookie
explanation_mandarin: 饼干是以面粉、糖、油脂等烘烤而成的零食或点心，通常作为茶点或随手小吃。
explanation_english: A baked snack made from flour, sugar, and fat; refers to biscuits or cookies commonly eaten as a snack or with tea.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我想食餅乾。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 soeng2 sik6 beng2 gon1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我想吃饼干。
examples.english_sentence: I want to eat some cookies.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 公司派咗一包餅乾俾我哋。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gung1 si1 paai3 zo2 jat1 baau1 beng2 gon1 bei2 ngo5 dei6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 公司发了一包饼干给我们。
examples.english_sentence: The company gave us a pack of biscuits.

mandarin_meaning: （口語/俗稱）用於購買糕點、麵包等小食的儲值卡或優惠券
english_meaning: a voucher or stored-value card used for buying pastries, bread, or snacks (colloquial/slang)
explanation_mandarin: 「餅卡」多用作口語，指可在麵包店、餅店或相關商戶使用的實體或電子卡/券，用來抵扣部分或全部購買糕點的小額消費。有時亦泛指店舖發放的免費或折扣券。
explanation_english: In colloquial usage, "餅卡" refers to a physical or electronic card/voucher usable at bakeries or pastry shops to pay for or discount pastries/snacks. It can be a stored-value card or a promotional voucher issued by the store.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢張餅卡仲有十蚊，你要唔要？
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 zoeng1 beng2 kaa1 zung6 jau5 sap6 man1, nei5 jiu3 m4 jiu3?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 這張餅卡還有十元，你要不要？
examples.english_sentence: This pastry voucher still has ten dollars on it — do you want it?

mandarin_meaning: 餅模；餅上的印記
english_meaning: cake/pastry stamp; imprint on a pastry
explanation_mandarin: 指用來在月餅、餅乾等糕點上壓出花紋或文字的模具，也可泛指餅面上的印記或壓痕。
explanation_english: Refers to the stamp or mold used to imprint patterns or characters on pastries (e.g. mooncakes); can also mean an imprint or mark left on a pastry.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋買咗個新餅印，今次整月餅會好靚。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 maai5 zo2 go3 san1 beng2 jan3, gam1 ci3 zing2 jyut6 beng2 wui5 hou2 leng3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我們買了個新的餅印，這次做月餅會很漂亮。
examples.english_sentence: We bought a new cake stamp; the mooncakes will look nice this time.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢塊餅有個奇怪嘅餅印，可能係運輸嘅時候俾壓到。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 faai3 beng2 jau5 go3 kei4 gwaai3 ge3 beng2 jan3, ho2 nang4 hai6 wan6 syu1 ge3 si4 hau6 bei2 aat3 dou3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 這塊餅上有奇怪的印記，可能是在運輸時被壓到。
examples.english_sentence: This piece has a strange mark — it was probably pressed during transport.

mandarin_meaning: 餅店的集點卡／印花卡
english_meaning: bakery loyalty card / punch (stamp) card
explanation_mandarin: 香港粵語俗稱，指餅店或食品店發給顧客的集點或印花卡，累積一定次數可兌換免費食品或折扣。
explanation_english: A Hong Kong Cantonese slang term for a bakery (or food shop) loyalty/punch card — customers collect stamps or punches and redeem them for free items or discounts.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢間麵包店有餅咭，買十個可以換一個免費嘅麵包。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 gaan1 min6 baau1 dim3 jau5 beng2 kaat1, maai5 sap6 go3 ho2 ji5 wun6 jat1 go3 min5 fai3 ge3 min6 baau1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 這間麵包店有餅咭，買十個可以換一個免費的麵包。
examples.english_sentence: This bakery has a loyalty 'beng kaat' — buy ten and you can get one free bread.

mandarin_meaning: 糕点店；烘焙坊；饼店
english_meaning: bakery; pastry shop; cake shop
explanation_mandarin: 指製作或販售糕點、麵包、蛋撻、月餅等烘焙食品的店舖。此詞在廣東話中常用。
explanation_english: A shop that makes and sells baked goods such as bread, pastries, cakes, and traditional treats. Commonly used in Cantonese.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 嗰間餅家嘅蛋撻好出名。
examples.jyutping_sentence: go2 gaan1 beng2 gaa1 ge3 daan6 taat1 hou2 ceot1 ming4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 那家糕点店的蛋挞很有名。
examples.english_sentence: That bakery's egg tarts are famous.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 農曆新年快到，餅家已經開始賣年糕同月餅。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nung4 lik6 san1 nin4 faai3 dou3, beng2 gaa1 ji5 ging1 hoi1 ci2 maai6 nin4 gou1 tung4 jyut6 beng2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 农历新年快到了，糕点店已经开始卖年糕和月饼。
examples.english_sentence: Lunar New Year is approaching, and bakeries have already started selling nian gao and mooncakes.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我阿媽喺嗰間餅家訂咗個生日蛋糕。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 aa3 maa1 hai2 go2 gaan1 beng2 gaa1 deng6 zo2 go3 saang1 jat6 daan6 gou1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我妈妈在那家糕点店订了一个生日蛋糕。
examples.english_sentence: My mom ordered a birthday cake from that bakery.

mandarin_meaning: （糕點或披薩等的）餅底、餅皮或底層
english_meaning: the base/crust of a pastry, cake or pizza; the bottom layer (crust)
explanation_mandarin: 指蛋糕、餅乾、披薩等烘焙食品的底層或餅皮，通常用來承托餡料或提供口感（例如餅底酥脆或鬆軟）。
explanation_english: Refers to the bottom layer or crust of baked goods such as cakes, cookies, or pizza; it supports fillings and contributes to texture (e.g., crunchy or soft crust).

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢個芝士蛋糕嘅餅底好香。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 go3 zi1 si6 daan6 gou1 ge3 beng2 dai2 hou2 hoeng1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这个芝士蛋糕的饼底很香。
examples.english_sentence: The crust of this cheesecake smells/deliciously fragrant.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 披薩嘅餅底太厚會影響口感。
examples.jyutping_sentence: pei1 saat3 ge3 beng2 dai2 taai3 hau5 wui5 jing2 hoeng2 hau2 gam2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 披萨的饼底太厚会影响口感。
examples.english_sentence: If the pizza crust is too thick, it will affect the texture.

mandarin_meaning: 糕點店；麵包店
english_meaning: bakery; pastry shop
explanation_mandarin: 指專門出售各式糕點、麵包、蛋糕、曲奇等烘焙食品的店鋪，在香港常見並兼具堂食或外賣服務。
explanation_english: A shop that sells pastries, cakes, bread, cookies and other baked goods; a bakery or pastry shop commonly found in Hong Kong.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋去隔離嘅餅店買生日蛋糕啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 heoi3 gaak3 lei4 ge3 beng2 dim3 maai5 saang1 jat6 daan6 gou1 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我們去隔壁的餅店買生日蛋糕吧。
examples.english_sentence: Let's go to the nearby bakery to buy a birthday cake.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢間餅店啲牛角包好出名。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 gaan1 beng2 dim3 di1 ngau4 gok3 baau1 hou2 ceot1 ming4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 這家餅店的牛角包很有名。
examples.english_sentence: The croissants from this bakery are very famous.

mandarin_meaning: 饼铺；糕点店，出售蛋挞、月饼、曲奇等糕点和烘焙食品。
english_meaning: bakery; pastry shop (a shop selling pastries and baked goods)
explanation_mandarin: 指出售各类中式或西式糕点、面包和烘焙食品的商店，尤指香港或广东地区常见的传统糕点店。
explanation_english: A shop that sells baked goods and pastries (e.g., egg tarts, mooncakes, cookies). Often refers to traditional Cantonese pastry shops commonly found in Hong Kong and Guangdong.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 隔離嗰間餅舖嘅蛋撻好出名。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gaak3 lei4 go2 gaan1 beng2 pou3 ge3 daan6 taat1 hou2 ceot1 ming4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 隔壁那家饼铺的蛋挞很有名。
examples.english_sentence: The egg tarts at that bakery next door are famous.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 可以喺餅舖買到傳統嘅廣式月餅。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ho2 ji5 hai2 beng2 pou3 maai5 dou3 cyun4 tung2 ge3 gwong2 sik1 jyut6 beng2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 可以在饼铺买到传统的广式月饼。
examples.english_sentence: You can buy traditional Cantonese mooncakes at the bakery.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 阿媽一大早去餅舖買早餐。
examples.jyutping_sentence: aa3 maa1 jat1 daai6 zou2 heoi3 beng2 pou3 maai5 zou2 caan1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 妈妈一大早就去饼铺买早点。
examples.english_sentence: Mom went to the bakery early to buy breakfast.

mandarin_meaning: （口語、俚語，較少見）字面為「餅＋電」，常用於幽默或網絡語境，可能指因吃餅而「提神／充電」或被餅（或以餅作為誘餌的人）吸引、打動；亦可泛指用小吃、零食等作為取悅或誘惑手段。
english_meaning: (colloquial/slang, uncommon) Literally "biscuit/cake + electrify." Used humorously or online to mean being "recharged" or perked up by eating a snack, or being attracted/enchanted by a snack (or someone using snacks to charm). Generally a playful way to say a snack gave you energy or tempted/charmed you.
explanation_mandarin: 「餅電」不是標準詞彙，而是粵語口語或網絡俚語用法，字面是「餅」加「電」。在會話中常用來幽默表達「吃了餅而提神」、「被餅吸引或被人用餅打動」等含義，語氣輕鬆、調侃。
explanation_english: Not a standard dictionary headword but a colloquial/online Cantonese slang combining "biscuit/cake" and "electrify." It is often used playfully to mean "to be perked up by a snack" or "to be charmed/tempted by a snack (or someone using snacks)." Tone is casual and teasing.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 今日上班好攰，食個餅電返啲精神。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gam1 jat6 soeng5 baan1 hou2 gui6, sik6 go3 beng2 din6 faan1 di1 zing1 seon3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 今天上班很累，吃個餅提提神。
examples.english_sentence: I'm really tired at work today; eating a snack will perk me up.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢送咗塊蛋糕嚟，真係畀我餅電咗。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 sung3 zo2 faai3 daan6 gou1 lei4, zan1 hai6 bei2 ngo5 beng2 din6 zo2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他送了一塊蛋糕來，真的把我用零食打動了。
examples.english_sentence: They gave me a slice of cake — I was totally charmed (by the snack).

mandarin_meaning: 餉（xiǎng）：薪水、津貼、軍糧或給付的食物／補助
english_meaning: pay; wages; allowance; rations (military); stipend
explanation_mandarin: 「餉」通常指薪資、津貼或軍隊、工人領取的糧食與給付。在現代口語中可指薪水或工資。
explanation_english: Refers to pay, wages, an allowance, or rations (especially military). In modern usage it can mean salary or stipend.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 士兵要按時領取糧餉。
examples.jyutping_sentence: si6 bing1 jiu3 on3 si4 ling5 ceot1 loeng4 soeng2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 士兵要按时领取粮饷。
examples.english_sentence: Soldiers must collect their rations/pay on time.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我仲未收到今個月嘅餉。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 zung6 mei6 sau1 dou3 gam1 go3 jyut6 ge3 soeng2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我還沒收到這個月的薪水/津貼。
examples.english_sentence: I haven't received this month's pay yet.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢份工個餉唔高，你要唔要？
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 fan6 gung1 go3 soeng2 m4 gou1, nei5 jiu3 m4 jiu3?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 這份工作的薪水不高，你要不要？
examples.english_sentence: The pay for this job isn't high — do you want it?

mandarin_meaning: 養（yǎng）：養育、飼養、維持、休養等
english_meaning: to raise, to nurture, to keep (animals), to support, to recuperate
explanation_mandarin: 表示養育、飼養、維持或休養等意思，常用作動詞，可指照顧小孩、飼養動物、養病或維持（如養家）。
explanation_english: A verb meaning to raise or nurture (children), to keep or rear (animals), to support/maintain, or to recuperate (as in recuperating from illness).

examples.cantonese_sentence: 做父母要用心養小朋友。
examples.jyutping_sentence: zou6 fu6 mou5 jiu3 jung6 sam1 joeng5 siu2 pang4 jau5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 做父母要用心養育小朋友。
examples.english_sentence: Parents should raise children with care.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我養咗一隻貓。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 joeng5 zo2 jat1 zek3 maau1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我養了一隻貓。
examples.english_sentence: I have/keep a cat.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 醫生話我要返屋企養病。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ji1 sang1 waa6 ngo5 jiu3 faan1 uk1 kei5 joeng5 beng6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 醫生說我要回家養病。
examples.english_sentence: The doctor said I need to go home to recuperate.

mandarin_meaning: 養分（提供生長與維持生命所需的營養物質）
english_meaning: nutrient; nourishment
explanation_mandarin: 指供給生長、發育或維持生命所需的營養物質，有時也用作口語或書面語表示食物的營養成分。"養份"在粵語書寫上有時與「養分」通用。
explanation_english: Refers to substances that provide nourishment necessary for growth, development, or maintenance of life. Often used to denote the nutritional content of food. In Cantonese writing, 養份 is sometimes used interchangeably with 養分/養分.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢啲菜好有養份，對身體有好處。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 di1 coi3 hou2 jau5 joeng5 fan6, deoi3 san1 tai2 jau5 hou2 co3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 這些菜很有養分，對身體有好處。
examples.english_sentence: These vegetables are very nutritious and good for the body.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 小朋友需要足夠嘅養份先可以健康成長。
examples.jyutping_sentence: siu2 pang4 jau5 seoi1 jiu3 zuk1 gau3 ge3 joeng5 fan6 sin1 ho2 ji5 gin6 hong1 sing4 coeng4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 小朋友需要足夠的養分才能健康成長。
examples.english_sentence: Children need enough nutrients to grow up healthy.

mandarin_meaning: 养伤；休养、康复（可指身体或情绪上的恢复）
english_meaning: to recuperate; to recover from physical injury or emotional hurt
explanation_mandarin: 指身體或情緒上的傷需要時間休養、康復。可用於字面意思（例如手術後養傷）或比喻（例如失戀後療癒心情）。
explanation_english: Refers to taking time to heal from a physical injury or emotional hurt. Used literally (e.g., recuperating after surgery) or metaphorically (e.g., recovering after a breakup).

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢最近做完手術，要喺屋企養傷幾個禮拜。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 zeoi3 gan6 zou6 jyun4 sau2 seot6, jiu3 hai2 uk1 kei2 joeng5 soeng1 gei2 go3 lai5 baai3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他最近做完手术，要在家里养伤几个星期。
examples.english_sentence: He just had surgery and needs to recuperate at home for a few weeks.

cantonese: 養兒一百歲，長憂九十九
jyutping: joeng5 ji4 jat1 baak3 seoi3, coeng4 jau1 gau2 sap6 gau2
mandarin_meaning: 養兒一百歲，長憂九十九（養育子女會帶來終生的操心，父母常為子女擔憂）
english_meaning: Raising children brings worries that last almost a lifetime; parents worry about their children throughout their lives.
explanation_mandarin: 這句諺語用來形容為人父母的憂慮長久且持續，表示孩子成年後父母仍會為他們擔心與掛念。
explanation_english: A proverb expressing that parenting involves long-lasting worries; even as children grow up, parents continue to worry about them throughout their lives.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 做父母真係唔簡單，養兒一百歲，長憂九十九。
examples.jyutping_sentence: zou6 fu6 mou5 zan1 hai6 m4 gaan2 daan1, joeng5 ji4 jat1 baak3 seoi3, coeng4 jau1 gau2 sap6 gau2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 做父母真的不簡單，養兒一百歲，長憂九十九。
examples.english_sentence: Being parents is really not easy — raising children brings worries for almost a lifetime.

mandarin_meaning: 養兒防老
english_meaning: to have children to ensure support in old age; raising children as old-age security
explanation_mandarin: 指父母養育子女，希望將來子女能夠照顧、贍養父母，把生兒育女視為保障晚年生活的一種方式。
explanation_english: Refers to the practice of having and raising children with the expectation that they will support and look after their parents in old age; treating children as a form of old-age security.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 而家啲年輕人唔係好鍾意養兒防老，佢哋寧願靠自己儲蓄同投資。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ji4 gaa1 di1 nin4 hing1 jan4 m4 hai6 hou2 zung1 ji3 joeng5 ji4 fong4 lou5, keoi5 dei6 ning4 jyun6 kaau3 zi6 gei2 cou5 zuk1 tung4 tau4 zi1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 現在的年輕人不太願意為了養兒防老而生孩子，他們寧可靠自己存錢和投資。
examples.english_sentence: Young people today are less inclined to have children just to secure support in old age; they'd rather rely on their own savings and investments.

jyutping: joeng5 bing1 cin1 jat6 jung6 zoi6 jat1 si4
mandarin_meaning: 養兵千日，用在一時
english_meaning: To train soldiers for a long time to be used at a single crucial moment; long-term preparation for a decisive occasion.
explanation_mandarin: 字面意思是長期養兵，為的是在關鍵時刻派上用場。比喻為了應付突發事件或抓住重要機會而長期做準備或儲備人力物力。
explanation_english: Literally 'train soldiers for a thousand days to be used at one moment.' Figuratively, it means making long-term preparations so people or resources can be deployed at a critical moment—being well-prepared for a decisive opportunity or emergency.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 公司養兵千日用在一時，今日新成立嘅應變隊就發揮晒作用。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gung1 si1 joeng5 bing1 cin1 jat6 jung6 zoi6 jat1 si4, gam1 jat6 san1 sing4 laap6 ge3 jing3 bin3 deoi6 zau6 faat3 fai1 saai3 zok3 jung6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 公司養兵千日用在一時，今天新成立的應變隊就發揮了作用。
examples.english_sentence: The company trained (kept reserves) for a long time for a single crucial moment; today the newly formed response team proved useful.

jyutping: joeng5 bing1 cin1 jat6 jung6 zoi6 jat1 ziu1
mandarin_meaning: 養兵千日，用在一朝 — 長期培養或準備，為了在關鍵時刻派上用場
english_meaning: To train or prepare for a long time so that one can be used or succeed at a critical moment; long-term preparation pays off when the opportunity arrives.
explanation_mandarin: 此成語比喻長期的培養、準備終於能在關鍵時刻發揮作用，常用來形容平日積累實力以備一時之需。
explanation_english: This proverb metaphorically describes long-term training or preparation that finally proves useful at a crucial moment. It is often used to indicate building up capability in advance for an important opportunity.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 公司平時投入好多資源去培訓新人，養兵千日用在一朝，終於喺今次大單到手嘅時候派上用場。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gung1 si1 ping4 si4 tau4 jap6 hou2 do1 zi1 jyun4 heoi3 pui4 fan3 san1 jan4, joeng5 bing1 cin1 jat6 jung6 zoi6 jat1 ziu1, zing1 jyu1 hai2 gam1 ci3 daai6 daan1 dou3 sau2 ge3 si4 hau6 paai3 soeng5 jung6 coeng4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 公司平時投入很多資源去培訓新人，養兵千日，用在一朝，終於在這次拿到大訂單的時候派上用場。
examples.english_sentence: The company invested a lot in training new hires; the long preparation finally paid off when we landed this big contract.

mandarin_meaning: 養分 / 營養物質
english_meaning: nutrients; nourishment
explanation_mandarin: 指生物或人體所需的營養物質，用以支持生長、維持生命或促進健康；也可比喻精神、文化等方面的滋養。
explanation_english: Refers to substances required by living organisms or the human body for growth, maintenance, and health (nutrients). Can also be used figuratively to mean nourishment for the mind or spirit.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 植物需要陽光、水同養分先可以生長。
examples.jyutping_sentence: zik6 mat6 seoi1 jiu3 joeng4 gwong1, seoi2 tung4 joeng5 fan6 sin1 ho2 ji5 saang1 zoeng2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 植物需要陽光、水和養分才能生長。
examples.english_sentence: Plants need sunlight, water, and nutrients to grow.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 閱讀可以俾你心靈嘅養分，令你思想更成熟。
examples.jyutping_sentence: jyut6 duk6 ho2 ji5 bei2 nei5 sam1 ling4 ge3 joeng5 fan6, ling6 nei5 si1 soeng2 gang3 seong4 suk6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 閱讀可以給你的心靈養分，讓你的思考更成熟。
examples.english_sentence: Reading can provide nourishment for your mind, making your thinking more mature.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢碗雞湯好有養分，老人飲咗會舒服啲。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 wun2 gai1 tong1 hou2 jau5 joeng5 fan6, lou5 jan4 jam2 zo2 wui5 syu1 fuk6 di1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 這碗雞湯很有營養，老人喝了會舒服一些。
examples.english_sentence: This bowl of chicken soup is very nutritious; elderly people will feel better after drinking it.

mandarin_meaning: 养不熟；难以教育/培养好
english_meaning: can't be raised/trained/made mature; can't be reformed or managed
explanation_mandarin: 粵語口語，用來形容某人或動物無法被教好或培養成習慣／成熟；也可引申指某事物無法讓它達到預期的狀態或改正行為。
explanation_english: A Cantonese colloquial verb phrase describing someone or an animal who cannot be properly raised, trained, or reformed; can also be used figuratively for things that cannot be made to reach the desired/mature state.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢隻狗養唔熟，成日都咬人。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 zek3 gau2 joeng5 m4 suk6, sing4 jat6 dou1 ngaau5 jan4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这只狗养不熟，总是咬人。
examples.english_sentence: This dog can't be trained; it keeps biting people.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢呢個仔真係養唔熟，學壞咗都唔肯改。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 ni1 go3 zai2 zan1 hai6 joeng5 m4 suk6, hok6 waai6 zo2 dou1 m4 hang2 goi2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他这个孩子真的教不熟，学坏了也不肯改。
examples.english_sentence: He really can't be raised/turned around; even when he goes bad he won't change.

mandarin_meaning: 提不起好感／提不起興趣；無法對某人或某事培養出溫暖的感情
