explanation_english: In Cantonese, '鬼市' (literally 'ghost market') is a colloquial term used to describe a market, mall, event, or business that is deserted or very quiet — i.e., lacking customers or attendees. It can be used literally or metaphorically.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 今日商場入面真係鬼市，幾間舖頭都冇人睇。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gam1 jat6 soeng1 coeng4 jap6 min6 zan1 hai6 gwai2 si5, gei2 gaan1 pou3 tau2 dou1 mou5 jan4 tai2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 今天商场里面真是冷清，几家店都没有顾客。
examples.english_sentence: The mall is really a ghost market today; several shops have no customers.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 夜市今次辦得唔好，成晚都鬼市。
examples.jyutping_sentence: je6 si5 gam1 ci3 baan6 dak1 m4 hou2, sing4 maan5 dou1 gwai2 si5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 夜市这次办得不好，整晚都很冷清。
examples.english_sentence: The night market wasn't run well this time; it was deserted all night.

mandarin_meaning: 鬼的影子；比喻虛幻的影像或令人害怕的幻覺
english_meaning: ghostly shadow; a ghostly apparition; figuratively a hallucination or unsettling, illusory sight
explanation_mandarin: 字面上指鬼的影子或幽靈的投影；口語中常用來形容看到幻覺、感覺到有幽靈存在，或比喻虛幻且令人不安的事物。
explanation_english: Literally 'ghost shadow'—refers to a ghostly silhouette or apparition. Colloquially used for seeing a hallucination or sensing a ghostly presence; can also be used figuratively for something illusory and unsettling.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 夜晚無燈，我以為見到鬼影，原來係條樹影。
examples.jyutping_sentence: je6 maan5 mou4 dang1, ngo5 ji5 wai6 gin3 dou3 gwai2 jing2, jyun4 loi4 hai6 tiu4 syu6 jing2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 晚上沒有燈，我以為看到鬼影，原來是樹影。
examples.english_sentence: In the dark I thought I saw a ghostly shadow, but it turned out to be a tree's shadow.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好驚，嗰啲只係你想像出嚟嘅鬼影罷啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 geng1, go2 di1 zi2 hai6 nei5 soeng2 zoeng6 ceot1 lai4 ge3 gwai2 jing2 baa6 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 別怕，那些只是你想像出來的鬼影罷了。
examples.english_sentence: Don't be afraid; those are just ghostly shadows you imagined (figments of your imagination).

mandarin_meaning: 到處有鬼影（或幻影）晃動，形容陰森可怕或看見幻影
english_meaning: Lit. ghost shadows looming everywhere; describes an eerie, spooky atmosphere or the sense of seeing many apparitions/phantoms.
explanation_mandarin: 「鬼影幢幢」用來形容四處可見像鬼影般的陰影或幻覺，常用來描述陰森、恐怖或令人毛骨悚然的場景或感覺。
explanation_english: The idiom describes numerous ghostly shadows or apparitions, used to depict a spooky, eerie scene or the feeling of seeing phantom figures; conveys an atmosphere that is creepy or unsettling.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 夜晚行過間荒廢嘅屋企，覺得鬼影幢幢，連門都唔敢入。
examples.jyutping_sentence: je6 maan5 hang4 gwo3 gaan1 fong1 fai3 ge3 uk1 kei5, gok3 dak1 gwai2 jing2 cong4 cong4, lin4 mun4 dou1 m4 gam2 jap6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 晚上路過那間荒廢的房子，覺得鬼影幢幢，連門都不敢進去。
examples.english_sentence: Passing by that abandoned house at night felt eerie, as if ghostly shadows were everywhere; I didn't even dare to go in.

mandarin_meaning: 連影子都沒有；完全沒有
english_meaning: Not even a ghost/trace; nothing at all; nowhere to be found
partOfSpeech_mandarin: 口語短語（表示完全沒有）
explanation_mandarin: 廣東話俚語，用來強調某物或某人完全沒有、毫無蹤跡。常在口語或非正式場合使用。
explanation_english: A Cantonese colloquial/slang expression used to emphasize complete absence—there's not even a trace or a single person/thing. Used in informal speech.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我搵咗成日，連鬼影都冇。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 wan2 zo2 sing4 jat6, lin4 gwai2 jing2 dou1 mou5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我找了一整天，連影子都沒有。
examples.english_sentence: I've been looking all day; there's not even a trace.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 成條街今晚鬼影都冇。
examples.jyutping_sentence: sing4 tiu4 gaai1 gam1 maan5 gwai2 jing2 dou1 mou5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 整條街今晚一個人都沒有。
examples.english_sentence: The whole street is deserted tonight; not a soul.

mandarin_meaning: 連影子都沒有；一個人或任何跡象都沒有，形容非常空無一人或毫無動靜。
english_meaning: Not a soul; completely empty or deserted — literally 'not even a ghost's shadow'.
explanation_mandarin: 用來形容某處非常冷清或毫無人跡，強調連鬼影也沒有。屬於廣東話口語或俚語，常用於描述場所或情況的空蕩。
explanation_english: A colloquial Cantonese expression used to describe a place or situation as utterly deserted or lacking any sign of life — emphasizing that there isn't even a 'ghost's shadow.' Commonly used informally.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 今晚條街咁冷清，鬼影都冇隻。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gam1 maan5 tiu4 gaai1 gam2 laang5 cing1, gwai2 jing2 dou1 mou5 zek3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 今晚這條街這麼冷清，連影子都沒有。
examples.english_sentence: The street is so deserted tonight — there's not a soul in sight.

mandarin_meaning: 鬼怪 (guǐguài) — 鬼魂、妖怪等超自然的存在
english_meaning: ghosts, spirits, monsters; supernatural creatures
explanation_mandarin: 指鬼魂、妖怪或其他超自然的可怕生物；有時也泛指形狀或行為怪異、令人害怕的事物或人。
explanation_english: Refers to ghosts, monsters, or other supernatural beings; can also be used more generally for something or someone frightening or strange.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 聽講嗰座舊屋有鬼怪，無人敢喺夜晚入去。
examples.jyutping_sentence: teng1 gong2 go2 zo6 gau6 uk1 jau5 gwai2 gwaai3, mou4 jan4 gam2 hai2 je6 maan5 jap6 heoi3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 听说那座旧屋有鬼怪，没人敢在夜里进去。
examples.english_sentence: They say that old house has ghosts/monsters; no one dares to go in at night.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 細路見到黑影就喊，話好似見到鬼怪。
examples.jyutping_sentence: sai3 lou6 gin3 dou3 hak1 jing2 zau6 haam3, waa6 hou2 ci5 gin3 dou3 gwai2 gwaai3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 小孩子看到黑影就哭，说好像看到鬼怪。
examples.english_sentence: The child cried when seeing the dark shadow, saying it looked like a ghost/monster.

mandarin_meaning: 鬼才 / 天才（比喻有非常獨特或出人意料的才能）
english_meaning: a genius; an exceptionally talented or cunning person (can be sincere praise or sarcastic)
explanation_mandarin: 「鬼才」字面為「鬼的才能」，用來形容某人非常有才華、想法異於常人或出人意表，既可作真誠稱讚，也可帶諷刺或嘲弄意味，視語境而定。
explanation_english: Literally 'ghost talent', used to describe someone with extraordinary, unconventional, or unexpectedly clever ability. It can be sincere praise ('a genius') or used sarcastically depending on context.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢真係鬼才，設計又創新又實用。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 zan1 hai6 gwai2 coi4, sik1 gai3 jau6 cong3 san1 jau6 sat6 jung6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他真是鬼才，設計既有創意又實用。
examples.english_sentence: He's a genius — his designs are both creative and practical.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你以為自己好叻？鬼才啦！
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 ji5 wai6 zi6 gei2 hou2 lek1? gwai2 coi4 laa1!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你以為自己很厲害？才怪呢！
examples.english_sentence: You think you're so clever? Yeah, right!

examples.cantonese_sentence: 今次佢諗出咁嘅方法，真係鬼才。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gam1 ci3 keoi5 nam2 ceot1 gam2 ge3 fong1 faat3, zan1 hai6 gwai2 coi4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这次他想出这样的办法，真是鬼才。
examples.english_sentence: This time he came up with that solution — he's really a genius.

mandarin_meaning: 鬼打（常作「鬼打牆」）：指人在某段路上迷失、反覆走回原地或短暫失去方向感（比喻恍惚、走神）。
english_meaning: A Cantonese colloquialism (short for "鬼打牆") meaning to become disoriented and repeatedly return to the same place, to get lost, or to be in a daze/absent-minded.
explanation_mandarin: 「鬼打」是粵語口語，通常為「鬼打牆」的簡稱。原意為傳說中被鬼迷惑而在街上反覆走回同一地方，現多用來形容迷路、失去方向感或一時走神、重複做同一件事。
explanation_english: "Gwai daa" is a Cantonese colloquialism, usually short for "gwai daa coeng" (鬼打牆). Literally invoking a "ghost-caused" phenomenon, it describes being inexplicably disoriented — e.g., walking in circles, returning to the same spot, or momentarily losing one's sense of direction or awareness.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我今晚返屋企嗰陣鬼打牆，行返到頭先嗰條街，點都搵唔到路。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 gam1 maan5 faan1 uk1 kei5 go2 zan6 gwai2 daa2 coeng4, haang4 faan1 dou3 tau4 sin1 go2 tiu4 gaai1, dim2 dou1 wan2 m4 dou2 lou6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我今晚回家的時候鬼打牆，走回了剛才的那條街，怎麼也找不到路。
examples.english_sentence: When I was heading home tonight I got "gui da qiang" — I walked back to the street I had just been on and couldn't find the way.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 頭先我真係鬼打，行到半路又返轉頭。
examples.jyutping_sentence: tau4 sin1 ngo5 zan1 hai6 gwai2 daa2, haang4 dou3 bun3 lou6 jau6 faan1 zyun2 tau4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 剛才我真的鬼打（迷路/走神），走到半路又回頭了。
examples.english_sentence: Just now I really "gwai daa" — I walked halfway and then turned back.

mandarin_meaning: 像被鬼迷住般，莫名其妙地
english_meaning: inexplicably; as if possessed/bewitched
explanation_mandarin: 口語廣東話說法，用來表示某人無緣無故、莫名其妙地做出某種行為或反應，好像被鬼迷住似的。常帶幽默或自嘲意味。
explanation_english: A colloquial Cantonese expression used to indicate doing something inexplicably or as if possessed/bewitched. Often used humorously or self-deprecatingly and functions as an adverb.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我今日鬼打咁出門先發現冇帶電話。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 gam1 jat6 gwai2 daa2 gam2 ceot1 mun4 sin1 faat3 jin6 mou5 daai3 din6 waa2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我今天莫名其妙出門才發現沒帶手機。
examples.english_sentence: Today I inexplicably left the house and only then realized I hadn't brought my phone.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢鬼打咁又返去學校搵舊教科書。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 gwai2 daa2 gam2 jau6 faan1 heoi3 hok6 haau6 wan2 gau6 gaau3 fo1 syu1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他莫名其妙又回到學校找舊課本。
examples.english_sentence: He inexplicably went back to school to look for his old textbook.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好鬼打咁做衝動嘅決定。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 gwai2 daa2 gam2 zou6 cung1 dung6 ge3 kyut3 ding6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 別莫名其妙做衝動的決定。
examples.english_sentence: Don't make impulsive decisions for no reason.

jyutping: gwai2 daa2 dou1 mou5 gam2 zing1 san4
mandarin_meaning: （口語）非常沒精神、極度疲倦
english_meaning: colloquial expression meaning extremely tired or completely lacking energy
explanation_mandarin: 這是一個廣東話的口語說法，用誇張的比喻表示一個人非常無精打采、幾乎沒有精神。字面上把沒精神比作連「鬼打」也不如，以增強語氣。
explanation_english: A colloquial Cantonese phrase that hyperbolically describes someone as extremely lethargic or drained of energy. Literally compares the lack of spirit to something worse than being 'hit by a ghost' to emphasize the exhaustion.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我琴晚瞓得唔好，今日真係鬼打都冇咁精神。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 kam4 maan5 fan3 dak1 m4 hou2, gam1 jat6 zan1 hai6 gwai2 daa2 dou1 mou5 gam2 zing1 san4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我昨晚睡得不好，今天真的一點精神都沒有。
examples.english_sentence: I didn't sleep well last night — I'm totally out of energy today.

mandarin_meaning: （俗語）被鬼迷惑或在陌生/夜間地方莫名其妙地反覆回到原處、迷失方向；也可比喻陷入反覆無法突破或精神迷亂的狀態。
english_meaning: A colloquial Cantonese expression meaning to be haunted or led astray by ghosts (literally); to become disoriented or repeatedly return to the same place. Figuratively, it describes being stuck in a repeating loop or feeling mentally confused.
explanation_mandarin: 通常指人在夜間或陌生地方行走時，莫名其妙地回到出發點或迷失方向，民間說法認為是被“鬼”作弄。也用來比喻事情反覆、無法前進或人很迷糊。
explanation_english: Refers to the phenomenon of inexplicably returning to the same spot or becoming disoriented (often at night), attributed to being tricked by ghosts. It is also used metaphorically for situations that repeat without progress or for mental confusion.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 今晚落夜街，成日行返轉頭，好似畀鬼打鬼。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gam1 maan5 lok6 je6 gaai1, sing4 jat6 haang4 faan1 zyun2 tau4, hou2 ci5 bei2 gwai2 daa2 gwai2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 今晚晚間出門，總是走回原處，好像被鬼打牆。
examples.english_sentence: We kept ending up back where we started when we walked out tonight, as if we'd been haunted.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 考試期間我成日忘記步驟，做嘢好亂，真係似畀鬼打鬼。
examples.jyutping_sentence: haau2 si3 kei4 gaan1 ngo5 sing4 jat6 mong4 gei3 bou6 zou6, zou6 je5 hou2 lyun6, zan1 hai6 ci5 bei2 gwai2 daa2 gwai2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 考試期間我總是忘記步驟，做事很混亂，真像被鬼迷惑。
examples.english_sentence: During exams I kept forgetting steps and getting everything mixed up; it really felt like I was being haunted.

mandarin_meaning: 突然或接二連三遭遇倒霉、不幸（口語）
english_meaning: sudden/unexpected run of bad luck; misfortune striking just when one thought things were fine (colloquial)
explanation_mandarin: 「鬼拍後尾枕」是香港粵語的俚語，字面意思為「鬼拍打在後尾的枕頭」，用來形容人在本以為安穩或走運時，突然遭遇倒霉事或接連不順。
explanation_english: A Hong Kong Cantonese slang expression literally meaning 'a ghost hitting the back-of-the-tail pillow.' It describes experiencing sudden bad luck or a streak of misfortune just when one thought things were settled or going well.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 阿明啱啱換咗份新工，頭兩日已經遇到唔少麻煩，真係鬼拍後尾枕。
examples.jyutping_sentence: aa3 ming4 ngaam1 ngaam1 wun6 zo2 fan6 san1 gung1, tau4 loeng5 jat6 ji5 ging1 jyu6 dou3 m4 siu2 maa4 faan4, zan1 hai6 gwai2 paak3 hau6 mei5 zam2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 阿明剛換了新工作，頭兩天就遇到很多麻煩，真是倒霉。
examples.english_sentence: A-Ming just started a new job and ran into a lot of problems in the first two days — what bad luck.

cantonese: 鬼拍後尾枕 - 不打自招
mandarin_meaning: 不打自招
english_meaning: to give oneself away; to confess or reveal guilt/secret without being forced
explanation_mandarin: 形容在沒有被迫或逼問的情況下，自己說出真相或承認錯誤；亦可指不小心露出破綻、自供。
explanation_english: Describes unintentionally revealing one's guilt or secrets without being forced; to give oneself away or blurt out a confession.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 面對證據，佢鬼拍後尾枕，乜嘢都供晒出嚟。
examples.jyutping_sentence: min6 deoi3 zing3 geoi3, keoi5 gwai2 paak3 hau6 mei5 zam2, mat1 je5 dou1 gung1 saai3 ceot1 lai4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 面對證據，他不打自招，什麼都供出來了。
examples.english_sentence: Faced with the evidence, he gave himself away and confessed to everything.

mandarin_meaning: 捉弄、搗亂、添麻煩（口語、俚語）
english_meaning: to mess with someone; to cause trouble or make mischief (slang)
explanation_mandarin: 「鬼掹腳」是廣東話口語俚語，字面上是「鬼拉腳」，用來形容故意捉弄、搗亂或無謂地添麻煩，常帶貶義或玩笑意味，適用於口語場合。
explanation_english: “鬼掹腳” is a Cantonese slang phrase literally meaning “ghost pulls the foot.” It describes deliberately messing with someone, causing trouble or pranking them. It’s informal and often carries a mildly negative or teasing sense.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你唔好鬼掹腳，等我講完先。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 m4 hou2 gwai2 maang2 goek3, dang2 ngo5 gong2 yun4 sin1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你不要添亂，等我說完再說。
examples.english_sentence: Don't cause trouble; wait until I finish speaking.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢成日鬼掹腳，搞到大家唔開心。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 sing4 jat6 gwai2 maang2 goek3, gaau2 dou3 daai6 gaa1 m4 hoi1 sam1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他總是愛捉弄人，弄得大家不高興。
examples.english_sentence: He always likes to mess with people, making everyone unhappy.

mandarin_meaning: 故意蒙騙、矇混過關或佯裝看不見（俚語）
english_meaning: to deliberately deceive or cover up; to pretend not to notice; to pull a fast one (slang)
explanation_mandarin: 「鬼揞眼」是廣東話俚語，字面是「鬼用手掩眼」，引申為故意矇混、欺騙或裝作看不見，以逃避責任或掩飾真相。
explanation_english: A Cantonese slang verb literally meaning "ghost covers eyes." It refers to deliberately deceiving, covering up, or pretending not to notice in order to avoid responsibility or hide the truth.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢成日鬼揞眼，唔肯承認自己錯誤。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 sing4 jat6 gwai2 am2 ngaan5, m4 hang2 sing4 jing6 zi6 gei2 co3 ng6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他老是故意蒙混，不肯承認自己的錯誤。
examples.english_sentence: He keeps trying to fool people and refuses to admit his mistakes.

mandarin_meaning: 鬼祟、搞怪或惹人厭的行為（口語、俚語）
english_meaning: a colloquial/slang term for acting sneaky, mischievous, or being a nuisance
partOfSpeech_mandarin: 口語/俚語（形容詞或動詞用法）
explanation_mandarin: 「鬼搰」為香港粵語的口語用詞，常用來形容人行為古怪、鬼祟、或有意惹人不快，語氣可帶貶義或半開玩笑。使用時語境多為非正式場合。
explanation_english: “鬼搰” is a Hong Kong Cantonese colloquial/slang term used to describe someone acting oddly, sneaky, mischievous, or being a nuisance. It often carries a mildly derogatory or teasing tone and is used in informal contexts.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢成日鬼搰，成班人傾偈都唔安心。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 seng4 jat6 gwai2 gau1, seng4 baan1 jan4 king1 gai2 dou1 m4 on1 sam1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他總是鬼搰，大家聊天都不放心。
examples.english_sentence: He's always being '鬼搰', so no one feels comfortable chatting around him.

mandarin_meaning: 鬼故事
english_meaning: ghost story; tale about ghosts or supernatural events
explanation_mandarin: 「鬼故」是廣東話口語，指有關鬼魂或靈異事件的故事，相當於普通話的「鬼故事」。通常用於描述嚇人的、超自然題材的短篇敘述或傳說。
explanation_english: “鬼故” is a Cantonese colloquial term referring to stories about ghosts or supernatural occurrences, equivalent to the Mandarin term “鬼故事” (ghost story). It typically denotes scary or supernatural tales told for entertainment or as local legend.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢鐘意講鬼故，成日嚇我。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 zung1 ji3 gong2 gwai2 gu3, sing4 jat6 haak3 ngo5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他喜歡講鬼故事，老是嚇我。
examples.english_sentence: He likes telling ghost stories and always scares me.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 喺香港，聽鬼故係啲人嘅消遣。
examples.jyutping_sentence: hai2 hoeng1 gong2, teng1 gwai2 gu3 hai6 di1 jan4 ge3 siu1 hin2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 在香港，聽鬼故事是人們的一種消遣。
examples.english_sentence: In Hong Kong, listening to ghost stories is a pastime for some people.

mandarin_meaning: 胡搞 / 捉弄 / 亂弄
english_meaning: to mess around; to prank; to make a mess of something
explanation_mandarin: 口語用法，表示亂搞、惡作劇、捉弄別人或把事情弄得一團糟。
explanation_english: A colloquial Cantonese expression meaning to mess around, play tricks on someone, or do something that causes disorder or trouble.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你鬼整乜嘢呀？
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 gwai2 zing2 mat1 je5 aa3?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你在胡搞什麼？
examples.english_sentence: What are you messing around with?

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢成日鬼整人，真係煩。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 seng4 jat6 gwai2 zing2 jan4, zan1 hai6 faan4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他經常捉弄別人，真煩。
examples.english_sentence: He/she is always messing with people — it's really annoying.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好鬼整啲嘢啦，做返正經嘢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 gwai2 zing2 di1 je5 laa1, zou6 faan1 zing3 ging1 je5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 別亂搞了，做正經事吧。
examples.english_sentence: Stop messing around and do something proper.

mandarin_meaning: 鬼斧神工 (guǐ fǔ shén gōng) — 形容技藝或天然景觀極其巧妙，彷彿由鬼神巧手所成。
english_meaning: Remarkable craftsmanship or artistry so extraordinary it seems the work of supernatural forces; superbly skillful or ingenious.
explanation_mandarin: 用來形容建築、雕刻、繪畫或自然景觀等的巧妙與精湛，達到令人驚嘆的程度，彷彿非人力可為。
explanation_english: Used to praise exceptionally fine workmanship, craftsmanship, art, or natural scenery — so exquisite or ingenious that it appears beyond human ability.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢座橋嘅設計真係鬼斧神工，令人嘆為觀止。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 zo6 kiu4 ge3 cit3 gai3 zan1 hai6 gwai2 fu2 san4 gung1, ling6 jan4 taan3 wai4 gun1 zi2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这座桥的设计真是鬼斧神工，让人叹为观止。
examples.english_sentence: The design of this bridge is truly a marvel — it's like something crafted by supernatural hands and leaves people in awe.

mandarin_meaning: （口語）形容像旋風一樣迅速活躍、忙亂的人或事；也可指突然興起的熱潮或狂熱
english_meaning: Colloquial term for a person or thing that's like a whirlwind — very active, fast, chaotic — or a sudden craze/frenzy
explanation_mandarin: 常用於粵語口語，形容人動作快、精力充沛或到處奔忙，或指某事物突然掀起一陣熱潮或狂熱。
explanation_english: Used colloquially in Cantonese to describe someone who is very energetic and constantly on the move (like a whirlwind), or to describe a sudden, intense craze or rush.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 隻細路成日跳嚟跳去，屋企就好似有個鬼旋風。
examples.jyutping_sentence: zek3 sai3 lou6 sing4 jat6 tiu3 lai4 tiu3 heoi3, uk1 kei2 zau6 hou2 ci5 jau5 go3 gwai2 syun4 fung1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 那个小孩总是跳来跳去，家里就像有个鬼旋风。
examples.english_sentence: The kid is always running/jumping around; the house feels like there's a whirlwind.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢打工嗰陣做嘢又快又多，真係鬼旋風。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 daa2 gung1 go2 zan6 zou6 je5 jau6 faai3 jau6 do1, zan1 hai6 gwai2 syun4 fung1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他工作的时候做事又快又多，真像个鬼旋风。
examples.english_sentence: When he works he's fast and takes on a lot — like a whirlwind.

mandarin_meaning: 農曆七月（中元節期間），民間相信亡靈回歸的時期
english_meaning: Ghost Month (the seventh month of the lunar calendar when spirits are believed to return)
explanation_mandarin: 「鬼月」指農曆七月，民間習俗認為此期間陰間的鬼魂會返回陽間，故有祭祀、燒紙、避免夜間游泳或搬家的禁忌。
explanation_english: Ghost Month refers to the seventh month of the lunar calendar, a period in folk belief when spirits return to the living world; it is associated with offerings, rituals, and various taboos (e.g., avoiding night swimming, weddings, or moving house).

examples.cantonese_sentence: 聽講今個鬼月，啲人會擺供品畀好兄弟。
examples.jyutping_sentence: teng1 gong2 gam1 go3 gwai2 jyut6, di1 jan4 wui5 baai2 gung1 ban2 bei2 hou2 hing1 dai6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 聽說這個鬼月，人們會擺供品給好兄弟（亡靈）。
examples.english_sentence: I heard that during this Ghost Month, people put offerings for the spirits.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 屋企啲長輩話鬼月唔好結婚或者搬屋。
examples.jyutping_sentence: uk1 kei5 di1 coeng4 bui3 waa6 gwai2 jyut6 m4 hou2 git3 fan1 waak6 ze2 bun1 uk1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 家裡的長輩說鬼月不要結婚或搬家。
examples.english_sentence: The elders at home say not to get married or move house during Ghost Month.

mandarin_meaning: 胡說、廢話、亂講
english_meaning: nonsense; rubbish; to talk nonsense
partOfSpeech_mandarin: 感嘆詞 / 名詞（口語、俚語）
explanation_mandarin: 廣東話口語俚語，用來貶低或否定別人的話，表示對方說的是荒謬、不可信或無意義的話。
explanation_english: A colloquial Cantonese slang term used to dismiss or belittle what someone is saying — indicating their words are nonsense, rubbish, or not to be taken seriously.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你講咩鬼槍呀？
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 gong2 me1 gwai2 coeng1 aa3?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你在說什麼胡說八道？
examples.english_sentence: What nonsense are you talking?

examples.cantonese_sentence: 收聲啦，唔好再講啲鬼槍嘢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: sau1 seng1 laa1, m4 hou2 zoi3 gong2 di1 gwai2 coeng1 je5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 閉嘴，不要再說那些廢話了。
examples.english_sentence: Shut up, don't talk that rubbish anymore.

mandarin_meaning: （粗俗）非常；表示极端程度，相当于普通话的“……死了/极其”
english_meaning: A coarse Cantonese intensifier meaning 'extremely' or '...to death' (colloquial/vulgar).
explanation_mandarin: 「鬼死」是廣東話的俗語/粗口，用作加強語氣置於形容詞或動詞之前，相當於普通話的「……死了」或「非常」，常見於口語且帶不禮貌或粗俗色彩。
explanation_english: “Gwai sei” is a Cantonese colloquial/vulgar intensifier placed before adjectives or verbs to emphasize degree (e.g. 'lazy as hell', 'damn hard'). It is common in speech and carries a coarse or impolite tone.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你鬼死咁遲先到！
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 gwai2 sei2 gam2 ci4 sin1 dou3!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你怎么这么晚才到！
examples.english_sentence: You're so damn late!

examples.cantonese_sentence: 今次考試鬼死難。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gam1 ci3 haau2 si3 gwai2 sei2 naan4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这次考试难死了。
examples.english_sentence: This exam is damn hard.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢鬼死懶，成日唔做嘢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 gwai2 sei2 laan5, sing4 jat6 m4 zou6 je5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他懒得要命，总是不做事。
examples.english_sentence: He's lazy as hell; never does any work.

mandarin_meaning: 非常 / 极其（口语化且带粗俗色彩的加强语气词）
english_meaning: extremely; (colloquial) so damn; an emphatic intensifier
explanation_mandarin: 「鬼死咁」是粤语口语中的粗俗程度副词，字面为“鬼死”，但用于加强语气，常与形容词或动词连用，表示“非常、特别、要命”等程度。
explanation_english: “鬼死咁” is a Cantonese colloquial/slang degree adverb literally meaning “ghost-die,” used as a strong intensifier. It commonly precedes adjectives or verbs to mean “extremely” or “so damn.” It is informal and somewhat coarse.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢件衫鬼死咁貴呀！
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 gin6 saam1 gwai2 sei2 gam2 gwai3 aa3!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这件衣服太贵了！
examples.english_sentence: This shirt is so damn expensive!

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢鬼死咁忙，連飯都冇時間食。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 gwai2 sei2 gam2 mong4, lin4 faan6 dou1 mou5 si4 gaan3 sik6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他忙得要命，连饭都没时间吃。
examples.english_sentence: He's so damn busy he doesn't even have time to eat.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 今日市中心鬼死咁多人，去邊度都塞車。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gam1 jat6 si5 zung1 sam1 gwai2 sei2 gam2 do1 jan4, heoi3 bin1 dou6 dou1 sak1 ce1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 今天市中心人多得要命，去哪儿都塞车。
examples.english_sentence: There are so many people downtown today; everywhere you go there's traffic.

mandarin_meaning: 吵得要命 / 非常吵（帶粗口、強烈語氣）
english_meaning: extremely noisy (slang, coarse intensifier)
explanation_mandarin: 「鬼殺咁嘈」是香港廣東話的粗口式說法，用作程度副詞，強調聲音非常吵或令人受不了。通常在非正式場合使用，帶有強烈情緒色彩。
explanation_english: “鬼殺咁嘈” is Cantonese slang from Hong Kong that functions as an intensifying adverbial phrase to say something is extremely noisy or unbearably loud. It’s colloquial and coarse, carrying strong emotional emphasis.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 樓下間酒吧夜夜鬼殺咁嘈，點瞓覺啊？
examples.jyutping_sentence: lou4 haa6 gaan1 zau2 baa1 je6 je6 gwai2 saat3 gam2 cou4 dim2 fan3 gaau3 aa3?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 樓下的酒吧每晚都吵得要命，我怎麼睡覺？
examples.english_sentence: The bar downstairs is damn noisy every night — how am I supposed to sleep?

mandarin_meaning: 鬼混（指游手好閒、混日子或隨便與人亂搞）
english_meaning: to mess around; to loaf about; to hang out aimlessly; to fool around with someone (casually)
explanation_mandarin: 口語詞，常用於粵語，指虛度光陰、游手好閒、混日子；也可指與人隨便交往或亂搞（含曖昧／性方面的意涵）。
explanation_english: A colloquial Cantonese verb meaning to idle away time, loaf around, or hang out aimlessly. It can also mean to casually mess around or have casual/irresponsible relationships with someone.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢成日喺街頭鬼混，唔肯搵工。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 seng4 jat6 hai2 gaai1 tau4 gwai2wan6, m4 hang2 wan2 gung1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他總是在街上鬼混，不肯找工作。
examples.english_sentence: He spends all his time hanging around on the streets and refuses to look for a job.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好同啲唔負責任嘅男仔鬼混。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 tung4 di1 m4 fu6zaak3 jam6 ge3 naam4zai2 gwai2wan6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 不要和那些不負責任的男生鬼混。
examples.english_sentence: Don't mess around with irresponsible guys.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢話佢唔想同人鬼混，想認真拍拖。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 waa6 keoi5 m4 soeng2 tung4 jan4 gwai2wan6, soeng2 jing6zan1 paak3to1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他說他不想和人鬼混，想認真談戀愛。
examples.english_sentence: They said they don't want to mess around and want to be in a serious relationship.

mandarin_meaning: （俚語）指經常非法改裝、愛飆車或製造噪音的小型機車／摩托車（常稱為「鬼火仔」）
english_meaning: slang for small modified mopeds/scooters (often ridden recklessly or noisily); can also refer to the riders
explanation_mandarin: 在香港口語中，「鬼火」多指那些無牌或改裝過、聲浪大且常在街頭飆車的小型摩托車，使用上亦可泛指騎這類車的人（如「鬼火仔」）。
explanation_english: In Hong Kong Cantonese, '鬼火' is a slang term for small, often illegally modified mopeds/scooters that are loud and commonly ridden recklessly; it can also refer to the riders (e.g. '鬼火仔').

examples.cantonese_sentence: 啲鬼火喺夜晚成日喺街度飆，成日搞到好嘈。
examples.jyutping_sentence: di1 gwai2 fo2 hai2 je6 maan5 seng4 jat6 hai2 gaai1 dou6 biu1, seng4 jat6 gaau2 dou3 hou2 cou4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 那些鬼火晚上常常在街上飆車，經常弄得很吵。
examples.english_sentence: Those 'gwai fo' bikes often race on the streets at night, constantly making a lot of noise.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 警察抓咗幾部鬼火，因為佢哋冇牌同埋改咗喉。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ging2 caat3 zaa1 zo2 gei2 bou6 gwai2 fo2, jan1 wai6 keoi5 dei6 mou5 paai4 tung4 maai4 goi2 zo2 hau4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 警察查扣了幾輛鬼火，因為它們沒牌照又改了排氣管。
examples.english_sentence: The police impounded several 'gwai fo' bikes because they had no license plates and had modified their exhausts.

mandarin_meaning: 非常漂亮 / 极其好看（口语）
english_meaning: extremely/ridiculously pretty (colloquial)
explanation_mandarin: 香港粤语口语俚语。用“鬼火咁”作程度副词，表示“非常、特别”，用于强调某人或某物很漂亮，常带夸张或惊讶的语气，主要在年轻人口中使用。
explanation_english: A Hong Kong Cantonese colloquial/slang expression. '鬼火咁' functions as an intensifier meaning 'extremely' or 'ridiculously'; '鬼火咁靚' means something is extremely pretty. It is informal, often playful or exaggerated, and common among younger speakers.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢件裙鬼火咁靚，我都想買。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 gin6 kwan4 gwai2 fo2 gam2 leng3, ngo5 dou1 soeng2 maai5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这条裙子漂亮得不得了，我也想买。
examples.english_sentence: This dress is insanely pretty — I want to buy it too.

mandarin_meaning: 鬼片 / 恐怖片
english_meaning: ghost movie; horror film
explanation_mandarin: 指以鬼怪、靈異或驚悚元素為題材的電影，常用來指恐怖片或驚悚片。在粵語口語中非常常見。
explanation_english: Refers to movies focusing on ghosts, supernatural phenomena, or horror/thriller elements. In Cantonese colloquial usage it commonly means a horror film.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 今晚想唔想一齊去戲院睇鬼片？
examples.jyutping_sentence: gam1 maan5 soeng2 m4 soeng2 jat1 cai4 heoi3 hei3 jyun2 tai2 gwai2 pin3?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 今晚想不想一起去電影院看鬼片？
examples.english_sentence: Do you want to go to the cinema to watch a horror movie tonight?

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢套鬼片好驚，我驚到訓唔着。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 tou3 gwai2 pin3 hou2 geng1, ngo5 geng1 dou3 fan3 m4 zoek6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 這部鬼片很恐怖，我害怕得睡不著。
examples.english_sentence: This horror movie is so scary that I can't fall asleep.

mandarin_meaning: 鬼牌；（牌類）小丑牌／百搭牌；比喻出乎意料的人或事（黑馬、不確定因素）
english_meaning: joker/wild card (in cards); figuratively a dark horse or an unpredictable factor/person
explanation_mandarin: 「鬼牌」在字面上指牌堆中的小丑牌或作為百搭的牌；口語中也用來指比賽或情況中出人意料、難以預測的人或事（黑馬、變數）。
explanation_english: Literally the joker/wild card in a deck of cards; colloquially used to refer to an unexpected person or factor in a competition or situation — a dark horse or unpredictable element.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢副牌有兩張鬼牌，可以變成任何牌。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 fu6 paai2 jau5 loeng5 zoeng1 gwai2 paai4, ho2 ji5 bin3 sing4 jam6 ho4 paai2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 這副牌有兩張鬼牌，可以變成任何牌。
examples.english_sentence: This deck has two jokers; they can become any card.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 今場比賽佢哋帶咗個鬼牌出嚟，贏咗我哋。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gam1 coeng4 bei2 coi3 keoi5 dei6 daai3 zo2 go3 gwai2 paai4 ceot1 lai4, jeng4 zo2 ngo5 dei6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 這場比賽他們帶了個鬼牌出來，贏了我們。
examples.english_sentence: They pulled out a dark horse in this match and beat us.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢成日做事好奇怪，真係個鬼牌。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 sing4 jat6 zou6 si6 hou2 kei4 gwaai3, zan1 hai6 go3 gwai2 paai4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他做事總是很奇怪，真的是個鬼牌。
examples.english_sentence: He always does strange things — he's really a wild card.

mandarin_meaning: 鬼界的首領/閻王；（口語）形容人非常厲害、狡黠或愛惡作劇
english_meaning: literally 'ghost king' (ruler of spirits, akin to Yama); colloquially someone extremely mischievous, formidable, or uncanny
explanation_mandarin: 1) 原指鬼界或陰間的首領，類似閻王。2) 在粵語口語/俚語中，可戲稱或貶稱某人特別厲害、狡黠或喜歡惡作劇，語氣可帶調侃或輕微貶義。
explanation_english: 1) Literally the 'king of ghosts' — a ruler of the spirit world, similar to Yama. 2) In Cantonese colloquial use (especially Hong Kong), it's used jokingly or pejoratively to describe someone extremely mischievous, crafty, formidable, or uncanny.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 古代神話中有鬼王，負責審判亡靈。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gu2 doi6 san4 waa6 zung1 jau5 gwai2 wong4, fu6 zak1 sam2 pun3 mong4 ling4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 古代神話中有鬼王，負責審判亡靈。
examples.english_sentence: In ancient mythology there is a 'ghost king' who judges the spirits.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢係公司入面嘅鬼王，成日整蠱人。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hai6 gung1 si1 jap6 min6 ge3 gwai2 wong4, seng4 jat6 zing2 gu2 jan4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他是公司裡的鬼王，經常捉弄別人。
examples.english_sentence: He's the office 'ghost king' — always playing pranks on people.

mandarin_meaning: 鬼畜（网络语）：可指残忍、野蛮、变态等贬义；也指一种网络剪辑/音视频二次创作风格（鬼畜视频），通过反复剪辑、循环配音或节奏化处理制造搞笑或讽刺效果。
english_meaning: Guǐchù (slang): can mean brutal, sadistic, perverse (pejorative); also refers to an Internet remix/editing style ('guǐchù videos') that repeats and edits audio/video for humorous or satirical effect.
partOfSpeech_mandarin: 形容词 / 名词（网络用语）
explanation_mandarin: 「鬼畜」原本字面與畜生相關，作口語時可形容人或行為殘忍、變態、惡劣；在網絡語境下，還特指一類利用重複剪輯、節奏化配音與素材拼接來製造喜感或諷刺效果的二次創作（如“鬼畜视频”）。
explanation_english: Originally evoking 'beastly' connotations, '鬼畜' in colloquial usage can describe people/behaviour that are cruel, perverse, or vicious. On the Internet it also names a remix/editing style that uses repetitive clipping, rhythmic audio edits, and montage to create comedic or satirical videos ('guǐchù videos').

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢條鬼畜片好癲，根本停唔到笑。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 tiu4 gwai2 cuk1 pin3 hou2 din1, gan1 bun2 ting4 m4 dou2 siu3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这条鬼畜视频太疯了，根本停不下来笑。
examples.english_sentence: This guǐchù video is crazy — I couldn't stop laughing.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢個人好鬼畜，成日用啲殘忍嘅方法嚇人。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 go3 jan4 hou2 gwai2 cuk1, sing4 jat6 jung6 di1 caan4 jan2 ge3 fong1 faat3 haak3 jan4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他这个人很鬼畜，总是用残忍的方式吓人。
examples.english_sentence: He's really 'guǐchù' — he always uses cruel ways to scare people.

mandarin_meaning: 鬼画符
english_meaning: chicken scratch; illegible writing; incomprehensible or meaningless writing/speech
explanation_mandarin: 指字跡潦草、難以辨認，像鬼畫的符一樣；也可比喻言語或文字難懂、毫無意義。
explanation_english: Describes handwriting that is illegible or scribbled (like 'chicken scratch'); can also be used figuratively to describe speech or writing that is incomprehensible or meaningless.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢啲字寫到好似鬼畫符，完全睇唔明。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 di1 zi6 se2 dou3 hou2 ci5 gwai2 waa6 fu4, jyun4 cyun4 tai2 m4 ming4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他/她的字写得像鬼画符，完全看不懂。
examples.english_sentence: His/her handwriting looks like chicken scratch — completely illegible.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢篇報告充滿專業術語，對外行人嚟講簡直係鬼畫符。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 pin1 bou3 gou3 cung1 mun5 zyun1 jip6 seot6 jyu5, deoi3 ngoi6 hong4 jan4 lai4 gong2 gaan2 zik6 hai6 gwai2 waa6 fu4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这篇报告充满专业术语，对外行人来说简直是鬼画符。
examples.english_sentence: This report is full of technical terms; to laypeople it's practically unintelligible.

mandarin_meaning: 誰知道 / 不知道（口語）
english_meaning: Who knows; beats me; no idea (colloquial)
explanation_mandarin: 「鬼知」為廣東話口語說法，用來表示不清楚或不知道，語氣可帶無奈或輕蔑。常見於短語如「鬼知啦」或與其他詞連用以表不肯確定的態度。
explanation_english: A Cantonese colloquial expression meaning 'who knows' or 'beats me'. It expresses lack of knowledge or uncertainty and can convey resignation or a dismissive tone. Often used as '鬼知啦' or in longer constructions.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 嗰啲嘢幾時先好返，鬼知。
examples.jyutping_sentence: go2 di1 je5 gei2 si4 sin1 hou2 faan1, gwai2 zi1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 那些東西什麼時候會好，誰知道。
examples.english_sentence: Who knows when those things will be fixed.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你問佢點解會遲，鬼知啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 man6 keoi5 dim2 gaai2 wui5 ci4, gwai2 zi1 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你問他為什麼會遲，誰知道啊。
examples.english_sentence: You ask why he's late? Who knows.

mandarin_meaning: 鬼神 (guǐshén)：鬼和神，泛指超自然的靈體或神靈。
english_meaning: Ghosts and gods; spirits and deities—supernatural beings or spiritual forces.
explanation_mandarin: 指鬼怪與神靈的總稱，常用於描述超自然存在或民間信仰中的靈體，有時也用來解釋不可思議的現象。
explanation_english: A collective term for ghosts and deities; used to refer to supernatural beings or spiritual forces in folk belief, and sometimes to explain mysterious phenomena.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 老人講以前呢條村入面有好多鬼神，啲人會去拜祭佢哋。
examples.jyutping_sentence: lou5 jan4 gong2 ji5 cin4 ni1 tiu4 cyun1 jap6 min6 jau5 hou2 do1 gwai2 san4, di1 jan4 wui5 heoi3 baai3 zai3 keoi5 dei6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 老人說以前這條村裡有很多鬼神，有些人會去祭拜它們。
examples.english_sentence: The elder said that in the past there were many spirits in this village; some people would go to worship them.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 遇到啲奇怪嘅事，啲人就話係鬼神作祟。
examples.jyutping_sentence: jyu6 dou3 di1 kei4 gwaai3 ge3 si6, di1 jan4 zau6 waa6 hai6 gwai2 san4 zok3 seoi3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 遇到一些奇怪的事，人們就說是鬼神作祟。
examples.english_sentence: When strange things happen, people say it's the spirits causing trouble.

mandarin_meaning: 鬼祟 (guǐsuì) — 形容偷偷摸摸、鬼鬼祟祟的行為
english_meaning: furtive; sneaky; secretive
explanation_mandarin: 用來形容行為或舉止隱蔽、不光明正大、看起來有可疑之處，常帶負面意味。
explanation_english: Describes behavior that is secretive, furtive, or sneaky — acting in a way that suggests one is trying to hide something; usually carries a negative connotation.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢行得好鬼祟，令人懷疑。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 haang4 dak1 hou2 gwai2 seoi3, ling6 jan4 waai4 ji4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他走路很鬼祟，讓人懷疑。
examples.english_sentence: He walks furtively, which makes people suspicious.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 小偷做嘢好鬼祟，唔想畀人見到。
examples.jyutping_sentence: siu2 tau1 zou6 je5 hou2 gwai2 seoi3, m4 soeng2 bei2 jan4 gin3 dou6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 小偷做事很鬼祟，不想被人看到。
examples.english_sentence: The thief acts furtively and doesn't want to be seen.

mandarin_meaning: 中元节（俗称鬼节，农历七月十五，祭祀孤魂和祖先的传统节日）
english_meaning: Ghost Festival (the traditional festival on the 15th day of the 7th lunar month when people honor spirits and ancestors)
explanation_mandarin: 指农历七月十五的中元节，俗称鬼节，人们会供奉祖先、烧纸钱、摆供品并进行祭祀活动，以安抚孤魂野鬼。
explanation_english: Refers to the Ghost Festival (Zhongyuan Festival) on the 15th day of the 7th lunar month. People make offerings, burn joss paper, and perform rituals to appease wandering spirits and honor ancestors.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 每年農曆七月十五日係鬼節，屋企會燒紙同擺供品。
examples.jyutping_sentence: mui5 nin4 nung4 lik6 cat1 jyut6 sap6 ng5 jat6 hai6 gwai2 zit3, uk1 kei5 wui5 siu1 zi2 tung4 baai2 gung1 ban2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 每年农历七月十五日是鬼节，家里会焚烧纸钱并摆放供品。
examples.english_sentence: Every year on the 15th day of the 7th lunar month is the Ghost Festival; families burn joss paper and place offerings.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 成條街掛滿燈籠同紙紮店，好有鬼節嘅氣氛。
examples.jyutping_sentence: sing4 tiu4 gaai1 gwaa3 mun5 dang1 lung4 tung4 zi2 zaak6 dim3, hou2 jau5 gwai2 zit3 ge3 hei3 fan6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 整条街挂满了灯笼和纸扎店，很有鬼节的气氛。
examples.english_sentence: The whole street is filled with lanterns and shops selling paper effigies; it feels very much like the Ghost Festival.

mandarin_meaning: 鬼鬼祟祟；偷偷摸摸，行為可疑或說話怪異
english_meaning: sneaky; furtive; acting or speaking in a suspicious/creepy way
explanation_mandarin: 粵語口語，形容一個人言行鬼鬼祟祟、偷偷摸摸或給人怪異、不誠懇的感覺。
explanation_english: A Cantonese colloquial expression describing someone who behaves or speaks in a furtive, sneaky, or vaguely creepy way, giving a suspicious impression.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢成日鬼聲鬼氣，唔想講清楚發生咩事。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 seng4 jat6 gwai2 seng1 gwai2 hei3, m4 soeng2 gong2 cing1 co2 faat3 sang1 me1 si6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他總是鬼鬼祟祟，不想把發生的事說清楚。
examples.english_sentence: He's always being sneaky and won't clearly say what happened.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你講嘢咁鬼聲鬼氣，聽落好怪。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 gong2 je5 gam3 gwai2 seng1 gwai2 hei3, teng1 lok6 hou2 gwaai3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你說話這麼鬼鬼祟祟，聽起來很奇怪。
examples.english_sentence: You talk so sneakily — it sounds really strange.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好喺度鬼聲鬼氣，直接講清楚啦！
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 hai2 dou6 gwai2 seng1 gwai2 hei3, zik6 zip3 gong2 cing1 co2 laa1!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 別在那裡鬼鬼祟祟，直接說清楚吧！
examples.english_sentence: Don't be so sneaky there — just say it clearly!

mandarin_meaning: 做鬼臉；做怪相（拉長臉、扮怪樣子以逗人或嚇人）
english_meaning: a grimace; to make a face or pull a funny/ugly face (to tease, amuse, or scare someone)
explanation_mandarin: 表示拉長臉或扮怪相以逗人、表示不滿或嚇人的表情，口語常見用法有「扮鬼臉」「做鬼臉」。
explanation_english: Refers to making a face or a grimace—often done to tease, amuse, show displeasure, or frighten someone. Commonly used colloquially as 'make a face' or 'pull a face.'

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢成日喺我面前扮鬼臉，想逗我笑。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 seng4 jat6 hai2 ngo5 min6 cin4 baan6 gwai2 lim5, soeng2 dau3 ngo5 siu3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他經常在我面前做鬼臉，想逗我笑。
examples.english_sentence: He often pulls faces in front of me to make me laugh.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 細路仔見陌生人會扮鬼臉嚇人。
examples.jyutping_sentence: sai3 lou6 zai2 gin3 mak6 sang1 jan4 wui5 baan6 gwai2 lim5 haak3 jan4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 小孩子見到陌生人會做鬼臉嚇人。
examples.english_sentence: Kids sometimes pull faces to startle strangers.

mandarin_meaning: 鬼話（胡說、謊話、不真實的話）
english_meaning: nonsense; lies; untrue/exaggerated talk
explanation_mandarin: 指不真實或誇張的話，常用來形容謊言、胡說或騙人的說話。
explanation_english: Refers to untrue or exaggerated talk; commonly used to describe lies, nonsense, or attempts to deceive.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你唔好講鬼話嚟騙我。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 m4 hou2 gong2 gwai2 waa6 lai4 pin3 ngo5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 別跟我說鬼話來騙我。
examples.english_sentence: Don't tell me lies to try to fool me.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢成日講鬼話，點信佢？
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 sing4 jat6 gong2 gwai2 waa6, dim2 seon3 keoi5?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他老是說鬼話，怎麼相信他？
examples.english_sentence: He always talks nonsense — how can I trust him?

mandarin_meaning: 满口谎言；胡说八道
english_meaning: full of lies; talking nonsense; a pack of lies
explanation_mandarin: 形容說的話全是謊言或胡說，不能相信。
explanation_english: Describes speech or statements that are full of lies or nonsense and therefore not to be trusted.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢成日講鬼話連篇，唔好信佢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 sing4 jat6 gong2 gwai2 waa6 lin4 pin1, m4 hou2 seon3 keoi5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他总是鬼话连篇，别相信他。
examples.english_sentence: He always talks a pack of lies; don't believe him.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 政府講嘅承諾係鬼話連篇，根本做唔到。
examples.jyutping_sentence: zing3 fu2 gong2 ge3 sing4 nok6 hai6 gwai2 waa6 lin4 pin1, gan1 bun2 zou6 m4 dou2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 政府说的承诺都是鬼话连篇，根本做不到。
examples.english_sentence: The government's promises are a pack of lies; they can't be fulfilled.

mandarin_meaning: 鬼迷心窍（被迷惑、失去理智）
english_meaning: to be infatuated/obsessed; to be bewitched and lose one's reason
explanation_mandarin: 形容為某種念頭或感情所迷惑，失去理智，做出不理性的行為，常用於形容愛情上的迷戀或被誘惑而判斷失準。
explanation_english: Describes being bewitched or obsessed by an idea or feeling and losing one's reason; often used for infatuation or being so taken with someone/something that one acts irrationally.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢為咗嗰個女仔鬼迷心竅，連屋企人嘅意見都唔聽。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 wai6 zo2 go2 go3 neoi5 zai2 gwai2 mai4 sam1 hiu3, lin4 uk1 kei5 jan4 ge3 ji3 gin3 dou1 m4 teng1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他為了那個女孩鬼迷心竅，連家人的意見都不聽。
examples.english_sentence: He's so infatuated with that girl that he won't listen to his family's opinions.

mandarin_meaning: 连鬼都害怕 / 非常可怕
english_meaning: so scary that even ghosts would be afraid; extremely frightening (colloquial)
explanation_mandarin: 用于夸张地形容某事或某物非常可怕，意思是“连鬼也会害怕”。常见于粤语口语中。
explanation_english: A colloquial Cantonese expression used to hyperbolically describe something extremely frightening — literally "even ghosts are afraid." Commonly used in spoken Cantonese.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 昨晚嗰套驚慄片真係鬼都怕，我成晚訓唔着。
examples.jyutping_sentence: zok3maan5 go2 tou3 ging1leot6 pin3 zan1hai6 gwai2 dou1 paa3, ngo5 seng4maan5 fan3 m4 zoek6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 昨晚那部惊悚片真是连鬼都害怕，我整晚都睡不着。
examples.english_sentence: That horror movie last night was so scary even ghosts would be afraid — I couldn't sleep the whole night.

mandarin_meaning: 鬼門關（比喻瀕臨死亡或處於生死關頭）
english_meaning: the gates of hell; the brink of death; a critical life-or-death moment
explanation_mandarin: 「鬼門關」原指通往陰間的門，常用來比喻人瀕臨死亡或經歷極其危險的時刻，也可指從生死邊緣被救回來。
explanation_english: Literally 'the gate of ghosts,' used metaphorically for being on the brink of death or in a critical life-or-death situation; it can also imply narrowly escaping death.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢出車禍嗰陣，差啲就過鬼門關，依家仲要慢慢康復。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 ceot1 ce1 wo6 go2 zan6, caa1 di1 zau6 gwo3 gwai2 mun4 gwaan1, ji1 gaa1 zung6 jiu3 maan6 maan6 hong1 fuk6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他出车祸那次差点就送命了，現在還要慢慢康復。
examples.english_sentence: When he had the car accident he almost died; now he still has to recover slowly.

mandarin_meaning: 胡說、荒謬、不可信（廣東話俚語）
english_meaning: nonsense; ridiculous; not to be trusted (Cantonese slang)
explanation_mandarin: 「鬼零秤」是香港廣東話口語俚語，用來形容某些話、說法或行為荒謬、沒有道理或不值得相信。語氣較口語、有時帶貶義。
explanation_english: A Hong Kong Cantonese slang term used to describe a statement or behavior as nonsense, ridiculous, or untrustworthy. Informal and often dismissive in tone.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢講嗰啲嘢聽落鬼零秤，唔好信佢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 gong2 go2 di1 je5 teng1 lok6 gwai2 ling4 ceng3, m4 hou2 seon3 keoi5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他說的那些話很荒謬，根本不可信，不要相信他。
examples.english_sentence: What he said sounds like nonsense; don't believe him.

mandarin_meaning: 鬼靈精怪（形容機靈、調皮或古怪）
english_meaning: mischievous; impish; crafty; quirky/odd
explanation_mandarin: 用來形容人（常指小孩）機靈、調皮、愛耍小伎倆，或行為舉止有些古怪、離奇。
explanation_english: Describes someone (often a child) who is clever, mischievous, and playful—prone to tricks or slyness; can also describe quirky or odd behavior.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你個細路咁鬼靈精怪，成日扮鬼扮馬，笑死我。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 go3 sai3 lou6 gam3 gwai2 ling4 zing1 gwaai3, sing4 jat6 baan6 gwai2 baan6 maa5, siu3 sei2 ngo5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你的孩子這麼鬼靈精怪，總是扮來扮去，逗得我很開心。
examples.english_sentence: Your kid is so mischievous—always making faces and acting silly; it cracks me up.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢啲諗法好鬼靈精怪，成日諗到啲離奇嘅主意。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 di1 nam2 faat3 hou2 gwai2 ling4 zing1 gwaai3, sing4 jat6 nam2 dou3 di1 lei4 kei4 ge3 zyu2 ji3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他的想法很鬼靈精怪，經常想到一些奇怪的主意。
examples.english_sentence: His ideas are very quirky—he often comes up with strange schemes.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好以為佢細個就唔識計較，佢好鬼靈精怪㗎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 ji5 wai6 keoi5 sai3 go3 zau6 m4 sik1 gai3 gaau3, keoi5 hou2 gwai2 ling4 zing1 gwaai3 gaa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 別以為他年紀小就不會算計，他很鬼靈精怪。
examples.english_sentence: Don't assume he's too young to be shrewd—he's quite crafty/impish.

mandarin_meaning: 鬼面罩（可指鬼臉的面具或俚語，形容厚顏無恥/囂張的行為）
english_meaning: ghost mask (literal: a mask shaped like a ghost); slang: brazen/shameless behavior or a ridiculous/ frightening mask
explanation_mandarin: 1) 字面意思：像鬼臉的面罩或面具。2) 俚語用法：在廣東話中有時用來形容人厚顏無恥、臉皮厚或行為囂張，也可戲稱某些很嚇人或荒謬的面罩。
explanation_english: 1) Literal: a mask resembling a ghost's face. 2) Slang: in Cantonese it can be used jokingly or pejoratively to describe someone who is shameless/brazen or to mock a ridiculous or scary mask.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢戴住個鬼面罩喺街度行，好嚇人。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 daai3 zyu6 go3 gwai2 min6 ziu3 hai2 gaai1 dou6 hang4, hou2 haak3 jan4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他戴着鬼面罩在街上走，很可怕。
examples.english_sentence: He was walking down the street wearing a ghost mask; it was really scary.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你咁樣講都得？真係鬼面罩！
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 gam2 gong2 dou1 dak1? zan1 hai6 gwai2 min6 ziu3!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你这样说也行？真是厚颜无耻！
examples.english_sentence: You can say that? That's really shameless!

mandarin_meaning: （口語）形容鬼祟、狡猾或愛耍小聰明的人；也可作戲稱，類似「壞蛋」「搗蛋鬼」。
english_meaning: Colloquial term for a sneaky or sly person; a teasing name for someone who acts mischievously or cunningly.
explanation_mandarin: 「鬼頭」多用於粵語口語，表示某人行為鬼祟、狡猾或常做些讓人摸不着頭腦的事，有時帶玩笑、輕鬆的語氣。
explanation_english: Used in colloquial Cantonese to describe someone who is sneaky, sly, or frequently behaves in a way that confuses others; often used playfully or teasingly.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你呢個鬼頭，成日做啲鬼嘢，唔好再呃人啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 ni1 go3 gwai2 tau4, seng4 jat6 zou6 di1 gwai2 je5, m4 hou2 zoi3 aak1 jan4 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你這個壞蛋，總是做些鬼祟的事，別再騙人了。
examples.english_sentence: You rascal, always doing sneaky things—stop deceiving people.

mandarin_meaning: 小鬼头；调皮的孩子；捣蛋鬼
english_meaning: little rascal; cheeky kid; brat (affectionate or reproachful slang)
explanation_mandarin: 「鬼頭仔」是廣東話的口語或俚語，常用來指調皮、愛惡作劇或令人頭痛的小孩，語氣可帶親暱或責備，視語境而定。
explanation_english: “鬼頭仔” is a Cantonese colloquial/slang term referring to a mischievous child or little rascal. The tone can be affectionate or reproachful depending on context.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你呢個鬼頭仔，唔好再偷食嘢啦！
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 ni1 go3 gwai2 tau4 zai2, m4 hou2 zoi3 tau1 sik6 je5 laa1!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你这个小鬼，别再偷吃东西了！
examples.english_sentence: You little rascal, stop stealing food!

mandarin_meaning: （某人）突然消失、無影無蹤（相當於「人間蒸發」）
english_meaning: to disappear without a trace; to vanish suddenly (often used when someone suddenly goes missing or avoids contact)
explanation_mandarin: 粵語俗語，字面為「鬼吃泥」，用來形容某人突然消失、避不見人或無法聯絡，帶有口語與幽默或貶義色彩。
explanation_english: A Cantonese slang phrase literally meaning "ghost eats mud." It describes someone who suddenly disappears or becomes unreachable—similar to saying someone "vanished" or "pulled a disappearing act." It is colloquial and often carries humorous or negative connotations.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢收咗我啲錢之後就鬼食泥，搵唔到佢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 sau1 zo2 ngo5 di1 cin2 zi1 hau6 zau6 gwai2 sik6 nai4, wan2 m4 dou2 keoi5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他收了我的錢之後就消失了，找不到他。
examples.english_sentence: He disappeared after taking my money; I can't find him.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 開會講完分工之後嗰個同事就鬼食泥，冇交過份內嘅工作。
examples.jyutping_sentence: hoi1 wui2 gong2 yun4 fan1 gung1 zi1 hau6 go2 go3 tung4 si6 zau6 gwai2 sik6 nai4, mou5 gaau1 gwo3 fan6 noi6 ge3 gung1 zok3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 開會分配好工作後那位同事就消失了，沒有交付應做的事。
examples.english_sentence: After tasks were assigned in the meeting, that colleague vanished and never did their part.

mandarin_meaning: 发呆 / 愣住 / 傻乎乎的样子
english_meaning: to be spaced out; to be in a daze; to act absent-minded or bewildered
partOfSpeech_mandarin: 口語，動詞短語/形容狀態
explanation_mandarin: 「鬼食泥噉聲」是廣東話俗語，形容一個人神情呆滯、發愣或一時反應遲鈍，好像走神或愣住了。
explanation_english: A Cantonese colloquial/slang expression describing someone who is dazed, spaced out, or acting bewildered — essentially zoning out or staring blankly.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢聽到嗰個消息之後，就坐喺度鬼食泥噉聲，一句說話都冇講。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 teng1 dou3 go2 go3 siu1 sik1 zi1 hau6 zau6 zou6 hai2 dou6 gwai2 sik6 nei4 gam2 seng1 jat1 geoi3 syut3 waa6 dou1 mou5 gong2
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他听到那个消息之后，就坐在那里发呆，一句话都没说。
examples.english_sentence: After hearing the news, he just sat there in a daze, not saying a single word.

mandarin_meaning: 調皮、愛搞怪、機靈
english_meaning: playful; mischievous; witty; quirky
explanation_mandarin: 「鬼馬」是廣東話形容一個人很調皮、愛搞怪或機靈幽默，帶有正面或輕鬆的語氣。
explanation_english: In Cantonese, "鬼馬" describes someone playful, mischievous, witty, or quirky. It usually has a lighthearted or affectionate tone.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢個性好鬼馬，成日諗到啲古靈精怪嘅主意。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 go3 sing3 hou2 gwai2 maa5, sing4 jat6 lam2 dou2 di1 gu2 ling4 zing1 gwaai3 ge3 zyu2 ji3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他個性很鬼馬（很愛搞怪、很機靈），常常想出一些古靈精怪的主意。
examples.english_sentence: He's very playful and quirky, always coming up with odd, creative ideas.

mandarin_meaning: 形容古靈精怪、愛搞怪、調皮且難以預測
english_meaning: mischievous, quirky, playful and unpredictable
explanation_mandarin: 「鬼馬雜」是廣東話俚語，用來形容人或行為古靈精怪、愛搞怪、充滿幽默感且難以預測，有時帶點混亂或不拘小節。
explanation_english: A Cantonese slang term describing a person or behavior that is mischievous, quirky, playful and unpredictable—often humorous and a bit unruly.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢個性好鬼馬雜，成日諗啲奇怪嘅主意。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 go3 sing3 hou2 gwai2 maa5 zaap6, sing4 jat6 nam2 di1 kei4 gwaai3 ge3 zyu2 ji3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他性格很古靈精怪、調皮，經常想一些奇怪的主意。
examples.english_sentence: He has a very mischievous and quirky personality; he often comes up with strange ideas.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢套戲幾鬼馬雜，觀眾笑到停唔到。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 tou3 hei3 gei2 gwai2 maa5 zaap6, gun1 zung3 siu3 dou3 ting4 m4 dou2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 這齣戲很古靈精怪、搞笑，觀眾笑得停不下來。
examples.english_sentence: This show is pretty quirky and hilarious; the audience couldn't stop laughing.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 教練話班上有個學生鬼馬雜，但好有創意。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gaau3 lin6 waa6 baan1 soeng6 jau5 go3 hok6 saang1 gwai2 maa5 zaap6, daan6 hou2 jau5 cong3 ji3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 教練說班上有個學生很古靈精怪，但很有創意。
examples.english_sentence: The coach said there's a student in the class who's quite mischievous and quirky, but very creative.

mandarin_meaning: 鬼鬼祟祟（偷偷摸摸、暗中行事，帶有可疑或不誠實的意味）
english_meaning: sneaky; furtive; secretive (behaving in a suspicious or underhanded way)
explanation_mandarin: 用來形容行為或舉止隱蔽、偷偷摸摸、讓人覺得可疑，常暗示不誠實或有隱瞞之處。
explanation_english: Describes behavior that is secretive, furtive, or suspicious — often implying dishonesty or attempts to avoid attention.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢成日鬼鬼祟祟，唔知道佢做緊啲咩。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 seng4 jat6 gwai2 gwai2 seoi3 seoi3, m4 zi1 dou3 keoi5 zou6 gan2 di1 me1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他總是鬼鬼祟祟，不知道他在做什麼。
examples.english_sentence: He's always being sneaky; I don't know what he's up to.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你唔好鬼鬼祟祟噉，直接講啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 m4 hou2 gwai2 gwai2 seoi3 seoi3 gam2, zik6 zip3 gong2 laa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你不要鬼鬼祟祟的，直接說就行了。
examples.english_sentence: Don't be sneaky; just say it directly.

mandarin_meaning: 調皮搗蛋、愛惡作劇或不太認真
english_meaning: mischievous; playful; cheeky; acting sly or not taking things seriously
explanation_mandarin: 用來形容人愛鬧、愛搞笑或愛惡作劇，不太認真，語氣通常輕鬆或帶玩笑成分。此詞為廣東話口語，香港常用。
explanation_english: Used to describe someone who is playful, mischievous, or prone to pranks—not very serious. The term is colloquial Cantonese, commonly used in Hong Kong, and often carries a lighthearted or cheeky tone.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢成日鬼鬼馬馬，唔肯認真做嘢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 seng4 jat6 gwai2 gwai2 maa5 maa5, m4 hang2 jing6 zan1 zou6 je5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他總是很調皮搗蛋，不肯認真做事。
examples.english_sentence: He's always mischievous and won't take his work seriously.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 細路仔鬼鬼馬馬，成日捉弄同學，老師都無辦法。
examples.jyutping_sentence: sai3 lou6 zai2 gwai2 gwai2 maa5 maa5, seng4 jat6 zuk1 lung6 tung4 hok6, lou5 si1 dou1 mou5 baan6 faat3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 孩子們很調皮，經常捉弄同學，老師也沒辦法。
examples.english_sentence: The kids are very mischievous, constantly teasing classmates, and the teacher can't do anything.

mandarin_meaning: 鬼鬼祟祟；偷偷摸摸
english_meaning: sneaky; furtive; secretive; behaving in a shady or surreptitious way
explanation_mandarin: 用來形容一個人行為偷偷摸摸、鬼祟、不光明正大，常帶有可疑或不信任的含義。
explanation_english: Describes behavior that is furtive or sneaky—acting in a secretive or shady manner, often causing suspicion.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢成日鬼鬼鼠鼠，好似有啲嘢唔講我哋。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 seng4 jat6 gwai2 gwai2 syu2 syu2, hou2 ci5 jau5 di1 je5 m4 gong2 ngo5 dei6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他总是鬼鬼祟祟，好像有事不跟我们说。
examples.english_sentence: He's always being sneaky, like he's hiding something from us.

mandarin_meaning: 鬼魂 (guǐhún)
english_meaning: ghost; spirit; the soul of a deceased person
explanation_mandarin: 指死者的靈魂或出現在人間的幽靈，常用於描述超自然現象或民間信仰中的存在。
explanation_english: Refers to the spirit or soul of a deceased person, or a ghost that appears among the living; commonly used to describe supernatural phenomena or entities in folklore and belief.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 老人家講佢見過鬼魂，半夜出現喺屋企。
examples.jyutping_sentence: lou5 jan4 gaa1 gong2 keoi5 gin3 gwo3 gwai2 wan4, bun3 je6 ceot1 jin6 hai2 uk1 kei2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 老人說他見過鬼魂，半夜出現在家裡。
examples.english_sentence: The elderly person said he had seen a ghost; it appeared at home in the middle of the night.

mandarin_meaning: 狡猾的人；陰險、狡詐（口語/俚語）
english_meaning: a sly or crafty person; sneaky/cunning (slang)
explanation_mandarin: 在香港粵語中用作俚語，形容某人很狡猾、鬼祟或愛耍手段，語氣多帶貶義。
explanation_english: A Cantonese slang term used to describe someone who is sly, sneaky, or crafty; often used pejoratively.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢好鬼鼠，成日講大話又唔負責。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hou2 gwai2 syu2, sing4 jat6 gong2 daai6 waa6 jau6 m4 fu6 zaak3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他很狡猾，經常說謊又不負責任。
examples.english_sentence: He's really sneaky; he often lies and doesn't take responsibility.

mandarin_meaning: 魁（kuí）：首領、魁首；在合成詞中可表示高大魁梧
english_meaning: kuí / kwai: leader, chief, head; also denotes being large or burly in compounds (e.g., 魁梧)
explanation_mandarin: 表示首領、領袖或首要人物；在合成詞如「魁首」表示領袖，在「魁梧」中表示高大、健壯。
explanation_english: Refers to a leader, chief, or foremost person; in compounds it can mean large and burly (e.g., 魁梧).

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢係我哋班嘅魁首，大家都聽佢嘅。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hai6 ngo5 dei6 baan1 ge3 kwai4 sau2, daai6 gaa1 dou1 teng1 keoi5 ge3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他是我們班的魁首，大家都聽他的。
examples.english_sentence: He is the leader of our class; everyone listens to him.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢個身形好魁梧，望落好有氣勢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 go3 san1 jing4 hou2 kwai4 ng4, mong6 lok6 hou2 jau5 hei3 sai3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他身材很魁梧，看起來很有氣勢。
examples.english_sentence: He is very burly; he looks imposing.

mandarin_meaning: 魁北克（加拿大東部的一個省，主要法語區）
english_meaning: Quebec (a province in eastern Canada, primarily French-speaking)
explanation_mandarin: 魁北克是加拿大的一個省，位於東部，官方語言以法語為主，省會為魁北克市，最大城市為蒙特利爾。
explanation_english: Quebec is a province in eastern Canada, predominantly French-speaking. Its capital is Quebec City and its largest city is Montreal.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我打算去魁北克旅遊。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 daa2 syun3 heoi3 kwai4 bak1 hak1 leoi5 jau4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我打算去魁北克旅遊。
examples.english_sentence: I'm planning to travel to Quebec.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 魁北克冬天好凍，成日落雪。
examples.jyutping_sentence: kwai4 bak1 hak1 dung1 tin1 hou2 dung3, sing4 jat6 lok6 syut3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 魁北克冬天很冷，經常下雪。
examples.english_sentence: Quebec is very cold in winter and it often snows.

mandarin_meaning: 魁梧（形容身材高大、強壯）
english_meaning: tall and strongly built; burly; imposing in stature
explanation_mandarin: 形容人身材高大、強壯，體格魁偉、有氣勢。
explanation_english: Describes a person who is tall, large, and strongly built — burly or imposing in appearance.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 嗰個保安好魁梧，企喺門口好有威嚴。
examples.jyutping_sentence: go2 go3 bou2 on1 hou2 kwai1 ng4, kei5 hai2 mun4 hau2 hou2 jau5 wai1 jim4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 那個保安很魁梧，站在門口很有威嚴。
examples.english_sentence: That security guard is very big and burly; standing at the entrance he looks very imposing.

mandarin_meaning: 魂；靈魂、精神
english_meaning: soul; spirit
explanation_mandarin: 表示人的靈魂或精神，也常出現在成語或複合詞中，如「魂不守舍」、「魂牽夢縈」、「魂飛魄散」。
explanation_english: Refers to a person's soul or spirit. Commonly appears in compounds and idioms (e.g. "魂不守舍", "魂牽夢縈", "魂飛魄散").

examples.cantonese_sentence: 聽到噩耗之後，佢整晚魂不守舍，瞓唔着覺。
examples.jyutping_sentence: teng1 dou3 ngok3 hou4 zi1 hau6, keoi5 zing2 maan5 wan4 bat1 sau2 se3, fan3 m4 zoek6 gaau3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 聽到噩耗之後，他整晚魂不守舍，睡不著覺。
examples.english_sentence: After hearing the bad news, he was distraught all night and couldn't sleep.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢對舊情人仍然魂牽夢縈。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 deoi3 gau6 cing4 jan4 jing4 jin4 wan4 hin1 mung6 jing4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他對舊情人仍然魂牽夢縈。
examples.english_sentence: He is still haunted by thoughts of his ex-lover.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 地震時大家驚到魂飛魄散。
examples.jyutping_sentence: dei6 zan3 si4 daai6 gaa1 geng1 dou3 wan4 fei1 pok3 saan3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 地震時大家驚得魂飛魄散。
examples.english_sentence: During the earthquake, everyone was terrified out of their wits.

mandarin_meaning: 魂断（hún duàn）：形容悲傷到靈魂似乎斷裂或消散，常作書面或文學用語，意指悲傷至極甚至喪命。
english_meaning: to have one's soul broken; to be heartbroken to the point of death or utter despair (literary/poetic).
explanation_mandarin: 用來形容因悲傷、絕望或思念而達到極度痛苦的狀態，帶有文學或書面色彩，常指悲傷到像靈魂斷裂或消散。
explanation_english: Used to describe an extreme state of sorrow or despair as if one's soul is broken or dispersed; a literary/poetic expression often meaning being heartbroken to death or utterly devastated.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢聽到舊愛結婚嘅消息，傷心到差啲魂斷。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 teng1 dou3 gau6 oi3 git3 fan1 ge3 siu1 sik1, soeng1 sam1 dou3 caa1 di1 wan4 dyun6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他聽到舊愛結婚的消息，傷心得差點魂斷。
examples.english_sentence: He heard that his ex had gotten married and was so heartbroken he nearly died of sorrow.

mandarin_meaning: 魂归天国 (hún guī tiān guó)，表示去世、过世
english_meaning: to pass away; to die (euphemism meaning one's soul returns to heaven)
explanation_mandarin: “魂归天国”是委婉说法，字面意思是“灵魂回到天国”，用来表示某人去世、过世。
explanation_english: “魂歸天國” is a euphemistic expression literally meaning “the soul returns to heaven,” used to indicate that someone has died.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢上個月魂歸天國，屋企人都好傷心。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 soeng6 go3 jyut6 wan4 gwai1 tin1 gwok3, uk1 kei5 jan4 dou1 hou2 soeng1 sam1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他上个月魂归天国，家里人都很伤心。
examples.english_sentence: He passed away last month; his family is very sad.

mandarin_meaning: 魂牽夢縈（hún qiān mèng yíng）：對某人或某事念念不忘，思念掛牽，縈繞心頭。
english_meaning: To be constantly thinking about or longing for someone or something; to have someone/something haunt one's thoughts and dreams.
partOfSpeech_mandarin: 成語 / 形容詞性短語
partOfSpeech_english: idiom (can function as verb phrase or adjective)
explanation_mandarin: 形容對人或事物深切思念、掛念，無法忘懷，常在心中和夢裡出現。
explanation_english: Describes intense longing or preoccupation with someone or something, so that the person or thing constantly occupies one's thoughts and dreams.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 自從佢離開之後，我成日都魂牽夢縈。
examples.jyutping_sentence: zi6 cung4 keoi5 lei4 hoi1 zi1 hau6, ngo5 sing4 jat6 dou1 wan4 hin1 mung6 jing4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 自從他離開之後，我總是魂牽夢萦。
examples.english_sentence: Since he/she left, I can't stop thinking about them; they haunt my dreams.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 嗰間老茶樓嘅味道令人魂牽夢縈，每次想起都好懷念。
examples.jyutping_sentence: go2 gaan1 lou5 caa4 lau4 ge3 mei6 dou6 ling6 jan4 wan4 hin1 mung6 jing4, mui5 ci3 soeng2 hei2 dou1 hou2 waai4 nim6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 那間老茶樓的味道讓人魂牽夢縈，每次想起都很懷念。
examples.english_sentence: The flavor of that old tea house lingers in one's mind; every time I recall it I'm filled with nostalgia.

mandarin_meaning: 調皮搗蛋或古靈精怪的人；俚語，用來形容機靈、狡黠或愛惡作劇的人（類似「鬼精」）
english_meaning: a little rascal; a mischievous or crafty person (Cantonese slang)
explanation_mandarin: 廣東話俚語，常用來形容一個人機靈、調皮、愛惡作劇或有點狡黠，語氣可戲謔或帶輕微貶義。與「鬼精」「鬼靈精怪」意近。
explanation_english: Cantonese slang used to describe someone who is clever in a mischievous way — a rascal or crafty person. The tone can be playful or mildly disparaging; similar in meaning to "鬼精" or "鬼靈精怪."

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢成日整蠱人，真係個魂精。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 sing4 jat6 zeng2 gu2 jan4, zan1 hai6 go3 wan4 zing1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他經常捉弄別人，真是個魂精。
examples.english_sentence: He always plays tricks on people — what a little rascal.

mandarin_meaning: 魂飞魄散 (hún fēi pò sàn) — 形容被吓得非常害怕或惊恐，仿佛魂魄都飞散了。
english_meaning: to be scared out of one's wits; to be terrified or panic-stricken (literally: soul flies and spirit scatters).
explanation_mandarin: 形容受到極大驚嚇，害怕到好像魂魄都飛走、散開一樣。也用來表示極度驚惶或驚慌失措。
explanation_english: Describes being extremely frightened or panicked, as if one's soul has flown away and the spirit has scattered. Often used to convey terror or being utterly shaken.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 聽到突然嘅巨響，我嚇到魂飛魄散。
examples.jyutping_sentence: teng1 dou3 dat6 jin4 ge3 geoi6 hoeng2, ngo5 haak3 dou3 wan4 fei1 pok3 saan3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 听到突然的巨响，我被吓得魂飞魄散。
examples.english_sentence: When I heard the sudden loud bang, I was terrified.

mandarin_meaning: 魂魄（指人的靈魂、精神）
english_meaning: soul; spirit (the soul or spiritual essence of a person)
explanation_mandarin: 指人的靈魂或精神（傳統上常說「魂」與「魄」），可以指死後的靈魂，也常用來形容受到驚嚇或精神恍惚。
explanation_english: Refers to a person's soul or spirit (traditionally the paired concepts of 魂 and 魄). It can mean the soul after death or be used to describe extreme fright or a disturbed/absent-minded state.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢嘅魂魄好似離咗身咁，半天冇反應。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 ge3 wan4 pok3 hou2 ci5 lei4 zo2 san1 gam2, bun3 tin1 mou5 faan2 jing3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他的魂魄好像離了身，半天沒有反應。
examples.english_sentence: His soul seemed to have left his body; he didn't respond for a long time.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 有啲人話清明節會祭拜亡者嘅魂魄。
examples.jyutping_sentence: jau5 di1 jan4 waa6 cing1 ming4 zit3 wui5 zai3 baai3 wong4 ze2 ge3 wan4 pok3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 有些人說清明節會祭拜亡者的魂魄。
examples.english_sentence: Some people say that during Tomb-Sweeping Day they honor the souls of the deceased.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢相信自己嘅魂魄俾人偷走咗。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 soeng1 seon3 zi6 gei2 ge3 wan4 pok3 bei2 jan4 tau1 zau2 zo2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他相信自己的魂魄被人偷走了。
examples.english_sentence: He believes his soul was stolen by someone.

mandarin_meaning: 魂不守舍；精神恍惚、心神不定
english_meaning: absent-minded; dazed; not fully present mentally
explanation_mandarin: 粤語俗語，字面上指「魂魄不齐」，用來形容一個人心神恍惚、注意力不集中或精神狀態異常。
explanation_english: A Cantonese colloquial expression literally meaning 'souls not together'. It describes someone who is dazed, distracted, absent-minded, or not mentally present.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢聽到噩耗之後，成日魂魄唔齊，做乜都唔專心。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 teng1 dou3 ngak6 hou3 zi1 hau6, sing4 jat6 wan4 pok3 m4 cai4, zou6 mat1 dou1 m4 zyun1 sam1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他聽到噩耗之後，整天魂不守舍，做什麼都不專心。
examples.english_sentence: After hearing the bad news, he's been absent-minded all the time and can't focus on anything.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 考試前一晚佢緊張到無訓好，第二日考場入面個樣好似魂魄唔齊。
examples.jyutping_sentence: haau2 si3 cin4 jat1 maan5 keoi5 gan2 zoeng1 dou3 mou4 fan3 hou2, dai6 ji6 jat6 haau2 coeng4 jap6 min6 go3 joeng6 hou2 ci5 wan4 pok3 m4 cai4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 考試前一晚他緊張到沒睡好，第二天考場裡面神情恍惚。
examples.english_sentence: He was so nervous the night before the exam that he didn't sleep well; in the exam room the next day he looked dazed.

mandarin_meaning: 魂魄；精神；勇氣、魄力
english_meaning: soul or spirit; also courage, boldness, driving force
explanation_mandarin: 「魄」可指人的魂魄或精神，也常用來表示勇氣與魄力，常見於「魂魄」、「魄力」等詞語中。
explanation_english: Refers to the soul or spirit; can also denote courage, boldness, or driving force. Commonly appears in compounds like '魂魄' and '魄力'.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢做事好有魄力，唔驚失敗。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 zou6 si6 hou2 jau5 pok3 lik6, m4 geng1 sat1 baai6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他做事很有魄力，不怕失敗。
examples.english_sentence: He works with a lot of determination; not afraid of failure.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢嚇到魂飛魄散。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 haak3 dou3 wan4 fei1 pok3 saan3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他被嚇得魂飛魄散。
examples.english_sentence: He was scared out of his wits.

mandarin_meaning: 魄力，指果斷、有膽識和勇氣去做重大或冒險決定並付諸行動
english_meaning: boldness; guts; decisiveness — the courage and resolve to make major or risky decisions and act on them
explanation_mandarin: 用來形容一個人做事果斷、有膽識、有勇氣承擔風險，能夠做出重大或冒險的決定並執行。
explanation_english: Describes a person's decisiveness and courage — the ability to take bold actions or make significant, sometimes risky, decisions and follow through.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢好有魄力，唔驚做大決定。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hou2 jau5 pok3 lik6, m4 geng1 zou6 daai6 kyut3 ding6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他很有魄力，不怕做重大決定。
examples.english_sentence: He has a lot of guts and isn't afraid to make big decisions.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 創業需要魄力同埋毅力。
examples.jyutping_sentence: cong3 jip6 seoi1 jiu3 pok3 lik6 tung4 maai4 ngai6 lik6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 創業需要魄力和毅力。
examples.english_sentence: Starting a business requires boldness and perseverance.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢做事有魄力，但有時太急躁。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 zou6 si6 jau5 pok3 lik6, daan6 jau5 si4 taai3 gap1 zou6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他做事有魄力，但有時太急躁。
examples.english_sentence: He works decisively, but sometimes is too impetuous.

mandarin_meaning: 魅（mèi）：魅力、迷惑、妖魅，常見於複合詞如「魅力」「魅惑」
english_meaning: charm; charisma; enchant; bewitch; (sometimes refers to a bewitching/demonic quality in compounds)
partOfSpeech_mandarin: 名詞／動詞（主要用於複合詞）
explanation_mandarin: 漢字「魅」多用於複合詞，表示吸引、迷惑或帶有妖魅色彩的特質。例如「魅力」指吸引人的特質，「魅惑」指使人迷惑。現代漢語中單獨使用較少。
explanation_english: The character '魅' commonly appears in compound words to denote charm, allure, or a bewitching/demonic quality (e.g., '魅力', '魅惑'). It is rarely used alone in modern speech and typically functions as a morpheme within compounds.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢嘅笑容好有魅力，令人好難抗拒。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 ge3 siu3 jung4 hou2 jau5 mei6 lik6, ling6 jan4 hou2 naan4 kong3 geoi3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他/她的笑容很有魅力，令人很難抗拒。
examples.english_sentence: Her smile is very charming, making it hard to resist.

mandarin_meaning: 魅力 (mèilì)：指吸引人的特質或能力，包含外表、性格或事物的吸引力。
english_meaning: charm, attractiveness, appeal, charisma
explanation_mandarin: 表示能吸引別人注意或喜愛的特質，既可以指人的氣質或外表，也可以指事物帶來的吸引力。
explanation_english: Refers to an attractive quality that draws people in; can describe a person's charisma or physical appeal, or the appealing quality of an object or place.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢有好大魅力，好多人都鍾意佢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 jau5 hou2 daai6 mei6 lik6, hou2 do1 jan4 dou1 zung1 ji3 keoi5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他很有魅力，很多人都喜歡他。
examples.english_sentence: He is very charming; many people like him.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢位演員演技同魅力都好出眾。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 wai2 jin2 jyun4 jin2 gei6 tung4 mei6 lik6 dou1 hou2 ceot1 zung3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 這位演員的演技和魅力都很出眾。
examples.english_sentence: This actor's acting and charisma are both outstanding.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 香港夜景嘅魅力吸引唔少遊客。
examples.jyutping_sentence: hoeng1 gong2 je6 ging2 ge3 mei6 lik6 kap1 jan5 m4 siu2 jau4 haak3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 香港夜景的魅力吸引了不少遊客。
examples.english_sentence: The charm of Hong Kong's night view attracts many tourists.

mandarin_meaning: 魍 (wǎng) — 鬼怪、妖怪；常見於合成詞「魍魎」，泛指山林或民間傳說中的惡鬼或妖物。
english_meaning: A type of demon, goblin, or spirit; often seen in the compound 'wangliang' referring to spirits or goblins in folklore.
explanation_mandarin: 單字「魍」本義為古代傳說中的鬼怪或妖物，現多見於詞語「魍魎」，用來指代各類山林或民間傳說的精怪。
explanation_english: The character '魍' refers to an ancient folkloric spirit or goblin. It is most commonly seen in the compound '魍魎' (wangliang) and denotes various kinds of mythical forest or folk spirits.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 古書講有魍魎出入山林，村民好驚。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gu2 syu1 gong2 jau5 mong5 loeng5 ceot1 jap6 saan1 lam4, cyun1 man4 hou2 geng1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 古書記載有魍魎出沒山林，村民很害怕。
examples.english_sentence: Ancient books record that wangliang (spirits) appear in the forests, and villagers are very frightened.

mandarin_meaning: （古代傳說中的）妖怪、作祟的鬼怪（為「魍魎」中的一個字）
english_meaning: an evil spirit or goblin in Chinese folklore (part of the compound '魍魎')
explanation_mandarin: 魎常與「魍」相對，合稱「魍魎」，指古代傳說中會作祟或搗亂的妖怪、鬼魅。屬於文言或民間傳說用詞。
explanation_english: Loeng refers to a spirit or demon in traditional Chinese folklore, often paired with 'mong' (魍) to form '魍魎' and denotes mischievous or malevolent spirits. The term is literary and folkloric.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 阿媽成日話山入面有魎，夜晚唔好一個人行。
examples.jyutping_sentence: aa3 maa1 sing4 jat6 waa6 saan1 jap6 min6 jau5 loeng5, je6 maan5 m4 hou2 jat1 go3 jan4 hang4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 媽媽常說山裡有魎，晚上不要一個人去。
examples.english_sentence: My mother often said there are spirits (魎) in the mountains; don't go alone at night.

mandarin_meaning: 魏（姓氏；历史上若干国名，如战国时期的魏国、南北朝的北魏）
english_meaning: Wei (a Chinese surname; name of historical states such as the Wèi state in the Warring States period and Northern Wei dynasty)
partOfSpeech_english: noun (proper noun — surname / name of a state)
explanation_mandarin: 「魏」常作中國姓氏，也指歷史上的國名（如戰國的魏、北魏等）。在廣東話中讀作 ngai6。
explanation_english: The character 魏 is used as a Chinese surname and as the name of historical states (e.g., the Wèi state in the Warring States period, Northern Wei). In Cantonese it is pronounced ngai6.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 魏先生今日冇嚟返工。
examples.jyutping_sentence: Ngai6 sin1 saang1 gam1 jat6 mou5 lai4 faan1 gung1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 魏先生今天没来上班。
examples.english_sentence: Mr. Wei didn't come to work today.

mandarin_meaning: 魏晋南北朝（指魏、晋及南北朝時期）
english_meaning: Wei, Jin, and the Northern and Southern Dynasties (a period in Chinese history)
explanation_mandarin: 指中國歷史上從三國末期到隋朝前的時代，包含魏、晉及南北朝各朝代，約公元220年至589年，特徵有政權更替頻繁、民族遷徙與文化交流。
explanation_english: Refers to the period in Chinese history spanning from the end of the Three Kingdoms to the pre-Sui era, encompassing the Wei, Jin, and the Northern and Southern dynasties (approx. 220–589 CE). It was marked by frequent regime changes, population movements, and cultural interchange.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 魏晉南北朝係中國一個重要嘅歷史時期。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngai6 zeon3 naam4 bak1 ciu4 hai6 zung1 gwok3 jat1 go3 zung6 jiu3 ge3 lik6 si2 si4 kei4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 魏晋南北朝是中国一个重要的历史时期。
examples.english_sentence: The Wei, Jin, and the Northern and Southern dynasties were an important period in Chinese history.

mandarin_meaning: 魑（通常指山林中的妖怪或惡靈）
english_meaning: a demonic or malevolent spirit; mountain demon (as in folklore)
explanation_mandarin: 『魑』常與『魅』連用（魑魅），指民間傳說中的妖怪或惡靈，尤其指山林、荒野等處作祟的怪物。
explanation_english: ‘魑’ refers to a demon or malevolent spirit in folklore, often appearing in the compound ‘魑魅’ to denote mountain or wild spirits that cause mischief.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 古書講山中有魑魅作祟，夜裏唔好一個人行山。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gu2 syu1 gong2 saan1 zung1 jau5 ci1 mui6 zok3 seoi3, je6 leoi5 m4 hou2 jat1 go3 jan4 haang4 saan1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 古書說山裡有魑魅作祟，晚上不要一個人爬山。
examples.english_sentence: Ancient books say there are mountain demons causing trouble in the mountains; don't hike alone at night.

mandarin_meaning: 指各種鬼怪；也比喻社會上形形色色的邪惡勢力或壞人。
english_meaning: Literally all kinds of ghosts and monsters; figuratively, nefarious beings, corrupt elements or malicious forces.
explanation_mandarin: 原指各種鬼怪和妖魔，後用來比喻社會上各種邪惡、混亂或可怕的人與勢力。
explanation_english: Originally denotes various ghosts and monsters; later used metaphorically for the many kinds of evil, chaotic, or malicious people and forces in society.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 近年啲社會新聞成日講到政商勾結，真係魑魅魍魎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gan6 nin4 di1 se5 wui6 san1 man4 sing4 jat6 gong2 dou3 zing3 soeng1 gau1 git3, zan1 hai6 ci1 mei6 mong5 loeng5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 近年這些社會新聞老是講到政商勾結，真是魑魅魍魎。
examples.english_sentence: Recent news often talks about collusion between politicians and businessmen — it's really full of nefarious people.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢本小說講盡古代嘅鬼怪傳說，入面有好多魑魅魍魎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 bun2 siu2 syut3 gong2 zeon6 gu2 doi6 ge3 gwai2 gwaai3 cyun4 syut3, jap6 min6 jau5 hou2 do1 ci1 mei6 mong5 loeng5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 這本小說講盡了古代的鬼怪傳說，裡面有很多魑魅魍魎。
examples.english_sentence: This novel covers ancient ghost and monster legends; inside it there are many demons and spirits.

mandarin_meaning: 魔 (mó)：通常指魔鬼、惡靈或與超自然、巫術相關的力量；也用作詞綴表示某種癮性或迷戀（如「魔性」、「魔法」）。
english_meaning: mo: demon/devil; malevolent spirit; supernatural/magical force; also used as a morpheme in compounds to indicate magic or an obsessive/mesmerizing quality (e.g., 'magic', 'mesmerizing charm').
explanation_mandarin: 單字「魔」常用來指代魔鬼、妖魔或魔力，也常與其他字組成詞語（如「魔法」「魔性」「魔鬼」），表達超自然或強烈吸引力的含義。
explanation_english: The character '魔' commonly denotes a demon, evil spirit, or magical force. It is frequently used in compounds (e.g., '魔法' = magic, '魔性' = mesmerizing/obsessive quality) to express supernatural or strongly captivating meanings.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢學識咗一啲簡單嘅魔法。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hok6 sik1 zo2 jat1 di1 gaan2 daan1 ge3 mo1 faat3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他学会了一些简单的魔法。
examples.english_sentence: He learned some simple magic.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢個笑容有魔性，好多人畀佢吸引。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 go3 siu3 jung4 jau5 mo1 sing3, hou2 do1 jan4 bei2 keoi5 kap1 jan5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他的笑容有魔性，许多人被他吸引。
examples.english_sentence: His smile has a mesmerizing charm; many people are attracted to him.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢好似畀魔迷住咗，成日做啲奇怪嘢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hou2 ci5 bei2 mo1 mai4 zyu6 zo2, sing4 jat6 zou6 di1 kei4 gwaai3 je5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他好像被魔迷住了，整天做些奇怪的事。
examples.english_sentence: He seems possessed/obsessed, doing strange things all the time.

mandarin_meaning: 魔力 (mólì)；魔法的力量或具有吸引力、魅力的特質
english_meaning: magic power; magical force; charm or irresistible attraction
explanation_mandarin: 指超自然或像魔法般的力量，也常用來形容某人或某物具有強烈的吸引力或魅力。
explanation_english: Refers to supernatural or magical power; also used figuratively to describe someone or something that has a strong, irresistible attraction or charm.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢有一種無法抗拒嘅魔力。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 jau5 jat1 zung2 mou4 faat3 kong3 geoi3 ge3 mo1 lik6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他/她有一种无法抗拒的魔力。
examples.english_sentence: He/She has an irresistible magic/charm.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 嗰套電影嘅魔力令我睇咗兩次。
examples.jyutping_sentence: go2 tou3 din6 jing2 ge3 mo1 lik6 ling6 ngo5 tai2 zo2 loeng5 ci3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 那部电影的魔力让我看了两遍。
examples.english_sentence: The movie's magic made me watch it twice.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢位歌手嘅舞台魔力吸引咗好多粉絲。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 wai2 go1 sau2 ge3 mou1 lik6 kap1 jan5 zo2 hou2 do1 fan2 si1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这位歌手的舞台魔力吸引了很多粉丝。
examples.english_sentence: This singer's stage charisma/magic attracted many fans.

mandarin_meaning: 魔咒
english_meaning: spell; curse; enchantment
explanation_mandarin: 指具有神秘力量的咒語或詛咒；也可比喻指反覆出現、難以擺脫的不幸或慣性問題。
explanation_english: Refers to a magical spell or curse; figuratively used to describe a persistent misfortune or an apparently inescapable negative pattern.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢好似中咗魔咒，成日遲到。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hou2 ci5 zung1 zo2 mo1 zau3, sing4 jat6 ci4 dou3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他好像中了魔咒，老是迟到。
examples.english_sentence: He seems to be under a spell; he's always late.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢隊球隊似乎有個魔咒，連續幾年都贏唔到冠軍。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 deoi6 kau4 deoi6 si6 fu1 jau5 go3 mo1 zau3, lin4 zuk6 gei2 nin4 dou1 jing4 m4 dou3 gun1 gwan1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 這支球隊似乎有個魔咒，連續幾年都贏不了冠軍。
examples.english_sentence: The team seems to have a curse; they haven't been able to win the championship for years.

mandarin_meaning: 魔女（mónǚ）：女巫、會施展魔法或被認為有超自然力量的女性
english_meaning: witch; a female practitioner of magic or sorceress (also used figuratively for a bewitching or malicious woman)
explanation_mandarin: 指會施魔法或被認為有巫術、超自然能力的女性；在口語或文學中也可作比喻，用來形容性格陰狠或有魅力令人難以抗拒的女性。
explanation_english: Refers to a woman who practices magic or is believed to possess supernatural powers. In speech or literature it can also be used figuratively to describe a malevolent or strangely alluring woman.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 電影入面嗰個魔女好有魅力，但又好危險。
examples.jyutping_sentence: din6 jing2 jap6 min6 go2 go3 mo1 neoi5 hou2 jau5 mui6 lik6, daan6 jau6 hou2 ngai4 him2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 电影里那个魔女很有魅力，但又很危险。
examples.english_sentence: The witch in the movie is very alluring but also very dangerous.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢俾人講係個魔女，其實只係性格難相處。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 bei2 jan4 gong2 hai6 go3 mo1 neoi5, kei4 sat6 zi2 hai6 sing3 gaak3 naan4 soeng1 cyu3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 她被人说是个魔女，其实只是性格难相处。
examples.english_sentence: People call her a witch, but she's actually just difficult to get along with.

mandarin_meaning: 魔幻（móhuàn）：具有魔法、超現實或奇幻色彩
english_meaning: magical; fantastical; having elements of magic or fantasy
explanation_mandarin: 用來形容事物具有魔法或超現實、奇幻的特質，常用於描述電影、故事、場景或氛圍。
explanation_english: Used to describe something that has magical, surreal, or fantastical qualities; commonly applied to movies, stories, scenes, or atmospheres.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢套電影好魔幻，感覺似入咗奇幻世界。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 tou3 din6 jing2 hou2 mo1 waan6, gam2 gok3 ci5 jap6 zo2 kei4 waan6 sai3 gaai3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这部电影很魔幻，感觉像进入了奇幻世界。
examples.english_sentence: This movie is very magical; it feels like entering a fantasy world.

mandarin_meaning: 魔掌（mózhǎng）：指邪惡勢力或壞人控制、掌握的力量或範圍，常作比喻
english_meaning: the clutches/grasp of evil; metaphorically, being under someone's malevolent control
explanation_mandarin: 用來比喻被邪惡或惡勢力掌控、支配的狀況；也可指某人或組織對他人的殘酷控制。
explanation_english: Used metaphorically to describe being controlled or dominated by evil forces or malicious actors; can denote someone's cruel or oppressive control over others.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 嗰間黑幫控制咗成條街，好多人都喺佢哋嘅魔掌之中。
examples.jyutping_sentence: go2 gaan1 hak1 bong1 hung3 zai3 zo2 seng4 tiu4 gaai1, hou2 do1 jan4 dou1 hai6 keoi5 dei6 ge3 mo1 zoeng2 zi1 zung1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 那個黑幫控制了整條街，很多人都在他們的魔掌之中。
